english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad cures all diseases; he alone is attached to it, whom the Dear Lord attaches.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naame naam milai vadiaaee jis no ma(n)n vasaae ||2||
english: Through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; he alone obtains it, whose mind is filled with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai taa phal paae sach karanee sukh saar ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the fruitful rewards are obtained. This true lifestyle beings sublime peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se jan niramal jo har laage har naame dharahi piaar ||3||
english: Those humble beings who are attached to the Lord are immaculate; they enshrine love for the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin kee ren milai taa(n) masatak laaee jin satigur pooraa dhiaaiaa ||
english: If I obtain the dust of their feet, I apply it to my forehead. They meditate on the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak tin kee ren poorai bhaag paaeeai jinee raam naam chit laaiaa ||4||3||13||
english: O Nanak, this dust is obtained only by perfect destiny. They focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||4||3||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabad beechaare so jan saachaa jin kai hiradai saachaa soee ||
english: That humble being who contemplates the Word of the Shabad is true; the True Lord is within his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਤਾਂ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saachee bhagat karahi din raatee taa(n) tan dookh na hoee ||1||
english: If someone performs true devotional worship day and night, then his body will not feel pain. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhagat kahai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone calls him, "Devotee, devotee."

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve bhagat na paaeeai poorai bhaag milai prabh soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But without serving the True Guru, devotional worship is not obtained. Only through perfect destiny does one meet God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਿਦੂ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mool gavaavahi laabh maagahi laahaa laabh kidoo hoee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs lose their capital, and still, they demand profits. How can they earn any profit?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jamakaal sadaa hai sir oopar doojai bhaai pat khoee ||2||
english: The Messenger of Death is always hovering above their heads. In the love of duality, they lose their honor. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bahale bhekh bhavahi din raatee haumai rog na jaaee ||
english: Trying on all sorts of religious robes, they wander around day and night, but the disease of their egotism is not cured.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paR paR loojhahi baad vakhaanahi mil maaiaa surat gavaaee ||3||
english: Reading and studying, they argue and debate; attached to Maya, they lose their awareness. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi param gat paavahi naam milai vadiaaee ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with the supreme status; through the Naam, they are blessed with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam jinaa man vasiaa dar saachai pat paaee ||4||4||14||
english: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Naam, are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||4||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh aasaa nahee utarai doojai bhaai khuaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukh cannot escape false hope. In the love of duality, he is ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਦਰੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੁ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਕਬਹੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਚਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: udar nai saan na bhareeai kabahoo trisanaa agan pachaae ||1||
english: His belly is like a river - it is never filled up. He is consumed by the fire of desire. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d raam ras raate ||
english: Eternally blissful are those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam dubidhaa man bhaagee har har a(n)mrit pee tripataate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, fills their hearts, and duality runs away from their minds. Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape paarabraham srisat jin saajee sir sir dha(n)dhai laae ||
english: The Supreme Lord God Himself created the Universe; He links each and every person to their tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu keeaa jin aape aape doojai laae ||2||
english: He Himself created love and attachment to Maya; He Himself attaches the mortals to duality. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tis no kihu kaheeai je doojaa hovai sabh tudhai maahi samaae ||
english: If there were any other, then I would speak to him; all will be merged in You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan tat beechaaraa jotee jot milaae ||3||
english: The Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; his light merges into the Light. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so prabh saachaa sad hee saachaa saachaa sabh aakaaraa ||
english: God is True, Forever True, and all His Creation is True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sojhee paaee sach naam nisataaraa ||4||5||15||
english: O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding; the True Name brings emancipation. ||4||5||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi pret jinhee raam na pachhaataa satajug param ha(n)s beechaaree ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who do not realize the Lord are goblins. In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the supreme soul-swans contemplated the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duaapur tretai maanas varatahi viralai haumai maaree ||1||
english: In the Silver Age of Dwaapur Yuga, and the Brass Age of Traytaa Yuga, mankind prevailed, but only a rare few subdued their egos. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi raam naam vadiaaee ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness is obtained through the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jug jug guramukh eko jaataa vin naavai mukat na paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs know the One Lord; without the Name, liberation is not attained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖੈ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam lakhai jan saachaa guramukh ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is revealed in the heart of the True Lord's humble servant. It dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap tare sagale kul taare jinee raam naam liv laaee ||2||
english: Those who are lovingly focused on the Lord's Name save themselves; they save all their ancestors as well. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh hai gun kaa daataa avagan sabad jalaae ||
english: My Lord God is the Giver of virtue. The Word of the Shabad burns away all faults and demerits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin man vasiaa se jan sohe hiradai naam vasaae ||3||
english: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam are beautiful; they enshrine the Naam within their hearts. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ghar dar mahal satiguroo dikhaaiaa ra(n)g siu raleeaa maanai ||
english: The True Guru has revealed to me the Lord's Home and His Court, and the Mansion of His Presence. I joyfully enjoy His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jo kichh kahai s bhalaa kar maanai naanak naam vakhaanai ||4||6||16||
english: Whatever He says, I accept as good; Nanak chants the Naam. ||4||6||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manasaa manahi samaai lai gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: The desires of the mind are absorbed in the mind, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poore te sojhee pavai phir marai na vaaro vaar ||1||
english: Understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru, and then the mortal does not die over and over again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere raam naam aadhaar ||
english: My mind takes the Support of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa sabh ichh pujaavanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; the Lord is the Fulfiller of all desires. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi eko rav rahiaa gur bin boojh na paai ||
english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading amongst all; without the Guru, this understanding is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh pragat hoaa meraa har prabh anadin har gun gaai ||2||
english: My Lord God has been revealed to me, and I have become Gurmukh. Night and day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa har ek hai hor thai sukh na paahi ||
english: The One Lord is the Giver of peace; peace is not found anywhere else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur jinee na seviaa daataa se a(n)t gae pachhutaahi ||3||
english: Those who do not serve the Giver, the True Guru, depart regretfully in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa phir dukh na laagai dhaai ||
english: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is obtained, and the mortal does not suffer in pain any longer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak har bhagat paraapat hoee jotee jot samaai ||4||7||17||
english: Nanak has been blessed with devotional worship of the Lord; his light has merged into the Light. ||4||7||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਭੂਲਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo jagat bauraanaa bhoolaa chotaa khaaee ||
english: Without the Guru, the world is insane; confused and deluded, it is beaten, and it suffers.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mai sadaa dukh paae dar kee khabar na paaee ||1||
english: It dies and dies again, and is reborn, always in pain, but it is unaware of the Lord's Gate. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man sadaa rahahu satigur kee saranaa ||
english: O my mind, remain always in the Protection of the True Guru's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hiradai har naam meethaa sad laagaa gurasabade bhavajal taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those people, to whose hearts the Lord's Name seems sweet, are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhekh karai bahut chit dolai a(n)tar kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: The mortal wears various religious robes, but his consciousness is unsteady; deep within, he is filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਭੂਖ ਅਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਭਉਕਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar tisaa bhookh at bahutee bhaukat phirai dar baar ||2||
english: Deep within is the great thirst and immense hunger; he wanders from door to door. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad marahi phir jeevahi tin kau mukat duaar ||
english: Those who die in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are reborn; they find the door of liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadaa sukh hovai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||3||
english: With constant peace and tranquility deep within, they enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai karanaa kichhoo na jaaee ||
english: As it pleases Him, He inspires us to act. Nothing else can be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad samhaale raam naam vadiaaee ||4||8||18||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Lord's Name. ||4||8||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa mohi khuaaiaa dukh khate dukh khaai ||
english: Lost in egotism, Maya and attachment, the mortal earns pain, and eats pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਹਲਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh halak dukh bhaaree bin bibek bharamaai ||1||
english: The great disease, the rabid disease of greed, is deep within him; he wanders around indiscriminately. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dhrig jeevan saisaar ||
english: The life of the self-willed manmukh in this world is cursed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam supanai nahee chetiaa har siu kade na laagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not remember the Lord's Name, even in his dreams. He is never in love with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pasooaa karam karai nahee boojhai kooR kamaavai kooRo hoi ||
english: He acts like a beast, and does not understand anything. Practicing falsehood, he becomes false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta ulatee hovai khoj lahai jan koi ||2||
english: But when the mortal meets the True Guru, his way of looking at the world changes. How rare are those humble beings who seek and find the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam ridai sad vasiaa paaiaa gunee nidhaan ||
english: That person, whose heart is forever filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, obtains the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee pooraa paaiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, he finds the Perfect Lord; the egotistical pride of his mind is eradicated. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare karaae aape maarag paae ||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act. He Himself places us on the path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੯॥
transliteration: aape guramukh de vadiaaee naanak naam samaae ||4||9||19||
english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness; O Nanak, he merges in the Naam. ||4||9||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: meree pateeaa likhahu har govi(n)d gopaalaa ||
english: Upon my writing tablet, I write the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਾਥੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai phaathe jam jaalaa ||
english: In the love of duality, the mortals are caught in the noose of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur kare meree pratipaalaa ||
english: The True Guru nurtures and sustains me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa merai naalaa ||1||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is always with me. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur upades prahilaad har ucharai ||
english: Following his Guru's instructions, Prahlaad chanted the Lord's Name;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਗਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saasanaa te baalak gam na karai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: he was a child, but he was not afraid when his teacher yelled at him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maataa upadesai prahilaad piaare ||
english: Prahlaad's mother gave her beloved son some advice:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: putr raam naam chhodahu jeeu lehu ubaare ||
english: "My son, you must abandon the Lord's Name, and save your life!"

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prahilaad kahai sunahu meree maai ||
english: Prahlaad said: "Listen, O my mother;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam na chhodaa gur deeaa bujhaai ||2||
english: I shall never give up the Lord's Name. My Guru has taught me this." ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਡਾ ਮਰਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)daa marakaa sabh jaai pukaare ||
english: Sandaa and Markaa, his teachers, went to his father the king, and complained:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਗੜਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਵਿਗਾੜੇ ॥
transliteration: prahilaad aap vigaRiaa sabh chaataRe vigaaRe ||
english: "Prahlaad himself has gone astray, and he leads all the other pupils astray."

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dusat sabhaa mahi ma(n)tr pakaaiaa ||
english: In the court of the wicked king, a plan was hatched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prahalaad kaa raakhaa hoi raghuraaiaa ||3||
english: God is the Savior of Prahlaad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haath khaRag kar dhaaiaa at aha(n)kaar ||
english: With sword in hand, and with great egotistical pride, Prahlaad's father ran up to him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਝੁ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har teraa kahaa tujh lae ubaar ||
english: "Where is your Lord, who will save you?"

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੈਆਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਥੰਮੑ ਉਪਾੜਿ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi bhaiaan roop nikasiaa tha(n)mh upaaR ||
english: In an instant, the Lord appeared in a dreadful form, and shattered the pillar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: haranaakhas nakhee bidaariaa prahalaad leeaa ubaar ||4||
english: Harnaakhash was torn apart by His claws, and Prahlaad was saved. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa ke har jeeu kaaraj savaare ||
english: The Dear Lord completes the tasks of the Saints.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad jan ke ikeeh kul udhaare ||
english: He saved twenty-one generations of Prahlaad's descendents.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad haumai bikh maare ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the poison of egotism is neutralized.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam sa(n)t nisataare ||5||10||20||
english: O Nanak, through the Name of the Lord, the Saints are emancipated. ||5||10||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੈਤ ਲਾਇ ਦਿਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape dait laai dite sa(n)t janaa kau aape raakhaa soee ||
english: The Lord Himself makes demons pursue the Saints, and He Himself saves them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo teree sadaa saranaaee tin man dukh na hoee ||1||
english: Those who remain forever in Your Sanctuary, O Lord - their minds are never touched by sorrow. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jug jug bhagataa kee rakhadaa aaiaa ||
english: In each and every age, the Lord saves the honor of His devotees.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਰਪਣੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dait putr prahalaad gaaitree tarapan kichhoo na jaanai sabade mel milaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Prahlaad, the demon's son, knew nothing of the Hindu morning prayer, the Gayatri, and nothing about ceremonial water-offerings to his ancestors; but through the Word of the Shabad, he was united in the Lord's Union. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi din raatee dubidhaa sabade khoee ||
english: Night and day, he performed devotional worship service, day and night, and through the Shabad, his duality was eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa niramal hai jo sach raate sach vasiaa man soee ||2||
english: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate and pure; the True Lord abides within their minds. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moorakh dubidhaa paRhahi mool na pachhaanahi birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: The fools in duality read, but they do not understand anything; they waste their lives uselessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੈਤੁ ਚਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)daa karahi dusat dait chiRaaiaa ||3||
english: The wicked demon slandered the Saint, and stirred up trouble. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਡਰੈ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad dubidhaa na paRai har naam na chhodai darai na kisai daa daraaiaa ||
english: Prahlaad did not read in duality, and he did not abandon the Lord's Name; he was not afraid of any fear.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਾ ਦੈਤੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kaa har jeeu raakhaa daitai kaal neRaa aaiaa ||4||
english: The Dear Lord became the Savior of the Saint, and the demonic Death could not even approach him. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanee paij aape raakhai bhagataa(n) dei vadiaaee ||
english: The Lord Himself saved his honor, and blessed his devotee with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ਅੰਧੈ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak haranaakhas nakhee bidaariaa a(n)dhai dar kee khabar na paaee ||5||11||21||
english: O Nanak, Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord with His claws; the blind demon knew nothing of the Lord's Court. ||5||11||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 4 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Bhairao, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗਿ ਲਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har jan sa(n)t kar kirapaa pag laain ||
english: The Lord, in His Mercy, attaches mortals to the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har bhaj surat samaain ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, vibrate and meditate on the Lord; let your awareness be absorbed in Him. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man har bhaj naam naraain ||
english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord and the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa kare sukhadaataa guramukh bhavajal har naam taraain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of Peace, grants His Grace; the Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat saadh mel har gaain ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramatee le raam rasaain ||2||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur saadhoo a(n)mrit giaan sar naain ||
english: Bathe in the pool of ambrosial nectar, the spiritual wisdom of the Holy Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਗਾਵਾਇਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh kilavikh paap gae gaavaain ||3||
english: All sins will be eliminated and eradicated. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: too aape karataa srisat dharaain ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator, the Support of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak mel teraa daas dasaain ||4||1||
english: Please unite servant Nanak with Yourself; he is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਫਲ ਸਾ ਘਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bol har naam saphal saa gharee ||
english: Fruitful is that moment when the Lord's Name is spoken.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur upades sabh dukh paraharee ||1||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, all pains are taken away. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mere man har bhaj naam naraharee ||
english: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਉ ਤਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa melahu gur pooraa satasa(n)gat sa(n)g si(n)dh bhau taree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, be merciful, and unite me with the Perfect Guru. Joining with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan dhiaai man har simaree ||
english: Meditate on the Life of the World; remember the Lord in your mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kot kota(n)tar tere paap paraharee ||2||
english: Millions upon millions of your sins shall be taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat saadh dhoor mukh paree ||
english: In the Sat Sangat, apply the dust of the feet of the holy to your face;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: isanaan keeo athasath surasaree ||3||
english: this is how to bathe in the sixty-eight sacred shrines, and the Ganges. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh kau har kirapaa karee ||
english: I am a fool; the Lord has shown mercy to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਤਾਰਣ ਹਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak taario taaran haree ||4||2||
english: The Savior Lord has saved servant Nanak. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sukrit karanee saar japamaalee ||
english: To do good deeds is the best rosary.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hiradai pher chalai tudh naalee ||1||
english: Chant on the beads within your heart, and it shall go along with you. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu banavaalee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Lord of the forest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa melahu satasa(n)gat toot gaee maaiaa jam jaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Have mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, so that I may be released from Maya's noose of death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa ghaal jin ghaalee ||
english: Whoever, as Gurmukh, serves and works hard,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਟਕਸਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis ghaReeai sabad sachee takasaalee ||2||
english: is molded and shaped in the true mint of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਦਿਖਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har agam agochar gur agam dikhaalee ||
english: The Guru has revealed to me the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vich kaaiaa nagar ladhaa har bhaalee ||3||
english: Searching within the body-village, I have found the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik har pitaa pratipaalee ||
english: I am just a child; the Lord is my Father, who nurtures and cherishes me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak taarahu nadar nihaalee ||4||3||
english: Please save servant Nanak, Lord; bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat tere too sabhanaa maahi ||
english: All hearts are Yours, Lord; You are in all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar koee naahi ||1||
english: There is nothing at all except You. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa mere man jaap ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau tudh saalaahee too meraa har prabh baap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I praise You, O Lord God, You are my Father. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah har prabh soi ||
english: Wherever I look, I see only the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh terai vas doojaa avar na koi ||2||
english: All are under Your control; there is no other at all. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kau tum har raakhiaa bhaavai ||
english: O Lord, when it is Your Will to save someone,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis kai neRai koi na jaavai ||3||
english: then nothing can threaten him. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: too jal thal maheeal sabh tai bharapoor ||
english: You are totally pervading and permeating the waters, the lands, the skies and all places.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak har jap haajaraa hajoor ||4||4||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Ever-present Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa sa(n)t har kee har moorat jis hiradai har naam muraar ||
english: The Lord's Saint is the embodiment of the Lord; within his heart is the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: masatak bhaag hovai jis likhiaa so guramat hiradai har naam samhaar ||1||
english: One who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, follows the Guru's Teachings, and contemplates the Name of the Lord within his heart. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: madhusoodan japeeai ur dhaar ||
english: Enshrine Him in your heart, and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dehee nagar tasakar pa(n)ch dhaatoo gurasabadee har kaadhe maar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The five plundering thieves are in the body-village; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord has beaten them and driven them out. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਜ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kaa har setee man maaniaa tin kaaraj har aap savaar ||
english: Those whose minds are satisfied with the Lord - the Lord Himself resolves their affairs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin chookee muhataajee lokan kee har a(n)geekaar keeaa karataar ||2||
english: Their subservience and their dependence on other people is ended; the Creator Lord is on their side. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਤਾਂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mataa masoorat taa(n) kichh keejai je kichh hovai har baahar ||
english: If something were beyond the realm of the Lord's Power, only then would we have recourse to consult someone else.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare soee bhal hosee har dhiaavahu anadin naam muraar ||3||
english: Whatever the Lord does is good. Meditate on the Name of the Lord, night and day. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਓਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har jo kichh kare s aape aape ohu poochh na kisai kare beechaar ||
english: Whatever the Lord does, He does by Himself. He does not ask or consult anyone else.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak so prabh sadaa dhiaaeeai jin meliaa satigur kirapaa dhaar ||4||1||5||
english: O Nanak, meditate forever on God; granting His Grace, He unites us with the True Guru. ||4||1||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: te saadhoo har melahu suaamee jin japiaa gat hoi hamaaree ||
english: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with the Holy people; meditating on You, I am saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kaa daras dekh man bigasai khin khin tin kau hau balihaaree ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, my mind blossoms forth. Each and every moment, I am a sacrifice to them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har hiradai jap naam muraaree ||
english: Meditate within your heart on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar jagat pit suaamee ham daasan daas keejai panihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Show Mercy, Mercy to me, O Father of the World, O my Lord and Master; make me the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tin mat ootam tin pat ootam jin hiradai vasiaa banavaaree ||
english: Their intellect is sublime and exalted, and so is their honor; the Lord, the Lord of the forest, abides within their hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee sevaa laai har suaamee tin simarat gat hoi hamaaree ||2||
english: O my Lord and Master, please link me to the service of those who meditate in remembrance on You, and are saved. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jin aisaa satigur saadh na paaiaa te har daragah kaadhe maaree ||
english: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru are beaten, and driven out of the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਕ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: te nar ni(n)dak sobh na paavahi tin nak kaate sirajanahaaree ||3||
english: These slanderous people have no honor or reputation; their noses are cut by the Creator Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har aap bulaavai aape bolai har aap nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar niraahaaree ||
english: The Lord Himself speaks, and the Lord Himself inspires all to speak; He is Immaculate and Formless, and needs no sustenance.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲਸੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: har jis too melahi so tudh milasee jan naanak kiaa ehi ja(n)t vichaaree ||4||2||6||
english: O Lord, he alone meets You, whom You cause to meet. Says servant Nanak, I am a wretched creature. What can I do? ||4||2||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਨਣੇ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat saaee har teree jit har keerat har sunane ||
english: That is Your True Congregation, Lord, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are heard.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੇਵਹ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin har naam suniaa man bheenaa tin ham srevah nit charane ||1||
english: The minds of those who listen to the Lord's Name are drenched with bliss; I worship their feet continually. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan har dhiaai tarane ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, the Life of the World, the mortals cross over.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇਤੁ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anek asa(n)kh naam har tere na jaahee jihavaa it ganane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Names are so many, they are countless, O Lord. This tongue of mine cannot even count them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਲੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasikh har bolahu har gaavahu le guramat har japane ||
english: O Gursikhs, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Praises of the Lord. Take the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਘਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo upades sune gur keraa so jan paavai har sukh ghane ||2||
english: Whoever listens to the Guru's Teachings - that humble being receives countless comforts and pleasures from the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਣੇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s va(n)s dha(n)n s pitaa dha(n)n s maataa jin jan jane ||
english: Blessed is the ancestry, blessed is the father, and blessed is that mother who gave birth to this humble servant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin saas giraas dhiaaiaa meraa har har se saachee daragah har jan bane ||3||
english: Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and morsel of food - those humble servants of the Lord look beautiful in the True Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: har har agam naam har tere vich bhagataa har dharane ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Names are profound and infinite; Your devotees cherish them deep within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਣੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak jan paaiaa mat guramat jap har har paar pavane ||4||3||7||
english: Servant Nanak has obained the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, he crosses over to the other side. ||4||3||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਥੀਤਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: sagalee theet paas daar raakhee ||
english: Setting aside all other days,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਮ ਥੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਨਮਾ ਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asatam theet govi(n)d janamaa see ||1||
english: It is said that the Lord was born on the eighth lunar day. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਰ ਕਰਤ ਕਚਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhoole nar karat kacharaain ||
english: Deluded and confused by doubt, the mortal practices falsehood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran te rahat naaraain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is beyond birth and death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪੰਜੀਰੁ ਖਵਾਇਓ ਚੋਰ ॥
transliteration: kar pa(n)jeer khavaaio chor ||
english: You prepare sweet treats and feed them to your stone god.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਢੋਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ohu janam na marai re saakat dhor ||2||
english: God is not born, and He does not die, you foolish, faithless cynic! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਧ ਦੇਹਿ ਲੋਰੋਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal paraadh dehi loronee ||
english: You sing lullabyes to your stone god - this is the source of all your mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜੋਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so mukh jalau jit kahahi thaakur jonee ||3||
english: Let that mouth be burnt, which says that our Lord and Master is subject to birth. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: janam na marai na aavai na jaai ||
english: He is not born, and He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaa prabh rahio samaai ||4||1||
english: The God of Nanak is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: oothat sukheeaa baithat sukheeaa ||
english: Standing up, I am at peace; sitting down, I am at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਂ ਐਸੇ ਬੁਝੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhau nahee laagai jaa(n) aise bujheeaa ||1||
english: I feel no fear, because this is what I understand. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: raakhaa ek hamaaraa suaamee ||
english: The One Lord, my Lord and Master, is my Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa kaa a(n)tarajaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਗਿ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soi achi(n)taa jaag achi(n)taa ||
english: I sleep without worry, and I awake without worry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਕਹਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jahaa kahaa(n) prabh too(n) varata(n)taa ||2||
english: You, O God, are pervading everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar sukh vasiaa baahar sukh paaiaa ||
english: I dwell in peace in my home, and I am at peace outside.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur ma(n)tr driRaaiaa ||3||2||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨ ਰਹਉ ਨ ਮਹ ਰਮਦਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: varat na rahau na mah ramadaanaa ||
english: I do not keep fasts, nor do I observe the month of Ramadaan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਜੋ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis sevee jo rakhai nidaanaa ||1||
english: I serve only the One, who will protect me in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ek gusaaee alahu meraa ||
english: The One Lord, the Lord of the World, is my God Allah.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਹਾਂ ਨੇਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo turak duhaa(n) neberaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He adminsters justice to both Hindus and Muslims. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਉ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: haj kaabai jaau na teerath poojaa ||
english: I do not make pilgrimages to Mecca, nor do I worship at Hindu sacred shrines.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eko sevee avar na doojaa ||2||
english: I serve the One Lord, and not any other. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਉ ਨ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: poojaa karau na nivaaj gujaarau ||
english: I do not perform Hindu worship services, nor do I offer the Muslim prayers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਲੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek nira(n)kaar le ridai namasakaarau ||3||
english: I have taken the One Formless Lord into my heart; I humbly worship Him there. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਨ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: naa ham hi(n)doo na musalamaan ||
english: I am not a Hindu, nor am I a Muslim.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੪॥
transliteration: alah raam ke pi(n)d paraan ||4||
english: My body and breath of life belong to Allah - to Raam - the God of both. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ihu keeaa vakhaanaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, this is what I say:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
transliteration: gur peer mil khud khasam pachhaanaa ||5||3||
english: meeting with the Guru, my Spiritual Teacher, I realize God, my Lord and Master. ||5||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਮਿਰਗੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: das miragee sahaje ba(n)dh aanee ||
english: I easily tied up the deer - the ten sensory organs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਮਿਰਗ ਬੇਧੇ ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch mirag bedhe siv kee baanee ||1||
english: I shot five of the desires with the Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲੇ ਚੜਿਓ ਸਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g le chaRio sikaar ||
english: I go out hunting with the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਕਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਹਥੀਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mrig pakare bin ghor hatheeaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and we capture the deer without horses or weapons. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਖੇਰ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aakher birat baahar aaio dhaai ||
english: My mind used to run around outside hunting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੇਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਗਾਂਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aheraa paaio ghar kai gaa(n)i ||2||
english: But now, I have found the game within the home of my body-village. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਕਰੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੇ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: mrig pakare ghar aane haat ||
english: I caught the deer and brought them home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਾਂਢੇ ਬਾਟਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chukh chukh le gae baa(n)dhe baat ||3||
english: Dividing them up, I shared them, bit by bit. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਅਹੇਰਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ehu aheraa keeno daan ||
english: God has given this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak kai ghar keval naam ||4||4||
english: Nanak's home is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚਿ ਲੋਚਿ ਖਾਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: je sau loch loch khaavaaiaa ||
english: Even though he may be fed with hundreds of longings and yearnings,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saakat har har cheet na aaiaa ||1||
english: still the faithless cynic does not remember the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee lehu mate ||
english: Take in the teachings of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g paavahu param gate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paathar kau bahu neer pavaaiaa ||
english: Stones may be kept under water for a long time.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਭੀਗੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਸੂਕਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nah bheegai adhik sookaaiaa ||2||
english: Even so, they do not absorb the water; they remain hard and dry. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਰਖੈ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khat saasatr moorakhai sunaaiaa ||
english: The six Shaastras may be read to a fool,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaise dah dis pavan jhulaaiaa ||3||
english: but it is like the wind blowing in the ten directions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਣ ਖਲਹਾਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਹਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin kan khalahaan jaise gaahan paaiaa ||
english: It is like threshing a crop without any corn - nothing is gained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਰਾਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tiu saakat te ko na baraasaaiaa ||4||
english: In the same way, no benefit comes from the faithless cynic. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tit hee laagaa jit ko laaiaa ||
english: As the Lord attaches them, so are all attached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh banat banaaiaa ||5||5||
english: Says Nanak, God has formed such a form. ||5||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan jin rachio sareer ||
english: He created the soul, the breath of life and the body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinahi upaae tis kau peer ||1||
english: He created all beings, and knows their pains. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur gobi(n)d jee kai kaam ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, is the Helper of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਦ ਛਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: halat palat jaa kee sad chhaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Here and herafter, He always provides shade. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh aaraadhan niramal reet ||
english: Worship and adoration of God is the pure way of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g binasee bipareet ||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of duality vanishes. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਨਹ ਪਾਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: meet heet dhan nah paaranaa ||
english: Friends, well-wishers and wealth will not support you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n mere naaraainaa ||3||
english: Blessed, blessed is my Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak bolai a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: Nanak utters the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: ek binaa doojaa nahee jaanee ||4||6||
english: Except the One Lord, he does not know any other at all. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਯੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: aagai day paachhai naaraain ||
english: The Lord is in front of me, and the Lord is behind me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਧਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: madh bhaag har prem rasaain ||1||
english: My Beloved Lord, the Source of Nectar, is in the middle as well. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਉਣ ॥
transliteration: prabhoo hamaarai saasatr saun ||
english: God is my Shaastra and my favorable omen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਉਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d grih bhaun ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In His Home and Mansion, I find peace, poise and bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa naam karan sun jeeve ||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with my tongue, and hearing it with my ears, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਮਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh simar simar amar thir theeve ||2||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I have become eternal, permanent and stable. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke dookh nivaare ||
english: The pains of countless lifetimes have been erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anahad sabad vaje darabaare ||3||
english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, vibrates in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh leee milaae ||
english: Granting His Grace, God has blended me with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagat aae ||4||7||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: kot manorath aavahi haath ||
english: It brings millions of desires to fulfillment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੀ ਪਾਂਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jam maarag kai sa(n)gee paa(n)th ||1||
english: On the Path of Death, It will go with you and help you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa jal gur gobi(n)d naam ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe, is the holy water of the Ganges.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੀਵਤ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo simarai tis kee gat hovai peevat bahuR na jon bhramaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever meditates on it, is saved; drinking it in, the mortal does not wander in reincarnation again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥
transliteration: poojaa jaap taap isanaan ||
english: It is my worship, meditation, austerity and cleansing bath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simarat naam bhae nihakaam ||2||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I have become free of desire. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਾਲ ਸਾਦਨ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raaj maal saadan darabaar ||
english: It is my domain and empire, wealth, mansion and court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: simarat naam pooran aachaar ||3||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam brings perfect conduct. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas ihu keeaa beechaar ||
english: Slave Nanak has deliberated, and has come to this conclusion:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: bin har naam mithiaa sabh chhaar ||4||8||
english: Without the Lord's Name, everything is false and worthless, like ashes. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: lep na laago til kaa mool ||
english: The poison had absolutely no harmful effect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਮੂਆ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੂਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dusat braahaman mooaa hoi kai sool ||1||
english: But the wicked Brahmin died in pain. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: har jan raakhe paarabraham aap ||
english: The Supreme Lord God Himself has saved His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਮੂਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paapee mooaa gur parataap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sinner died through the Power of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: apanaa khasam jan aap dhiaaiaa ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord and Master meditates on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆਣਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: iaanaa paapee ohu aap pachaaiaa ||2||
english: He Himself has destroyed the ignorant sinner. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh maat pitaa apane daas kaa rakhavaalaa ||
english: God is the Mother, the Father and the Protector of His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਥਾ ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kaa maathaa eehaa(n) oohaa kaalaa ||3||
english: The face of the slanderer, here and hereafter, is blackened. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kee paramesar sunee aradaas ||
english: The Transcendent Lord has heard the prayer of servant Nanak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲੇਛੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਚਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: malechh paapee pachiaa bhaiaa niraas ||4||9||
english: The filthy sinner lost hope and died. ||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: khoob khoob khoob khoob khoob tero naam ||
english: Excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent is Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jhooth jhooth jhooth jhooth dunee gumaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: False, false, false, false is pride in the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਗਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਦੇ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nagaj tere ba(n)de deedaar apaar ||
english: The glorious vision of Your slaves, O Infinite Lord, is wonderful and beauteous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam binaa sabh duneeaa chhaar ||1||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is just ashes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਦਮ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: acharaj teree kudarat tere kadam salaah ||
english: Your Creative Power is marvellous, and Your Lotus Feet are admirable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਨੀਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ganeev teree siphat sache paatisaah ||2||
english: Your Praise is priceless, O True King. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਪਨਹ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: needhariaa dhar panah khudaai ||
english: God is the Support of the unsupported.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gareeb nivaaj din rain dhiaai ||3||
english: Meditate day and night on the Cherisher of the meek and humble. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau khud khasam miharavaan ||
english: God has been merciful to Nanak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦਿਲ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: alahu na visarai dil jee paraan ||4||10||
english: May I never forget God; He is my heart, my soul, my breath of life. ||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saach padaarath guramukh lahahu ||
english: As Gurmukh, obtain the true wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh kaa bhaanaa sat kar sahahu ||1||
english: Accept the Will of God as True. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jeevat jeevat jeevat rahahu ||
english: Live, live, live forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਪੀਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: raam rasaain nit uth peevahu ||
english: Rise early each day, and drink in the Nectar of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har har har rasanaa kahahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kalijug mahi ik naam udhaar ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the One Name alone shall save you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak bolai braham beechaar ||2||11||
english: Nanak speaks the wisdom of God. ||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sarab phal paae ||
english: Serving the True Guru, all fruits and rewards are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam kee mail mitaae ||1||
english: The filth of so many lifetimes is washed away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan prabh tero naau ||
english: Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poorab karam likhe gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Because of the karma of my past deeds, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g hovai udhaar ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sobhaa paavai prabh kai duaar ||2||
english: I am blessed with honor in God's Court. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਚਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan charan prabh sevaa ||
english: Serving at God's Feet, all comforts are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhoor baachhahi sabh sur nar devaa ||3||
english: All the angels and demi-gods long for the dust of the feet of such beings. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak paaiaa naam nidhaan ||
english: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: har jap jap udhariaa sagal jahaan ||4||12||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the whole world is saved. ||4||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kau ka(n)th lagaavai ||
english: God hugs His slave close in His Embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kau agan mahi paavai ||1||
english: He throws the slanderer into the fire. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: paapee te raakhe naaraain ||
english: The Lord saves His servants from the sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਚਿਆ ਆਪ ਕਮਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paapee kee gat katahoo naahee paapee pachiaa aap kamaain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: No one can save the sinner. The sinner is destroyed by his own actions. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: daas raam jeeu laagee preet ||
english: The Lord's slave is in love with the Dear Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਹੋਈ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kee hoee bipareet ||2||
english: The slanderer loves something else. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham apanaa birad pragataaiaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has revealed His Innate Nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਖੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dokhee apanaa keetaa paaiaa ||3||
english: The evil-doer obtains the fruits of his own actions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aai na jaaee rahiaa samaaee ||
english: God does not come or go; He is All-pervading and permeating.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak daas har kee saranaaee ||4||13||
english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||4||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਨ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sreedhar mohan sagal upaavan nira(n)kaar sukhadaataa ||
english: The Fascinating Lord, the Creator of all, the Formless Lord, is the Giver of Peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisaa prabh chhod karahi an sevaa kavan bikhiaa ras maataa ||1||
english: You have abandoned this Lord, and you serve another. Why are you intoxicated with the pleasures of corruption? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: re man mere too govid bhaaj ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਰਸਿ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar upaav sagal mai dekhe jo chitaveeai tit bigaras kaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have seen all other sorts of efforts; whatever you can think of, will only bring failure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: thaakur chhod daasee kau simarahi manamukh a(n)dh agiaanaa ||
english: The blind, ignorant, self-willed manmukhs forsake their Lord and Master, and dwell on His slave Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਪਸੂ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat karahi tin ni(n)dahi nigure pasoo samaanaa ||2||
english: They slander those who worship their Lord; they are like beasts, without a Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਹਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d tan dhan sabh prabh kaa saakat kahate meraa ||
english: Soul, life, body and wealth all belong to God, but the faithless cynics claim that they own them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਮੈਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh duramat hai mailee bin gur bhavajal pheraa ||3||
english: They are proud and arrogant, evil-minded and filthy; without the Guru, they are reincarnated into the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hom jag jap tap sabh sa(n)jam tat teerath nahee paaiaa ||
english: Through burnt offerings, charitable feasts, ritualistic chants, penance, all sorts of austere self-discipline and pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, they do not find God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
transliteration: mitiaa aap pae saranaaee guramukh naanak jagat taraaiaa ||4||1||14||
english: Self-conceit is only erased when one seeks the Lord's Sanctuary and becomes Gurmukh; O Nanak, he crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||1||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਉਦਾਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ban mahi pekhio trin mahi pekhio grihi pekhio udaasaae ||
english: I have seen Him in the woods, and I have seen Him in the fields. I have seen Him in the household, and in renunciation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੰਡਧਾਰ ਜਟਧਾਰੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: da(n)dadhaar jatadhaarai pekhio varat nem teerathaae ||1||
english: I have seen Him as a Yogi carrying His staff, as a Yogi with matted hair, fasting, making vows, and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਏਂ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g pekhio man maae(n) ||
english: I have seen Him in the Society of the Saints, and within my own mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oobh paiaal sarab mahi pooran ras ma(n)gal gun gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the sky, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in everything, He is pervading and permeating. With love and joy, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਭੇਖ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ਕਾਪੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jog bhekh sa(n)niaasai pekhio jat ja(n)gam kaapaRaae ||
english: I have seen Him among the Yogis, the Sannyaasees, the celibates, the wandering hermits and the wearers of patched coats.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tapee tapeesur mun mahi pekhio nat naatik nirataae ||2||
english: I have seen Him among the men of severe self-discipline, the silent sages, the actors, dramas and dances. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਖਟ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: chahu mahi pekhio khat mahi pekhio das asatee si(n)mritaae ||
english: I have seen Him in the four Vedas, I have seen Him in the six Shaastras, in the eighteen Puraanas and the Simritees as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਉ ਦੁਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh mil eko ek vakhaanahi tau kis te kahau duraae ||3||
english: All together, they declare that there is only the One Lord. So tell me, from whom is He hidden? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਹ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: agah agah bea(n)t suaamee nah keem keem keemaae ||
english: Unfathomable and Inaccessible, He is our Infinite Lord and Master; His Value is beyond valuation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak tin kai bal bal jaaeeai jih ghat paragateeaae ||4||2||15||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, within whose heart He is revealed. ||4||2||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nikat bujhai so buraa kiu karai ||
english: How can anyone do evil, if he realizes that the Lord is near?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਨਿਤ ਡਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bikh sa(n)chai nit darataa phirai ||
english: One who gathers corruption, constantly feels fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਅਰੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hai nikate ar bhed na paaiaa ||
english: He is near, but this mystery is not understood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin satigur sabh mohee maaiaa ||1||
english: Without the True Guru, all are enticed by Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇੜੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: neRai neRai sabh ko kahai ||
english: Everyone says that He is near, near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhed viralaa ko lahai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But rare is that person, who, as Gurmukh, understands this mystery. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nikat na dekhai par grihi jaai ||
english: The mortal does not see the Lord near at hand; instead, he goes to the homes of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: darab hirai mithiaa kar khaai ||
english: He steals their wealth and lives in falsehood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paee thagauree har sa(n)g na jaaniaa ||
english: Under the influence of the drug of illusion, he does not know that the Lord is with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baajh guroo hai bharam bhulaaniaa ||2||
english: Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
transliteration: nikat na jaanai bolai kooR ||
english: Not understanding that the Lord is near, he tells lies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੂਠਾ ਹੈ ਮੂੜੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi moothaa hai mooR ||
english: In love and attachment to Maya, the fool is plundered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasat disa(n)tar jaai ||
english: That which he seeks is within his own self, but he looks for it outside.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: baajh guroo hai bharam bhulaai ||3||
english: Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
transliteration: jis masatak karam likhiaa lilaat ||
english: One whose good karma is recorded on his forehead

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve khulhe kapaat ||
english: serves the True Guru; thus the hard and heavy shutters of his mind are opened wide.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar nikate soi ||
english: Within his own being and beyond, he sees the Lord near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak aavai na jaavai koi ||4||3||16||
english: O servant Nanak, he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||4||3||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jis too raakhahi tis kaun maarai ||
english: Who can kill that person whom You protect, O Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh tujh hee a(n)tar sagal sa(n)saarai ||
english: All beings, and the entire universe, is within You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kot upaav chitavat hai praanee ||
english: The mortal thinks up millions of plans,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so hovai j karai choj vidaanee ||1||
english: but that alone happens, which the Lord of wondrous plays does. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raakhahu raakhahu kirapaa dhaar ||
english: Save me, save me, O Lord; shower me with Your Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree saran terai daravaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, and Your Court. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin seviaa nirabhau sukhadaataa ||
english: Whoever serves the Fearless Lord, the Giver of Peace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਏਕੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tin bhau door keeaa ek paraataa ||
english: is rid of all his fears; he knows the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo too karahi soee phun hoi ||
english: Whatever You do, that alone comes to pass in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maarai na raakhai doojaa koi ||2||
english: There is no other who can kill or protect us. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਮਾਣਸ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa too sochahi maanas baan ||
