english: What do you think, with your human understanding?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee purakh sujaan ||
english: The All-knowing Lord is the Searcher of Hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek tek eko aadhaar ||
english: The One and only Lord is my Support and Protection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai sirajanahaar ||3||
english: The Creator Lord knows everything. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis oopar nadar kare karataar ||
english: That person who is blessed by the Creator's Glance of Grace

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tis jan ke sabh kaaj savaar ||
english: all his affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa raakhaa eko soi ||
english: The One Lord is his Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak apaR na saakai koi ||4||4||17||
english: O servant Nanak, no one can equal him. ||4||4||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je hovai baahar ||
english: We should feel sad, if God were beyond us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਰਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je visarai narahar ||
english: We should feel sad, if we forget the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je doojaa bhaae ||
english: We should feel sad, if we are in love with duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕੜੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiaa kaReeai jaa(n) rahiaa samaae ||1||
english: But why should we feel sad? The Lord is pervading everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੜੇ ਕੜਿ ਪਚਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi kaRe kaR pachiaa ||
english: In love and attachment to Maya, the mortals are sad, and are consumed by sadness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਖਪਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai bhram bhram bhram khapiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Name, they wander and wander and wander, and waste away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je doojaa karataa ||
english: We should feel sad, if there were another Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਅਨਿਆਇ ਕੋ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je aniaai ko marataa ||
english: We should feel sad, if someone dies by injustice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je kichh jaanai naahee ||
english: We should feel sad, if something were not known to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕੜੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kiaa kaReeai jaa(n) bharapoor samaahee ||2||
english: But why should we feel sad? The Lord is totally permeating everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je kichh hoi dhingaanai ||
english: We should feel sad, if God were a tyrant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਰੰਞਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: tau kaReeai je bhool ra(n)njaanai ||
english: We should feel sad, if He made us suffer by mistake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa jo hoi sabh prabh te ||
english: The Guru says that whatever happens is all by God's Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਕਾੜਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮ ਸੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tab kaaRaa chhod achi(n)t ham sote ||3||
english: So I have abandoned sadness, and I now sleep without anxiety. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh toohai thaakur sabh ko teraa ||
english: O God, You alone are my Lord and Master; all belong to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu karahi niberaa ||
english: According to Your Will, You pass judgement.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa naasat ik rahiaa samaai ||
english: There is no other at all; the One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੮॥
transliteration: raakhahu paij naanak saranaai ||4||5||18||
english: Please save Nanak's honor; I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||5||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਜੇ ਕੈਸੋ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin baaje kaiso niratikaaree ||
english: Without music, how is one to dance?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕੰਠੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin ka(n)thai kaise gaavanahaaree ||
english: Without a voice, how is one to sing?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਲ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਜੈ ਰਬਾਬ ॥
transliteration: jeel binaa kaise bajai rabaab ||
english: Without strings, how is a guitar to be played?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam binaa birathe sabh kaaj ||1||
english: Without the Naam, all affairs are useless. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kahahu ko tariaa ||
english: Without the Naam - tell me: who has ever been saved?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kaise paar pariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the True Guru, how can anyone cross over to the other side? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bin jihavaa kahaa ko bakataa ||
english: Without a tongue, how can anyone speak?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bin sravanaa kahaa ko sunataa ||
english: Without ears, how can anyone hear?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਪੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: bin netraa kahaa ko pekhai ||
english: Without eyes, how can anyone see?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਰੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam binaa nar kahee na lekhai ||2||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal is of no account at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
transliteration: bin bidiaa kahaa koee pa(n)dit ||
english: Without learning, how can one be a Pandit - a religious scholar?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਰੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਮੰਡਿਤ ॥
transliteration: bin amarai kaise raaj ma(n)dit ||
english: Without power, what is the glory of an empire?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਹਾ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe kahaa man thaharaanaa ||
english: Without understanding, how can the mind become steady?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag bauraanaa ||3||
english: Without the Naam, the whole world is insane. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਕਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: bin bairaag kahaa bairaagee ||
english: Without detachment, how can one be a detached hermit?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: bin hau tiaag kahaa kooo tiaagee ||
english: Without renouncing egotism, how can anyone be a renunciate?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਚੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bin bas pa(n)ch kahaa man choore ||
english: Without overcoming the five thieves, how can the mind be subdued?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam binaa sad sad hee jhoore ||4||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal regrets and repents forever and ever. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bin gur deekhiaa kaise giaan ||
english: Without the Guru's Teachings, how can anyone obtain spiritual wisdom?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bin pekhe kahu kaiso dhiaan ||
english: Without seeing - tell me: how can anyone visualize in meditation?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bin bhai kathanee sarab bikaar ||
english: Without the Fear of God, all speech in useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੫॥੬॥੧੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak dar kaa beechaar ||5||6||19||
english: Says Nanak, this is the wisdom of the Lord's Court. ||5||6||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog maanukh kau deenaa ||
english: Mankind is afflicted with the disease of egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਰੋਗਿ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਬਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam rog maigal bas leenaa ||
english: The disease of sexual desire overwhelms the elephant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: drisat rog pach mue pata(n)gaa ||
english: Because of the disease of vision, the moth is burnt to death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਰੋਗਿ ਖਪਿ ਗਏ ਕੁਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naad rog khap gae kura(n)gaa ||1||
english: Because of the disease of the sound of the bell, the deer is lured to its death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jo jo deesai so so rogee ||
english: Whoever I see is diseased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਰਹਿਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rog rahit meraa satigur jogee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only my True Guru, the True Yogi, is free of disease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੋਗਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆਨੋ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa rog meen grasiaano ||
english: Because of the disease of taste, the fish is caught.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਵਰੁ ਬਿਨਸਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: baasan rog bhavar binasaano ||
english: Because of the disease of smell, the bumble bee is destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇਤ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: het rog kaa sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The whole world is caught in the disease of attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tribidh rog mahi badhe bikaaraa ||2||
english: In the disease of the three qualities, corruption is multiplied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੇ ਮਰਤਾ ਰੋਗੇ ਜਨਮੈ ॥
transliteration: roge marataa roge janamai ||
english: In disease the mortals die, and in disease they are born.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮੈ ॥
transliteration: roge phir phir jonee bharamai ||
english: In disease they wander in reincarnation again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਬੰਧ ਰਹਨੁ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: rog ba(n)dh rahan ratee na paavai ||
english: Entangled in disease, they cannot stay still, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin satigur rog katahi na jaavai ||3||
english: Without the True Guru, the disease is never cured. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jis keenee daiaa ||
english: When the Supreme Lord God grants His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਰੋਗਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baah pakaR rogahu kadh laiaa ||
english: He grabs hold of the mortal's arm, and pulls him up and out of the disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: Reaching the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mortal's bonds are broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur rog mitaaiaa ||4||7||20||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru cures him of the disease. ||4||7||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) mahaa ana(n)d ||
english: When He comes to mind, then I am in supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sabh dukh bha(n)j ||
english: When He comes to mind, then all my pains are shattered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) saradhaa pooree ||
english: When He comes to mind, my hopes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਝੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) kabahi na jhooree ||1||
english: When He comes to mind, I never feel sadness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar raam raai pragate aai ||
english: Deep within my being, my Sovereign Lord King has revealed Himself to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai deeo ra(n)g laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has inspired me to love Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sarab ko raajaa ||
english: When He comes to mind, I am the king of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) poore kaajaa ||
english: When He comes to mind, all my affairs are completed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) ra(n)g gulaal ||
english: When He comes to mind, I am dyed in the deep crimson of His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sadaa nihaal ||2||
english: When He comes to mind, I am ecstatic forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sad dhanava(n)taa ||
english: When He comes to mind, I am wealthy forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦ ਨਿਭਰੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sad nibhara(n)taa ||
english: When He comes to mind, I am free of doubt forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sabh ra(n)g maane ||
english: When He comes to mind, then I enjoy all pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) chookee kaane ||3||
english: When He comes to mind, I am rid of fear. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sahaj ghar paaiaa ||
english: When He comes to mind, I find the home of peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) su(n)n samaaiaa ||
english: When He comes to mind, I am absorbed in the Primal Void of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai sad keeratan karataa ||
english: When He comes to mind, I continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੧॥
transliteration: man maaniaa naanak bhagava(n)taa ||4||8||21||
english: Nanak's mind is pleased and satisfied with the Lord God. ||4||8||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਪੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਦ ਚਰੰਜੀਵੀ ॥
transliteration: baap hamaaraa sad chara(n)jeevee ||
english: My Father is Eternal, forever alive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee hamaare sad hee jeevee ||
english: My brothers live forever as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: meet hamaare sadaa abinaasee ||
english: My friends are permanent and imperishable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kuta(n)b hamaaraa nij ghar vaasee ||1||
english: My family abides in the home of the self within. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ham sukh paaiaa taa(n) sabhahi suhele ||
english: I have found peace, and so all are at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai pitaa sa(n)g mele ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has united me with my Father. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar mere sabh te ooche ||
english: My mansions are the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪੂਛੇ ॥
transliteration: des mere bea(n)t apoochhe ||
english: My countries are infinite and uncountable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ॥
transliteration: raaj hamaaraa sad hee nihachal ||
english: My kingdom is eternally stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਅਖੂਟੁ ਅਬੇਚਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maal hamaaraa akhoot abechal ||2||
english: My wealth is inexhaustible and permanent. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sobhaa meree sabh jug a(n)tar ||
english: My glorious reputation resounds throughout the ages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: baaj hamaaree thaan thana(n)tar ||
english: My fame has spread in all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: keerat hamaree ghar ghar hoee ||
english: My praises echo in each and every house.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagat hamaaree sabhanee loee ||3||
english: My devotional worship is known to all people. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮਾਝ ॥
transliteration: pitaa hamaare pragate maajh ||
english: My Father has revealed Himself within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਰਲਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਂਝ ॥
transliteration: pitaa poot ral keenee saa(n)jh ||
english: The Father and son have joined together in partnership.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jau pitaa pateene ||
english: Says Nanak, when my Father is pleased,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: pitaa poot ekai ra(n)g leene ||4||9||22||
english: then the Father and son are joined together in love, and become one. ||4||9||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: niravair purakh satigur prabh daate ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is free of revenge and hate; He is God, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਖਸਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: ham aparaadhee tumh bakhasaate ||
english: I am a sinner; You are my Forgiver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis paapee kau milai na dhoee ||
english: That sinner, who finds no protection anywhere

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saran aavai taa(n) niramal hoee ||1||
english: - if he comes seeking Your Sanctuary, then he becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh paaiaa satiguroo manaai ||
english: Pleasing the True Guru, I have found peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh phal paae guroo dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Guru, I have obtained all fruits and rewards. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham satigur aades ||
english: I humbly bow to the Supreme Lord God, the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan teraa sabh teraa des ||
english: My mind and body are Yours; all the world is Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੂਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਤਾਂ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chookaa paRadaa taa(n) nadaree aaiaa ||
english: When the veil of illusion is removed, then I come to see You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khasam toohai sabhanaa ke raaiaa ||2||
english: You are my Lord and Master; You are the King of all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis bhaanaa sooke kaasat hariaa ||
english: When it pleases Him, even dry wood becomes green.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis bhaanaa taa(n) thal sir sariaa ||
english: When it pleases Him, rivers flow across the desert sands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tis bhaanaa taa(n) sabh phal paae ||
english: When it pleases Him, all fruits and rewards are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਗਈ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chi(n)t gaee lag satigur paae ||3||
english: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, my anxiety is dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਤੂਠਾ ॥
transliteration: haraamakhor niragun kau toothaa ||
english: I am unworthy and ungrateful, but He has been merciful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal man a(n)mrit voothaa ||
english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; the Ambrosial Nectar rains down in my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham gur bhae daiaalaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Guru, has become kind and compassionate to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak daas dekh bhae nihaalaa ||4||10||23||
english: Slave Nanak beholds the Lord, enraptured. ||4||10||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa bemuhataaj ||
english: My True Guru is totally independent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur mere sachaa saaj ||
english: My True Guru is adorned with Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭਸ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa sabhas kaa daataa ||
english: My True Guru is the Giver of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur meraa purakh bidhaataa ||1||
english: My True Guru is the Primal Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੈਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: gur jaisaa naahee ko dev ||
english: There is no deity equal to the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis masatak bhaag s laagaa sev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever has good destiny inscribed on his forehead, applies himself to seva - selfless service. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa sarab pratipaalai ||
english: My True Guru is the Sustainer and Cherisher of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa maar jeevaalai ||
english: My True Guru kills and revives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur mere kee vadiaaee ||
english: The glorious greatness of my True Guru

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pragat bhaee hai sabhanee thaaee ||2||
english: Has become manifest everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਿਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa taan nitaan ||
english: My True Guru is the power of the powerless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa ghar deebaan ||
english: My True Guru is my home and court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai hau sad bal jaaiaa ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pragat maarag jin kar dikhalaaiaa ||3||
english: He has shown me the path. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jin gur seviaa tis bhau na biaapai ||
english: One who serves the Guru is not afflicted with fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jin gur seviaa tis dukh na sa(n)taapai ||
english: One who serves the Guru does not suffer in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ॥
transliteration: naanak sodhe si(n)mrit bed ||
english: Nanak has studied the Simritees and the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੇਦ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੪॥
transliteration: paarabraham gur naahee bhed ||4||11||24||
english: There is no difference between the Supreme Lord God and the Guru. ||4||11||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam lait man paragat bhaiaa ||
english: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal is exalted and glorified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪਾਪੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam lait paap tan te gaiaa ||
english: Repeating the Naam, sin is banished from the body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਸਗਲ ਪੁਰਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam lait sagal purabaaiaa ||
english: Repeating the Naam, all festivals are celebrated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam lait athasath majanaaiaa ||1||
english: Repeating the Naam, one is cleansed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: teerath hamaraa har ko naam ||
english: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur upadesiaa tat giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has instructed me in the true essence of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naam lait dukh door paraanaa ||
english: Repeating the Naam, the mortal's pains are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਤਿ ਮੂੜ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naam lait at mooR sugiaanaa ||
english: Repeating the Naam, the most ignorant people become spiritual teachers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪਰਗਟਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam lait paragat ujeeaaraa ||
english: Repeating the Naam, the Divine Light blazes forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਛੁਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam lait chhute ja(n)jaaraa ||2||
english: Repeating the Naam, one's bonds are broken. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam lait jam neR na aavai ||
english: Repeating the Naam, the Messenger of Death does not draw near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam lait daragah sukh paavai ||
english: Repeating the Naam, one finds peace in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naam lait prabh kahai saabaas ||
english: Repeating the Naam, God gives His Approval.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam hamaaree saachee raas ||3||
english: The Naam is my true wealth. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur upades kahio ihu saar ||
english: The Guru has instructed me in these sublime teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har keerat man naam adhaar ||
english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and the Naam are the Support of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਪੁਨਹਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak udhare naam punahachaar ||
english: Nanak is saved through the atonement of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਲੋਕਹ ਪਤੀਆਰ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੫॥
transliteration: avar karam lokah pateeaar ||4||12||25||
english: Other actions are just to please and appease the people. ||4||12||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਖ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: namasakaar taa kau lakh baar ||
english: I bow in humble worship, tens of thousands of times.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu man deejai taa kau vaar ||
english: I offer this mind as a sacrifice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: simaran taa kai mitahi sa(n)taap ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, sufferings are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਹਿ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi ana(n)d na viaapahi taap ||1||
english: Bliss wells up, and no disease is contracted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aiso heeraa niramal naam ||
english: Such is the diamond, the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat pooran sabh kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting it, all works are perfectly completed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee drisat dukh deraa dhahai ||
english: Beholding Him, the house of pain is demolished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਗਹੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam seetal man gahai ||
english: The mind seizes the cooling, soothing, Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anik bhagat jaa ke charan poojaaree ||
english: Millions of devotees worship His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooranahaaree ||2||
english: He is the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਊਣੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi oone subhar bhariaa ||
english: In an instant, He fills the empty to over-flowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi sooke keene hariaa ||
english: In an instant, He transforms the dry into green.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi nithaave kau deeno thaan ||
english: In an instant, He gives the homeless a home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khin mahi nimaane kau deeno maan ||3||
english: In an instant, He bestows honor on the dishonored. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ek rahiaa bharapooraa ||
english: The One Lord is totally pervading and permeating all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so jaapai jis satigur pooraa ||
english: He alone meditates on the Lord, whose True Guru is Perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har keeratan taa ko aadhaar ||
english: Such a person has the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises for his Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis aap daiaar ||4||13||26||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is merciful to him. ||4||13||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mohi duhaagan aap seegaaree ||
english: I was discarded and abandoned, but He has embellished me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਦੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: roop ra(n)g de naam savaaree ||
english: He has blessed me with beauty and His Love; through His Name, I am exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: mitio dukh ar sagal sa(n)taap ||
english: All my pains and sorrows have been eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur hoe mere maaee baap ||1||
english: The Guru has become my Mother and Father. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਗ੍ਰਸਤਿ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: sakhee saheree merai grasat ana(n)d ||
english: O my friends and companions, my household is in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa bhete mohi ka(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Granting His Grace, my Husband Lord has met me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tapat bujhee pooran sabh aasaa ||
english: The fire of desire has been extinguished, and all my desires have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਭਏ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mite a(n)dher bhae paragaasaa ||
english: The darkness has been dispelled, and the Divine Light blazes forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: anahad sabad acharaj bisamaad ||
english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, is wondrous and amazing!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਸਾਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur pooraa pooraa parasaad ||2||
english: Perfect is the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau pragat bhae gopaal ||
english: That person, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: taa kai darasan sadaa nihaal ||
english: by the Blessed Vision of his Darshan, I am forever enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sarab gunaa taa kai bahut nidhaan ||
english: He obtains all virtues and so many treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau satigur deeo naam ||3||
english: The True Guru blesses him with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhetio thaakur apanaa ||
english: That person who meets with his Lord and Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal har har japanaa ||
english: his mind and body are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo jan prabh bhaae ||
english: Says Nanak, such a humble being is pleasing to God;

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: taa kee ren biralaa ko paae ||4||14||27||
english: only a rare few are blessed with the dust of his feet. ||4||14||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਆਲਕੁ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: chitavat paap na aalak aavai ||
english: The mortal does not hesitate to think about sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਭਜਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹ ਸਰਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: besuaa bhajat kichh nah saramaavai ||
english: He is not ashamed to spend time with prostitutes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saaro dinas majooree karai ||
english: He works all day long,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ਬਜਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simaran kee velaa bajar sir parai ||1||
english: but when it is time to remember the Lord, then a heavy stone falls on his head. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਗਿ ਭੂਲੋ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa lag bhoolo sa(n)saar ||
english: Attached to Maya, the world is deluded and confused.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap bhulaaiaa bhulaavanahaarai raach rahiaa birathaa biuhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Deluder Himself has deluded the mortal, and now he is engrossed in worthless worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pekhat maaiaa ra(n)g bihaai ||
english: Gazing on Maya's illusion, its pleasures pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੜਬੜ ਕਰੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gaRabaR karai kaudee ra(n)g laai ||
english: He loves the shell, and ruins his life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬੰਧ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh biuhaar ba(n)dh man dhaavai ||
english: Bound to blind worldly affairs, his mind wavers and wanders.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karanaihaar na jee mahi aavai ||2||
english: The Creator Lord does not come into his mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: karat karat iv hee dukh paaiaa ||
english: Working and working like this, he only obtains pain,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਰਜ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pooran hot na kaaraj maaiaa ||
english: and his affairs of Maya are never completed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh man leenaa ||
english: His mind is saturated with sexual desire, anger and greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੜਫਿ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taRaph mooaa jiu jal bin meenaa ||3||
english: Wiggling like a fish out of water, he dies. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jis ke raakhe hoe har aap ||
english: One who has the Lord Himself as his Protector,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: har har naam sadaa jap jaap ||
english: chants and meditates forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har ke gun gaaiaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak satigur pooraa paaiaa ||4||15||28||
english: O Nanak, he has found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: apanee daiaa kare so paae ||
english: He alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saach sabad hirade man maahi ||
english: With the True Word of the Shabad in his heart and mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh jaahi ||1||
english: the sins of countless incarnations vanish. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jee ko aadhaar ||
english: The Lord's Name is the Support of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਾਰਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad japahu nit bhaaee taar lae saagar sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, chant the Name continually, O Siblings of Destiny; It shall carry you across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kau likhiaa har ehu nidhaan ||
english: Those who have this treasure of the Lord's Name written in their destiny,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: se jan daragah paavahi maan ||
english: those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d gun gaau ||
english: Singing His Glorious Praises with peace, poise and bliss,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aagai milai nithaave thaau ||2||
english: even the homeless obtain a home hereafter. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jugah juga(n)tar ihu tat saar ||
english: Throughout the ages, this has been the essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har simaran saachaa beechaar ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and contemplate the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis laR laai lae so laagai ||
english: He alone is attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, whom the Lord Himself attaches.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa soiaa jaagai ||3||
english: Asleep for countless incarnations, he now awakens. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: tere bhagat bhagatan kaa aap ||
english: Your devotees belong to You, and You belong to Your devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: apanee mahimaa aape jaap ||
english: You Yourself inspire them to chant Your Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh terai haath ||
english: All beings and creatures are in Your Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak ke prabh sad hee saath ||4||16||29||
english: Nanak's God is always with him. ||4||16||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Inner-knower of my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai aavai kaamee ||
english: The Naam is so useful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: rom rom raviaa har naam ||
english: The Lord's Name permeates each and every hair of mine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur poorai keeno daan ||1||
english: The Perfect True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan merai bha(n)daar ||
english: The Jewel of the Naam is my treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agam amolaa apar apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is inaccessible, priceless, infinite and incomparable. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai nihachal dhanee ||
english: The Naam is my unmoving, unchanging Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: naam kee mahimaa sabh mahi banee ||
english: The glory of the Naam spreads over the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai pooraa saahu ||
english: The Naam is my perfect master of wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai beparavaahu ||2||
english: The Naam is my independence. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai bhojan bhaau ||
english: The Naam is my food and love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai man kaa suaau ||
english: The Naam is the objective of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: naam na visarai sa(n)t prasaad ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I never forget the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਦ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam lait anahad poore naad ||3||
english: Repeating the Naam, the Unstruck Sound-current of the Naad resounds. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te naam nau nidh paaee ||
english: By God's Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam siu ban aaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I am tuned in to the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: dhanava(n)te seee paradhaan ||
english: They alone are wealthy and supreme,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak jaa kai naam nidhaan ||4||17||30||
english: O Nanak, who have the treasure of the Naam. ||4||17||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too meraa pitaa toohai meraa maataa ||
english: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too mere jee praan sukhadaataa ||
english: You are my Soul, my Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too meraa thaakur hau daas teraa ||
english: You are my Lord and Master; I am Your slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tujh bin avar nahee ko meraa ||1||
english: Without You, I have no one at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa karahu prabh daat ||
english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and give me this gift,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumhree usatat karau din raat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that I may sing Your Praises, day and night. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham tere ja(n)t too bajaavanahaaraa ||
english: I am Your musical instrument, and You are the Musician.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham tere bhikhaaree daan dehi daataaraa ||
english: I am Your beggar; please bless me with Your charity, O Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: tau parasaad ra(n)g ras maane ||
english: By Your Grace, I enjoy love and pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar tumahi samaane ||2||
english: You are deep within each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te japeeai naau ||
english: By Your Grace, I chant the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g tumare gun gaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tumhree daiaa te hoi darad binaas ||
english: In Your Mercy, You take away our pains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮਇਆ ਤੇ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tumaree maiaa te kamal bigaas ||3||
english: By Your Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaar jaau guradev ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: saphal darasan jaa kee niramal sev ||
english: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His service is immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu thaakur prabh mere ||
english: Be Merciful to me, O my Lord God and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: gun gaavai naanak nit tere ||4||18||31||
english: that Nanak may continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||18||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch jaa kaa darabaar ||
english: His Regal Court is the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa taa kau johaar ||
english: I humbly bow to Him, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ooche te oochaa jaa kaa thaan ||
english: His place is the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot aghaa mitahi har naam ||1||
english: Millions of sins are erased by the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis saranaaee sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: In His Sanctuary, we find eternal peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jaa kau melai soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He Mercifully unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke karatab lakhe na jaahi ||
english: His wondrous actions cannot even be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa bharavaasaa sabh ghat maahi ||
english: All hearts rest their faith and hope in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: pragat bhaiaa saadhoo kai sa(n)g ||
english: He is manifest in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat araadhahi anadin ra(n)g ||2||
english: The devotees lovingly worship and adore Him night and day. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dede tot nahee bha(n)daar ||
english: He gives, but His treasures are never exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaar ||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa hukam na metai koi ||
english: No one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sir paatisaahaa saachaa soi ||3||
english: The True Lord is above the heads of kings. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kee ot tisai kee aasaa ||
english: He is my Anchor and Support; I place my hopes in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh hamaraa tis hee paasaa ||
english: I place my pain and pleasure before Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
transliteration: raakh leeno sabh jan kaa paRadaa ||
english: He covers the faults of His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak tis kee usatat karadaa ||4||19||32||
english: Nanak sings His Praises. ||4||19||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੀ ਰੋਜੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: rovanahaaree roj banaaiaa ||
english: The whiner whines every day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਨ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: balan baratan kau sanaba(n)dh chit aaiaa ||
english: His attachment to his household and entanglements cloud his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: boojh bairaag kare je koi ||
english: If someone becomes detached through understanding,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran phir sog na hoi ||1||
english: he will not have to suffer in birth and death again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa kaa sabh dha(n)dh pasaar ||
english: All of his conflicts are extensions of his corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: viralai keeno naam adhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How rare is that person who takes the Naam as his Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: tribidh maaiaa rahee biaap ||
english: The three-phased Maya infects all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: jo lapataano tis dookh sa(n)taap ||
english: Whoever clings to it suffers pain and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: sukh naahee bin naam dhiaae ||
english: There is no peace without meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan badabhaagee paae ||2||
english: By great good fortune, the treasure of the Naam is received. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗੀ ਸਿਉ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: svaa(n)gee siu jo man reejhaavai ||
english: One who loves the actor in his mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਗਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: svaag utaariai phir pachhutaavai ||
english: later regrets it when the actor takes off his costume.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਰਤਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: megh kee chhaaiaa jaise baratanahaar ||
english: The shade from a cloud is transitory,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੋ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taiso parapa(n)ch moh bikaar ||3||
english: like the worldly paraphernalia of attachment and corruption. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ek vasat je paavai koi ||
english: If someone is blessed with the singular substance,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜੁ ਤਾਹੀ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pooran kaaj taahee kaa hoi ||
english: then all of his tasks are accomplished to perfection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad jin paaiaa naam ||
english: One who obtains the Naam, by Guru's Grace

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak aaiaa so paravaan ||4||20||33||
english: - O Nanak, his coming into the world is certified and approved. ||4||20||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa jonee bhavanaa ||
english: Slandering the Saints, the mortal wanders in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa rogee karanaa ||
english: Slandering the Saints, he is diseased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa dookh sahaam ||
english: Slandering the Saints, he suffers in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਾਨੁ ਦੈਤ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daan dait ni(n)dak kau jaam ||1||
english: The slanderer is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਬਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g karahi jo baad ||
english: Those who argue and fight with the Saints

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tin ni(n)dak naahee kichh saad ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - those slanderers find no happiness at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੇਦਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat kee ni(n)daa ka(n)dh chhedaavai ||
english: Slandering the devotees, the wall of the mortal's body is shattered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਰਕੁ ਭੁੰਚਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat kee ni(n)daa narak bhu(n)chaavai ||
english: Slandering the devotees, he suffers in hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਗਲੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat kee ni(n)daa garabh mahi galai ||
english: Slandering the devotees, he rots in the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat kee ni(n)daa raaj te talai ||2||
english: Slandering the devotees, he loses his realm and power. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kee gat katahoo naahi ||
english: The slanderer finds no salvation at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaahi ||
english: He eats only that which he himself has planted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chor jaar jooaar te buraa ||
english: He is worse than a thief, a lecher, or a gambler.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਨਿੰਦਕਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anahodaa bhaar ni(n)dak sir dharaa ||3||
english: The slanderer places an unbearable burden upon his head. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham ke bhagat niravair ||
english: The devotees of the Supreme Lord God are beyond hate and vengeance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਪੂਜੈ ਪੈਰ ॥
transliteration: so nisatarai jo poojai pair ||
english: Whoever worships their feet is emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh ni(n)dak bholaaiaa ||
english: The Primal Lord God has deluded and confused the slanderer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak kirat na jaai mitaaiaa ||4||21||34||
english: O Nanak, the record of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||4||21||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਦ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai bed ar naad ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the Vedas and the Sound-current of the Naad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai poore kaaj ||
english: Through the Naam, my tasks are perfectly accomplished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai poojaa dev ||
english: The Naam is my worship of deities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai gur kee sev ||1||
english: The Naam is my service to the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai driRio har naam ||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ootam har har kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The highest task of all is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai majan isanaan ||
english: The Naam is my cleansing bath and purification.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai pooran daan ||
english: The Naam is my perfect donation of charity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਪਵੀਤ ॥
transliteration: naam lait te sagal paveet ||
english: Those who repeat the Naam are totally purified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam japat mere bhaaee meet ||2||
english: Those who chant the Naam are my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਉਣ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai saun sa(n)jog ||
english: The Naam is my auspicious omen and good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੁਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai tripat subhog ||
english: The Naam is the sublime food which satisfies me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਆਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai sagal aachaar ||
english: The Naam is my good conduct.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam hamaarai niramal biuhaar ||3||
english: The Naam is my immaculate occupation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man vasiaa prabh ek ||
english: All those humble beings whose minds are filled with the One God

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: sagal janaa kee har har tek ||
english: have the Support of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan naanak har gun gaau ||
english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with your mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jis devai naau ||4||22||35||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord bestows His Name. ||4||22||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਧਨਾ ॥
transliteration: niradhan kau tum devahu dhanaa ||
english: You bless the poor with wealth, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: anik paap jaahi niramal manaa ||
english: Countless sins are taken away, and the mind becomes immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooran kaam ||
english: All the mind's desires are fulfilled, and one's tasks are perfectly accomplished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat apune kau devahu naam ||1||
english: You bestow Your Name upon Your devotee. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saphal sevaa gopaal raai ||
english: Service to the Lord, our Sovereign King, is fruitful and rewarding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee taa te birathaa koi na jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes; no one is turned away from His Door empty-handed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੰਡਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: rogee kaa prabh kha(n)dahu rog ||
english: God eradicates the disease from the diseased person.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਕਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: dukheee kaa mitaavahu prabh sog ||
english: God takes away the sorrows of the suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਥਾਨਿ ਬੈਠਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: nithaave kau tumh thaan baithaavahu ||
english: And those who have no place at all - You seat them upon the place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: daas apane kau bhagatee laavahu ||2||
english: You link Your slave to devotional worship. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਤੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nimaane kau prabh deto maan ||
english: God bestows honor on the dishonored.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: mooR mugadh hoi chatur sugiaan ||
english: He makes the foolish and ignorant become clever and wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਇਆਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhaiaan kaa bhau nasai ||
english: The fear of all fear disappears.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan apane kai har man basai ||3||
english: The Lord dwells within the mind of His humble servant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh sookh nidhaan ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is the Treasure of Peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tat giaan har a(n)mrit naam ||
english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa sa(n)t tahalai laae ||
english: Granting His Grace, He enjoins the mortals to serve the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak saadhoo sa(n)g samaae ||4||23||36||
english: O Nanak, such a person merges in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||23||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi har man vasai ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi durat sabh nasai ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, all sins run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi niramal reet ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, one's lifestyle is immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਏਕ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g hoi ek pareet ||1||
english: In the Society of the Saints, one comes to love the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੁ ਤਹਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal tahaa kaa naau ||
english: That alone is called the Realm of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇਵਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham keval gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: where only the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God are sung. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi janam maran rahai ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, birth and death are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi jam kichhoo na kahai ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, the Messenger of Death cannot touch the mortal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g hoi niramal baanee ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, one's speech becomes immaculate

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi naam vakhaanee ||2||
english: In the realm of the saints, the Lord's Name is chanted. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal kaa nihachal aasan ||
english: The Realm of the Saints is the eternal, ever-stable place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi paap binaasan ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, sins are destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi niramal kathaa ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, the immaculate sermon is spoken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਨਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g haumai dukh nasaa ||3||
english: In the Society of the Saints, the pain of egotism runs away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal kaa nahee binaas ||
english: The Realm of the Saints cannot be destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal mahi har gunataas ||
english: In the Realm of the Saints, is the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal thaakur bisraam ||
english: The Realm of the Saints is the resting place of our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak ot pot bhagavaan ||4||24||37||
english: O Nanak, He is woven into the fabric of His devotees, through and through. ||4||24||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਜਾਂ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: rog kavan jaa(n) raakhai aap ||
english: Why worry about disease, when the Lord Himself protects us?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: tis jan hoi na dookh sa(n)taap ||
english: That person whom the Lord protects, does not suffer pain and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jis oopar prabh kirapaa karai ||
english: That person, upon whom God showers His Mercy

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis oopar te kaal paraharai ||1||
english: - Death hovering above him is turned away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sakhaaee har har naam ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever our Help and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis cheet aavai tis sadaa sukh hovai nikat na aavai taa kai jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When He comes to mind, the mortal finds lasting peace, and the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਨ ਸੋ ਤਬ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jab ihu na so tab kinahi upaaiaa ||
english: When this being did not exist, who created him then?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kavan mool te kiaa pragataaiaa ||
english: What has been produced from the source?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: aapahi maar aap jeevaalai ||
english: He Himself kills, and He Himself rejuvenates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apane bhagat kau sadaa pratipaalai ||2||
english: He cherishes His devotees forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh jaanahu tis kai haath ||
english: Know that everything is in His Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: prabh mero anaath ko naath ||
english: My God is the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan taa kaa hai naau ||
english: His Name is the Destroyer of pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukh paavahi tis ke gun gaau ||3||
english: Singing His Glorious Praises, you shall find peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sun suaamee sa(n)tan aradaas ||
english: O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan dhan tumhrai paas ||
english: I place my soul, my breath of life and wealth before You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag teraa sabh tujhahi dhiaae ||
english: All this world is Yours; it meditates on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੮॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak sukh paae ||4||25||38||
english: Please shower Nanak with Your Mercy and bless him with peace. ||4||25||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਹਾ ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teree tek rahaa kal maahi ||
english: With Your Support, I survive in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teree tek tere gun gaahi ||
english: With Your Support, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: teree tek na pohai kaal ||
english: With Your Support, death cannot even touch me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teree tek binasai ja(n)jaal ||1||
english: With Your Support, my entanglements vanish. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: deen duneeaa teree tek ||
english: In this world and the next, I have Your Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi raviaa saahib ek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Lord, our Lord and Master, is all-pervading. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਕਰਉ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: teree tek karau aana(n)d ||
english: With Your Support, I celebrate blissfully.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: teree tek japau gur ma(n)t ||
english: With Your Support, I chant the Guru's Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: teree tek tareeai bhau saagar ||
english: With Your Support, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar pooraa sukh saagar ||2||
english: The Perfect Lord, our Protector and Savior, is the Ocean of Peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: teree tek naahee bhau koi ||
english: With Your Support, I have no fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee saachaa soi ||
english: The True Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: teree tek teraa man taan ||
english: With Your Support, my mind is filled with Your Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾਂ ਤੂ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: eehaa(n) oohaa(n) too deebaan ||3||
english: Here and there, You are my Court of Appeal. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: teree tek teraa bharavaasaa ||
english: I take Your Support, and place my faith in You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal dhiaavahi prabh gunataasaa ||
english: All meditate on God, the Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jap jap anad karahi tere daasaa ||
english: Chanting and meditating on You, Your slaves celebrate in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੯॥
transliteration: simar naanak saache gunataasaa ||4||26||39||
english: Nanak meditates in remembrance on the True Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||26||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਛੋਡੀ ਪਰਾਈ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: prathame chhodee paraaee ni(n)daa ||
english: First, I gave up slandering others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: utar gaee sabh man kee chi(n)daa ||
english: All the anxiety of my mind was dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: lobh mohu sabh keeno door ||
english: Greed and attachment were totally banished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: param baisano prabh pekh hajoor ||1||
english: I see God ever-present, close at hand; I have become a great devotee. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aiso tiaagee viralaa koi ||
english: Such a renunciate is very rare.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japai jan soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Such a humble servant chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh kaa chhodiaa sa(n)g ||
english: I have forsaken my egotistical intellect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਾ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh kaa utariaa ra(n)g ||
english: The love of sexual desire and anger has vanished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaae har har hare ||
english: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g nisatare ||2||
english: In the Company of the Holy, I am emancipated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤ ਹੋਏ ਸੰਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: bairee meet hoe sa(n)maan ||
english: Enemy and friend are all the same to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sarab mahi pooran bhagavaan ||
english: The Perfect Lord God is permeating all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa maan sukh paaiaa ||
english: Accepting the Will of God, I have found peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam driRaaiaa ||3||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis raakhai aap ||
english: That person, whom the Lord, in His Mercy, saves

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਮ ਜਾਪ ॥
transliteration: soee bhagat japai naam jaap ||
english: that devotee chants and meditates on the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
transliteration: man pragaas gur te mat laee ||
english: That person, whose mind is illumined, and who obtains understanding through the Guru

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੪੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee pooree paee ||4||27||40||
english: - says Nanak, he is totally fulfilled. ||4||27||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਧਨਿ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh naahee bahutai dhan khaate ||
english: There is no peace in earning lots of money.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੇਖੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh naahee pekhe nirat naate ||
english: There is no peace in watching dances and plays.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਸ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sukh naahee bahu des kamaae ||
english: There is no peace in conquering lots of countries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa har har gun gaae ||1||
english: All peace comes from singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਲਹਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d lahahu ||
english: You shall obtain peace, poise and bliss,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat paaeeai vadabhaagee guramukh har har naam kahahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: when you find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by great good fortune. As Gurmukh, utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan maat pitaa sut banitaa ||
english: Mother, father, children and spouse - all place the mortal in bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan karam dharam hau karataa ||
english: Religious rituals and actions done in ego place the mortal in bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaatanahaar man vasai ||
english: If the Lord, the Shatterer of bonds, abides in the mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau sukh paavai nij ghar basai ||2||
english: then peace is obtained, dwelling in the home of the self deep within. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabh jaachik prabh devanahaar ||
english: Everyone is a beggar; God is the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan bea(n)t apaar ||
english: The Treasure of Virtue is the Infinite, Endless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no karam kare prabh apanaa ||
english: That person, unto whom God grants His Mercy

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har naam tinai jan japanaa ||3||
english: - that humble being chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: gur apane aagai aradaas ||
english: I offer my prayer to my Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa purakh gunataas ||
english: O Primal Lord God, Treasure of Virtue, please bless me with Your Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tumaree saranaaee ||
english: Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੪੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakhahu gusaaee ||4||28||41||
english: If it pleases You, please protect me, O Lord of the World. ||4||28||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur mil tiaagio doojaa bhaau ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I have forsaken the love of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
