gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh japio har kaa naau ||
english: As Gurmukh, I chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bisaree chi(n)t naam ra(n)g laagaa ||
english: My anxiety is gone, and I am in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa soiaa jaagaa ||1||
english: I was asleep for countless lifetimes, but I have now awakened. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanee sevaa laae ||
english: Granting His Grace, He has linked me to His service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g sarab sukh paae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pleasures are found. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rog dokh gur sabad nivaare ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has eradicated disease and evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam aukhadh man bheetar saare ||
english: My mind has absorbed the medicine of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: gur bhetat man bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, my mind is in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan naam bhagava(n)t ||2||
english: All treasures are in the Name of the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kee mitee jam traas ||
english: My fear of birth and death and the Messenger of Death has been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਂਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat oo(n)dh kamal bigaas ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat nihachal bisraam ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I have found eternal, abiding peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pooran hoe sagale kaam ||3||
english: All my tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਆਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dulabh deh aaee paravaan ||
english: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is approved by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਹੋਈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: saphal hoee jap har har naam ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, it has become fruitful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa karee ||
english: Says Nanak, God has blessed me with His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੪੨॥
transliteration: saas giraas japau har haree ||4||29||42||
english: With every breath and morsel of food, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||29||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh te oochaa jaa kaa naau ||
english: His Name is the Highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa taa ke gun gaau ||
english: Sing His Glorious Praises, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat sagalaa dukh jaai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all pain is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab sookh vasahi man aai ||1||
english: All pleasures come to dwell in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: simar manaa too saachaa soi ||
english: O my mind, meditate in remembrance on the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: halat palat tumaree gat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this world and the next, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: purakh nira(n)jan sirajanahaar ||
english: The Immaculate Lord God is the Creator of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t devai aahaar ||
english: He gives sustenance to all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਖਤੇ ਖਿਨ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot khate khin bakhasanahaar ||
english: He forgives millions of sins and mistakes in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai sadaa nisataar ||2||
english: Through loving devotional worship, one is emancipated forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saachaa dhan saachee vadiaaee ||
english: True wealth and true glorious greatness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te nihachal mat paaee ||
english: and eternal, unchanging wisdom, are obtained from the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis raakhanahaaraa ||
english: When the Protector, the Savior Lord, bestows His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kaa sagal mitai a(n)dhiaaraa ||3||
english: all spiritual darkness is dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham siu laago dhiaan ||
english: I focus my meditation on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio nirabaan ||
english: The Lord of Nirvaanaa is totally pervading and permeating all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhau met mile gopaal ||
english: Eradicating doubt and fear, I have met the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur bhae daiaal ||4||30||43||
english: The Guru has become merciful to Nanak. ||4||30||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat man hoi pragaas ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is illumined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: mitahi kales sukh sahaj nivaas ||
english: Suffering is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat jis prabh dei ||
english: They alone receive it, unto whom God gives it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਏ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poore gur kee paae sev ||1||
english: They are blessed to serve the Perfect Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa prabh tero naau ||
english: All peace and comfort are in Your Name, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar mere man gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhai soee phal paae ||
english: You shall receive the fruits of your desires,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: when the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe har dhiaai ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, your comings and goings cease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai prabh kee liv laai ||2||
english: Through loving devotional worship, lovingly focus your attention on God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: binase kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and egotism are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: toote maaiaa moh piaar ||
english: Love and attachment to Maya are broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee tek rahai din raat ||
english: Lean on God's Support, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham kare jis daat ||3||
english: The Supreme Lord God has given this gift. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee ||
english: Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanee sevaa laai ||
english: Bless me with Your Grace, Lord, and link me to Your service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੪੪॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaai ||4||31||44||
english: Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||31||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: laaj marai jo naam na levai ||
english: One who does not repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die of shame.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਸੁਖੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam bihoon sukhee kiu sovai ||
english: Without the Name, how can he ever sleep in peace?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
transliteration: har simaran chhaad param gat chaahai ||
english: The mortal abandons meditative remembrance of the Lord, and then wishes for the state of supreme salvation;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਖਾ ਕਤ ਆਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mool binaa saakhaa kat aahai ||1||
english: but without roots, how can there be any branches? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur govi(n)d mere man dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kee mail utaarai ba(n)dhan kaat har sa(n)g milaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The filth of countless incarnations shall be washed away. Breaking your bonds, you shall be united with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: teerath naai kahaa such sail ||
english: How can a stone be purified by bathing at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: man kau viaapai haumai mail ||
english: The filth of egotism clings to the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kot karam ba(n)dhan kaa mool ||
english: Millions of rituals and actions taken are the root of entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਪੂਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ke bhajan bin birathaa pool ||2||
english: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, the mortal gathers only worthless bundles of straw. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਖਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: bin khaae boojhai nahee bhookh ||
english: Without eating, hunger is not satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
transliteration: rog jaai taa(n) utarahi dookh ||
english: When the disease is cured, then the pain goes away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi biaapiaa ||
english: The mortal is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin prabh keenaa so prabh nahee jaapiaa ||3||
english: He does not meditate on God, that God who created him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan saadh dha(n)n har naau ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Holy Saint, and blessed is the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar keeratan gun gaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Kirtan, the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dhan har bhagat dhan karanaihaar ||
english: Blessed is the devotee of the Lord, and blessed is the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੪੫॥
transliteration: saran naanak prabh purakh apaar ||4||32||45||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Primal, the Infinite. ||4||32||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਏ ਭਉ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: gur suprasa(n)n hoe bhau gae ||
english: When the Guru was totally pleased, my fear was taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਏ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan man mahi lae ||
english: I enshrine the Name of the Immaculate Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaal ||
english: He is Merciful to the meek, forever Compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binas gae sagale ja(n)jaal ||1||
english: All my entanglements are finished. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghane ||
english: I have found peace, poise, and myriads of pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mite bhai bharamaa a(n)mrit har har rasan bhane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt are dispelled. My tongue chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laago het ||
english: I have fallen in love with the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਪਰੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi binasio mahaa paret ||
english: In an instant, the terrible demons are destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har har jap jaap ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar govid gur aap ||2||
english: The Guru is Himself the Savior Lord, the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau sadaa pratipaarai ||
english: He Himself cherishes His servant forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa ke saas nihaarai ||
english: He watches over every breath of His humble devotee.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ ਕਹੁ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਾਤ ॥
transliteration: maanas kee kahu ketak baat ||
english: Tell me, what is the nature of human beings?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jam te raakhai de kar haath ||3||
english: The Lord extends His Hand, and saves them from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: niramal sobhaa niramal reet ||
english: Immaculate is the Glory, and Immaculate is the way of life,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham aaiaa man cheet ||
english: of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur deeno daan ||
english: The Guru, in His Mercy, has granted this Gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak paaiaa naam nidhaan ||4||33||46||
english: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||33||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath gur meraa ||
english: My Guru is the All-powerful Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee praan sukhadaataa neraa ||
english: He is the Soul, the Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace, always near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai bha(n)jan abinaasee raai ||
english: He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eternal, Unchanging, Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan dekhiai sabh dukh jaai ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all fear is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau teree saranaa ||
english: Wherever I look, is the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bal bal jaaee satigur charanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: pooran kaam mile guradev ||
english: My tasks are perfectly accomplished, meeting the Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਫਲਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sabh phaladaataa niramal sev ||
english: He is the Giver of all rewards. Serving Him, I am immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene apune daas ||
english: He reaches out with His Hand to His slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਦੀਓ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam rid deeo nivaas ||2||
english: The Name of the Lord abides in their hearts. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d naahee kichh sog ||
english: They are forever in bliss, and do not suffer at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad nah biaapai rog ||
english: No pain, sorrow or disease afflicts them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh teraa too karanaihaar ||
english: Everything is Yours, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham gur agam apaar ||3||
english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Inaccessible and Infinite. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal sobhaa acharaj baanee ||
english: His Glorious Grandeur is immaculate, and the Bani of His Word is wonderful!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran man bhaanee ||
english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal raviaa soi ||
english: He is permeating the waters, the lands and the skies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kichh prabh te hoi ||4||34||47||
english: O Nanak, everything comes from God. ||4||34||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: man tan raataa raam ra(n)g charane ||
english: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab manorath pooran karane ||
english: All the desires of my mind have been perfectly fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gaavat bhagava(n)t ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing of the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur deeno pooraa ma(n)t ||1||
english: The True Guru has imparted this perfect wisdom. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: so vadabhaagee jis naam piaar ||
english: Very fortunate are those who love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis kai sa(n)g tarai sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Associating with them, we cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: soee giaanee j simarai ek ||
english: They are spiritual teachers, who meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: so dhanava(n)taa jis budh bibek ||
english: Wealthy are those who have a discriminating intellect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕੁਲਵੰਤਾ ਜਿ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: so kulava(n)taa j simarai suaamee ||
english: Noble are those who remember their Lord and Master in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so pativa(n)taa j aap pachhaanee ||2||
english: Honorable are those who understand their own selves. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun goupaal din rain dhiaaiaa ||
english: Day and night I meditate on the Glories of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan pooran aasaa ||
english: My bonds are broken, and my hopes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ke charan rid maahi nivaasaa ||3||
english: The Feet of the Lord now abide in my heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karamaa ||
english: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: so jan aaiaa prabh kee saranaa ||
english: that humble being enters the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: aap pavit paavan sabh keene ||
english: He himself is pure, and he sanctifies all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੮॥
transliteration: raam rasaain rasanaa cheenhe ||4||35||48||
english: His tongue chants the Name of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||4||35||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: naam lait kichh bighan na laagai ||
english: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no obstacles block the way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਤ ਜਮੁ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: naam sunat jam doorahu bhaagai ||
english: Listening to the Naam, the Messenger of Death runs far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਸਭ ਦੂਖਹ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naam lait sabh dookhah naas ||
english: Repeating the Naam, all pains vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat har charan nivaas ||1||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Lord's Lotus Feet dwell within. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nirabighan bhagat bhaj har har naau ||
english: Meditating, vibrating the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is unobstructed devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rasak rasak har ke gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving affection and energy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: har simarat kichh chaakh na johai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Eye of Death cannot see you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੈਤ ਦੇਉ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: har simarat dait deu na pohai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, demons and ghosts shall not touch you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਬਧੈ ॥
transliteration: har simarat mohu maan na badhai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, attachment and pride shall not bind you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਰੁਧੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har simarat garabh jon na rudhai ||2||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall not be consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har simaran kee sagalee belaa ||
english: Any time is a good time to meditate in remembrance on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har simaran bahu maahi ikelaa ||
english: Among the masses, only a few meditate in remembrance on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaat ajaat japai jan koi ||
english: Social class or no social class, anyone may meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo jaapai tis kee gat hoi ||3||
english: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japeeai saadhasa(n)g ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kaa pooran ra(n)g ||
english: Perfect is the Love of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh kirapaa dhaar ||
english: O God, shower Your Mercy on Nanak,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: saas saas har dehu chitaar ||4||36||49||
english: that he may think of you with each and every breath. ||4||36||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਸਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਬੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: aape saasat aape bed ||
english: He Himself is the Shaastras, and He Himself is the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: aape ghat ghat jaanai bhed ||
english: He knows the secrets of each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ॥
transliteration: jot saroop jaa kee sabh vath ||
english: He is the Embodiment of Light; all beings belong to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karan kaaran pooran samarath ||1||
english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the Perfect All-powerful Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee ot gahahu man mere ||
english: Grab hold of the Support of God, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal guramukh aaraadhahu dusaman dookh na aavai nere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, worship and adore His Lotus Feet; enemies and pains shall not even approach you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape van trin tribhavan saar ||
english: He Himself is the Essence of the forests and fields, and all the three worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai soot paroiaa sa(n)saar ||
english: The universe is strung on His Thread.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aape siv sakatee sa(n)jogee ||
english: He is the Uniter of Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap nirabaanee aape bhogee ||2||
english: He Himself is in the detachment of Nirvaanaa, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau tat tat soi ||
english: Wherever I look, there He is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa naahee koi ||
english: Without Him, there is no one at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saagar tareeai naam kai ra(n)g ||
english: In the Love of the Naam, the world-ocean is crossed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun gaavai naanak saadhasa(n)g ||3||
english: Nanak sings His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: mukat bhugat jugat vas jaa kai ||
english: Liberation, the ways and means of enjoyment and union are under His Control.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: oonaa naahee kichh jan taa kai ||
english: His humble servant lacks nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis hoi suprasa(n)n ||
english: That person, with whom the Lord, in His Mercy, is pleased

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਧੰਨ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੫੦॥
transliteration: naanak daas seee jan dha(n)n ||4||37||50||
english: - O slave Nanak, that humble servant is blessed. ||4||37||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa man aana(n)d gobi(n)d ||
english: The minds of the Lord's devotee are filled with bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਭਏ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: asathit bhae binasee sabh chi(n)d ||
english: They become stable and permanent, and all their anxiety is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhram binas gae khin maahi ||
english: Their fears and doubts are dispelled in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham vasiaa man aai ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam raam sa(n)t sadaa sahaai ||
english: The Lord is forever the Help and Support of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghar baahar naale paramesar rav rahiaa pooran sabh thaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Inside the home of the heart, and outside as well, the Transcendent Lord is always with us, permeating and pervading all places. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: dhan maal joban jugat gopaal ||
english: The Lord of the World is my wealth, property, youth and ways and means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jee praan nit sukh pratipaal ||
english: He continually cherishes and brings peace to my soul and breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kau de raakhai haath ||
english: He reaches out with His Hand and saves His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nimakh na chhodai sad hee saath ||2||
english: He does not abandon us, even for an instant; He is always with us. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har saa preetam avar na koi ||
english: There is no other Beloved like the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saar samhaale saachaa soi ||
english: The True Lord takes care of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dh naraain ||
english: The Lord is our Mother, Father, Son and Relation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aad jugaad bhagat gun gaain ||3||
english: Since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages, His devotees sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kee dhar prabh kaa man jor ||
english: My mind is filled with the Support and the Power of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek binaa doojaa nahee hor ||
english: Without the Lord, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਪੁਰਖਾਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak kai man ihu purakhaarath ||
english: Nanak's mind is encouraged by this hope,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੫੧॥
transliteration: prabhoo hamaaraa saare suaarath ||4||38||51||
english: that God will accomplish my objectives in life. ||4||38||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪੜਿਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhai kau bhau paRiaa simarat har naam ||
english: Fear itself becomes afraid, when the mortal remembers the Lord's Name in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal biaadh mitee trihu gun kee daas ke hoe pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All the diseases of the three gunas - the three qualities - are cured, and tasks of the Lord's slaves are perfectly accomplished. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har ke lok sadaa gun gaavahi tin kau miliaa pooran dhaam ||
english: The people of the Lord always sing His Glorious Praises; they attain His Perfect Mansion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan kaa daras baa(n)chhai din raatee hoi puneet dharam raai jaam ||1||
english: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma and the Messenger of Death yearn, day and night, to be sanctified by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad ni(n)daa saadhasa(n)g mitiaa abhimaan ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication, egotism, slander and egotistical pride are eradicted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੫੨॥
transliteration: aise sa(n)t bhetahi vadabhaagee naanak tin kai sad kurabaan ||2||39||52||
english: By great good fortune, such Saints are met. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||39||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਜਮੀ ਜੋ ਪੰਚਨ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch majamee jo pa(n)chan raakhai ||
english: One who harbors the five thieves, becomes the embodiment of these five.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa rasanaa nit uth bhaakhai ||
english: He gets up each day and tells lies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਪਾਖੰਡ ॥
transliteration: chakr banaai karai paakha(n)d ||
english: He applies ceremonial religious marks to his body, but practices hypocrisy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਪਚੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਡ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhur jhur pachai jaise tri ra(n)d ||1||
english: He wastes away in sadness and pain, like a lonely widow. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਝੂਠੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam binaa sabh jhooth ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, everything is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਠੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur poore mukat na paaeeai saachee daragahi saakat mooth ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, liberation is not obtained. In the Court of the True Lord, the faithless cynic is plundered. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: soee kucheel kudarat nahee jaanai ||
english: One who does not know the Lord's Creative Power is polluted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੀਪਿਐ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: leepiai thaai na such har maanai ||
english: Ritualistically plastering one's kitchen square does not make it pure in the Eyes of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mailaa baahar nit dhovai ||
english: If a person is polluted within, he may wash himself everyday on the outside,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachee daragahi apanee pat khovai ||2||
english: but in the Court of the True Lord, he forfeits his honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran karai upaau ||
english: He works for the sake of Maya,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲੈ ਸੀਧਾ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabahi na ghaalai seedhaa paau ||
english: but he never places his feet on the right path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tis cheet na aanai ||
english: He never even remembers the One who created him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kooRee kooRee mukhahu vakhaanai ||3||
english: He speaks falsehood, only falsehood, with his mouth. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no karam kare karataar ||
english: That person, unto whom the Creator Lord shows Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g hoi tis biuhaar ||
english: deals with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har naam bhagat siu laagaa ra(n)g ||
english: One who lovingly worships the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੫੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis jan nahee bha(n)g ||4||40||53||
english: says Nanak - no obstacles ever block his way. ||4||40||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kau phitake sa(n)saar ||
english: The entire universe curses the slanderer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kaa jhoothaa biuhaar ||
english: False are the dealings of the slanderer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kaa mailaa aachaar ||
english: The slanderer's lifestyle is filthy and polluted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daas apune kau raakhanahaar ||1||
english: The Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His slave. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮੁਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak muaa ni(n)dak kai naal ||
english: The slanderer dies with the rest of the slanderers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੜਕਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesar jan raakhe ni(n)dak kai sir kaRakio kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, protects and saves His humble servant. Death roars and thunders over the head of the slanderer. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kaa kahiaa koi na maanai ||
english: No one belives what the slanderer says.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak jhooth bol pachhutaane ||
english: The slanderer tells lies, and later regrets and repents.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋਰਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰਨਿ ਲਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haath pachhorahi sir dharan lagaahi ||
english: He wrings his hands, and hits his head against the ground.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਦਈ ਛੋਡੈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kau daee chhodai naahi ||2||
english: The Lord does not forgive the slanderer. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa daas kichh buraa na maagai ||
english: The Lord's slave does not wish anyone ill.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਂਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kau laagai dukh saa(n)gai ||
english: The slanderer suffers, as if stabbed by a spear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੰਖ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bagule jiu rahiaa pa(n)kh pasaar ||
english: Like a crane, he spreads his feathers, to look like a swan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕਢਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mukh te boliaa taa(n) kadhiaa beechaar ||3||
english: When he speaks with his mouth, then he is exposed and driven out. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee karataa soi ||
english: The Creator is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har jan karai s nihachal hoi ||
english: That person, whom the Lord makes His Own, becomes stable and steady.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa daas saachaa darabaar ||
english: The Lord's slave is true in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੫੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak kahiaa tat beechaar ||4||41||54||
english: Servant Nanak speaks, after contemplating the essence of reality. ||4||41||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dui kar jor karau aradaas ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d dhan tis kee raas ||
english: My soul, body and wealth are His property.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: soee meraa suaamee karanaihaar ||
english: He is the Creator, my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot baar jaaee balihaar ||1||
english: Millions of times, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo dhoor puneet karee ||
english: The dust of the feet of the Holy brings purity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man ke bikaar mitahi prabh simarat janam janam kee mail haree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remembering God in meditation, the mind's corruption is eradicated, and the filth of countless incarnations is washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai grih mahi sagal nidhaan ||
english: All treasures are in His household.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sevaa paaeeai maan ||
english: Serving Him, the mortal attains honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooranahaar ||
english: He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਆਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jee praan bhagatan aadhaar ||2||
english: He is the Support of the soul and the breath of life of His devotees. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sagal pragaas ||
english: His Light shines in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevahi bhagat gunataas ||
english: Chanting and meditating on God, the Treasure of Virtue, His devotees live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sev na birathee jaai ||
english: Service to Him does not go in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar ek dhiaai ||3||
english: Deep within your mind and body, meditate on the One Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਦਇਆ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: gur upades daiaa sa(n)tokh ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, compassion and contentment are found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਥੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan niramal ihu thok ||
english: This Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the immaculate object.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa leejai laR laai ||
english: Please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੫੫॥
transliteration: charan kamal naanak nit dhiaai ||4||42||55||
english: Nanak meditates continually on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||4||42||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੁਨੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur apune sunee aradaas ||
english: The True Guru has listened to my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj aaiaa sagalaa raas ||
english: All my affairs have been resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar prabhoo dhiaaiaa ||
english: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਡਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poore dar sagal chukaaiaa ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled all my fears. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sabh te vad samarath guradev ||
english: The All-powerful Divine Guru is the Greatest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh sukh paaee tis kee sev || rahaau ||
english: Serving Him, I obtain all comforts. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa keeaa sabh kichh hoi ||
english: Everything is done by Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa amar na metai koi ||
english: No one can erase His Eternal Decree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesar anoop ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is incomparably beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saphal moorat gur tis kaa roop ||2||
english: The Guru is the Image of Fulfillment, the Embodiment of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai a(n)tar basai har naam ||
english: The Name of the Lord abides deep within him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jo jo pekhai s braham giaan ||
english: Wherever he looks, he sees the Wisdom of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸੁਏ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bees bisue jaa kai man paragaas ||
english: His mind is totally enlightened and illuminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis jan kai paarabraham kaa nivaas ||3||
english: Within that person, the Supreme Lord God abides. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau sad karee namasakaar ||
english: I humbly bow to that Guru forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਜਾਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau sad jaau balihaar ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||
english: I wash the feet of the Guru, and drink in this water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੬॥
transliteration: gur naanak jap jap sad jeevaa ||4||43||56||
english: Chanting and meditating forever on Guru Nanak, I live. ||4||43||56||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 5 paRataal ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: paratipaal prabh kripaal kavan gun ganee ||
english: God is the Compassionate Cherisher. Who can count His Glorious Virtues?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik ra(n)g bahu tara(n)g sarab ko dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Countless colors, and countless waves of joy; He is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: anik giaan anik dhiaan anik jaap jaap taap ||
english: Endless spiritual wisdom, endless meditations, endless chants, intense meditations and austere self-disciplines.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨਿਤ ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਰ ਮੁਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik gunit dhunit lalit anik dhaar munee ||1||
english: Countless virtues, musical notes and playful sports; countless silent sages enshrine Him in their hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਜ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਸ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: anik naad anik baaj nimakh nimakh anik svaad anik dokh anik rog mitahi jas sunee ||
english: Countless melodies, countless instruments, countless tastes, each and every instant. Countless mistakes and countless diseases are removed by hearing His Praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਵ ਤਟਹ ਖਟਹ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਜਾਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥੮॥੨੧॥੭॥੫੭॥੯੩॥
transliteration: naanak sev apaar dev tatah khatah barat poojaa gavan bhavan jaatr karan sagal phal punee ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||
english: O Nanak, serving the Infinite, Divine Lord, one earns all the rewards and merits of performing the six rituals, fasts, worship services, pilgrimages to sacred rivers, and journeys to sacred shrines. ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aatam mahi raam raam mahi aatam cheenas gur beechaaraa ||
english: The Lord is in the soul, and the soul is in the Lord. This is realized through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee sabad pachhaanee dukh kaatai hau maaraa ||1||
english: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani is realized through the Word of the Shabad. Sorrow is dispelled, and egotism is eliminated. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਬੁਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naanak haumai rog bure ||
english: O Nanak, the disease of egotism is so very deadly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧੁਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa(n) tah ekaa bedan aape bakhasai sabad dhure ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the pain of the same disease. The Primal Lord Himself bestows the Shabad of His Word. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸੂਲਾਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape parakhe parakhanahaarai bahur soolaak na hoee ||
english: When the Appraiser Himself appraises the mortal, then he is not tested again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin kau nadar bhaee gur mele prabh bhaanaa sach soee ||2||
english: Those who are blessed with His Grace meet with the Guru. They alone are true, who are pleasing to God. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar rogee rogee dharat sabhogee ||
english: Air, water and fire are diseased; the world with its enjoyments is diseased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਹ ਸਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maat pitaa maaiaa deh s rogee rogee kuta(n)b sa(n)jogee ||3||
english: Mother, father, Maya and the body are diseased; those united with their relatives are diseased. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਸਰੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: rogee brahamaa bisan sarudraa rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are diseased; the whole world is diseased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har pad cheen bhae se mukate gur kaa sabad veechaaraa ||4||
english: Those who remember the Lord's Feet and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are liberated. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਨਦੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rogee saat samu(n)d sanadeeaa kha(n)d pataal s rog bhare ||
english: The seven seas are diseased, along with the rivers; the continents and the nether regions of the underworlds are full of disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਰਬੀ ਥਾਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har ke lok s saach suhele sarabee thaaee nadar kare ||5||
english: The people of the Lord dwell in Truth and peace; He blesses them with His Grace everywhere. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਾ ਹਠੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: rogee khat darasan bhekhadhaaree naanaa hathee anekaa ||
english: The six Shaastras are diseased, as are the many who follow the different religious orders.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਏਕਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bed kateb karahi kah bapure nah boojhahi ik ekaa ||6||
english: What can the poor Vedas and Bibles do? People do not understand the One and Only Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mith ras khaai s rog bhareejai ka(n)d mool sukh naahee ||
english: Eating sweet treats, the mortal is filled with disease; he finds no peace at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam visaar chalahi an maarag a(n)t kaal pachhutaahee ||7||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they walk on other paths, and at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: teerath bharamai rog na chhootas paRiaa baad bibaad bhaiaa ||
english: Wandering around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the mortal is not cured of his disease. Reading scripture, he gets involved in useless arguments.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: dubidhaa rog s adhik vaderaa maaiaa kaa muhataaj bhaiaa ||8||
english: The disease of duality is so very deadly; it causes dependence on Maya. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saachaa sabad salaahai man saachaa tis rog gaiaa ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh and praises the True Shabad with the True Lord in his mind is cured of his disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak har jan anadin niramal jin kau karam neesaan paiaa ||9||1||
english: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is immaculate, night and day; he bears the insignia of the Lord's Grace. ||9||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin karatai ik chalat upaaiaa ||
english: The Creator has staged His Wondrous Play.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anahad baanee sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: I listen to the Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, and the Bani of His Word.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole guramukh bujhaaiaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded and confused, while the Gurmukhs understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaran karataa karadaa aaiaa ||1||
english: The Creator creates the Cause that causes. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad merai a(n)tar dhiaan ||
english: Deep within my being, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau kabahu na chhodau har kaa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I shall never forsake the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਪੜਣ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pitaa prahalaad paRan pathaaiaa ||
english: Prahlaad's father sent him to school, to learn to read.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਪਾਟੀ ਪਾਧੇ ਕੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: lai paatee paadhe kai aaiaa ||
english: He took his writing tablet and went to the teacher.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹ ਪੜਉ ਅਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa nah paRau achaar ||
english: He said, "I shall not read anything except the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meree pateeaa likh dehu gobi(n)d muraar ||2||
english: Write the Lord's Name on my tablet." ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਸਿਉ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: putr prahilaad siu kahiaa maai ||
english: Prahlaad's mother said to her son,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨ ਪੜਹੁ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paravirat na paRahu rahee samajhaai ||
english: "I advise you not to read anything except what you are taught."

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau daataa har jeeu merai naal ||
english: He answered, "The Great Giver, my Fearless Lord God is always with me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਉ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je har chhodau tau kul laagai gaal ||3||
english: If I were to forsake the Lord, then my family would be disgraced." ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਵਿਗਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad sabh chaataRe vigaare ||
english: "Prahlaad has corrupted all the other students.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hamaaraa kahiaa na sunai aapane kaaraj savaare ||
english: He does not listen to what I say, and he does his own thing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh nagaree mahi bhagat driRaaee ||
english: He instigated devotional worship in the townspeople."

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dusat sabhaa kaa kichh na vasaaee ||4||
english: The gathering of the wicked people could not do anything against him. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਡੈ ਮਰਕੈ ਕੀਈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)dai marakai keeee pookaar ||
english: Sanda and Marka, his teachers, made the complaint.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਦੈਤ ਰਹੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhe dait rahe jhakh maar ||
english: All the demons kept trying in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kee pat raakhai soee ||
english: The Lord protected His humble devotee, and preserved his honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: keete kai kahiai kiaa hoee ||5||
english: What can be done by mere created beings? ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਦੈਤਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kirat sa(n)jogee dait raaj chalaaiaa ||
english: Because of his past karma, the demon ruled over his kingdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har na boojhai tin aap bhulaaiaa ||
english: He did not realize the Lord; the Lord Himself confused him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: putr prahalaad siu vaad rachaaiaa ||
english: He started an argument with his son Prahlaad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa na boojhai kaal neRai aaiaa ||6||
english: The blind one did not understand that his death was approaching. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਕੋਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬਾਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad kothe vich raakhiaa baar deeaa taalaa ||
english: Prahlaad was placed in a cell, and the door was locked.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਡਰਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau baalak mool na daraee merai a(n)tar gur gopaalaa ||
english: The fearless child was not afraid at all. He said, "Within my being, is the Guru, the Lord of the World."

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਅਨਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: keetaa hovai sareekee karai anahodaa naau dharaaiaa ||
english: The created being tried to compete with his Creator, but he assumed this name in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਆਇ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa sou aai pahutaa jan siu vaad rachaaiaa ||7||
english: That which was predestined for him has come to pass; he started an argument with the Lord's humble servant. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਜ ਉਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pitaa prahalaad siu guraj uthaaee ||
english: The father raised the club to strike down Prahlaad, saying,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾਂ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa(n) tumhaaraa jagadees gusaaee ||
english: "Where is your God, the Lord of the Universe, now?"

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan daataa a(n)t sakhaaee ||
english: He replied, "The Life of the World, the Great Giver, is my Help and Support in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rahiaa samaaee ||8||
english: Wherever I look, I see Him permeating and prevailing." ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਥੰਮੑੁ ਉਪਾੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tha(n)mh upaaR har aap dikhaaiaa ||
english: Tearing down the pillars, the Lord Himself appeared.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਦੈਤੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaaree dait maar pachaaiaa ||
english: The egotistical demon was killed and destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa man aana(n)d vajee vadhaaee ||
english: The minds of the devotees were filled with bliss, and congratulations poured in.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau de vadiaaee ||9||
english: He blessed His servant with glorious greatness. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa mohu upaaiaa ||
english: He created birth, death and attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa karatai likh paaiaa ||
english: The Creator has ordained coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad kai kaaraj har aap dikhaaiaa ||
english: For the sake of Prahlaad, the Lord Himself appeared.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa bol aagai aaiaa ||10||
english: The word of the devotee came true. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲੀ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dev kulee lakhimee kau karahi jaikaar ||
english: The gods proclaimed the victory of Lakshmi, and said,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maataa narasi(n)gh kaa roop nivaar ||
english: "O mother, make this form of the Man-lion disappear!"

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਭਉ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lakhimee bhau karai na saakai jaai ||
english: Lakshmi was afraid, and did not approach.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਆਇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: prahalaad jan charanee laagaa aai ||11||
english: The humble servant Prahlaad came and fell at the Lord's Feet. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur naam nidhaan driRaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru implanted the treasure of the Naam within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਝੂਠੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raaj maal jhoothee sabh maaiaa ||
english: Power, property and all Maya is false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਨਰ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lobhee nar rahe lapataai ||
english: But still, the greedy people continue clinging to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: har ke naam bin daragah milai sajaai ||12||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortals are punished in His Court. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sabh ko kare karaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, everyone acts as the Lord makes them act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se paravaan jinee har siu chit laaiaa ||
english: They alone are approved and accepted, who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa a(n)geekaar karadaa aaiaa ||
english: He has made His devotees His Own.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: karatai apanaa roop dikhaaiaa ||13||1||2||
english: The Creator has appeared in His Own Form. ||13||1||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te a(n)mrit phal paaiaa haumai trisan bujhaaee ||
english: Serving the Guru, I obtain the Ambrosial Fruit; my egotism and desire have been quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kaa naam hridai man vasiaa manasaa manahi samaaee ||1||
english: The Name of the Lord dwells within my heart and mind, and the desires of my mind are quieted. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu kripaa karahu mere piaare ||
english: O Dear Lord, my Beloved, please bless me with Your Mercy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin har gun deen jan maa(n)gai gur kai sabad udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, Your humble servant begs for Your Glorious Praises; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਰਤੀ ਅੰਚ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kau jam johi na saakai ratee a(n)ch dookh na laaee ||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch the humble Saints; it does not cause them even an iota of suffering or pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap tarahi sagale kul taarahi jo teree saranaaee ||2||
english: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Lord, save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kee paij rakhahi too aape eh teree vadiaaee ||
english: You Yourself save the honor of Your devotees; this is Your Glory, O Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh dukh kaatahi dubidhaa ratee na raaee ||3||
english: You cleanse them of the sins and the pains of countless incarnations; You love them without even an iota of duality. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ham mooR mugadh kichh boojhahi naahee too aape dehi bujhaaee ||
english: I am foolish and ignorant, and understand nothing. You Yourself bless me with understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee karasee avar na karanaa jaaee ||4||
english: You do whatever You please; nothing else can be done at all. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jagat upaai tudh dha(n)dhai laaiaa bhoo(n)dee kaar kamaaee ||
english: Creating the world, You have linked all to their tasks - even the evil deeds which men do.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: janam padaarath jooai haariaa sabadai surat na paaee ||5||
english: They lose this precious human life in the gamble, and do not understand the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh marahi tin kichhoo na soojhai duramat agiaan a(n)dhaaraa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs die, understanding nothing; they are enveloped by the darkness of evil-mindedness and ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bhavajal paar na paavahi kab hee doob mue bin gur sir bhaaraa ||6||
english: They do not cross over the terrible world-ocean; without the Guru, they drown and die. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachai sabad rate jan saache har prabh aap milaae ||
english: True are those humble beings who are imbued with the True Shabad; the Lord God unites them with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee sabad pachhaatee saach rahe liv laae ||7||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they come to understand the Shabad. They remain lovingly focused on the True Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aap niramal tere jan hai niramal gur kai sabad veechaare ||
english: You Yourself are Immaculate and Pure, and pure are Your humble servants who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai sad balihaarai raam naam ur dhaare ||8||2||3||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those, who enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts. ||8||2||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai soee vad raajaa ||
english: He alone is a great king, who keeps the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis poore kaajaa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his tasks are perfectly accomplished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tin kot dhan paae ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, obtains millions of treasures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam binaa janam birathaa jaae ||1||
english: Without the Naam, life is useless. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tis saalaahee jis har dhan raas ||
english: I praise that person, who has the capital of the Lord's Wealth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so vadabhaagee jis gur masatak haath ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is very fortunate, on whose forehead the Guru has placed His Hand. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਟ ਕਈ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis kot kaee sainaa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, has many millions of armies on his side.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੈਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis sahaj sukhainaa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, enjoys peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so seetal hooaa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart becomes cool and calm.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮੂਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam binaa dhrig jeevan mooaa ||2||
english: Without the Naam, both life and death are cursed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so jeevan mukataa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis sabh hee jugataa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart knows all ways and means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tin nau nidh paaee ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart obtains the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam binaa bhram aavai jaaee ||3||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal wanders, coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so veparavaahaa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is carefree and independent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis sad hee laahaa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart always earns a profit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis vad paravaaraa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a large family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam binaa manamukh gaavaaraa ||4||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal is just an ignorant, self-willed manmukh. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis nihachal aasan ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a permanent position.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis takhat nivaasan ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is seated on the throne.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so saachaa saahu ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the true king.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naamaheen naahee pat vesaahu ||5||
english: Without the Naam, no one has any honor or respect. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so sabh mahi jaataa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is famous everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so purakh bidhaataa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the Embodiment of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so sabh te oochaa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naam binaa bhram jonee moochaa ||6||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal wanders in reincarnation. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਪਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis pragat pahaaraa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart sees the Lord manifested in His Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai tis mitiaa a(n)dhaaraa ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his darkness is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis naam ridai so purakh paravaan ||
english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is approved and accepted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam binaa phir aavan jaan ||7||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: tin naam paaiaa jis bhaio kripaal ||
english: He alone receives the Naam, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਲਖੇ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mahi lakhe goupaal ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World is understood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe sukh paaiaa ||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation ends, and peace is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tatai tat milaaiaa ||8||1||4||
english: Says Nanak, my essence has merged in the Essence of the Lord. ||8||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀਨੇ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot bisan keene avataar ||
english: He created millions of incarnations of Vishnu.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਧ੍ਰਮਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kot brahama(n)d jaa ke dhramasaal ||
english: He created millions of universes as places to practice righteousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਹੇਸ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kot mahes upaai samaae ||
english: He created and destroyed millions of Shivas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਜਣ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot brahame jag saajan laae ||1||
english: He employed millions of Brahmas to create the worlds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਗੁਵਿੰਦੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aiso dhanee guvi(n)d hamaaraa ||
english: Such is my Lord and Master, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baran na saakau gun bisathaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot even describe His Many Virtues. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੇਵਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kot maaiaa jaa kai sevakaai ||
english: Millions of Mayas are His maid-servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਿਹਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kot jee jaa kee sihajaai ||
english: Millions of souls are His beds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਅੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kot upaarajanaa terai a(n)g ||
english: Millions of universes are the limbs of His Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਭਗਤ ਬਸਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kot bhagat basat har sa(n)g ||2||
english: Millions of devotees abide with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot chhatrapat karat namasakaar ||
english: Millions of kings with their crowns and canopies bow before Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਠਾਢੇ ਹੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: kot i(n)dr thaadhe hai duaar ||
