english: Millions of Indras stand at His Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kot baiku(n)th jaa kee drisatee maahi ||
english: Millions of heavenly paradises are within the scope of His Vision.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot naam jaa kee keemat naahi ||3||
english: Millions of His Names cannot even be appraised. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਦ ॥
transliteration: kot pooreeat hai jaa kai naad ||
english: Millions of celestial sounds resound for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਖਾਰੇ ਚਲਿਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: kot akhaare chalit bisamaad ||
english: His Wondrous Plays are enacted on millions of stages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot sakat siv aagiaakaar ||
english: Millions of Shaktis and Shivas are obedient to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਧਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kot jee devai aadhaar ||4||
english: He gives sustenance and support to millions of beings. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਝਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot teerath jaa ke charan majhaar ||
english: In His Feet are millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮ ਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot pavitr japat naam chaar ||
english: Millions chant His Sacred and Beautiful Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kot poojaaree karate poojaa ||
english: Millions of worshippers worship Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kot bisathaaran avar na doojaa ||5||
english: Millions of expanses are His; there is no other at all. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸ ॥
transliteration: kot mahimaa jaa kee niramal ha(n)s ||
english: Millions of swan-souls sing His Immaculate Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਸ ॥
transliteration: kot usatat jaa kee karat brahama(n)s ||
english: Millions of Brahma's sons sing His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਓਪਤਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kot paralau opat nimakh maahi ||
english: He creates and destroys millions, in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kot gunaa tere gane na jaahi ||6||
english: Millions are Your Virtues, Lord - they cannot even be counted. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਥਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kot giaanee kathahi giaan ||
english: Millions of spiritual teachers teach His spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kot dhiaanee dharat dhiaan ||
english: Millions of meditators focus on His meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਤਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kot tapeesar tap hee karate ||
english: Millions of austere penitents practice austerities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਨੀਸਰ ਮੋੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kot muneesar moun mahi rahate ||7||
english: Millions of silent sages dwell in silence. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: avigat naath agochar suaamee ||
english: Our Eternal, Imperishable, Incomprehensible Lord and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: poor rahiaa ghat a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is permeating all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jat kat dekhau teraa vaasaa ||
english: Wherever I look, I see Your Dwelling, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur keeo pragaasaa ||8||2||5||
english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with enlightenment. ||8||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur mo kau keeno daan ||
english: The True Guru has blessed me with this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: amol ratan har deeno naam ||
english: He has given me the Priceless Jewel of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚੋਜ ਆਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaj binod choj aana(n)taa ||
english: Now, I intuitively enjoy endless pleasures and wondrous play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh milio achi(n)taa ||1||
english: God has spontaneously met with Nanak. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak keerat har saachee ||
english: Says Nanak, True is the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bahur bahur tis sa(n)g man raachee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Again and again, my mind remains immersed in it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai bhojan bhaau ||
english: Spontaneously, I feed on the Love of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਲੀਚੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai leechai naau ||
english: Spontaneously, I take God's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai sabad udhaar ||
english: Spontaneously, I am saved by the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai bhare bha(n)daar ||2||
english: Spontaneously, my treasures are filled to overflowing. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai kaaraj poore ||
english: Spontaneously, my works are perfectly accomplished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਲਥੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai lathe visoore ||
english: Spontaneously, I am rid of sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai bairee meetaa ||
english: Spontaneously, my enemies have become friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: achi(n)to hee ihu man vas keetaa ||3||
english: Spontaneously, I have brought my mind under control. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t prabhoo ham keeaa dilaasaa ||
english: Spontaneously, God has comforted me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaaree pooran aasaa ||
english: Spontaneously, my hopes have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮੑਾ ਕਉ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਾਂਤੁ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamhaa kau sagal sidhaa(n)t ||
english: Spontaneously, I have totally realized the essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: achi(n)t ham kau gur deeno ma(n)t ||4||
english: Spontaneously, I have been blessed with the Guru's Mantra. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਬੈਰ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaare binase bair ||
english: Spontaneously, I am rid of hatred.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਧੇਰ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaare mite a(n)dher ||
english: Spontaneously, my darkness has been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)to hee man keeratan meethaa ||
english: Spontaneously, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise seems so sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: achi(n)to hee prabh ghat ghat deethaa ||5||
english: Spontaneously, I behold God in each and every heart. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t mitio hai sagalo bharamaa ||
english: Spontaneously, all my doubts have been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਵਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t vasio man sukh bisraamaa ||
english: Spontaneously, peace and celestial harmony fill my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai anahat vaajai ||
english: Spontaneously, the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current resounds within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai gobi(n)d gaajai ||6||
english: Spontaneously, the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t hamaarai man pateeaanaa ||
english: Spontaneously, my mind has been pleased and appeased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਨੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal dhanee achi(n)t pachhaanaa ||
english: I have spontaneously realized the Eternal, Unchanging Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਬੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)to upajio sagal bibekaa ||
english: Spontaneously, all wisdom and knowledge has welled up within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਚਰੀ ਹਥਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: achi(n)t charee hath har har tekaa ||7||
english: Spontaneously, the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, has come into my hands. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t prabhoo dhur likhiaa lekh ||
english: Spontaneously, God has recorded my pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t milio prabh thaakur ek ||
english: Spontaneously, the One Lord and Master God has met me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)t achi(n)taa sagalee gaee ||
english: Spontaneously, all my cares and worries have been taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਈ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: prabh naanak naanak naanak maee ||8||3||6||
english: Nanak, Nanak, Nanak, has merged into the Image of God. ||8||3||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau baanee bhagataa kee || kabeer jeeu ghar 1 ||
english: Bhairao, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu dhan mere har ko naau ||
english: The Name of the Lord - this alone is my wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਬਾਧਉ ਬੇਚਿ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaa(n)th na baadhau bech na khaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I do not tie it up to hide it, nor do I sell it to make my living. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naau mere khetee naau mere baaree ||
english: The Name is my crop, and the Name is my field.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat karau jan saran tumhaaree ||1||
english: As Your humble servant, I perform devotional worship to You; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥
transliteration: naau mere maaiaa naau mere poo(n)jee ||
english: The Name is Maya and wealth for me; the Name is my capital.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਨਉ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tumahi chhod jaanau nahee doojee ||2||
english: I do not forsake You; I do not know any other at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naau mere ba(n)dhip naau mere bhaaee ||
english: The Name is my family, the Name is my brother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naau mere sa(n)g a(n)t hoi sakhaaee ||3||
english: The Name is my companion, who will help me in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mahi jis rakhai udaas ||
english: One whom the Lord keeps detached from Maya

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer hau taa ko daas ||4||1||
english: - says Kabeer, I am his slave. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਂਗੇ ਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਂਗੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naa(n)ge aavan naa(n)ge jaanaa ||
english: Naked we come, and naked we go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਹਿਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koi na rahihai raajaa raanaa ||1||
english: No one, not even the kings and queens, shall remain. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: raam raajaa nau nidh merai ||
english: The Sovereign Lord is the nine treasures for me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਪੈ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)pai het kalat dhan terai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The possessions and the spouse to which the mortal is lovingly attached, are Your wealth, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਸੰਗ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਸੰਗਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: aavat sa(n)g na jaat sa(n)gaatee ||
english: They do not come with the mortal, and they do not go with him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਹਾਥੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahaa bhaio dar baa(n)dhe haathee ||2||
english: What good does it do him, if he has elephants tied up at his doorway? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੰਕਾ ਗਢੁ ਸੋਨੇ ਕਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: la(n)kaa gadh sone kaa bhaiaa ||
english: The fortress of Sri Lanka was made out of gold,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਰਾਵਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: moorakh raavan kiaa le gaiaa ||3||
english: but what could the foolish Raawan take with him when he left? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer kichh gun beechaar ||
english: Says Kabeer, think of doing some good deeds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਲੇ ਜੁਆਰੀ ਦੁਇ ਹਥ ਝਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: chale juaaree dui hath jhaar ||4||2||
english: In the end, the gambler shall depart empty-handed. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਇੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: mailaa brahamaa mailaa i(n)d ||
english: Brahma is polluted, and Indra is polluted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੈ ਚੰਦੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rav mailaa mailaa hai cha(n)d ||1||
english: The sun is polluted, and the moon is polluted. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mailaa malataa ihu sa(n)saar ||
english: This world is polluted with pollution.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ik har niramal jaa kaa a(n)t na paar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only the One Lord is Immaculate; He has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾਇ ਕੈ ਈਸ ॥
transliteration: maile brahama(n)daai kai ees ||
english: The rulers of kingdoms are polluted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਦਿਨ ਤੀਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maile nis baasur din tees ||2||
english: Nights and days, and the days of the month are polluted. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mailaa motee mailaa heer ||
english: The pearl is polluted, the diamond is polluted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਪਉਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mailaa paun paavak ar neer ||3||
english: Wind, fire and water are polluted. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਸਿਵ ਸੰਕਰਾ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
transliteration: maile siv sa(n)karaa mahes ||
english: Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh are polluted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਭੇਖ ॥੪॥
transliteration: maile sidh saadhik ar bhekh ||4||
english: The Siddhas, seekers and strivers, and those who wear religious robes, are polluted. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਜਟਾ ਸਹੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: maile jogee ja(n)gam jataa sahet ||
english: The Yogis and wandering hermits with their matted hair are polluted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਸਮੇਤਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: mailee kaaiaa ha(n)s samet ||5||
english: The body, along with the swan-soul, is polluted. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer te jan paravaan ||
english: Says Kabeer, those humble beings are approved and pure,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨ ॥੬॥੩॥
transliteration: niramal te jo raamahi jaan ||6||3||
english: Who know the Lord. ||6||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਕਾ ਕਿਬਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: man kar makaa kibalaa kar dehee ||
english: Let your mind be Mecca, and your body the temple of worship.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਨਹਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bolanahaar param gur ehee ||1||
english: Let the Supreme Guru be the One who speaks. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਬਾਂਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
transliteration: kahu re mulaa(n) baa(n)g nivaaj ||
english: O Mullah, utter the call to prayer.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਦਸੈ ਦਰਵਾਜ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek maseet dasai daravaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The one mosque has ten doors. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਿਮਿਲਿ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਦੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: misimil taamas bharam kadooree ||
english: So slaughter your evil nature, doubt and cruelty;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਾਖਿ ਲੇ ਪੰਚੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਬੂਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaakh le pa(n)chai hoi sabooree ||2||
english: consume the five demons and you shall be blessed with contentment. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਕਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo turak kaa saahib ek ||
english: Hindus and Muslims have the same One Lord and Master.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਸੇਖ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kah karai mulaa(n) kah karai sekh ||3||
english: What can the Mullah do, and what can the Shaykh do? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer hau bhaiaa divaanaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, I have gone insane.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: mus mus manooaa sahaj samaanaa ||4||4||
english: Slaughtering, slaughtering my mind, I have merged into the Celestial Lord. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਲਿਤਾ ਬਿਗਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa kai sa(n)g salitaa bigaree ||
english: When the stream flows into the Ganges,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਲਿਤਾ ਗੰਗਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so salitaa ga(n)gaa hoi nibaree ||1||
english: Then it becomes the Ganges. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bigario kabeeraa raam duhaaee ||
english: Just so, Kabeer has changed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਭਇਓ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saach bhaio an katahi na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has become the Embodiment of Truth, and he does not go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan kai sa(n)g taravar bigario ||
english: Associating with the sandalwood tree, the tree nearby is changed;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so taravar cha(n)dan hoi nibario ||2||
english: that tree begins to smell just like the sandalwood tree. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: paaras kai sa(n)g taa(n)baa bigario ||
english: Coming into contact with the philosophers' stone, copper is transformed;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so taa(n)baa ka(n)chan hoi nibario ||3||
english: that copper is transformed into gold. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan sa(n)g kabeeraa bigario ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, Kabeer is transformed;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰਿਓ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: so kabeer raamai hoi nibario ||4||5||
english: that Kabeer is transformed into the Lord. ||4||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੇ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਹਥਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਬਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: maathe tilak hath maalaa baanaa(n) ||
english: Some apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, hold malas in their hands, and wear religious robes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਖਿਲਉਨਾ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: logan raam khilaunaa jaanaa(n) ||1||
english: Some people think that the Lord is a play-thing. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹਉ ਬਉਰਾ ਤਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jau hau bauraa tau raam toraa ||
english: If I am insane, then I am Yours, O Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: log maram kah jaanai moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How can people know my secret? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੋਰਉ ਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਪੂਜਉ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: torau na paatee poojau na devaa ||
english: I do not pick leaves as offerings, and I do not worship idols.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam bhagat bin nihaphal sevaa ||2||
english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, service is useless. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur poojau sadaa sadaa manaavau ||
english: I worship the True Guru; forever and ever, I surrender to Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aisee sev daragah sukh paavau ||3||
english: By such service, I find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: log kahai kabeer bauraanaa ||
english: People say that Kabeer has gone insane.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: kabeer kaa maram raam pahichaanaa(n) ||4||6||
english: Only the Lord realizes the secret of Kabeer. ||4||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ulat jaat kul dooo bisaaree ||
english: Turning away from the world, I have forgotten both my social class and ancestry.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਬੁਨਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: su(n)n sahaj mahi bunat hamaaree ||1||
english: My weaving now is in the most profound celestial stillness. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਝਗਰਾ ਰਹਾ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa jhagaraa rahaa na kooo ||
english: I have no quarrel with anyone.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਛਾਡੇ ਦੋਊ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit mulaa(n) chhaade dooo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have abandoned both the Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, and the Mullahs, the Muslim priests. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੁਨਿ ਬੁਨਿ ਆਪ ਆਪੁ ਪਹਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: bun bun aap aap pahiraavau ||
english: I weave and weave, and wear what I weave.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਨਹੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jah nahee aap tahaa hoi gaavau ||2||
english: Where egotism does not exist, there I sing God's Praises. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit mulaa(n) jo likh deeaa ||
english: Whatever the Pandits and Mullahs have written,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhaad chale ham kachhoo na leeaa ||3||
english: I reject; I do not accept any of it. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਇਖਲਾਸੁ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਲੇ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ridai ikhalaas nirakh le meeraa ||
english: My heart is pure, and so I have seen the Lord within.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: aap khoj khoj mile kabeeraa ||4||7||
english: Searching, searching within the self, Kabeer has met the Lord. ||4||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਆਦਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: niradhan aadar koee na dei ||
english: No one respects the poor man.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਓਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਧਰੇਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laakh jatan karai ohu chit na dharei ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He may make thousands of efforts, but no one pays any attention to him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਸਰਧਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jau niradhan saradhan kai jaai ||
english: When the poor man goes to the rich man,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਗੇ ਬੈਠਾ ਪੀਠਿ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aage baithaa peeth phiraai ||1||
english: and sits right in front of him, the rich man turns his back on him. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸਰਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jau saradhan niradhan kai jaai ||
english: But when the rich man goes to the poor man,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਆ ਆਦਰੁ ਲੀਆ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deeaa aadar leeaa bulaai ||2||
english: the poor man welcomes him with respect. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਸਰਧਨੁ ਦੋਨਉ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: niradhan saradhan donau bhaaee ||
english: The poor man and the rich man are both brothers.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਨ ਮੇਟੀ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabh kee kalaa na metee jaaee ||3||
english: God's pre-ordained plan cannot be erased. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer niradhan hai soee ||
english: Says Kabeer, he alone is poor,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: jaa ke hiradai naam na hoee ||4||8||
english: who does not have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart. ||4||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te bhagat kamaaee ||
english: Serving the Guru, devotional worship is practiced.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tab ih maanas dehee paaee ||
english: Then, this human body is obtained.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: is dehee kau simarahi dev ||
english: Even the gods long for this human body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so dehee bhaj har kee sev ||1||
english: So vibrate that human body, and think of serving the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਜਹੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਭੂਲਿ ਮਤ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bhajahu goubi(n)d bhool mat jaahu ||
english: Vibrate, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and never forget Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਏਹੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam kaa ehee laahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the blessed opportunity of this human incarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਰਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jab lag jaraa rog nahee aaiaa ||
english: As long as the disease of old age has not come to the body,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jab lag kaal grasee nahee kaaiaa ||
english: and as long as death has not come and seized the body,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jab lag bikal bhaee nahee baanee ||
english: and as long as your voice has not lost its power,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਜਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaj lehi re man saarigapaanee ||2||
english: O mortal being, vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਨ ਭਜਸਿ ਭਜਸਿ ਕਬ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ab na bhajas bhajas kab bhaaee ||
english: If you do not vibrate and meditate on Him now, when will you, O Sibing of Destiny?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਭਜਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aavai a(n)t na bhajiaa jaaee ||
english: When the end comes, you will not be able to vibrate and meditate on Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਬ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karahi soee ab saar ||
english: Whatever you have to do - now is the best time to do it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: phir pachhutaahu na paavahu paar ||3||
english: Otherwise, you shall regret and repent afterwards, and you shall not be carried across to the other side. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: so sevak jo laaiaa sev ||
english: He alone is a servant, whom the Lord enjoins to His service.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: tin hee paae nira(n)jan dev ||
english: He alone attains the Immaculate Divine Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
transliteration: gur mil taa ke khulhe kapaat ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, his doors are opened wide,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਨੀ ਬਾਟ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bahur na aavai jonee baat ||4||
english: and he does not have to journey again on the path of reincarnation. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ihee teraa ausar ih teree baar ||
english: This is your chance, and this is your time.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤੂ ਦੇਖੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat bheetar too dekh bichaar ||
english: Look deep into your own heart, and reflect on this.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer jeet kai haar ||
english: Says Kabeer, you can win or lose.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: bahu bidh kahio pukaar pukaar ||5||1||9||
english: In so many ways, I have proclaimed this out loud. ||5||1||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਬਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: siv kee puree basai budh saar ||
english: In the City of God, sublime understanding prevails.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tah tumh mil kai karahu bichaar ||
english: There, you shall meet with the Lord, and reflect on Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
transliteration: eet oot kee sojhee parai ||
english: Thus, you shall understand this world and the next.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun karam meraa kar kar marai ||1||
english: What is the use of claiming that you own everything, if you only die in the end? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nij pad oopar laago dhiaan ||
english: I focus my meditation on my inner self, deep within.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam naam moraa braham giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Name of the Sovereign Lord is my spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਬੰਧਿਆ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: mool duaarai ba(n)dhiaa ba(n)dh ||
english: In the first chakra, the root chakra, I have grasped the reins and tied them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: rav oopar gahi raakhiaa cha(n)d ||
english: I have firmly placed the moon above the sun.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਛਮ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਤਪੈ ॥
transliteration: pachham duaarai sooraj tapai ||
english: The sun blazes forth at the western gate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰ ਡੰਡ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mer da(n)d sir oopar basai ||2||
english: Through the central channel of the Shushmanaa, it rises up above my head. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਸਚਮ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਲ ਓੜ ॥
transliteration: pasacham duaare kee sil oR ||
english: There is a stone at that western gate,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਸਿਲ ਊਪਰਿ ਖਿੜਕੀ ਅਉਰ ॥
transliteration: tih sil oopar khiRakee aur ||
english: and above that stone, is another window.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਿੜਕੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: khiRakee oopar dasavaa duaar ||
english: Above that window is the Tenth Gate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer taa kaa a(n)t na paar ||3||2||10||
english: Says Kabeer, it has no end or limitation. ||3||2||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so mulaa(n) jo man siu larai ||
english: He alone is a Mullah, who struggles with his mind,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur upades kaal siu jurai ||
english: and through the Guru's Teachings, fights with death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਮਰਦੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kaal purakh kaa maradai maan ||
english: He crushes the pride of the Messenger of Death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਲਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis mulaa kau sadaa salaam ||1||
english: Unto that Mullah, I ever offer greetings of respect. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਕਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: hai hajoor kat door bataavahu ||
english: God is present, right here at hand; why do you say that He is far away?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁੰਦਰ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: du(n)dar baadhahu su(n)dar paavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Tie up your disturbing passions, and find the Beauteous Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaajee so j kaaiaa beechaarai ||
english: He alone is a Qazi, who contemplates the human body,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਜਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kee agan braham parajaarai ||
english: and through the fire of the body, is illumined by God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਝਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: supanai bi(n)d na deee jharanaa ||
english: He does not lose his semen, even in his dreams;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਜੀ ਕਉ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis kaajee kau jaraa na maranaa ||2||
english: for such a Qazi, there is no old age or death. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਰ ਤਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: so surataan j dui sar taanai ||
english: He alone is a sultan and a king, who shoots the two arrows,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਨੈ ॥
transliteration: baahar jaataa bheetar aanai ||
english: gathers in his outgoing mind,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gagan ma(n)dal mahi lasakar karai ||
english: and assembles his army in the realm of the mind's sky, the Tenth Gate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾਨੁ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so surataan chhatr sir dharai ||3||
english: The canopy of royalty waves over such a sultan. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jogee gorakh gorakh karai ||
english: The Yogi cries out, "Gorakh, Gorakh".

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo raam naam ucharai ||
english: The Hindu utters the Name of Raam.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: musalamaan kaa ek khudaai ||
english: The Muslim has only One God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kabeer kaa suaamee rahiaa samaai ||4||3||11||
english: The Lord and Master of Kabeer is all-pervading. ||4||3||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਕਹਤੇ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: jo paathar kau kahate dev ||
english: Those who call a stone their god

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: taa kee birathaa hovai sev ||
english: their service is useless.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਂਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo paathar kee paa(n)ee paai ||
english: Those who fall at the feet of a stone god

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਅਜਾਂਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis kee ghaal ajaa(n)ee jaai ||1||
english: - their work is wasted in vain. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਸਦ ਬੋਲੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: thaakur hamaraa sad bola(n)taa ||
english: My Lord and Master speaks forever.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa kau prabh daan detaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God gives His gifts to all living beings. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar deu na jaanai a(n)dh ||
english: The Divine Lord is within the self, but the spiritually blind one does not know this.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: bhram kaa mohiaa paavai pha(n)dh ||
english: Deluded by doubt, he is caught in the noose.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨ ਪਾਥਰੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: na paathar bolai naa kichh dei ||
english: The stone does not speak; it does not give anything to anyone.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phokat karam nihaphal hai sev ||2||
english: Such religious rituals are useless; such service is fruitless. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je miratak kau cha(n)dan chaRaavai ||
english: If a corpse is anointed with sandalwood oil,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: us te kahahu kavan phal paavai ||
english: what good does it do?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਰੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: je miratak kau bisataa maahi rulaaee ||
english: If a corpse is rolled in manure,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa(n) miratak kaa kiaa ghat jaaee ||3||
english: what does it lose from this? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਕਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer hau kahau pukaar ||
english: Says Kabeer, I proclaim this out loud

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਮਝਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: samajh dekh saakat gaavaar ||
english: behold, and understand, you ignorant, faithless cynic.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਰ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bahut ghar gaale ||
english: The love of duality has ruined countless homes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: raam bhagat hai sadaa sukhaale ||4||4||12||
english: The Lord's devotees are forever in bliss. ||4||4||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਮੀਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
transliteration: jal mahi meen maaiaa ke bedhe ||
english: The fish in the water is attached to Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਛੇਦੇ ॥
transliteration: deepak pata(n)g maaiaa ke chhede ||
english: The moth fluttering around the lamp is pierced through by Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਕਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam maaiaa ku(n)char kau biaapai ||
english: The sexual desire of Maya afflicts the elephant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਖਾਪੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhuia(n)gam bhri(n)g maaiaa mahi khaape ||1||
english: The snakes and bumble bees are destroyed through Maya. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਐਸੀ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa aisee mohanee bhaaee ||
english: Such are the enticements of Maya, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਡਹਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jete jee tete dahakaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As many living beings are there are, have been deceived. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)khee mrig maaiaa mahi raate ||
english: The birds and the deer are imbued with Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਰ ਮਾਖੀ ਅਧਿਕ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: saakar maakhee adhik sa(n)taape ||
english: Sugar is a deadly trap for the flies.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੇ ਉਸਟ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ture usat maaiaa mahi bhelaa ||
english: Horses and camels are absorbed in Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sidh chauraaseeh maaiaa mahi khelaa ||2||
english: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of miraculous spiritual powers, play in Maya. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਜਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: chhi jatee maaiaa ke ba(n)daa ||
english: The six celibates are slaves of Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਵੈ ਨਾਥ ਸੂਰਜ ਅਰੁ ਚੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: navai naath sooraj ar cha(n)daa ||
english: So are the nine masters of Yoga, and the sun and the moon.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਪੇ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tape rakheesar maaiaa mahi sootaa ||
english: The austere disciplinarians and the Rishis are asleep in Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maaiaa mahi kaal ar pa(n)ch dootaa ||3||
english: Death and the five demons are in Maya. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਨ ਸਿਆਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: suaan siaal maaiaa mahi raataa ||
english: Dogs and jackals are imbued with Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੰਤਰ ਚੀਤੇ ਅਰੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)tar cheete ar si(n)ghaataa ||
english: Monkeys, leopards and lions,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਜਾਰ ਗਾਡਰ ਅਰੁ ਲੂਬਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maa(n)jaar gaadar ar loobaraa ||
english: cats, sheep, foxes,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਮੂਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: birakh mool maaiaa mahi paraa ||4||
english: trees and roots are planted in Maya. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa a(n)tar bheene dev ||
english: Even the gods are drenched with Maya,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਤੇਵ ॥
transliteration: saagar i(n)draa ar dharatev ||
english: as are the oceans, the sky and the earth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer jis udar tis maaiaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, whoever has a belly to fill, is under the spell of Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਛੂਟੇ ਜਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੩॥
transliteration: tab chhoote jab saadhoo paaiaa ||5||5||13||
english: The mortal is emancipated only when he meets the Holy Saint. ||5||5||13||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jab lag meree meree karai ||
english: As long as he cries out, Mine! Mine!,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tab lag kaaj ek nahee sarai ||
english: none of his tasks is accomplished.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jab meree meree mit jaai ||
english: When such possessiveness is erased and removed,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab prabh kaaj savaarahi aai ||1||
english: then God comes and resolves his affairs. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa giaan bichaar manaa ||
english: Contemplate such spiritual wisdom, O mortal man.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kee na simarahu dukh bha(n)janaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Destroyer of pain? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jab lag si(n)gh rahai ban maahi ||
english: As long as the tiger lives in the forest,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਨੁ ਫੂਲੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tab lag ban phoolai hee naahi ||
english: the forest does not flower.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਆਰੁ ਸਿੰਘ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jab hee siaar si(n)gh kau khaai ||
english: But when the jackal eats the tiger,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫੂਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phool rahee sagalee banaraai ||2||
english: then the entire forest flowers. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤੋ ਬੂਡੈ ਹਾਰੋ ਤਿਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jeeto boodai haaro tirai ||
english: The victorious are drowned, while the defeated swim across.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paar utarai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one crosses over and is saved.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: daas kabeer kahai samajhaai ||
english: Slave Kabeer speaks and teaches:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪॥
transliteration: keval raam rahahu liv laai ||3||6||14||
english: remain lovingly absorbed, attuned to the Lord alone. ||3||6||14||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: satar saii salaar hai jaa ke ||
english: He has 7,000 commanders,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਵਾ ਲਾਖੁ ਪੈਕਾਬਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: savaa laakh paikaabar taa ke ||
english: and hundreds of thousands of prophets;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਜੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਠਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sekh j kaheeahi kot athaasee ||
english: He is said to have 88,000,000 shaykhs,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhapan kot jaa ke khel khaasee ||1||
english: and 56,000,000 attendants. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਗਰੀਬ ਕੀ ਕੋ ਗੁਜਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mo gareeb kee ko gujaraavai ||
english: I am meek and poor - what chance do I have of being heard there?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਜਲਸਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: majalas door mahal ko paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His Court is so far away; only a rare few attain the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਹੈ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tetees karoRee hai khel khaanaa ||
english: He has 33,000,000 play-houses.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ਲਖ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਵਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: chauraasee lakh phirai divaanaa(n) ||
english: His beings wander insanely through 8.4 million incarnations.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦਮ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baabaa aadam kau kichh nadar dikhaaee ||
english: He bestowed His Grace on Adam, the father of mankind,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਨਿ ਭੀ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਘਨੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: un bhee bhisat ghaneree paaee ||2||
english: who then lived in paradise for a long time. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜਰਦ ਰੂ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dil khalahal jaa kai jarad roo baanee ||
english: Pale are the faces of those whose hearts are disturbed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਰੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: chhod kateb karai saitaanee ||
english: They have forsaken their Bible, and practice Satanic evil.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਰੋਸੁ ਹੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa dos ros hai loee ||
english: One who blames the world, and is angry with people,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: apanaa keeaa paavai soee ||3||
english: shall receive the fruits of his own actions. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਮ ਸਦਾ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tum daate ham sadaa bhikhaaree ||
english: You are the Great Giver, O Lord; I am forever a beggar at Your Door.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਉ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਜਗਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: deu jabaab hoi bajagaaree ||
english: If I were to deny You, then I would be a wretched sinner.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਨਹ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: daas kabeer teree panah samaanaa(n) ||
english: Slave Kabeer has entered Your Shelter.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਿਸਤੁ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਹਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੫॥
transliteration: bhisat najeek raakh rahamaanaa ||4||7||15||
english: Keep me near You, O Merciful Lord God - that is heaven for me. ||4||7||15||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਊਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sabh koee chalan kahat hai oohaa(n) ||
english: Everyone speaks of going there,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naa jaanau baiku(n)th hai kahaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: but I do not even know where heaven is. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਆਪ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aap aap kaa maram na jaanaa(n) ||
english: One who does not even know the mystery of his own self,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਬਖਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baatan hee baiku(n)th bakhaanaa(n) ||1||
english: speaks of heaven, but it is only talk. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jab lag man baiku(n)th kee aas ||
english: As long as the mortal hopes for heaven,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tab lag naahee charan nivaas ||2||
english: he will not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਾਈ ਕੋਟੁ ਨ ਪਰਲ ਪਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khaaee kot na paral pagaaraa ||
english: Heaven is not a fort with moats and ramparts, and walls plastered with mud;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naa jaanau baiku(n)th duaaraa ||3||
english: I do not know what heaven's gate is like. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਮੀਰ ਅਬ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kahi kameer ab kaheeai kaahi ||
english: Says Kabeer, now what more can I say?

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat baiku(n)thai aahi ||4||8||16||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven itself. ||4||8||16||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਲੀਜੈ ਗਢੁ ਬੰਕਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiu leejai gadh ba(n)kaa bhaaee ||
english: How can the beautiful fortress be conquered, O Siblings of Destiny?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੋਵਰ ਕੋਟ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਵਰ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dovar kot ar tevar khaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It has double walls and triple moats. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਪਚੀਸ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਆਡੀ ਪਰਬਲ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch pachees moh mad matasar aadee parabal maaiaa ||
english: It is defended by the five elements, the twenty-five categories, attachment, pride, jealousy and the awesomely powerful Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਗਰੀਬ ਕੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan gareeb ko jor na pahuchai kahaa karau raghuraaiaa ||1||
english: The poor mortal being does not have the strength to conquer it; what should I do now, O Lord? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਿਵਾਰੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam kivaaree dukh sukh daravaanee paap pu(n)n daravaajaa ||
english: Sexual desire is the window, pain and pleasure are the gate-keepers, virtue and sin are the gates.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਦੁੰਦਰ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: krodh pradhaan mahaa bad du(n)dar tah man maavaasee raajaa ||2||
english: Anger is the great supreme commander, full of argument and strife, and the mind is the rebel king there. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸਨਾਹ ਟੋਪੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੋ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਚਢਾਈ ॥
transliteration: svaad sanaah top mamataa ko kubudh kamaan chadhaaee ||
english: Their armor is the pleasure of tastes and flavors, their helmets are worldly attachments; they take aim with their bows of corrupt intellect.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤੀਰ ਰਹੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਉ ਗਢੁ ਲੀਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tisanaa teer rahe ghat bheetar iu gadh leeo na jaaee ||3||
english: The greed that fills their hearts is the arrow; with these things, their fortress is impregnable. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਵਾਈ ਗੋਲਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prem paleetaa surat havaaee golaa giaan chalaaiaa ||
english: But I have made divine love the fuse, and deep meditation the bomb; I have launched the rocket of spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਰਜਾਲੀ ਏਕਹਿ ਚੋਟ ਸਿਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: braham agan sahaje parajaalee ekahi chot sijhaaiaa ||4||
english: The fire of God is lit by intuition, and with one shot, the fortress is taken. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਲੈ ਲਰਨੇ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh lai larane laagaa tore dui daravaajaa ||
english: Taking truth and contentment with me, I begin the battle and storm both the gates.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਕਰਿਓ ਗਢ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat ar gur kee kripaa te pakario gadh ko raajaa ||5||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and by Guru's Grace, I have captured the king of the fortress. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਵਤ ਭੀਰਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀ ਕਾਲ ਭੈ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bhagavat bheer sakat simaran kee katee kaal bhai phaasee ||
english: With the army of God's devotees, and Shakti, the power of meditation, I have snapped the noose of the fear of death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਮੀਰੁ ਚੜੑਿਓ ਗੜੑ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਲੀਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੬॥੯॥੧੭॥
transliteration: daas kameer chaRhio gaRh oopar raaj leeo abinaasee ||6||9||17||
english: Slave Kabeer has climbed to the top of the fortress; I have obtained the eternal, imperishable domain. ||6||9||17||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗ ਗੁਸਾਇਨਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)g gusaain gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: The mother Ganges is deep and profound.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੰਜੀਰ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਖਰੇ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ja(n)jeer baa(n)dh kar khare kabeer ||1||
english: Tied up in chains, they took Kabeer there. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਡਿਗੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man na digai tan kaahe kau daraai ||
english: My mind was not shaken; why should my body be afraid?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal chit rahio samaai || rahaau ||
english: My consciousness remained immersed in the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਕੀ ਲਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa kee lahar meree tutee ja(n)jeer ||
english: The waves of the Ganges broke the chains,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗਛਾਲਾ ਪਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mrigachhaalaa par baithe kabeer ||2||
english: and Kabeer was seated on a deer skin. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕੰਬੀਰ ਕੋਊ ਸੰਗ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: kahi ka(n)beer kooo sa(n)g na saath ||
english: Says Kabeer, I have no friend or companion.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਰਾਖਨ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ॥੩॥੧੦॥੧੮॥
transliteration: jal thal raakhan hai raghunaath ||3||10||18||
english: On the water, and on the land, the Lord is my Protector. ||3||10||18||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau kabeer jeeu asatapadee ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, Kabeer Jee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਦ੍ਰੁਗਮ ਗੜਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਾਸ ॥
transliteration: agam drugam gaR rachio baas ||
english: God constructed a fortress, inaccessible and unreachable, in which He dwells.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jaa mahi jot kare paragaas ||
english: There, His Divine Light radiates forth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਜੁਲੀ ਚਮਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: bijulee chamakai hoi ana(n)d ||
english: Lightning blazes, and bliss prevails there,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪਉੜੑੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jih pauRhe prabh baal gobi(n)d ||1||
english: where the Eternally Young Lord God abides. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu jeeu raam naam liv laagai ||
english: This soul is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaraa maran chhootai bhram bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is saved from old age and death, and its doubt runs away. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: abaran baran siu man hee preet ||
english: Those who believe in high and low social classes,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੀਤ ॥
transliteration: haumai gaavan gaavahi geet ||
english: only sing songs and chants of egotism.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਹੋਤ ਝੁਨਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anahad sabad hot jhunakaar ||
english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, resounds in that place,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪਉੜੑੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jih pauRhe prabh sree gopaal ||2||
english: where the Supreme Lord God abides. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)dal ma(n)dal ma(n)dal ma(n)daa ||
english: He creates planets, solar systems and galaxies;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੀਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਖੰਡਾ ॥
transliteration: tri asathaan teen tri kha(n)daa ||
english: He destroys the three worlds, the three gods and the three qualities.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਭ ਅੰਤ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar rahiaa abh a(n)t ||
english: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord God dwells in the heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paar na paavai ko dharaneedhar ma(n)t ||3||
english: No one can find the limits or the secrets of the Lord of the World. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਦਲੀ ਪੁਹਪ ਧੂਪ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kadalee puhap dhoop paragaas ||
english: The Lord shines forth in the plantain flower and the sunshine.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਜ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਓ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: raj pa(n)kaj mahi leeo nivaas ||
english: He dwells in the pollen of the lotus flower.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਦਸ ਦਲ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: duaadas dal abh a(n)tar ma(n)t ||
english: The Lord's secret is within the twelve petals of the heart-lotus.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਪਉੜੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਮਲਾ ਕੰਤ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jah pauRe sree kamalaa ka(n)t ||4||
english: The Supreme Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi dwells there. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aradh uradh mukh laago kaas ||
english: He is like the sky, stretching across the lower, upper and middle realms.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n ma(n)dal mahi kar paragaas ||
english: In the profoundly silent celestial realm, He radiates forth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾਂ ਸੂਰਜ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੰਦ ॥
transliteration: oohaa(n) sooraj naahee cha(n)d ||
english: Neither the sun nor the moon are there,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aad nira(n)jan karai ana(n)d ||5||
english: but the Primal Immaculate Lord celebrates there. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਿ ਪਿੰਡਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: so brahama(n)d pi(n)d so jaan ||
english: Know that He is in the universe, and in the body as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maan sarovar kar isanaan ||
english: Take your cleansing bath in the Mansarovar Lake.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਪ ॥
transliteration: soha(n) so jaa kau hai jaap ||
english: Chant "Sohang" - "He is me."

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪੁੰਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਪ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jaa kau lipat na hoi pu(n)n ar paap ||6||
english: He is not affected by either virtue or vice. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਘਾਮ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਮ ॥
transliteration: abaran baran ghaam nahee chhaam ||
english: He is not affected by either high or low social class, sunshine or shade.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
transliteration: avar na paaeeai gur kee saam ||
english: He is in the Guru's Sanctuary, and nowhere else.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taaree na tarai aavai na jaai ||
english: He is not diverted by diversions, comings or goings.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: su(n)n sahaj mahi rahio samaai ||7||
english: Remain intuitively absorbed in the celestial void. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man madhe jaanai je koi ||
english: One who knows the Lord in the mind

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਆਪੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo bolai so aapai hoi ||
english: whatever he says, comes to pass.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jot ma(n)tr man asathir karai ||
english: One who firmly implants the Lord's Divine Light, and His Mantra within the mind

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਰੈ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer so praanee tarai ||8||1||
english: - says Kabeer, such a mortal crosses over to the other side. ||8||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kot soor jaa kai paragaas ||
english: Millions of suns shine for Him,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਕਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kot mahaadev ar kabilaas ||
english: millions of Shivas and Kailash mountains.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: duragaa kot jaa kai maradan karai ||
english: Millions of Durga goddesses massage His Feet.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: brahamaa kot bed ucharai ||1||
english: Millions of Brahmas chant the Vedas for Him. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਜਾਚਉ ਤਉ ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jau jaachau tau keval raam ||
english: When I beg, I beg only from the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan dev siu naahee kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have nothing to do with any other deities. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਰਾਕ ॥
transliteration: kot cha(n)drame karahi charaak ||
english: Millions of moons twinkle in the sky.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਤੇਤੀਸਉ ਜੇਵਹਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
transliteration: sur teteesau jevahi paak ||
english: Three hundred thirty million gods eat the Lord's offerings.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੋਟਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nav grah kot thaadhe darabaar ||
english: The nine stars, a million times over, stand at His Door.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharam kot jaa kai pratihaar ||2||
english: Millions of Righteous Judges of Dharma are His gate-keepers. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਚਉਬਾਰੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pavan kot chaubaare phirahi ||
english: Millions of winds blow around Him in the four directions.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੇਜ ਬਿਸਥਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: baasak kot sej bisatharahi ||
english: Millions of serpents prepare His bed.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਨੀਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: samu(n)d kot jaa ke paaneehaar ||
english: Millions of oceans are His water-carriers.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰੋਮਾਵਲਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: romaaval kot athaarah bhaar ||3||
english: The eighteen million loads of vegetation are His Hair. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਮੇਰ ਭਰਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot kamer bharahi bha(n)daar ||
english: Millions of treasurers fill His Treasury.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿਕ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕਰੈ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kotik lakhimee karai seegaar ||
english: Millions of Lakshmis adorn themselves for Him.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kotik paap pu(n)n bahu hirahi ||
english: Many millions of vices and virtues look up to Him.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: i(n)dr kot jaa ke sevaa karahi ||4||
english: Millions of Indras serve Him. ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: chhapan kot jaa kai pratihaar ||
english: Fifty-six million clouds are His.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਗਰੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਖਿਅਤ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nagaree nagaree khiat apaar ||
english: In each and every village, His infinite fame has spread.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲਟ ਛੂਟੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: lat chhootee varatai bikaraal ||
english: Wild demons with dishevelled hair move about.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲਾ ਖੇਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kot kalaa khelai gopaal ||5||
english: The Lord plays in countless ways. ||5||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਗ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot jag jaa kai darabaar ||
english: Millions of charitable feasts are held in His Court,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)dhrab kot karahi jaikaar ||
english: and millions of celestial singers celebrate His victory.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਭੈ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: bidiaa kot sabhai gun kahai ||
english: Millions of sciences all sing His Praises.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਊ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: taoo paarabraham kaa a(n)t na lahai ||6||
english: Even so, the limits of the Supreme Lord God cannot be found. ||6||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ॥
transliteration: baavan kot jaa kai romaavalee ||
english: Rama, with millions of monkeys,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਨ ਸੈਨਾ ਜਹ ਤੇ ਛਲੀ ॥
transliteration: raavan sainaa jah te chhalee ||
english: Conquered Raawan's army.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਹਤ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sahas kot bahu kahat puraan ||
english: Billions of Puraanas greatly praise Him;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਕਾ ਮਥਿਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: durajodhan kaa mathiaa maan ||7||
english: He humbled the pride of Duyodhan. ||7||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੰਦ੍ਰਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)drap kot jaa kai lavai na dharahi ||
english: Millions of gods of love cannot compete with Him.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਹਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar a(n)tar manasaa harahi ||
english: He steals the hearts of mortal beings.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer sun saarigapaan ||
english: Says Kabeer, please hear me, O Lord of the World.

author: Bhagat Namdev
transliteration: dehi abhai pad maa(n)gau daan ||8||2||18||20||
english: I beg for the blessing of fearless dignity. ||8||2||18||20||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau baanee naamadeu jeeu kee ghar 1 ||
english: Bhairao, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕਰਉ ਸਤ ਖੰਡ ॥
transliteration: re jihabaa karau sat kha(n)d ||
english: O my tongue, I will cut you into a hundred pieces,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਉਚਰਸਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaam na ucharas sree gobi(n)d ||1||
english: if you do not chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਲੇ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)gee le jihabaa har kai naai ||
english: O my tongue, be imbued with the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sura(n)g ra(n)geele har har dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and imbue yourself with this most excellent color. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਅਵਰੇਂ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa jihabaa avare(n) kaam ||
english: O my tongue, other occupations are false.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nirabaan pad ik har ko naam ||2||
english: The state of Nirvaanaa comes only through the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh kot an poojaa karee ||
english: The performance of countless millions of other devotions

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek na poojas naamai haree ||3||
english: is not equal to even one devotion to the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: pranavai naamadeu ihu karanaa ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, this is my occupation.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: ana(n)t roop tere naaraainaa ||4||1||
english: O Lord, Your Forms are endless. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: par dhan par daaraa paraharee ||
english: One who stays away from others' wealth and others' spouses

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kai nikat basai naraharee ||1||
english: - the Lord abides near that person. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨ ਭਜੰਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo na bhaja(n)te naaraainaa ||
english: Those who do not meditate and vibrate on the Lord

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਨ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa mai na karau darasanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - I do not even want to see them. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin kai bheetar hai a(n)taraa ||
english: Those whose inner beings are not in harmony with the Lord,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਨਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaise pas taise oi naraa ||2||
english: are nothing more than beasts. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨਾਕਹਿ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pranavat naamadeu naakahi binaa ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, a man without a nose

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸੋਹੈ ਬਤੀਸ ਲਖਨਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: naa sohai batees lakhanaa ||3||2||
english: does not look handsome, even if he has the thirty-two beauty marks. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਟੋਰੈ ਗਡਵੈ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: doodh katorai gadavai paanee ||
english: Naam Dayv milked the brown cow,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਪਲ ਗਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਹਿ ਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kapal gaai naamai duhi aanee ||1||
english: And brought a cup of milk and a jug of water to his family god. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doodh peeu gobi(n)de raai ||
english: "Please drink this milk, O my Sovereign Lord God.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: doodh peeu mero man pateeaai ||
english: Drink this milk and my mind will be happy.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naahee ta ghar ko baap risaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Otherwise, my father will be angry with me." ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋੁਇਨ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੀ ॥
transliteration: souin katoree a(n)mrit bharee ||
english: Taking the golden cup, Naam Dayv filled it with the ambrosial milk,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lai naamai har aagai dharee ||2||
english: and placed it before the Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਬਸੈ ॥
transliteration: ek bhagat mere hirade basai ||
english: The Lord looked upon Naam Dayv and smiled.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਰਾਇਨੁ ਹਸੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naame dekh naraain hasai ||3||
english: "This one devotee abides within my heart." ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਇ ਭਗਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doodh peeaai bhagat ghar gaiaa ||
english: The Lord drank the milk, and the devotee returned home.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naame har kaa darasan bhaiaa ||4||3||
english: Thus did Naam Dayv come to receive the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਉਰੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mai bauree meraa raam bhataar ||
english: I am crazy - the Lord is my Husband.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rach rach taa kau karau si(n)gaar ||1||
english: I decorate and adorn myself for Him. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: bhale ni(n)dau bhale ni(n)dau bhale ni(n)dau log ||
english: Slander me well, slander me well, slander me well, O people.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man raam piaare jog ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My body and mind are united with my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: baad bibaad kaahoo siu na keejai ||
english: Do not engage in any arguments or debates with anyone.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam rasaain peejai ||2||
english: With your tongue, savor the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ab jee jaan aisee ban aaee ||
english: Now, I know within my soul, that such an arrangement has been made;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਉ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: milau gupaal neesaan bajaaee ||3||
english: I will meet with my Lord by the beat of the drum. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਨਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa karai nar koee ||
english: Anyone can praise or slander me.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ ਭੇਟਲ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naame sreera(n)g bhetal soee ||4||4||
english: Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਖੀਰਿ ਖਾਡ ਘੀਉ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo kheer khaad gheeu na bhaavai ||
english: Sometimes, people do not appreciate milk, sugar and ghee.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਟੂਕ ਮਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo ghar ghar took magaavai ||
english: Sometimes, they have to beg for bread from door to door.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਕੂਰਨੁ ਚਨੇ ਬਿਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kabahoo kooran chane binaavai ||1||
english: Sometimes, they have to pick out the grain from the chaff. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu raam raakhai tiu raheeai re bhaaee ||
english: As the Lord keeps us, so do we live, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kee mahimaa kichh kathan na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Glory cannot even be described. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਤੁਰੇ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਨਚਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo ture tura(n)g nachaavai ||
english: Sometimes, people prance around on horses.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇ ਪਨਹੀਓ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kabahoo paai panaheeo na paavai ||2||
english: Sometimes, they do not even have shoes for their feet. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਖਾਟ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸੁਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo khaat supedee suvaavai ||
english: Sometimes, people sleep on cozy beds with white sheets.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਭੂਮਿ ਪੈਆਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kabahoo bhoom paiaar na paavai ||3||
english: Sometimes, they do not even have straw to put down on the ground. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naamadeu ik naam nisataarai ||
english: Naam Dayv prays, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, can save us.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jih gur milai tih paar utaarai ||4||5||
english: One who meets the Guru, is carried across to the other side. ||4||5||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਦੇਹੁਰੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hasat khelat tere dehure aaiaa ||
english: Laughing and playing, I came to Your Temple, O Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਾਮਾ ਪਕਰਿ ਉਠਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat karat naamaa pakar uthaaiaa ||1||
english: While Naam Dayv was worshipping, he was grabbed and driven out. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹੀਨੜੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਦਿਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: heenaRee jaat meree jaadim raaiaa ||
english: I am of a low social class, O Lord;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chheepe ke janam kaahe kau aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: why was I born into a family of fabric dyers? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਕਮਲੀ ਚਲਿਓ ਪਲਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lai kamalee chalio palataai ||
english: I picked up my blanket and went back,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁਰੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dehurai paachhai baithaa jaai ||2||
english: to sit behind the temple. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu jiu naamaa har gun ucharai ||
english: As Naam Dayv uttered the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਫਿਰੈ ॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa(n) kau dehuraa phirai ||3||6||
english: the temple turned around to face the Lord's humble devotee. ||3||6||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau naamadeu jeeu ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਨਾਜ ॥
transliteration: jaisee bhookhe preet anaaj ||
english: As the hungry person loves food,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਜਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: trikhaava(n)t jal setee kaaj ||
english: and the thirsty person is obsessed with water,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮੂੜ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: jaisee mooR kuta(n)b paraain ||
english: and as the fool is attached to his family

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisee naame preet naraain ||1||
english: - just so, the Lord is very dear to Naam Dayv. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: naame preet naaraain laagee ||
english: Naam Dayv is in love with the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai bhaio bairaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has naturally and intuitively become detached from the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਰਤ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaisee par purakhaa rat naaree ||
english: Like the woman who falls in love with another man,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਨਰੁ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: lobhee nar dhan kaa hitakaaree ||
english: and the greedy man who loves only wealth,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaamee purakh kaamanee piaaree ||
english: and the sexually promiscuous man who loves women and sex,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aisee naame preet muraaree ||2||
english: just so, Naam Dayv is in love with the Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saaee preet j aape laae ||
english: But that alone is real love, which the Lord Himself inspires;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee dubidhaa jaae ||
english: by Guru's Grace, duality is eradicated.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabahu na tootas rahiaa samaai ||
english: Such love never breaks; through it, the mortal remains merged in the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naame chit laaiaa sach naai ||3||
english: Naam Dayv has focused his consciousness on the True Name. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaisee preet baarik ar maataa ||
english: Like the love between the child and its mother,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa har setee man raataa ||
english: so is my mind imbued with the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: pranavai naamadeu laagee preet ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, I am in love with the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਬਸੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: gobid basai hamaarai cheet ||4||1||7||
english: The Lord of the Universe abides within my consciousness. ||4||1||7||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar kee naar tiaagai a(n)dhaa ||
english: The blind fool abandons the wife of his own home,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਘਾਲੈ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: par naaree siu ghaalai dha(n)dhaa ||
english: and has an affair with another woman.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਿੰਬਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੂਆ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaise si(n)bal dekh sooaa bigasaanaa ||
