english: He is like the parrot, who is pleased to see the simbal tree;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਮੂਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t kee baar mooaa lapataanaa ||1||
english: but in the end, he dies, stuck to it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਅਗਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paapee kaa ghar agane maahi ||
english: The home of the sinner is on fire.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਮਿਟਵੈ ਕਬ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jalat rahai mitavai kab naahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It keeps burning, and the fire cannot be extinguished. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat na dekhai jaai ||
english: He does not go to see where the Lord is being worshipped.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maarag chhod amaarag paai ||
english: He abandons the Lord's Path, and takes the wrong path.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: moolahu bhoolaa aavai jaai ||
english: He forgets the Primal Lord God, and is caught in the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਲਾਦਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit daar laad bikh khaai ||2||
english: He throws away the Ambrosial Nectar, and gathers poison to eat. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਕੇ ਪਰੈ ਅਖਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu besvaa ke parai akhaaraa ||
english: He is like the prostitute, who comes to dance,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪਰੁ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਂੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaapar pahir karahi sa(n)eegaaraa ||
english: wearing beautiful clothes, decorated and adorned.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
transliteration: poore taal nihaale saas ||
english: She dances to the beat, exciting the breath of those who watch her.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਵਾ ਕੇ ਗਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਫਾਸ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vaa ke gale jam kaa hai phaas ||3||
english: But the noose of the Messenger of Death is around her neck. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke masatak likhio karamaa ||
english: One who has good karma recorded on his forehead,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਜਿ ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: so bhaj par hai gur kee saranaa ||
english: hurries to enter the Guru's Sanctuary.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kahat naamadeu ihu beechaar ||
english: Says Naam Dayv, consider this:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: in bidh sa(n)tahu utarahu paar ||4||2||8||
english: O Saints, this is the way to cross over to the other side. ||4||2||8||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੰਡਾ ਮਰਕਾ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਹੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)daa marakaa jaai pukaare || paRai nahee ham hee pach haare ||
english: Sanda and Marka went and complained to Harnaakhash, "Your son does not read his lessons. We are tired of trying to teach him.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਰ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਚਟੀਆ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam kahai kar taal bajaavai chateeaa sabhai bigaare ||1||
english: He chants the Lord's Name, clapping his hands to keep the beat; he has spoiled all the other students. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਪਿਬੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naamaa japibo karai ||
english: He chants the Lord's Name,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hiradai har jee ko simaran dharai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and he has enshrined meditative remembrance of the Lord within his heart." ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਜੇ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਟਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: basudhaa bas keenee sabh raaje binatee karai pataraanee ||
english: "Your father the king has conquered the whole world", said his mother the queen.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੂਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਉ ਅਉਰੈ ਠਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poot prahilaad kahiaa nahee maanai tin tau aurai thaanee ||2||
english: "O Prahlad my son, you do not obey him, so he has decided to deal with you in another way." ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਤਰ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਸਹ ਅਉਧ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dusat sabhaa mil ma(n)tar upaaiaa karasah audh ghaneree ||
english: The council of villians met and resolved to send Prahlaad into the life hereafter.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਜਲ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gir tar jal juaalaa bhai raakhio raajaa raam maaiaa pheree ||3||
english: Prahlaad was thrown off a mountain, into the water, and into a fire, but the Sovereign Lord God saved him, by changing the laws of nature. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਭੈ ਕੋਪਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਤਾਉ ਜੁ ਤੁਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: kaadh khaRag kaal bhai kopio mohi bataau j tuhi raakhai ||
english: Harnaakhash thundered with rage and threatened to kill Prahlaad. "Tell me, who can save you?"

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੀਤ ਪੀਤਾਂਬਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ਥੰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: peet peetaa(n)bar tribhavan dhanee tha(n)bh maahi har bhaakhai ||4||
english: Prahlaad answered, "The Lord, the Master of the three worlds, is contained even in this pillar to which I am tied." ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਖਹ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਕੀਏ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: haranaakhas jin nakhah bidaario sur nar keee sanaathaa ||
english: The Lord who tore Harnaakhash apart with His nails proclaimed Himself the Lord of gods and men.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਮ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: kahi naamadeu ham narahar dhiaavah raam abhai pad daataa ||5||3||9||
english: Says Naam Dayv, I meditate on the Lord, the Man-lion, the Giver of fearless dignity. ||5||3||9||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਪੂਛੈ ਸੁਨੁ ਬੇ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: sulataan poochhai sun be naamaa ||
english: The Sultan said, "Listen, Naam Dayv:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dekhau raam tumhaare kaamaa ||1||
english: let me see the actions of your Lord." ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੇ ਬਾਧਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naamaa sulataane baadhilaa ||
english: The Sultan arrested Naam Dayv,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhau teraa har beethulaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and said, "Let me see your Beloved Lord." ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਿਲਿ ਗਊ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bisamil gaoo dehu jeevaai ||
english: "Bring this dead cow back to life.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਤਰੁ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰਉ ਠਾਂਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naatar garadan maarau thaa(n)i ||2||
english: Otherwise, I shall cut off your head here and now." ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਐਸੀ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baadisaah aisee kiu hoi ||
english: Naam Dayv answered, "O king, how can this happen?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਆ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bisamil keeaa na jeevai koi ||3||
english: No one can bring the dead back to life. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa keeaa kachhoo na hoi ||
english: I cannot do anything by my own actions.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kar hai raam hoi hai soi ||4||
english: Whatever the Lord does, that alone happens." ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹੁ ਚੜੑਿਓ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: baadisaahu chaRhio aha(n)kaar ||
english: The arrogant king was enraged at this reply.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਹਸਤੀ ਦੀਨੋ ਚਮਕਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gaj hasatee deeno chamakaar ||5||
english: He incited an elephant to attack. ||5||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰੁਦਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rudan karai naame kee maai ||
english: Naam Dayv's mother began to cry,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਭਜਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: chhod raam kee na bhajahi khudaai ||6||
english: And she said, "Why don't you abandon your Lord Raam, and worship his Lord Allah?" ||6||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂੰਗੜਾ ਨ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: na hau teraa poo(n)gaRaa na too meree maai ||
english: Naam Dayv answered, "I am not your son, and you are not my mother.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: pi(n)d paRai tau har gun gaai ||7||
english: Even if my body dies, I will still sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord." ||7||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਗਜਿੰਦੁ ਸੁੰਡ ਕੀ ਚੋਟ ॥
transliteration: karai gaji(n)d su(n)d kee chot ||
english: The elephant attacked him with his trunk,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਉਬਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naamaa ubarai har kee ot ||8||
english: but Naam Dayv was saved, protected by the Lord. ||8||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kaajee mulaa(n) karahi salaam ||
english: The king said, "The Qazis and the Mullahs bow down to me,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਲਿਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
transliteration: in hi(n)doo meraa maliaa maan ||9||
english: but this Hindu has trampled my honor." ||9||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੁਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: baadisaah benatee sunehu ||
english: The people pleaded with the king, "Hear our prayer, O king.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਨਾ ਲੇਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naame sar bhar sonaa lehu ||10||
english: Here, take Naam Dayvs weight in gold, and release him." ||10||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਲੇਉ ਤਉ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਰਉ ॥
transliteration: maal leu tau dojak parau ||
english: The king replied, "If I take the gold, then I will be consigned to hell,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਉ ਭਰਉ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: deen chhod duneeaa kau bharau ||11||
english: by forsaking my faith and gathering worldly wealth." ||11||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਹੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਾਥਹੁ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: paavahu beRee haathahu taal ||
english: With his feet in chains, Naam Dayv kept the beat with his hands,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naamaa gaavai gun gopaal ||12||
english: singing the Praises of the Lord. ||12||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਜਉ ਉਲਟੀ ਬਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)g jamun jau ulatee bahai ||
english: "Even if the Ganges and the Jamunaa rivers flow backwards,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਹੈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: tau naamaa har karataa rahai ||13||
english: I will still continue singing the Praises of the Lord." ||13||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਤ ਘੜੀ ਜਬ ਬੀਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saat ghaRee jab beetee sunee ||
english: Three hours passed,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: ajahu na aaio tribhavan dhanee ||14||
english: and even then, the Lord of the three worlds had not come. ||14||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਤਣ ਬਾਜ ਬਜਾਇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)tan baaj bajaailaa ||
english: Playing on the instrument of the feathered wings,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਰੁੜ ਚੜੑੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਆਇਲਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: garuR chaRhe gobi(n)d aailaa ||15||
english: the Lord of the Universe came, mounted on the eagle garura. ||15||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: apane bhagat par kee pratipaal ||
english: He cherished His devotee,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਰੁੜ ਚੜੑੇ ਆਏ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: garuR chaRhe aae gopaal ||16||
english: and the Lord came, mounted on the eagle garura. ||16||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਹਿ ਤ ਧਰਣਿ ਇਕੋਡੀ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: kahahi ta dharan ikodee karau ||
english: The Lord said to him, "If you wish, I shall turn the earth sideways.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਹਿ ਤ ਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਧਰਉ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kahahi ta le kar oopar dharau ||17||
english: If you wish, I shall turn it upside down. ||17||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਹਿ ਤ ਮੁਈ ਗਊ ਦੇਉ ਜੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: kahahi ta muee gaoo deu jeeaai ||
english: If you wish, I shall bring the dead cow back to life.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sabh koee dekhai pateeaai ||18||
english: Everyone will see and be convinced." ||18||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਸੇਲ ਮਸੇਲ ॥
transliteration: naamaa pranavai sel masel ||
english: Naam Dayv prayed, and milked the cow.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਦੁਹਾਈ ਬਛਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gaoo duhaaee bachharaa mel ||19||
english: He brought the calf to the cow, and milked her. ||19||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧਹਿ ਦੁਹਿ ਜਬ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਭਰੀ ॥
transliteration: doodhahi duhi jab matukee bharee ||
english: When the pitcher was filled with milk,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲੇ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਕੇ ਆਗੇ ਧਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: le baadisaah ke aage dharee ||20||
english: Naam Dayv took it and placed it before the king. ||20||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹੁ ਮਹਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baadisaahu mahal mahi jaai ||
english: The king went into his palace,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਉਘਟ ਕੀ ਘਟ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: aughat kee ghat laagee aai ||21||
english: and his heart was troubled. ||21||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaajee mulaa(n) binatee phuramaai ||
english: Through the Qazis and the Mullahs, the king offered his prayer,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸੀ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: bakhasee hi(n)doo mai teree gaai ||22||
english: "Forgive me, please, O Hindu; I am just a cow before you." ||22||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: naamaa kahai sunahu baadisaah ||
english: Naam Dayv said, "Listen, O king:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਤੀਆ ਮੁਝੈ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: ihu kichh pateeaa mujhai dikhaai ||23||
english: have I done this miracle? ||23||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਪਤੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: is pateeaa kaa ihai paravaan ||
english: The purpose of this miracle is

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੀਲਿ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਸੁਲਿਤਾਨ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: saach seel chaalahu sulitaan ||24||
english: that you, O king, should walk on the path of truth and humility." ||24||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸਭ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naamadeu sabh rahiaa samaai ||
english: Naam Dayv became famous everywhere for this.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਭ ਨਾਮੇ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: mil hi(n)doo sabh naame pahi jaahi ||25||
english: The Hindus all went together to Naam Dayv. ||25||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jau ab kee baar na jeevai gaai ||
english: If the cow had not been revived,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਕਾ ਪਤੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: ta naamadev kaa pateeaa jaai ||26||
english: people would have lost faith in Naam Dayv. ||26||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naame kee keerat rahee sa(n)saar ||
english: The fame of Naam Dayv spread throughout the world.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਲੇ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa(n) le udhariaa paar ||27||
english: The humble devotees were saved and carried across with him. ||27||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭਇਆ ਖੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal kales ni(n)dak bhaiaa khed ||
english: All sorts of troubles and pains afflicted the slanderer.

author: Bhagat Namdev
transliteration: naame naaraain naahee bhed ||28||1||10||
english: There is no difference between Naam Dayv and the Lord. ||28||1||10||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: ghar 2 ||
english: Second House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta milai muraar ||
english: By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one meets the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta utarai paar ||
english: By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one is carried across to the other side.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta baiku(n)th tarai ||
english: By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one swims across to heaven.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta jeevat marai ||1||
english: By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sat sat sat sat sat guradev ||
english: True, True, True True, True is the Divine Guru.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਆਨ ਸਭ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jhooth jhooth jhooth jhooth aan sabh sev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: False, false, false, false is all other service. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta naam driRaavai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is implanted within.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu na dah dis dhaavai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one does not wander in the ten directions.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਪੰਚ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu pa(n)ch te door ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the five demons are kept far away.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਨ ਮਰਿਬੋ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jau guradeu na maribo jhoor ||2||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one does not die regretting. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is blessed with the Ambrosial Bani of the Word.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta akath kahaanee ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one speaks the Unspoken Speech.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta a(n)mrit deh ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's body becomes like ambrosial nectar.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੇਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jau guradeu naam jap lehi ||3||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one utters and chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਭਵਨ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu bhavan trai soojhai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one sees the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਊਚ ਪਦ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ooch pad boojhai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one understands the state of supreme dignity.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਸੀਸੁ ਅਕਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta sees akaas ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's head is in the Akaashic ethers.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jau guradeu sadaa saabaas ||4||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is always congratulated everywhere. ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu sadaa bairaagee ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one remains detached forever.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu par ni(n)daa tiaagee ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one forsakes the slander of others.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu buraa bhalaa ek ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one looks upon good and bad as the same.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਹਿ ਲੇਖ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jau guradeu lilaatahi lekh ||5||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has good destiny written on his forehead. ||5||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਕੰਧੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ka(n)dh nahee hirai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the wall of the body is not eroded.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਫਿਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu dehuraa phirai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the temple turns itself towards the mortal.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਛਾਪਰਿ ਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta chhaapar chhaaee ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's home is constructed.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸਿਹਜ ਨਿਕਸਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jau guradeu sihaj nikasaaee ||6||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's bed is lifted up out of the water. ||6||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta athasath naaiaa ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤਨਿ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu tan chakr lagaaiaa ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's body is stamped with the sacred mark of Vishnu.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਦੁਆਦਸ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta duaadas sevaa ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has performed the twelve devotional services.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੇਵਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jau guradeu sabhai bikh mevaa ||7||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, all poison is transformed into fruit. ||7||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਸੰਸਾ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta sa(n)saa tootai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, skepticism is shattered.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta jam te chhootai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one escapes from the Messenger of Death.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਭਉਜਲ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta bhaujal tarai ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jau guradeu ta janam na marai ||8||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is not subject to the cycle of reincarnation. ||8||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਅਠਦਸ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu athadas biuhaar ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one understands the rituals of the eighteen Puraanas.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jau guradeu athaarah bhaar ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, it is as if one has made an offering of the eighten loads of vegetation.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin guradeu avar nahee jaaee ||
english: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one needs no other place of rest.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੯॥੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naamadeu gur kee saranaaee ||9||1||2||11||
english: Naam Dayv has entered the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||9||1||2||11||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau baanee ravidaas jeeu kee ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bin dekhe upajai nahee aasaa ||
english: Without seeing something, the yearning for it does not arise.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so hoi binaasaa ||
english: Whatever is seen, shall pass away.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਜੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: baran sahit jo jaapai naam ||
english: Whoever chants and praises the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so jogee keval nihakaam ||1||
english: is the true Yogi, free of desire. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਰਚੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: parachai raam ravai jau koee ||
english: When someone utters the Name of the Lord with love,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paaras parasai dubidhaa na hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: it is as if he has touched the philosopher's stone; his sense of duality is eradicated. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so mun man kee dubidhaa khaai ||
english: He alone is a silent sage, who destroys the duality of his mind.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin duaare trai lok samaai ||
english: Keeping the doors of his body closed, he merges in the Lord of the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: man kaa subhaau sabh koee karai ||
english: Everyone acts according to the inclinations of the mind.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਨਭੈ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karataa hoi s anabhai rahai ||2||
english: Attuned to the Creator Lord, one remains free of fear. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਕਾਰਨ ਫੂਲੀ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phal kaaran phoolee banaraai ||
english: Plants blossom forth to produce fruit.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਬ ਫੂਲੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phal laagaa tab phool bilaai ||
english: When the fruit is produced, the flowers wither away.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੈ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਮ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: giaanai kaaran karam abhiaas ||
english: For the sake of spiritual wisdom, people act and practice rituals.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਹ ਕਰਮਹ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: giaan bhaiaa tah karamah naas ||3||
english: When spiritual wisdom wells up, then actions are left behind. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਰਨ ਦਧਿ ਮਥੈ ਸਇਆਨ ॥
transliteration: ghrit kaaran dadh mathai saiaan ||
english: For the sake of ghee, wise people churn milk.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jeevat mukat sadaa nirabaan ||
english: Those who are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive - are forever in the state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪਰਮ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas param bairaag ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, O you unfortunate people,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਅਭਾਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: ridai raam kee na japas abhaag ||4||1||
english: why not meditate on the Lord with love in your heart? ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: naamadev ||
english: Naam Dayv:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਕਲੰਦਰ ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥
transliteration: aau kala(n)dar kesavaa ||
english: Come, O Lord of beautiful hair,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਬਦਾਲੀ ਭੇਸਵਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar abadaalee bhesavaa || rahaau ||
english: wearing the robes of a Sufi Saint. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਉਸੈ ਸਪਤ ਪਯਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jin aakaas kulah sir keenee kausai sapat payaalaa ||
english: Your cap is the realm of the Akaashic ethers; the seven nether worlds are Your sandals.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚਮਰ ਪੋਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨੇ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chamar pos kaa ma(n)dar teraa ih bidh bane gupaalaa ||1||
english: The body covered with skin is Your temple; You are so beautiful, O Lord of the World. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾ ਪੇਹਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਲਹ ਸਹਸ ਇਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chhapan kot kaa pehan teraa solah sahas ijaaraa ||
english: The fifty-six million clouds are Your gowns, the 16,000 milkmaids are your skirts.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮੁਦਗਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaar athaarah mudagar teraa sahanak sabh sa(n)saaraa ||2||
english: The eighteen loads of vegetation is Your stick, and all the world is Your plate. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਜਿਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਨਾ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: dehee mahajid man maulaanaa sahaj nivaaj gujaarai ||
english: The human body is the mosque, and the mind is the priest, who peacefully leads the prayer.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬੀਬੀ ਕਉਲਾ ਸਉ ਕਾਇਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: beebee kaulaa sau kaain teraa nira(n)kaar aakaarai ||3||
english: You are married to Maya, O Formless Lord, and so You have taken form. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਛਿਨਾਏ ਕਿਹ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karat mere taal chhinaae kih pahi karau pukaaraa ||
english: Performing devotional worship services to You, my cymbals were taken away; unto whom should I complain?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਫਿਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦੇਸਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naame kaa suaamee a(n)tarajaamee phire sagal bedesavaa ||4||1||
english: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, wanders everywhere; He has no specific home. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: raag basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade dutuke ||
english: Raag Basant, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਹ ਮੁਮਾਰਖੀ ਚੜਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: maahaa maah mumaarakhee chaRiaa sadaa basa(n)t ||
english: Among the months, blessed is this month, when spring always comes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਫੜੁ ਚਿਤ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paraphaR chit samaal soi sadaa sadaa gobi(n)d ||1||
english: Blossom forth, O my consciousness, contemplating the Lord of the Universe, forever and ever. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bholiaa haumai surat visaar ||
english: O ignorant one, forget your egotistical intellect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਲੈ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar beechaar man gun vich gun lai saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Subdue your ego, and contemplate Him in your mind; gather in the virtues of the Sublime, Virtuous Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਪੇਡੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: karam ped saakhaa haree dharam phul phal giaan ||
english: Karma is the tree, the Lord's Name the branches, Dharmic faith the flowers, and spiritual wisdom the fruit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pat paraapat chhaav ghanee chookaa man abhimaan ||2||
english: Realization of the Lord are the leaves, and eradication of the pride of the mind is the shade. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੰਨੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: akhee kudarat ka(n)nee baanee mukh aakhan sach naam ||
english: Whoever sees the Lord's Creative Power with his eyes, and hears the Guru's Bani with his ears, and utters the True Name with his mouth,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pat kaa dhan pooraa hoaa laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||3||
english: attains the perfect wealth of honor, and intuitively focuses his meditation on the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਣਾ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maahaa rutee aavanaa vekhahu karam kamaai ||
english: The months and the seasons come; see, and do your deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰੇ ਨ ਸੂਕਹੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hare na sookahee j guramukh rahe samaai ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who remain merged in the Lord do not wither away; they remain green forever. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 basa(n)t ||
english: First Mehl, Basant:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਆਈਲੇ ਸਰਸ ਬਸੰਤ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: rut aaeele saras basa(n)t maahi ||
english: The season of spring, so delightful, has come.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g raate ravahi s terai chaai ||
english: Those who are imbued with love for You, O Lord, chant Your Name with joy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਵਉ ਲਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kis pooj chaRaavau lagau paai ||1||
english: Whom else should I worship? At whose feet should I bow? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਹਉ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: teraa daasan daasaa kahau raai ||
english: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan jugat na milai kaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Life of the Universe, there is no other way to meet You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: teree moorat ekaa bahut roop ||
english: You have only One Form, and yet You have countless forms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਵਉ ਦੇਉ ਧੂਪ ॥
transliteration: kis pooj chaRaavau deu dhoop ||
english: Which one should I worship? Before which one should I burn incense?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਹਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: teraa a(n)t na paaiaa kahaa paai ||
english: Your limits cannot be found. How can anyone find them?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਹਉ ਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teraa daasan daasaa kahau raai ||2||
english: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸਠਿ ਸੰਬਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: tere sath sa(n)bat sabh teerathaa ||
english: The cycles of years and the places of pilgrimage are Yours, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa sach naam paramesaraa ||
english: Your Name is True, O Transcendent Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: teree gat avigat nahee jaaneeai ||
english: Your State cannot be known, O Eternal, Unchanging Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਣਜਾਣਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anajaanat naam vakhaaneeai ||3||
english: Although You are unknown, still we chant Your Name. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak vechaaraa kiaa kahai ||
english: What can poor Nanak say?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਏਕਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh lok salaahe ekasai ||
english: All people praise the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੋਕਾ ਪਾਵ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sir naanak lokaa paav hai ||
english: Nanak places his head on the feet of such people.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: balihaaree jaau jete tere naav hai ||4||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your Names, as many as there are, O Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: suine kaa chaukaa ka(n)chan kuaar ||
english: The kitchen is golden, and the cooking pots are golden.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੁਪੇ ਕੀਆ ਕਾਰਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: rupe keeaa kaaraa bahut bisathaar ||
english: The lines marking the cooking square are silver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਕਾ ਉਦਕੁ ਕਰੰਤੇ ਕੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa kaa udak kara(n)te kee aag ||
english: The water is from the Ganges, and the firewood is sanctified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰੁੜਾ ਖਾਣਾ ਦੁਧ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਡਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garuRaa khaanaa dudh siu gaad ||1||
english: The food is soft rice, cooked in milk. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: re man lekhai kabahoo na paai ||
english: O my mind, these things are worthless,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaam na bheejai saach naai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: if you are not drenched with the True Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਲੀਖੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: das ath leekhe hovahi paas ||
english: One may have the eighteen Puraanas written in his own hand;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖਾਗਰ ਪਾਠਿ ॥
transliteration: chaare bed mukhaagar paath ||
english: he may recite the four Vedas by heart,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬੀ ਨਾਵੈ ਵਰਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: purabee naavai varanaa(n) kee daat ||
english: and take ritual baths at holy festivals and give charitable donations;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: varat nem kare din raat ||2||
english: he may observe the ritual fasts, and perform religious ceremonies day and night. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੇਖ ॥
transliteration: kaajee mulaa(n) hovahi sekh ||
english: He may be a Qazi, a Mullah or a Shaykh,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ॥
transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam bhagave bhekh ||
english: a Yogi or a wandering hermit wearing saffron-colored robes;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ ॥
transliteration: ko girahee karamaa kee sa(n)dh ||
english: he may be a householder, working at his job;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭ ਖੜੀਅਸਿ ਬੰਧਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin boojhe sabh khaReeas ba(n)dh ||3||
english: but without understanding the essence of devotional worship, all people are eventually bound and gagged, and driven along by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਲਿਖੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jete jee likhee sir kaar ||
english: Each person's karma is written on his forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਗਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: karanee upar hovag saar ||
english: According to their deeds, they shall be judged.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hukam karahi moorakh gaavaar ||
english: Only the foolish and the ignorant issue commands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saache ke siphat bha(n)daar ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, the treasure of praise belongs to the True Lord alone. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 teejaa ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: basatr utaar diga(n)bar hog ||
english: A person may take off his clothes and be naked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਟਾਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jataadhaar kiaa kamaavai jog ||
english: What Yoga does he practice by having matted and tangled hair?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: man niramal nahee dasavai duaar ||
english: If the mind is not pure, what use is it to hold the breath at the Tenth Gate?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਮੂੜੑਾ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram bhram aavai mooRhaa vaaro vaar ||1||
english: The fool wanders and wanders, entering the cycle of reincarnation again and again. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੂੜੑ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ek dhiaavahu mooRh manaa ||
english: Meditate on the One Lord, O my foolish mind,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paar utar jaahi ik khinaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and you shall cross over to the other side in an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr karahi vakhiaan ||
english: Some recite and expound on the Simritees and the Shaastras;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਪੜੑਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: naadee bedee paRhhi puraan ||
english: some sing the Vedas and read the Puraanas;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਨਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d drisat man kapat kamaahi ||
english: but they practice hypocrisy and deception with their eyes and minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਮਈਆ ਨੇੜਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kai ramaeeaa neR naahi ||2||
english: The Lord does not even come near them. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je ko aisaa sa(n)jamee hoi ||
english: Even if someone practices such self-discipline,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਵਿਸੇਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kriaa visekh poojaa karei ||
english: compassion and devotional worship

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh man bikhiaa maahi ||
english: - if he is filled with greed, and his mind is engrossed in corruption,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi nira(n)jan kaise paahi ||3||
english: how can he find the Immaculate Lord? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: keetaa hoaa kare kiaa hoi ||
english: What can the created being do?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no aap chalaae soi ||
english: The Lord Himself moves him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa(n) bharam chukaae ||
english: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then his doubts are dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhai taa(n) saachaa paae ||4||
english: If the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he obtains the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis jeeu a(n)tar mailaa hoi ||
english: If someone's soul is polluted within,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: teerath bhavai disa(n)tar loi ||
english: what is the use of his traveling to sacred shrines of pilgrimage all over the world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: naanak mileeai satigur sa(n)g ||
english: O Nanak, when one joins the Society of the True Guru,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਕੇ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਬੰਧ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: tau bhavajal ke tootas ba(n)dh ||5||4||
english: then the bonds of the terrifying world-ocean are broken. ||5||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhavan teree maaiaa moh ||
english: All the worlds have been fascinated and enchanted by Your Maya, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਤੋਹ ॥
transliteration: mai avar na deesai sarab toh ||
english: I do not see any other at all - You are everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਾਥਾ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: too sur naathaa devaa dev ||
english: You are the Master of Yogis, the Divinity of the divine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam milai gur charan sev ||1||
english: Serving at the Guru's Feet, the Name of the Lord is received. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mere su(n)dar gahir ga(n)bheer laal ||
english: O my Beauteous, Deep and Profound Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam gun gaae too apara(n)par sarab paal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name. You are Infinite, the Cherisher of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: bin saadh na paaeeai har kaa sa(n)g ||
english: Without the Holy Saint, association with the Lord is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲ ਮਲੀਨ ਅੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: bin gur mail maleen a(n)g ||
english: Without the Guru, one's very fiber is stained with filth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin har naam na sudh hoi ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, one cannot become pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur sabad salaahe saach soi ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਖਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau too raakhahi rakhanahaar ||
english: O Savior Lord, that person whom You have saved

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo milaavahi karahi saar ||
english: - You lead him to meet the True Guru, and so take care of him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਪਰਹਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bikh haumai mamataa paraharaai ||
english: You take away his poisonous egotism and attachment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh dookh binaase raam raai ||3||
english: You dispel all his sufferings, O Sovereign Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: ootam gat mit har gun sareer ||
english: His state and condition are sublime; the Lord's Glorious Virtues permeate his body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ ॥
transliteration: guramat pragate raam naam heer ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the diamond of the Lord's Name is revealed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: liv laagee naam taj doojaa bhaau ||
english: He is lovingly attuned to the Naam; he is rid of the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak har gur gur milaau ||4||5||
english: O Lord, let servant Nanak meet the Guru. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meree sakhee sahelee sunahu bhaai ||
english: O my friends and companions, listen with love in your heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa pir reesaaloo sa(n)g saai ||
english: My Husband Lord is Incomparably Beautiful; He is always with me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu alakh na lakheeai kahahu kaai ||
english: He is Unseen - He cannot be seen. How can I describe Him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur sa(n)g dikhaaio raam raai ||1||
english: The Guru has shown me that my Sovereign Lord God is with me. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਨੇ ॥
transliteration: mil sakhee sahelee har gun bane ||
english: Joining together with my friends and companions, I am adorned with the Lord's Glorious Virtues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਨ ਮਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sa(n)g khelahi var kaaman guramukh khojat man mane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sublime soul-brides play with their Lord God. The Gurmukhs look within themselves; their minds are filled with faith. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukhee duhaagan naahi bheu ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, suffering in separation, do not understand this mystery.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੇਉ ॥
transliteration: ohu ghat ghat raavai sarab preu ||
english: The Beloved Lord of all celebrates in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh thir cheenai sa(n)g deu ||
english: The Gurmukh is stable, knowing that God is always with him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੇਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur naam driRaaiaa jap japeu ||2||
english: The Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur bhagat na bhaau hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, devotional love does not well up within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur sa(n)t na sa(n)g dei ||
english: Without the Guru, one is not blessed with the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਧੰਧੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur a(n)dhule dha(n)dh roi ||
english: Without the Guru, the blind cry out, entangled in worldly affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man guramukh niramal mal sabad khoi ||3||
english: That mortal who becomes Gurmukh becomes immaculate; the Word of the Shabad washes away his filth. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur man maario kar sa(n)jog ||
english: Uniting with the Guru, the mortal conquers and subdues his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਵੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: ahinis raave bhagat jog ||
english: Day and night, he savors the Yoga of devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur sa(n)t sabhaa dukh mitai rog ||
english: Associating with the Saint Guru, suffering and sickness are ended.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak har var sahaj jog ||4||6||
english: Servant Nanak merges with his Husband Lord, in the Yoga of intuitive ease. ||4||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
transliteration: aape kudarat kare saaj ||
english: By His Creative Power, God fashioned the creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਰਾਜਿ ॥
transliteration: sach aap nibeRe raaj raaj ||
english: The King of kings Himself adminsters true justice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: guramat ootam sa(n)g saath ||
english: The most sublime Word of the Guru's Teachings is always with us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਥਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam rasaain sahaj aath ||1||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name, the source of nectar, is easily acquired. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਬਿਸਰਸਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: mat bisaras re man raam bol ||
english: So chant the Name of the Lord; do not forget it, O my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apara(n)par agam agochar guramukh har aap tulaae atul tol ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is Infinite, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; His weight cannot be weighed, but He Himself allows the Gurmukh to weigh Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤੋਰ ॥
transliteration: gur charan sarevahi gurasikh tor ||
english: Your GurSikhs serve at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਤਰੇ ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰ ਤੋਰ ॥
transliteration: gur sev tare taj mer tor ||
english: Serving the Guru, they are carried across; they have abandoned any distinction between 'mine' and 'yours'.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਨਿ ਕਠੋਰ ॥
transliteration: nar ni(n)dak lobhee man kathor ||
english: The slanderous and greedy people are hard-hearted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਸਿ ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur sev na bhaaee s chor chor ||2||
english: Those who do not love to serve the Guru are the most thieving of thieves. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthaa bakhase bhagat bhaau ||
english: When the Guru is pleased, He blesses the mortals with loving devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai paaeeai har mahal thaau ||
english: When the Guru is pleased, the mortal obtains a place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: parahar ni(n)daa har bhagat jaag ||
english: So renounce slander, and awaken in devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har bhagat suhaavee karam bhaag ||3||
english: Devotion to the Lord is wonderful; it comes through good karma and destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gur mel milaavai kare daat ||
english: The Guru unites in union with the Lord, and grants the gift of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasikh piaare dinas raat ||
english: The Guru loves His Sikhs, day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: phal naam paraapat gur tus dei ||
english: They obtain the fruit of the Naam, when the Guru's favor is bestowed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak paavahi virale kei ||4||7||
english: Says Nanak, those who receive it are very rare indeed. ||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਇਕ ਤੁਕਾ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ik tukaa ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl, Ek-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saahib bhaavai sevak sevaa karai ||
english: When it pleases our Lord and Master, His servant serves Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevat marai sabh kul udharai ||1||
english: He remains dead while yet alive, and redeems all his ancestors. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat na chhodau kiaa ko hasai ||
english: I shall not renounce Your devotional worship, O Lord; what does it matter if people laugh at me?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saach naam merai hiradai vasai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Name abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jaise maaiaa mohi praanee galat rahai ||
english: Just as the mortal remains engrossed in attachment to Maya,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਤ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taise sa(n)t jan raam naam ravat rahai ||2||
english: so does the Lord's humble Saint remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai moorakh mugadh oopar karahu daiaa ||
english: I am foolish and ignorant, O Lord; please be merciful to me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਪਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tau saranaagat rahau paiaa ||3||
english: May I remain in Your Sanctuary. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak sa(n)saar ke nihaphal kaamaa ||
english: Says Nanak, worldly affairs are fruitless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ko paavai a(n)mrit naamaa ||4||8||
english: Only by Guru's Grace does one receive the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 basa(n)t hi(n)dol ghar 2 ||
english: First Mehl, Basant Hindol, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਬਿਪ ਪੂਜਿ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saal graam bip pooj manaavahu sukrit tulasee maalaa ||
english: O Brahmin, you worship and believe in your stone-god, and wear your ceremonial rosary beads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam jap beRaa baa(n)dhahu daiaa karahu daiaalaa ||1||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord. Build your boat, and pray, "O Merciful Lord, please be merciful to me." ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਲਰਾ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kaahe kalaraa si(n)chahu janam gavaavahu ||
english: Why do you irrigate the barren, alkaline soil? You are wasting your life away!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਢਹਗਿ ਦਿਵਾਲ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਚੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaachee dhahag divaal kaahe gach laavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This wall of mud is crumbling. Why bother to patch it with plaster? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਹਰਿਹਟ ਮਾਲ ਟਿੰਡ ਪਰੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kar harihat maal ti(n)d parovahu tis bheetar man jovahu ||
english: Let your hands be the buckets, strung on the chain, and yoke the mind as the ox to pull it; draw the water up from the well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਭਰਹੁ ਕਿਆਰੇ ਤਉ ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit si(n)chahu bharahu kiaare tau maalee ke hovahu ||2||
english: Irrigate your fields with the Ambrosial Nectar, and you shall be owned by God the Gardener. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸੋਲੇ ਗੋਡਹੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh dui karahu basole godahu dharatee bhaaee ||
english: Let sexual desire and anger be your two shovels, to dig up the dirt of your farm, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਗੋਡਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu godahu tiu tumh sukh paavahu kirat na metiaa jaaee ||3||
english: The more you dig, the more peace you shall find. Your past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bagule te phun ha(n)sulaa hovai je too karahi daiaalaa ||
english: The crane is again transformed into a swan, if You so will, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa daiaa karahu daiaalaa ||4||1||9||
english: Prays Nanak, the slave of Your slaves: O Merciful Lord, have mercy on me. ||4||1||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 hi(n)dol ||
english: Basant, First Mehl, Hindol:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੀ ਵਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਝੀ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਖੇ ॥
transliteration: saahuraRee vath sabh kichh saajhee pevakaRai dhan vakhe ||
english: In the House of the Husband Lord - in the world hereafter, everything is jointly owned; but in this world - in the house of the soul-bride's parents, the soul-bride owns them separately.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap kuchajee dos na deoo jaanaa naahee rakhe ||1||
english: She herself is ill-mannered; how can she blame anyone else? She does not know how to take care of these things. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਹਉ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mere saahibaa hau aape bharam bhulaanee ||
english: O my Lord and Master, I am deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਲਿਖੇ ਸੇਈ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: akhar likhe seee gaavaa avar na jaanaa baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I sing the Word which You have written; I do not know any other Word. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਦਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਚੋਲੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kadh kaseedaa pahirahi cholee taa(n) tumh jaanahu naaree ||
english: She alone is known as the Lord's bride, who embroiders her gown in the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je ghar raakhahi buraa na chaakhahi hovahi ka(n)t piaaree ||2||
english: She who preserves and protects the home of her own heart and does not taste of evil, shall be the Beloved of her Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: je too(n) paRiaa pa(n)dit beenaa dui akhar dui naavaa ||
english: If you are a learned and wise religious scholar, then make a boat of the letters of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਲੰਘਾਏ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak ek la(n)ghaae je kar sach samaavaa(n) ||3||2||10||
english: Prays Nanak, the One Lord shall carry you across, if you merge in the True Lord. ||3||2||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant Hindol, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: raajaa baalak nagaree kaachee dusataa naal piaaro ||
english: The king is just a boy, and his city is vulnerable. He is in love with his wicked enemies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਮਾਈ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਪਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dui maaee dui baapaa paReeahi pa(n)dit karahu beechaaro ||1||
english: He reads of his two mothers and his two fathers; O Pandit, reflect on this. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾ ਤੁਮੑ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ॥
transliteration: suaamee pa(n)ditaa tumh dehu matee ||
english: O Master Pandit, teach me about this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kin bidh paavau praanapatee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How can I obtain the Lord of life? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੰਡੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bheetar agan banaasapat maulee saagar pa(n)dai paaiaa ||
english: There is fire within the plants which bloom; the ocean is tied into a bundle.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui ghar hee bheetar aisaa giaan na paaiaa ||2||
english: The sun and the moon dwell in the same home in the sky. You have not obtained this knowledge. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਇਕ ਮਾਈ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: raam rava(n)taa jaaneeai ik maaee bhog karei ||
english: One who knows the All-pervading Lord, eats up the one mother - Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੇਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa ke lakhan jaaneeahi khimaa dhan sa(n)grahei ||3||
english: Know that the sign of such a person is that he gathers the wealth of compassion. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kahiaa sunahi na khaaiaa maanahi tinhaa hee setee vaasaa ||
english: The mind lives with those who do not listen, and do not admit what they eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਤੋਲਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੧॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa khin tolaa khin maasaa ||4||3||11||
english: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slave: one instant the mind is huge, and the next instant, it is tiny. ||4||3||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant Hindol, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahu guroo sukhadaataa har mele bhukh gavaae ||
english: The Guru is the True Banker, the Giver of peace; He unites the mortal with the Lord, and satisfies his hunger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har bhagat driRaae anadin har gun gaae ||1||
english: Granting His Grace, He implants devotional worship of the Lord within; and then night and day, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mat bhoolahi re man chet haree ||
english: O my mind, do not forget the Lord; keep Him in your consciousness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur mukat naahee trai loee guramukh paaeeai naam haree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Guru, no one is liberated anywhere in the three worlds. The Gurmukh obtains the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin bhagatee nahee satigur paaeeai bin bhaagaa nahee bhagat haree ||
english: Without devotional worship, the True Guru is not obtained. Without good destiny, devotional worship of the Lord is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin bhaagaa satasa(n)g na paaeeai karam milai har naam haree ||2||
english: Without good destiny, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is not obtained. By the grace of one's good karma, the Lord's Name is received. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat gupat upaae vekhai paragat guramukh sa(n)t janaa ||
english: In each and every heart, the Lord is hidden; He creates and watches over all. He reveals Himself in the humble, Saintly Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har karahi s har ra(n)g bheene har jal a(n)mrit naam manaa ||3||
english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are drenched with the Lord's Love. Their minds are drenched with the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: jin kau takhat milai vadiaaee guramukh se paradhaan keee ||
english: Those who are blessed with the glory of the Lord's Throne - those Gurmukhs are renowned as supreme.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਥੀਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: paaras bhet bhae se paaras naanak har gur sa(n)g theee ||4||4||12||
english: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves becomes the philosopher's stone; they become the companions of the Lord, the Guru. ||4||4||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ghar 1 dutuke ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl, First House, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: maahaa rutee mahi sad basa(n)t ||
english: Throughout the months and the seasons, the Lord is always in bloom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jit hariaa sabh jee ja(n)t ||
english: He rejuvenates all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਰਮ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa hau aakhaa kiram ja(n)t ||
english: What can I say? I am just a worm.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teraa kinai na paaiaa aad a(n)t ||1||
english: No one has found Your beginning or Your end, O Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: tai saahib kee karahi sev ||
english: Those who serve You, Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: param sukh paavahi aatam dev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: obtain the greatest peace; their souls are so divine. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai taa(n) sevaa karai ||
english: If the Lord is merciful, then the mortal is allowed to serve Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he remains dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: anadin saach naam ucharai ||
english: Night and day, he chants the True Name;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: in bidh praanee dutar tarai ||2||
english: in this way, he crosses over the treacherous world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bikh a(n)mrit karataar upaae ||
english: The Creator created both poison and nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਇ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar birakh kau dui phal laae ||
english: He attached these two fruits to the world-plant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare karaae ||
english: The Creator Himself is the Doer, the Cause of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਖਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai tisai khavaae ||3||
english: He feeds all as He pleases. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak jis no nadar karei ||
english: O Nanak, when He casts His Glance of Grace,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam aape dei ||
english: He Himself bestows His Ambrosial Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa kee baasanaa manahi karei ||
english: Thus, the desire for sin and corruption is ended.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: apanaa bhaanaa aap karei ||4||1||
english: The Lord Himself carries out His Own Will. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: raate saach har naam nihaalaa ||
english: Those who are attuned to the True Lord's Name are happy and exalted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: Take pity on me, O God, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis bin avar nahee mai koi ||
english: Without Him, I have no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhai soi ||1||
english: As it pleases His Will, He keeps me. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur gopaal merai man bhaae ||
english: The Guru, the Lord, is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rahi na sakau darasan dekhe bin sahaj milau gur mel milaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot even survive, without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. But I shall easily unite with the Guru, if He unites me in His Union. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu man lobhee lobh lubhaanaa ||
english: The greedy mind is enticed by greed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raam bisaar bahur pachhutaanaa ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, it regrets and repents in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਰਾਂਗੇ ॥
transliteration: bichhurat milaai gur sev raa(n)ge ||
english: The separated ones are reunited, when they are inspired to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naam deeo masatak vadabhaage ||2||
english: They are blessed with the Lord's Name - such is the destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee kee ih deh sareeraa ||
english: This body is built of air and water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਠਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog kathin tan peeraa ||
english: The body is afflicted with the terribly painful illness of egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam daaroo gun gaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh has the Medicine: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur rog gavaaiaa ||3||
english: Granting His Grace, the Guru has cured the illness. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਨਦੀਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: chaar nadeeaa aganee tan chaare ||
english: The four evils are the four rivers of fire flowing through the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਜਲੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa jalat jale aha(n)kaare ||
english: It is burning in desire, and burning in egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur raakhe vadabhaagee taare ||
english: Those whom the Guru protects and saves are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak ur har a(n)mrit dhaare ||4||2||
english: Servant Nanak enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in his heart. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har seve so har kaa log ||
english: One who serves the Lord is the Lord's person.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saach sahaj kade na hovai sog ||
english: He dwells in intuitive peace, and never suffers in sorrow.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mue naahee har man maahi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are dead; the Lord is not within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਭੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi bhee mar jaahi ||1||
english: They die and die again and again, and are reincarnated, only to die once more. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੀਵੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: se jan jeeve jin har man maahi ||
english: They alone are alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saach samhaalahi saach samaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They contemplate the True Lord, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har na sevahi te har te door ||
english: Those who do not serve the Lord are far away from the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: disa(n)tar bhavahi sir paavahi dhoor ||
english: They wander in foreign lands, with dust thrown on their heads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har aape jan leee laai ||
english: The Lord Himself enjoins His humble servants to serve Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin sadaa sukh hai til na tamaai ||2||
english: They live in peace forever, and have no greed at all. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare chookai abhimaan ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee daragah paavai maan ||
english: Then, the mortal is honored in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu vekhai sad hajoor ||
english: He sees the Dear Lord always close at hand, ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||3||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sees the Lord pervading and permeating all. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t kee kare pratipaal ||
english: The Lord cherishes all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਦ ਸਮੑਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sad samhaal ||
english: By Guru's Grace, contemplate Him forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dar saachai pat siu ghar jaai ||
english: You shall go to your true home in the Lord's Court with honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam vadaaee paai ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall be blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar poojaa man te hoi ||
english: One who worships the Lord within his mind,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko vekhai aur na koi ||
english: sees the One and Only Lord, and no other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojai lokee bahut dukh paaiaa ||
english: People in duality suffer terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੈਨੋ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur maino ek dikhaaiaa ||1||
english: The True Guru has shown me the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh mauliaa sad basa(n)t ||
english: My God is in bloom, forever in spring.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man mauliaa gaai gun gobi(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This mind blossoms forth, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur poochhahu tumh karahu beechaar ||
english: So consult the Guru, and reflect upon His wisdom;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: taa(n) prabh saache lagai piaar ||
english: then, you shall be in love with the True Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਾਸਤ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap chhod hohi daasat bhaai ||
english: Abandon your self-conceit, and be His loving servant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau jagajeevan vasai man aai ||2||
english: Then, the Life of the World shall come to dwell in your mind. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat kare sad vekhai hajoor ||
english: Worship Him with devotion, and see Him always ever-present, close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh sad rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: My God is forever permeating and pervading all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: is bhagatee kaa koee jaanai bheu ||
english: Only a rare few know the mystery of this devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh meraa prabh aatam deu ||3||
english: My God is the Enlightener of all souls. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur mel milaae ||
english: The True Guru Himself unites us in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan siu aap chit laae ||
english: He Himself links our consciousness to the Lord, the Life of the World.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan hariaa sahaj subhaae ||
english: Thus, our minds and bodies are rejuvenated with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam rahe liv laae ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we remain attuned to the String of His Love. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal har vasai man aai ||
english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells within their minds,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te sahaj subhaai ||
english: by Guru's Grace, with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
