transliteration: bhagat kare vichahu aap khoi ||
english: Through devotional worship, self-conceit is eradicated from within,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tad hee saach milaavaa hoi ||1||
english: and then, one meets the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sohahi sadaa har prabh duaar ||
english: His devotees are forever beauteous at the Door of the Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai het saachai prem piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Loving the Guru, they have love and affection for the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat kare so jan niramal hoi ||
english: That humble being who worships the Lord with devotion becomes immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee vichahu haumai khoi ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is eradicated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu aap vasai man aai ||
english: The Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell within the mind,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa saa(n)t sukh sahaj samaai ||2||
english: and the mortal remains immersed in peace, tranquility and intuitive ease. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤ ॥
transliteration: saach rate tin sad basa(n)t ||
english: Those who are imbued with Truth, are forever in the bloom of spring.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: man tan hariaa rav gun guvi(n)d ||
english: Their minds and bodies are rejuvenated, uttering the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੂਕਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai sookaa sa(n)saar ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, the world is dry and parched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agan trisanaa jalai vaaro vaar ||3||
english: It burns in the fire of desire, over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: soee kare j har jeeu bhaavai ||
english: One who does only that which is pleasing to the Dear Lord

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sukh sareer bhaanai chit laavai ||
english: - his body is forever at peace, and his consciousness is attached to the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: apanaa prabh seve sahaj subhaai ||
english: He serves His God with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai man aai ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in his mind. ||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabad jalaae ||
english: Attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan hariaa satigur bhaae ||
english: The mind and body are rejuvenated by the Love of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲਿਓੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saphaliou birakh har kai duaar ||
english: The tree bears fruit at the Lord's Door,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saachee baanee naam piaar ||1||
english: in love with the True Bani of the Guru's Word, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man hariaa sahaj subhaai ||
english: This mind is rejuvenated, with intuitive ease;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sach phal laagai satigur bhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: loving the True Guru, it bears the fruit of truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aape neRai aape door ||
english: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad vekhai sad hajoor ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is seen to be ever-present, close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ ਫੂਲੀ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chhaav ghanee phoolee banaraai ||
english: The plants have blossomed forth, giving a dense shade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh bigasai sahaj subhaai ||2||
english: The Gurmukh blossoms forth, with intuitive ease. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: anadin keeratan karahi din raat ||
english: Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜੂਠਿ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur gavaaee vichahu jooth bharaa(n)t ||
english: The True Guru drives out sin and doubt from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਵੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: parapa(n)ch vekh rahiaa visamaad ||
english: Gazing upon the wonder of God's Creation, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh paaeeai naam prasaad ||3||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by His Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa sabh ras bhog ||
english: The Creator Himself enjoys all delights.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਗ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare soee par hog ||
english: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vadaa daataa til na tamaai ||
english: He is the Great Giver; He has no greed at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak mileeai sabad kamaai ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, living the Word of the Shabad, the mortal meets with God. ||4||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag sach kaar kamaavai ||
english: By perfect destiny, one acts in truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: eko chetai phir jon na aavai ||
english: Remembering the One Lord, one does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam is jag mahi aaiaa ||
english: Fruitful is the coming into the world, and the life of one

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saach naam sahaj samaaiaa ||1||
english: who remains intuitively absorbed in the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kaar karahu liv laai ||
english: The Gurmukh acts, lovingly attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam sevahu vichahu aap gavaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Be dedicated to the Lord's Name, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tis jan kee hai saachee baanee ||
english: True is the speech of that humble being;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad jag maahi samaanee ||
english: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is spread throughout the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਪਸਰੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chahu jug pasaree saachee soi ||
english: Throughout the four ages, his fame and glory spread.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam rataa jan paragat hoi ||2||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord's humble servant is recognized and renowned. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik saachai sabad rahe liv laai ||
english: Some remain lovingly attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se jan saache saachai bhaai ||
english: True are those humble beings who love the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saach dhiaain dekh hajoor ||
english: They meditate on the True Lord, and behold Him near at hand, ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee pag pa(n)kaj dhoor ||3||
english: They are the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko karataa avar na koi ||
english: There is only One Creator Lord; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee melaavaa hoi ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, comes Union with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin sach seviaa tin ras paaiaa ||
english: Whoever serves the True Lord finds joy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje naam samaaiaa ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, he is intuitively absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karahi jan dekh hajoor ||
english: The Lord's humble servant worships Him, and beholds Him ever-present, near at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee pag pa(n)kaj dhoor ||
english: He is the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har setee sad rahahi liv laai ||
english: Those who remain lovingly attuned to the Lord forever

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorai satigur deeaa bujhaai ||1||
english: are blessed with understanding by the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: daasaa kaa daas viralaa koee hoi ||
english: How rare are those who become the slave of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ootam padavee paavai soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They attain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko sevahu avar na koi ||
english: So serve the One Lord, and no other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jit seviai sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu marai na aavai jaai ||
english: He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis bin avar sevee kiu maai ||2||
english: Why should I serve any other than Him, O my mother? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: se jan saache jinee saach pachhaaniaa ||
english: True are those humble beings who realize the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aap maar sahaje naam samaaniaa ||
english: Conquering their self-conceit, they merge intuitively into the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam paraapat hoi ||
english: The Gurmukhs gather in the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man niramal niramal sach soi ||3||
english: Their minds are immaculate, and their reputations are immaculate. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin giaan keeaa tis har too jaan ||
english: Know the Lord, who gave you spiritual wisdom,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saach sabad prabh ek sinjaan ||
english: and realize the One God, through the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har ras chaakhai taa(n) sudh hoi ||
english: When the mortal tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, he becomes pure and holy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sach soi ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam - their reputations are true. ||4||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਕੁਲਾਂ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naam rate kulaa(n) kaa karahi udhaar ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their generations are redeemed and saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee baanee naam piaar ||
english: True is their speech; they love the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole kaahe aae ||
english: Why have the wandering self-willed manmukhs even come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naamahu bhoole janam gavaae ||1||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the mortals waste their lives away. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marai mar maran savaarai ||
english: One who dies while yet alive, truly dies, and embellishes his death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad saach ur dhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sach bhojan pavit sareeraa ||
english: Truth is the food of the Gurmukh; his body is sanctified and pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man niramal sad gunee gaheeraa ||
english: His mind is immaculate; he is forever the ocean of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)mai marai na aavai jaai ||
english: He is not forced to come and go in the cycle of birth and death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee saach samaai ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, he merges in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: saachaa sevahu saach pachhaanai ||
english: Serving the True Lord, one realizes Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har dar neesaanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he goes to the Lord's Court with his banners flying proudly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dar saachai sach sobhaa hoi ||
english: In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains true glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paavai soi ||3||
english: He comes to dwell in the home of his own inner being. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap abhul sachaa sach soi ||
english: He cannot be fooled; He is the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hor sabh bhoolahi doojai pat khoi ||
english: All others are deluded; in duality, they lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saachaa sevahu saachee baanee ||
english: So serve the True Lord, through the True Bani of His Word.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naame saach samaanee ||4||9||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, merge in the True Lord. ||4||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin karamaa sabh bharam bhulaaee ||
english: Without the grace of good karma, all are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi bahut dukh paaee ||
english: In attachment to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe thaur na paaee ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisataa kaa keeRaa bisataa maahi samaaee ||1||
english: They are like maggots in manure, rotting away in manure. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: hukam ma(n)ne so jan paravaan ||
english: That humble being who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command is accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad naam neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is blessed with the insignia and the banner of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saach rate jinhaa dhur likh paaiaa ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are imbued with the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord is forever pleasing to their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee baanee sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: Through the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, eternal peace is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jotee jot milaae soi ||2||
english: Through it, one's light merges into the Light. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek naam taare sa(n)saar ||
english: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, can save the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee naam piaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to love the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naamai mukat kinai na paaee ||
english: Without the Naam, no one obtains liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poore gur te naam palai paaee ||3||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevaa naam driRhaae ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is implanted within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin ik jaataa se jan paravaan ||
english: Those humble beings who know the One Lord are approved and accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate dar neesaan ||4||10||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they go to the Lord's Court with His banner and insignia. ||4||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kare satiguroo milaae ||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord leads the mortal to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: aape aap vasai man aae ||
english: The Lord Himself comes to abide in his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: nihachal mat sadaa man dheer ||
english: His intellect becomes steady and stable, and his mind is strengthened forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai gunee gaheer ||1||
english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Ocean of Virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naamahu bhoole marahi bikh khaai ||
english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord - those mortals die eating poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: brithaa janam phir aavahi jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Their lives are wasted uselessly, and they continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahu bhekh karahi man saa(n)t na hoi ||
english: They wear all sorts of religious robes, but their minds are not at peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahu abhimaan apanee pat khoi ||
english: In great egotism, they lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee jin sabad pachhaaniaa ||
english: But those who realize the Word of the Shabad, are blessed by great good fortune.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਦਾ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baahar jaadaa ghar mahi aaniaa ||2||
english: They bring their distractible minds back home. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi vasat agam apaaraa ||
english: Within the home of the inner self is the inaccessible and infinite substance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat khojahi sabad beechaaraa ||
english: Those who find it, by following the Guru's Teachings, contemplate the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naam nav nidh paaee ghar hee maahi ||
english: Those who obtain the nine treasures of the Naam within the home of their own inner being,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa ra(n)g raate sach samaahi ||3||
english: are forever dyed in the color of the Lord's Love; they are absorbed in the Truth. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap kare kichh karan na jaai ||
english: God Himself does everything; no one can do anything at all by himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape bhaavai lae milaai ||
english: When God so wills, He merges the mortal into Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tis te neRai naahee ko door ||
english: All are near Him; no one is far away from Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rahiaa bharapoor ||4||11||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har chet subhaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remember the Lord with love,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ras rahai aghaai ||
english: and you shall remain satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kot kota(n)tar ke paap jal jaahi ||
english: The sins of millions upon millions of lifetimes shall be burnt away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevat marahi har naam samaahi ||1||
english: Remaining dead while yet alive, you shall be absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: har kee daat har jeeu jaanai ||
english: The Dear Lord Himself knows His own bountiful blessings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad ihu man mauliaa har gunadaataa naam vakhaanai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This mind blossoms forth in the Guru's Shabad, chanting the Name of the Lord, the Giver of virtue. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਵੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagavai ves bhram mukat na hoi ||
english: No one is liberated by wandering around in saffron-colored robes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahu sa(n)jam saa(n)t na paavai koi ||
english: Tranquility is not found by strict self-discipline.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramat naam paraapat hoi ||
english: But by following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed to receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har paavai soi ||2||
english: By great good fortune, one finds the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi raam naam vadiaaee ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness comes through the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te paaiaa jaaee ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naam rate sadaa sukh paaee ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Naam find everlasting peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin naamai haumai jal jaaee ||3||
english: But without the Naam, mortals burn in egotism. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har naam beechaaraa ||
english: By great good furtune, some contemplate the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chhootai raam naam dukh saaraa ||
english: Through the Lord's Name, all sorrows are eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hiradai vasiaa s baahar paasaaraa ||
english: He dwells within the heart, and pervades the external universe as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak jaanai sabh upaavanahaaraa ||4||12||
english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord knows all. ||4||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਇਕ ਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ik tuke ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl, Ek-Thukay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਰਮ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: teraa keeaa kiram ja(n)t ||
english: I am just a worm, created by You, O Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਜਾਪੀ ਆਦਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dehi ta jaapee aad ma(n)t ||1||
english: If you bless me, then I chant Your Primal Mantra. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun aakh veechaaree meree maai ||
english: I chant and reflect on His Glorious Virtues, O my mother.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jap har kai lagau paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, I fall at the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਦਿ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad laage naam suaad ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I am addicted to the favor of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੁ ਵੈਰਿ ਵਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaahe janam gavaavahu vair vaad ||2||
english: Why waste your life in hatred, vengeance and conflict? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa keenhee chookaa abhimaan ||
english: When the Guru granted His Grace, my egotism was eradicated,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaj bhaai paaiaa har naam ||3||
english: and then, I obtained the Lord's Name with intuitive ease. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮੁ ਊਚਾ ਸਬਦ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ootam oochaa sabad kaam ||
english: The most lofty and exalted occupation is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai saach naam ||4||1||13||
english: Nanak chants the True Name. ||4||1||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਚੜਿਆ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: banasapat maulee chaRiaa basa(n)t ||
english: The season of spring has come, and all the plants have blossomed forth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ihu man mauliaa satiguroo sa(n)g ||1||
english: This mind blossoms forth, in association with the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tumh saach dhiaavahu mugadh manaa ||
english: So meditate on the True Lord, O my foolish mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa(n) sukh paavahu mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only then shall you find peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਉਲਿਐ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: it man mauliai bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
english: This mind blossoms forth, and I am in ecstasy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit phal paaiaa naam gobi(n)d ||2||
english: I am blessed with the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: eko ek sabh aakh vakhaanai ||
english: Everyone speaks and says that the Lord is the One and Only.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hukam boojhai taa(n) eko jaanai ||3||
english: By understanding the Hukam of His Command, we come to know the One Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak haumai kahai na koi ||
english: Says Nanak, no one can describe the Lord by speaking through ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aakhan vekhan sabh saahib te hoi ||4||2||14||
english: All speech and insight comes from our Lord and Master. ||4||2||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੁਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh jug tere keete hoe ||
english: All the ages were created by You, O Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai mat budh hoe ||1||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one's intellect is awakened. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu aape laihu milaai ||
english: O Dear Lord, please blend me with Yourself;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sach naam samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: let me merge in the True Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man basa(n)t hare sabh loi ||
english: When the mind is in spring, all people are rejuvenated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਲਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phalahi phuleeahi raam naam sukh hoi ||2||
english: Blossoming forth and flowering through the Lord's Name, peace is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa basa(n)t gurasabad veechaare ||
english: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is in spring forever,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam raakhai ur dhaare ||3||
english: with the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man basa(n)t tan man hariaa hoi ||
english: When the mind is in spring, the body and mind are rejuvenated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak ihu tan birakh raam naam phal paae soi ||4||3||15||
english: O Nanak, this body is the tree which bears the fruit of the Lord's Name. ||4||3||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tinh basa(n)t jo har gun gaai ||
english: They alone are in the spring season, who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag har bhagat karaai ||1||
english: They come to worship the Lord with devotion, through their perfect destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: is man kau basa(n)t kee lagai na soi ||
english: This mind is not even touched by spring.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man jaliaa doojai doi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This mind is burnt by duality and double-mindedness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਂਧਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man dha(n)dhai baa(n)dhaa karam kamaai ||
english: This mind is entangled in worldly affairs, creating more and more karma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa moothaa sadaa bilalaai ||2||
english: Enchanted by Maya, it cries out in suffering forever. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man chhootai jaa(n) satigur bhetai ||
english: This mind is released, only when it meets with the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਫੇਟੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jamakaal kee phir aavai na phetai ||3||
english: Then, it does not suffer beatings by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man chhootaa gur leeaa chhadaai ||
english: This mind is released, when the Guru emancipates it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak maaiaa mohu sabad jalaai ||4||4||16||
english: O Nanak, attachment to Maya is burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Basant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਫੂਲੀ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t chaRiaa phoolee banaraai ||
english: Spring has come, and all the plants are flowering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ehi jee ja(n)t phoolahi har chit laai ||1||
english: These beings and creatures blossom forth when they focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: in bidh ihu man hariaa hoi ||
english: In this way, this mind is rejuvenated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japai din raatee guramukh haumai kadhai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night, egotism is removed and washed away from the Gurmukhs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur baanee sabad sunaae ||
english: The True Guru speaks the Bani of the Word, and the Shabad, the Word of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ihu jag hariaa satigur bhaae ||2||
english: This world blossoms forth in its greenery, through the love of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: phal phool laage jaa(n) aape laae ||
english: The mortal blossoms forth in flower and fruit, when the Lord Himself so wills.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mool lagai taa(n) satigur paae ||3||
english: He is attached to the Lord, the Primal Root of all, when he finds the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਵਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: aap basa(n)t jagat sabh vaaRee ||
english: The Lord Himself is the season of spring; the whole world is His Garden.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak poorai bhaag bhagat niraalee ||4||5||17||
english: O Nanak, this most unique devotional worship comes only by perfect destiny. ||4||5||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 3 ghar 2 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Third Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee vitahu vaariaa bhaaee gurasabad vitahu bal jaaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny. I am devoted and dedicated to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur saalaahee sad apanaa bhaaee gur charanee chit laaee ||1||
english: I praise my Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny. I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man raam naam chit laai ||
english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan teraa hariaa hovai ik har naamaa phal paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in lush greenery, and you shall obtain the fruit of the Name of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare bhaaee har ras a(n)mrit peeaai ||
english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, O Siblings of Destiny. They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime essence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vichahu haumai dukh uth gaiaa bhaaee sukh vuthaa man aai ||2||
english: The pain of egotism within is eradicated and banished, O Siblings of Destiny, and peace comes to dwell in their minds. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhur aape jinhaa no bakhasion bhaaee sabade laian milaai ||
english: Those whom the Primal Lord Himself forgives, O Siblings of Destiny, are united with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕੀ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhooR tinhaa kee aghuleeai bhaaee satasa(n)gat mel milaai ||3||
english: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in the company of Sadh Sangat, the True Congregation, we are united with the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae kare aap bhaaee jin hariaa keeaa sabh koi ||
english: He Himself does, and causes all to be done, O Siblings of Destiny; He makes everything blossom forth in green abundance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak man tan sukh sad vasai bhaaee sabad milaavaa hoi ||4||1||18||12||18||30||
english: O Nanak, peace fills their minds and bodies forever, O Siblings of Destiny; they are united with the Shabad. ||4||1||18||12||18||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: raag basa(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ikatuke ||
english: Raag Basant, Fourth Mehl, First House, Ik-Thukay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਸਰੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu pasaree sooraj kiran jot ||
english: Just as the light of the sun's rays spread out,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu ghat ghat ramaeeaa ot pot ||1||
english: the Lord permeates each and every heart, through and through. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eko har raviaa srab thaai ||
english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading all places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee mileeai meree maai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar eko har soi ||
english: The One Lord is deep within each and every heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਇਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur miliai ik pragat hoi ||2||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the One Lord becomes manifest, radiating forth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: eko ek rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: The One and Only Lord is present and prevailing everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਲੋਭੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saakat nar lobhee jaanahi door ||3||
english: The greedy, faithless cynic thinks that God is far away. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko ek varatai har loi ||
english: The One and Only Lord permeates and pervades the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak har ekou kare s hoi ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, whatever the One Lord does comes to pass. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 4 ||
english: Basant, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਦੇ ਪਏ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas dui sade pae ||
english: Day and night, the two calls are sent out.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man har simarahu a(n)t sadaa rakh lae ||1||
english: O mortal, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, who protects you forever, and saves you in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har chet sadaa man mere ||
english: Concentrate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਲਸੁ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh aalas dookh bha(n)j prabh paaiaa guramat gaavahu gun prabh kere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God the Destroyer of all depression and suffering is found, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glorious Praises of God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh phir phir haumai mue ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs die of their egotism, over and over again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਿ ਦੈਤਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaal dait sa(n)ghaare jam pur gae ||2||
english: They are destroyed by Death's demons, and they must go to the City of Death. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har har har liv laage ||
english: The Gurmukhs are lovingly attached to the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam maran dooo dukh bhaage ||3||
english: Their pains of both birth and death are taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kau har kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: The Lord showers His Mercy on His humble devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa miliaa banavaaree ||4||2||
english: Guru Nanak has shown mercy to me; I have met the Lord, the Lord of the forest. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲੁਕਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ratan kothaRee gaR ma(n)dar ek lukaanee ||
english: The Lord's Name is a jewel, hidden in a chamber of the palace of the body-fortress.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta khojeeai mil jotee jot samaanee ||1||
english: When one meets the True Guru, then he searches and finds it, and his light merges with the Divine Light. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maadho saadhoo jan dehu milaai ||
english: O Lord, lead me to meet with the Holy Person, the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhat daras paap sabh naasahi pavitr param pad paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my sins are erased, and I obtain the supreme, sublime, sanctified status. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਗਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch chor mil laage nagareeaa raam naam dhan hiriaa ||
english: The five thieves join together and plunder the body-village, stealing the wealth of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜ ਪਰੇ ਤਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਉਬਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramat khoj pare tab pakare dhan saabat raas ubariaa ||2||
english: But through the Guru's Teachings, they are traced and caught, and this wealth is recovered intact. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਭਰਮ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d bharam upaav kar thaake rid a(n)tar maaiaa maaiaa ||
english: Practicing hypocrisy and superstition, people have grown weary of the effort, but still, deep within their hearts, they yearn for Maya, Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhoo purakh purakhapat paaiaa agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||3||
english: By the Grace of the Holy Person, I have met with the Lord, the Primal Being, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath jagadees gusaaee kar kirapaa saadh milaavai ||
english: The Lord, the Lord of the Earth, the Lord of the Universe, in His Mercy, leads me to meet the Holy Person, the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saa(n)t hovai man a(n)tar nit hiradai har gun gaavai ||4||1||3||
english: O Nanak, peace then comes to abide deep within my mind, and I constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 4 hi(n)dol ||
english: Basant, Fourth Mehl, Hindol:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਨਛੇ ॥
transliteration: tumh vad purakh vad agam gusaaee ham keere kiram tumanachhe ||
english: You are the Great Supreme Being, the Vast and Inaccessible Lord of the World; I am a mere insect, a worm created by You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਬਨਛੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har deen daiaal karahu prabh kirapaa gur satigur charan ham banachhe ||1||
english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, please grant Your Grace; O God, I long for the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਛੇ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d jeeu satasa(n)gat mel kar kripachhe ||
english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please be merciful and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਨਛੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh mal bhariaa mil sa(n)gat kar prabh hanachhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I was overflowing with the filthy sins of countless past lives. But joining the Sangat, God made me pure again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਵਿਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥
transliteration: tumhraa jan jaat avijaataa har japio patit paveechhe ||
english: Your humble servant, whether of high class or low class, O Lord - by meditating on You, the sinner becomes pure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਿਨਛੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har keeo sagal bhavan te oopar har sobhaa har prabh dinachhe ||2||
english: The Lord exalts and elevates him above the whole world, and the Lord God blesses him with the Lord's Glory. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਤਿਨਛੇ ॥
transliteration: jaat ajaat koee prabh dhiaavai sabh poore maanas tinachhe ||
english: Anyone who meditates on God, whether of high class or low class, will have all of his hopes and desires fulfilled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਛੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se dha(n)n vade vad poore har jan jinh har dhaario har urachhe ||3||
english: Those humble servants of the Lord who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, are blessed, and are made great and totally perfect. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਢੀਂਢੇ ਢੀਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਛੇ ॥
transliteration: ham dhee(n)dhe dheem bahut at bhaaree har dhaar kripaa prabh milachhe ||
english: I am so low, I am an utterly heavy lump of clay. Please shower Your Mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with Yourself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੂਠੇ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak gur paaiaa har toothe ham keee patit paveechhe ||4||2||4||
english: The Lord, in His Mercy, has led servant Nanak to find the Guru; I was a sinner, and now I have become immaculate and pure. ||||4||2||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 4 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਗੀਧੇ ॥
transliteration: meraa ik khin manooaa rahi na sakai nit har har naam ras geedhe ||
english: My mind cannot survive, even for an instant, without the Lord. I drink in continually the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਥਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਥਨਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲੀਧੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu baarik rasak pario than maataa than kaadhe bilal bileedhe ||1||
english: It is like a baby, who joyfully sucks at his mother's breast; when the breast is withdrawn, he weeps and cries. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d jeeu mere man tan naam har beedhe ||
english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, my mind and body are pierced through by the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag gur satigur paaiaa vich kaaiaa nagar har seedhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru, and in the body-village, the Lord has revealed Himself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
transliteration: jan ke saas saas hai jete har birahi prabhoo har beedhe ||
english: Each and every breath of the Lord's humble servant is pierced through with love of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਦੇਖੇ ਸੁਕਲੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu jal kamal preet at bhaaree bin jal dekhe sukaleedhe ||2||
english: As the lotus is totally in love with the water and withers away without seeing the water, so am I in love with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਧੇ ॥
transliteration: jan japio naam nira(n)jan narahar upades guroo har preedhe ||
english: The Lord's humble servant chants the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨੀਧੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam kee haumai mal nikasee har a(n)mrit har jal needhe ||3||
english: The filth of egotism which stained me for countless lifetimes has been washed away, by the Ambrosial Water of the Ocean of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਬਿਚਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀਧੇ ॥
transliteration: hamare karam na bicharahu thaakur tumh paij rakhahu apaneedhe ||
english: Please, do not take my karma into account, O my Lord and Master; please save the honor of Your slave.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੀਧੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: har bhaavai sun binau benatee jan naanak saran paveedhe ||4||3||5||
english: O Lord, if it pleases You, hear my prayer; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 4 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: man khin khin bharam bharam bahu dhaavai til ghar nahee vaasaa paaeeai ||
english: Each and every moment, my mind roams and rambles, and runs all over the place. It does not stay in its own home, even for an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur a(n)kas sabad daaroo sir dhaario ghar ma(n)dar aan vasaaeeai ||1||
english: But when the bridle of the Shabad, the Word of God, is placed over its head, it returns to dwell in its own home. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d jeeu satasa(n)gat mel har dhiaaeeai ||
english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, lead me to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, so that I may meditate on You, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog gaiaa sukh paaiaa har sahaj samaadh lagaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am cured of the disease of egotism, and I have found peace; I have intuitively entered into the state of Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ghar ratan laal bahu maanak laade man bhramiaa lahi na sakaaeeai ||
english: This house is loaded with countless gems, jewels, rubies and emeralds, but the wandering mind cannot find them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਓਡਾ ਕੂਪੁ ਗੁਹਜ ਖਿਨ ਕਾਢੈ ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu odaa koop guhaj khin kaadhai tiu satigur vasat lahaaeeai ||2||
english: As the water-diviner finds the hidden water, and the well is then dug in an instant, so do we find the object of the Name through the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jin aisaa satigur saadh na paaiaa te dhrig dhrig nar jeevaaeeai ||
english: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru - cursed, cursed are the lives of those people.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam padaarath pu(n)n phal paaiaa kaudee badalai jaaeeai ||3||
english: The treasure of this human life is obtained when one's virtues bear fruit, but it is lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: madhusoodan har dhaar prabh kirapaa kar kirapaa guroo milaaeeai ||
english: O Lord God, please be merciful to me; be merciful, and lead me to meet the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak nirabaan pad paaiaa mil saadhoo har gun gaaeeai ||4||4||6||
english: Servant Nanak has attained the state of Nirvaanaa; meeting with the Holy people, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 4 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਹ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੁੰਞੁ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan bhaiaa dukh bikhiaa deh manamukh su(n)njee su(n)nj ||
english: Coming and going, he suffers the pains of vice and corruption; the body of the self-willed manmukh is desolate and vacant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਜਮਿ ਪਕਰੇ ਕਾਲਿ ਸਲੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam khin pal nahee chetiaa jam pakare kaal salu(n)nj ||1||
english: He does not dwell on the Lord's Name, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death seizes him by his hair. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁੰਞੁ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d jeeu bikh haumai mamataa mu(n)nj ||
english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please rid me of the poison of egotism and attachment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat gur kee har piaaree mil sa(n)gat har ras bhu(n)nj ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Sat Sangat, Guru's True Congregation is so dear to the Lord. So join the Sangat, and taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੰਞੁ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat saadh daiaa kar melahu saranaagat saadhoo pa(n)nj ||
english: Please be kind to me, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy; I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham dubade paathar kaadh lehu prabh tumh deen daiaal dukh bha(n)nj ||2||
english: I am a heavy stone, sinking down - please lift me up and pull me out! O God, Merciful to the meek, You are the Destroyer of sorrow. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
transliteration: har usatat dhaarahu rid a(n)tar suaamee satasa(n)gat mil budh la(n)nj ||
english: I enshrine the Praises of my Lord and Master within my heart; joining the Sat Sangat, my intellect is enlightened.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har naamai ham preet lagaanee ham har vitahu ghum va(n)nj ||3||
english: I have fallen in love with the Lord's Name; I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
transliteration: jan ke poor manorath har prabh har naam devahu har la(n)nj ||
english: O Lord God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant; please bless me with Your Name, O Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੭॥੩੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak man tan anad bhaiaa hai gur ma(n)tr deeo har bha(n)nj ||4||5||7||12||18||7||37||
english: Servant Nanak's mind and body are filled with ecstasy; the Guru has blessed him with the Mantra of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||7||12||18||7||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 1 dutuke ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl, First House, Du-Thukay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur sevau kar namasakaar ||
english: I serve the Guru, and humbly bow to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aaj hamaarai ma(n)galachaar ||
english: Today is a day of celebration for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aaj hamaarai mahaa ana(n)d ||
english: Today I am in supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਲਥੀ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chi(n)t lathee bhete gobi(n)d ||1||
english: My anxiety is dispelled, and I have met the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸੰਤ ॥
transliteration: aaj hamaarai grihi basa(n)t ||
english: Today, it is springtime in my household.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gun gaae prabh tumh bea(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I sing Your Glorious Praises, O Infinite Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬਨੇ ਫਾਗ ॥
transliteration: aaj hamaarai bane phaag ||
english: Today, I am celebrating the festival of Phalgun.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੇਲਨ ਲਾਗ ॥
transliteration: prabh sa(n)gee mil khelan laag ||
english: Joining with God's companions, I have begun to play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਲੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: holee keenee sa(n)t sev ||
english: I celebrate the festival of Holi by serving the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਅਤਿ ਲਾਲ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ra(n)g laagaa at laal dev ||2||
english: I am imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Divine Love. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਅਤਿ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: man tan maulio at anoop ||
english: My mind and body have blossomed forth, in utter, incomparable beauty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਛਾਵ ਧੂਪ ॥
transliteration: sookai naahee chhaav dhoop ||
english: They do not dry out in either sunshine or shade;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੂਤੀ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sagalee rootee hariaa hoi ||
english: they flourish in all seasons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇਵ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sad basa(n)t gur mile dev ||3||
english: It is always springtime, when I meet with the Divine Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖੁ ਜਮਿਓ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ॥
transliteration: birakh jamio hai paarajaat ||
english: The wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree has sprouted and grown.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫੂਲ ਲਗੇ ਫਲ ਰਤਨ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: phool lage phal ratan bhaa(n)t ||
english: It bears flowers and fruits, jewels of all sorts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tripat aghaane har gunah gaai ||
english: I am satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har har har dhiaai ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਟਵਾਣੀ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ਹਾਟੁ ਕੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: hatavaanee dhan maal haat keet ||
english: The shopkeeper deals in merchandise for profit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੂਆਰੀ ਜੂਏ ਮਾਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jooaaree jooe maahi cheet ||
english: The gambler's consciousness is focused on gambling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੀ ਜੀਵੈ ਅਮਲੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: amalee jeevai amal khaai ||
english: The opium addict lives by consuming opium.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu har jan jeevai har dhiaai ||1||
english: In the same way, the humble servant of the Lord lives by meditating on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਰਚੈ ॥
transliteration: apanai ra(n)g sabh ko rachai ||
english: Everyone is absorbed in his own pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit prabh laaiaa tit tit lagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is attached to whatever God attaches him to. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘ ਸਮੈ ਮੋਰ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: megh samai mor niratikaar ||
english: When the clouds and the rain come, the peacocks dance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਕਉਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d dekh bigasahi kaulaar ||
english: Seeing the moon, the lotus blossoms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: maataa baarik dekh ana(n)d ||
english: When the mother sees her infant, she is happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tiu har jan jeevahi jap gobi(n)d ||2||
english: In the same way, the humble servant of the Lord lives by meditating on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਘ ਰੁਚੈ ਸਦ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਾਸ ॥
transliteration: si(n)gh ruchai sad bhojan maas ||
english: The tiger always wants to eat meat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਣੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੂਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਉਲਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ran dekh soore chit ulaas ||
english: Gazing upon the battlefield, the warrior's mind is exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਅਤਿ ਧਨ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kirapan kau at dhan piaar ||
english: The miser is totally in love with his wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har jan kau har har aadhaar ||3||
english: The humble servant of the Lord leans on the Support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰੰਗ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab ra(n)g ik ra(n)g maahi ||
english: All love is contained in the Love of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh har kai naai ||
english: All comforts are contained in the Comfort of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat ihu nidhaan ||
english: He alone receives this treasure,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur jis kare daan ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, unto whom the Guru gives His gift. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tis basa(n)t jis prabh kripaal ||
english: He alone experiences this springtime of the soul, unto whom God grants His Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tis basa(n)t jis gur daiaal ||
english: He alone experiences this springtime of the soul, unto whom the Guru is merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gal tis kai jis ek kaam ||
english: He alone is joyful, who works for the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis sad basa(n)t jis ridai naam ||1||
english: He alone experiences this eternal springtime of the soul, within whose heart the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: grihi taa ke basa(n)t ganee ||
english: This spring comes only to those homes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai keeratan har dhunee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: in which the melody of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises resounds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਉਲਿ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: preet paarabraham maul manaa ||
english: O mortal, let your love for the Supreme Lord God blossom forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: giaan kamaaeeai poochh janaa(n) ||
english: Practice spiritual wisdom, and consult the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਪਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: so tapasee jis saadhasa(n)g ||
english: He alone is an ascetic, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sad dhiaanee jis gurahi ra(n)g ||2||
english: He alone dwells in deep, continual meditation, who loves his Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se nirabhau jinh bhau paiaa ||
english: He alone is fearless, who has the Fear of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so sukheeaa jis bhram gaiaa ||
english: He alone is peaceful, whose doubts are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਇਕਾਂਤੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦਾ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so ikaa(n)tee jis ridaa thaai ||
english: He alone is a hermit, who heart is steady and stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਠਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: soee nihachal saach thaai ||3||
english: He alone is steady and unmoving, who has found the true place. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਖੋਜੈ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ekaa khojai ek preet ||
english: He seeks the One Lord, and loves the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਹੀਤ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: darasan parasan heet cheet ||
english: He loves to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g ra(n)gaa sahaj maan ||
english: He intuitively enjoys the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak daas tis jan kurabaan ||4||3||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to that humble being. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿੰਡ ਦੀਨੑ ॥
transliteration: jee praan tumh pi(n)d deenh ||
english: You gave us our soul, breath of life and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਗਧ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
transliteration: mugadh su(n)dar dhaar jot keenh ||
english: I am a fool, but You have made me beautiful, enshrining Your Light within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: sabh jaachik prabh tumh daiaal ||
english: We are all beggars, O God; You are merciful to us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat hovat nihaal ||1||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are uplifted and exalted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam kaaran karan jog ||
english: O my Beloved, only You have the potency to act,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਥੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau paavau tum te sagal thok ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and cause all to be done. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam japat hovat udhaar ||
english: Chanting the Naam, the mortal is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam japat sukh sahaj saar ||
english: Chanting the Naam, sublime peace and poise are found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam japat pat sobhaa hoi ||
english: Chanting the Naam, honor and glory are received.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam japat bighan naahee koi ||2||
english: Chanting the Naam, no obstacles shall block your way. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਇਹ ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaaran ih dulabh deh ||
english: For this reason, you have been blessed with this body, so difficult to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੋਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: so bol mere prabhoo dehi ||
english: O my Dear God, please bless me to speak the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mahi ihu bisraam ||
english: This tranquil peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa ridai japee prabh tero naam ||3||
english: May I always chant and meditate within my heart on Your Name, O God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa koi naahi ||
english: Other than You, there is no one at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh tero khel tujh mahi samaahi ||
english: Everything is Your play; it all merges again into You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh le ||
english: As it pleases Your Will, save me, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: sukh naanak pooraa gur mile ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, peace is obtained by meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh preetam merai sa(n)g raai ||
english: My Beloved God, my King is with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jisahi dekh hau jeevaa maai ||
english: Gazing upon Him, I live, O my mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran dukh na hoi ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, there is no pain or suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮੋਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar daiaa milaavahu tisahi mohi ||1||
english: Please, take pity on me, and lead me on to meet Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਮਨ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam praan adhaar man ||
english: My Beloved is the Support of my breath of life and mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਧਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan sabh tero dhan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This soul, breath of life, and wealth are all Yours, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau khojahi sur nar dev ||
english: He is sought by the angels, mortals and divine beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਨ ਲਹਹਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
transliteration: mun jan sekh na lahahi bhev ||
english: The silent sages, the humble, and the religious teachers do not understand His mystery.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee gat mit kahee na jaai ||
english: His state and extent cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ghat ghat rahiaa samaai ||2||
english: In each and every home of each and every heart, He is permeating and pervading. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke bhagat aana(n)d mai ||
english: His devotees are totally in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke bhagat kau naahee khai ||
english: His devotees cannot be destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke bhagat kau naahee bhai ||
english: His devotees are not afraid.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa ke bhagat kau sadaa jai ||3||
english: His devotees are victorious forever. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaun upamaa teree kahee jaai ||
english: What Praises of Yours can I utter?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa prabh rahio samaai ||
english: God, the Giver of peace, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak jaachai ek daan ||
english: Nanak begs for this one gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi dehu naam ||4||5||
english: Be merciful, and bless me with Your Name. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਰੇ ਬੂਟ ॥
transliteration: mil paanee jiu hare boot ||
english: As the plant turns green upon receiving water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੂਟ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat tiu haumai chhoot ||
english: just so, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਦਾਸੇ ਧੀਰ ਮੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jaisee daase dheer meer ||
english: Just as the servant is encouraged by his ruler,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਗੁਰਹ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taise udhaaran gurah peer ||1||
english: we are saved by the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tum daate prabh denahaar ||
english: You are the Great Giver, O Generous Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh tis namasakaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Each and every instant, I humbly bow to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jisahi paraapat saadhasa(n)g ||
english: Whoever enters the Saadh Sangat

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tis jan laagaa paarabraham ra(n)g ||
english: that humble being is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥
transliteration: te ba(n)dhan te bhae mukat ||
english: He is liberated from bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat araadhahi jog jugat ||2||
english: His devotees worship Him in adoration; they are united in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ॥
transliteration: netr sa(n)tokhe daras pekh ||
english: My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa gaae gun anek ||
english: My tongue sings the Infinite Praises of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa boojhee gur prasaad ||
english: My thirst is quenched, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਸੁਆਦਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man aaghaanaa har rasahi suaad ||3||
english: My mind is satisfied, with the sublime taste of the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sevak laago charan sev ||
english: Your servant is committed to the service of Your Feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)par dev ||
english: O Primal Infinite Divine Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal udhaaran tero naam ||
english: Your Name is the Saving Grace of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak paaio ihu nidhaan ||4||6||
english: Nanak has received this teasure. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਬਡ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: tum bad daate de rahe ||
english: You are the Great Giver; You continue to give.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jee praan mahi rav rahe ||
english: You permeate and pervade my soul, and my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਖਾਨ ॥
transliteration: deene sagale bhojan khaan ||
english: You have given me all sorts of foods and dishes.

author: Guru Arjan
