gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohi niragun ik gun na jaan ||1||
english: I am unworthy; I know none of Your Virtues at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hau kachhoo na jaanau teree saar ||
english: I do not understand anything of Your Worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too kar gat meree prabh daiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Save me, O my Merciful Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਨ ਤਾਪ ਨ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jaap na taap na karam keet ||
english: I have not practiced meditation, austerities or good actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੂ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aavai naahee kachhoo reet ||
english: I do not know the way to meet You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਆਸ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: man mahi raakhau aas ek ||
english: Within my mind, I have placed my hopes in the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਰਉ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam tere kee tarau tek ||2||
english: The Support of Your Name shall carry me across. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa prabh tumh prabeen ||
english: You are the Expert, O God, in all powers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਲਹਿ ਮੀਨ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na paavahi jalahi meen ||
english: The fish cannot find the limits of the water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਊਚਹ ਤੇ ਊਚ ॥
transliteration: agam agam oochah te ooch ||
english: You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable, the Highest of the High.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਥੋਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਬਹੁਤ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham thore tum bahut mooch ||3||
english: I am small, and You are so very Great. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jin too dhiaaiaa se ganee ||
english: Those who meditate on You are wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jin too paaiaa se dhanee ||
english: Those who attain You are rich.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੁਖੀ ਸੇ ॥
transliteration: jin too seviaa sukhee se ||
english: Those who serve You are peaceful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰੇ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saran naanak pare ||4||7||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tis too sev jin too keeaa ||
english: Serve the One who created You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tis araadh jin jeeu deeaa ||
english: Worship the One who gave you life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਾਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa chaakar hohi phir daan na laagai ||
english: Become His servant, and you shall never again be punished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੋਤਦਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis kee kar potadaaree phir dookh na laagai ||1||
english: Become His trustee, and you shall never again suffer sorrow. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: evad bhaag hohi jis praanee ||
english: That mortal who is blessed with such great good fortune,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so paae ihu pad nirabaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: attains this state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: doojee sevaa jeevan birathaa ||
english: Life is wasted uselessly in the service of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: kachhoo na hoee hai pooran arathaa ||
english: No efforts shall be rewarded, and no works brought to fruition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਸੇਵਾ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: maanas sevaa kharee duhelee ||
english: It is so painful to serve only mortal beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadh kee sevaa sadaa suhelee ||2||
english: Service to the Holy brings lasting peace and bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: je loRahi sadaa sukh bhaaee ||
english: If you long for eternal peace, O Siblings of Destiny,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat gurahi bataaee ||
english: then join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; this is the Guru's advice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: oohaa japeeai keval naam ||
english: There, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is meditated on.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat paaragaraam ||3||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, you shall be emancipated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਤ ਮਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal tat mahi tat giaan ||
english: Among all essences, this is the essence of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab dhiaan mahi ek dhiaan ||
english: Among all meditations, meditation on the One Lord is the most sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਊਤਮ ਧੁਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har keeratan mahi ootam dhunaa ||
english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is the ultimate melody.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak gur mil gaai gunaa ||4||8||
english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੋਲਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis bolat mukh pavit hoi ||
english: Chanting His Name, one's mouth becomes pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat niramal hai soi ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, one's reputation becomes stainless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jis araadhe jam kichh na kahai ||
english: Worshipping Him in adoration, one is not tortured by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis kee sevaa sabh kichh lahai ||1||
english: Serving Him, everything is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raam raam bol raam raam ||
english: The Lord's Name - chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tiaagahu man ke sagal kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Abandon all the desires of your mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਧਰਣਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jis ke dhaare dharan akaas ||
english: He is the Support of the earth and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat jis kaa hai pragaas ||
english: His Light illuminates each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat patit puneet hoi ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, even fallen sinners are sanctified;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal phir phir na roi ||2||
english: in the end, they will not weep and wail over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਊਤਮ ਧਰਮ ॥
transliteration: sagal dharam mahi ootam dharam ||
english: Among all religions, this is the ultimate religion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਕੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥
transliteration: karam karatoot kai oopar karam ||
english: Among all rituals and codes of conduct, this is above all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: jis kau chaahahi sur nar dev ||
english: The angels, mortals and divine beings long for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਲਗਹੁ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa kee lagahu sev ||3||
english: To find Him, commit yourself to the service of the Society of the Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੀਆ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh jis keeaa daan ||
english: One whom the Primal Lord God blesses with His bounties,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kau miliaa har nidhaan ||
english: obtains the treasure of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee gat mit kahee na jaai ||
english: His state and extent cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak jan har har dhiaai ||4||9||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: man tan bheetar laagee piaas ||
english: My mind and body are gripped by thirst and desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: gur daiaal pooree meree aas ||
english: The Merciful Guru has fulfilled my hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh kaate saadhasa(n)g ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all my sins have been taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japio har naam ra(n)g ||1||
english: I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I am in love with the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad basa(n)t banaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, this spring of the soul has come.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai ur dhaare sadaa sadaa har jas sunaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within my heart; I listen to the Lord's Praise, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ॥
transliteration: samarath suaamee kaaran karan ||
english: Our All-powerful Lord and Master is the Doer of all, the Cause of all causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣ ॥
transliteration: mohi anaath prabh teree saran ||
english: I am an orphan - I seek Your Sanctuary, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t tere aadhaar ||
english: All beings and creatures take Your Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੇਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh lehi nisataar ||2||
english: Be merciful, God, and save me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: bhav kha(n)dan dukh naas dev ||
english: God is the Destroyer of fear, the Remover of pain and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sur nar mun jan taa kee sev ||
english: The angelic beings and silent sages serve Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਣਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dharan akaas jaa kee kalaa maahi ||
english: The earth and the sky are in His Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: teraa deeaa sabh ja(n)t khaahi ||3||
english: All beings eat what You give them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee prabh daiaal ||
english: O Merciful God, O Searcher of hearts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kau nadar nihaal ||
english: please bless Your slave with Your Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi dehu daan ||
english: Please be kind and bless me with this gift,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jap jeevai naanak tero naam ||4||10||
english: that Nanak may live in Your Name. ||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਭ ਗਏ ਪਾਪ ॥
transliteration: raam ra(n)g sabh gae paap ||
english: Loving the Lord, one's sins are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: raam japat kachh nahee sa(n)taap ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, one does not suffer at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪਤ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਧੇਰ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d japat sabh mite a(n)dher ||
english: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, all darkness is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਫੇਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simarat kachh naahi pher ||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the cycle of reincarnation comes to an end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hamaarai raam ra(n)g ||
english: The love of the Lord is springtime for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa siu sadaa sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am always with the humble Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨੀ ਕੀਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janee keeaa upades ||
english: The Saints have shared the Teachings with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jah gobi(n)d bhagat so dha(n)n des ||
english: Blessed is that country where the devotees of the Lord of the Universe dwell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har bhagatiheen udiaan thaan ||
english: But that place where the Lord's devotees are not, is wilderness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ghat ghat pachhaan ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, realize the Lord in each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har keeratan ras bhog ra(n)g ||
english: Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and enjoy the nectar of His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: man paap karat too sadaa sa(n)g ||
english: O mortal, you must always restrain yourself from committing sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nikat pekh prabh karanahaar ||
english: Behold the Creator Lord God near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: eet oot prabh kaaraj saar ||3||
english: Here and hereafter, God shall resolve your affairs. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਗੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu lago dhiaan ||
english: I focus my meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh keeno daan ||
english: Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with this Gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: teriaa sa(n)t janaa kee baachhau dhoor ||
english: I yearn for the dust of the feet of Your Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jap naanak suaamee sad hajoor ||4||11||
english: Nanak meditates on his Lord and Master, who is ever-present, near at hand. ||4||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sach paramesar nit navaa ||
english: The True Transcendent Lord is always new, forever fresh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te nit chavaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I continually chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥
transliteration: prabh rakhavaale maaee baap ||
english: God is my Protector, my Mother and Father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran nahee sa(n)taap ||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, I do not suffer in sorrow. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khasam dhiaaee ik man ik bhaai ||
english: I meditate on my Lord and Master, single-mindedly, with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee sadaa saranaaee saachai saahib rakhiaa ka(n)th laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru forever. My True Lord and Master hugs me close in His Embrace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖੇ ॥
transliteration: apane jan prabh aap rakhe ||
english: God Himself protects His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਕੇ ॥
transliteration: dusat doot sabh bhram thake ||
english: The demons and wicked enemies have grown weary of struggling against Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur saache nahee jaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, there is no place to go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਧਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dukh des disa(n)tar rahe dhaai ||2||
english: Wandering through the lands and foreign countries, people only grow tired and suffer in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਓਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kirat onhaa kaa mitas naahi ||
english: The record of their past actions cannot be erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅਪਣਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: oi apanaa beejiaa aap khaahi ||
english: They harvest and eat what they have planted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jan kaa rakhavaalaa aap soi ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Protector of His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan kau pahuch na sakas koi ||3||
english: No one can rival the humble servant of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh daas rakhe kar jatan aap ||
english: By His own efforts, God protects His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖੰਡ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: akha(n)d pooran jaa ko prataap ||
english: God's Glory is perfect and unbroken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d nit rasan gaai ||
english: So sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with your tongue forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak jeevai har charan dhiaai ||4||12||
english: Nanak lives by meditating on the Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur charan sarevat dukh gaiaa ||
english: Dwelling at the Guru's Feet, pain and suffering go away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh karee maiaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sarab manorath pooran kaam ||
english: All my desires and tasks are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jap jeevai naanak raam naam ||1||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, Nanak lives. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saa rut suhaavee jit har chit aavai ||
english: How beautiful is that season, when the Lord fills the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਂਤੀ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur deesai bilalaa(n)tee saakat phir phir aavai jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the True Guru, the world weeps. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation, over and over again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: se dhanava(n)t jin har prabh raas ||
english: They alone are rich, who have the Wealth of the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh gur sabad naas ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sexual desire and anger are eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhai binase nirabhai pad paaiaa ||
english: Their fear is dispelled, and they attain the state of fearlessness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur mil naanak khasam dhiaaiaa ||2||
english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak meditates on his Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਓ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat prabh keeo nivaas ||
english: God dwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: har jap jap hoee pooran aas ||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, one's hopes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa ||
english: God permeates and pervades the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur mil naanak har har kahiaa ||3||
english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਏਹ ॥
transliteration: asat sidh nav nidh eh ||
english: The eight miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures are contained in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: karam paraapat jis naam deh ||
english: This is bestowed when God grants His Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabh jap jap jeevahi tere daas ||
english: Your slaves, O God, live by chanting and meditating on Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gur mil naanak kamal pragaas ||4||13||
english: O Nanak, the heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth. ||4||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ikatuke ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl, First House, Ik-Thukay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਜਪਿ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal ichhaa jap pu(n)neeaa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, all desires are fulfilled,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh mele chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||1||
english: and the mortal is re-united with God, after having been separated for so long. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਰਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੈ ਰਵਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tum ravahu gobi(n)dai ravan jog ||
english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, who is worthy of meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਵਿਐ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit raviai sukh sahaj bhog ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on Him, enjoy celestial peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa nadar nihaaliaa ||
english: Bestowing His Mercy, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apanaa daas aap samhaaliaa ||2||
english: God Himself takes care of His slave. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਰਸਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee ras banee ||
english: My bed has been beautified by His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖ ਧਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aai mile prabh sukh dhanee ||3||
english: God, the Giver of Peace, has come to meet me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa gun avagan na beechaariaa ||
english: He does not consider my merits and demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
transliteration: prabh naanak charan poojaariaa ||4||1||14||
english: Nanak worships at the Feet of God. ||4||1||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh binase gaai gunaa ||
english: The sins are erased, singing the Glories of God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin upajee sahaj dhunaa ||1||
english: night and day, celestial joy wells up. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: man maulio har charan sa(n)g ||
english: My mind has blossomed forth, by the touch of the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਤੌ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa saadhoo jan bhete nit raatau har naam ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By His Grace, He has led me to meet the Holy men, the humble servants of the Lord. I remain continually imbued with the love of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa pragate goupaal ||
english: In His Mercy, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laR laai udhaare deen daiaal ||2||
english: The Lord, Merciful to the meek, has attached me to the hem of His robe and saved me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu man hoaa saadh dhoor ||
english: This mind has become the dust of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nit dekhai suaamee hajoor ||3||
english: I behold my Lord and Master, continually, ever-present. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa gaee ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and desire have vanished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak prabh kirapaa bhaee ||4||2||15||
english: O Nanak, God has become kind to me. ||4||2||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: rog mitaae prabhoo aap ||
english: God Himself has cured the disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰ ਥਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baalak raakhe apane kar thaap ||1||
english: He laid on His Hands, and protected His child. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj grihi sad basa(n)t ||
english: Celestial peace and tranquility fill my home forever, in this springtime of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰੂਪ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee saranee aae kaliaan roop jap har har ma(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru; I chant the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of emancipation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਕਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sog sa(n)taap kate prabh aap ||
english: God Himself has dispelled my sorrow and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur apune kau nit nit jaap ||2||
english: I meditate continually, continuously, on my Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jan teraa jape naau ||
english: That humble being who chants Your Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh phal paae nihachal gun gaau ||3||
english: obtains all fruits and rewards; singing the Glories of God, he becomes steady and stable. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਲੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa bhalee reet ||
english: O Nanak, the way of the devotees is good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਪਦੇ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa japade neet neet ||4||3||16||
english: They meditate continually, continuously, on the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||4||3||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: hukam kar keenhe nihaal ||
english: By His Will, He makes us happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau bhaiaa daiaal ||1||
english: He shows Mercy to His servant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai sabh pooraa keeaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru makes everything perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rid mahi deeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He implants the Amrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam meraa kachh na beechaario ||
english: He does not consider the karma of my actions, or my Dharma, my spiritual practice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baah pakar bhavajal nisataario ||2||
english: Taking me by the arm, He saves me and carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaat mail niramal kare ||
english: God has rid me of my filth, and made me stainless and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur poore kee saranee pare ||3||
english: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap karahi aap karanaihaare ||
english: He Himself does, and causes everything to be done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak udhaare ||4||4||17||
english: By His Grace, O Nanak, He saves us. ||4||4||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫੂਲ ਫੂਲ ਫੂਲੇ ॥
transliteration: dekh phool phool phoole ||
english: Behold the flowers flowering, and the blossoms blossoming forth!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਤਿਆਗੇ ॥
transliteration: aha(n) tiaag tiaage ||
english: Renounce and abandon your egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal paage ||
english: Grasp hold of His Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: tum milahu prabh sabhaage ||
english: Meet with God, O blessed one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har chet man mere || rahaau ||
english: O my mind, remain conscious of the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਘਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਕੂਲੇ ॥
transliteration: saghan baas koole ||
english: The tender young plants smell so good,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੂਕਿ ਕਠੂਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ik rahe sook kathoole ||
english: while others remain like dry wood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t rut aaee ||
english: The season of spring has come;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਫੂਲਤਾ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paraphoolataa rahe ||1||
english: it blossoms forth luxuriantly. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਲੂ ਆਇਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ab kaloo aaio re ||
english: Now, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has come.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਵਹੁ ਬੋਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ik naam bovahu bovahu ||
english: Plant the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰੂਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: an root naahee naahee ||
english: It is not the season to plant other seeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਭੂਲਹੁ ॥
transliteration: mat bharam bhoolahu bhoolahu ||
english: Do not wander lost in doubt and delusion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur mile har paae ||
english: One who has such destiny written on his forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੈ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jis masatak hai lekhaa ||
english: Shall meet with the Guru and find the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੁਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man rut naam re ||
english: O mortal, this is the season of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
transliteration: gun kahe naanak har hare har hare ||2||18||
english: Nanak utters the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||2||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 2 hi(n)dol ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Hindol:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hoi ikatr milahu mere bhaaee dubidhaa door karahu liv laai ||
english: Come and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; dispel your sense of duality and let yourselves be lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜੋੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸਫਾ ਵਿਛਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naamai ke hovahu joRee guramukh baisahu saphaa vichhaai ||1||
english: Let yourselves be joined to the Name of the Lord; become Gurmukh, spread out your mat, and sit down. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਹੁ ਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: inh bidh paasaa dhaalahu beer ||
english: In this way, throw the dice, O brothers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam japahu din raatee a(n)t kaal nah laagai peer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. At the very last moment, you shall not have to suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸਾਜਹੁ ਸਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam tumh chaupaR saajahu sat karahu tumh saaree ||
english: Let righteous actions be your gameboard, and let the truth be your dice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੀਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਲ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu jeetahu aisee khel har piaaree ||2||
english: Conquer sexual desire, anger, greed and worldly attachment; only such a game as this is dear to the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਸੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: uth isanaan karahu parabhaate soe har aaraadhe ||
english: Rise in the early hours of the morning, and take your cleansing bath. Before you go to bed at night, remember to worship the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੜੇ ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bikhaRe daau la(n)ghaavai meraa satigur sukh sahaj setee ghar jaate ||3||
english: My True Guru will assist you, even on your most difficult moves; you shall reach your true home in celestial peace and poise. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har aape khelai aape dekhai har aape rachan rachaaiaa ||
english: The Lord Himself plays, and He Himself watches; the Lord Himself created the creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh jo nar khelai so jin baajee ghar aaiaa ||4||1||19||
english: O servant Nanak, that person who plays this game as Gurmukh, wins the game of life, and returns to his true home. ||4||1||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 hi(n)dol ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl, Hindol:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: teree kudarat toohai jaanahi aur na doojaa jaanai ||
english: You alone know Your Creative Power, O Lord; no one else knows it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa karahi mere piaare soee tujhai pachhaanai ||1||
english: He alone realizes You, O my Beloved, unto whom You show Your Mercy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teriaa bhagataa kau balihaaraa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: thaan suhaavaa sadaa prabh teraa ra(n)g tere aapaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your place is eternally beautiful, God; Your wonders are infinite. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: teree sevaa tujh te hovai aur na doojaa karataa ||
english: Only You Yourself can perform Your service. No one else can do it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat teraa soee tudh bhaavai jis no too ra(n)g dharataa ||2||
english: He alone is Your devotee, who is pleasing to You. You bless them with Your Love. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਨਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: too vad daataa too vad daanaa aur nahee ko doojaa ||
english: You are the Great Giver; You are so very Wise. There is no other like You.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too samarath suaamee meraa hau kiaa jaanaa teree poojaa ||3||
english: You are my All-powerful Lord and Master; I do not know how to worship You. ||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa mahal agochar mere piaare bikham teraa hai bhaanaa ||
english: Your Mansion is imperceptible, O my Beloved; it is so difficult to accept Your Will.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਢਹਿ ਪਇਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak dhahi paiaa duaarai rakh levahu mugadh ajaanaa ||4||2||20||
english: Says Nanak, I have collapsed at Your Door, Lord. I am foolish and ignorant - please save me! ||4||2||20||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਅਹੰ ਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mool na boojhai aap na soojhai bharam biaapee aha(n) manee ||1||
english: The mortal does not know the Primal Lord God; he does not understand hmself. He is engrossed in doubt and egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pitaa paarabraham prabh dhanee ||
english: My Father is the Supreme Lord God, my Master.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi nisataarahu niragunee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am unworthy, but please save me anyway. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: opat paralau prabh te hovai ih beechaaree har janee ||2||
english: Creation and destruction come only from God; this is what the Lord's humble servants believe. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸੇ ਗਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam prabhoo ke jo ra(n)g raate kal mahi sukheee se ganee ||3||
english: Only those who are imbued with God's Name are judged to be peaceful in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੧॥
transliteration: avar upaau na koee soojhai naanak tareeai gur bachanee ||4||3||21||
english: It is the Guru's Word that carries us across; Nanak cannot think of any other way. ||4||3||21||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Basant Hindol, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: saadho ihu tan mithiaa jaanau ||
english: O Holy Saints, know that this body is false.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਯਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: yaa bheetar jo raam basat hai saacho taahi pachhaano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord who dwells within it - recognize that He alone is real. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਾ ਐਡਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag hai sa(n)pat supane kee dekh kahaa aidaano ||
english: The wealth of this world is only a dream; why are you so proud of it?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)g tihaarai kachhoo na chaalai taahi kahaa lapataano ||1||
english: None of it shall go along with you in the end; why do you cling to it? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa dooo parahar har keerat ur aano ||
english: Leave behind both praise and slander; enshrine the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises within your heart.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak sabh hee mai pooran ek purakh bhagavaano ||2||1||
english: O servant Nanak, the One Primal Being, the Lord God, is totally permeating everywhere. ||2||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 9 ||
english: Basant, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਹੀਐ ਮੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paapee heeai mai kaam basaai ||
english: The heart of the sinner is filled with unfulfilled sexual desire.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man cha(n)chal yaa te gahio na jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He cannot control his fickle mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਅਰੁ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam ar sa(n)niaas ||
english: The Yogis, wandering ascetics and renunciates

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਪਰਿ ਡਾਰੀ ਇਹ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh hee par daaree ih phaas ||1||
english: - this net is cast over them all. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਜਿਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jihi jihi har ko naam samhaar ||
english: Those who contemplate the Name of the Lord

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: te bhav saagar utare paar ||2||
english: cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kee saranaai ||
english: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: deejai naam rahai gun gaai ||3||2||
english: Please bestow the blessing of Your Name, that he may continue to sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 9 ||
english: Basant, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: maaee mai dhan paaio har naam ||
english: O mother, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਧਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਠੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man mero dhaavan te chhootio kar baitho bisaraam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind has stopped its wanderings, and now, it has come to rest. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mamataa tan te bhaagee upajio niramal giaan ||
english: Attachment to Maya has run away from my body, and immaculate spiritual wisdom has welled up within me.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਏਹ ਪਰਸਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lobh moh eh paras na saakai gahee bhagat bhagavaan ||1||
english: Greed and attachment cannot even touch me; I have grasped hold of devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਬ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa sa(n)saa chookaa ratan naam jab paaiaa ||
english: The cynicism of countless lifetimes has been eradicated, since I obtained the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਿਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: trisanaa sakal binaasee man te nij sukh maahi samaaiaa ||2||
english: My mind was rid of all its desires, and I was absorbed in the peace of my own inner being. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau hot daiaal kirapaa nidh so gobi(n)d gun gaavai ||
english: That person, unto whom the Merciful Lord shows compassion, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh kee sa(n)pai kooo guramukh paavai ||3||3||
english: Says Nanak, this wealth is gathered only by the Gurmukh. ||3||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 9 ||
english: Basant, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: man kahaa bisaario raam naam ||
english: O my mind, how can you forget the Lord's Name?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਰੈ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan binasai jam siu parai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the body perishes, you shall have to deal with the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਪਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag dhooe kaa pahaar ||
english: This world is just a hill of smoke.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਿਹ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tai saachaa maaniaa kih bichaar ||1||
english: What makes you think that it is real? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ॥
transliteration: dhan daaraa sa(n)pat greh ||
english: Wealth, spouse, property and household

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਸਮਝ ਲੇਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kachh sa(n)g na chaalai samajh leh ||2||
english: - none of them shall go along with you; you must know that this is true! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: ik bhagat naaraain hoi sa(n)g ||
english: Only devotion to the Lord shall go with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਤਿਹ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj tih ek ra(n)g ||3||4||
english: Says Nanak, vibrate and meditate on the Lord with single-minded love. ||3||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 9 ||
english: Basant, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਰੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਾਗ ॥
transliteration: kahaa bhoolio re jhoothe lobh laag ||
english: Why do you wander lost, O mortal, attached to falsehood and greed?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਅਜਹੁ ਜਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kachh bigario naahin ajahu jaag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Nothing has been lost yet - there is still time to wake up! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਮ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਕੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sam supanai kai ihu jag jaan ||
english: You must realize that this world is nothing more than a dream.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binasai chhin mai saachee maan ||1||
english: In an instant, it shall perish; know this as true. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g terai har basat neet ||
english: The Lord constantly abides with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਭਜੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nis baasur bhaj taahi meet ||2||
english: Night and day, vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baar a(n)t kee hoi sahaai ||
english: At the very last instant, He shall be your Help and Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gun taa ke gaai ||3||5||
english: Says Nanak, sing His Praises. ||3||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ghar 1 dutukeeaa ||
english: Basant, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House, Du-Tukees:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਕਊਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jag kaooaa naam nahee cheet ||
english: The world is a crow; it does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਗਿਰੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naam bisaar girai dekh bheet ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, it sees the bait, and pecks at it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਚੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: manooaa dolai cheet aneet ||
english: The mind wavers unsteadily, in guilt and deceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਤੂਟੀ ਝੂਠ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jag siu tootee jhooth pareet ||1||
english: I have shattered my attachment to the false world. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਜਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh bikh bajar bhaar ||
english: The burden of sexual desire, anger and corruption is unbearable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kaise gun chaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, how can the mortal maintain a virtuous lifestyle? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਬਾਲੂ ਕਾ ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar baaloo kaa ghooman gher ||
english: The world is like a house of sand, built on a whirlpool;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਰਖਸਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਹੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: barakhas baanee budabudaa her ||
english: it is like a bubble formed by drops of rain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਤੇ ਧਰਿ ਚਕੁ ਫੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: maatr boo(n)d te dhar chak pher ||
english: It is formed from a mere drop, when the Lord's wheel turns round.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਚੇਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarab jot naamai kee cher ||2||
english: The lights of all souls are the servants of the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਇ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab upaai guroo sir mor ||
english: My Supreme Guru has created everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਪਗ ਲਾਗਉ ਤੋਰ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karau pag laagau tor ||
english: I perform devotional worship service to You, and fall at Your Feet, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੋ ਚਾਹਉ ਤੁਝ ਓਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naam rato chaahau tujh or ||
english: Imbued with Your Name, I long to be Yours.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਚੋਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam duraai chalai so chor ||3||
english: Those who do not let the Naam become manifest within themselves, depart like thieves in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pat khoee bikh a(n)chal paai ||
english: The mortal loses his honor, gathering sin and corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saach naam rato pat siu ghar jaai ||
english: But imbued with the Lord's Name, you shall go to your true home with honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੑਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh keenhs prabh rajaai ||
english: God does whatever He wills.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhai maanai nirabhau meree maai ||4||
english: One who abides in the Fear of God, becomes fearless, O my mother. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਨਿ ਚਾਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaman chaahai su(n)dar bhog ||
english: The woman desires beauty and pleasure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਫੂਲ ਮੀਠੇ ਰਸ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: paan phool meethe ras rog ||
english: But betel leaves, garlands of flowers and sweet tastes lead only to disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੀਲੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਤੇਤੋ ਸੋਗ ॥
transliteration: kheelai bigasai teto sog ||
english: The more she plays and enjoys, the more she suffers in sorrow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੑਸਿ ਹੋਗ ॥੫॥
transliteration: prabh saranaagat keenhs hog ||5||
english: But when she enters into the Sanctuary of God, whatever she wishes comes to pass. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਸਿ ਅਧਿਕੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaapaR pahiras adhik seegaar ||
english: She wears beautiful clothes with all sorts of decorations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਫੂਲੀ ਰੂਪੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maatee phoolee roop bikaar ||
english: But the flowers turn to dust, and her beauty leads her into evil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬਾਂਧੋ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa baa(n)dho baar ||
english: Hope and desire have blocked the doorway.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੂਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naam binaa soonaa ghar baar ||6||
english: Without the Naam, one's hearth and home are deserted. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਛਹੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gaachhahu putree raaj kuaar ||
english: O princess, my daughter, run away from this place!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੋਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naam bhanahu sach dot savaar ||
english: Chant the True Name, and embellish your days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: priu sevahu prabh prem adhaar ||
english: Serve your Beloved Lord God, and lean on the Support of His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gurasabadee bikh tiaas nivaar ||7||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, abandon your thirst for corruption and poison. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mohan mohi leeaa man mohi ||
english: My Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad pachhaanaa tohi ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have realized You, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਢੇ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak thaadhe chaahahi prabhoo duaar ||
english: Nanak stands longingly at God's Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: tere naam sa(n)tokhe kirapaa dhaar ||8||1||
english: I am content and satisfied with Your Name; please shower me with Your Mercy. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਉ ਭਰਮਸਿ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man bhoolau bharamas aai jaai ||
english: The mind is deluded by doubt; it comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਲੁਬਧ ਲੁਭਾਨਉ ਬਿਖਮ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: at lubadh lubhaanau bikham maai ||
english: It is lured by the poisonous lure of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nah asathir deesai ek bhaai ||
english: It does not remain stable in the Love of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨ ਕੁੰਡਲੀਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu meen ku(n)daleeaa ka(n)th paai ||1||
english: Like the fish, its neck is pierced by the hook. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਉ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਸਾਚ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man bhoolau samajhas saach naai ||
english: The deluded mind is instructed by the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad beechaare sahaj bhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਉ ਭਰਮਸਿ ਭਵਰ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: man bhoolau bharamas bhavar taar ||
english: The mind, deluded by doubt, buzzes around like a bumble bee.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bil birathe chaahai bahu bikaar ||
english: The holes of the body are worthless, if the mind is filled with such great desire for corrupt passions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਗਲ ਜਿਉ ਫਾਸਸਿ ਕਾਮਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maigal jiu phaasas kaamahaar ||
english: It is like the elephant, trapped by its own sexual desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੜਿ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਸੀਸ ਮਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaR ba(n)dhan baadhio sees maar ||2||
english: It is caught and held tight by the chains, and beaten on its head. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੌ ਦਾਦਰੁ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man mugadhau daadar bhagatiheen ||
english: The mind is like a foolish frog, without devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਸਟ ਸਰਾਪੀ ਨਾਮ ਬੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dar bhrasat saraapee naam been ||
english: It is cursed and condemned in the Court of the Lord, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨ ॥
transliteration: taa kai jaat na paatee naam leen ||
english: He has no class or honor, and no one even mentions his name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਖਾਈ ਗੁਣਹ ਬੀਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh dookh sakhaaee gunah been ||3||
english: That person who lacks virtue - all of his pains and sorrows are his only companions. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: man chalai na jaaee thaak raakh ||
english: His mind wanders out, and cannot be brought back or restrained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: bin har ras raate pat na saakh ||
english: Without being imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, it has no honor or credit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: too aape surataa aap raakh ||
english: You Yourself are the Listener, Lord, and You Yourself are our Protector.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਿ ਧਾਰਣ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dhar dhaaran dekhai jaanai aap ||4||
english: You are the Support of the earth; You Yourself behold and understand it. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap bhulaae kis kahau jaai ||
english: When You Yourself make me wander, unto whom can I complain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur mele birathaa kahau maai ||
english: Meeting the Guru, I will tell Him of my pain, O my mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਛੋਡਉ ਗੁਣ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: avagan chhodau gun kamaai ||
english: Abandoning my worthless demerits, now I practice virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gurasabadee raataa sach samaai ||5||
english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am absorbed in the True Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai mat ootam hoi ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, the intellect is elevated and exalted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man niramal haumai kadhai dhoi ||
english: The mind becomes immaculate, and egotism is washed away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa mukat ba(n)dh na sakai koi ||
english: He is liberated forever, and no one can put him in bondage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sadaa naam vakhaanai aur na koi ||6||
english: He chants the Naam forever, and nothing else. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man har kai bhaanai aavai jaai ||
english: The mind comes and goes according to the Will of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi eko kichh kahan na jaai ||
english: The One Lord is contained amongst all; nothing else can be said.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh hukamo varatai hukam samaai ||
english: The Hukam of His Command pervades everywhere, and all merge in His Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਸਭ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: dookh sookh sabh tis rajaai ||7||
english: Pain and pleasure all come by His Will. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੂਲੌ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too abhul na bhoolau kade naahi ||
english: You are infallible; You never make mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਮਤਿ ਅਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad sunaae mat agaahi ||
english: Those who listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad - their intellects become deep and profound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੋਟਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too motau thaakur sabad maahi ||
english: You, O my Great Lord and Master, are contained in the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: man naanak maaniaa sach salaahi ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, my mind is pleased, praising the True Lord. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: darasan kee piaas jis nar hoi ||
english: That person, who thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਤੁ ਰਾਚੈ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ekat raachai parahar doi ||
english: is absorbed in the One Lord, leaving duality behind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: door darad math a(n)mrit khaai ||
english: His pains are taken away, as he churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai ek samaai ||1||
english: The Gurmukh understands, and merges in the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੇਤੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tere darasan kau ketee bilalaai ||
english: So many cry out for Your Darshan, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: viralaa ko cheenas gur sabad milaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How rare are those who realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad and merge with Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bed vakhaan kahahi ik kaheeai ||
english: The Vedas say that we should chant the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ohu bea(n)t a(n)t kin laheeai ||
english: He is endless; who can find His limits?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: eko karataa jin jag keeaa ||
english: There is only One Creator, who created the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਧਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baajh kalaa dhar gagan dhareeaa ||2||
english: Without any pillars, He supports the earth and the sky. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: eko giaan dhiaan dhun baanee ||
english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained in the melody of the Bani, the Word of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ek niraalam akath kahaanee ||
english: The One Lord is Untouched and Unstained; His story is unspoken.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: eko sabad sachaa neesaan ||
english: The Shabad, the Word, is the Insignia of the One True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poore gur te jaanai jaan ||3||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, the Knowing Lord is known. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: eko dharam driRai sach koee ||
english: There is only one religion of Dharma; let everyone grasp this truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat pooraa jug jug soee ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfect, all the ages through.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anahad raataa ek liv taar ||
english: Imbued with the Unmanifest Celestial Lord, and lovingly absorbed in the One,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ohu guramukh paavai alakh apaar ||4||
english: the Gurmukh attains the invisible and infinite. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਤਖਤੁ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: eko takhat eko paatisaahu ||
english: There is one celestial throne, and One Supreme King.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੀ ਥਾਈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sarabee thaaee veparavaahu ||
english: The Independent Lord God is pervading all places.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa keeaa tribhavan saar ||
english: The three worlds are the creation of that Sublime Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ohu agam agochar eka(n)kaar ||5||
english: The One Creator of the Creation is Unfathomable and Incomprehensible. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekaa moorat saachaa naau ||
english: His Form is One, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: tithai nibaRai saach niaau ||
english: True justice is administered there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee karanee pat paravaan ||
english: Those who practice Truth are honored and accepted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saachee daragah paavai maan ||6||
english: They are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekaa bhagat eko hai bhaau ||
english: Devotional worship of the One Lord is the expression of love for the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin bhai bhagatee aavau jaau ||
english: Without the Fear of God and devotional worship of Him, the mortal comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਹੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur te samajh rahai mihamaan ||
english: One who obtains this understanding from the Guru dwells like an honored guest in this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har ras raataa jan paravaan ||7||
english: That humble being who is imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord is certified and approved. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: it ut dekhau sahaje raavau ||
english: I see Him here and there; I dwell on Him intuitively.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin thaakur kisai na bhaavau ||
english: I do not love any other than You, O Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak haumai sabad jalaaiaa ||
english: O Nanak, my ego has been burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur saachaa daras dikhaaiaa ||8||3||
english: The True Guru has shown me the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal cheet na paavai paaraa ||
english: The fickle consciousness cannot find the Lord's limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat na laagai baaraa ||
english: It is caught in non-stop coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਰੀਐ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dookh ghano mareeai karataaraa ||
english: I am suffering and dying, O my Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin preetam ko karai na saaraa ||1||
english: No one cares for me, except my Beloved. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਤਮ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਉ ਹੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ootam kis aakhau heenaa ||
english: All are high and exalted; how can I call anyone low?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhagatee sach naam pateenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Devotional worship of the Lord and the True Name has satisfied me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh kar thaakee bahutere ||
english: I have taken all sorts of medicines; I am so tired of them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiu dukh chookai bin gur mere ||
english: How can this disease be cured, without my Guru?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੂਖ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhagatee dookh ghanere ||
english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, the pain is so great.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dukh sukh daate thaakur mere ||2||
english: My Lord and Master is the Giver of pain and pleasure. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਾਂਧਉ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: rog vado kiu baa(n)dhau dheeraa ||
english: The disease is so deadly; how can I find the courage?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਟੈ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: rog bujhai so kaatai peeraa ||
english: He knows my disease, and only He can take away the pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai avagan man maahi sareeraa ||
english: My mind and body are filled with faults and demerits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢੂਢਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਬੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhoodhat khojat gur mele beeraa ||3||
english: I searched and searched, and found the Guru, O my brother! ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad daaroo har naau ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the Lord's Name are the cures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu too raakhahi tivai rahaau ||
english: As You keep me, so do I remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਕਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jag rogee kah dekh dikhaau ||
english: The world is sick; where should I look?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har niramaail niramal naau ||4||
english: The Lord is Pure and Immaculate; Immaculate is His Name. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi ghar jo dekh dikhaavai ||
english: The Guru sees and reveals the Lord's home, deep within the home of the self;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਸੋ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur mahalee so mahal bulaavai ||
english: He ushers the soul-bride into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man mahi manooaa chit mahi cheetaa ||
english: When the mind remains in the mind, and the consciousness in the consciousness,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਅਤੀਤਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aise har ke log ateetaa ||5||
english: such people of the Lord remain unattached. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog te rahahi niraasaa ||
english: They remain free of any desire for happiness or sorrow;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit chaakh har naam nivaasaa ||
english: tasting the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, they abide in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaan rahai liv laagaa ||
english: They recognize their own selves, and remain lovingly attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: janam jeet guramat dukh bhaagaa ||6||
english: They are victorious on the battlefield of life, following the Guru's Teachings, and their pains run away. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਉ ॥
transliteration: gur deeaa sach a(n)mrit peevau ||
english: The Guru has given me the True Ambrosial Nectar; I drink it in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਰਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj marau jeevat hee jeevau ||
english: Of course, I have died, and now I am alive to live.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: apano kar raakhahu gur bhaavai ||
english: Please, protect me as Your Own, if it pleases You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tumaro hoi s tujhahi samaavai ||7||
english: One who is Yours, merges into You. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: bhogee kau dukh rog viaapai ||
english: Painful diseases afflict those who are sexually promiscuous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa prabh jaapai ||
english: God appears permeating and pervading in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukh hee te gur sabad ateetaa ||
english: One who remains unattached, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak raam ravai hit cheetaa ||8||4||
english: - O Nanak, his heart and consciousness dwell upon and savor the Lord. ||8||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਇਕ ਤੁਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ik tukeeaa ||
english: Basant, First Mehl, Ik-Tukee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਭਸਮ ਅੰਧੂਲੇ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mat bhasam a(n)dhoole garab jaahi ||
english: Do not make such a show of rubbing ashes on your body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: in bidh naage jog naahi ||1||
english: O naked Yogi, this is not the way of Yoga! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੑੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਤੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mooRhe kaahe bisaario tai raam naam ||
english: You fool! How can you have forgotten the Lord's Name?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal terai aavai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: At the very last moment, it and it alone shall be of any use to you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur poochh tum karahu beechaar ||
english: Consult the Guru, reflect and think it over.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah saarigapaan ||2||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord of the World. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਆਖਾ ਜਾਂ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa hau aakhaa jaa(n) kachhoo naahi ||
english: What can I say? I am nothing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaat pat sabh terai naai ||3||
english: All my status and honor are in Your Name. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਾਲੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaahe maal darab dekh garab jaahi ||
english: Why do you take such pride in gazing upon your property and wealth?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: chalatee baar tero kachhoo naahi ||4||
english: When you must leave, nothing shall go along with you. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch maar chit rakhahu thaai ||
english: So subdue the five thieves, and hold your consciousness in its place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਪਾਂਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jog jugat kee ihai paa(n)i ||5||
english: This is the basis of the way of Yoga. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਪੈਖੜੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai paikhaR tere manai maahi ||
english: Your mind is tied with the rope of egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har na chetahi mooRe mukat jaahi ||6||
english: You do not even think of the Lord - you fool! He alone shall liberate you. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਜਮ ਵਸਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mat har visariai jam vas paahi ||
english: If you forget the Lord, you will fall into the clutches of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਚੋਟ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal mooRe chot khaahi ||7||
english: At that very last moment, you fool, you shall be beaten. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad beechaarahi aap jaai ||
english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and be rid of your ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਜੋਗੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: saach jog man vasai aai ||8||
english: True Yoga shall come to dwell in your mind. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin jeeu pi(n)d ditaa tis chetahi naahi ||
english: He blessed you with body and soul, but you do not even think of Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: maRee masaanee mooRe jog naahi ||9||
english: You fool! Visiting graves and cremation grounds is not Yoga. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: gun naanak bolai bhalee baan ||
english: Nanak chants the sublime, glorious Bani of the Word.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੋਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਖੇ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥੧੦॥੫॥
transliteration: tum hohu sujaakhe lehu pachhaan ||10||5||
english: Understand it, and appreciate it. ||10||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਧੁਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa duramat adhulee kaar ||
english: In duality and evil-mindedness, the mortal acts blindly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਮਝਿ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh bharamai majh gubaar ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders, lost in the darkness. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਅੰਧੁਲੀ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)dhulaa a(n)dhulee mat laagai ||
english: The blind man follows blind advice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur karanee bin bharam na bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Unless one takes the Guru's Way, his doubt is not dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhule guramat na bhaaee ||
english: The manmukh is blind; he does not like the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pasoo bhae abhimaan na jaaee ||2||
english: He has become a beast; he cannot get rid of his egotistical pride. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh ja(n)t upaae ||
english: God created 8.4 million species of beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਣੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mere thaakur bhaane siraj samaae ||3||
english: My Lord and Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, creates and destroys them. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਭੂਲੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sagalee bhoolai nahee sabad achaar ||
english: All are deluded and confused, without the Word of the Shabad and good conduct.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਮਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: so samajhai jis gur karataar ||4||
english: He alone is instructed in this, who is blessed by the Guru, the Creator. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke chaakar thaakur bhaane ||
english: The Guru's servants are pleasing to our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
