gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਕਾਣੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bakhas leee naahee jam kaane ||5||
english: The Lord forgives them, and they no longer fear the Messenger of Death. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kai hiradai eko bhaaiaa ||
english: Those who love the One Lord with all their heart

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aape mele bharam chukaaiaa ||6||
english: - He dispels their doubts and unites them with Himself. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bemuhataaj bea(n)t apaaraa ||
english: God is Independent, Endless and Infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sach pateejai karanaihaaraa ||7||
english: The Creator Lord is pleased with Truth. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੂਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhoole gur samajhaavai ||
english: O Nanak, the Guru instructs the mistaken soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਟਿਕਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: ek dikhaavai saach tikaavai ||8||6||
english: He implants the Truth within him, and shows him the One Lord. ||8||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Basant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਵਰਾ ਫੂਲ ਬੇਲਿ ॥
transliteration: aape bhavaraa phool bel ||
english: He Himself is the bumble bee, the fruit and the vine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਤ ਮੇਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape sa(n)gat meet mel ||1||
english: He Himself unites us with the Sangat - the Congregation, and the Guru, our Best Friend. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਭਵਰਾ ਬਾਸੁ ਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aisee bhavaraa baas le ||
english: O bumble bee, suck in that fragrance,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰ ਫੂਲੇ ਬਨ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taravar phoole ban hare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: which causes the trees to flower, and the woods to grow lush foliage. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aape kavalaa ka(n)t aap ||
english: He Himself is Lakshmi, and He Himself is her husband.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਥਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape raave sabad thaap ||2||
english: He established the world by Word of His Shabad, and He Himself ravishes it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਛਰੂ ਗਊ ਖੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape bachharoo gaoo kheer ||
english: He Himself is the calf, the cow and the milk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਥੰਮੑੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape ma(n)dar tha(n)mh sareer ||3||
english: He Himself is the Support of the body-mansion. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape karanee karanahaar ||
english: He Himself is the Deed, and He Himself is the Doer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape guramukh kar beechaar ||4||
english: As Gurmukh, He contemplates Himself. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too kar kar dekhahi karanahaar ||
english: You create the creation, and gaze upon it, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਅਸੰਖ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jot jee asa(n)kh dei adhaar ||5||
english: You give Your Support to the uncounted beings and creatures. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too sar saagar gun gaheer ||
english: You are the Profound, Unfathomable Ocean of Virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: too akul nira(n)jan param heer ||6||
english: You are the Unknowable, the Immaculate, the most Sublime Jewel. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: too aape karataa karan jog ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator, with the Potency to create.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਰਾਜਨ ਸੁਖੀ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: nihakeval raajan sukhee log ||7||
english: You are the Independent Ruler, whose people are at peace. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਦਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak dhraape har naam suaad ||
english: Nanak is satisfied with the subtle taste of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੮॥੭॥
transliteration: bin har gur preetam janam baad ||8||7||
english: Without the Beloved Lord and Master, life is meaningless. ||8||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Basant Hindol, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਸਤ ਚਉਦਹ ਤੀਨਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: nau sat chaudah teen chaar kar mahalat chaar bahaalee ||
english: The nine regions, the seven continents, the fourteen worlds, the three qualities and the four ages - You established them all through the four sources of creation, and You seated them in Your mansions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਦੀਵੇ ਚਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਦੀਏ ਏਕਾ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaare deeve chahu hath deee ekaa ekaa vaaree ||1||
english: He placed the four lamps, one by one, into the hands of the four ages. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧੌ ਐਸੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: miharavaan madhusoodan maadhau aisee sakat tumhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Merciful Lord, Destroyer of demons, Lord of Lakshmi, such is Your Power - Your Shakti. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar lasakar paavak teraa dharam kare sikadaaree ||
english: Your army is the fire in the home of each and every heart. And Dharma - righteous living is the ruling chieftain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਵੇਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharatee deg milai ik veraa bhaag teraa bha(n)daaree ||2||
english: The earth is Your great cooking pot; Your beings receive their portions only once. Destiny is Your gate-keeper. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਾਬੂਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naa saaboor hovai phir ma(n)gai naarad kare khuaaree ||
english: But the mortal becomes unsatisfied, and begs for more; his fickle mind brings him disgrace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨਾ ਅਉਗਣ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lab adheraa ba(n)deekhaanaa augan pair luhaaree ||3||
english: Greed is the dark dungeon, and demerits are the shackles on his feet. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਮੁਦਗਰ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਕੋੁਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee maar pavai nit mudagar paap kare koutavaaree ||
english: His wealth constantly batters him, and sin acts as the police officer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhaavai cha(n)gaa bhaavai ma(n)daa jaisee nadar tumhaaree ||4||
english: Whether the mortal is good or bad, he is as You look upon him, O Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੇਖਾਂ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh kau alahu kaheeai sekhaa(n) aaee vaaree ||
english: The Primal Lord God is called Allah. The Shaykh's turn has now come.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਐਸੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: deval devatiaa kar laagaa aisee keerat chaalee ||5||
english: The temples of the gods are subject to taxes; this is what it has come to. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂਜਾ ਬਾਂਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਨੀਲ ਰੂਪ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: koojaa baa(n)g nivaaj musalaa neel roop banavaaree ||
english: The Muslim devotional pots, calls to prayer, prayers and prayer mats are everywhere; the Lord appears in blue robes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੀਆ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆਂ ਬੋਲੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ghar ghar meeaa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa(n) bolee avar tumaaree ||6||
english: In each and every home, everyone uses Muslim greetings; your speech has changed, O people. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੀਰ ਮਹੀਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: je too meer maheepat saahib kudarat kaun hamaaree ||
english: You, O my Lord and Master, are the King of the earth; what power do I have to challenge You?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)t salaam karahige ghar ghar siphat tumhaaree ||7||
english: In the four directions, people bow in humble adoration to You; Your Praises are sung in each and every heart. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: teerath si(n)mrit pu(n)n daan kichh laahaa milai dihaaRee ||
english: Making pilgrimages to sacred shrines, reading the Simritees and giving donations in charity - these do bring any profit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee mekaa ghaRee samhaalee ||8||1||8||
english: O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained in an instant, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol ghar 2 mahalaa 4 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Second House, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)iaa nagar ik baalak vasiaa khin pal thir na rahaaee ||
english: Within the body-village there lives a child who cannot hold still, even for an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik upaav jatan kar thaake baara(n) baar bharamaaee ||1||
english: It makes so many efforts, and grows weary, but still, it wanders restlessly again and again. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mere thaakur baalak ikat ghar aan ||
english: O my Lord and Master, Your child has come home, to be one with You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai bhaj raam naam neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, he finds the Perfect Lord. Meditating and vibrating on the Name of the Lord, he receives the Insignia of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu miratak maRaa sareer hai sabh jag jit raam naam nahee vasiaa ||
english: These are dead corpses, these bodies of all the people of the world; the Name of the Lord does not dwell in them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਦਕੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam gur udak chuaaiaa phir hariaa hoaa rasiaa ||2||
english: The Guru leads us to taste the water of the Lord's Name, and then we savor and enjoy it, and our bodies are rejuvenated. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai nirakhat nirakhat sareer sabh khojiaa ik guramukh chalat dikhaaiaa ||
english: I have examined and studied and searched my entire body, and as Gurmukh, I behold a miraculous wonder.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: baahar khoj mue sabh saakat har guramatee ghar paaiaa ||3||
english: All the faithless cynics searched outside and died, but following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord within the home of my own heart. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: deenaa deen daiaal bhae hai jiu krisan bidar ghar aaiaa ||
english: God is Merciful to the meekest of the meek; Krishna came to the house of Bidar, a devotee of low social status.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਗੈ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: milio sudaamaa bhaavanee dhaar sabh kichh aagai daalad bha(n)j samaaiaa ||4||
english: Sudama loved God, who came to meet him; God sent everything to his home, and ended his poverty. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kee paij vaderee mere thaakur aap rakhaaee ||
english: Great is the glory of the Name of the Lord. My Lord and Master Himself has enshrined it within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਘਟਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: je sabh saakat karahi bakheelee ik ratee til na ghataaee ||5||
english: Even if all the faithless cynics continue slandering me, it is not diminished by even one iota. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jan kee usatat hai raam naamaa dah dis sobhaa paaee ||
english: The Lord's Name is the praise of His humble servant. It brings him honor in the ten directions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਖਵਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak saakat khav na sakai til apanai ghar lookee laaee ||6||
english: The slanderers and the faithless cynics cannot endure it at all; they have set fire to their own houses. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jan kau jan mil sobhaa paavai gun mahi gun paragaasaa ||
english: The humble person meeting with another humble person obtains honor. In the glory of the Lord, their glory shines forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mere thaakur ke jan preetam piaare jo hovahi daasan daasaa ||7||
english: The servants of my Lord and Master are loved by the Beloved. They are the slaves of His slaves. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape jal apara(n)par karataa aape mel milaavai ||
english: The Creator Himself is the Water; He Himself unites us in His Union.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sahaj milaae jiu jal jalahi samaavai ||8||1||9||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in celestial peace and poise, like water blending with water. ||8||1||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 1 dutukeeaa ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl, First House, Du-Tukee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: sun saakhee man jap piaar ||
english: Listen to the stories of the devotees, O my mind, and meditate with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ajaamal udhariaa kahi ek baar ||
english: Ajaamal uttered the Lord's Name once, and was saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਮੀਕੈ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: baalameekai hoaa saadhasa(n)g ||
english: Baalmeek found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhroo kau miliaa har nisa(n)g ||1||
english: The Lord definitely met Dhroo. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਚਉ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: teriaa sa(n)taa jaachau charan ren ||
english: I beg for the dust of the feet of Your Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਵਉ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: le masatak laavau kar kripaa den ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, that I may apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਨਿਕਾ ਉਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਹੈ ਤੋਤ ॥
transliteration: ganikaa udharee har kahai tot ||
english: Ganika the prostitute was saved, when her parrot uttered the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਜਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮੋਖ ॥
transliteration: gajai(n)dr dhiaaio har keeo mokh ||
english: The elephant meditated on the Lord, and was saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਸੁਦਾਮੇ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜ ॥
transliteration: bipr sudaame daalad bha(n)j ||
english: He delivered the poor Brahmin Sudama out of poverty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਭਜੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: re man too bhee bhaj gobi(n)d ||2||
english: O my mind, you too must meditate and vibrate on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਧਿਕੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਖਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: badhik udhaario kham prahaar ||
english: Even the hunter who shot an arrow at Krishna was saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਉਧਰੀ ਅੰਗੁਸਟ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kubijaa udharee a(n)gusat dhaar ||
english: Kubija the hunchback was saved, when God placed His Feet on her thumb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਰੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਦਾਸਤ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bidar udhaario daasat bhaai ||
english: Bidar was saved by his attitude of humility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: re man too bhee har dhiaai ||3||
english: O my mind, you too must meditate on the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad rakhee har paij aap ||
english: The Lord Himself saved the honor of Prahlaad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਛੀਨਤ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਰਖੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
transliteration: basatr chheenat dropatee rakhee laaj ||
english: Even when she was being disrobed in court, Dropatee's honor was preserved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jin jin seviaa a(n)t baar ||
english: Those who have served the Lord, even at the very last instant of their lives, are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਰਹਿ ਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: re man sev too parahi paar ||4||
english: O my mind, serve Him, and you shall be carried across to the other side. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)nai seviaa baal budh ||
english: Dhanna served the Lord, with the innocence of a child.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਈ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: trilochan gur mil bhaee sidh ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, Trilochan attained the perfection of the Siddhas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਣੀ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: benee kau gur keeo pragaas ||
english: The Guru blessed Baynee with His Divine Illumination.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: re man too bhee hohi daas ||5||
english: O my mind, you too must be the Lord's slave. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਦੇਵ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
transliteration: jaidev tiaagio aha(n)mev ||
english: Jai Dayv gave up his egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਈ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਸੈਨੁ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: naaee udhario sain sev ||
english: Sain the barber was saved through his selfless service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man deeg na dolai kahoo(n) jaai ||
english: Do not let your mind waver or wander; do not let it go anywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: man too bhee tarasahi saran paai ||6||
english: O my mind, you too shall cross over; seek the Sanctuary of God. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jih anugrahu thaakur keeo aap ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You have shown Your Mercy to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਤੈਂ ਲੀਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਾਖਿ ॥
transliteration: se tai(n) leene bhagat raakh ||
english: You saved those devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa gun avagan na beechaario koi ||
english: You do not take their merits and demerits into account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ih bidh dekh man lagaa sev ||7||
english: Seeing these ways of Yours, I have dedicated my mind to Your service. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਏਕ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: kabeer dhiaaio ek ra(n)g ||
english: Kabeer meditated on the One Lord with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਸਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: naamadev har jeeu basahi sa(n)g ||
english: Naam Dayv lived with the Dear Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਧਿਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: ravidaas dhiaae prabh anoop ||
english: Ravi Daas meditated on God, the Incomparably Beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰੂਪ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: gur naanak dev govi(n)d roop ||8||1||
english: Guru Nanak Dayv is the Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Basant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik janam bhrame jon maahi ||
english: The mortal wanders in reincarnation through countless lifetimes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har simaran bin narak paahi ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he falls into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bihoonaa kha(n)d kha(n)d ||
english: Without devotional worship, he is cut apart into pieces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਜਮੁ ਦੇਤ ਡੰਡ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin boojhe jam det da(n)d ||1||
english: Without understanding, he is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d bhajahu mere sadaa meet ||
english: Meditate and vibrate forever on the Lord of the Universe, O my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saach sabad kar sadaa preet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Love forever the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਹੂੰ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tokh na aavat kahoo(n) kaaj ||
english: Contentment does not come by any endeavors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂੰਮ ਬਾਦਰ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਜ ॥
transliteration: dhoo(n)m baadar sabh maaiaa saaj ||
english: All the show of Maya is just a cloud of smoke.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤੌ ਨਹ ਸੰਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paap kara(n)tau nah sa(n)gaai ||
english: The mortal does not hesitate to commit sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bikh kaa maataa aavai jaai ||2||
english: Intoxicated with poison, he comes and goes in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karat badhe bikaar ||
english: Acting in egotism and self-conceit, his corruption only increases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਲੋਭ ਡੂਬੌ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: moh lobh doobau sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is drowning in attachment and greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh man vas keeaa ||
english: Sexual desire and anger hold the mind in its power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: supanai naam na har leeaa ||3||
english: Even in his dreams, he does not chant the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਬ ਮੰਗਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kab hee raajaa kab ma(n)ganahaar ||
english: Sometimes he is a king, and sometimes he is a beggar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਧੌ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dookh sookh baadhau sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is bound by pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਉਧਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man udharan kaa saaj naahi ||
english: The mortal makes no arrangements to save himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਿਤ ਪਉਤ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: paap ba(n)dhan nit paut jaahi ||4||
english: The bondage of sin continues to hold him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਠ ਮੀਤ ਕੋਊ ਸਖਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: eeth meet kooo sakhaa naahi ||
english: He has no beloved friends or companions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaa(n)hi ||
english: He himself eats what he himself plants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਨੑੈ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai keenhai hot bikaar ||
english: He gathers up that which brings corruption;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: se chhod chaliaa khin mahi gavaar ||5||
english: leaving them, the fool must depart in an instant. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਮਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi bahu bharamiaa ||
english: He wanders in attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਰੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kirat rekh kar karamiaa ||
english: He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: karanaihaar alipat aap ||
english: Only the Creator Himself remains detached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: nahee lep prabh pu(n)n paap ||6||
english: God is not affected by virtue or vice. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu gobi(n)d daiaal ||
english: Please save me, O Merciful Lord of the Universe!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: teree saran pooran kripaal ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Compassionate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa nahee thaau ||
english: Without You, I have no other place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh dehu naau ||7||
english: Please take pity on me, God, and bless me with Your Name. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too karataa too karanahaar ||
english: You are the Creator, and You are the Doer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਊਚਾ ਤੂ ਬਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too oochaa too bahu apaar ||
english: You are High and Exalted, and You are totally Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੜਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa laR lehu laai ||
english: Please be merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas prabh kee saranaai ||8||2||
english: Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||8||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t kee vaar mahal 5 ||
english: Basant Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਹੋਹੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaai kai hohu hariaa bhaaee ||
english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and blossom forth in green abundance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖੰਤੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਇਹ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karam likha(n)tai paaeeai ih rut suhaaee ||
english: By your high destiny, you have been blessed with this wondrous spring of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: van trin tribhavan mauliaa a(n)mrit phal paaee ||
english: See all the three worlds in bloom, and obtain the Fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਲਥੀ ਸਭ ਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo sukh oopajai lathee sabh chhaaee ||
english: Meeting with the Holy Saints, peace wells up, and all sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak simarai ek naam phir bahuR na dhaaee ||1||
english: O Nanak, remember in meditation the One Name, and you shall never again be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਜੇ ਬਧੇ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)je badhe mahaabalee kar sachaa dhoaa ||
english: The five powerful desires are bound down, when you lean on the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਯੁ ਖੜੋਆ ॥
transliteration: aapane charan japaaian vich day khaRoaa ||
english: The Lord Himself leads us to dwell at His Feet. He stands right in our midst.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
transliteration: rog sog sabh mit gae nit navaa niroaa ||
english: All sorrows and sicknesses are eradicated, and you become ever-fresh and rejuvenated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਮੋਆ ॥
transliteration: din rain naam dhiaaidaa phir paai na moaa ||
english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You shall never again die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis te upajiaa naanakaa soee phir hoaa ||2||
english: And the One, from whom we came, O Nanak, into Him we merge once again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਥਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਹ ਰਹੈ ਕਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kithahu upajai kah rahai kah maahi samaavai ||
english: Where do we come from? Where do we live? Where do we go in the end?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh khasam ke kaun keemat paavai ||
english: All creatures belong to God, our Lord and Master. Who can place a value on Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਣਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahan dhiaain sunan nit se bhagat suhaavai ||
english: Those who meditate, listen and chant, those devotees are blessed and beautified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਦੂਸਰੁ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar saahibo doosar lavai na laavai ||
english: The Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; there is no other equal to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: sach poorai gur upadesiaa naanak sunaavai ||3||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has taught this Truth. Nanak proclaims it to the world. ||3||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t baanee bhagataa(n) kee || kabeer jee ghar 1 ||
english: Basant, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਉਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: maulee dharatee mauliaa akaas ||
english: The earth is in bloom, and the sky is in bloom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghat ghat mauliaa aatam pragaas ||1||
english: Each and every heart has blossomed forth, and the soul is illumined. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਅਨਤ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam mauliaa anat bhaai ||
english: My Sovereign Lord King blossoms forth in countless ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah rahiaa samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever I look, I see Him there pervading. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਮਉਲੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa maule chaar bed ||
english: The four Vedas blossom forth in duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਤੇਬ ॥੨॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit maulee siu kateb ||2||
english: The Simritees blossom forth, along with the Koran and the Bible. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰੁ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kar maulio jog dhiaan ||
english: Shiva blossoms forth in Yoga and meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: kabeer ko suaamee sabh samaan ||3||1||
english: Kabeer's Lord and Master pervades in all alike. ||3||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜਨ ਮਾਤੇ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit jan maate paRhi puraan ||
english: The Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, are intoxicated, reading the Puraanas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਮਾਤੇ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: jogee maate jog dhiaan ||
english: The Yogis are intoxicated in Yoga and meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)niaasee maate aha(n)mev ||
english: The Sannyaasees are intoxicated in egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਸੀ ਮਾਤੇ ਤਪ ਕੈ ਭੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tapasee maate tap kai bhev ||1||
english: The penitents are intoxicated with the mystery of penance. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਜਾਗ ॥
transliteration: sabh mad maate kooo na jaag ||
english: All are intoxicated with the wine of Maya; no one is awake and aware.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਚੋਰ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਸਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g hee chor ghar musan laag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The thieves are with them, plundering their homes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗੈ ਸੁਕਦੇਉ ਅਰੁ ਅਕੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaagai sukadeu ar akoor ||
english: Suk Dayv and Akrur are awake and aware.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਣਵੰਤੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਧਰਿ ਲੰਕੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hanava(n)t jaagai dhar la(n)koor ||
english: Hanuman with his tail is awake and aware.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kar jaagai charan sev ||
english: Shiva is awake, serving at the Lord's Feet.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਵ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kal jaage naamaa jaidev ||2||
english: Naam Dayv and Jai Dayv are awake in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaagat sovat bahu prakaar ||
english: There are many ways of being awake, and sleeping.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaagai soee saar ||
english: To be awake as Gurmukh is the most excellent way.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: is dehee ke adhik kaam ||
english: The most sublime of all the actions of this body,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer bhaj raam naam ||3||2||
english: says Kabeer, is to meditate and vibrate on the Lord's Name. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਇ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: joi khasam hai jaaiaa ||
english: The wife gives birth to her husband.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਤਿ ਬਾਪੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poot baap khelaaiaa ||
english: The son leads his father in play.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਪਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin sravanaa kheer pilaaiaa ||1||
english: Without breasts, the mother nurses her baby. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਗਾ ਕਲਿ ਕੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhahu logaa kal ko bhaau ||
english: Behold, people! This is how it is in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤਿ ਮੁਕਲਾਈ ਅਪਨੀ ਮਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sut mukalaaee apanee maau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The son marries his mother. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਗਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੁਰੀਆ ਮਾਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pagaa bin hureeaa maarataa ||
english: Without feet, the mortal jumps.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਦਨੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਰ ਖਿਰ ਹਾਸਤਾ ॥
transliteration: badanai bin khir khir haasataa ||
english: Without a mouth, he bursts into laughter.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰੁ ਪੈ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nidraa bin nar pai sovai ||
english: Without feeling sleepy, he lays down and sleeps.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਸਨ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin baasan kheer bilovai ||2||
english: Without a churn, the milk is churned. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਸਥਨ ਗਊ ਲਵੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin asathan gaoo laveree ||
english: Without udders, the cow gives milk.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੈਡੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਟ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paide bin baat ghaneree ||
english: Without travelling, a long journey is made.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur baat na paaee ||
english: Without the True Guru, the path is not found.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer samajhaaee ||3||3||
english: Says Kabeer, see this, and understand. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਪਠਾਏ ਪੜਨ ਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad pathaae paRan saal ||
english: Prahlaad was sent to school.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾ ਬਹੁ ਲੀਏ ਬਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sakhaa bahu leee baal ||
english: He took many of his friends along with him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਪੜੑਾਵਸਿ ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mo kau kahaa paRhaavas aal jaal ||
english: He asked his teacher, "Why do you teach me about worldly affairs?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meree pateeaa likh dehu sree goupaal ||1||
english: Write the Name of the Dear Lord on my tablet." ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡਉ ਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: nahee chhodau re baabaa raam naam ||
english: O Baba, I will not forsake the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਅਉਰ ਪੜੑਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mero aur paRhn siu nahee kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I will not bother with any other lessons. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਡੈ ਮਰਕੈ ਕਹਿਓ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)dai marakai kahio jaai ||
english: Sanda and Marka went to the king to complain.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prahalaad bulaae beg dhaai ||
english: He sent for Prahlaad to come at once.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੁ ਬਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: too raam kahan kee chhod baan ||
english: He said to him, "Stop uttering the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੁ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਛਡਾਊ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tujh turat chhadaaoo mero kahio maan ||2||
english: I shall release you at once, if you obey my words." ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਸਤਾਵਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mo kau kahaa sataavahu baar baar ||
english: Prahlaad answered, "Why do you annoy me, over and over again?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: prabh jal thal gir keee pahaar ||
english: God created the water, land, hills and mountains.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਗਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ik raam na chhodau gurahi gaar ||
english: I shall not forsake the One Lord; if I did, I would be going against my Guru.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਘਾਲਿ ਜਾਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mo kau ghaal jaar bhaavai maar daar ||3||
english: You might as well throw me into the fire and kill me." ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕੋਪਿਓ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaadh khaRag kopio risaai ||
english: The king became angry and drew his sword.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh raakhanahaaro mohi bataai ||
english: "Show me your protector now!"

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥੰਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: prabh tha(n)bh te nikase kai bisathaar ||
english: So God emerged out of the pillar, and assumed a mighty form.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਛੇਦਿਓ ਨਖ ਬਿਦਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: haranaakhas chhedio nakh bidaar ||4||
english: He killed Harnaakhash, tearing him apart with his nails. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੇਵਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: oi param purakh devaadh dev ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Divinity of the divine,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਭੇਵ ॥
transliteration: bhagat het narasi(n)gh bhev ||
english: for the sake of His devotee, assumed the form of the man-lion.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ko lakhai na paar ||
english: Says Kabeer, no one can know the Lord's limits.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: prahalaad udhaare anik baar ||5||4||
english: He saves His devotees like Prahlaad over and over again. ||5||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਦਨ ਚੋਰ ॥
transliteration: is tan man madhe madan chor ||
english: Within the body and mind are thieves like sexual desire,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: jin giaan ratan hir leen mor ||
english: which has stolen my jewel of spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਉ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mai anaath prabh kahau kaahi ||
english: I am a poor orphan, O God; unto whom should I complain?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਿਗੂਤੋ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ko ko na bigooto mai ko aahi ||1||
english: Who has not been ruined by sexual desire? What am I? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਦਾਰੁਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maadhau daarun dukh sahio na jaai ||
english: O Lord, I cannot endure this agonizing pain.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਚਪਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mero chapal budh siu kahaa basaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What power does my fickle mind have against it? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਸਿਵ ਸੁਕਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: sanak sana(n)dan siv sukaad ||
english: Sanak, Sanandan, Shiva and Suk Dayv

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਜਾਨੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: naabh kamal jaane brahamaad ||
english: were born out of Brahma's naval chakra.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਟਾਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kab jan jogee jataadhaar ||
english: The poets and the Yogis with their matted hair

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਆਪਨ ਅਉਸਰ ਚਲੇ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh aapan ausar chale saar ||2||
english: all lived their lives with good behavior. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਥਾਹ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too athaahu mohi thaah naahi ||
english: You are Unfathomable; I cannot know Your depth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਉ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh deenaa naath dukh kahau kaahi ||
english: O God, Master of the meek, unto whom should I tell my pains?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋਰੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਥਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: moro janam maran dukh aath dheer ||
english: Please rid me of the pains of birth and death, and bless me with peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੁਨ ਰਉ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: sukh saagar gun rau kabeer ||3||5||
english: Kabeer utters the Glorious Praises of God, the Ocean of peace. ||3||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਬਨਜਾਰੇ ਪਾਚ ॥
transliteration: naaik ek banajaare paach ||
english: There is one merchant and five traders.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਰਧ ਪਚੀਸਕ ਸੰਗੁ ਕਾਚ ॥
transliteration: baradh pacheesak sa(n)g kaach ||
english: The twenty-five oxen carry false merchandise.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਬਹੀਆਂ ਦਸ ਗੋਨਿ ਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nau baheeaa(n) das gon aahi ||
english: There are nine poles which hold the ten bags.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਸਨਿ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kasan bahatar laagee taahi ||1||
english: The body is tied by the seventy-two ropes. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਐਸੇ ਬਨਜ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀਨ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: mohi aise banaj siu naheen kaaj ||
english: I don't care at all about such commerce.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਟੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਢੈ ਬਿਆਜੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih ghatai mool nit badhai biaaj || rahaau ||
english: It depletes my capital, and the interest charges only increase. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਨਜੁ ਕੀਨ ॥
transliteration: saat soot mil banaj keen ||
english: Weaving the seven threads together, they carry on their trade.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨ ॥
transliteration: karam bhaavanee sa(n)g leen ||
english: They are led on by the karma of their past actions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਕਰਤ ਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: teen jagaatee karat raar ||
english: The three tax-collectors argue with them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਲੋ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਝਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chalo banajaaraa haath jhaar ||2||
english: The traders depart empty-handed. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ਬਨਜੁ ਟੂਟ ॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee hiraanee banaj toot ||
english: Their capital is exhausted, and their trade is ruined.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਟਾਂਡੋ ਗਇਓ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
transliteration: dah dis taa(n)do gaio phoot ||
english: The caravan is scattered in the ten directions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer man sarasee kaaj ||
english: Says Kabeer, O mortal, your tasks will be accomplished,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਤ ਭਰਮ ਭਾਜ ॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: sahaj samaano ta bharam bhaaj ||3||6||
english: when you merge in the Celestial Lord; let your doubts run away. ||3||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t hi(n)dol ghar 2 ||
english: Basant Hindol, Second House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: maataa joothee pitaa bhee joothaa joothe hee phal laage ||
english: The mother is impure, and the father is impure. The fruit they produce is impure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜੂਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavahi joothe jaahi bhee joothe joothe marahi abhaage ||1||
english: Impure they come, and impure they go. The unfortunate ones die in impurity. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kahu pa(n)dit soochaa kavan thaau ||
english: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar, which place is uncontaminated?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਬੈਸਿ ਹਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jahaa(n) bais hau bhojan khaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Where should I sit to eat my meal? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੋਲਤ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਠੇ ॥
transliteration: jihabaa joothee bolat joothaa karan netr sabh joothe ||
english: The tongue is impure, and its speech is impure. The eyes and ears are totally impure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੇ ਲੂਠੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: i(n)dree kee jooth utaras naahee braham agan ke loothe ||2||
english: The impurity of the sexual organs does not depart; the Brahmin is burnt by the fire. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਾਨੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agan bhee joothee paanee joothaa joothee bais pakaaiaa ||
english: The fire is impure, and the water is impure. The place where you sit and cook is impure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠੀ ਕਰਛੀ ਪਰੋਸਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: joothee karachhee parosan laagaa joothe hee baith khaaiaa ||3||
english: Impure is the ladle which serves the food. Impure is the one who sits down to eat it. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਰੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gobar joothaa chaukaa joothaa joothee deenee kaaraa ||
english: Impure is the cow dung, and impure is the kitchen square. Impure are the lines that mark it off.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer teee nar sooche saachee paree bichaaraa ||4||1||7||
english: Says Kabeer, they alone are pure, who have obtained pure understanding. ||4||1||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamaana(n)d jee ghar 1 ||
english: Raamaanand Jee, First House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kat jaaeeai re ghar laago ra(n)g ||
english: Where should I go? My home is filled with bliss.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa chit na chalai man bhaio pa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My consciousness does not go out wandering. My mind has become crippled. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਮਨ ਭਈ ਉਮੰਗ ॥
transliteration: ek divas man bhaee uma(n)g ||
english: One day, a desire welled up in my mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ॥
transliteration: ghas cha(n)dan choaa bahu suga(n)dh ||
english: I ground up sandalwood, along with several fragrant oils.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poojan chaalee braham thaai ||
english: I went to God's place, and worshipped Him there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so braham bataaio gur man hee maahi ||1||
english: That God showed me the Guru, within my own mind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਜਲ ਪਖਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jahaa jaaeeai tah jal pakhaan ||
english: Wherever I go, I find water and stones.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: too poor rahio hai sabh samaan ||
english: You are totally pervading and permeating in all.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan sabh dekhe joi ||
english: I have searched through all the Vedas and the Puraanas.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਈਹਾਂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oohaa(n) tau jaaeeai jau eehaa(n) na hoi ||2||
english: I would go there, only if the Lord were not here. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤੋਰ ॥
transliteration: satigur mai balihaaree tor ||
english: I am a sacrifice to You, O my True Guru.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: jin sakal bikal bhram kaate mor ||
english: You have cut through all my confusion and doubt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
transliteration: raamaana(n)d suaamee ramat braham ||
english: Raamaanand's Lord and Master is the All-pervading Lord God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad kaatai kot karam ||3||1||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad eradicates the karma of millions of past actions. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t baanee naamadeu jee kee ||
english: Basant, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਕਟਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saahib sa(n)katavai sevak bhajai ||
english: If the servant runs away when his master is in trouble,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੋਊ ਕੁਲ ਲਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chira(n)kaal na jeevai dooo kul lajai ||1||
english: he will not have a long life, and he brings shame to all his family. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat na chhodau bhaavai log hasai ||
english: I shall not abandon devotional worship of You, O Lord, even if the people laugh at me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਬਸੈਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal mere heeare basai(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਰਨੁ ਮਾਂਡੈ ॥
transliteration: jaise apane dhanahi praanee maran maa(n)dai ||
english: The mortal will even die for the sake of his wealth;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛਾਡੈਂ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taise sa(n)t janaa(n) raam naam na chhaadai(n) ||2||
english: in the same way, the Saints do not forsake the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa gaiaa godaavaree sa(n)saar ke kaamaa ||
english: Pilgrimages to the Ganges, the Gaya and the Godawari are merely worldly affairs.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: naaraain suprasa(n)n hoi ta sevak naamaa ||3||1||
english: If the Lord were totally pleased, then He would let Naam Dayv be His servant. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਝਰ ਬਾਜੈ ॥ ਕਾਇਆ ਡੂਬੈ ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lobh lahar at neejhar baajai || kaaiaa doobai kesavaa ||1||
english: The tidal waves of greed constantly assault me. My body is drowning, O Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੇ ਤਾਰਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar samu(n)de taar goubi(n)de || taar lai baap beethulaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please carry me across the world-ocean, O Lord of the Universe. Carry me across, O Beloved Father. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਲ ਬੇੜਾ ਹਉ ਖੇਵਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ॥ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anil beRaa hau khev na saakau || teraa paar na paaiaa beethulaa ||2||
english: I cannot steer my ship in this storm. I cannot find the other shore, O Beloved Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂ ਮੋ ਕਉ ॥ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal satigur mel too mo kau || paar utaare kesavaa ||3||
english: Please be merciful, and unite me with the True Guru; Carry me across, O Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਹਉ ਤਰਿ ਭੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naamaa kahai hau tar bhee na jaanau || mo kau baah dehi baah dehi beethulaa ||4||2||
english: Says Naam Dayv, I do not know how to swim. Give me Your Arm, give me Your Arm, O Beloved Lord. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਵਲਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਣੀ ਗਾਡੀ ਚਾਲਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj aval dhooR manee gaadee chaalatee ||
english: Slowly at first, the body-cart loaded with dust starts to move.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪੀਛੈ ਤਿਨਕਾ ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂਕਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: peechhai tinakaa lai kar haa(n)katee ||1||
english: Later, it is driven on by the stick. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਨਕਤ ਥ੍ਰੂਟਿਟਿ ਹਾਂਕਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jaise panakat throotit haa(n)katee ||
english: The body moves along like the ball of dung, driven on by the dung-beetle.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਿ ਧੋਵਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਲਾਡੁਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sar dhovan chaalee laadulee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The beloved soul goes down to the pool to wash itself clean. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਧੋਬੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dhobee dhovai birah biraataa ||
english: The washerman washes, imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har charan meraa man raataa ||2||
english: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਰਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naamadeu ram rahiaa ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are All-pervading.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਰ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: apane bhagat par kar daiaa ||3||3||
english: Please be kind to Your devotee. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t baanee ravidaas jee kee ||
english: Basant, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸੁਝੰਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tujhahi sujha(n)taa kachhoo naahi ||
english: You know nothing.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਾਵਾ ਦੇਖੇ ਊਭਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pahiraavaa dekhe oobh jaahi ||
english: Seeing your clothes, you are so proud of yourself.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਵਤੀ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: garabavatee kaa naahee thaau ||
english: The proud bride shall not find a place with the Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਵੈ ਕਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teree garadan oopar lavai kaau ||1||
english: Above your head, the crow of death is cawing. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਾਂਇ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਬਾਵਲੀ ॥
transliteration: too kaa(n)i garabahi baavalee ||
english: Why are you so proud? You are insane.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਭਾਦਉ ਖੂੰਬਰਾਜੁ ਤੂ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਖਰੀ ਉਤਾਵਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise bhaadau khoo(n)baraaj too tis te kharee utaavalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even the mushrooms of summer live longer than you. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jaise kura(n)k nahee paaio bhed ||
english: The deer does not know the secret;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਢੂਢੈ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tan suga(n)dh dhoodhai prades ||
english: the musk is within its own body, but it searches for it outside.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਪ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ap tan kaa jo kare beechaar ||
english: Whoever reflects on his own body

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis nahee jamaka(n)kar kare khuaar ||2||
english: - the Messenger of Death does not abuse him. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr kaa karahi aha(n)kaar ||
english: The man is so proud of his sons and his wife;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਗਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: thaakur lekhaa maganahaar ||
english: his Lord and Master shall call for his account.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਫੇੜੇ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pheRe kaa dukh sahai jeeu ||
english: The soul suffers in pain for the actions it has committed.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paachhe kisahi pukaarahi peeu peeu ||3||
english: Afterwards, whom shall you call, "Dear, Dear." ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਜਉ ਲੇਹਿ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kee jau lehi ot ||
english: If you seek the Support of the Holy,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: tere mitahi paap sabh kot kot ||
english: millions upon millions of your sins shall be totally erased.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੋੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas jou japai naam ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, one who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: tis jaat na janam na jon kaam ||4||1||
english: is not concerned with social class, birth and rebirth. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t kabeer jeeu ||
english: Basant, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਹ ਕੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ॥
transliteration: surah kee jaisee teree chaal ||
english: You walk like a cow.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਛਟ ਊਪਰਿ ਝਮਕ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teree poo(n)chhat oopar jhamak baal ||1||
english: The hair on your tail is shiny and lustrous. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਤੂ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: is ghar mahi hai s too dhoo(n)dh khaahi ||
english: Look around, and eat anything in this house.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਮਤਿ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aur kis hee ke too mat hee jaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But do not go out to any other. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕੀ ਚਾਟਹਿ ਚੂਨੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: chaakee chaatahi choon khaahi ||
english: You lick the grinding bowl, and eat the flour.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕੀ ਕਾ ਚੀਥਰਾ ਕਹਾਂ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaakee kaa cheetharaa kahaa(n) lai jaahi ||2||
english: Where have you taken the kitchen rags? ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਛੀਕੇ ਪਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਡੀਠਿ ॥
transliteration: chheeke par teree bahut deeth ||
english: Your gaze is fixed on the basket in the cupboard.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਲਕਰੀ ਸੋਟਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰੈ ਪੀਠਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mat lakaree sotaa teree parai peeth ||3||
english: Watch out - a stick may strike you from behind. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੋਗ ਭਲੇ ਕੀਨ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer bhog bhale keen ||
english: Says Kabeer, you have over-indulged in your pleasures.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਰੈ ਈਂਟ ਢੇਮ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: mat kooo maarai ee(n)t dhem ||4||1||
english: Watch out - someone may throw a brick at you. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰਗ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag saarag chaupade mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Saarang, Chau-Padhay, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: apune thaakur kee hau cheree ||
english: I am the hand-maiden of my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan gahe jagajeevan prabh ke haumai maar niberee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have grasped the Feet of God, the Life of the world. He has killed and eradicated my egotism. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pooran param jot paramesar preetam praan hamaare ||
english: He is the Perfect, Supreme Light, the Supreme Lord God, my Beloved, my Breath of Life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohan mohi leeaa man meraa samajhas sabad beechaare ||1||
english: The Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind; contemplating the Word of the Shabad, I have come to understand. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਨ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh heen hochhee mat jhoothee man tan peer sareere ||
english: The worthless self-willed manmukh, with false and shallow understanding - his mind and body are held in pain's grip.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੀਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jab kee raam ra(n)geelai raatee raam japat man dheere ||2||
english: Since I came to be imbued with the Love of my Beautiful Lord, I meditate on the Lord, and my mind is encouraged. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: haumai chhod bhaee bairaagan tab saachee surat samaanee ||
english: Abandoning egotism, I have become detached. And now, I absorb true intuitive understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਲੋੁਕਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: akul nira(n)jan siu man maaniaa bisaree laaj loukaanee ||3||
english: The mind is pleased and appeased by the Pure, Immaculate Lord; the opinions of other people are irrelevant. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਰ ਭਵਿਖ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhoor bhavikh naahee tum jaise mere preetam praan adhaaraa ||
english: There is no other like You, in the past or in the future, O my Beloved, my Breath of Life, my Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: har kai naam ratee sohaagan naanak raam bhataaraa ||4||1||
english: The soul-bride is imbued with the Name of the Lord; O Nanak, the Lord is her Husband. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Saarang, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har bin kiu raheeai dukh biaapai ||
english: How can I survive without the Lord? I am suffering in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਫੀਕੀ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa saad na pheekee ras bin bin prabh kaal sa(n)taapai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My tongue does not taste - all is bland without the Lord's sublime essence. Without God, I suffer and die. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jab lag daras na parasai preetam tab lag bhookh piaasee ||
english: As long as I do not attain the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, I remain hungry and thirsty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜਲ ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan dekhat hee man maaniaa jal ras kamal bigaasee ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is pleased and appeased. The lotus blossoms forth in the water. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਨਵਿ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਗਰਜੈ ਬਰਸੈ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਮੋਰ ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: oonav ghanahar garajai barasai kokil mor bairaagai ||
english: The low-hanging clouds crack with thunder and burst. The cuckoos and the peacocks are filled with passion,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਘਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taravar birakh biha(n)g bhuia(n)gam ghar pir dhan sohaagai ||2||
english: along with the birds in the trees, the bulls and the snakes. The soul-bride is happy when her Husband Lord returns home. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ਕੁਲਖਨੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kuchil kuroop kunaar kulakhanee pir kaa sahaj na jaaniaa ||
english: She is filthy and ugly, unfeminine and ill-mannered - she has no intuitive understanding of her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਨ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ras ra(n)g rasan nahee tripatee duramat dookh samaaniaa ||3||
english: She is not satisfied by the sublime essence of her Lord's Love; she is evil-minded, immersed in her pain. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aai na jaavai naa dukh paavai naa dukh darad sareere ||
english: The soul-bride does not come and go in reincarnation or suffer in pain; her body is not touched by the pain of disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak prabh te sahaj suhelee prabh dekhat hee man dheere ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, she is intuitively embellished by God; seeing God, her mind is encouraged. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Saarang, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: door naahee mero prabh piaaraa ||
english: My Beloved Lord God is not far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur bachan mero man maaniaa har paae praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind is pleased and appeased by the Word of the True Guru's Teachings. I have found the Lord, the Support of my breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: in bidh har mileeai var kaaman dhan sohaag piaaree ||
english: This is the way to meet your Husband Lord. Blessed is the soul-bride who is loved by her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਬਰਨ ਕੁਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaat baran kul sahasaa chookaa guramat sabad beechaaree ||1||
english: Social class and status, race, ancestry and skepticism are eliminated, following the Guru's Teachings and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਿੰਸਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jis man maanai abhimaan na taa kau hi(n)saa lobh visaare ||
english: One whose mind is pleased and appeased, has no egotistical pride. Violence and greed are forgotten.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaj ravai var kaaman pir kee guramukh ra(n)g savaare ||2||
english: The soul-bride intuitively ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; as Gurmukh, she is embellished by His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਰਉ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaarau aisee preet kuta(n)b sanaba(n)dhee maaiaa moh pasaaree ||
english: Burn away any love of family and relatives, which increases your attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis a(n)tar preet raam ras naahee dubidhaa karam bikaaree ||3||
english: One who does not savor the Lord's Love deep within, lives in duality and corruption. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਿਤ ਕੌ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ratan padaarath hit kau durai na laal piaaree ||
english: His Love is a priceless jewel deep within my being; the Lover of my Beloved is not hidden.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam amolak jug jug a(n)tar dhaaree ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, enshrine the Priceless Naam deep within your being, all the ages through. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t janaa kee ham dhoor ||
english: I am the dust of the feet of the humble Saints of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat param pad paaiaa aatam raam rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the supreme status. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sa(n)t milai saa(n)t paaeeai kilavikh dukh kaate sabh door ||
english: Meeting the Saintly True Guru, I have found peace and tranquility. Sins and painful mistakes are totally erased and taken away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਫੂਲਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aatam jot bhaee paraphoolit purakh nira(n)jan dekhiaa hajoor ||1||
english: The Divine Light of the soul radiates forth, gazing upon the Presence of the Immaculate Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag satasa(n)gat paaee har har naam rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the Sat Sangat; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is all-prevading everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਨਾਏ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: athasath teerath majan keeaa satasa(n)gat pag naae dhoor ||2||
english: I have taken my cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, bathing in the dust of the feet of the True Congregation. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਕੁਸੁਧੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: duramat bikaar maleen mat hochhee hiradaa kusudh laagaa moh koor ||
english: Evil-minded and corrupt, filthy-minded and shallow, with impure heart, attached to enticement and falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin karamaa kiu sa(n)gat paaeeai haumai biaap rahiaa man jhoor ||3||
english: Without good karma, how can I find the Sangat? Engrossed in egotism, the mortal remains stuck in regret. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਾਗਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal kripaa kar har jee maagau satasa(n)gat pag dhoor ||
english: Be kind and show Your Mercy, O Dear Lord; I beg for the dust of the feet of the Sat Sangat.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t milai har paaeeai jan har bhetiaa raam hajoor ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, meeting with the Saints, the Lord is attained. The Lord's humble servant obtains the Presence of the Lord. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d charanan kau balihaaree ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਰਣਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal jagat na jaaee taranaa jap har har paar utaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot swim across the terrifying world ocean. But chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am carried across across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hiradai prateet banee prabh keree sevaa surat beechaaree ||
english: Faith in God came to fill my heart; I serve Him intuitively, and contemplate Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin raam naam jap hiradai sarab kalaa gunakaaree ||1||
english: Night and day, I chant the Lord's Name within my heart; it is all-powerful and virtuous. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh agam agochar raviaa srab thaaee man tan alakh apaaree ||
english: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, All-pervading everywhere, in all minds and bodies; He is Infinite and Invisible.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaal bhae tab paaiaa hiradai alakh lakhaaree ||2||
english: When the Guru bebomes merciful, then the Unseen Lord is seen within the heart. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar har naam sarab dharaneedhar saakat kau door bhaiaa aha(n)kaaree ||
english: Deep within the inner being is the Name of the Lord, the Support of the entire earth, but to the egotistical shaakta, the faithless cynic, He seems far away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: trisanaa jalat na kabahoo boojhahi jooai baajee haaree ||3||
english: His burning desire is never quenched, and he loses the game of life in the gamble. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat har gun gaavahi gur ki(n)chat kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: Standing up and sitting down, the mortal sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, when the Guru bestows even a tiny bit of His Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jin kau nadar bhaee hai tin kee paij savaaree ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are blessed by His Glance of Grace - He saves and protects their honor. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har a(n)mrit naam dehu piaare ||
english: O my Beloved Lord, Har, Har, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin oopar guramukh man maaniaa tin ke kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those whose minds are pleased to be Gurmukh - the Lord completes their projects. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo jan deen bhae gur aagai tin ke dookh nivaare ||
english: Those humble beings who become meek before the Guru-their pains are taken away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi gur aagai gur kai sabad savaare ||1||
english: Night and day, they perform devotional worship services to the Guru; they are embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam a(n)mrit ras rasanaa ras gaavahi ras beechaare ||
english: Within their hearts is the ambrosial essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they savor this essence, sing the praises of this essence, and contemplate this essence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਓਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaad a(n)mrit ras cheenhiaa oi paavahi mokh duaare ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are aware of this ambrosial essence; they find the Gate of Salvation. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਅਚਲਾ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh achal achalaa mat jis driRataa naam adhaare ||
english: The True is the Primal Being, Unmoving and Unchanging. One who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord - his intellect becomes focused and steady.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਵਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis aagai jeeu devau apunaa hau satigur kai balihaare ||3||
english: I offer my soul to Him; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhram doojai bhaai laage a(n)tar agiaan gubaare ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are stuck in doubt and attached to duality; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is within them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur daataa nadar na aavai naa uravaar na paare ||4||
english: They do not see the True Guru, the Giver; they are not on this shore, or the other. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sarabe ghat ghat raviaa suaamee sarab kalaa kal dhaare ||
english: Our Lord and Master is permeating and pervading each and every heart; He is supremely Potent to exercise His Might.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੫॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak daasan daas kahat hai kar kirapaa lehu ubaare ||5||3||
english: Nanak, the slave of His slaves, says, please, be merciful and save me! ||5||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gobid kee aisee kaar kamaai ||
english: This is the way to work for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s sat kar maanahu guramukh naam rahahu liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever He does, accept that as true. As Gurmukh, remain lovingly absorbed in His Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਅਵਰ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gobid preet lagee at meethee avar visar sabh jaai ||
english: The Love of the Lord of the Universe seems supremely sweet. Everything else is forgotten.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin rahas bhaiaa man maaniaa jotee jot milaai ||1||
english: Night and day, he is in ecstasy; his mind is pleased and appeased, and his light merges into the Light. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jab gun gaai tab hee man tripatai saa(n)t vasai man aai ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, his mind is satisfied. Peace and tranquility come to abide within his mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
