transliteration: gur kirapaal bhae tab paaiaa har charanee chit laai ||2||
english: When the Guru becomes merciful, the mortal finds the Lord; he focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mat pragaas bhaee har dhiaaiaa giaan tat liv laai ||
english: The intellect is enlightened, meditating on the Lord. He remains lovingly attuned to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot pragatee man maaniaa har sahaj samaadh lagaai ||3||
english: The Divine Light radiates forth deep within his being; his mind is pleased and appeased. He merges intuitively into Celestial Samaadhi. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hiradai kapat nit kapat kamaavahi mukhahu har har sunaai ||
english: One whose heart is filled with falsehood, continues to practice falsehood, even while he teaches and preaches about the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਤੁਹ ਕੂਟੈ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa tuh kootai dukh khaai ||4||
english: Within him is the utter darkness of greed. He is thrashed like wheat, and suffers in pain. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jab suprasa(n)n bhae prabh mere guramukh parachaa laai ||
english: When my God is totally pleased, the mortal tunes in and becomes Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam nira(n)jan paaiaa naam japat sukh paai ||5||4||
english: Nanak has obtained the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, he has found peace. ||5||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: meraa man raam naam man maanee ||
english: My mind is pleased and appeased by the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: merai heearai satigur preet lagaaee man har har kathaa sukhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has implanted divine love within my heart. The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal hovahu jan oopar jan devahu akath kahaanee ||
english: Please be merciful to Your meek and humble servant; please bless Your humble servant with Your Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil har ras paaiaa har man tan meeth lagaanee ||1||
english: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found the sublime essence of the Lord. The Lord seems so sweet to my mind and body. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har kai ra(n)g rate bairaagee jinh guramat naam pachhaanee ||
english: They alone are unattached, who are imbued with the Lord's Love; through the Guru's Teachings, they realize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: purakhai purakh miliaa sukh paaiaa sabh chookee aavan jaanee ||2||
english: Meeting with the Primal Being, one finds peace, and one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣੀ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: nainee birahu dekhaa prabh suaamee rasanaa naam vakhaanee ||
english: With my eyes, I gaze lovingly upon God, my Lord and Master. I chant His Name with my tongue.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sravanee keeratan sunau din raatee hiradai har har bhaanee ||3||
english: With my ears, I listen to the Kirtan of His Praises, day and night. I love the Lord, Har, Har, with all my heart. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਣੇ ਤਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa gur vasagat aane tau unaman naam lagaanee ||
english: When the Guru helped me to overcome the five thieves, then I found ultimate bliss, attached to the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree har raamai naam samaanee ||4||5||
english: The Lord has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; he merges in the Lord, in the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜ੍ਹੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam paRhu saar ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and study His Excellence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin thir nahee koee hor nihaphal sabh bisathaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is steady or stable. All the rest of the show is useless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਜੀਐ ਬਉਰੇ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa leejai kiaa tajeeai baure jo deesai so chhaar ||
english: What is there to accept, and what is there to reject, O madman? Whatever is seen shall turn to dust.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਸਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis bikhiaa kau tumh apunee kar jaanahu saa chhaad jaahu sir bhaar ||1||
english: That poison which you believe to be your own - you must abandon it and leave it behind. What a load you have to carry on your head! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਅਉਧ ਫੁਨਿ ਘਾਟੈ ਬੂਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: til til pal pal audh phun ghaatai boojh na sakai gavaar ||
english: Moment by moment, instant by instant, your life is running out. The fool cannot understand this.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so kichh karai j saath na chaalai ihu saakat kaa aachaar ||2||
english: He does things which will not go along with him in the end. This is the lifestyle of the faithless cynic. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਤਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g mil baure tau paavahi mokh duaar ||
english: So join together with the humble Saints, O madman, and you shall find the Gate of Salvation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin satasa(n)g sukh kinai na paaiaa jaai poochhahu bed beechaar ||3||
english: Without the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, no one finds any peace. Go and ask the scholars of the Vedas. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਸਭੈ ਕੋਊ ਚਾਲੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raanaa raau sabhai kooo chaalai jhooth chhod jaai paasaar ||
english: All the kings and queens shall depart; they must leave this false expanse.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t sadaa thir nihachal jin raam naam aadhaar ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, the Saints are eternally steady and stable; they take the Support of the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦਾ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ghar 3 dupadaa ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਪੂਤ ਝਗਰਤ ਹਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਪ ॥
transliteration: kaahe poot jhagarat hau sa(n)g baap ||
english: O son, why do you argue with your father?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਣੇ ਬਡੀਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਝਗਰਤ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin ke jane badeere tum hau tin siu jhagarat paap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is a sin to argue with the one who fathered you and raised you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਤੁਮ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਉ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: jis dhan kaa tum garab karat hau so dhan kisahi na aap ||
english: That wealth, which you are so proud of - that wealth does not belong to anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin mahi chhod jaai bikhiaa ras tau laagai pachhutaap ||1||
english: In an instant, you shall have to leave behind all your corrupt pleasures; you shall be left to regret and repent. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾਪ ॥
transliteration: jo tumare prabh hote suaamee har tin ke jaapahu jaap ||
english: He is God, your Lord and Master - chant the Chant of that Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਜਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: upades karat naanak jan tum kau jau sunahu tau jaai sa(n)taap ||2||1||7||
english: Servant Nanak spreads the Teachings; if you listen to it, you shall be rid of your pain. ||2||1||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ghar 5 dupade paRataal ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay, Partaal:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੋ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap man jaga(n)naath jagadeesaro jagajeevano manamohan siu preet laagee mai har har har tek sabh dinas sabh raat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, the Life of the World, the Enticer of the mind; fall in love with Him. I take the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, all day and all night. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਨਿਨ ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har kee upamaa anik anik anik gun gaavat suk naarad brahamaadik tav gun suaamee ganin na jaat ||
english: Endless, endless, endless are the Praises of the Lord. Suk Dayv, Naarad and the gods like Brahma sing His Glorious Praises. Your Glorious Virtues, O my Lord and Master, cannot even be counted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too har bea(n)t too har bea(n)t too har suaamee too aape hee jaanahi aapanee bhaa(n)t ||1||
english: O Lord, You are Infinite, O Lord, You are Infinite, O Lord, You are my Lord and Master; only You Yourself know Your Own Ways. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟ ਹੀ ਬਸਤੇ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਾਤ ॥
transliteration: har kai nikat nikat har nikat hee basate te har ke jan saadhoo har bhagaat ||
english: Those who are near, near to the Lord - those who dwell near the Lord - those humble servants of the Lord are the Holy, the devotees of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: te har ke jan har siu ral mile jaise jan naanak salalai salal milaat ||2||1||8||
english: Those humble servants of the Lord merge with their Lord, O Nanak, like water merging with water. ||2||1||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਨਰਹਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap man narahare narahar suaamee har sagal dev devaa sree raam raam naamaa har preetam moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your Lord and Master. The Lord is the Most Divine of all the divine beings. Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the Lord, my most Dear Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jit grihi gun gaavate har ke gun gaavate raam gun gaavate tit grihi vaaje pa(n)ch sabad vad bhaag mathoraa ||
english: That household, in which the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung, where the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, resound - great is the destiny written on the forehead of one who lives in such a household.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਗਏ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tinh jan ke sabh paap gae sabh dokh gae sabh rog gae kaam krodh lobh mohu abhimaan gae tinh jan ke har maar kadhe pa(n)ch choraa ||1||
english: All the sins of that humble being are taken away, all pains are taken away, all diseases are taken away; sexual desire, anger, greed, attachment and egotistical pride are taken away. The Lord drives the five thieves out of such a person of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ॥
transliteration: har raam bolahu har saadhoo har ke jan saadhoo jagadees japahu man bachan karam har har aaraadhoo har ke jan saadhoo ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O Holy Saints of the Lord; meditate on the Lord of the Universe, O Holy people of the Lord. Meditate in thought, word and deed on the Lord, Har, Har. Worship and adore the Lord, O Holy people of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਧੂ ॥
transliteration: har raam bol har raam bol sabh paap gavaadhoo ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, chant the Name of the Lord. It shall rid you of all your sins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਗਰਣੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੋੁਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nit nit jaagaran karahu sadaa sadaa aana(n)d jap jagadeesouraa ||
english: Continually and continuously remain awake and aware. You shall be in ecstasy forever and ever, meditating on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਭੈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: man ichhe phal paavahu sabhai phal paavahu dharam arath kaam mokh jan naanak har siu mile har bhagat toraa ||2||2||9||
english: Servant Nanak: O Lord, Your devotees obtain the fruits of their minds' desires; they obtain all the fruits and rewards, and the four great blessings - Dharmic faith, wealth and riches, fulfilment of desires and liberation. ||2||2||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੋ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jap man maadho madhusoodano har sreera(n)go paramesaro sat paramesaro prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of Wealth, the Source of Nectar, the Supreme Lord God, the True Transcendent Being, God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੂਖਨ ਕੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੂਖਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਓੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh dookhan ko ha(n)taa sabh sookhan ko daataa har preetam gun gaaou ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Destroyer of all suffering, the Giver of all peace; sing the Praises of my Beloved Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਾਨੰਤਰਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਚਾਓੁ ॥
transliteration: har ghat ghate ghat basataa har jal thale har basataa har thaan thaana(n)tar basataa mai har dekhan ko chaaou ||
english: The Lord dwells in the home of each and every heart. The Lord dwells in the water, and the Lord dwells on the land. The Lord dwells in the spaces and interspaces. I have such a great longing to see the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਵੈ ਸੰਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੰਤੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਨੁ ਸੰਤੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: koee aavai sa(n)to har kaa jan sa(n)to meraa preetam jan sa(n)to mohi maarag dikhalaavai ||
english: If only some Saint, some humble Saint of the Lord, my Holy Beloved, would come, to show me the way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਾਓੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis jan ke hau mal mal dhovaa paaou ||1||
english: I would wash and massage the feet of that humble being. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har jan kau har miliaa har saradhaa te miliaa guramukh har miliaa ||
english: The Lord's humble servant meets the Lord, through his faith in the Lord; meeting the Lord, he becomes Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਓੁ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan aana(n)d bhae mai dekhiaa har raaou ||
english: My mind and body are in ecstasy; I have seen my Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau kirapaa bhaee har kee kirapaa bhaee jagadeesur kirapaa bhaee ||
english: Servant Nanak has been blessed with Grace, blessed with the Lord's Grace, blessed with the Grace of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਓੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੦॥
transliteration: mai anadino sad sad sadaa har japiaa har naaou ||2||3||10||
english: I meditate on the Lord, the Name of the Lord, night and day, forever, forever and ever. ||2||3||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ॥
transliteration: jap man nirabhau ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Fearless Lord,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sat sat sadaa sat ||
english: who is True, True, Forever True.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: niravair akaal moorat ||
english: He is free of vengeance, the Image of the Undying,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ॥
transliteration: aajoonee sa(n)bhau ||
english: beyond birth, Self-existent.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੋੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere man anadinou dhiaai nira(n)kaar niraahaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my mind, meditate night and day on the Formless, Self-sustaining Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਪਰਭਵਨ ਕਰਤ ਰਹਤ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har darasan kau har darasan kau kot kot tetees sidh jatee jogee tat teerath parabhavan karat rahat niraahaaree ||
english: For the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, the three hundred thirty million gods, and millions of Siddhas, celibates and Yogis make their pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, and go on fasts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਹੋਵਤੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin jan kee sevaa thaai paee jinh kau kirapaal hovat banavaaree ||1||
english: The service of the humble person is approved, unto whom the Lord of the World shows His Mercy. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke ho sa(n)t bhale te ootam bhagat bhale jo bhaavat har raam muraaree ||
english: They alone are the good Saints of the Lord, the best and most exalted devotees, who are pleasing to their Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jinh kaa a(n)g karai meraa suaamee tinh kee naanak har paij savaaree ||2||4||11||
english: Those who have my Lord and Master on their side - O Nanak, the Lord saves their honor. ||2||4||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 paRataal ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl, Partaal:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap man govi(n)d har govi(n)d gunee nidhaan sabh srisat kaa prabho mere man har bol har purakh abinaasee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Virtue, the God of all creation. O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable, Primal Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਸੋ ਪੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam a(n)mrit har har hare so peeai jis raam piaasee ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar, Har, Har, Har. He alone drinks it in, whom the Lord inspires to drink it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aap daiaal daiaa kar melai jis satiguroo so jan har har a(n)mrit naam chakhaasee ||1||
english: The Merciful Lord Himself bestows His Mercy, and He leads the mortal to meet with the True Guru. That humble being tastes the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jo jan sevahi sad sadaa meraa har hare tin kaa sabh dookh bharam bhau jaasee ||
english: Those who serve my Lord, forever and ever - all their pain, doubt and fear are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਪੀਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam lae taa(n) jeevai jiu chaatrik jal peeai tripataasee ||2||5||12||
english: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and so he lives, like the song-bird, which is satisfied only by drinking in the water. ||2||5||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਸਿਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jap man siree raam ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Supreme Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: raam ramat raam ||
english: The Lord, the Lord is All-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sat sat raam ||
english: True, True is the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਸਦ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bolahu bhaeeaa sad raam raam raam rav rahiaa sarabage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, forever. He is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਜਗੇ ॥
transliteration: raam aape aap aape sabh karataa raam aape aap aap sabhat jage ||
english: The Lord Himself is Himself the Creator of all. The Lord Himself is Himself pervading the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis aap kripaa kare meraa raam raam raam raai so jan raam naam liv laage ||1||
english: That person, upon whom my Sovereign Lord King, Raam, Raam, Raam, bestows His Mercy - that person is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੋ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਅਗੇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kee upamaa dekhahu har sa(n)tahu jo bhagat janaa(n) kee pat raakhai vich kalijug age ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, behold the Glory of the Name of the Lord; His Name saves the honor of His humble devotees in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਭਗੇ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak kaa a(n)g keeaa merai raam raai dusaman dookh gae sabh bhage ||2||6||13||
english: My Sovereign Lord King has taken servant Nanak's side; his enemies and attackers have all run away. ||2||6||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur moorat kau bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Image of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਂਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar piaas chaatrik jiu jal kee saphal darasan kad paa(n)u ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My inner being is filled with a great thirst, like that of the song-bird for water. When shall I find the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anaathaa ko naath sarab pratipaalak bhagat vachhal har naau ||
english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Cherisher of all. He is the Lover of the devotees of His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kau koi na raakhai praanee tis too dehi asaraau ||1||
english: That mortal, whom no one can protect - You bless him with Your Support, O Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਨਿਗਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਥਾਵਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nidhariaa dhar nigatiaa gat nithaaviaa too thaau ||
english: Support of the unsupported, Saving Grace of the unsaved, Home of the homeless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਂਉ ਤਹਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dah dis jaa(n)u tahaa(n) too sa(n)ge teree keerat karam kamaau ||2||
english: Wherever I go in the ten directions, You are there with me. The only thing I do is sing the Kirtan of Your Praises. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਤੇ ਏਕਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekas te laakh laakh te ekaa teree gat mit kahi na sakaau ||
english: From Your Oneness, You become tens of thousands, and from tens of thousands, You become One. I cannot describe Your state and extent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too bea(n)t teree mit nahee paaeeai sabh tero khel dikhaau ||3||
english: You are Infinite - Your value cannot be appraised. Everything I see is Your play. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhan kaa sa(n)g saadh siu gosat har saadhan siu liv laau ||
english: I speak with the Company of the Holy; I am in love with the Holy people of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak paaiaa hai guramat har dehu daras man chaau ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak has found the Lord through the Guru's Teachings; please bless me with Your Blessed Vision; O Lord, my mind yearns for it. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
english: The Dear Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ ਛਪਾਈ ਸਾਖੀ ਭੂਤ ਪਵਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karat buraaee maanukh te chhapaaee saakhee bhoot pavaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The mortal does evil deeds, and hides from others, but like the air, the Lord is present everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਨੌ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਖਟ ਕਰਮਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਜੂਠਾਨ ॥
transliteration: baisanau naam karat khat karamaa a(n)tar lobh joothaan ||
english: You call yourself a devotee of Vishnu and you practice the six rituals, but your inner being is polluted with greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਭ ਅਗਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa kee ni(n)daa karate doobe sabh agiaan ||1||
english: Those who slander the Society of the Saints, shall all be drowned in their ignorance. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਮ ਪਾਕੁ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਝੂਠ ਗੁਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: karahi som paak hirahi par darabaa a(n)tar jhooth gumaan ||
english: The mortal eats the food which he has carefully prepared, and then steals the wealth of others. His inner being is filled with falsehood and pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saasatr bed kee bidh nahee jaanahi biaape man kai maan ||2||
english: He knows nothing of the Vedas or the Shaastras; his mind is gripped by pride. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਾਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਸਫਰੀ ਦੰਫਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)dhiaa kaal karahi sabh varataa jiu sapharee da(n)phaan ||
english: He says his evening prayers, and observes all the fasts, but this is all just a show.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਊਝੜਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮਾਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabhoo bhulaae oojhaR paae nihaphal sabh karamaan ||3||
english: God made him stray from the path, and sent him into the wilderness. All his actions are useless. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੌ ਪੜੑਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: so giaanee so baisanau paRhiaa jis karee kripaa bhagavaan ||
english: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is a devotee of Vishnu and a scholar, whom the Lord God blesses with His Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓੁਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਨ ॥੪॥
transliteration: oun satigur sev param pad paaiaa udhariaa sagal bisvaan ||4||
english: Serving the True Guru, he obtains the supreme status and saves the whole world. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਥਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੋੁਲਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ham kathah kichh kath nahee jaanah prabh bhaavai tivai boulaan ||
english: What can I say? I don't know what to say. As God wills, so do I speak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਇਕ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਓ ਸਰਾਨ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kee dhoor ik maa(n)gau jan naanak paio saraan ||5||2||
english: I ask only for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Servant Nanak seeks their Sanctuary. ||5||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਨਾਚਨੋ ਰਹੋ ॥
transliteration: ab moro naachano raho ||
english: Now, my dancing is over.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਰਗੀਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਲਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laal rageelaa sahaje paaio satigur bachan laho ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have intuitively obtained my Darling Beloved. Through the Word of the True Guru's Teachings, I found Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਆਰ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਉਪਹਾਸ ਕਹੋ ॥
transliteration: kuaar ka(n)niaa jaise sa(n)g saheree pri bachan upahaas kaho ||
english: The virgin speaks with her friends about her husband and they laugh together;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਤਬ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਜਿ ਲਜੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau surijan grih bheetar aaio tab mukh kaaj lajo ||1||
english: but when he comes home, she becomes shy, and modestly covers her face. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਨਿਕੋ ਕੋਠਾਰੀ ਚੜਿਓ ਕਬਰੋ ਹੋਤ ਫਿਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jiu kaniko kothaaree chaRio kabaro hot phiro ||
english: When gold is melted in the crucible, it flows freely everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਧ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਬਾਰਹਿ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਿਰੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jab te sudh bhae hai baarahi tab te thaan thiro ||2||
english: But when it is made into pure solid bars of gold, then it remains stationary. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਤਊ ਲਉ ਬਜਿਓ ਮੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ ਪਲੋ ॥
transliteration: jau din rain taoo lau bajio moorat gharee palo ||
english: As long as the days and the nights of one's life last, the clock strikes the hours, minutes and seconds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰਿਓ ਤਬ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਜੁ ਨ ਭਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bajaavanahaaro ooth sidhaario tab phir baaj na bhaio ||3||
english: But when the gong player gets up and leaves, the gong is not sounded again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁੰਭ ਉਦਕ ਪੂਰਿ ਆਨਿਓ ਤਬ ਓੁਹੁ ਭਿੰਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੋ ॥
transliteration: jaise ku(n)bh udak poor aanio tab ouhu bhi(n)n drisato ||
english: When the pitcher is filled with water, the water contained within it seems distinct.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਜਲੈ ਮਹਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭ ਮਿਲੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ku(n)bh jalai mahi daario a(n)bhai a(n)bh milo ||4||3||
english: Says Nanak, when the pitcher is emptied out, the water mingles again with water. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ab poochhe kiaa kahaa ||
english: Now if he is asked, what can he say?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੈਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਨੀਕੋ ਬਾਵਰ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਿਉ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laino naam a(n)mrit ras neeko baavar bikh siu gahi rahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He was supposed to have gathered the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, but instead, the mad-man was busy with poison. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਾਤਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲਹਾ ॥
transliteration: dulabh janam chira(n)kaal paaio jaatau kaudee badalahaa ||
english: This human life, so difficult to obtain, was finally obtained after such a long time. He is losing it in exchange for a shell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਥੂਰੀ ਕੋ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਦਿਓ ਕਾਲਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਜਿਵਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaathooree ko gaahak aaio laadio kaalar birakh jivahaa ||1||
english: He came to buy musk, but instead, he has loaded dust and thistle grass. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਲਾਭੁ ਲਾਭਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਠਾਗਉਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਉਲਝਿ ਪਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aaio laabh laabhan kai taaee mohan thaagauree siu ulajh pahaa ||
english: He comes in search of profits, but he is entangled in the enticing illusion of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਬਾਦਰੈ ਲਾਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਦਿ ਲਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaach baadarai laal khoee hai phir ihu ausar kad lahaa ||2||
english: He loses the jewel, in exchange for mere glass. When will he have this blessed opportunity again? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਧ ਏਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਹ ਦਾਸਿ ਭਜਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal paraadh ek gun naahee thaakur chhodah daas bhajahaa ||
english: He is full of sins, and he has not even one redeeming virtue. Forsaking his Lord and Master, he is involved with Maya, God's slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਮਸਟਿ ਜੜਵਤ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਂਨੑਿਹਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aaee masat jaRavat kee niaaee jiu tasakar dar saa(n)nhihaa ||3||
english: And when the final silence comes, like inanimate matter, he is caught like a thief at the door. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰਿ ਰਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aan upaau na kooo soojhai har daasaa saranee par rahaa ||
english: I cannot see any other way out. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜਉ ਸਗਲੇ ਅਉਗਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਧਰਹਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tab hee man chhuteeai jau sagale augan met dharahaa ||4||4||
english: Says Nanak, the mortal is emancipated, only when all his demerits and faults are erased and eradicated. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਧੀਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਰਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: maaee dheer rahee pri bahut biraagio ||
english: O mother, my patience is gone. I am in love with my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਆਨੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t aanoop ra(n)g re tinh siu ruchai na laagio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: There are so many kinds of incomparable pleasures, but I am not interested in any of them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ ਟੇਰਉ ਨਂੀਦ ਪਲਕ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: nis baasur pri pri mukh terau na(n)eed palak nahee jaagio ||
english: Night and day, I utter, "Pri-a, Pri-a - Beloved, Beloved" with my mouth. I cannot sleep, even for an instant; I remain awake and aware.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haar kajar basatr anik seegaar re bin pir sabhai bikh laagio ||1||
english: Necklaces, eye make-up, fancy clothes and decorations - without my Husband Lord, these are all poison to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਦੀਨ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦੇਸਾਂਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: poochhau poochhau deen bhaa(n)t kar kooo kahai pri desaa(n)gio ||
english: I ask and ask, with humility, "Who can tell me which country my Husband Lord lives in?"

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੀਂਓੁ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hee(n)ou de(n)u sabh man tan arapau sees charan par raakhio ||2||
english: I would dedicate my heart to him, I offer my mind and body and everything; I place my head at his feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰਦਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: charan ba(n)danaa amol daasaro de(n)u saadhasa(n)gat aradaagio ||
english: I bow at the feet of the voluntary slave of the Lord; I beg him to bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa mohi prabhoo milaavahu nimakh daras pekhaagio ||3||
english: Show Mercy to me, that I may meet God, and gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan every moment. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: drisat bhaee tab bheetar aaio meraa man anadin seetalaagio ||
english: When He is Kind to me, He comes to dwell within my being. Night and day, my mind is calm and peaceful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਬਾਜਿਓ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ras ma(n)gal gaae sabad anaahad baajio ||4||5||
english: Says Nanak, I sing the Songs of Joy; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad resounds within me. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: maaee sat sat sat har sat sat sat saadhaa ||
english: O mother, True, True True is the Lord, and True, True, True is His Holy Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਹਿਓ ਮੈ ਛੀਕਿ ਗਾਂਠਰੀ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bachan guroo jo poorai kahio mai chheek gaa(n)tharee baadhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Word which the Perfect Guru has spoken, I have tied to my robe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਖਿਅਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਵਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਬੇਨਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: nis baasur nakhiatr binaasee rav saseear benaadhaa ||
english: Night and day, and the stars in the sky shall vanish. The sun and the moon shall vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਜਲ ਪਵਨ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਅਟਲਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gir basudhaa jal pavan jaaigo ik saadh bachan atalaadhaa ||1||
english: The mountains, the earth, the water and the air shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint shall endure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸੇਤ ਬਿਨਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)d binaasee jer binaasee utabhuj set binaadhaa ||
english: Those born of eggs shall pass away, and those born of the womb shall pass away. Those born of the earth and sweat shall pass away as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਖਟਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਨਿਹਚਲਾਧਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaar binaasee khatahi binaasee ik saadh bachan nihachalaadhaa ||2||
english: The four Vedas shall pass away, and the six Shaastras shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is eternal. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾਮ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਾਤਕੁ ਭੀ ਬੇਨਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: raaj binaasee taam binaasee saatak bhee benaadhaa ||
english: Raajas, the quality of energetic activity shall pass away. Taamas, the quality of lethargic darkness shall pass away. Saatvas, the quality of peaceful light shall pass away as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਆਗਾਧਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: drisatimaan hai sagal binaasee ik saadh bachan aagaadhaa ||3||
english: All that is seen shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is beyond destruction. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: aape aap aap hee aape sabh aapan khel dikhaadhaa ||
english: He Himself is Himself by Himself. All that is seen is His play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਹੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: paaio na jaaee kahee bhaa(n)t re prabh naanak gur mil laadhaa ||4||6||
english: He cannot be found by any means. O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, God is found. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਿਬੋ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: merai man baasibo gur gobi(n)d ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, dwells within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਹਾਂ ਨਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jahaa(n) simaran bhaio hai thaakur tahaa(n) nagar sukh aana(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever my Lord and Master is remembered in meditation - that village is filled with peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਬੀਸਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਤਹਾਂ ਦੂਖ ਸਭ ਆਪਦ ॥
transliteration: jahaa(n) beesarai thaakur piaaro tahaa(n) dookh sabh aapad ||
english: Wherever my Beloved Lord and Master is forgotten - all misery and misfortune is there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤਹਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah gun gaai aana(n)d ma(n)gal roop tahaa(n) sadaa sukh sa(n)pad ||1||
english: Where the Praises of my Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss and Joy are sung - eternal peace and wealth are there. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਦਿਆਨਦ ॥
transliteration: jahaa sravan har kathaa na suneeai tah mahaa bhaiaan udiaanad ||
english: Wherever they do not listen to the Stories of the Lord with their ears - the utterly desolate wilderness is there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਹ ਸਘਨ ਬਾਸ ਫਲਾਂਨਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jahaa(n) keeratan saadhasa(n)gat ras tah saghan baas phalaa(n)nad ||2||
english: Where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung with love in the Saadh Sangat - there is fragrance and fruit and joy in abundance. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਰਖ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਅਉਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਨਦ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran kot barakh jeevai sagalee audh brithaanad ||
english: Without meditative remembrance on the Lord, one may live for millions of years, but his life would be totally useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੀਵਾਨਦ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek nimakh gobi(n)d bhajan kar tau sadaa sadaa jeevaanad ||3||
english: But if he vibrates and meditates on the Lord of the Universe, for even a moment, then he shall live forever and ever. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਨਦ ॥
transliteration: saran saran saran prabh paavau deejai saadhasa(n)gat kirapaanad ||
english: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary; please mercifully bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਂਨਦ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak poor rahio hai sarab mai sagal gunaa bidh jaa(n)nad ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, the Lord is All-pervading everywhere, amongst all. He knows the qualities and the condition of all. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਭਰੋਸਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi raam bharosau paae ||
english: Now, I have obtained the Support of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾਨਿਧਿ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo saran pario karunaanidh te te bhavahi taraae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the Ocean of Mercy are carried across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਅਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sukh soio ar sahaj samaaio sahasaa gurahi gavaae ||
english: They sleep in peace, and intuitively merge into the Lord. The Guru takes away their cynicism and doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo chaahat soee har keeo man baa(n)chhat phal paae ||1||
english: Whatever they wish for, the Lord does; they obtain the fruits of their minds' desires. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਉ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hiradai japau netr dhiaan laavau sravanee kathaa sunaae ||
english: In my heart, I meditate on Him; with my eyes, I focus my meditation on Him. With my ears, I listen to His Sermon.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: charanee chalau maarag thaakur kai rasanaa har gun gaae ||2||
english: With my feet, I walk on my Lord and Mater's Path. With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿਓ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਉਲਟੀ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dekhio drisat sarab ma(n)gal roop ulatee sa(n)t karaae ||
english: With my eyes, I see the Lord, the Embodiment of Absolute Bliss; the Saint has turned away from the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paaio laal amol naam har chhod na katahoo jaae ||3||
english: I have found the Priceless Name of the Beloved Lord; it never leaves me or goes anywhere else. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਉਨ ਬਡਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਉ ਰੀਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kavan upamaa kaun badaaee kiaa gun kahau reejhaae ||
english: What praise, what glory and what virtues should I utter, in order to please the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਏ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: hot kripaal deen daiaa prabh jan naanak daas dasaae ||4||8||
english: That humble being, unto whom the Merciful Lord is kind - O servant Nanak, he is the slave of God's slaves. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓੁਇ ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਰਨਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: oui sukh kaa siu baran sunaavat ||
english: Who can I tell, and with whom can I speak, about this state of peace and bliss?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anad binod pekh prabh darasan man ma(n)gal gun gaavat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am in ecstasy and delight, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. My mind sings His Songs of Joy and His Glories. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: bisam bhaee pekh bisamaadee poor rahe kirapaavat ||
english: I am wonderstruck, gazing upon the Wondrous Lord. The Merciful Lord is All-pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਖਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮੁਸਕਾਵਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: peeo a(n)mrit naam amolak jiu chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaavat ||1||
english: I drink in the Invaluable Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Like the mute, I can only smile - I cannot speak of its flavor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: jaise pavan ba(n)dh kar raakhio boojh na aavat jaavat ||
english: As the breath is held in bondage, no one can understand its coming in and going out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਉਆ ਕੀ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾਵਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kau ridai pragaas bhaio har uaa kee kahee na jaai kahaavat ||2||
english: So is that person, whose heart is enlightened by the Lord - his story cannot be told. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਸੀਖੇ ਪਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: aan upaav jete kichh kaheeahi tete seekhe paavat ||
english: As many other efforts as you can think of - I have seen them and studied them all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਅਗਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਖਾਵਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: achi(n)t laal grih bheetar pragatio agam jaise parakhaavat ||3||
english: My Beloved, Carefree Lord has revealed Himself within the home of my own heart; thus I have realized the Inaccessible Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਤੁਲੋ ਤੁਲਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: niragun nira(n)kaar abinaasee atulo tulio na jaavat ||
english: The Absolute, Formless, Eternally Unchanging, Immeasurable Lord cannot be measured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਰਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ajar jin jariaa tis hee kau ban aavat ||4||9||
english: Says Nanak, whoever endures the unendurable - this state belongs to him alone. ||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਗੁਦਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bikhaee din rain iv hee gudaarai ||
english: The corrupt person passes his days and nights uselessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਭਜੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਜਿਉ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d na bhajai aha(n)budh maataa janam jooai jiu haarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; he is intoxicated with egotistical intellect. He loses his life in the gamble. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naam amolaa preet na tis siu par ni(n)daa hitakaarai ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, but he is not in love with it. He loves only to slander others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਪਰੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਜਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhaapar baa(n)dh savaarai trin ko duaarai paavak jaarai ||1||
english: Weaving the grass, he builds his house of straw. At the door, he builds a fire. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਰ ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਮੂੰਡਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaalar pot uthaavai moo(n)dahi a(n)mrit man te daarai ||
english: He carries a load of sulfur on his head, and drives the Ambrosial Nectar out of his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਢੈ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਾਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਝਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: odhai basatr kaajar mahi pariaa bahur bahur phir jhaarai ||2||
english: Wearing his good clothes, the mortal falls into the coal-pit; again and again, he tries to shake it off. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੈ ਪੇਡੁ ਡਾਲ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੌ ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaatai ped daal par thaadhau khaai khaai musakaarai ||
english: Standing on the branch, eating and eating and smiling, he cuts down the tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਛਿਟੀ ਛਿਟੀ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: girio jaai rasaatal pario chhitee chhitee sir bhaarai ||3||
english: He falls down head-first and is shattered into bits and pieces. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਗਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: niravairai sa(n)g vair rachaae pahuch na sakai gavaarai ||
english: He bears vengeance against the Lord who is free of vengeance. The fool is not up to the task.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)tan kaa raakhaa paarabraham nira(n)kaarai ||4||10||
english: Says Nanak, the Saving Grace of the Saints is the Formless, Supreme Lord God. ||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: avar sabh bhoole bhramat na jaaniaa ||
english: All the others are deluded by doubt; they do not understand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਬੇਦਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek sudhaakhar jaa kai hiradai vasiaa tin bedahi tat pachhaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That person, within whose heart the One Pure Word abides, realizes the essence of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਤੇਤਾ ਲੋਗ ਪਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paravirat maarag jetaa kichh hoeeai tetaa log pachaaraa ||
english: He walks in the ways of the world, trying to please people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau lau ridai nahee paragaasaa tau lau a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||1||
english: But as long as his heart is not enlightened, he is stuck in pitch black darkness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਂਮੈ ॥
transliteration: jaise dharatee saadhai bahu bidh bin beejai nahee jaa(n)mai ||
english: The land may be prepared in every way, but nothing sprouts without being planted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee hai tutai naahee abhimaanai ||2||
english: Just so, without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated, nor is egotistical pride eradicated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨੈਨੂ ਕੈਸੇ ਰੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: neer bilovai at sram paavai nainoo kaise reesai ||
english: The mortal may churn water until he is sore, but how can butter be produced?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin gur bhete mukat na kaahoo milat nahee jagadeesai ||3||
english: Without meeting the Guru, no one is liberated, and the Lord of the Universe is not met. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat ihai beechaario sarab sukhaa har naamaa ||
english: Searching and searching, I have come to this realization: all peace and bliss are in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਥਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis bhaio paraapat jaa kai lekh mathaamaa ||4||11||
english: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed. ||4||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: anadin raam ke gun kaheeai ||
english: Night and day, utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal padaarath sarab sookh sidh man baa(n)chhat phal laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall obtain all wealth, all pleasures and successes, and the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t praan sukhadaate simarah prabh abinaasee ||
english: Come, O Saints, let us meditate in remembrance on God; He is the Eternal, Imperishable Giver of Peace and Praanaa, the Breath of Life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anaathah naath deen dukh bha(n)jan poor rahio ghat vaasee ||1||
english: Master of the masterless, Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; He is All-pervading and permeating, abiding in all hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਨਾਵਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavat sunat sunaavat saradhaa har ras pee vadabhaage ||
english: The very fortunate ones drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, singing, reciting and listening to the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kal kales mite sabh tan te raam naam liv jaage ||2||
english: All their sufferings and struggles are wiped away from their bodies; they remain lovingly awake and aware in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh jhooth taj ni(n)daa har simaran ba(n)dhan toote ||
english: So abandon your sexual desire, greed, falsehood and slander; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall be released from bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਅਹੰ ਅੰਧ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: moh magan aha(n) a(n)dh mamataa gur kirapaa te chhoote ||3||
english: The intoxication of loving attachments, egotism and blind possessiveness are eradicated by Guru's Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too samarath paarabraham suaamee kar kirapaa jan teraa ||
english: You are All-Powerful, O Supreme Lord God and Master; please be Merciful to Your humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: poor rahio sarab mahi thaakur naanak so prabh neraa ||4||12||
english: My Lord and Master is All-pervading and prevailing everywhere; O Nanak, God is Near. ||4||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਚਰਨ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree guradev charan ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g paarabraham dhiaaeeai upades hamaaree gat karan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I meditate with Him on the Supreme Lord God; His Teachings have emancipated me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog bhai sagal binaase jo aavai har sa(n)t saran ||
english: All pains, diseases and fears are erased, for one who comes to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap japai avarah naam japaavai vad samarath taaran taran ||1||
english: He Himself chants, and inspires others to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He is Utterly All-Powerful; He carries us across to the other side. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਊਣੇ ਕਉ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa ko ma(n)tr utaarai sahasaa oone kau subhar bharan ||
english: His Mantra drives out cynicism, and totally fills the empty one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਤ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭ ਪਰਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har daasan kee aagiaa maanat te naahee phun garabh paran ||2||
english: Those who obey the Order of the Lord's slaves, do not enter into the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ॥
transliteration: bhagatan kee tahal kamaavat gaavat dukh kaate taa ke janam maran ||
english: Whoever works for the Lord's devotees and sings His Praises - his pains of birth and death are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਜਰ ਜਰਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhaio kripaal beethulaa tin har har ajar jaran ||3||
english: Those unto whom my Beloved becomes Merciful, endure the Unendurable Ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਬਰਨ ॥
transliteration: har rasahi aghaane sahaj samaane mukh te naahee jaat baran ||
english: Those who are satisfied by the Sublime Essence of the Lord, merge intuitively into the Lord; no mouth can describe their state.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਨ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sa(n)tokhe naam prabhoo jap jap udharan ||4||13||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they are content; chanting and meditating on God's Name, they are saved. ||4||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: gaaio ree mai gun nidh ma(n)gal gaaio ||
english: I sing, O I sing the Songs of Joy of my Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨ ਅਉਸਰ ਜਉ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhale sa(n)jog bhale din ausar jau gopaal reejhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Fortunate is the time, fortunate is the day and the moment, when I become pleasing to the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਨ ਮੋਰਲੋ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah charan moralo maathaa ||
english: I touch my forehead to the Feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸੰਤ ਧਰੇ ਹਾਥਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hamare masatak sa(n)t dhare haathaa ||1||
english: The Saints have placed their hands on my forehead. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਹ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੋਰਲੋ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhah ma(n)tr moralo manooaa ||
english: My mind is filled with the Mantra of the Holy Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa te gat hoe trai guneeaa ||2||
english: and I have risen above the three qualities||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਹ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨੈਨ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagatah daras dekh nain ra(n)gaa ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of God's devotees, my eyes are filled with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤੂਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lobh moh toote bhram sa(n)gaa ||3||
english: Greed and attachment are gone, along with doubt. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sukh sahaj ana(n)daa ||
english: Says Nanak, I have found intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਲੑਿ ਭੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kholhi bheet mile paramaana(n)daa ||4||14||
english: Tearing down the wall, I have met the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||4||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਕਹਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਬੇਦਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaise kahau mohi jee bedanaaee ||
english: How can I express the pain of my soul?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਮਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan piaas pri preet manohar man na rahai bahu bidh umakaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Enticing and Lovely Beloved. My mind cannot survive - it yearns for Him in so many ways. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਨਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chitavan chitavau pri preet bairaagee kad paavau har darasaaee ||
english: I think thoughts of Him; I miss the Love of my Beloved. When will I obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਕਰਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jatan karau ihu man nahee dheerai kooo hai re sa(n)t milaaee ||1||
english: I try, but this mind is not encouraged. Is there any Saint who can lead me to God? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਮਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam pu(n)n sabh homau tis arapau sabh sukh jaa(n)ee ||
english: Chanting, penance, self-control, good deeds and charity - I sacrifice all these in fire; I dedicate all peace and places to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek nimakh pri daras dikhaavai tis sa(n)tan kai bal jaa(n)ee ||2||
english: One who helps me to behold the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, for even an instant - I am a sacrifice to that Saint. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੇਵਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karau nihoraa bahut benatee sevau din rainaaee ||
english: I offer all my prayers and entreaties to him; I serve him, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maan abhimaan hau sagal tiaagau jo pri baat sunaaee ||3||
english: I have renounced all pride and egotism; he tells me the stories of my Beloved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਈ ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dekh charitr bhaee hau bisaman gur satigur purakh milaaee ||
english: I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the wondrous play of God. The Guru, the True Guru, has led me to meet the Primal Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥
transliteration: prabh ra(n)g daiaal mohi grih mahi paaiaa jan naanak tapat bujhaaee ||4||1||15||
english: I have found God, my Merciful Loving Lord, within the home of my own heart. O Nanak, the fire within me has been quenched. ||4||1||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਬ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: re mooRhe too kiu simarat ab naahee ||
english: You fool, why are you not meditating on the Lord now?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: narak ghor mahi uradh tap karataa nimakh nimakh gun gaa(n)hee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the awful hell of the fire of the womb, you did penance, upside-down; each and every instant, you sang His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਹੀ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: anik janam bhramatau hee aaio maanas janam dulabhaahee ||
english: You wandered through countless incarnations, until finally you attained this priceless human birth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਉ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਤਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਅਨ ਠਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garabh jon chhod jau nikasio tau laago an thaa(n)hee ||1||
english: Leaving the womb, you were born, and when you came out, you became attached to other places. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਠਗਾਈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: karahi buraaee thagaaee din rain nihaphal karam kamaahee ||
english: You practiced evil and fraud day and night, and did useless deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਹ ਗਾਹਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kan naahee tuh gaahan laage dhaai dhaai dukh paa(n)hee ||2||
english: You thrash the straw, but it has no wheat; running around and hurrying, you obtain only pain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਸਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa sa(n)g kooR lapataaio urajh pario kusamaa(n)hee ||
english: The false person is attached to falsehood; he is entangled with transitory things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਉ ਕਾਲ ਮੁਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dharam raai jab pakaras bavare tau kaal mukhaa uth jaahee ||3||
english: And when the Righteous Judge of Dharma seizes you, O madman, you shall arise and depart with your face blackened. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: so miliaa jo prabhoo milaaiaa jis masatak lekh likhaa(n)hee ||
english: He alone meets with God, whom God Himself meets, by such pre-ordained destiny written on his forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਲਿਪ ਰਹੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tinh jan balihaaree jo alip rahe man maa(n)hee ||4||2||16||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being, who remains unattached within his mind. ||4||2||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiu jeevan preetam bin maaee ||
english: How can I live without my Beloved, O my mother?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਹੋਤ ਮਿਰਤਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke bichhurat hot miratakaa grih mahi rahan na paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Separated from Him, the mortal becomes a corpse, and is not allowed to remain within the house. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਹਂੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ha(n)ee praan ko daataa jaa kai sa(n)g suhaaee ||
english: He is the Giver of the soul, the heart, the breath of life. Being with Him, we are embellished with joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa sa(n)tahu mohi apunee prabh ma(n)gal gun gaaee ||1||
english: Please bless me with Your Gace, O Saint, that I may sing the songs of joyful praise to my God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਥੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਾਈਁ ॥
transliteration: charan sa(n)tan ke maathe mere oopar nainahu dhoor baa(n)chhaaee(n) ||
english: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. My eyes long for their dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jih prasaad mileeai prabh naanak bal bal taa kai hau jaaee ||2||3||17||
english: By His Grace, we meet God; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਅਉਸਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: uaa ausar kai hau bal jaaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that occasion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar apanaa prabh simaran vadabhaagee har paa(n)ee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on my God; by great good fortune, I have found the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੈਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhalo kabeer daas daasan ko ootam sain jan naaee ||
english: Kabeer is good, the slave of the Lord's slaves; the humble barber Sain is sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ooch te ooch naamadeu samadarasee ravidaas thaakur ban aaee ||1||
english: Highest of the high is Naam Dayv, who looked upon all alike; Ravi Daas was in tune with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d tan dhan saadhan kaa ihu man sa(n)t renaaee ||
english: My soul, body and wealth belong to the Saints; my mind longs for the dust of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਭਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prataap bharam sabh naase naanak mile gusaaee ||2||4||18||
english: And by the radiant Grace of the Saints, all my doubts have been erased. O Nanak, I have met the Lord. ||2||4||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: manorath poore satigur aap ||
english: The True Guru fulfills the mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal padaarath simaran jaa kai aath pahar mere man jaap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All wealth and treasures are obtained by remembering Him in meditation; twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, meditate on Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam suaamee teraa jo peevai tis hee tripataas ||
english: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master. Whoever drinks it in is satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh naasahi aagai daragah hoi khalaas ||1||
english: The sins of countless incarnations are erased, and hereafter, he shall be saved and redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saran tumaaree aaio karate paarabraham pooran abinaas ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Creator, O Perfect Supreme Eternal Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੯॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa tere charan dhiaavau naanak man tan daras piaas ||2||5||19||
english: Please be kind to me, that I may meditate on Your Lotus Feet. O Nanak, my mind and body thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||5||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਹਾ ਲੁਭਾਈਐ ਆਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: man kahaa lubhaaeeai aan kau ||
english: O my mind, why are you lured away by otherness?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eet oot prabh sadaa sahaaee jee sa(n)g tere kaam kau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Here and hereafter, God is forever your Help and Support. He is your soul-mate; He will help you succeed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਇਹੈ ਅਘਾਵਨ ਪਾਂਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam pri preet manohar ihai aghaavan paa(n)n kau ||
english: The Name of your Beloved Lover, the Fascinating Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar. Drinking it in, you shall find satisfaction.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਨੀਕੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: akaal moorat hai saadh sa(n)tan kee thaahar neekee dhiaan kau ||1||
english: The Being of Immortal Manifestation is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meditate on Him in that most sublime place. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਉਤਾਰਨ ਮਾਂਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: baanee ma(n)tr mahaa purakhan kee manahi utaaran maa(n)n kau ||
english: The Bani, the Word of the Supreme Lord God, is the greatest Mantra of all. It eradicates pride from the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
transliteration: khoj lahio naanak sukh thaanaa(n) har naamaa bisraam kau ||2||1||20||
english: Searching, Nanak found the home of peace and bliss in the Name of the Lord. ||2||1||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man sadaa ma(n)gal gobi(n)d gaai ||
english: O my mind, sing forever the Songs of Joy of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਅਘ ਨਿਮਖ ਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rog sog tere mitahi sagal agh nimakh heeai har naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All your disease, sorrow and sin will be erased, if you meditate on the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chhod siaanap bahu chaturaaee saadhoo saranee jaai paai ||
english: Abandon all your clever tricks; go and enter the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau hoi kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan jam te hovai dharam raai ||1||
english: When the Lord, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, the Messenger of Death is changed into the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ekas bin naahee ko doojaa aan na beeo lavai laai ||
english: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. No one else can equal Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਾਇ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee naanak ko sukhadaataa har praan saai ||2||2||21||
english: The Lord is Nanak's Mother, Father and Sibling, the Giver of Peace, his Breath of Life. ||2||2||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਸੰਗ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: har jan sagal udhaare sa(n)g ke ||
english: The Lord's humble servant saves those who accompany him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae puneet pavitr man janam janam ke dukh hare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Their minds are sanctified and rendered pure, and they are rid of the pains of countless incarnations. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਸੇ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maarag chale tinhee sukh paaiaa jinh siu gosat se tare ||
english: Those who walk on the path find peace; they are saved, along with those who speak with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: boodat ghor a(n)dh koop mahi te saadhoo sa(n)g paar pare ||1||
english: Even those who are drowning in the horrible, deep dark pit are carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ਬਡੇ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਖ ਜੁਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jinh ke bhaag bade hai bhaaee tinh saadhoo sa(n)g mukh jure ||
english: Those who have such high destiny turn their faces toward the Saadh Sangat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
transliteration: tinh kee dhoor baa(n)chhai nit naanak prabh meraa kirapaa kare ||2||3||22||
english: Nanak longs for the dust of their feet; O God, please shower Your Mercy on me! ||2||3||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਂਏ ॥
transliteration: har jan raam raam raam dhiaa(n)e ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਪਲਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਹ ਪਾਂਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek palak sukh saadh samaagam kot baiku(n)thah paa(n)e ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who enjoys peace in the Company of the Holy, even for an instant, obtains millions of heavenly paradises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: dulabh deh jap hot puneetaa jam kee traas nivaarai ||
english: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is sanctified by meditating on the Lord. It takes away the fear of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਕੇ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa patit ke paatik utarahi har naamaa ur dhaarai ||1||
english: Even the sins of terrible sinners are washed away, by cherishing the Lord's Name within the heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo jo sunai raam jas niramal taa kaa janam maran dukh naasaa ||
english: Whoever listens to the Immaculate Praises of the Lord - his pains of birth and death are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗਂੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak paaeeai vadabhaaga(n)ee man tan hoi bigaasaa ||2||4||23||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord is found by great good fortune, and then the mind and body blossom forth. ||2||4||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 4 ||
