english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਕਰਉ ਜੋਦਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mohan ghar aavahu karau jodareeaa ||
english: O my Fascinating Lord, I pray to You: come into my house.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ਬੋਲਉ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਚਿਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maan karau abhimaanai bolau bhool chook teree pri chireeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I act in pride, and speak in pride. I am mistaken and wrong, but I am still Your hand-maiden, O my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਅਰੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nikat sunau ar pekhau naahee bharam bharam dukh bhareeaa ||
english: I hear that You are near, but I cannot see You. I wander in suffering, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਹਿ ਪਾਰਦੋ ਮਿਲਉ ਲਾਲ ਮਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi kripaal gur laahi paarado milau laal man hareeaa ||1||
english: The Guru has become merciful to me; He has removed the veils. Meeting with my Beloved, my mind blossoms forth in abundance. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ek nimakh je bisarai suaamee jaanau kot dinas lakh bareeaa ||
english: If I were to forget my Lord and Master, even for an instant, it would be like millions of days, tens of thousands of years.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਭੀਰ ਜਉ ਪਾਈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kee bheer jau paaee tau naanak har sa(n)g mireeaa ||2||1||24||
english: When I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, I met my Lord. ||2||1||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚਉ ਸੋਚ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ab kiaa sochau soch bisaaree ||
english: Now what should I think? I have given up thinking.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karanaa saa soee kar rahiaa dehi naau balihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You do whatever You wish to do. Please bless me with Your Name - I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਫੂਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੂਖਿ ਗਰੁੜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chahu dis phool rahee bikhiaa bikh gur ma(n)tr mookh garuRaaree ||
english: The poison of corruption is flowering forth in the four directions; I have taken the GurMantra as my antidote.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲਾ ਅਲਿਪਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhio kar apunaa jiu jal kamalaa alipaaree ||1||
english: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me as His Own; like the lotus in the water, I remain unattached. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਸਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hau naahee kichh mai kiaa hosaa sabh tum hee kal dhaaree ||
english: I am nothing. What am I? You hold all in Your Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak bhaag pario har paachhai raakh sa(n)t sadakaaree ||2||2||25||
english: Nanak has run to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save him, for the sake of Your Saints. ||2||2||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਵ ਬਿਰਕਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi sarab upaav birakaate ||
english: Now I have abandoned all efforts and devices.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee har ekas te meree gaate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Lord and Master is the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes, my only Saving Grace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਂਤੇ ॥
transliteration: dekhe naanaa roop bahu ra(n)gaa an naahee tum bhaa(n)te ||
english: I have seen numerous forms of incomparable beauty, but nothing is like You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: de(n)hi adhaar sarab kau thaakur jee praan sukhadaate ||1||
english: You give Your Support to all, O my Lord and Master; You are the Giver of peace, of the soul and the breath of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਹਾਰਿ ਜਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: bhramatau bhramatau haar jau pario tau gur mil charan paraate ||
english: Wandering, wandering, I grew so tired; meeting the Guru, I fell at His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai sarab sukh paaiaa ih sookh bihaanee raate ||2||3||26||
english: Says Nanak, I have found total peace; this life-night of mine passes in peace. ||2||3||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਬਧਿਓ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi labadhio hai har tekaa ||
english: Now I have found the Support of my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਮਾਣਿਕੁ ਦੇਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur daiaal bhae sukhadaaee a(n)dhulai maanik dekhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru, the Giver of peace, has become merciful to me. I was blind - I see the jewel of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਤਿਮਰ ਨਿਰਮਲੀਆ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਬਿਬੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: kaate agiaan timar niramaleeaa budh bigaas bibekaa ||
english: I have cut away the darkness of ignorance and become immaculate; my discriminationg intellect has blossomed forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਫੇਨੁ ਜਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਏ ਏਕਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu jal tara(n)g phen jal hoee hai sevak thaakur bhae ekaa ||1||
english: As the waves of water and the foam become water again, the Lord and His servant become One. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਠਿਓ ਤਹ ਹੀ ਆਇਓ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਏਕਾ ॥
transliteration: jah te uthio tah hee aaio sabh hee ekai ekaa ||
english: He is taken in again, into what from which he came; all is one in the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਇਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਪਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਕਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak drisat aaio srab thaaee praanapatee har samakaa ||2||4||27||
english: O Nanak, I have come to see the Master of the breath of life, all-pervading everywhere. ||2||4||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮਾਂਗੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa man ekai hee pri maa(n)gai ||
english: My mind longs for the One Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਦੇਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pekh aaio sarab thaan des pri rom na samasar laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have looked everywhere in every country, but nothing equals even a hair of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨੀਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਰੁਚਾਂਗੈ ॥
transliteration: mai neere anik bhojan bahu bi(n)jan tin siu drisat na karai ruchaa(n)gai ||
english: All sorts of delicacies and dainties are placed before me, but I do not even want to look at them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ ਟੇਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਲੋਭਾਂਗੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ras chaahai pri pri mukh terai jiu al kamalaa lobhaa(n)gai ||1||
english: I long for the sublime essence of the Lord, calling, "Pri-o! Pri-o! - Beloved! Beloved!", like the Bumble bee longing for the lotus flower. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸਰਬਾਂਗੈ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan manamohan laalan sukhadaaee sarabaa(n)gai ||
english: The Treasure of Virtue, the Enticer of the mind, my Beloved is the Giver of peace to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਓ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਖਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
transliteration: gur naanak prabh paahi pathaaio milahu sakhaa gal laagai ||2||5||28||
english: Guru Nanak has led me to You, O God. Join with me, O my Best Friend, and hold me close in Your Embrace. ||2||5||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: ab moro thaakur siu man maanaa(n) ||
english: Now my mind is pleased and appeased by my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਛੇਦਿਓ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh kripaal daiaal bhae hai ihu chhedio dusat bigaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Holy Saint has become kind and compassionate to me, and has destroyed this demon of duality. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁਘਰ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tum hee su(n)dar tumahi siaane tum hee sughar sujaanaa ||
english: You are so beautiful, and You are so wise; You are elegant and all-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal jog ar giaan dhiaan ik nimakh na keemat jaanaa(n) ||1||
english: All the Yogis, spiritual teachers and meditators do not know even a bit of Your value. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਨਾਇਕ ਤੁਮੑਹਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tum hee naaik tumhhi chhatrapat tum poor rahe bhagavaanaa ||
english: You are the Master, You are the Lord under the royal canopy; You are the perfectly pervading Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
transliteration: paavau daan sa(n)t sevaa har naanak sad kurabaanaa(n) ||2||6||29||
english: Please bless me with the gift of service to the Saints; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||6||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: merai man cheet aae pri ra(n)gaa ||
english: The Love of my Beloved comes into my conscious mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਰਜਨਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bisario dha(n)dh ba(n)dh maaiaa ko rajan sabaaee ja(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have forgotten the entangling affairs of Maya, and I spend my life-night fighting with evil. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har sevau har ridai basaavau har paaiaa satasa(n)gaa ||
english: I serve the Lord; the Lord abides within my heart. I have found my Lord in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aiso milio manohar preetam sukh paae mukh ma(n)gaa ||1||
english: So I have met with my enticingly beautiful Beloved; I have obtained the peace which I asked for. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਭੋਗਉ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: priu apanaa gur bas kar deenaa bhogau bhog nisa(n)gaa ||
english: The Guru has brought my Beloved under my control, and I enjoy Him with unrestrained pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਠੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae naanak bhau mitiaa har paaio paatha(n)gaa ||2||7||30||
english: I have become fearless; O Nanak, my fears have been eradicated. Chanting the Word, I have found the Lord. ||2||7||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu ke darasan kau kurabaanee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Dear Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਚਨ ਨਾਦ ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੇਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bachan naad mere sravanahu poore dehaa pri a(n)k samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Naad, the Sound-current of His Word fills my ears; my body has settled gently into the Lap of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਰਿ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: chhootar te gur keeee souhaagan har paaio sughaR sujaanee ||
english: I was a discarded bride, and the Guru has made me a happy soul-bride. I have found the Elegant and All-knowing Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਬਾਸਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jih ghar mahi baisan nahee paavat so thaan milio baasaanee ||1||
english: That home, in which I was not even allowed to sit - I have found that place in which I can dwell. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਆਇਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਆਨ ਸੰਤਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: unh kai bas aaio bhagat bachhal jin raakhee aan sa(n)taanee ||
english: God, the Love of His devotees, has come under the control of those who protect the honor of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋੁਕਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har sa(n)g man maaniaa sabh chookee kaan loukaanee ||2||8||31||
english: Says Nanak, my mid is pleased and appeased with the Lord, and my subservience to other people has come to an end. ||2||8||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੇਰੋ ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: ab mero pa(n)chaa te sa(n)g tootaa ||
english: Now my association with the five thieves has come to an end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekh bhae man aanad gur kirapaa te chhootaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is in ecstasy; by Guru's Grace, I am released. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁ ਧਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਖ ਸੂਰੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: bikham thaan bahut bahu dhareeaa anik raakh soorootaa ||
english: The impregnable place is guarded by countless ramparts and warriors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ੍ਹ ਕਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਨਥ ਭਏ ਲੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikham gaarh kar pahuchai naahee sa(n)t saanath bhae lootaa ||1||
english: This impregnable fortress cannot be touched, but with the assistance of the Saints, I have entered and robbed it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਪਰਿਆ ਅਮੋਲ ਲਾਲ ਆਖੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: bahut khajaane merai paalai pariaa amol laal aakhootaa ||
english: I have found such a great treasure, a priceless, inexhaustible supply of jewels.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਘੂਟਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree tau man mahi har ras ghootaa ||2||9||32||
english: O servant Nanak, when God showered His Mercy on me, my mind drank in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||9||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ab mero thaakur siu man leenaa ||
english: Now my mind is absorbed in my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: praan daan gur poorai deeaa urajhaaio jiu jal meenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the breath of life. I am involved with the Lord, like the fish with the water. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਇਹ ਅਰਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad matasar ih arap sagal daan keenaa ||
english: I have cast out sexual desire, anger, greed, egotism and envy; I have offered all this as a gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਤਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ma(n)tr driRaai har aukhadh gur deeo tau milio sagal prabeenaa ||1||
english: The Guru has implanted the medicine of the Lord's Mantra within me, and I have met with the All-knowing Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਉ ਖੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: grihu teraa too thaakur meraa gur hau khoee prabh deenaa ||
english: My household belongs to You, O my Lord and Master; the Guru has blessed me with God, and rid me of egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai sahaj ghar paaiaa har bhagat bha(n)daar khajeenaa ||2||10||33||
english: Says Nanak, I have found the Lord with intuitive ease, within the home of my own heart. Devotional worship of the Lord is a treasure over-flowing. ||2||10||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mohan sabh jee tere too taarahi ||
english: O my Enticing Lord, all beings are Yours - You save them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੁਟਹਿ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਨਿਮਖ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhutahi sa(n)ghaar nimakh kirapaa te kot brahama(n)d udhaarahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even a tiny bit of Your Mercy ends all cruelty and tyranny. You save and redeem millions of universes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਾਮੑਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: karahi aradaas bahut bena(n)tee nimakh nimakh saamhaarahi ||
english: I offer countless prayers; I remember You each and every instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan haath dei nisataarahi ||1||
english: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; please give me Your hand and save me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਏ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕਹੁ ਏ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa e bhoopat bapure kaheeahi kahu e kis no maarahi ||
english: And what about these poor kings? Tell me, who can they kill?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਤੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਹਿ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: raakh raakh raakh sukhadaate sabh naanak jagat tumhaarahi ||2||11||34||
english: Save me, save me, save me, O Giver of peace; O Nanak, all the world is Yours. ||2||11||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi dhan paaio har naamaa ||
english: Now I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਥਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae achi(n)t trisan sabh bujhee hai ihu likhio lekh mathaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have become carefree, and all my thirsty desires are satisfied. Such is the destiny written on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਦੇਹ ਗਿਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat bhaio bairaagee phir aaio deh giraamaa ||
english: Searching and searching, I became depressed; I wandered all around, and finally came back to my body-village.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੋਰਿਓ ਹਥਿ ਚਰਿਓ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਗਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kripaal saudaa ihu jorio hath chario laal agaamaa ||1||
english: The Merciful Guru made this deal, and I have obtained the priceless jewel. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਬਾਪਾਰ ਬਨਜ ਜੋ ਕਰੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: aan baapaar banaj jo kareeahi tete dookh sahaamaa ||
english: The other deals and trades which I did, brought only sorrow and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੫॥
transliteration: gobid bhajan ke nirabhai vaapaaree har raas naanak raam naamaa ||2||12||35||
english: Fearless are those traders who deal in meditation on the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, the Lord's Name is their capital. ||2||12||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਸਟ ਲਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: merai man misat lage pri bolaa ||
english: The Speech of my Beloved seems so sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸਦ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur baah pakar prabh sevaa laae sad daiaal har dholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has taken hold of my arm, and linked me to God's service. My Beloved Lord is forever merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਭਿ ਗੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh too thaakur sarab pratipaalak mohi kalatr sahit sabh golaa ||
english: O God, You are my Lord and Master; You are the Cherisher of all. My wife and I are totally Your slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maan taan sabh toohai toohai ik naam teraa mai olhaa ||1||
english: You are all my honor and power - You are. Your Name is my only Support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਸਾਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਘਾਸੁ ਬਢਾਵਹਿ ਕੇਤਕ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: je takhat baisaalahi tau daas tumhaare ghaas badhaavahi ketak bolaa ||
english: If You seat me on the throne, then I am Your slave. If You make me a grass-cutter, then what can I say?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh purakh bidhaate mere thaakur agah atolaa ||2||13||36||
english: Servant Nanak's God is the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, Unfathomable and Immeasurable. ||2||13||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਣ ਸੋਹੰ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam kahat gun soha(n) ||
english: The tongue becomes beautiful, uttering the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਓਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek nimakh opaai samaavai dekh charit man moha(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In an instant, He creates and destroys. Gazing upon His Wondrous Plays, my mind is fascinated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਸੁ ਅਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਾਨ ਦੁਖ ਜੋਹੰ ॥
transliteration: jis suniai man hoi rahas at ridai maan dukh joha(n) ||
english: Listening to His Praises, my mind is in utter ecstasy, and my heart is rid of pride and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukh paaio dukh door paraaio ban aaee prabh toha(n) ||1||
english: I have found peace, and my pains have been taken away, since I became one with God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੰ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh gae man niramal hoee hai gur kaadhe maaiaa droha(n) ||
english: Sinful resides have been wiped away, and my mind is immaculate. The Guru has lifted me up and pulled me out of the deception of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੋਹੰ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੩੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai so prabh paaiaa karan kaaran samarathoha(n) ||2||14||37||
english: Says Nanak, I have found God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes. ||2||14||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਚਲਤੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: nainahu dekhio chalat tamaasaa ||
english: With my eyes, I have seen the marvellous wonders of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹੂ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਘਟ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh hoo door sabh hoo te nerai agam agam ghat vaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is far from all, and yet near to all. He is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, and yet He dwells in the heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭੂਲੁ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਨ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਮਤਾ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਪਚਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: abhool na bhoolai likhio na chalaavai mataa na karai pachaasaa ||
english: The Infallible Lord never makes a mistake. He does not have to write His Orders, and He does not have to consult with anyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਬਿਨਾਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin mahi saaj savaar binaahai bhagat vachhal gunataasaa ||1||
english: In an instant, He creates, embellishes and destroys. He is the Lover of His devotees, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਲਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੀਓ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahi deepak balio gur ridai keeo paragaasaa ||
english: Lighting the lamp in the deep dark pit, the Guru illumines and enlightens the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੩੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak daras pekh sukh paaiaa sabh pooran hoee aasaa ||2||15||38||
english: Says Nanak, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I have found peace, and all my hopes have been fulfilled. ||2||15||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: charanah gobi(n)d maarag suhaavaa ||
english: The most beautiful path for the feet is to follow the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਮਾਰਗ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਧਾਈਐ ਤੇਤੋ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan maarag jetaa kichh dhaaeeai teto hee dukh haavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The more you walk on any other path, the more you suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਹਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਟਹਲਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: netr puneet bhae daras pekhe hasat puneet tahalaavaa ||
english: The eyes are sanctified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. Serving Him, the hands are sanctified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ridaa puneet ridai har basio masat puneet sa(n)t dhooraavaa ||1||
english: The heart is sanctified, when the Lord abides within the heart; that forehead which touches the dust of the feet of the Saints is sanctified. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan naam har har kai jis karam likhiaa tin paavaa ||
english: All treasures are in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he alone obtains it, who has it written in his karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਹਾਵਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau gur pooraa bhetio sukh sahaje anad bihaavaa ||2||16||39||
english: Servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; he passes his life-night in peace, poise and pleasure. ||2||16||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ॥
transliteration: dhiaaio a(n)t baar naam sakhaa ||
english: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; at the very last instant, it shall be your Help and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jah maat pitaa sut bhaaee na pahuchai tahaa tahaa too rakhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In that place where your mother, father, children and siblings shall be of no use to you at all, there, the Name alone shall save you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop grih mahi tin simario jis masatak lekh likhaa ||
english: He alone meditates on the Lord in the deep dark pit of his own household, upon whose forehead such destiny is written.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੂਲੑੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੁਹੀ ਦਿਖਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khoolhe ba(n)dhan mukat gur keenee sabh toohai tuhee dikhaa ||1||
english: His bonds are loosened, and the Guru liberates him. He sees You, O Lord, everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਆਘਾਏ ਰਸਨ ਚਖਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam peeaa man tripatiaa aaghaae rasan chakhaa ||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, his mind is satisfied. Tasting it, his tongue is satiated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਲਾਹੀ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਖਾ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sukh sahaj mai paaiaa gur laahee sagal tikhaa ||2||17||40||
english: Says Nanak, I have obtained celestial peace and poise; the Guru has quenched all my thirst. ||2||17||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur mil aise prabhoo dhiaaiaa ||
english: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on God in such a way,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਾਤੀ ਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal daiaal dukh bha(n)jan lagai na taatee baaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that He has become kind and compassionate to me. He is the Destroyer of pain; He does not allow the hot wind to even touch me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹਮ ਲੇਤੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jete saas saas ham lete tete hee gun gaaiaa ||
english: With each and every breath I take, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਤ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nimakh na bichhurai gharee na bisarai sad sa(n)ge jat jaaiaa ||1||
english: He is not separated from me, even for an instant, and I never forget Him. He is always with me, wherever I go. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau bal bal bal bal charan kamal kau bal bal gur darasaaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His Lotus Feet. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kaahoo paravaahaa jau sukh saagar mai paaiaa ||2||18||41||
english: Says Nanak, I do not care about anything else; I have found the Lord, the Ocean of peace. ||2||18||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: merai man sabad lago gur meethaa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad seems so sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੑਿਓ ਕਰਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khulhio karam bhaio paragaasaa ghat ghat har har deethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My karma has been activated, and the Divine Radiance of the Lord, Har, Har, is manifest in each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਘਟ ਬੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham aajonee sa(n)bhau sarab thaan ghat beethaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, beyond birth, Self-existent, is seated within every heart everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaio paraapat a(n)mrit naamaa bal bal prabh charaneethaa ||1||
english: I have come to obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lotus Feet of God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਕੀਏ ਸਗਲ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat kee ren mukh laagee keee sagal teerath majaneethaa ||
english: I anoint my forehead with the dust of the Society of the Saints; it is as if I have bathed at all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ra(n)g chalool bhae hai har ra(n)g na lahai majeethaa ||2||19||42||
english: Says Nanak, I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love; the Love of my Lord shall never fade away. ||2||19||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam deeo gur saathe ||
english: The Guru has given me the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as my Companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਬਚਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਭੂਖ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nimakh bachan prabh heearai basio sagal bhookh meree laathe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If the Word of God dwells within my heart for even an instant, all my hunger is relieved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਸਭ ਨਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan gun naaik thaakur sukh samooh sabh naathe ||
english: O Treasure of Mercy, Master of Excellence, my Lord and Master, Ocean of peace, Lord of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਉਰ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਆਸ ਬਿਰਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek aas mohi teree suaamee aur duteeaa aas biraathe ||1||
english: My hopes rest in You alone, O my Lord and Master; hope in anything else is useless. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: nain tripataase dekh darasaavaa gur kar dhaare merai maathe ||
english: My eyes were satisfied and fulfilled, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, when the Guru placed His Hand on my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai atul sukh paaiaa janam maran bhai laathe ||2||20||43||
english: Says Nanak, I have found immeasurable peace; my fear of birth and death is gone. ||2||20||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਆਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: re mooRhe aan kaahe kat jaaee ||
english: You fool: why are you going somewhere else?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g manohar a(n)mrit hai re bhool bhool bikh khaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Enticing Ambrosial Amrit is with you, but you are deluded, totally deluded, and you eat poison. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਅਨੂਪ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh su(n)dar chatur anoop bidhaate tis siu ruch nahee raaee ||
english: God is Beautiful, Wise and Incomparable; He is the Creator, the Architect of Destiny, but you have no love for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਵਰ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਝੂਠਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohan siu baavar man mohio jhooth thagauree paaee ||1||
english: The mad-man's mind is enticed by Maya, the enticer; he has taken the intoxicating drug of falsehood. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bhaio daiaal kripaal dukh harataa sa(n)tan siu ban aaee ||
english: The Destroyer of pain has become kind and compassionate to me, and I am in tune with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੪॥
transliteration: sagal nidhaan gharai mahi paae kahu naanak jot samaaee ||2||21||44||
english: I have obtained all treasures within the home of my own heart; says Nanak, my light has merged into the Light. ||2||21||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਪਹਿਲਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: oa(n) pri preet cheet pahilareeaa ||
english: My consciousness has loved my Beloved God, since the very beginning of time.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tau bachan deeo mere satigur tau mai saaj seegareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When You blessed me with the Teachings, O my True Guru, I was embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਅਭੂਲਾ ਹਮ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ham bhoolah tum sadaa abhoolaa ham patit tum patit udhareeaa ||
english: I am mistaken; You are never mistaken. I am a sinner; You are the Saving Grace of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਲਾਜ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham neech birakh tum mailaagar laaj sa(n)g sa(n)g basareeaa ||1||
english: I am a lowly thorn-tree, and You are the sandalwood tree. Please preserve my honor by staying with me; please stay with me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਆ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੰਤਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tum ga(n)bheer dheer upakaaree ham kiaa bapure ja(n)tareeaa ||
english: You are deep and profound, calm and benevolent. What am I? Just a poor helpless being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਤਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੂਖਿ ਸੇਜਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੪੫॥
transliteration: gur kripaal naanak har melio tau meree sookh sejareeaa ||2||22||45||
english: The Merciful Guru Nanak has united me with the Lord. I lay on His Bed of Peace. ||2||22||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਓਇ ਦਿਨਸ ਧੰਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: man oi dinas dha(n)n paravaanaa(n) ||
english: O my mind, blessed and approved is that day,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਤੇ ਘਰੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saphal te gharee sa(n)jog suhaave satigur sa(n)g giaanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and fruitful is that hour, and lucky is that moment, when the True Guru blesses me with spirtual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਗ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n subhaag dha(n)n sohaagaa dha(n)n det jin maanaa(n) ||
english: Blessed is my good destiny, and blessed is my Husband Lord. Blessed are those upon whom honor is bestowed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਹੀਂਉ ਕੀਓ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ihu tan tumhraa sabh grihu dhan tumaraa hee(n)u keeo kurabaanaa(n) ||1||
english: This body is Yours, all my home and wealth are Yours; I offer my heart as a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪੇਖਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: kot laakh raaj sukh paae ik nimakh pekh drisataanaa(n) ||
english: I obtain tens of thousands and millions of regal pleasures, if I gaze upon Your Blessed Vision, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਹ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੨੩॥੪੬॥
transliteration: jau kahahu mukhahu sevak ih baiseeai sukh naanak a(n)t na jaanaa(n) ||2||23||46||
english: When You, O God, say, "My servant, stay here with me", Nanak knows unlimited peace. ||2||23||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ab moro sahasaa dookh gaiaa ||
english: Now I am rid of my skepticism and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਛੋਡੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aur upaav sagal tiaag chhode satigur saran paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have abandoned and forsaken all other efforts, and come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਰੇ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਖਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab sidh kaaraj sabh savare aha(n) rog sagal hee khaiaa ||
english: I have attained total perfection, and all my works are perfectly completed; the illness of egotism has been totally eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖਉ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot paraadh khin mahi khau bhaee hai gur mil har har kahiaa ||1||
english: Millions of sins are destroyed in an instant; meeting with the Guru, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦਾਸ ਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch daas gur vasagat keene man nihachal nirabhaiaa ||
english: Subduing the five thieves, he Guru has made them my slaves; my mind has become stable and steady and fearless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਡੋਲੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੪੭॥
transliteration: aai na jaavai na kat hee dolai thir naanak raajaiaa ||2||24||47||
english: It does not come or go in reincarnation; it does not waver or wander anywhere. O Nanak, my empire is eternal. ||2||24||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh mero it ut sadaa sahaaee ||
english: Here and hereafter, God is forever my Help and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamohan mere jee ko piaaro kavan kahaa gun gaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Enticer of my mind, the Beloved of my soul. What Glorious Praises of His can I sing and chant? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਿ ਖਿਲਾਇ ਲਾਡ ਲਾਡਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khel khilaai laad laadaavai sadaa sadaa anadaaee ||
english: He plays with me, He fondles and caresses me. Forever and ever, He blesses me with bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pratipaalai baarik kee niaaee jaise maat pitaaee ||1||
english: He cherishes me, like the father and the mother love their child. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਿ ਸਕੀਐ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis bin nimakh nahee rahi sakeeai bisar na kabahoo jaaee ||
english: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant; I shall never forget Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੪੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat te magan bhae liv laaee ||2||25||48||
english: Says Nanak, joining the Society of the Saints, I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to my Lord. ||2||25||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: apanaa meet suaamee gaaeeai ||
english: Sing of your Lord and Master, your Best Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aas na avar kaahoo kee keejai sukhadaataa prabh dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Do not place your hopes in anyone else; meditate on God, the Giver of peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan jisahi ghar tis hee saranee paaeeai ||
english: Peace, joy and salvation are in His Home. Seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisahi tiaag maanukh je sevahu tau laaj lon hoi jaaeeai ||1||
english: But if you forsake Him, and serve mortal beings, your honor will dissolve like salt in water. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਓਟ ਪਕਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ek ot pakaree thaakur kee gur mil mat budh paaeeai ||
english: I have grasped the Anchor and Support of my Lord and Master; meeting with the Guru, I have found wisdom and understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੪੯॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan naanak prabh miliaa sagal chukee muhataaeeai ||2||26||49||
english: Nanak has met God, the Treasure of Excellence; all dependence on others is gone. ||2||26||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ot sataanee prabh jeeu merai ||
english: I have the Almighty Support of my Dear Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਲਿਆਵਉ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਮਾਣਿ ਮਹਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: drisat na liaavau avar kaahoo kau maan mahat prabh terai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I do not look up to anyone else. My honor and glory are Yours, O God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apunai kaadh leeaa bikh gherai ||
english: God has taken my side; He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the whirlpool of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam aukhadh mukh deeno jaai paiaa gur pairai ||1||
english: He has poured the medicine of the Naam, the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, into my mouth; I have fallen at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹਉ ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan upamaa kahau ek mukh niragun ke daaterai ||
english: How can I praise You with only one mouth? You are generous, even to the unworthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੫੦॥
transliteration: kaat silak jau apunaa keeno naanak sookh ghanerai ||2||27||50||
english: You cut away the noose, and now You own me; Nanak is blessed with myriad joys. ||2||27||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh simarat dookh binaasee ||
english: Remembering God in meditation, pains are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਖਲਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal jee sukhadaataa hoee sagal khalaasee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the Giver of peace to the soul becomes merciful, the mortal is totally redeemed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਸੂਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: avar na kooo soojhai prabh bin kahu ko kis pahi jaasee ||
english: I know of none other than God; tell me, who else should I approach?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu raakhahu thaakur sabh kichh tum hee paasee ||1||
english: As You know me, so do You keep me, O my Lord and Master.I have surrendered everything to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhe prabh apune sad jeevan abinaasee ||
english: God gave me His Hand and saved me; He has blessed me with eternal life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥੨੮॥੫੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak man anad bhaiaa hai kaatee jam kee phaasee ||2||28||51||
english: Says Nanak, my mind is in ecstasy; the noose of death has been cut away from my neck. ||2||28||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: mero man jat kat tujhahi samhaarai ||
english: My mind contemplates You, O Lord, all the time.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਪਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik deen pitaa prabh mere jiu jaanahi tiu paarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am Your meek and helpless child; You are God my Father. As You know me, You save me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਭੁਖੌ ਤਬ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਅਘਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਘਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jab bhukhau tab bhojan maa(n)gai aghaae sookh saghaarai ||
english: When I am hungry, I ask for food; when I am full, I am totally at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਅਰੋਗ ਜਬ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੌ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab arog jab tum sa(n)g basatau chhutakat hoi ravaarai ||1||
english: When I dwell with You, I am free of disease; if I become separated from You, I turn to dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਥਾਪਿਉ ਥਾਪਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan basero daas daasan ko thaapiu thaapanahaarai ||
english: What power does the slave of Your slave have, O Establisher and Disestablisher?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਤਬ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naam na bisarai tab jeevan paaeeai binatee naanak ih saarai ||2||29||52||
english: If I do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then I die. Nanak offers this prayer. ||2||29||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: man te bhai bhau door paraaio ||
english: I have shaken off fear and dread from my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਲਾਲ ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laal daiaal gulaal laadile sahaj sahaj gun gaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With intuitive ease, peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Kind, Sweet, Darling Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanaat kamaat kripaa te bahur na katahoo dhaaio ||
english: Practicing the Guru's Word, by His Grace, I do not wander anywhere anymore.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rahat upaadh samaadh sukh aasan bhagat vachhal grihi paaio ||1||
english: The illusion has been dispelled; I am in Samaadhi, Sukh-aasan, the position of peace. I have found the Lord, the Lover of His devotees, within the home of my own heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: naad binod kod aana(n)daa sahaje sahaj samaaio ||
english: | The Sound-current of the Naad, playful joys and pleasures - I am intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੫੩॥
transliteration: karanaa aap karaavan aape kahu naanak aap aapaaio ||2||30||53||
english: He Himself is the Creator, the Cause of causes. Says Nanak, He Himself is All-in-all. ||2||30||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam manahi aadhaaro ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin deeaa tis kai kurabaanai gur poore namasakaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the One who gave it to me; I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: boojhee trisanaa sahaj suhelaa kaam krodh bikh jaaro ||
english: My thirst is quenched, and I have been intuitively embellished. The poisons of sexual desire and anger have been burnt away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੈ ਇਹ ਠਾਹਰ ਜਹ ਆਸਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aai na jaai basai ih thaahar jah aasan nira(n)kaaro ||1||
english: This mind does not come and go; it abides in that place, where the Formless Lord sits. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਏਕੈ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: ekai paragat ekai gupataa ekai dhu(n)dhookaaro ||
english: The One Lord is manifest and radiant; the One Lord is hidden and mysterious. The One Lord is abysmal darkness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੩੧॥੫੪॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh soee kahu naanak saach beechaaro ||2||31||54||
english: From the beginning, throughout the middle and until the end, is God. Says Nanak, reflect on the Truth. ||2||31||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਘਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin prabh rahan na jaai gharee ||
english: Without God, I cannot survive, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sookh taahoo kai pooran jaa kai sukh hai haree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who finds joy in the Lord finds total peace and perfection. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਘਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gal roop praan jeevan dhan simarat anad ghanaa ||
english: God is the Embodiment of bliss, the Breath of Life and Wealth; remembering Him in meditation, I am blessed with absolute bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੇ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਭਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vad samarath sadaa sad sa(n)ge gun rasanaa kavan bhanaa ||1||
english: He is utterly All-powerful, with me forever and ever; what tongue can utter His Glorious Praises? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਹਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: thaan pavitraa maan pavitraa pavitr sunan kahanahaare ||
english: His Place is sacred, and His Glory is sacred; sacred are those who listen and speak of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੨॥੫੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak te bhavan pavitraa jaa mahi sa(n)t tumhaare ||2||32||55||
english: Says Nanak, that dwelling is sacred, in which Your Saints live. ||2||32||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਤੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa japatee toohee toohee ||
english: My tongue chants Your Name, Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਇਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh tum hee pratipaalak mrit ma(n)dal ik tuhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the mother's womb, You sustained me, and in this mortal world, You alone help me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tumahi pitaa tum hee phun maataa tumahi meet hit bhraataa ||
english: You are my Father, and You are my Mother; You are my Loving Friend and Sibling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tum paravaar tumahi aadhaaraa tumahi jee praanadaataa ||1||
english: You are my Family, and You are my Support. You are the Giver of the Breath of Life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜਰੀਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tumahi khajeenaa tumahi jareenaa tum hee maanik laalaa ||
english: You are my Treasure, and You are my Wealth. You are my Gems and Jewels.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੩॥੫੬॥
transliteration: tumahi paarajaat gur te paae tau naanak bhae nihaalaa ||2||33||56||
english: You are the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree. Nanak has found You through the Guru, and now he is enraptured. ||2||33||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਹੂ ਕਾਹੂ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaahoo kaahoo apuno hee chit aavai ||
english: Wherever he goes, his consciousness turns to his own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਚੇਰੋ ਹੋਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kaahoo ko chero hovat thaakur hee pahi jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever is a chaylaa (a servant) goes only to his Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: apane pahi dookh apane pahi sookhaa apune hee pahi birathaa ||
english: He shares his sorrows, his joys and his condition only with his own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਤਾਨਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਥਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apune pahi maan apune pahi taanaa apane hee pahi arathaa ||1||
english: He obtains honor from his own, and strength from his own; he gets an advantage from his own. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਮਿਲਖਾ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kin hee raaj joban dhan milakhaa kin hee baap mahataaree ||
english: Some have regal power, youth, wealth and property; some have a father and a mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੫੭॥
transliteration: sarab thok naanak gur paae pooran aas hamaaree ||2||34||57||
english: I have obtained all things, O Nanak, from the Guru. My hopes have been fulfilled. ||2||34||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jhootho maaiaa ko mad maan ||
english: False is intoxication and pride in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhroh moh door kar bapure sa(n)g gopaalahi jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Get rid of your fraud and attachment, O wretched mortal, and remember that the Lord of the World is with you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਉਮਰੇ ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਅਰੁ ਖਾਨ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa raaj joban ar umare meer malak ar khaan ||
english: False are royal powers, youth, nobility, kings, rulers and aristocrats.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਪਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mithiaa kaapar suga(n)dh chaturaaee mithiaa bhojan paan ||1||
english: False are the fine clothes, perfumes and clever tricks; false are the foods and drinks. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਰੋ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: deen ba(n)dharo daas daasaro sa(n)tah kee saaraan ||
english: O Patron of the meek and the poor, I am the slave of Your slaves; I seek the Sanctuary of Your Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਗਨਿ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥੨॥੩੫॥੫੮॥
transliteration: maa(n)gan maa(n)gau hoi achi(n)taa mil naanak ke har praan ||2||35||58||
english: I humbly ask, I beg of You, please relieve my anxiety; O Lord of Life, please unite Nanak with Yourself. ||2||35||58||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਇਤਨੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: apunee itanee kachhoo na saaree ||
english: By himself, the mortal cannot accomplish anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਾਜ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਵਰਤਾ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਆਨ ਜੰਜਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik kaaj anik dhaavarataa urajhio aan ja(n)jaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He runs around chasing all sorts of projects, engrossed in other entanglements. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਉਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਹਾਂ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਹ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dius chaar ke deesahi sa(n)gee oohaa(n) naahee jah bhaaree ||
english: His companions of these few days will not be there when he is in trouble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin siu raach maach hit laaio jo kaam nahee gaavaaree ||1||
english: He is hand and glove with those who are of no use to him; the poor wretch is affectionately involved with them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਹਮਰੋ ਬਸੁ ਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hau naahee naahee kichh meraa naa hamaro bas chaaree ||
english: I am nothing; nothing belongs to me. I have no power or control.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੬॥੫੯॥
transliteration: karan karaavan naanak ke prabh sa(n)tan sa(n)g udhaaree ||2||36||59||
english: O Creator, Cause of causes, Lord God of Nanak, I am saved and redeemed in the Society of the Saints. ||2||36||59||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mohanee mohat rahai na horee ||
english: The Great Enticer Maya keeps enticing, and cannot be stopped.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal kee piaaree tutai na kaahoo toree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: She is the Beloved of all the Siddhas and seekers; no one can fend her off. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਉਚਰਤ ਰਸਨਾਗਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਵਨ ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khat saasatr ucharat rasanaagar teerath gavan na thoree ||
english: Reciting the six Shaastras and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage do not decrease her power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤਪੀਆ ਊਹਾ ਗੈਲਿ ਨ ਛੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poojaa chakr barat nem tapeeaa oohaa gail na chhoree ||1||
english: Devotional worship, ceremonial religious marks, fasting, vows and penance - none of these will make her release her hold. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਤ ਜਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahi patit hot jag sa(n)tahu karahu param gat moree ||
english: The world has fallen into the deep dark pit. O Saints, please bless me with the supreme status of salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਓ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੭॥੬੦॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat naanak bhaio mukataa darasan pekhat bhoree ||2||37||60||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has been liberated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||37||60||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੇ ਖਾਟਿ ਖਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kahaa karahi re khaat khaatulee ||
english: Why are you working so hard to earn profits?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨਿ ਅਫਾਰ ਤੋਰ ਚਾਮਰੋ ਅਤਿ ਜਜਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pavan aphaar tor chaamaro at jajaree teree re maatulee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are puffed up like a bag of air, and your skin is very brittle. Your body has grown old and dusty. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿਓ ਊਹਾ ਲੇ ਧਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸਾ ਮਾਸ ਦੇਤ ਝਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
transliteration: oohee te hario oohaa le dhario jaise baasaa maas det jhaatulee ||
english: You move things from here to there, like the hawk swooping down on the flesh of its prey.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਸਫਰੀ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: devanahaar bisaario a(n)dhule jiu sapharee udar bharai bahi haatulee ||1||
english: You are blind - you have forgotten the Great Giver. You fill your belly like a traveller at an inn. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਝੂਠ ਰਸ ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਭੀਰ ਬਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
transliteration: saad bikaar bikaar jhooth ras jah jaano tah bheer baatulee ||
english: You are entangled in the taste of false pleasures and corrupt sins; the path which you have to take is very narrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਝੁ ਰੇ ਇਆਨੇ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਖੁਲੑੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਾਂਠੁਲੀ ॥੨॥੩੮॥੬੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak samajh re iaane aaj kaal khulhai teree gaa(n)thulee ||2||38||61||
english: Says Nanak: figure it out, you ignorant fool! Today or tomorrow, the knot will be untied! ||2||38||61||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੀਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
transliteration: gur jeeu sa(n)g tuhaarai jaanio ||
english: O Dear Guru, by associating with You, I have come to know the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਧ ਉਆ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਗਹ ਭੀ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot jodh uaa kee baat na puchheeai taa(n) daragah bhee maanio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: There are millions of heroes, and no one pays any attention to them, but in the Court of the Lord, I am honored and respected. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kavan mool praanee kaa kaheeai kavan roop drisataanio ||
english: What is the origin of the human beings? How beautiful they are!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਬਖਾਨਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jot pragaas bhaee maatee sa(n)g dulabh deh bakhaanio ||1||
english: When God infuses His Light into clay, the human body is judged to be precious. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਸੇਵ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਜਪ ਤਾਪਾ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਓ ॥
transliteration: tum te sev tum te jap taapaa tum te tat pachhaanio ||
english: From You, I have learned to serve; from You, I have learned to chant and meditate; from You, I have realized the essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕਟੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨਿਓ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੬੨॥
transliteration: kar masatak dhar katee jevaree naanak daas dasaanio ||2||39||62||
english: Placing His Hand on my forehead, He has cut away the bonds which held me; O Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves. ||2||39||62||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har har deeo sevak kau naam ||
english: The Lord has blessed His servant with His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਭਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਖਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maanas kaa ko bapuro bhaaee jaa ko raakhaa raam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What can any poor mortal do to someone who has the Lord as his Savior and Protector? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਹਾ ਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੰਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aap mahaa jan aape pa(n)chaa aap sevak kai kaam ||
english: He Himself is the Great Being; He Himself is the Leader. He Himself accomplishes the tasks of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape sagale doot bidaare thaakur a(n)tarajaam ||1||
english: Our Lord and Master destroys all demons; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: aape pat raakhee sevak kee aap keeo ba(n)dhaan ||
english: He Himself saves the honor of His servants; He Himself blesses them with stability.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੪੦॥੬੩॥
transliteration: aad jugaad sevak kee raakhai naanak ko prabh jaan ||2||40||63||
english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He saves His servants. O Nanak, how rare is the person who knows God. ||2||40||63||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: too mere meet sakhaa har praan ||
english: O Lord, You are my Best Friend, my Companion, my Breath of Life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤੋ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਧਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man dhan jeeu pi(n)d sabh tumaraa ihu tan seeto tumarai dhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind, wealth, body and soul are all Yours; this body is sewn together by Your Blessing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦੀਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦੀਏ ਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: tum hee deee anik prakaaraa tum hee deee maan ||
english: You have blessed me with all sorts of gifts; you have blessed me with honor and respect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa tum hee pat raakhahu a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||1||
english: Forever and ever, You preserve my honor, O Inner-knower, O Searcher of hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jin sa(n)tan jaaniaa too thaakur te aae paravaan ||
english: Those Saints who know You, O Lord and Master - blessed and approved is their coming into the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੬੪॥
transliteration: jan kaa sa(n)g paaeeai vadabhaagee naanak sa(n)tan kai kurabaan ||2||41||64||
english: The Congregation of those humble beings is obtained by great good fortune; Nanak is a sacrifice to the Saints. ||2||41||64||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karahu gat daiaal sa(n)tahu moree ||
english: Save me, O Merciful Saint!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tum samarath kaaran karanaa tootee tum hee joree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the All-powerful Cause of causes. You have ended my separation, and joined me with God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਖਈ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke bikhaee tum taare sumat sa(n)g tumaarai paaee ||
english: You save us from the corruption and sins of countless incarnations; associating with You, we obtain sublime understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik jon bhramate prabh bisarat saas saas har gaaee ||1||
english: Forgetting God, we wandered through countless incarnations; with each and every breath, we sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo jo sa(n)g mile saadhoo kai te te patit puneetaa ||
english: Whoever meets with the Holy Saints - those sinners are sanctified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੨॥੪੨॥੬੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke vadabhaagaa tin janam padaarath jeetaa ||2||42||65||
english: Says Nanak, those who have such high destiny, win this invaluable human life. ||2||42||65||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਨ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: thaakur binatee karan jan aaio ||
english: O my Lord and Master, Your humble servant has come to offer this prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਸੁਨਤ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sookh aana(n)d sahaj ras sunat tuhaaro naaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Hearing Your Name, I am blessed with total peace, bliss, poise and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਕੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਸੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਛਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan sookh ke saagar jas sabh mahi jaa ko chhaaio ||
english: The Treasure of Mercy, the Ocean of Peace - His Praises are diffused everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g ra(n)g tum keee apanaa aap drisataaio ||1||
english: O Lord, You celebrate in the Society of the Saints; You reveal Yourself to them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਨ ਝਾਰੀ ਕੇਸਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: nainahu sa(n)g sa(n)tan kee sevaa charan jhaaree kesaaio ||
english: With my eyes I see the Saints, and dedicate myself to serving them; I wash their feet with my hair.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੬੬॥
transliteration: aath pahar darasan sa(n)tan kaa sukh naanak ihu paaio ||2||43||66||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Saints; this is the peace and comfort which Nanak has received. ||2||43||66||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee ||
english: One who is lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਜਨੁ ਸੁਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sajan suridaa suhelaa sahaje so kaheeai badabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: is a good-hearted friend, intuitively embellished with happiness. He is said to be blessed and fortunate. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: rahit bikaar alap maaiaa te aha(n)budh bikh tiaagee ||
english: He is rid of sin and corruption, and detached from Maya; he has renounced the poison of egotistical intellect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਏਕਹਿ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੀਐਂ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daras piaas aas ekahi kee tek heeai(n) pri paagee ||1||
english: He thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and he places his hopes in the One Lord alone. The Feet of his Beloved are the Support of his heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਸੋਇ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਸਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t soi jaagan uth baisan achi(n)t hasat bairaagee ||
english: He sleeps, wakes, rises up and sits down without anxiety; he laughs and cries without anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਠਗਾਨਾ ਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਠਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੪੪॥੬੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin jagat thagaanaa s maaiaa har jan thaagee ||2||44||67||
english: Says Nanak, she who has cheated the world - that Maya is cheated by the humble servant of the Lord. ||2||44||67||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ab jan oopar ko na pukaarai ||
english: Now, no one complains about the Lord's humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਕਾਰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pookaaran kau jo udam karataa gur paramesar taa kau maarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever tries to complain is destroyed by the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਓਹੁ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: niravairai sa(n)g vair rachaavai har daragah ohu haarai ||
english: Whoever harbors vengeance against the One who is beyond all vengenace, shall lose in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aad jugaad prabh kee vadiaaee jan kee paij savaarai ||1||
english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, it is the glorious greatness of God, that He preserves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae sagal bhau mitiaa charan kamal aadhaarai ||
english: The mortal becomes fearless, and all his fears are taken away, when he leans on the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੪੫॥੬੮॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan japio naau naanak pragat bhaio sa(n)saarai ||2||45||68||
english: Chanting the Name, through the Guru's Word, Nanak has become famous throughout the world. ||2||45||68||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
transliteration: har jan chhodiaa sagalaa aap ||
english: The Lord's humble servant has discarded all self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu rakhahu gusaaee pekh jeevaa(n) parataap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As You see fit, You save us, O Lord of the World. Beholding Your Glorious Grandeur, I live. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: gur upades saadh kee sa(n)gat binasio sagal sa(n)taap ||
english: Through the Guru's Instruction, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sorrow and suffering is taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mitr satr pekh samat beechaario sagal sa(n)bhaakhan jaap ||1||
english: I look upon friend and enemy alike; all that I speak is the Lord's meditation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: tapat bujhee seetal aaghaane sun anahad bisam bhae bisamaad ||
english: The fire within me is quenched; I am cool, calm and tranquil. Hearing the unstruck celestial melody, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਦ ॥੨॥੪੬॥੬੯॥
transliteration: anad bhaiaa naanak man saachaa pooran poore naad ||2||46||69||
english: I am in ecstasy, O Nanak, and my mind is filled with Truth, through the perfect perfection of the Sound-current of the Naad. ||2||46||69||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: merai gur moro sahasaa utaariaa ||
english: My Guru has rid me of my cynicism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਈਐ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kai jaaeeai balihaaree sadaa sadaa hau vaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that Guru; I am devoted to Him, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa naam japio din raatee gur ke charan man dhaariaa ||
english: I chant the Guru's Name day and night; I enshrine the Guru's Feet within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kee dhoor karau nit majan kilavikh mail utaariaa ||1||
english: I bathe continually in the dust of the Guru's Feet, washing off my dirty sins. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee karau nit sevaa gur apanaa namasakaariaa ||
english: I continually serve the Perfect Guru; I humbly bow to my Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਦੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੪੭॥੭੦॥
transliteration: sarab phalaa deenhe gur poorai naanak gur nisataariaa ||2||47||70||
english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with all fruitful rewards; O Nanak, the Guru has emancipated me. ||2||47||70||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam praan gat paavai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal attains salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mitahi kales traas sabh naasai saadhasa(n)g hit laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His sorrows are dispelled, and his fears are all erased; he is in love with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har har har har man aaraadhe rasanaa har jas gaavai ||
english: His mind worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; his tongue sings the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan kaam krodh ni(n)daa baasudev ra(n)g laavai ||1||
english: Abandoning egotistical pride, sexual desire, anger and slander, he embraces love for the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਤ ਸੋੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: daamodar daiaal aaraadhahu gobi(n)d karat souhaavai ||
english: Worship and adore the Merciful Lord God; chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, you shall be embellished and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੪੮॥੭੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sabh kee hoi renaa har har daras samaavai ||2||48||71||
english: Says Nanak, whoever becomes the dust of all, merges in the Blesed Vision of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||48||71||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: apune gur poore balihaarai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਕੀਓ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pragat prataap keeo naam ko raakhe raakhanahaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
