english: My Savior Lord has saved me; He has revealed the Glory of His Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੀਏ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau keee sevak daas apane sagale dookh bidaarai ||
english: He makes His servants and slaves fearless, and takes away all their pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan upaav tiaag jan sagale charan kamal rid dhaarai ||1||
english: So renounce all other efforts, and enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: praan adhaar meet saajan prabh ekai eka(n)kaarai ||
english: God is the Support of the breath of life, my Best Friend and Companion, the One and Only Creator of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੪੯॥੭੨॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch thaakur naanak kaa baar baar namasakaarai ||2||49||72||
english: Nanak's Lord and Master is the Highest of all; again and again, I humbly bow to Him. ||2||49||72||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਕੋ ਕਹਾ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bin har hai ko kahaa bataavahu ||
english: Tell me: other than the Lord, who exists?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh samooh karunaa mai karataa tis prabh sadaa dhiaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Creator, the Embodiment of Mercy, bestows all comforts; meditate forever on that God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਏ ਜੰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai soot paroe ja(n)taa tis prabh kaa jas gaavahu ||
english: All creatures are strung on His Thread; sing the Praises of that God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਆਨ ਕਹਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simar thaakur jin sabh kichh deenaa aan kahaa pahi jaavahu ||1||
english: Meditate in remembrance on that Lord and Master who gives you everything. Why would you go to anyone else? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saphal sevaa suaamee mere kee man baa(n)chhat phal paavahu ||
english: Service to my Lord and Master is fruitful and rewarding; from Him, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੫੦॥੭੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak laabh laahaa lai chaalahu sukh setee ghar jaavahu ||2||50||73||
english: Says Nanak, take your profits and leave; you shall go to your true home in peace. ||2||50||73||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: thaakur tumh saranaaee aaiaa ||
english: O my Lord and Master, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: utar gaio mere man kaa sa(n)saa jab te darasan paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The anxiety of my mind departed, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਬੋਲਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anabolat meree birathaa jaanee apanaa naam japaaiaa ||
english: You know my condition, without my speaking. You inspire me to chant Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਅਨਦ ਅਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh naathe sukh sahaj samaae anad anad gun gaaiaa ||1||
english: My pains are gone, and I am absorbed in peace, poise and bliss, singing Your Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਕਢਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baah pakar kadh leene apune grih a(n)dh koop te maaiaa ||
english: Taking me by the arm, You lifted me up, out of the deep dark pit of household and Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੫੧॥੭੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur ba(n)dhan kaate bichhurat aan milaaiaa ||2||51||74||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has broken my bonds, and ended my separation; He has united me with God. ||2||51||74||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਠਾਂਢੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kee gat thaa(n)dhee ||
english: The Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਕਾਢੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan simrit saadhoo jan khojat khojat kaadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Searching, searching the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the Holy Saints have realized this. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚ ਅਰੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਤੌ ਫਿਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: siv bira(n)ch ar i(n)dr lok taa mahi jalatau phiriaa ||
english: In the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and Indra, I wandered around, burning up with envy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simar simar suaamee bhae seetal dookh darad bhram hiriaa ||1||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, I became cool and calm; my pains, sorrows and doubts are gone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤਰਿਓ ਪੁਰਾਤਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jo jo tario puraatan navatan bhagat bhaai har devaa ||
english: Whoever has been saved in the past or the present, was saved through loving devotional worship of the Divine Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੫੨॥੭੫॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh jeeu milai sa(n)t jan sevaa ||2||52||75||
english: This is Nanak's prayer: O Dear God, please let me serve the humble Saints. ||2||52||75||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jihave a(n)mrit gun har gaau ||
english: O my tongue, sing the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਚਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har bol kathaa sun har kee ucharahu prabh ko naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, listen to the Lord's Sermon, and chant God's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ratan dhan sa(n)chahu man tan laavahu bhaau ||
english: So gather in the jewel, the wealth of the Lord's Name; love God with your mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan bibhoot mithiaa kar maanahu saachaa ihai suaau ||1||
english: You must realize that all other wealth is false; this alone is the true purpose of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee praan mukat ko daataa ekas siu liv laau ||
english: He is the Giver of the soul, the breath of life and liberation; lovingly tune in to the One and Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥੨॥੫੩॥੭੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee saranaaee det sagal apiaau ||2||53||76||
english: Says Nanak, I have entered His Sanctuary; He gives sustenance to all. ||2||53||76||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: hotee nahee kavan kachh karanee ||
english: I cannot do anything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੈ ਓਟ ਪਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihai ot paaee mil sa(n)tah gopaal ek kee saranee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have taken this Support, meeting the Saints; I have entered the Sanctuary of the One Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch dokh chhidr iaa tan mahi bikhai biaadh kee karanee ||
english: The five wicked enemies are within this body; they lead the mortal to practice evil and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅਪਾਰ ਦਿਨਸ ਗਣਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਲੁ ਜਰਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aas apaar dinas gan raakhe grasat jaat bal jaranee ||1||
english: He has infinite hope, but his days are numbered, and old age is sapping his strength. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਭੈ ਹਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: anaathah naath daiaal sukh saagar sarab dokh bhai haranee ||
english: He is the Help of the helpless, the Merciful Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of all pains and fears.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੪॥੭੭॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat chitavat naanak daas pekh jeevaa prabh charanee ||2||54||77||
english: Slave Nanak longs for this blessing, that he may live, gazing upon the Feet of God. ||2||54||77||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਦ ॥
transliteration: pheeke har ke naam bin saad ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, flavors are tasteless and insipid.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras keeratan har gaaeeai ahinis pooran naad ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sing the Sweet Ambrosial Praises of the Lord's Kirtan; day and night, the Sound-current of the Naad will resonate and resound. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖਾਦ ॥
transliteration: simarat saa(n)t mahaa sukh paaeeai mit jaahi sagal bikhaad ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, total peace and bliss are obtained, and all sorrows are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵਹੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har laabh saadhasa(n)g paaeeai ghar lai aavahu laad ||1||
english: The profit of the Lord, Har, Har, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; so load it and bring it on home. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਜਾਦ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch ooch te oocho a(n)t nahee marajaad ||
english: He is the Highest of all, the Highest of the high; His celestial ecomony has no limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੫੫॥੭੮॥
transliteration: baran na saakau naanak mahimaa pekh rahe bisamaad ||2||55||78||
english: Nanak cannot even express His Glorious Grandeur; gazing upon Him, he is wonder-struck. ||2||55||78||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਸੁਨਨ ਪੜਨ ਕਉ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aaio sunan paRan kau baanee ||
english: The mortal came to hear and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar lagahi an laalach birathaa janam paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But he has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he has become attached to other temptations. His life is totally worthless! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਝੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਥੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: samajh achet chet man mere kathee sa(n)tan akath kahaanee ||
english: O my unconscious mind, become conscious and figure it out; the Saints speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਭੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laabh laihu har ridai araadhahu chhutakai aavan jaanee ||1||
english: So gather in your profits - worship and adore the Lord within your heart; your coming and going in reincarnation shall end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: udam sakat siaanap tumhree dehi ta naam vakhaanee ||
english: Efforts, powers and clever tricks are Yours; if You bless me with them, I repeat Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੬॥੭੯॥
transliteration: seee bhagat bhagat se laage naanak jo prabh bhaanee ||2||56||79||
english: They alone are devotees, and they alone are attached to devotional worship, O Nanak, who are pleasing to God. ||2||56||79||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanava(n)t naam ke vanajaare ||
english: Those who deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)jhee karahu naam dhan khaatahu gur kaa sabad veechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So become a partner with them, and earn the wealth of the Naam. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: chhodahu kapat hoi niravairaa so prabh sa(n)g nihaare ||
english: Abandon your deception, and go beyond vengeance; see God who is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach dhan vanajahu sach dhan sa(n)chahu kabahoo na aavahu haare ||1||
english: Deal only in this true wealth and gather in this true wealth, and you shall never suffer loss. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khaat kharachat kichh nikhutat naahee aganat bhare bha(n)daare ||
english: Eating and consuming it, it is never exhausted; God's treasures are overflowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੫੭॥੮੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sobhaa sa(n)g jaavahu paarabraham kai duaare ||2||57||80||
english: Says Nanak, you shall go home to the Court of the Supreme Lord God with honor and respect. ||2||57||80||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee mohi kavan anaath bichaaraa ||
english: O Dear God, I am wretched and helpless!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan mool te maanukh kariaa ihu parataap tuhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: From what source did you create humans? This is Your Glorious Grandeur. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee praan sarab ke daate gun kahe na jaahi apaaraa ||
english: You are the Giver of the soul and the breath of life to all; Your Infinite Glories cannot be spoken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾਂ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh ke preetam srab pratipaalak sarab ghataa(n) aadhaaraa ||1||
english: You are the Beloved Lord of all, the Cherisher of all, the Support of all hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: koi na jaanai tumaree gat mit aapahi ek pasaaraa ||
english: No one knows Your state and extent. You alone created the expanse of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਵ ਬੈਠਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫੮॥੮੧॥
transliteration: saadh naav baithaavahu naanak bhav saagar paar utaaraa ||2||58||81||
english: Please, give me a seat in the boat of the Holy; O Nanak, thus I shall cross over this terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other shore. ||2||58||81||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aavai raam saran vadabhaagee ||
english: One who comes to the Lord's Sanctuary is very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekas bin kichh hor na jaanai avar upaav tiaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He knows of no other than the One Lord. He has renounced all other efforts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man bach kram aaraadhai har har saadhasa(n)g sukh paaiaa ||
english: He worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, in thought, word and deed; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anad binod akath kathaa ras saachai sahaj samaaiaa ||1||
english: He enjoys bliss and pleasure, and savors the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; he merges intuitively into the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jo apunaa keeno taa kee ootam baanee ||
english: Sublime and exalted is the speech of one whom the Lord, in His Mercy makes His Own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੯॥੮੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak nisatareeai jo raate prabh nirabaanee ||2||59||82||
english: Those who are imbued with God in the state of Nirvaanaa, O Nanak, are emancipated in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||59||82||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa te saadhoo saran gahee ||
english: Since I grasped hold of the Sanctuary of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj man bhaio pragaasaa birathaa kachh na rahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: my mind is illuminated with tranquility, peace and poise, and I am rid of all my pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਏਹ ਕਹੀ ॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal naam dehu apunaa binatee eh kahee ||
english: Please be merciful to me, O Lord, and bless me with Your Name; this is the prayer I offer to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan biuhaar bisare prabh simarat paaio laabh sahee ||1||
english: I have forgotten my other occupations; remembering God in meditation, I have obtained the true profit. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਸਾਈ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jah te upajio tahee samaano saaee basat ahee ||
english: We shall merge again into the One from whom we came; He is the Essence of Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਓ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਹੀ ॥੨॥੬੦॥੮੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoio jotee jot samahee ||2||60||83||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has eradicated my doubt; my light has merged into the Light. ||2||60||83||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam ko jas gaau ||
english: O my tongue, sing the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਲੋ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan suaad bisaar sagale bhalo naam suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Abandon all other tastes and flavors; the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is so sublime. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal basaai hiradai ek siu liv laau ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart; let yourself be lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat hohi niramal bahuR jon na aau ||1||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become immaculate and pure; you shall not come to be reincarnated again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan adhaar teraa too nithaave thaau ||
english: You are the Support of the soul and the breath of life; You are the Home of the homeless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥੬੧॥੮੪॥
transliteration: saas saas samhaal har har naanak sad bal jaau ||2||61||84||
english: With each and every breath, I dwell on the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||61||84||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: baiku(n)th gobi(n)d charan nit dhiaau ||
english: To meditate on the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe is heaven for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mukat padaarath saadhoo sa(n)gat a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the treasure of liberation and the Lord's Ambrosial Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ootam kathaa suneejai sravanee maiaa karahu bhagavaan ||
english: O Lord God, please be kind to me, that I may hear with my ears Your Sublime and Exalted Sermon.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਦੋਊ ਪਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavat jaat dooo pakh pooran paaeeai sukh bisraam ||1||
english: My cycle of coming and going is finally completed, and I have attained peace and tranquility. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sodhat sodhat tat beechaario bhagat saresat pooree ||
english: Searching and searching, I have realized the essence of reality: devotional worship is the most sublime fulfillment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਊਰੀ ॥੨॥੬੨॥੮੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ik raam naam bin avar sagal bidh ooree ||2||62||85||
english: Says Nanak, without the Name of the One Lord, all other ways are imperfect. ||2||62||85||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saache satiguroo daataaraa ||
english: The True Guru is the True Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekh sagal dukh naasahi charan kamal balihaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my pains are dispelled. I am a sacrifice to His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sat paramesar sat saadh jan nihachal har kaa naau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is True, and True are the Holy Saints; the Name of the Lord is steady and stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaavanee paarabraham kee abinaasee gun gaau ||1||
english: So worship the Imperishable, Supreme Lord God with love, and sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar mit nahee paaeeai sagal ghataa aadhaar ||
english: The limits of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be found; He is the Support of all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਹੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬੩॥੮੬॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu kahu taa kau jaa kaa a(n)t na paar ||2||63||86||
english: O Nanak, chant, "Waaho! Waaho!" to Him, who has no end or limitation. ||2||63||86||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan base man merai ||
english: The Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੈ ਸਭ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poor rahio thaakur sabh thaaee nikat basai sabh nerai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places; He dwells nearby, close to all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan tor raam liv laaee sa(n)tasa(n)g ban aaee ||
english: Breaking my bonds, I have lovingly tuned in to the Lord, and now the Saints are pleased with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਇਛਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam padaarath bhaio puneetaa ichhaa sagal pujaaee ||1||
english: This precious human life has been sanctified, and all my desires have been fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau kripaa karahu prabh mere so har kaa jas gaavai ||
english: O my God, whoever You bless with Your Mercy - he alone sings Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬੪॥੮੭॥
transliteration: aath pahar gobi(n)d gun gaavai jan naanak sad bal jaavai ||2||64||87||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to that person who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||64||87||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਉ ਗਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevan tau ganeeai har pekhaa ||
english: A person is judged to be alive, only if he sees the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮ ਕੀ ਰੇਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa preetam manamohan phor bharam kee rekhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please be merciful to me, O my Enticing Beloved Lord, and erase the record of my doubts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਸ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਖਾਂ ॥
transliteration: kahat sunat kichh saa(n)t na upajat bin bisaas kiaa sekhaa(n) ||
english: By speaking and listening, tranquility and peace are not found at all. What can anyone learn without faith?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਲੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabhoo tiaag aan jo chaahat taa kai mukh laagai kaalekhaa ||1||
english: One who renounces God and longs for another - his face is blackened with filth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai raas sarab sukh suaamee aan na maanat bhekhaa ||
english: One who is blessed with the wealth of our Lord and Master, the Embodiment of Peace, does not believe in any other religious doctrine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੨॥੬੫॥੮੮॥
transliteration: naanak daras magan man mohio pooran arath bisekhaa ||2||65||88||
english: O Nanak, one whose mind is fascinated and intoxicated with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan - his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||2||65||88||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: simaran raam ko ik naam ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਮਲ ਦਗਧ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kalamal dagadh hohi khin a(n)tar kot daan isanaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this way, the sins of your past mistakes shall be burnt off in an instant. It is like giving millions in charity, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਜੰਜਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਘਾਲਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: aan ja(n)jaar brithaa sram ghaalat bin har phokat giaan ||
english: Entangled in other affairs, the mortal suffers uselessly in sorrow. Without the Lord, wisdom is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਭਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran sa(n)kat te chhootai jagadees bhajan sukh dhiaan ||1||
english: The mortal is freed of the anguish of death and birth, meditating and vibrating on the Blissful Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
transliteration: teree saran pooran sukh saagar kar kirapaa devahu daan ||
english: I seek Your Sancutary, O Perfect Lord, Ocean of Peace. Please be merciful, and bless me with this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੬੬॥੮੯॥
transliteration: simar simar naanak prabh jeevai binas jaai abhimaan ||2||66||89||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, Nanak lives; his egotistical pride has been eradicated. ||2||66||89||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਰਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿ ਧੁਰ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: dhoorat soee j dhur kau laagai ||
english: He alone is a Dhoorat, who is attached to the Primal Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਧੁਰੰਧਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਸੁੰਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: soee dhura(n)dhar soee basu(n)dhar har ek prem ras paagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is a Dhurandhar, and he alone is a Basundhar, who is absorbed in the sublime essence of Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਬੰਚ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਲਾਭੈ ਸੋ ਧੂਰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂੜੑਾ ॥
transliteration: balaba(n)ch karai na jaanai laabhai so dhoorat nahee mooRhaa ||
english: One who practices deception and does not know where true profit lies is not a Dhoorat - he is a fool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਸਾਰਥਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੂੜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: suaarath tiaag asaarath rachio nah simarai prabh rooRaa ||1||
english: He abandons profitable enterprises and is involved in unprofitable ones. He does not meditate on the Beauteous Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: soee chatur siaanaa pa(n)dit so sooraa so daanaa(n) ||
english: He alone is clever and wise and a religious scholar, he alone is a brave warrior, and he alone is intelligent,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੬੭॥੯੦॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jin har har japio naanak so paravaanaa ||2||67||90||
english: who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, he alone is approved. ||2||67||90||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ॥
transliteration: har har sa(n)t janaa kee jeevan ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the life of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bikhai ras bhog a(n)mrit sukh saagar raam naam ras peevan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Instead of enjoying corrupt pleasures, they drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name of the Lord, the Ocean of Peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੀਵਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)chan raam naam dhan ratanaa man tan bheetar seevan ||
english: They gather up the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name, and weave it into the fabric of their mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਂਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਲਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਖੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raa(n)g bhae man laalaa raam naam ras kheevan ||1||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, their minds are dyed in the deep crimson color of devotional love; they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਵਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu meenaa jal siu urajhaano raam naam sa(n)g leevan ||
english: As the fish is immersed in water, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਥੀਵਨਿ ॥੨॥੬੮॥੯੧॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t chaatrik kee niaaee har boo(n)d paan sukh theevan ||2||68||91||
english: O Nanak, the Saints are like the rainbirds; they are comforted, drinking in the drops of the Lord's Name. ||2||68||91||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har ke naamaheen betaal ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortal is a ghost.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤੇਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jetaa karan karaavan tetaa sabh ba(n)dhan ja(n)jaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All the actions he commits are just shackles and bonds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਟੈ ਕਾਲ ॥
transliteration: bin prabh sev karat an sevaa birathaa kaatai kaal ||
english: Without serving God, one who serves another wastes his time uselessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਬ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jab jam aai sa(n)ghaarai praanee tab tumaro kaun havaal ||1||
english: When the Messenger of Death comes to kill you, O mortal, what will your condition be then? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu daas apune kau sadaa sadaa kirapaal ||
english: Please protect Your slave, O Eternally Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥੬੯॥੯੨॥
transliteration: sukh nidhaan naanak prabh meraa saadhasa(n)g dhan maal ||2||69||92||
english: O Nanak, my God is the Treasure of Peace; He is the wealth and property of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||69||92||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan raam ko biuhaar ||
english: My mind and body deal only in the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ ਗੀਧੇ ਪੋਹਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat gun gaavan geedhe pohat nah sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Imbued with loving devotional worship, I sing His Glorious Praises; I am not affected by worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sravanee keeratan simaran suaamee ihu saadh ko aachaar ||
english: This is the way of life of the Holy Saint: he listens to the Kirtan, the Praises of his Lord and Master, and meditates in remembrance on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal asathit rid a(n)tar poojaa praan ko aadhaar ||1||
english: He implants the Lord's Lotus Feet deep within his heart; worship of the Lord is the support of his breath of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh deen daiaal sunahu bena(n)tee kirapaa apanee dhaar ||
english: O God, Merciful to the meek, please hear my prayer, and shower Your Blessings upon me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਉਚਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੭੦॥੯੩॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan ucharau nit rasanaa naanak sad balihaar ||2||70||93||
english: I continually chant the treasure of the Naam with my tongue; Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||2||70||93||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke naamaheen mat thoree ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, his intellect is shallow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਿਰੀਧਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਅੰਧ ਦੁਖ ਘੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simarat naahi sireedhar thaakur milat a(n)dh dukh ghoree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, his Lord and Master; the blind fool suffers in terrible agony. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam siu preet na laagee anik bhekh bahu joree ||
english: He does not embrace love for the Name of the Lord; he is totally attached to various religious robes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਟਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਿਉ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tootat baar na laagai taa kau jiu gaagar jal phoree ||1||
english: His attachments are shattered in an instant; when the pitcher is broken, the water runs out. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਖਚਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagat ras deejai man khachit prem ras khoree ||
english: Please bless me, that I may worship You in loving devotion. My mind is absorbed and intoxicated with Your Delicious Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੭੧॥੯੪॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee prabh bin aan na horee ||2||71||94||
english: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary; without God, there is no other at all. ||2||71||94||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਵਾ ਅਉਸਰ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: chitavau vaa ausar man maahi ||
english: In my mind, I think about that moment,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hoi ikatr milahu sa(n)t saajan gun gobi(n)d nit gaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: when I join the Gathering of the Friendly Saints, constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhajan jete kaam kareeahi tete birathe jaa(n)hi ||
english: Without vibrating and meditating on the Lord, whatever deeds you do will be useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran paramaana(n)d man meetho tis bin doosar naahi ||1||
english: The Perfect Embodiment of Supreme Bliss is so sweet to my mind. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਧਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam karam sukh saadhan tul na kachhooai laahi ||
english: Chanting, deep meditation, austere self-discipline, good deeds and other techniques to being peace - they are not equal to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੭੨॥੯੫॥
transliteration: charan kamal naanak man bedhio charanah sa(n)g samaahi ||2||72||95||
english: Nanak's mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord; it is absorbed in His Lotus Feet. ||2||72||95||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh sa(n)ge a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: My God is always with me; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਪਾਛੈ ਖੇਮ ਸੂਖਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aagai kusal paachhai khem sookhaa simarat naam suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I find happiness in the world hereafter, and peace and pleasure in this world, meditating in remembrance on the Name of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet sakhaa har merai gun goupaal har raaiaa ||
english: The Lord is my Best Friend, my Buddy, my Companion. I sing the Glorious Praises of my Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisar na jaaee nimakh hiradai te poorai guroo milaaiaa ||1||
english: I shall not forget Him in my heart, even for an instant; I have met with the Perfect Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhe daas apane jee ja(n)t vas jaa kai ||
english: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; all beings and creatures are in His Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੨॥੭੩॥੯੬॥
transliteration: ekaa liv pooran paramesur bhau nahee naanak taa kai ||2||73||96||
english: One who is lovingly attuned to the One, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God, O Nanak, is rid of all fear. ||2||73||96||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai raam ko bal hoi ||
english: One who has the Lord's Power on his side

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooran taahoo ke dookh na biaapai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - all his desires are fulfilled, and no pain afflicts him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo jan bhagat daas nij prabh kaa sun jeevaa(n) tis soi ||
english: That humble devotee is a slave of his God, who listens to Him, and so lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕੌ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: udam karau darasan pekhan kau karam paraapat hoi ||1||
english: I have made the effort to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; it is obtained only by good karma. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee drisat nihaarau doosar naahee koi ||
english: It is only by Guru's Grace that I see His Vision with my eyes which none can equal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥੭੪॥੯੭॥
transliteration: daan dehi naanak apane kau charan jeevaa(n) sa(n)t dhoi ||2||74||97||
english: Please bless Nanak with this Gift, that he may wash the Feet of the Saints, and so live. ||2||74||97||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jeevat raam ke gun gaai ||
english: I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੇ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa gopaal beethule bisar na kab hee jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please be Merciful to me, O my Loving Lord of the Universe, that I may never forget You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhan sabh tumaraa suaamee aan na doojee jaai ||
english: My mind, body, wealth and all are Yours, O my Lord and Master; there is nowhere else for me at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਪੈਨੑੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu too raakhahi tiv hee rahanaa tumhraa painhai khaai ||1||
english: As You keep me, so do I survive; I eat and I wear whatever You give me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai bal bal jaaee bahuR na janamaa dhaai ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I shall never again fall into reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥੭੫॥੯੮॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai ||2||75||98||
english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sancuary, Lord; as it pleases Your Will, so do You guide him. ||2||75||98||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: man re naam ko sukh saar ||
english: O my mind, the Naam is the most sublime peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਕਾਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan kaam bikaar maaiaa sagal deesahi chhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Other affairs of Maya are corrupt. They are nothing more than dust. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਤਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: grihi a(n)dh koop patit praanee narak ghor gubaar ||
english: The mortal has fallen into the deep dark pit of household attachment; it is a horrible, dark hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik jonee bhramat haario bhramat baara(n) baar ||1||
english: He wanders in various incarnations, growing weary; he wanders through them again and again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan bhagat bachhal deen kirapaa dhaar ||
english: O Purifier of sinners, O Lover of Your devotees, please shower Your Mercy on Your meek servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੬॥੯੯॥
transliteration: kar joR naanak daan maa(n)gai saadhasa(n)g udhaar ||2||76||99||
english: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, please save me in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||76||99||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: biraajit raam ko parataap ||
english: The Glorious Radiance of the Lord has spread out everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੀਨੈ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aadh biaadh upaadh sabh naasee binase teenai taap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The doubts of my mind and body are all erased, and I am rid of the three diseases. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa bujhee pooran sabh aasaa chooke sog sa(n)taap ||
english: My thirst is quenched, and my hopes have all been fulfilled; my sorrows and sufferings are over.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee man tan aatam dhraap ||1||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, my mind, body and soul are comforted and encouraged. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਾਪ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad matasar saadhoo kai sa(n)g khaap ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, pride and envy are destroyed in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੭੭॥੧੦੦॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai kaatanahaare naanak ke maaee baap ||2||77||100||
english: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; O Nanak, He is our Mother and Father. ||2||77||100||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aatur naam bin sa(n)saar ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is miserable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tripat na hovat kookaree aasaa it laago bikhiaa chhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Like a dog, its desires are never satisfied; it clings to the ashes of corruption. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ਜਨਮਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: paai thagauree aap bhulaaio janamat baaro baar ||
english: Administering the intoxicating drug, God Himself leads the mortals astray; they are reincarnated again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kaa simaran nimakh na simario jamaka(n)kar karat khuaar ||1||
english: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death makes him suffer. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan teriaa sa(n)tah kee raavaar ||
english: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੮॥੧੦੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas daras prabh jaachai man tan ko aadhaar ||2||78||101||
english: Slave Nanak asks for the Blessed Vision of God. It is the Support of his mind and body. ||2||78||101||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mailaa har ke naam bin jeeu ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, the soul is polluted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tin prabh saachai aap bhulaaiaa bikhai thagauree peeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Lord God has Himself administered the intoxicating drug of corruption, and led the mortal astray. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀ ਥਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kot janam bhramatau bahu bhaa(n)tee thit nahee katahoo paaee ||
english: Wandering through millions of incarnations in countless ways, he does not find stability anywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur sahaj na bhetiaa saakat aavai jaaee ||1||
english: The faithless cynic does not intuitively meet with the Perfect True Guru; he continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu prabh sa(n)mrith daate tum prabh agam apaar ||
english: Please save me, O All-powerful Lord God, O Great Giver; O God, You are Inaccessible and Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੯॥੧੦੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee bhavajal utario paar ||2||79||102||
english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, to cross over the terrible world-ocean, and reach the other shore. ||2||79||102||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਣ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਦ ॥
transliteration: raman kau raam ke gun baad ||
english: To chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord is Sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g dhiaaeeai paramesar a(n)mrit jaa ke suaad ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Transcendent Lord God; The taste of His essence is Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕੁ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: simarat ek achut abinaasee binase maaiaa maad ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the One Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, the intoxication of Maya wears off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਏ ਬਿਖਾਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaj anad anahad dhun baanee bahur na bhae bikhaad ||1||
english: One who is blessed with intuitive peace and poise, and the vibrations of the Unstruck Celestial Bani, never suffers again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਕ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ॥
transliteration: sanakaadik brahamaadik gaavat gaavat suk prahilaad ||
english: Even Brahma and his sons sing God's Praises; Sukdayv and Prahlaad sing His Praises as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤ ਅਮਿਉ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੮੦॥੧੦੩॥
transliteration: peevat amiu manohar har ras jap naanak har bisamaad ||2||80||103||
english: Drinking in the fascinating Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime essence, Nanak meditates on the Amazing Lord. ||2||80||103||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਨੑੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਕੋਟ ॥
transliteration: keenhe paap ke bahu kot ||
english: He commits many millions of sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਥਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dinas rainee thakat naahee katahi naahee chhot ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Day and night, he does not get tired of them, and he never finds release. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਜਰ ਬਿਖ ਬਿਆਧੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਠਾਈ ਪੋਟ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bajar bikh biaadhee sir uthaaee pot ||
english: He carries on his head a terrible, heavy load of sin and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਘਰਿ ਗਈਆਂ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੇ ਝੋਟ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ughar gaeeaa(n) khinahi bheetar jamahi graase jhot ||1||
english: In an instant, he is exposed. The Messenger of Death seizes him by his hair. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਪਰੇਤ ਉਸਟ ਗਰਧਭ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨੀ ਲੇਟ ॥
transliteration: pas paret usat garadhabh anik jonee let ||
english: He is consigned to countless forms of reincarnation, into beasts, ghosts, camels and donkeys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਫੇਟ ॥੨॥੮੧॥੧੦੪॥
transliteration: bhaj saadhasa(n)g gobi(n)d naanak kachh na laagai phet ||2||81||104||
english: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, you shall never be struck or harmed at all. ||2||81||104||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਸੂ ਕੇ ਗਟਾਕ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe khaavahi bisoo ke gataak ||
english: He is so blind! He is eating loads of poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਟਿਓ ਸਾਸੁ ਗਇਓ ਤਤ ਘਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nain sravan sareer sabh hutio saas gaio tat ghaat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His eyes, ears and body are totally exhausted; he shall lose his breath in an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਰਞਾਣਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਲੇ ਪੋਖਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਗਈਆ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: anaath ranjaan udar le pokhahi maaiaa gaeeaa haat ||
english: Making the poor suffer, he fills his belly, but the wealth of Maya shall not go with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਛਾਂਟਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kilabikh karat karat pachhutaavahi kabahu na saakahi chhaa(n)t ||1||
english: Committing sinful mistakes again and again, he regrets and repents, but he can never give them up. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਜਮਦੂਤੀ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰਿਓ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਉਪਰਿ ਮਟਾਕ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak jamadootee aai sa(n)ghaario devahi moo(n)d upar mataak ||
english: The Messenger of Death comes to slaughter the slanderer; he beats him on his head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਕਟਾਰੀ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਲਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਫਾਟ ॥੨॥੮੨॥੧੦੫॥
transliteration: naanak aapan kataaree aapas kau laaee man apanaa keeno phaat ||2||82||105||
english: O Nanak, he cuts himself with his own dagger, and damages his own mind. ||2||82||105||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੀ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ॥
transliteration: tootee ni(n)dak kee adh beech ||
english: The slanderer is destroyed in mid-stream.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਇ ਪਹੂਚੀ ਮੀਚ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jan kaa raakhaa aap suaamee bemukh kau aai pahoochee meech ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Our Lord and Master is the Saving Grace, the Protector of His humble servants; those who have turned their backs on the Guru are overtaken by death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: us kaa kahiaa koi na sunaee kahee na baisan paavai ||
english: No one listens to what he says; he is not allowed to sit anywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਰਕੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa(n) dukh aagai narak bhu(n)chai bahu jonee bharamaavai ||1||
english: He suffers in pain here, and falls into hell hereafter. He wanders in endless reincarnations. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਖੰਡੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pragat bhaiaa kha(n)dee brahama(n)dee keetaa apanaa paaiaa ||
english: He has become infamous across worlds and galaxies; he receives according to what he has done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੮੩॥੧੦੬॥
transliteration: naanak saran nirabhau karate kee anad ma(n)gal gun gaaiaa ||2||83||106||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Fearless Creator Lord; he sings His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss. ||2||83||106||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚਲਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa chalat bahu parakaar ||
english: Desire plays itself out in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਤਹੁ ਬਾਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਤੀ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooran hot na katahu baatahi a(n)t paratee haar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But it is not fulfilled at all, and in the end, it dies, exhausted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਨ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sookh na sahaj upajai ihai is biuhaar ||
english: It does not produce tranquility, peace and poise; this is the way it works.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਹਿ ਜਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai kaam krodhahi jaar ||1||
english: He does not know what belongs to him, and to others. He burns in sexual desire and anger. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar dukh biaapio daas levahu taar ||
english: The world is enveloped by an ocean of pain; O Lord, please save Your slave!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮੪॥੧੦੭॥
transliteration: charan kamal saranaai naanak sad sadaa balihaar ||2||84||107||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet; Nanak is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||2||84||107||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
transliteration: re paapee tai kavan kee mat leen ||
english: O sinner, who taught you to sin?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nimakh gharee na simar suaamee jeeu pi(n)d jin deen ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You do not contemplate your Lord and Master, even for an instant; it was He who gave you your body and soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਵੰਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਖੀਨ ॥
transliteration: khaat peevat sava(n)t sukheeaa naam simarat kheen ||
english: Eating, drinking and sleeping, you are happy, but contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you are miserable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਉਦਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਟ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਹਾਂ ਹੋਵਤ ਦੀਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garabh udar bilalaat karataa tahaa(n) hovat deen ||1||
english: In the womb of your mother, you cried and whined like a wretch. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਾਧਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਨ ॥
transliteration: mahaa maad bikaar baadhaa anik jon bhrameen ||
english: And now, bound by great pride and corruption, you shall wander in endless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਕਵਨ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਦ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੨॥੮੫॥੧੦੮॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d bisare kavan dukh ganeeahi sukh naanak har pad cheenh ||2||85||108||
english: You have forgotten the Lord of the Universe; what misery will be your lot now? O Nanak, peace is found by realizing the sublime state of the Lord. ||2||85||108||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਚਰਨਹ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maaee ree charanah ot gahee ||
english: O mother, I have grasped the Protection, the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਬਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan pekh meraa man mohio duramat jaat bahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fascinated, and evil-mindedness is taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਊਚ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
transliteration: agah agaadh ooch abinaasee keemat jaat na kahee ||
english: He is Unfathomable, Incomprehensible, Exalted and High, Eternal and Imperishable; His worth cannot be appraised.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jal thal pekh pekh man bigasio poor rahio srab mahee ||1||
english: Gazing upon Him, gazing upon Him in the water and on the land, my mind has blossomed forth in ecstasy. He is totally pervading and permeating all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਹੀ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal preetam manamohan mil saadhah keeno sahee ||
english: Merciful to the meek, my Beloved, Enticer of my mind; meeting with the Holy, He is known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਭੀਰ ਨ ਫਹੀ ॥੨॥੮੬॥੧੦੯॥
transliteration: simar simar jeevat har naanak jam kee bheer na phahee ||2||86||109||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Nanak lives; the Messenger of Death cannot catch or torment him. ||2||86||109||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: maaee ree man mero matavaaro ||
english: O mother, my mind is intoxicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨਦ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਪਿਓ ਖੁਮਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pekh daiaal anad sukh pooran har ras rapio khumaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon the Merciful Lord, I am filled with bliss and peace; imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, I am intoxicated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਊਜਲ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: niramal bhae oojal jas gaavat bahur na hovat kaaro ||
english: I have become spotless and pure, singing the Sacred Praises of the Lord; I shall never again be dirtied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਚੀ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu doree raachee bhetio purakh apaaro ||1||
english: My awareness is focused on the Lotus Feet of God; I have met the Infinite, Supreme Being. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਦੀਪਕ ਭਇਓ ਉਜਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene sarabas deene deepak bhaio ujaaro ||
english: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything; He has lit up my lamp.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹਾਂ ਤਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੮੭॥੧੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam rasik bairaagee kulah samoohaa(n) taaro ||2||87||110||
english: O Nanak, savoring the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I have become detached; my generations have been carried across as well. ||2||87||110||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maaee ree aan simar mar jaa(n)hi ||
english: O mother, by meditating in remembrance on some other, the mortal dies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tiaag gobid jeean ko daataa maaiaa sa(n)g lapataahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forsaking the Lord of the Universe, the Giver of souls, the mortal is engrossed and entangled in Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naam bisaar chalahi an maarag narak ghor mahi paahi ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he walks on some other path, and falls into the most horrible hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਜਾਂਈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗਰਭੈ ਗਰਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik sajaa(n)ee ganat na aavai garabhai garabh bhramaahi ||1||
english: He suffers uncounted punishments, and wanders from womb to womb in reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: se dhanava(n)te se pativa(n)te har kee saran samaahi ||
english: They alone are wealthy, and they alone are honorable, who are absorbed in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੨॥੮੮॥੧੧੧॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak jag jeetio bahur na aavahi jaa(n)hi ||2||88||111||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they conquer the world; they do not come and go in reincarnation ever again. ||2||88||111||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਕੁਠਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaatee kutilataa kuthaar ||
english: The Lord has cut down the crooked tree of my deceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਨ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram ban dahan bhae khin bheetar raam naam parahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The forest of doubt is burnt away in an instant, by the fire of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰਹਰੀਆ ਕਾਢੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh ni(n)daa parahareeaa kaadhe saadhoo kai sa(n)g maar ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and slander are gone; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have beaten them and driven them out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam padaarath guramukh jeetiaa bahur na jooai haar ||1||
english: The Gurmukh is successful in this priceless human life; he shall not lose it in the gamble ever again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh ke gun gaavah pooran sabad beechaar ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplate the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮੯॥੧੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak daasan daas jan teraa punah punah namasakaar ||2||89||112||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves; over and over again, he bows in humble reverence to You. ||2||89||112||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pothee paramesar kaa thaan ||
english: This Holy Book is the home of the Transcendent Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gaavahi gun gobi(n)d pooran braham giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has the perfect knowledge of God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal mun lochahi birale laagai dhiaan ||
english: The Siddhas and seekers and all the silent sages long for the Lord, but those who meditate on Him are rare.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jisahi kripaal hoi meraa suaamee pooran taa ko kaam ||1||
english: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is merciful - all his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai bhai bha(n)jan tis jaanai sagal jahaan ||
english: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, knows the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੯੦॥੧੧੩॥
transliteration: khin pal bisar nahee mere karate ihu naanak maa(n)gai daan ||2||90||113||
english: May I never forget You, even for an instant, O my Creator Lord; Nanak begs for this blessing. ||2||90||113||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੂਠਾ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: voothaa sarab thaaee mehu ||
english: The rain has fallen everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anad ma(n)gal gaau har jas pooran pragatio nehu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Singing the Lord's Praises with ecstasy and bliss, the Perfect Lord is revealed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਊਨ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dis jal nidh oon thaau na kehu ||
english: On all four sides and in the ten directions, the Lord is an ocean. There is no place where He does not exist.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kripaa nidh gobi(n)d pooran jee daan sabh dehu ||1||
english: O Perfect Lord God, Ocean of Mercy, You bless all with the gift of the soul. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sat sat har sat suaamee sat saadhasa(n)gehu ||
english: True, True, True is my Lord and Master; True is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਭਰਮੇਹੁ ॥੨॥੯੧॥੧੧੪॥
transliteration: sat te jan jin parateet upajee naanak nah bharamehu ||2||91||114||
english: True are those humble beings, within whom faith wells up; O Nanak, they are not deluded by doubt. ||2||91||114||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gobid jeeu too mere praan adhaar ||
english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, You are the Support of my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet sahaaee tum hee too mero paravaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my Best Friend and Companion, my Help and Support; You are my family. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar masatak dhaario merai maathai saadhasa(n)g gun gaae ||
english: You placed Your Hand on my forehead; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sabh phal paae rasak raam naam dhiaae ||1||
english: By Your Grace, I have obtained all fruits and rewards; I meditate on the Lord's Name with delight. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਧਰਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: abichal neev dharaaee satigur kabahoo dolat naahee ||
english: The True Guru has laid the eternal foundation; it shall never be shaken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੨॥੯੨॥੧੧੫॥
transliteration: gur naanak jab bhae daiaaraa sarab sukhaa nidh paa(n)hee ||2||92||115||
english: Guru Nanak has become merciful to me, and I have been blessed with the treasure of absolute peace. ||2||92||115||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਪ ॥
transliteration: nibahee naam kee sach khep ||
english: Only the true merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, stays with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਨਿਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਲੇਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laabh har gun gaai nidh dhan bikhai maahi alep ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of wealth, and earn your profit; in the midst of corruption, remain untouched. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagal sa(n)tokhe aapanaa prabh dhiaai ||
english: All beings and creatures find contentment, meditating on their God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ratan janam apaar jeetio bahuR jon na paai ||1||
english: The priceless jewel of infinite worth, this human life, is won, and they are not consigned to reincarnation ever again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal gobid bhaiaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: When the Lord of the Universe shows His kindness and compassion, the mortal finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈ ਲਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥੯੩॥੧੧੬॥
transliteration: har charan raas naanak paaee lagaa prabh siu ra(n)g ||2||93||116||
english: Nanak has found the wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he is imbued with the Love of God. ||2||93||116||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: maaee ree pekh rahee bisamaad ||
english: O mother, I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anahad dhunee meraa man mohio acharaj taa ke svaad ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind is enticed by the unstruck celestial melody; its flavor is amazing! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਅਹਿਲਾਦ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa ba(n)dhap hai soee man har ko ahilaad ||
english: He is my Mother, Father and Relative. My mind delights in the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਮਾਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gaae gun gobi(n)d binasio sabh paramaad ||1||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all my illusions are dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੋਰੀ ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੀ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਖਾਦ ॥
transliteration: doree lapat rahee charanah sa(n)g bhram bhai sagale khaad ||
english: I am lovingly attached to His Lotus Feet; my doubt and fear are totally consumed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੯੪॥੧੧੭॥
transliteration: ek adhaar naanak jan keeaa bahur na jon bhramaad ||2||94||117||
english: Servant Nanak has taken the Support of the One Lord. He shall not wander in reincarnation ever again. ||2||94||117||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮੂਹ ॥
transliteration: maaee ree maatee charan samooh ||
english: O mother, I am totally intoxicated with the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਸਭ ਲੂਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekas bin hau aan na jaanau duteeaa bhaau sabh looh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I know of none other than the Lord. I have totally burnt off my sense of duality. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਅਵਰ ਜੋ ਕਰਣਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਖੂਹ ॥
transliteration: tiaag goupaal avar jo karanaa te bikhiaa ke khooh ||
english: To abandon the Lord of the World, and become involved with anything else, is to fall into the pit of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਕਾਢੀ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਧੂਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daras piaas meraa man mohio kaadhee narak te dhooh ||1||
english: My mind is enticed, thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. He has lifted me up and out of hell. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੂਹ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad milio sukhadaataa binasee haumai hooh ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met the Lord, the Giver of peace; the noise of egotism has been stilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੂਹ ॥੨॥੯੫॥੧੧੮॥
transliteration: raam ra(n)g raate daas naanak maulio man tan jooh ||2||95||118||
english: Slave Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord; the forests of his mind and body have blossomed forth. ||2||95||118||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਾਚ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: binase kaach ke biuhaar ||
english: The false dealings are finished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam bhaj mil saadhasa(n)gat ihai jag mahi saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord. This is the most excellent thing in the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨ ਡੋਲਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: eet oot na dol katahoo naam hiradai dhaar ||
english: Here and hereafter, you shall never waver; enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਾਗੀ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur charan bohith milio bhaagee utario sa(n)saar ||1||
english: The boat of the Guru's Feet is found by great good fortune; it shall carry you across the world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਨਾਥ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor rahio sarab naath apaar ||
english: The Infinite Lord is totally permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਰਸ ਸਭਿ ਖਾਰ ॥੨॥੯੬॥੧੧੯॥
transliteration: har naam a(n)mrit peeu naanak aan ras sabh khaar ||2||96||119||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, all other tastes are bitter. ||2||96||119||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taa te karan palaah kare ||
english: You whine and cry

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੌ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bikaar moh mad maatau simarat naahi hare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - you are intoxicated with the great corruption of attachment and pride, but you do not remember the Lord in meditation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਜਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g japate naaraain tin ke dokh jare ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy - the guilt of their minstakes is burnt away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਧੰਨਿ ਓਇ ਜਨਮੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saphal deh dha(n)n oi janame prabh kai sa(n)g rale ||1||
english: Fruitful is the body, and blessed is the birth of those who merge with God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath asat dasaa sidh sabh oopar saadh bhale ||
english: The four great blessings, and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers - above all these are the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਪਲੇ ॥੨॥੯੭॥੧੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak daas dhoor jan baa(n)chhai udharahi laag pale ||2||97||120||
english: Slave Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of the humble; attached to the hem of His robe, he is saved. ||2||97||120||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਕਾਂਖੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam ke jan kaa(n)khee ||
english: The Lord's humble servants yearn for the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਏਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਬ ਆਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan bachan ehee sukh chaahat prabh daras dekhahi kab aakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In thought, word and deed, they long for this peace, to gaze with their eyes upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੀ ॥
