transliteration: too bea(n)t paarabraham suaamee gat teree jaai na laakhee ||
english: You are Endless, O God, my Supreme Lord and Master; Your state cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal preet man bedhiaa kar sarabas a(n)tar raakhee ||1||
english: My mind is pierced through by the Love of Your Lotus Feet; this is everything to me - I enshrine it deep within my being. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan simrit saadhoo jan ih baanee rasanaa bhaakhee ||
english: In the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the humble and the Holy chant this Bani with their tongues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੨॥੯੮॥੧੨੧॥
transliteration: jap raam naam naanak nisatareeai hor duteeaa birathee saakhee ||2||98||121||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, O Nanak, I am emancipated; other teachings of duality are useless. ||2||98||121||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਖੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਮਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: maakhee raam kee too maakhee ||
english: A fly! You are just a fly, created by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਦ ਚਾਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jah duraga(n)dh tahaa too baisahi mahaa bikhiaa mad chaakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever it stinks, you land there; you suck in the most toxic stench. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤਹਿ ਅਸਥਾਨਿ ਤੂ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੇਖੀ ਆਖੀ ॥
transliteration: kitahi asathaan too tikan na paavahi ih bidh dekhee aakhee ||
english: You don't stay put anywhere; I have seen this with my eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਛਾਡਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਪਰੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀ ਪਾਖੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa bin tai koi na chhaadiaa sa(n)t pare gobid kee paakhee ||1||
english: You have not spared anyone, except the Saints - the Saints are on the side of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਤੈ ਮੋਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale tai mohe bin sa(n)taa kinai na laakhee ||
english: You have enticed all beings and creatures; no one knows You, except the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੨॥੯੯॥੧੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas har keeratan raataa sabad surat sach saakhee ||2||99||122||
english: Slave Nanak is imbued with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. Focusing his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad, he realizes the Presence of the True Lord. ||2||99||122||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: maaee ree kaatee jam kee phaas ||
english: O mother, the noose of Death has been cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਬੀਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har japat sarab sukh paae beeche grasat udaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found total peace. I remain unattached in the midst of my household. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa leene kar apune upajee daras piaas ||
english: Granting His Grace, He has made me His Own. The thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan wells up within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil har gun gaae binasee duteeaa aas ||1||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I have given up other hopes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅਟਵੀ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: mahaa udiaan atavee te kaadhe maarag sa(n)t kahio ||
english: The Saint has pulled me out of the utterly desolate wilderness, and shown me the path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੧੦੦॥੧੨੩॥
transliteration: dekhat daras paap sabh naase har naanak ratan lahio ||2||100||123||
english: Gazing upon His Darshan, all sins are taken away; Nanak is blessed with the jewel of the Lord. ||2||100||123||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਅਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: maaee ree ario prem kee khor ||
english: O mother, I am involved with the Love of the Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਰੁਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan ruchit piaas man su(n)dar sakat na koee tor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am intoxicated with it. My mind has such a longing and thirst for the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Beauteous Lord. No one can break this. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਪਤਿ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਧਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: praan maan pat pit sut ba(n)dhap har sarabas dhan mor ||
english: The Lord is my breath of life, honor, spouse, parent, child, relative, wealth - everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਸਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhrig sareer asat bisataa krim bin har jaanat hor ||1||
english: Cursed is this body of bones, this pile of maggots and manure, if it knows any other than the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਜੋਰ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan paraa poorabalaa jor ||
english: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, by the power of the karma of my past actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਆਨ ਨਿਹੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੦੧॥੧੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak saran kripaa nidh saagar binasio aan nihor ||2||101||124||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Treasure, the Ocean of Mercy; my subservience to others is past. ||2||101||124||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: neekee raam kee dhun soi ||
english: The Lord's melody is noble and sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal anoop suaamee japat saadhoo hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lotus Feet of my Lord and Master are incomparably beautiful. Meditating on them, one becomes Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਤਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਕਢੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chitavataa gopaal darasan kalamalaa kadh dhoi ||
english: Just by thinking of the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Lord of the World, the dirty sins are washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਾਡੇ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran bikaar a(n)kur har kaat chhaade khoi ||1||
english: The Lord cuts down and weeds out the corruption of the cycle of birth and death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: paraa poorab jisahi likhiaa biralaa paae koi ||
english: How rare is that person who has such pre-ordained destiny, to find the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਣ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਜੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੦੨॥੧੨੫॥
transliteration: ravan gun gopaal karate naanakaa sach joi ||2||102||125||
english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, this is Truth. ||2||102||125||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kee mat saar ||
english: The intellect of one who dwells on the Name of the Lord is excellent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਜੁ ਆਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਮਿਥਨ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bisaar j aan raachahi mithan sabh bisathaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who forgets the Lord and becomes involved with some other - all his showy pretensions are false. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਪ ਹੋਵਤ ਖਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam bhaj suaamee paap hovat khaar ||
english: Meditate, vibrate on our Lord and Master in the Company of the Holy, and your sins shall be eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charanaarabi(n)d basaai hiradai bahur janam na maar ||1||
english: When the Lord's Lotus Feet abide within the heart, the mortal is never again caught in the cycle of death and birth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kar anugrah raakh leene ek naam adhaar ||
english: He showers us with His kindness and compassion; He saves and protects those who take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੦੩॥੧੨੬॥
transliteration: din rain simarat sadaa naanak mukh oojal darabaar ||2||103||126||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, day and night, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||103||126||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: maanee too(n) raam kai dar maanee ||
english: Honored - you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਸਭ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae binasee sabh abhimaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; your egotistical pride will be totally dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu apunee kar leenee guramukh poor giaanee ||
english: Showering His kindness and compassion, He shall make you His Own. As Gurmukh, your spiritual wisdom shall be perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab sookh aana(n)d ghanere thaakur daras dhiaanee ||1||
english: All peace and all sorts of ecstasy are obtained, by meditating on the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਰਤਨਿ ਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਸਾਈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: nikat varatan saa sadaa suhaagan dah dis saaee jaanee ||
english: She who dwells close to her Lord is always the pure, happy soul-bride; she is famous in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧੦੪॥੧੨੭॥
transliteration: pri ra(n)g ra(n)g ratee naaraain naanak tis kurabaanee ||2||104||127||
english: She is imbued with the Love of her Loving Beloved Lord; Nanak is a sacrifice to her. ||2||104||127||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ ਆਸਰੋ ਈਸ ॥
transliteration: tu charan aasaro ees ||
english: O Lord, I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ਸਾਕੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਤੁਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumahi pachhaanoo saak tumahi sa(n)g raakhanahaar tumai jagadees || rahaau ||
english: You are my Best Friend and Companion; I am with You. You are our Protector, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਹੀਐ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: too hamaro ham tumare kaheeai it ut tum hee raakhe ||
english: You are mine, and I am Yours; here and hereafter, You are my Saving Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too bea(n)t apara(n)par suaamee gur kirapaa koee laakhai ||1||
english: You are Endess and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; by Guru's Grace, a few understand. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਕਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: bin bakane bin kahan kahaavan a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
english: Without being spoken, without being told, You know all, O Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੨॥੧੦੫॥੧੨੮॥
transliteration: jaa kau mel lae prabh naanak se jan daragah maane ||2||105||128||
english: One whom God unites with Himself, O Nanak, that humble being is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||105||128||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Fifth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿ ਆਨ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har bhaj aan karam bikaar ||
english: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord; other actions are corrupt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maan mohu na bujhat trisanaa kaal gras sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Pride, attachment and desire are not quenched; the world is in the grip of death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਵਤ ਹਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਤੀ ਅਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: khaat peevat hasat sovat audh bitee asaar ||
english: Eating, drinking, laughing and sleeping, life passes uselessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਉਦਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਜਲਤੋ ਜਮਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: narak udar bhrama(n)t jalato jamahi keenee saar ||1||
english: The mortal wanders in reincarnation, burning in the hellish environment of the womb; in the end, he is destroyed by death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਾਪ ਰਤ ਕਰ ਝਾਰ ॥
transliteration: par droh karat bikaar ni(n)daa paap rat kar jhaar ||
english: He practices fraud, cruelty and slander against others; he sins, and washes his hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਮ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾਂ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binaa satigur boojh naahee tam moh mahaa(n) a(n)dhaar ||2||
english: Without the True Guru, he has no understanding; he is lost in the utter darkness of anger and attachment. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਇ ਮੂਠੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bikh thagauree khaai mootho chit na sirajanahaar ||
english: He takes the intoxicating drugs of cruelty and corruption, and is plundered. He is not conscious of the Creator Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਆਰੋ ਮਾਤੰਗ ਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gupat hoi rahio niaaro maata(n)g mat aha(n)kaar ||3||
english: The Lord of the Universe is hidden and unattached. The mortal is like a wild elephant, intoxicated with the wine of egotism. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kar kripaa prabh sa(n)t raakhe charan kamal adhaar ||
english: In His Mercy, God saves His Saints; they have the Support of His Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੯॥
transliteration: kar jor naanak saran aaio goupaal purakh apaar ||4||1||129||
english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Primal Being, the Infinite Lord God. ||4||1||129||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ghar 6 paRataal ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Partaal:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਗੁਨ ਅਮੋਲ ॥
transliteration: subh bachan bol gun amol ||
english: Chant His Sublime Word and His Priceless Glories.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਕਰੀ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ki(n)karee bikaar ||
english: Why are you indulding in corrupt actions?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਰੀ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dekh ree beechaar ||
english: Look at this, see and understand!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad dhiaai mahal paai ||
english: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਤੀ ਮਹਾ ਕੇਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)g ra(n)g karatee mahaa kel ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, you shall totally play with Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨ ਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: supan ree sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is a dream.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨੀ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mithanee bisathaar ||
english: Its expanse is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਕਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੇਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sakhee kaai mohi mohilee pri preet ridai mel ||1||
english: O my companion, why are you so enticed by the Enticer? Enshrine the Love of Your Beloved within your heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab ree preet piaar ||
english: He is total love and affection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੀ ਦਇਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh sadaa ree daiaar ||
english: God is always merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਏਂ ਆਨ ਆਨ ਰੁਚੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)e(n) aan aan rucheeai ||
english: Others - why are you involved with others?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਚੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)g sa(n)g khacheeai ||
english: Remain involved with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jau saadhasa(n)g paae ||
english: When you join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har dhiaae ||
english: says Nanak, meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਰਹੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਮੇਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
transliteration: ab rahe jamahi mel ||2||1||130||
english: Now, your association with death is ended. ||2||1||130||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਦਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chanaa bahu dat karaa ||
english: You may make donations of gold,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhoom daan arap dharaa ||
english: and give away land in charity

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਚ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਤ ॥
transliteration: man anik soch pavitr karat ||
english: and purify your mind in various ways,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਮਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naahee re naam tul man charan kamal laage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: but none of this is equal to the Lord's Name. Remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਜਿਹਵ ਭਨੇ ॥
transliteration: chaar bed jihav bhane ||
english: You may recite the four Vedas with your tongue,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਖਸਟ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
transliteration: das asat khasat sravan sune ||
english: and listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the six Shaastras with your ears,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨੇ ॥
transliteration: nahee tul gobid naam dhune ||
english: but these are not equal to the celestial melody of the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man charan kamal laage ||1||
english: Remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਤ ਸੰਧਿ ਸੋਚ ਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: barat sa(n)dh soch chaar ||
english: You may observe fasts, and say your prayers, purify yourself

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਕੁੰਟਿ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kriaa ku(n)t niraahaar ||
english: and do good deeds; you may go on pilgrimages everywhere and eat nothing at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰਸ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਕਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aparas karat paakasaar ||
english: You may cook your food without touching anyone;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nivalee karam bahu bisathaar ||
english: you may make a great show of cleansing techniques,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: dhoop deep karate har naam tul na laage ||
english: and burn incense and devotional lamps, but none of these are equal to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਦਇਆਰ ਸੁਨਿ ਦੀਨ ਬੇਨਤੀ ॥
transliteration: raam daiaar sun deen benatee ||
english: O Merciful Lord, please hear the prayer of the meek and the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨੈਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਸਟ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
transliteration: dehu daras nain pekhau jan naanak naam misat laage ||2||2||131||
english: Please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, that I may see You with my eyes. The Naam is so sweet to servant Nanak. ||2||2||131||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਪਿ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam raam raam jaap ramat raam sahaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam. The Lord is your Help and Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਲਬਧਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai charan laage kaam krodh lobh tiaage gur gopaal bhae kripaal labadh apanee paaee ||1||
english: Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, I have abandoned sexual desire, anger and greed. The Guru, the Lord of the World, has been kind to me, and I have realized my destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧ ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਹ ਕੋਊ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: binase bhram moh a(n)dh toote maaiaa ke ba(n)dh pooran sarabatr thaakur nah kooo bairaaee ||
english: My doubts and attachments have been dispelled, and the blinding bonds of Maya have been broken. My Lord and Master is pervading and permeating everywhere; no one is an enemy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
transliteration: suaamee suprasa(n)n bhae janam maran dokh gae sa(n)tan kai charan laag naanak gun gaaee ||2||3||132||
english: My Lord and Master is totally satisfied with me; He has rid me of the pains of death and birth. Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||132||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har hare har mukhahu bol har hare man dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, within your mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ॥
transliteration: sravan sunan bhagat karan anik paatik punahacharan ||
english: Hear Him with your ears, and practice devotional worship - these are good deeds, which make up for past evils.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨ ਪਰਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਨ ਬਾਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saran paran saadhoo aan baan bisaare ||1||
english: So seek the Sanctuary of the Holy, and forget all your other habits. ||1||.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤਿ ਪਾਵਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har charan preet neet neet paavanaa mahi mahaa puneet ||
english: Love the Lord's Feet, continually and continuously - the most sacred and sanctified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਭੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਲਿਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak bhai door karan kalimal dokh jaare ||
english: Fear is taken away from the servant of the Lord, and the dirty sins and mistakes of the past are burnt away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਰਹਤ ਜਨਮ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kahat mukat sunat mukat rahat janam rahate ||
english: Those who speak are liberated, and those who listen are liberated; those who keep the Rehit, the Code of Conduct, are not reincarnated again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
transliteration: raam raam saar bhoot naanak tat beechaare ||2||4||133||
english: The Lord's Name is the most sublime essence; Nanak contemplates the nature of reality. ||2||4||133||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਾਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam bhagat maag sa(n)t tiaag sagal kaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I beg for devotion to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I have forsaken all other activities. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: preet laai har dhiaai gun goubi(n)d sadaa gaai ||
english: Meditate lovingly on the Lord, and sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਬਾਂਛੁ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jan kee ren baa(n)chh dainahaar suaamee ||1||
english: I long for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant, O Great Giver, my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਆਨਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sarab kusal sukh bisraam aanadaa aana(n)d naam jam kee kachh naahi traas simar a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the ultimate ecstasy, bliss, happiness, peace and tranquility. The fear is death is dispelled by meditating in remembrance on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਗਲ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਨ ॥
transliteration: ek saran gobi(n)d charan sa(n)saar sagal taap haran ||
english: Only the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Lord of the Universe can destroy all the suffering of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵ ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
transliteration: naav roop saadhasa(n)g naanak paaragaraamee ||2||5||134||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the boat, O Nanak, to carry us across to the other side. ||2||5||134||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਲਾਲ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ॥
transliteration: gun laal gaavau gur dekhe ||
english: Gazing upon my Guru, I sing the Praises of my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਏਕੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਗ ਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)chaa te ek chhootaa jau saadhasa(n)g pag rau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I escape from the five thieves, and I find the One, when I join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਉ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: drisatau kachh sa(n)g na jaai maan tiaag mohaa ||
english: Nothing of the visible world shall go along with you; abandon your pride and attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ekai har preet laai mil saadhasa(n)g sohaa ||1||
english: Love the One Lord, and join the Saadh Sangat, and you shall be embellished and exalted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paaio hai gun nidhaan sagal aas pooree ||
english: I have found the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence; all my hopes have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ੍ਹ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
transliteration: naanak man ana(n)d bhae gur bikham gaarh toree ||2||6||135||
english: Nanak's mind is in ecstasy; the Guru has shattered the impregnable fortress. ||2||6||135||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਰਾਗੈਗੀ ॥
transliteration: man biraagaigee ||
english: My mind is neutral and detached;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤੀ ਦਰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khojatee darasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I seek only the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੇਵਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)tan sev kai priu heearai dhiaaio ||
english: Serving the Holy Saints, I meditate on my Beloved within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਉਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aana(n)d roopee pekh kai hau mahal paavaugee ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Embodiment of Ecstasy, I rise to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਉਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam karee sabh tiaag kai hau saran paraugee ||
english: I work for Him; I have forsaken everything else. I seek only His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਨਾਵਉਗੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak suaamee gar mile hau gur manaavaugee ||2||7||136||
english: O Nanak, my Lord and Master hugs me close in His Embrace; the Guru is pleased and satisfied with me. ||2||7||136||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aisee hoi paree ||
english: This is my condition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਤੇ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaanate daiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only my Merciful Lord knows it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਰ ਪਿਤਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਿ ਬੇਚਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: maatar pitar tiaag kai man sa(n)tan paahi bechaaio ||
english: I have abandoned my mother and father, and sold my mind to the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੁਲ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaat janam kul khoeeai hau gaavau har haree ||1||
english: I have lost my social status, birth-right and ancestry; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: lok kuta(n)b te tooteeai prabh kirat kirat karee ||
english: I have broken away from other people and family; I work only for God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩੭॥
transliteration: gur mo kau upadesiaa naanak sev ek haree ||2||8||137||
english: The Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to serve only the One Lord. ||2||8||137||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੂ ॥
transliteration: laal laal mohan gopaal too ||
english: You are my Loving Beloved Enticing Lord of the World.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਾਖਾਣ ਜੰਤ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਤੂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keet hasat paakhaan ja(n)t sarab mai pratipaal too ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are in worms, elephants, stones and all beings and creatures; You nourish and cherish them all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: nah door poor hajoor sa(n)ge ||
english: You are not far away; You are totally present with all.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰਸਾਲ ਤੂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: su(n)dar rasaal too ||1||
english: You are Beautiful, the Source of Nectar. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਨਹ ਕੁਲਹ ਕੁਲ ॥
transliteration: nah baran baran nah kulah kul ||
english: You have no caste or social class, no ancestry or family.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਤੂ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩੮॥
transliteration: naanak prabh kirapaal too ||2||9||138||
english: Nanak: God, You are Merciful. ||2||9||138||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag mah 5 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਕੇਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਮੇਲ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੂਰ ਮੋਹੇ ॥
transliteration: karat kel bikhai mel cha(n)dr soor mohe ||
english: Acting and play-acting, the mortal sinks into corruption. Even the moon and the sun are enticed and bewitched.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜਤਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁੰਦਰ ਨਉਪਰੀ ਝੁਨੰਤਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਅਨਿਗ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਧੋਹੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: upajataa bikaar du(n)dar nauparee jhuna(n)takaar su(n)dar anig bhaau karat phirat bin gopaal dhohe || rahaau ||
english: The disturbing noise of corruption wells up, in the tinkling ankle bells of Maya the beautiful. With her beguiling gestures of love, she seduces everyone except the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਉਨੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਰਹੀ ਕਾਚ ਕਰਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਸਹੀ ਉਨਮਤ ਅੰਧ ਧੰਧ ਰਚਿਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਹੋਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teen bhaune lapataai rahee kaach karam na jaat sahee unamat a(n)dh dha(n)dh rachit jaise mahaa saagar hohe ||1||
english: Maya clings to the three worlds; those who are stuck in wrong actions cannot escape her. Drunk and engrossed in blind worldly affairs, they are tossed about on the mighty ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਦਾਸ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੩੯॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੫॥
transliteration: udhare har sa(n)t daas kaat deenee jam kee phaas patit paavan naam jaa ko simar naanak ohe ||2||10||139||3||13||155||
english: The Saint, the slave of the Lord is saved; the noose of the Messenger of Death is snapped. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; O Nanak, remember Him in meditation. ||2||10||139||3||13||155||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag saara(n)g mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Saarang, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har bin tero ko na sahaaee ||
english: No one will be your help and support, except the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n) kee maat pitaa sut banitaa ko kaahoo ko bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Who has any mother, father, child or spouse? Who is anyone's brother or sister? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਅਰੁ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸਗਰੀ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਅਪਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dharanee ar sa(n)pat sagaree jo maanio apanaaee ||
english: All the wealth, land and property which you consider your own

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਕਹਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tan chhootai kachh sa(n)g na chaalai kahaa taahi lapataaee ||1||
english: - when you leave your body, none of it shall go along with you. Why do you cling to them? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ ਨ ਬਢਾਈ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa dukh bha(n)jan taa siu ruch na badhaaee ||
english: God is Merciful to the meek, forever the Destroyer of fear, and yet you do not develop any loving relationship with Him.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਜਗਤ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kahat jagat sabh mithiaa jiu supanaa rainaaee ||2||1||
english: Says Nanak, the whole world is totally false; it is like a dream in the night. ||2||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 9 ||
english: Saarang, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kahaa man bikhiaa siu lapataahee ||
english: O mortal, why are you engrossed in corruption?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਯਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: yaa jag mahi kooo rahan na paavai ik aavahi ik jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: No one is allowed to remain in this world; one comes, and another departs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂ ਕੋ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਾਂ ਕੀ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n) ko tan dhan sa(n)pat kaa(n) kee kaa siu nehu lagaahee ||
english: Who has a body? Who has wealth and property? With whom should we fall in love?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo deesai so sagal binaasai jiu baadar kee chhaahee ||1||
english: Whatever is seen, shall all disappear, like the shade of a passing cloud. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਗਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan saran sa(n)tan gahu mukat hohi chhin maahee ||
english: Abandon egotism, and grasp the Sanctuary of the Saints; you shall be liberated in an instant.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak bhagava(n)t bhajan bin sukh supanai bhee naahee ||2||2||
english: O servant Nanak, without meditating and vibrating on the Lord God, there is no peace, even in dreams. ||2||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 9 ||
english: Saarang, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਨਰ ਅਪਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa nar apano janam gavaavai ||
english: O mortal, why have you wasted your life?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mad bikhiaa ras rachio raam saran nahee aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Intoxicated with Maya and its riches, involved in corrupt pleasures, you have not sought the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਸੁਪਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਾ ਲੋਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar sagal hai supano dekh kahaa lobhaavai ||
english: This whole world is just a dream; why does seeing it fill you with greed?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo upajai so sagal binaasai rahan na kooo paavai ||1||
english: Everything that has been created will be destroyed; nothing will remain. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa tan saacho kar maanio ih bidh aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
english: You see this false body as true; in this way, you have placed yourself in bondage.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak sooo jan mukataa raam bhajan chit laavai ||2||3||
english: O servant Nanak, he is a liberated being, whose consciousness lovingly vibrates, and meditates on the Lord. ||2||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 9 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: man kar kabahoo na har gun gaaio ||
english: In my mind, I never sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪਨੋ ਭਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur keeno apano bhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I remained under the influence of corruption, night and day; I did whatever I pleased. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਨਹਿ ਕਾਨਨਿ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: gur upades sunio nahi kaanan par daaraa lapataaio ||
english: I never listened to the Guru's Teachings; I was entangled with others' spouses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਸਮਝਿਓ ਨਹ ਸਮਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa kaaran bahu dhaavat samajhio nah samajhaaio ||1||
english: I ran all around slandering others; I was taught, but I never learned. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਹਉ ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kahaa kahau mai apunee karanee jih bidh janam gavaaio ||
english: How can I even describe my actions? This is how I wasted my life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਅਉਗਨ ਮੋ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੩੯॥੪॥੧੫੯॥
transliteration: kahi naanak sabh augan mo mahi raakh lehu saranaaio ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159||
english: Says Nanak, I am totally filled with faults. I have come to Your Sanctuary - please save me, O Lord! ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰਗ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag saarag asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Saarang, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har bin kiu jeevaa meree maaee ||
english: How can I live, O my mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jai jagadees teraa jas jaachau mai har bin rahan na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Hail to the Lord of the Universe. I ask to sing Your Praises; without You, O Lord, I cannot even survive. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har kee piaas piaasee kaaman dekhau rain sabaaee ||
english: I am thirsty, thirsty for the Lord; the soul-bride gazes upon Him all through the night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਨਾਥ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sreedhar naath meraa man leenaa prabh jaanai peer paraaee ||1||
english: My mind is absorbed into the Lord, my Lord and Master. Only God knows the pain of another. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਪੀਰ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: ganat sareer peer hai har bin gurasabadee har paa(n)ee ||
english: My body suffers in pain, without the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I find the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal kripaa kar har jeeu har siu rahaa(n) samaaee ||2||
english: O Dear Lord, please be kind and compassionate to me, that I might remain merged in You, O Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਰਵਤ ਰਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisee ravat ravahu man mere har charanee chit laaee ||
english: Follow such a path, O my conscious mind, that you may remain focused on the Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bisam bhae gun gaai manohar nirabhau sahaj samaaee ||3||
english: I am wonder-struck, singing the Glorious Praises of my Fascinating Lord; I am intuitively absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam sadaa dhun nihachal ghatai na keemat paaee ||
english: That heart, in which the Eternal, Unchanging Naam vibrates and resounds, does not diminish, and cannot be evaluated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh koee niradhan satigur boojh bujhaaee ||4||
english: Without the Name, everyone is poor; the True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: preetam praan bhae sun sajanee doot mue bikh khaaee ||
english: My Beloved is my breath of life - listen, O my companion. The demons have taken poison and died.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਬ ਕੀ ਤੈਸੀ ਰੰਗੁਲ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jab kee upajee tab kee taisee ra(n)gul bhaee man bhaaee ||5||
english: As love for Him welled up, so it remains. My mind is imbued with His Love. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaadh sadaa liv har siu jeevaa(n) har gun gaaee ||
english: I am absorbed in celestial samaadhi, lovingly attached to the Lord forever. I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad rataa bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laaee ||6||
english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have become detached from the world. In the profound primal trance, I dwell within the home of my own inner being. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਸਾਂਈਂ ॥
transliteration: sudh ras naam mahaa ras meethaa nij ghar tat gusaa(n)ee(n) ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is sublimely sweet and supremely delicious; within the home of my own self, I understand the essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਜਹ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tah hee man jah hee tai raakhiaa aisee guramat paaee ||7||
english: Wherever You keep my mind, there it is. This is what the Guru has taught me. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sanak sanaad brahamaad i(n)draadik bhagat rate ban aaee ||
english: Sanak and Sanandan, Brahma and Indra, were imbued with devotional worship, and came to be in harmony with Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak har bin gharee na jeevaa(n) har kaa naam vadaaee ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. The Name of the Lord is glorious and great. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Saarang, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har bin kiu dheerai man meraa ||
english: Without the Lord, how can my mind be comforted?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲਪ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot kalap ke dookh binaasan saach driRaai niberaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The guilt and sin of millions of ages is erased, and one is released from the cycle of reincarnation, when the Truth is implanted within. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਜਲੇ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਉ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
transliteration: krodh nivaar jale hau mamataa prem sadaa nau ra(n)gee ||
english: Anger is gone, egotism and attachment have been burnt away; I am imbued with His ever-fresh Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਚਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anabhau bisar gae prabh jaachiaa har niramaail sa(n)gee ||1||
english: Other fears are forgotten, begging at God's Door. The Immaculate Lord is my Companion. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal mat tiaag bhau bha(n)jan paaiaa ek sabad liv laagee ||
english: Forsaking my fickle intellect, I have found God, the Destroyer of fear; I am lovingly attuned to the One Word, the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ras chaakh trikhaa nivaaree har mel lae badabhaagee ||2||
english: Tasting the sublime essence of the Lord, my thirst is quenched; by great good fortune, the Lord has united me with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਭਰਤ ਸਿੰਚਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: abharat si(n)ch bhae subhar sar guramat saach nihaalaa ||
english: The empty tank has been filled to overflowing. Following the Guru's Teachings, I am enraptured with the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man rat naam rate nihakeval aad jugaad daiaalaa ||3||
english: My mind is imbued with love for the Naam. The Immaculate Lord is merciful, from the beginning of time, and througout the ages. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: mohan mohi leeaa man moraa badai bhaag liv laagee ||
english: My mind is fascinated with the Fascinating Lord. By great good fortune, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saach beechaar kilavikh dukh kaate man niramal anaraagee ||4||
english: Contemplating the True Lord, all the resides of sins and mistakes are wiped away. My mind is pure and immaculate in His Love. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer saagar ratanaagar avar nahee an poojaa ||
english: God is the Deep and Unfathomable Ocean, the Source of all jewels; no other is worthy of worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabad beechaar bharam bhau bha(n)jan avar na jaaniaa doojaa ||5||
english: I contemplate the Shabad, the Destroyer of doubt and fear; I do not know any other at all. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manooaa maar niramal pad cheeniaa har ras rate adhikaaee ||
english: Subduing my mind, I have realized the pure status; I am totally imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ekas bin mai avar na jaanaa(n) satigur boojh bujhaaee ||6||
english: I do not know any other except the Lord. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar anaath ajonee guramat eko jaaniaa ||
english: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Unmastered and Unborn; through the Guru's Teachings, I know the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: subhar bhare naahee chit dolai man hee te man maaniaa ||7||
english: Filled to overflowing, my consciousness does not waver; through the Mind, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਕਥਉ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee akathau katheeai kahau kahaavai soee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken; I speak what He makes me speak.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak deen daiaal hamaare avar na jaaniaa koee ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, my Lord is Merciful to the meek; I do not know any other at all. ||8||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ghar 1 ||
english: Saarang, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man mere har kai naam vadaaee ||
english: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is glorious and great.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin avar na jaanaa koee har kai naam mukat gat paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I know of none, other than the Lord; through the Lord's Name, I have attained liberation and emancipation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਮਕਾਲ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabad bhau bha(n)jan jamakaal nikha(n)jan har setee liv laaee ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly attuned to the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa guramukh jaataa sahaje rahiaa samaaee ||1||
english: As Gurmukh, I have realized the Lord, the Giver of peace; I remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa(n) kaa bhojan har naam nira(n)jan painhn bhagat badaaee ||
english: The Immaculate Name of the Lord is the food of His devotees; they wear the glory of devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa sadaa har sevan har dar sobhaa paaee ||2||
english: They abide in the home of their inner beings, and they serve the Lord forever; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾਚੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥੈ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh budh kaachee manooaa dolai akath na kathai kahaanee ||
english: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is false; his mind wavers and wobbles, and he cannot speak the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramat nihachal har man vasiaa a(n)mrit saachee baanee ||3||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Eternal Unchanging Lord abides within the mind; the True Word of His Bani is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man ke tara(n)g sabad nivaare rasanaa sahaj subhaaee ||
english: The Shabad calms the turbulent waves of the mind; the tongue is intuively imbued with peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਸਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur mil raheeai sad apune jin har setee liv laaee ||4||
english: So remain united forever with your True Guru, who is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man sabad marai taa mukato hovai har charanee chit laaee ||
english: If the mortal dies in the Shabad, then he is liberated; he focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har sar saagar sadaa jal niramal naavai sahaj subhaaee ||5||
english: The Lord is an Ocean; His Water is Forever Pure. Whoever bathes in it is intuitively imbued with peace. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sabad veechaar sadaa ra(n)g raate haumai trisanaa maaree ||
english: Those who contemplate the Shabad are forever imbued with His Love; their egotism and desires are subdued.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar nihakeval har raviaa sabh aatam raam muraaree ||6||
english: The Pure, Unattached Lord permeates their inner beings; the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading all. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak sev rahe sach raate jo terai man bhaane ||
english: Your humble servants serve You, O Lord; those who are imbued with the Truth are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: dubidhaa mahal na paavai jag jhoothee gun avagan na pachhaane ||7||
english: Those who are involved in duality do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; caught in the false nature of the world, they do not discriminate between merits and demerits. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aape mel lae akath katheeai sach sabad sach baanee ||
english: When the Lord merges us into Himself, we speak the Unspoken Speech; True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saache sach samaane har kaa naam vakhaanee ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, the true people are absorbed in the Truth; they chant the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Saarang, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: man mere har kaa naam at meethaa ||
english: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is supremely sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh bhau bha(n)jan guramukh eko deethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is the Destroyer of the sins, the guilt and fears of countless incarnations; the Gurmukh sees the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kot kota(n)tar ke paap binaasan har saachaa man bhaaiaa ||
english: Millions upon millions of sins are erased, when the mind comes to love the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har bin avar na soojhai doojaa satigur ek bujhaaiaa ||1||
english: I do not know any other, except the Lord; the True Guru has revealed the One Lord to me. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prem padaarath jin ghat vasiaa sahaje rahe samaaee ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Love, remain intuitively absorbed in Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabad rate se ra(n)g chaloole raate sahaj subhaaee ||2||
english: Imbued with the Shabad, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. They are imbued with the Lord's celestial peace and poise. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa sabad veechaar ras raatee laal bhaee ra(n)g laaee ||
english: Contemplating the Shabad, the tongue is imbued with joy; embracing His Love, it is dyed a deep crimson.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam nihakeval jaaniaa man tripatiaa saa(n)t aaee ||3||
english: I have come to know the Name of the Pure Detached Lord; my mind is satisfied and comforted. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਮੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paRhi paRhi monee sabh thaake bhram bhekh thake bhekhadhaaree ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and study, and all the silent sages have grown weary; they have grown weary of wearing their religious robes and wandering all around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur parasaad nira(n)jan paaiaa saachai sabad veechaaree ||4||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I contemplate the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaar sach raate saach sabad man bhaaiaa ||
english: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended, and I am imbued with Truth; the True Word of the Shabad is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeeai jin vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||5||
english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is found, and self-conceit is eliminated from within. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saachai sabad sahaj dhun upajai man saachai liv laaee ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the celestial melody wells up, and the mind is lovingly focused on the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: agam agochar naam nira(n)jan guramukh ma(n)n vasaaee ||6||
english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord, abides in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ekas mahi sabh jagato varatai viralaa ek pachhaanai ||
english: The whole world is contained in the One Lord. How rare are those who understand the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabad marai taa sabh kichh soojhai anadin eko jaanai ||7||
english: One who dies in the Shabad comes to know everything; night and day, he realizes the One Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan boojhai hor kahanaa kathan na jaaee ||
english: That humble being, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, understands. Nothing else can be said.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sadaa bairaagee ek sabad liv laaee ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are forever detached from the world; they are lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad. ||8||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Saarang, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: man mere har kee akath kahaanee ||
english: O my mind, the Speech of the Lord is unspoken.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har nadar kare soee jan paae guramukh viralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That humble being who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains it. How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har gahir ga(n)bheer gunee gaheer gur kai sabad pachhaaniaa ||
english: The Lord is Deep, Profound and Unfathomable, the Ocean of Excellence; He is realized through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬਉਰਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bahu bidh karam karahi bhaai doojai bin sabadai bauraaniaa ||1||
english: Mortals do their deeds in all sorts of ways, in the love of duality; but without the Shabad, they are insane. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har naam naavai soee jan niramal phir mailaa mool na hoee ||
english: That humble being who bathes in the Lord's Name becomes immaculate; he never becomes polluted again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag hai mailaa doojai bharam pat khoee ||2||
english: Without the Name, the whole world is polluted; wandering in duality, it loses its honor. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਂ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa driRaa(n) kiaa sa(n)grahi tiaagee mai taa boojh na paaee ||
english: What should I grasp? What should I gather up or leave behind? I do not know.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hohi daiaal kripaa kar har jeeu naamo hoi sakhaaee ||3||
english: O Dear Lord, Your Name is the Help and Support of those whom You bless with Your kindness and compassion. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sach daataa karam bidhaataa jis bhaavai tis naai laae ||
english: The True Lord is the True Giver, the Architect of Destiny; as He pleases, He links mortals to the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guroo duaarai soee boojhai jis no aap bujhaae ||4||
english: He alone comes to understand, who enters the Guru's Gate, whom the Lord Himself instructs. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dekh bisamaad ihu man nahee chete aavaa gaun sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Even gazing upon the wonders of the Lord, this mind does not think of Him. The world comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur seve soee boojhai paae mokh duaaraa ||5||
english: Serving the True Guru, the mortal comes to understand, and finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jinh dar soojhai se kade na vigaaRahi satigur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: Those who understand the Lord's Court, never suffer separation from him. The True Guru has imparted this understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee kirat kamaavahi aavan jaan rahaaee ||6||
english: They practice truth, self-restraint and good deeds; their comings and goings are ended. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: se dar saachai saach kamaavahi jin guramukh saach adhaaraa ||
english: In the Court of the True Lord, they practice Truth. The Gurmukhs take the Support of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: manamukh doojai bharam bhulaae naa boojhahi veechaaraa ||7||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander, lost in doubt and duality. They do not know how to contemplate the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aape guramukh aape devai aape kar kar vekhai ||
english: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself gives; He Himself creates and beholds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak se jan thaai pae hai jin kee pat paavai lekhai ||8||3||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings are approved, whose honor the Lord Himself accepts. ||8||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 1 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਸਾਈਁ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: gusaaee(n) parataap tuhaaro deethaa ||
english: O Lord of the World, I gaze upon Your wondrous glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਬੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan upaai samaavan sagal chhatrapat beethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Creator and Destroyer. You are the Sovereign Lord of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਰਾਜ ਭਏ ਰੰਕਾ ਉਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: raanaa raau raaj bhae ra(n)kaa un jhoothe kahan kahaaio ||
english: The rulers and nobles and kings shall become beggars. Their ostentatious shows are false

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hamaraa raajan sadaa salaamat taa ko sagal ghataa jas gaaio ||1||
english: . My Sovereign Lord King is eternally stable. His Praises are sung in every heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਮਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਤ ਜੇਤ ਪਾਹੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: upamaa sunahu raajan kee sa(n)tahu kahat jet paahoochaa ||
english: Listen to the Praises of my Lord King, O Saints. I chant them as best I can.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਊਚੇ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: besumaar vad saah daataaraa ooche hee te oochaa ||2||
english: My Lord King, the Great Giver, is Immeasurable. He is the Highest of the high. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨਿ ਪਰੋਇਓ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰਾ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: pavan paroio sagal akaaraa paavak kaasat sa(n)ge ||
english: He has strung His Breath throughout the creation; He locked the fire in the wood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਰੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕਤ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: neer dharan kar raakhe ekat koi na kis hee sa(n)ge ||3||
english: He placed the water and the land together, but neither blends with the other. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਥਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat kathaa raajan kee chaalai ghar ghar tujhahi umaahaa ||
english: In each and every heart, the Story of our Sovereign Lord is told; in each and every home, they yearn for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh paachhai kariaa prathame rijak samaahaa ||4||
english: Afterwards, He created all beings and creatures; but first, He provided them with sustenance. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karanaa s aape karanaa masalat kaahoo deenhee ||
english: Whatever He does, He does by Himself. Who has ever given Him advice?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਚੀਨੑੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar karah dikhaae saachee saakhee cheenhee ||5||
english: The mortals make all sorts of efforts and showy displays, but He is realized only through the Teachings of Truth. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਦੀਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa kar raakhe apane deenee naam vadaaee ||
english: The Lord protects and saves His devotees; He blesses them with the glory of His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਤੈਂ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜੑਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jin jin karee avagiaa jan kee te tai(n) deee ruRhaaee ||6||
english: Whoever is disrespectful to the humble servant of the Lord, shall be swept away and destroyed. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mukat bhae saadhasa(n)gat kar tin ke avagan sabh parahariaa ||
english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are liberated; all their demerits are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tin kau dekh bhae kirapaalaa tin bhav saagar tariaa ||7||
english: Seeing them, God becomes merciful; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਾਨੑੇ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮੑੇ ਬਡ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham naanhe neech tumhe bad saahib kudarat kaun beechaaraa ||
english: I am lowly, I am nothing at all; You are my Great Lord and Master - how can I even contemplate Your creative potency?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan seetal gur daras dekhe naanak naam adhaaraa ||8||1||
english: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Nanak takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 asatapadee ghar 6 ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agaadh sunahu jan kathaa ||
english: Listen to the Story of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kee acharaj sabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The glory of the Supreme Lord God is wondrous and amazing! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa satigur namasakaar ||
english: Forever and ever, humbly bow to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te gun gaai apaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: man bheetar hovai paragaas ||
english: His Light shall radiate deep within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan agiaan binaas ||1||
english: With the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mit naahee jaa kaa bisathaar ||
english: There is no limit to His Expanse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sobhaa taa kee apar apaar ||
english: His Glory is Infinite and Endless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik ra(n)g jaa ke gane na jaahi ||
english: His many plays cannot be counted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sog harakh duhahoo mahi naahi ||2||
english: He is not subject to pleasure or pain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik brahame jaa ke bed dhun karahi ||
english: Many Brahmas vibrate Him in the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਹੇਸ ਬੈਸਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik mahes bais dhiaan dharahi ||
english: Many Shivas sit in deep meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਅੰਸਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anik purakh a(n)saa avataar ||
english: Many beings take incarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਊਭੇ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anik i(n)dr oobhe darabaar ||3||
english: Many Indras stand at the Lord's Door. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਵਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਅਰੁ ਨੀਰ ॥
transliteration: anik pavan paavak ar neer ||
english: Many winds, fires and waters.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਤਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਦਧਿ ਖੀਰ ॥
transliteration: anik ratan saagar dadh kheer ||
english: Many jewels, and oceans of butter and milk.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਰ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਨਖਿਆਤਿ ॥
transliteration: anik soor saseear nakhiaat ||
english: Many suns, moons and stars.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anik devee devaa bahu bhaa(n)t ||4||
english: Many gods and goddesses of so many kinds. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ॥
transliteration: anik basudhaa anik kaamadhen ||
english: Many earths, many wish-fulfilling cows.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਨ ॥
transliteration: anik paarajaat anik mukh ben ||
english: Many miraculous Elysian trees, many Krishnas playing the flute.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਕਾਸ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: anik akaas anik paataal ||
english: Many Akaashic ethers, many nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਖੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੫॥
transliteration: anik mukhee japeeai gopaal ||5||
english: Many mouths chant and meditate on the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: anik saasatr simrit puraan ||
english: Many Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਬਖਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: anik jugat hovat bakhiaan ||
english: Many ways in which we speak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਰੋਤੇ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: anik sarote sunahi nidhaan ||
english: Many listeners listen to the Lord of Treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sarab jee pooran bhagavaan ||6||
english: The Lord God totally permeates all beings. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਧਰਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਕੁਮੇਰ ॥
transliteration: anik dharam anik kumer ||
english: Many righteous judges of Dharma, many gods of wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਨਿਕ ਸੁਮੇਰ ॥
transliteration: anik baran anik kanik sumer ||
english: Many gods of water, many mountains of gold.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੇਖ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik sekh navatan naam lehi ||
english: Many thousand-headed snakes, chanting ever-new Names of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਤੇਹਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: paarabraham kaa a(n)t na tehi ||7||
english: They do not know the limits of the Supreme Lord God. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਹ ਖੰਡ ॥
transliteration: anik pureeaa anik tah kha(n)d ||
english: Many solar systems, many galaxies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
transliteration: anik roop ra(n)g brahama(n)d ||
english: Many forms, colors and celestial realms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ॥
transliteration: anik banaa anik phal mool ||
english: Many gardens, many fruits and roots.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੂਖਮ ਆਪਹਿ ਅਸਥੂਲ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aapahi sookham aapahi asathool ||8||
english: He Himself is mind, and He Himself is matter. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: anik jugaad dinas ar raat ||
english: Many ages, days and nights.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਲਉ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਤਪਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: anik paralau anik utapaat ||
english: Many apocalypses, many creations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik jee jaa ke grih maahi ||
english: Many beings are in His home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਂਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ramat raam pooran srab thaa(n)i ||9||
english: The Lord is perfectly pervading all places. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anik maaiaa jaa kee lakhee na jaai ||
english: Many Mayas, which cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਖੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anik kalaa khelai har raai ||
english: Many are the ways in which our Sovereign Lord plays.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਸੰਗੀਤ ॥
transliteration: anik dhunit lalit sa(n)geet ||
english: Many exquisite melodies sing of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਤਹ ਚੀਤ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: anik gupat pragate tah cheet ||10||
english: Many recording scribes of the conscious and subconscious are revealed there. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch bhagat jaa kai sa(n)g ||
english: He is above all, and yet He dwells with His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun gaavahi ra(n)g ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, they sing His Praises with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਆਨੰਦ ਝੁਨਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anik anaahad aana(n)d jhunakaar ||
english: Many unstruck melodies resound and resonate with bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: uaa ras kaa kachh a(n)t na paar ||11||
english: There is no end or limit of that sublime essence. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh sat asathaan ||
english: True is the Primal Being, and True is His dwelling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ooch te ooch niramal nirabaan ||
english: He is the Highest of the high, Immaculate and Detached, in Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: apunaa keeaa jaanahi aap ||
english: He alone knows His handiwork.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aape ghat ghat rahio biaap ||
english: He Himself pervades each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan naanak daiaal ||
english: The Merciful Lord is the Treasure of Compassion, O Nanak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੨॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: jin japiaa naanak te bhae nihaal ||12||1||2||2||3||7||
english: Those who chant and meditate on Him, O Nanak, are exalted and enraptured. ||12||1||2||2||3||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: saarag chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Saarang, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਅਨਭੈ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh dekheeai anabhai kaa daataa ||
english: See the Giver of fearlessness in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat pooran hai alipaataa ||
english: The Detached Lord is totally permeating each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat pooran kar bisatheeran jal tara(n)g jiu rachan keeaa ||
english: Like waves in the water, He created the creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਭੋਗ ਘਟਾਣੇ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਕੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: habh ras maane bhog ghataane aan na beeaa ko theeaa ||
english: He enjoys all tastes, and takes pleasure in all hearts. There is no other like Him at all.

author: Guru Arjan
