gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)gee ik ra(n)gee thaakur sa(n)tasa(n)g prabh jaataa ||
english: The color of the Lord's Love is the one color of our Lord and Master; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, God is realized.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਅਨਭੈ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak daras leenaa jiu jal meenaa sabh dekheeai anabhai kaa daataa ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am drenched with the Blessed Vision of the Lord, like the fish in the water. I see the Giver of fearlessness in all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaun upamaa deu kavan badaaee ||
english: What praises should I give, and what approval should I offer to Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio srab thaaee ||
english: The Perfect Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸੋਹਨ ਜਬ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਬ ਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pooran manamohan ghat ghat sohan jab khi(n)chai tab chhaaee ||
english: The Perfect Enticing Lord adorns each and every heart. When He withdraws, the mortal turns to dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਹੁ ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤਕ ਬੇਲਾ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kiu na araadhahu mil kar saadhahu gharee muhatak belaa aaee ||
english: Why do you not worship and adore Him? Join together with the Holy Saints; any instant, your time shall come.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਰਥੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: arath darab sabh jo kichh deesai sa(n)g na kachhahoo jaaee ||
english: All your property and wealth, and all that you see - none of it will go along with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har har aaraadhahu kavan upamaa deu kavan badaaee ||2||
english: Says Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. What praise, and what approval, can I offer to Him? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: poochhau sa(n)t mero thaakur kaisaa ||
english: I ask the Saints, what is my Lord and Master like?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਂੀਉ ਅਰਾਪਉਂ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)eeu araapau(n) dehu sadesaa ||
english: I offer my heart, to one who brings me news of Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਕਹ ਮੋਹਨ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: dehu sadesaa prabh jeeu kaisaa kah mohan paravesaa ||
english: Give me news of my Dear God; where does the Enticer live?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਈ ਥਾਨ ਥਾਨੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)g a(n)g sukhadaaee pooran brahamaaee thaan thaana(n)tar desaa ||
english: He is the Giver of peace to life and limb; God is totally permeating all places, interspaces and countries.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan te mukataa ghat ghat jugataa kahi na sakau har jaisaa ||
english: He is liberated from bondage, joined to each and every heart. I cannot say what the Lord is like.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪੂਛੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dekh charit naanak man mohio poochhai deen mero thaakur kaisaa ||3||
english: Gazing upon His wondrous play, O Nanak, my mind is fascinated. I humbly ask, what is my Lord and Master like? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apune pahi aaiaa ||
english: In His Kindness, He has come to His humble servant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਰਿਦਾ ਜਿਹ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s ridaa jih charan basaaiaa ||
english: Blessed is that heart, in which the Lord's Feet are enshrined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਇਆ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: charan basaaiaa sa(n)t sa(n)gaaiaa agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||
english: His Feet are enshrined within, in the Society of the Saints; the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਲਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaiaa pragaas ridai ulaas prabh loReedaa paaiaa ||
english: The heart is enlightened and illumined and enraptured; God has been found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਹਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh naathaa sukh ghar mahi voothaa mahaa ana(n)d sahajaaiaa ||
english: Pain is gone, and peace has come to my house. The ultimate intuitive peace prevails.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai pooraa paaiaa kar kirapaa apune pahi aaiaa ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord; in His Kindness, He has come to His humble servant. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਰਾਇ ਮਹਮੇ ਹਸਨੇ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g kee vaar mahalaa 4 raai mahame hasane kee dhun ||
english: Vaar Of Saarang, Fourth Mehl, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Mehma-Hasna:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਪਾਹੂ ਨਿਵਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੋਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਛਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gur ku(n)jee paahoo nival man kothaa tan chhat ||
english: The key of the Guru opens the lock of attachment, in the house of the mind, under the roof of the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤਾਕੁ ਨ ਉਘੜੈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹਥਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak gur bin man kaa taak na ughaRai avar na ku(n)jee hath ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Guru, the door of the mind cannot be opened. No one else holds the key in hand. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦਿ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai raagee naadee bed ||
english: He is not won over by music, songs or the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੋਗਿ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai suratee giaanee jog ||
english: He is not won over by intuitive wisdom, meditation or Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੋਗੀ ਕੀਤੈ ਰੋਜਿ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai sogee keetai roj ||
english: He is not won over by feeling sad and depressed forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਰੂਪਂੀ ਮਾਲਂੀ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai roopa(n)ee maala(n)ee ra(n)g ||
english: He is not won over by beauty, wealth and pleasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਵਿਐ ਨੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai teerath bhaviai na(n)g ||
english: He is not won over by wandering naked at sacred shrines.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਦਾਤਂੀ ਕੀਤੈ ਪੁੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai daata(n)ee keetai pu(n)n ||
english: He is not won over by giving donations in charity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai baahar baithiaa su(n)n ||
english: He is not won over by living alone in the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਭੇੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਿੜਿ ਸੂਰ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai bheR marahi bhiR soor ||
english: He is not won over by fighting and dying as a warrior in battle.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੂੜ ॥
transliteration: na bheejai kete hovahi dhooR ||
english: He is not won over by becoming the dust of the masses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa likheeai man kai bhaai ||
english: The account is written of the loves of the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bheejai saachai naai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord is won over only by His Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਛਿਅ ਖਟ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nav chhi khat kaa kare beechaar ||
english: You may study the nine grammars, the six Shaastras and the six divions of the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨ ਉਚਰੈ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nis din ucharai bhaar athaar ||
english: You may recite the Mahaabhaarata.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tin bhee a(n)t na paaiaa tohi ||
english: Even these cannot find the limits of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam bihoon mukat kiu hoi ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be liberated?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਵਸਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naabh vasat brahamai a(n)t na jaaniaa ||
english: Brahma, in the lotus of the navel, does not know the limits of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak naam pachhaaniaa ||3||
english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, realizes the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape aap nira(n)janaa jin aap upaaiaa ||
english: The Immaculate Lord Himself, by Himself, created Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape khel rachaaion sabh jagat sabaaiaa ||
english: He Himself created the whole drama of all the world's play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਅਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: trai gun aap sirajian maaiaa mohu vadhaaiaa ||
english: He Himself formed the three gunas, the three qualities; He increased the attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ubare jin bhaanaa bhaaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are saved - those who love the Will of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sach varatadaa sabh sach samaaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord is pervading everywhere; all are contained within the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਖੈ ਵੇਕ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae naanakaa aape rakhai vek ||
english: He Himself creates, O Nanak; He establishes the various creatures.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa kis no aakheeai jaa(n) sabhanaa saahib ek ||
english: How can anyone be called bad? We have only One Lord and Master.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa saahib ek hai vekhai dha(n)dhai laai ||
english: There is One Lord and Master of all; He watches over all, and assigns all to their tasks.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kisai thoRaa kisai agalaa khaalee koee naahi ||
english: Some have less, and some have more; no one is allowed to leave empty.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਵਿਚੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aavahi na(n)ge jaahi na(n)ge viche karahi vithaar ||
english: Naked we come, and naked we go; in between, we put on a show.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਗੈ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hukam na jaaneeai agai kaaee kaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of God's Command - what will he have to do in the world hereafter? ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਸਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਉ ਭੇਜੈ ਜਿਨਸਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jinas thaap jeeaa(n) kau bhejai jinas thaap lai jaavai ||
english: He sends out the various created beings, and he calls back the various created beings again.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ਆਪੇ ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaapai aape ete ves karaavai ||
english: He himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes. He fashions them in various forms.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jete jee phirahi audhootee aape bhikhiaa paavai ||
english: And all the human beings who wander around as beggars, He Himself gives in charity to them.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਦਾਵੇ ॥
transliteration: lekhai bolan lekhai chalan kaait keechahi daave ||
english: As it is recorded, the mortals speak, and as it is recorded, they walk. So why put on all this show?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਏਹੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mool mat paravaanaa eho naanak aakh sunaae ||
english: This is the basis of intelligence; this is certified and approved. Nanak speaks and proclaims it.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karanee upar hoi tapaavas je ko kahai kahaae ||2||
english: By past actions, each being is judged; what else can anyone say? ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh chalat rachaaion gun paragatee aaiaa ||
english: The Guru's Word makes the drama play itself out. Through virtue, this becomes evident.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee sad ucharai har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Whoever utters the Word of the Guru's Bani - the Lord is enshrined in his mind.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਿ ਗਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sakat gaee bhram katiaa siv jot jagaaiaa ||
english: Maya's power is gone, and doubt is eradicated; awaken to the Light of the Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kai potai pu(n)n hai gur purakh milaaiaa ||
english: Those who hold onto goodness as their treasure meet the Guru, the Primal Being.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje mil rahe har naam samaaiaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed and blended into the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਚਲੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: saah chale vanajaariaa likhiaa devai naal ||
english: The merchants come from the Banker; He sends the account of their destiny with them.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਈਐ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: likhe upar hukam hoi laeeai vasat samhaal ||
english: On the basis of their accounts, He issues the Hukam of His Command, and they are left to take care of their merchandise.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vasat laee vanajaaraee vakhar badhaa paai ||
english: The merchants have purchased their merchandise and packed up their cargo.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੇਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: keee laahaa lai chale ik chale mool gavaai ||
english: Some depart after having earned a good profit, while others leave, having lost their investment altogether.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਥੋੜਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੰਗਿਓ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: thoRaa kinai na ma(n)gio kis kaheeai saabaas ||
english: No one asks to have less; who should be celebrated?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nadar tinaa kau naanakaa j saabat laae raas ||1||
english: The Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, upon those who have preserved their capital investment. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੁੜਿ ਜੁੜਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜੁੜੇ ॥
transliteration: juR juR vichhuRe vichhuR juRe ||
english: United, the united separate, and separated, they unite again.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਿ ਜੀਵਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: jeev jeev mue mue jeeve ||
english: Living, the living die, and dying, they live again.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਾਪ ਕੇਤਿਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਟੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਹੂਏ ॥
transliteration: ketiaa ke baap ketiaa ke bete kete gur chele hooe ||
english: They become the fathers of many, and the sons of many; they become the gurus of many, and the disciples.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੂਏ ॥
transliteration: aagai paachhai ganat na aavai kiaa jaatee kiaa hun hooe ||
english: No account can be made of the future or the past; who knows what shall be, or what was?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh karanaa kirat kar likheeai kar kar karataa kare kare ||
english: All the actions and events of the past are recorded; the Doer did, He does, and He will do.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukh mareeai guramukh tareeai naanak nadaree nadar kare ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukh dies, while the Gurmukh is saved; O Nanak, the Gracious Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh doojaa bharam hai doojai lobhaaiaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders in duality, lured and enticed by duality.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਕੂੜੋ ਆਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kooR kapat kamaavade kooRo aalaaiaa ||
english: He practices falsehood and deception, telling lies.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr mohu het hai sabh dukh sabaaiaa ||
english: Love and attachment to children and spouse is total misery and pain.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeahi bharamahi bharamaaiaa ||
english: He is gagged and bound at the door of the Messenger of Death; he dies, and wanders lost in reincarnation.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh janam gavaaiaa naanak har bhaaiaa ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukh wastes his life; Nanak loves the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin vadiaaee tere naam kee te rate man maahi ||
english: Those who are blessed with the glorious greatness of Your Name - their minds are imbued with Your Love.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)mrit ek hai doojaa a(n)mrit naahi ||
english: O Nanak, there is only One Ambrosial Nectar; there is no other nectar at all.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)mrit manai maahi paaeeai gur parasaad ||
english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained within the mind, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪੀਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tinhee peetaa ra(n)g siu jinh kau likhiaa aad ||1||
english: They alone drink it in with love, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਇ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeai kare soi saalaahi ||
english: Why praise the created being? Praise the One who created all.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak ekee baaharaa doojaa daataa naahi ||
english: O Nanak, there is no other Giver, except the One Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karataa so saalaaheeai jin keetaa aakaar ||
english: Praise the Creator Lord, who created the creation.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: daataa so saalaaheeai j sabhasai de aadhaar ||
english: Praise the Great Giver, who gives sustenence to all.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸਦੀਵ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak aap sadeev hai pooraa jis bha(n)daar ||
english: O Nanak, the treasure of the Eternal Lord is over-flowing.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadaa kar saalaaheeai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||2||
english: Praise and honor the One, who has no end or limitation. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai seviai sukh paaee ||
english: The Name of the Lord is a treasure. Serving it, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਉਚਰਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan ucharaa(n) pat siu ghar jaa(n)ee ||
english: I chant the Name of the Immaculate Lord, so that I may go home with honor.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh baanee naam hai naam ridai vasaaee ||
english: The Word of the Gurmukh is the Naam; I enshrine the Naam within my heart.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਈਁ ॥
transliteration: mat pa(n)kheroo vas hoi satiguroo dhiaaee(n) ||
english: The bird of the intellect comes under one's control, by meditating on the True Guru.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak aap daiaal hoi naame liv laaee ||4||
english: O Nanak, if the Lord becomes merciful, the mortal lovingly tunes in to the Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: tis siu kaisaa bolanaa j aape jaanai jaan ||
english: How can we speak of Him? Only He knows Himself.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚੀਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: cheeree jaa kee naa phirai saahib so paravaan ||
english: His decree cannot be challenged; He is our Supreme Lord and Master.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚੀਰੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: cheeree jis kee chalanaa meer malak salaar ||
english: By His Decree, even kings, nobles and commanders must step down.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saaee bhalee kaar ||
english: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, O Nanak, is a good deed.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚੀਰੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਹਥਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa cheeree chalanaa hath tinhaa kichh naahi ||
english: By His Decree, we walk; nothing rests in our hands.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਠੀ ਕਰਲੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saahib kaa phuramaan hoi uthee karalai paahi ||
english: When the Order comes from our Lord and Master, all must rise up and take to the road.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਚੀਰੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jehaa cheeree likhiaa tehaa hukam kamaahi ||
english: As His Decree is issued, so is His Command obeyed.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਘਲੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਦੇ ਉਠੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghale aavahi naanakaa sade uthee jaahi ||1||
english: Those who are sent, come, O Nanak; when they are called back, they depart and go. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸੀਐ ਸੇਈ ਪੋਤੇਦਾਰ ॥
transliteration: siphat jinaa kau bakhaseeai seee potedaar ||
english: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Praises, are the true keepers of the treasure.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)jee jin kau diteeaa tinhaa mile bha(n)daar ||
english: Those who are blessed with the key - they alone receive the treasure.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਹੂ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਤੇ ਕੀਅਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jah bha(n)daaree hoo gun nikalahi te keeahi paravaan ||
english: That treasure, from which virtue wells up - that treasure is approved.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nadar tinhaa kau naanakaa naam jinhaa neesaan ||2||
english: Those who are blessed by His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, bear the Insignia of the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan niramalaa suniai sukh hoee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is immaculate and pure; hearing it, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sun sun ma(n)n vasaaeeai boojhai jan koee ||
english: Listening and hearing, It is enshrined in the mind; how rare is that humble being who realizes it.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bahadiaa uthadiaa na visarai saachaa sach soee ||
english: Sitting down and standing up, I shall never forget Him, the Truest of the true.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kau naam adhaar hai naame sukh hoee ||
english: His devotees have the Support of His Name; in His Name, they find peace.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak man tan rav rahiaa guramukh har soee ||5||
english: O Nanak, He permeates and pervades mind and body; He is the Lord, the Guru's Word. ||5||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਤੋਲ ਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naanak tuleeahi tol je jeeu pichhai paaeeai ||
english: O Nanak, the weight is weighed out, when the soul is placed on the scale.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਬੋਲ ਜੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: ikas na pujahi bol je poore pooraa kar milai ||
english: Nothing is equal to speaking of the One, who perfectly unites us with the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: vadaa aakhan bhaaraa tol ||
english: To call Him glorious and great carries such a heavy weight.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਹਉਲੀ ਮਤੀ ਹਉਲੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
transliteration: hor haulee matee haule bol ||
english: Other intellectualisms are lightweight; other words are lightweight as well.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਬਤ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dharatee paanee parabat bhaar ||
english: The weight of the earth, water and mountains

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕੰਡੈ ਤੋਲੈ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kiu ka(n)dai tolai suniaar ||
english: - how can the goldsmith weigh it on the scale?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਤੋਲਾ ਮਾਸਾ ਰਤਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tolaa maasaa ratak paai ||
english: What weights can balance the scale?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak puchhiaa dei pujaai ||
english: O Nanak, when questioned, the answer is given.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: moorakh a(n)dhiaa a(n)dhee dhaat ||
english: The blind fool is running around, leading the blind.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਨਿ ਆਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi kahi kahan kahaain aap ||1||
english: The more they say, the more they expose themselves. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਆਖਿ ॥
transliteration: aakhan aukhaa sunan aukhaa aakh na jaapee aakh ||
english: It is difficult to chant it; it is difficult to listen to it. It cannot be chanted with the mouth.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਾਖਹਿ ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ik aakh aakhahi sabad bhaakhahi aradh uradh din raat ||
english: Some speak with their mouths and chant the Word of the Shabad - the low and the high, day and night.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਿਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਿਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: je kihu hoi ta kihu disai jaapai roop na jaat ||
english: If He were something, then He would be visible. His form and state cannot be seen.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਟ ਅਉਘਟ ਘਟ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaaran karataa kare ghat aughat ghat thaap ||
english: The Creator Lord does all deeds; He is established in the hearts of the high and the low.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਖਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aakhan aukhaa naanakaa aakh na jaapai aakh ||2||
english: It is so difficult to chant it, O Nanak; it cannot be chanted with the mouth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai man rahaseeai naame saa(n)t aaee ||
english: Hearing the Name, the mind is delighted. The Name brings peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai man tripateeai sabh dukh gavaaee ||
english: Hearing the Name, the mind is satisfied, and all pains are taken away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai naau oopajai naame vadiaaee ||
english: Hearing the Name, one becomes famous; the Name brings glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naame hee sabh jaat pat naame gat paaee ||
english: The Name brings all honor and status; through the Name, salvation is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai naanak liv laaee ||6||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Name; Nanak is lovingly attuned to the Name. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਰਾਗਂੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਵੇਦਂੀ ॥
transliteration: jooth na raaga(n)ee jooth na veda(n)ee ||
english: Impurity does not come from music; impurity does not come from the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਭੇਦੀ ॥
transliteration: jooth na cha(n)d sooraj kee bhedee ||
english: Impurity does not come from the phases of the sun and the moon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਅੰਨੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jooth na a(n)nee jooth na naaee ||
english: Impurity does not come from food; impurity does not come from ritual cleansing baths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jooth na meehu varhiai sabh thaaee ||
english: Impurity does not come from the rain, which falls everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧਰਤੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jooth na dharatee jooth na paanee ||
english: Impurity does not come from the earth; impurity does not come from the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਉਣੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jooth na paunai maahi samaanee ||
english: Impurity does not come from the air which is diffused everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak niguriaa gun naahee koi ||
english: O Nanak, the one who has no Guru, has no redeeming virtues at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਫੇਰਿਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: muhi pheriai muhu joothaa hoi ||1||
english: Impurity comes from turning one's face away from God. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੁਲੀਆ ਸੁਚੀਆ ਜੇ ਭਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak chuleeaa sucheeaa je bhar jaanai koi ||
english: O Nanak, the mouth is truly cleansed by ritual cleansing, if you really know how to do it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾ ਜਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: surate chulee giaan kee jogee kaa jat hoi ||
english: For the intuitively aware, cleansing is spiritual wisdom. For the Yogi, it is self-control.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਚੁਲੀ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕੀ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: brahaman chulee sa(n)tokh kee girahee kaa sat daan ||
english: For the Brahmin, cleansing is contentment; for the householder, it is truth and charity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਨਿਆਵ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: raaje chulee niaav kee paRiaa sach dhiaan ||
english: For the king, cleansing is justice; for the scholar, it is true meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਧੋਪਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paanee chit na dhopaee mukh peetai tikh jaai ||
english: The consciousness is not washed with water; you drink it to quench your thirst.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paanee pitaa jagat kaa phir paanee sabh khaai ||2||
english: Water is the father of the world; in the end, water destroys it all. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai sabh sidh hai ridh pichhai aavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, all supernatural spiritual powers are obtained, and wealth follows along.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai nau nidh milai man chi(n)diaa paavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, the nine treasures are received, and the mind's desires are obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai sa(n)tokh hoi kavalaa charan dhiaavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, contentment comes, and Maya meditates at one's feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai sahaj oopajai sahaje sukh paavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, intuitive peace and poise wells up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramatee naau paaeeai naanak gun gaavai ||7||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained; O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dukh vich ja(n)man dukh maran dukh varatan sa(n)saar ||
english: In pain, we are born; in pain, we die. In pain, we deal with the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dukh dukh agai aakheeai paRhi paRhi karahi pukaar ||
english: Hereafter, there is said to be pain, only pain; the more the mortals read, the more they cry out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਪੰਡਾ ਖੁਲੑੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh keeaa pa(n)daa khulheeaa sukh na nikalio koi ||
english: The packages of pain are untied, but peace does not emerge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh vich jeeu jalaaiaa dukheeaa chaliaa roi ||
english: In pain, the soul burns; in pain, it departs weeping and wailing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak siphatee ratiaa man tan hariaa hoi ||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Lord's Praise, the mind and body blossom forth, rejuvenated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਅਗੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਭੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh keeaa agee maareeahi bhee dukh daaroo hoi ||1||
english: In the fire of pain, the mortals die; but pain is also the cure. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਭਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਸੂ ਹੂ ਭਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: naanak duneeaa bhas ra(n)g bhasoo hoo bhas kheh ||
english: O Nanak, worldly pleasures are nothing more than dust. They are the dust of the dust of ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਸੋ ਭਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭੀ ਭਸੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: bhaso bhas kamaavanee bhee bhas bhareeai deh ||
english: The mortal earns only the dust of the dust; his body is covered with dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਭਸੂ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa jeeu vichahu kadheeai bhasoo bhariaa jaai ||
english: When the soul is taken out of the body, it too is covered with dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agai lekhai ma(n)giai hor dasoonee paai ||2||
english: And when one's account is called for in the world hereafter, he receives only ten times more dust. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai such sa(n)jamo jam neR na aavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, one is blessed with purity and self-control, and the Messenger of Death will not draw near.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai ghat chaananaa aanher gavaavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai aap bujheeai laahaa naau paavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, one comes to understand his own self, and the profit of the Name is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naai suniai paap kateeahi niramal sach paavai ||
english: Hearing the Name, sins are eradicated, and one meets the Immaculate True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naai suniai mukh ujale naau guramukh dhiaavai ||8||
english: O Nanak, hearing the Name, one's face becomes radiant. As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਭਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar naaraain sabhaa naal ||
english: In your home, is the Lord God, along with all your other gods.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਵਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: pooj kare rakhai naavaal ||
english: You wash your stone gods and worship them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਫੁਲ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)goo cha(n)nan phul chaRaae ||
english: You offer saffron, sandalwood and flowers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pairee pai pai bahut manaae ||
english: Falling at their feet, you try so hard to appease them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੂਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਪੈਨੑੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maanooaa ma(n)g ma(n)g painhai khaai ||
english: Begging, begging from other people, you get things to wear and eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhee ka(n)mee a(n)dh sajaai ||
english: For your blind deeds, you will be blindly punished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਰਦਿਆ ਰਖੈ ॥
transliteration: bhukhiaa dei na maradiaa rakhai ||
english: Your idol does not feed the hungry, or save the dying.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਝਗੜਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਸਥੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa jhagaRaa a(n)dhee sathai ||1||
english: The blind assembly argues in blindness. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਜੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: sabhe suratee jog sabh sabhe bed puraan ||
english: All intuitive understanding, all Yoga, all the Vedas and Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕਰਣੇ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: sabhe karane tap sabh sabhe geet giaan ||
english: All actions, all penances, all songs and spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sabhe budhee sudh sabh sabh teerath sabh thaan ||
english: All intellect, all enlightenment, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਅਮਰ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਖਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sabh paatisaaheeaa amar sabh sabh khuseeaa sabh khaan ||
english: All kingdoms, all royal commands, all joys and all delicacies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਵ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: sabhe maanas dev sabh sabhe jog dhiaan ||
english: All mankind, all divinites, all Yoga and meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)d sabh sabhe jee jahaan ||
english: All worlds, all celestial realms; all the beings of the universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਵਹੈ ਕਲਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hukam chalaae aapanai karamee vahai kalaam ||
english: According to His Hukam, He commands them. His Pen writes out the account of their actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa sach naai sach sabhaa deebaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, True is the Lord, and True is His Name. True is His Congregation and His Court. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai sukh oopajai naame gat hoee ||
english: With faith in the Name, peace wells up; the Name brings emancipation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai pat paaeeai hiradai har soee ||
english: With faith in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord is enshrined in the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai bhavajal la(n)gheeai phir bighan na hoee ||
english: With faith in the Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and no obstructions are ever again encountered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai pa(n)th paragataa naame sabh loee ||
english: With faith in the Name, the Path is revealed; through the Name, one is totally enlightened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak satigur miliai naau ma(n)neeai jin devai soee ||9||
english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; he alone has faith, who is blessed with it. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: pureeaa kha(n)daa sir kare ik pair dhiaae ||
english: The mortal walks on his head through the worlds and realms; he meditates, balanced on one foot.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਤਲੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: paun maar man jap kare sir mu(n)dee talai dei ||
english: Controlling the wind of the breath, he meditates within his mind, tucking his chin down into his chest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਟਿਕ ਟਿਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kis upar ohu tik tikai kis no jor karei ||
english: What does he lean on? Where does he get his power?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kis no kaheeai naanakaa kis no karataa dei ||
english: What can be said, O Nanak? Who is blessed by the Creator?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hukam rahaae aapanai moorakh aap ganei ||1||
english: God keeps all under His Command, but the fool shows off himself. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਆਖਾਂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: hai hai aakhaa(n) kot kot kotee hoo kot kot ||
english: He is, He is - I say it millions upon millions, millions upon millions of times.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖੂੰ ਆਖਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: aakhoo(n) aakhaa(n) sadaa sadaa kahan na aavai tot ||
english: With my mouth I say it, forever and ever; there is no end to this speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਥਕਾਂ ਨ ਠਾਕੀਆ ਏਵਡ ਰਖਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naa hau thakaa(n) na thaakeeaa evad rakhahi jot ||
english: I do not get tired, and I will not be stopped; this is how great my determination is.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਸਿਅਹੁ ਚੁਖ ਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak chasiahu chukh bi(n)d upar aakhan dos ||2||
english: O Nanak, this is tiny and insignificant. To say that it is more, is wrong. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai kul udharai sabh kuta(n)b sabaaiaa ||
english: With faith in the Name, all one's ancestors and family are saved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai sa(n)gat udharai jin ridai vasaaiaa ||
english: With faith in the Name, one's associates are saved; enshrine it within your heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai sun udhare jin rasan rasaaiaa ||
english: With faith in the Name, those who hear it are saved; let your tongue delight in it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai dukh bhukh gaee jin naam chit laaiaa ||
english: With faith in the Name, pain and hunger are dispelled; let your consciousness be attached to the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam tinee saalaahiaa jin guroo milaaiaa ||10||
english: O Nanak, they alone Praise the Name, who meet with the Guru. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਹ ਸਭਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabhe raatee sabh dih sabh thitee sabh vaar ||
english: All nights, all days, all dates, all days of the week;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਤਂੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabhe rutee maah sabh sabh dharata(n)ee sabh bhaar ||
english: All seasons, all months, all the earth and everything on it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sabhe paanee paun sabh sabh aganee paataal ||
english: All waters, all winds, all fires and underworlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)d sabh sabh lo lo aakaar ||
english: All solar systems and galaxies, all worlds, people and forms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hukam na jaapee ketaRaa kahi na sakeejai kaar ||
english: No one knows how great the Hukam of His Command is; no one can describe His actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਥਕਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਂੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi thakahi aakh aakh kar siphata(n)ee veechaar ||
english: Mortals may utter, chant, recite and contemplate His Praises until they grow weary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trin na paaio bapuRee naanak kahai gavaar ||1||
english: The poor fools, O Nanak, cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਂੀ ਪਰਣੈ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: akha(n)ee paranai je phiraa(n) dekhaa(n) sabh aakaar ||
english: If I were to walk around with my eyes wide open, gazing at all the created forms;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਾ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾਂ ਪੁਛਾ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: puchhaa giaanee pa(n)ditaa(n) puchhaa bed beechaar ||
english: I could ask the spiritual teachers and religious scholars, and those who contemplate the Vedas;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਾ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਮਾਣਸਾਂ ਜੋਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: puchhaa devaa(n) maanasaa(n) jodh karahi avataar ||
english: I could ask the gods, mortal men, warriors and divine incarnations;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sidh samaadhee sabh sunee jaai dekhaa(n) darabaar ||
english: I could consult all the Siddhas in Samaadhi, and go to see the Lord's Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: agai sachaa sach naai nirabhau bhai vin saar ||
english: Hereafter, Truth is the Name of all; the Fearless Lord has no fear at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਮਤੀ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਅੰਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hor kachee matee kach pich a(n)dhiaa a(n)dh beechaar ||
english: False are other intellectualisms, false and shallow; blind are the contemplations of the blind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak karamee ba(n)dagee nadar la(n)ghaae paar ||2||
english: O Nanak, by the karma of good actions, the mortal comes to meditate on the Lord; by His Grace, we are carried across. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਈ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai duramat gaee mat paragatee aaiaa ||
english: With faith in the Name, evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the intellect is enlightened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naau ma(n)niai haumai gaee sabh rog gavaaiaa ||
english: With faith in the Name, egotism is eradicated, and all sickness is cured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai naam oopajai sahaje sukh paaiaa ||
english: Believing in the Name, The Name wells up, and intuitive peace and poise are obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai saa(n)t oopajai har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Believing in the Name, tranquility and peace well up, and the Lord is enshrined in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rata(n)n hai guramukh har dhiaaiaa ||11||
english: O Nanak, the Name is a jewel; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾਂ ॥
transliteration: hor sareek hovai koee teraa tis agai tudh aakhaa(n) ||
english: If there were any other equal to You, O Lord, I would speak to them of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh agai tudhai saalaahee mai a(n)dhe naau sujaakhaa ||
english: You, I praise You; I am blind, but through the Name, I am all-seeing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jetaa aakhan saahee sabadee bhaakhiaa bhaai subhaaee ||
english: Whatever is spoken, is the Word of the Shabad. Chanting it with love, we are embellished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bahutaa eho aakhan sabh teree vadiaaee ||1||
english: Nanak, this is the greatest thing to say: all glorious greatness is Yours. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਨ ਸਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਜੰਮੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) na siaa kiaa chaakaree jaa(n) ja(n)me kiaa kaar ||
english: When there was nothing, what happened? What happens when one is born?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaaran karataa kare dekhai vaaro vaar ||
english: The Creator, the Doer, does all; He watches over all, again and again

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਚੁਪੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: je chupai je ma(n)giai daat kare daataar ||
english: . Whether we keep silent or beg out loud, the Great Giver blesses us with His gifts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ik daataa sabh ma(n)gate phir dekhahi aakaar ||
english: The One Lord is the Giver; we are all beggars. I have seen this throughout the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai jeevai devanahaar ||2||
english: Nanak knows this: the Great Giver lives forever. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai surat oopajai naame mat hoee ||
english: With faith in the Name, intuitive awareness wells up; through the Name, intelligence comes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai gun ucharai naame sukh soee ||
english: With faith in the Name, chant the Glories of God; through the Name, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai bhram kateeai phir dukh na hoee ||
english: With faith in the Name, doubt is eradicated, and the mortal never suffers again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਤਿ ਧੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai saalaaheeai paapaa(n) mat dhoee ||
english: With faith in the Name, sing His Praises, and your sinful intellect shall be washed clean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak poore gur te naau ma(n)neeai jin devai soee ||12||
english: O Nanak, through the Perfect Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; they alone receive it, unto whom He gives it. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੑੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: saasatr bed puraan paRh(n)taa ||
english: Some read the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਕਾਰੰਤਾ ਅਜਾਣੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pookaara(n)taa ajaana(n)taa ||
english: They recite them, out of ignorance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) boojhai taa(n) soojhai soee ||
english: If they really understood them, they would realize the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aakhai kook na hoee ||1||
english: Nanak says, there is no need to shout so loud. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) hau teraa taa(n) sabh kichh meraa hau naahee too hovahi ||
english: When I am Yours, then everything is mine. When I am not, You are.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aape sakataa aape surataa sakatee jagat parovahi ||
english: You Yourself are All-powerful, and You Yourself are the Intuitive Knower. The whole world is strung on the Power of Your Shakti.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭੇਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aape bheje aape sade rachanaa rach rach vekhai ||
english: You Yourself send out the mortal beings, and You Yourself call them back home. Having created the creation, You behold it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਂਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa sachee naa(n)ee sach pavai dhur lekhai ||2||
english: O Nanak, True is the Name of the True Lord; through Truth, one is accepted by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan alakh hai kiu lakhiaa jaaee ||
english: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is unknowable. How can it be known?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan naal hai kiu paaeeai bhaaee ||
english: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is with the mortal being. How can it be obtained, O Siblings of Destiny?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan varatadaa raviaa sabh thaa(n)ee ||
english: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is all-pervading and permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te paaeeai hiradai dei dikhaaee ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained. It is revealed within the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree karam hoi gur mileeai bhaaee ||13||
english: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Grace, the mortal meets with the Guru, O Siblings of Desitny. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੁਤੇ ਮੁਹੀ ਖਾਜੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kal hoee kute muhee khaaj hoaa muradaar ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, people have faces like dogs; they eat rotting carcasses for food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR bol bol bhaukanaa chookaa dharam beechaar ||
english: They bark and speak, telling only lies; all thought of righteousness has left them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਮੰਦੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jin jeeva(n)diaa pat nahee muiaa ma(n)dee soi ||
english: Those who have no honor while alive, will have an evil reputation after they die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: likhiaa hovai naanakaa karataa kare s hoi ||1||
english: Whatever is predestined, happens, O Nanak; whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਨਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਬੋਧੀਆ ਪੁਰਸ ਹੋਏ ਸਈਆਦ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)naa hoeeaa bodheeaa puras hoe saeeaad ||
english: Women have become advisors, and men have become hunters.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੁਚ ਭੰਨੀ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਜੁ ਅਹਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: seel sa(n)jam such bha(n)nee khaanaa khaaj ahaaj ||
english: Humility, self-control and purity have run away; people eat the uneatable, forbidden food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: saram gaiaa ghar aapanai pat uth chalee naal ||
english: Modesty has left her home, and honor has gone away with her.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa ek hai aur na sachaa bhaal ||2||
english: O Nanak, there is only One True Lord; do not bother to search for any other as true. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਸਮ ਲੇਪਨ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: baahar bhasam lepan kare a(n)tar gubaaree ||
english: You smear your outer body with ashes, but within, you are filled with darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khi(n)thaa jholee bahu bhekh kare duramat aha(n)kaaree ||
english: You wear the patched coat and all the right clothes and robes, but you are still egotistical and proud.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਊਚਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saahib sabad na oocharai maaiaa moh pasaaree ||
english: You do not chant the Shabad, the Word of Your Lord and Master; you are attached to the expanse of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar laalach bharam hai bharamai gaavaaree ||
english: Within, you are filled with greed and doubt; you wander around like a fool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam na chetaee jooai baajee haaree ||14||
english: Says Nanak, you never even think of the Naam; you have lost the game of life in the gamble. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lakh siu preet hovai lakh jeevan kiaa khuseeaa kiaa chaau ||
english: You may be in love with tens of thousands, and live for thousands of years; but what good are these pleasures and occupations?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਵਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa vis hoi vichhoRaa ek ghaRee mahi jaai ||
english: And when you must separate from them, that separation is like poison, but they will be gone in an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਜੈ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je sau varhiaa mithaa khaajai bhee phir kauRaa khaai ||
english: You may eat sweets for a hundred years, but eventually, you will have to eat the bitter as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਉੜਤਣੁ ਧਾਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mithaa khaadhaa chit na aavai kauRatan dhaai jaai ||
english: Then, you will not remember eating the sweets; bitterness will permeate you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਉੜਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: mithaa kauRaa dovai rog ||
english: The sweet and the bitter are both diseases.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)t vigute bhog ||
english: O Nanak, eating them, you will come to ruin in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਗੜਾ ਝਾਖ ॥
transliteration: jhakh jhakh jhakhanaa jhagaRaa jhaakh ||
english: It is useless to worry and struggle to death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਝਖਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhakh jhakh jaahi jhakhahi tinh paas ||1||
english: Entangled in worries and struggles, people exhaust themselves. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਕਾਠੁ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਂਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kaapaR kaath ra(n)gaaiaa raa(n)g ||
english: They have fine clothes and furniture of various colors.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਗਚ ਕੀਤੇ ਬਾਗੇ ਬਾਗ ॥
transliteration: ghar gach keete baage baag ||
english: Their houses are painted beautifully white.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saad sahaj kar man khelaaiaa ||
english: In pleasure and poise, they play their mind games.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tai sah paasahu kahan kahaaiaa ||
english: When they approach You, O Lord, they shall be spoken to.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mithaa kar kai kauRaa khaaiaa ||
english: They think it is sweet, so they eat the bitter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਉੜੈ ਤਨਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin kauRai tan rog jamaaiaa ||
english: The bitter disease grows in the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je phir mithaa peRai paai ||
english: If, later on, they receive the sweet,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਉੜਤਣੁ ਚੂਕਸਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tau kauRatan chookas maai ||
english: then their bitterness shall be gone, O mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paavai soi ||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed to receive

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis no praapat likhiaa hoi ||2||
english: what he is predestined to receive. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kai hiradai mail kapat hai baahar dhovaaiaa ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the filth of deception, may wash themselves on the outside.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kooR kapat kamaavade kooR paragatee aaiaa ||
english: They practice falsehood and deception, and their falsehood is revealed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਹ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar hoi s nikalai nah chhapai chhapaaiaa ||
english: That which is within them, comes out; it cannot be concealed by concealment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kooRai laalach lagiaa phir joonee paaiaa ||
english: Attached to falsehood and greed, the mortal is consigned to reincarnation over and over again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak jo beejai so khaavanaa karatai likh paaiaa ||15||
english: O Nanak, whatever the mortal plants, he must eat. The Creator Lord has written our destiny. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਬੇਦਂੀ ਆਣੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kathaa kahaanee beda(n)ee aanee paap pu(n)n beechaar ||
english: The Vedas bring forth stories and legends, and thoughts of vice and virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਲੈਣਾ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦੇਣਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: de de lainaa lai lai denaa narak surag avataar ||
english: What is given, they receive, and what is received, they give. They are reincarnated in heaven and hell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਿਮ ਜਾਤੀਂ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: utam madhim jaatee(n) jinasee bharam bhavai sa(n)saar ||
english: High and low, social class and status - the world wanders lost in superstition.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee tat vakhaanee giaan dhiaan vich aaee ||
english: The Ambrosial Word of Gurbani proclaims the essence of reality. Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained within it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਂੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aakhee guramukh jaatee surata(n)ee karam dhiaaee ||
english: The Gurmukhs chant it, and the Gurmukhs realize it. Intuitively aware, they meditate on it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam saaj hukamai vich rakhai hukamai a(n)dar vekhai ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He formed the Universe, and in His Hukam, He keeps it. By His Hukam, He keeps it under His Gaze.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak agahu haumai tutai taa(n) ko likheeai lekhai ||1||
english: O Nanak, if the mortal shatters his ego before he departs, as it is pre-ordained, then he is approved. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਕਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bed pukaare pu(n)n paap surag narak kaa beeu ||
english: The Vedas proclaim that vice and virtue are the seeds of heaven and hell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਉਗਵੈ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jo beejai so ugavai khaa(n)daa jaanai jeeu ||
english: Whatever is planted, shall grow. The soul eats the fruits of its actions, and understands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: giaan salaahe vadaa kar sacho sachaa naau ||
english: Whoever praises spiritual wisdom as great, becomes truthful in the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਸਚੁ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sach beejai sach ugavai daragah paaeeai thaau ||
english: When Truth is planted, Truth grows. In the Court of the Lord, you shall find your place of honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bed vapaaree giaan raas karamee palai hoi ||
english: The Vedas are only merchants; spiritual wisdom is the capital; by His Grace, it is received.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਸੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲਦਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak raasee baaharaa lad na chaliaa koi ||2||
english: O Nanak, without capital, no one has ever departed with profit. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)m birakh bahu sa(n)cheeai a(n)mrit ras paaiaa ||
english: You can water a bitter neem tree with ambrosial nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: biseear ma(n)tr visaaheeai bahu doodh peeaaiaa ||
english: You can feed a venomous snake lots of milk.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਭਿੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਪਥਰੁ ਨਾਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh abhi(n)n na bhijaee pathar naavaaiaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is resistant; he cannot be softened. You might as well water a stone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bikh mahi a(n)mrit si(n)cheeai bikh kaa phal paaiaa ||
english: Irrigating a poisonous plant with ambrosial nectar, only poisonous fruit is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)gat mel har sabh bikh lahi jaaiaa ||16||
english: O Lord, please unite Nanak with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, so that he may be rid of all poison. ||16||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਿ ਨ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਪੁਛੀ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maran na moorat puchhiaa puchhee thit na vaar ||
english: Death does not ask the time; it does not ask the date or the day of the week.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਇਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਨੑੀ ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ikanhee ladiaa ik lad chale ikanhee badhe bhaar ||
english: Some have packed up, and some who have packed up have gone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa hoee saakhatee ikanhaa hoee saar ||
english: Some are severely punished, and some are taken care of.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਸਣੈ ਦਮਾਮਿਆ ਛੁਟੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: lasakar sanai damaamiaa chhute ba(n)k duaar ||
english: They must leave their armies and drums, and their beautiful mansions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਢੇਰੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਈ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak dheree chhaar kee bhee phir hoee chhaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, the pile of dust is once again reduced to dust. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਢੇਰੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੰਦਾ ਕੋਟੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak dheree dhahi paee mitee sa(n)daa kot ||
english: O Nanak, the pile shall fall apart; the fortress of the body is made of dust.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ਖੋਟੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਖੋਟੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bheetar chor bahaaliaa khot ve jeeaa khot ||2||
english: The thief has settled within you; O soul, your life is false. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਨਕ ਵਢੇ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin a(n)dar ni(n)daa dusat hai nak vadhe nak vadhaaiaa ||
english: Those who are filled with vicious slander, shall have their noses cut, and be shamed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਰੂਪ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa karoop dukheee sadaa kaale muh maaiaa ||
english: They are totally ugly, and always in pain. Their faces are blackened by Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhalake uth nit par darab hirahi har naam churaaiaa ||
english: They rise early in the morning, to cheat and steal from others; they hide from the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu tin kee sa(n)gat mat karahu rakh lehu har raaiaa ||
english: O Dear Lord, let me not even associate with them; save me from them, O my Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak paiai kirat kamaavade manamukh dukh paaiaa ||17||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs act according to their past deeds, producing nothing but pain. ||17||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh koee hai khasam kaa khasamahu sabh ko hoi ||
english: Everyone belongs to our Lord and Master. Everyone came from Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa taa sach paavai koi ||
english: Only by realizing the Hukam of His Command, is Truth obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaneeai buraa na deesai koi ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes his own self; no one appears evil to him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaaeeai sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Fruitful is his coming into the world. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa daataa aap hai aape melanahaar ||
english: He Himself is the Giver of all; He unites all with Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sabad mile na vichhuRahi jinaa seviaa har daataar ||2||
english: O Nanak, they are united with the Word of the Shabad; serving the Lord, the Great Giver, they shall never be separated from Him again. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hiradai saa(n)t hai naau ugav aaiaa ||
english: Peace and tranquility fill the heart of the Gurmukh; the Name wells up within them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jap tap teerath sa(n)jam kare mere prabh bhaaiaa ||
english: Chanting and meditation, penance and self-discipline, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage - the merits of these come by pleasing my God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hiradaa sudh har sevade sohahi gun gaaiaa ||
english: So serve the Lord with a pure heart; singing His Glorious Praises, you shall be embellished and exalted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mere har jeeu evai bhaavadaa guramukh taraaiaa ||
english: My Dear Lord is pleased by this; he carries the Gurmukh across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh melian har dar sohaaiaa ||18||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is merged with the Lord; he is embellished in His Court. ||18||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੀ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhanava(n)taa iv hee kahai avaree dhan kau jaau ||
english: Thus speaks the wealthy man: I should go and get more wealth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak niradhan tit din jit din visarai naau ||1||
english: Nanak becomes poor on that day when he forgets the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੜੈ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਘਟੈ ਆਰਜਾ ॥
transliteration: sooraj chaRai vijog sabhasai ghatai aarajaa ||
english: The sun rises and sets, and the lives of all run out.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਾਰੈ ਕੋ ਜਿਣੈ ॥
transliteration: tan man rataa bhog koee haarai ko jinai ||
english: The mind and body experience pleasures; one loses, and another wins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਰਿਆ ਫੂਕਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਥੰਮੑੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko bhariaa phook aakhan kahan na tha(n)mheeai ||
english: Everyone is puffed up with pride; even after they are spoken to, they do not stop.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਫੂਕ ਕਢਾਏ ਢਹਿ ਪਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vekhai aap phook kadhaae dhahi pavai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; when He takes the air out of the balloon, the body falls. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat naam nidhaan hai jithahu har paaiaa ||
english: The treasure of the Name is in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. There, the Lord is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ghat chaananaa aanher gavaaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: lohaa paaras bheteeai ka(n)chan hoi aaiaa ||
english: Iron is transformed into gold, when it touches the Philosopher's Stone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak satigur miliai naau paaeeai mil naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, the Name is obtained. Meeting Him, the mortal meditates on the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: jinh kai potai pu(n)n hai tinhee darasan paaiaa ||19||
english: Those who have virtue as their treasure, obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਵੇਚਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhrig tinaa kaa jeeviaa j likh likh vechahi naau ||
english: Cursed are the lives of those who read and write the Lord's Name to sell it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਉਜੜੈ ਖਲਵਾੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khetee jin kee ujaRai khalavaaRe kiaa thaau ||
english: Their crop is devastated - what harvest will they have?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਰਮੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਅਗੈ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਦਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: sachai saramai baahare agai lahahi na daad ||
english: Lacking truth and humility, they shall not be appreciated in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਲਿ ਏਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਅਕਲਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: akal eh na aakheeai akal gavaaeeai baad ||
english: Wisdom which leads to arguments is not called wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਲੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅਕਲੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: akalee saahib seveeai akalee paaeeai maan ||
english: Wisdom leads us to serve our Lord and Master; through wisdom, honor is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਲੀ ਪੜੑਿ ਕੈ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਅਕਲੀ ਕੀਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: akalee paRhi kai bujheeai akalee keechai daan ||
english: Wisdom does not come by reading textbooks; wisdom inspires us to give in charity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aakhai raahu ehu hor galaa(n) saitaan ||1||
english: Says Nanak, this is the Path; other things lead to Satan. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਐਸੀ ਬਨੀ ਜਰੂਰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa karai kahaavai taisaa aisee banee jaroorat ||
english: Mortals are known by their actions; this is the way it has to be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਿੰਙ ਝਿੰਙ ਨਹ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਐਸੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੂਰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: hovahi li(n)ng jhi(n)ng nah hovahi aisee kaheeai soorat ||
english: They should show goodness, and not be deformed by their actions; this is how they are called beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਓਸੁ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਮੂਰਤਿ ॥੨॥
