transliteration: jo os ichhe so phal paae taa(n) naanak kaheeai moorat ||2||
english: Whatever they desire, they shall receive; O Nanak, they become the very image of God. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਫਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur a(n)mrit birakh hai a(n)mrit ras phaliaa ||
english: The True Guru is the tree of ambrosia. it bears the fruit of sweet nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis paraapat so lahai gurasabadee miliaa ||
english: He alone receives it, who is so pre-destined, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai har setee raliaa ||
english: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, is blended with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਬਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal johi na sakaee ghat chaanan baliaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot even see him; his heart is illumined with God's Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak bakhas milaaian phir garabh na galiaa ||20||
english: O Nanak, God forgives him, and blends him with Himself; he does not rot away in the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sach varat sa(n)tokh teerath giaan dhiaan isanaan ||
english: Those who have truth as their fast, contentment as their sacred shrine of pilgrimage, spiritual wisdom and meditation as their cleansing bath,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਤੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: daiaa devataa khimaa japamaalee te maanas paradhaan ||
english: kindness as their deity, and forgiveness as their chanting beads - they are the most excellent people.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਚਉਕਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jugat dhotee surat chaukaa tilak karanee hoi ||
english: Those who take the Way as their loincloth, and intuitive awareness their ritualistically purified enclosure, with good deeds their ceremonial forehead mark,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaau bhojan naanakaa viralaa ta koee koi ||1||
english: and love their food - O Nanak, they are very rare. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉਮੀ ਨੇਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਜੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naumee nem sach je karai ||
english: On the ninth day of the month, make a vow to speak the Truth,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa ucharai ||
english: and your sexual desire, anger and desire shall be eaten up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਸੇ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੈ ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dasamee dase duaar je thaakai ekaadasee ek kar jaanai ||
english: On the tenth day, regulate your ten doors; on the eleventh day, know that the Lord is One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: duaadasee pa(n)ch vasagat kar raakhai tau naanak man maanai ||
english: On the twelfth day, the five thieves are subdued, and then, O Nanak, the mind is pleased and appeased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਵਰਤੁ ਰਹੀਜੈ ਪਾਡੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aisaa varat raheejai paade hor bahut sikh kiaa deejai ||2||
english: Observe such a fast as this, O Pandit, O religious scholar; of what use are all the other teachings? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਇ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhoopat raaje ra(n)g raai sa(n)chahi bikh maaiaa ||
english: Kings, rulers and monarchs enjoy pleasures and gather the poison of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਦੇ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kar het vadhaaide par darab churaaiaa ||
english: In love with it, they collect more and more, stealing the wealth of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਵਿਸਹਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr na visahahi bahu preet lagaaiaa ||
english: They do not trust their own children or spouses; they are totally attached to the love of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਦਿਆ ਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੁਹਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਹਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vekhadiaa hee maaiaa dhuhi gaee pachhutahi pachhutaaiaa ||
english: But even as they look on, Maya cheats them, and they come to regret and repent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeahi naanak har bhaaiaa ||21||
english: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are beaten and punished; O Nanak, it pleases the Will of the Lord. ||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੀਤ ॥
transliteration: giaan vihoonaa gaavai geet ||
english: The one who lacks spiritual wisdom sings religious songs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਖੇ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਘਰੇ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bhukhe mulaa(n) ghare maseet ||
english: The hungry Mullah turns his home into a mosque.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਖਟੂ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: makhatoo hoi kai ka(n)n paRaae ||
english: The lazy unemployed has his ears pierced to look like a Yogi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: phakar kare hor jaat gavaae ||
english: Someone else becomes a pan-handler, and loses his social status.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਮੰਗਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur peer sadaae ma(n)gan jaai ||
english: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he goes around begging

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਐ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kai mool na lageeai paai ||
english: - don't ever touch his feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: ghaal khaai kichh hathahu dei ||
english: One who works for what he eats, and gives some of what he has

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak raahu pachhaanahi sei ||1||
english: - O Nanak, he knows the Path. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਕੂਪ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ॥
transliteration: manahu j a(n)dhe koop kahiaa birad na jaananhee ||
english: Those mortals whose minds are like deep dark pits do not understand the purpose of life, even when it is explained to them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਊਂਧੈ ਕਵਲਿ ਦਿਸਨੑਿ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)dhai oo(n)dhai kaval disanhi khare karoop ||
english: Their minds are blind, and their heart-lotuses are upside-down; they look totally ugly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: ik kahi jaanahi kahiaa bujhahi te nar sughaR saroop ||
english: Some know how to speak, and understand what they are told. They are wise and beautiful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਦ ਨ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਗੀਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa naad na bed na gee ras ras kas na jaana(n)t ||
english: Some do not understand about the Sound-current of the Naad or the Vedas, music, virtue or vice.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਸਰ ਅਖਰ ਕਾ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਲਹੰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa sudh na budh na akal sar akhar kaa bheu na laha(n)t ||
english: Some are not blessed with understanding, intelligence, or sublime intellect; they do not grasp the mystery of God's Word.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਨਰ ਅਸਲਿ ਖਰ ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੰਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak se nar asal khar j bin gun garab kara(n)t ||2||
english: O Nanak, they are donkeys; they are very proud of themselves, but they have no virtues at all. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਭ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabh pavit hai dhan sa(n)pai maaiaa ||
english: To the Gurmukh, everything is sacred: wealth, property, Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਜੋ ਖਰਚਦੇ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har arath jo kharachade de(n)de sukh paaiaa ||
english: Those who spend the wealth of the Lord find peace through giving.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide tin tot na aaiaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name shall never be deprived.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਟਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa(n) nadaree aavadaa maaiaa sut paaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs come to see the Lord, and leave behind the things of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਹੋਰੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa(n) hor chit na aavaee har naam samaaiaa ||22||
english: O Nanak, the devotees do not think of anything else; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||22||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan se vadabhaagee ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad jinhaa ek liv laagee ||
english: They are lovingly attuned to the True Shabad, the Word of the One God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: girah kuta(n)b mahi sahaj samaadhee ||
english: In their own household and family, they are in natural Samaadhi.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se sache bairaagee ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are truly detached from the world. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ganatai sev na hovaee keetaa thaai na paai ||
english: Calculated service is not service at all, and what is done is not approved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio sach na lago bhaau ||
english: The flavor of the Shabad, the Word of God, is not tasted if the mortal is not in love with the True Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur piaaraa na lagaee manahath aavai jaai ||
english: The stubborn-minded person does not even like the True Guru; he comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਭਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਦਸ ਵਿਖਾਂ ਪਿਛਾਹਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je ik vikh agaahaa bhare taa(n) das vikhaa(n) pichhaahaa jaai ||
english: He takes one step forward, and ten steps back.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa chaakaree je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
english: The mortal works to serve the True Guru, if he walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap gavaai satiguroo no milai sahaje rahai samaai ||
english: He loses his self-conceit, and meets the True Guru; he remains intuitively absorbed in the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tinhaa naam na veesarai sache mel milaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਇਦੇ ਕੋ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khaan malook kahaaide ko rahan na paaee ||
english: They call themselves emperors and rulers, but none of them will be allowed to stay.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੜੑ ਮੰਦਰ ਗਚ ਗੀਰੀਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gaRh ma(n)dar gach geereeaa kichh saath na jaaee ||
english: Their sturdy forts and mansions - none of them will go along with them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਇਨ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: soin saakhat paun veg dhrig dhrig chaturaaee ||
english: Their gold and horses, fast as the wind, are cursed, and cursed are their clever tricks.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chhateeh a(n)mrit parakaar karahi bahu mail vadhaaee ||
english: Eating the thirty-six delicacies, they become bloated with pollution.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak jo devai tisahi na jaananhee manamukh dukh paaee ||23||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh does not know the One who gives, and so he suffers in pain. ||23||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋੁਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੇਸੰਤਰ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paRhi paRhi pa(n)dit mounee thake desa(n)tar bhav thake bhekhadhaaree ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and recite until they get tired. They wander through foreign lands in their religious robes, until they are exhausted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai naau kade na paain dukh laagaa at bhaaree ||
english: In love with duality, they never receive the Name. Held in the grasp of pain, they suffer terribly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: moorakh a(n)dhe trai gun sevahi maaiaa kai biuhaaree ||
english: The blind fools serve the three gunas, the three dispositions; they deal only with Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar kapat udar bharan kai taaee paath paRahi gaavaaree ||
english: With deception in their hearts, the fools read sacred texts to fill their bellies.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve so sukh paae jin haumai vichahu maaree ||
english: One who serves the True Guru finds peace; he eradicates egotism from within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁਨਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak paRanaa gunanaa ik naau hai boojhai ko beechaaree ||1||
english: O Nanak, there is One Name to chant and dwell on; how rare are those who reflect on this and understand. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਂਗੇ ਆਵਣਾ ਨਾਂਗੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: naa(n)ge aavanaa naa(n)ge jaanaa har hukam paaiaa kiaa keejai ||
english: Naked we come, and naked we go. This is by the Lord's Command; what else can we do?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਰੋਸੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kee vasat soee lai jaaigaa ros kisai siu keejai ||
english: The object belongs to Him; He shall take it away; with whom should one be angry.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s bhaanaa ma(n)ne sahaje har ras peejai ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh accepts God's Will; he intuitively drinks in the Lord's sublime essence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sukhadaataa sadaa salaahihu rasanaa raam raveejai ||2||
english: O Nanak, praise the Giver of peace forever; with your tongue, savor the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੜੑਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gaRhi kaaiaa seegaar bahu bhaa(n)t banaaee ||
english: The fortress of the body has been decorated and adorned in so many ways.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਕਤੀਫਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਧਰ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g para(n)g kateephiaa pahirahi dhar maaee ||
english: The wealthy wear beautiful silk robes of various colors.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਸੁਪੇਦ ਦੁਲੀਚਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਸਭਾ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: laal suped duleechiaa bahu sabhaa banaaee ||
english: They hold elegant and beautiful courts, on red and white carpets.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭੋਗਣਾ ਗਰਬੈ ਗਰਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dukh khaanaa dukh bhoganaa garabai garabaaee ||
english: But they eat in pain, and in pain they seek pleasure; they are very proud of their pride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam na chetio a(n)t lae chhadaaee ||24||
english: O Nanak, the mortal does not even think of the Name, which shall deliver him in the end. ||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje sukh sutee sabad samaai ||
english: She sleeps in intuitive peace and poise, absorbed in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape prabh mel laee gal laai ||
english: God hugs her close in His Embrace, and merges her into Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa chookee sahaj subhaai ||
english: Duality is eradicated with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam vasiaa man aai ||
english: The Naam comes to abide in her mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se ka(n)th laae j bha(n)n ghaRaai ||
english: He hugs close in His Embrace those who shatter and reform their beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jo dhur mile se hun aan milaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are predestined to meet Him, come and meet Him now. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinhee naam visaariaa kiaa jap jaapahi hor ||
english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord - so what if they chant other chants?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਮੁਠੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bisataa a(n)dar keet se muthe dha(n)dhai chor ||
english: They are maggots in manure, plundered by the thief of worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai jhoothe laalach hor ||2||
english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; greed for anything else is false. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naam salaahan naam ma(n)n asathir jag soee ||
english: Those who praise the Naam, and believe in the Naam, are eternally stable in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai har har chitavai doojaa nahee koee ||
english: Within their hearts, they dwell on the Lord, and nothing else at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: rom rom har ucharai khin khin har soee ||
english: With each and every hair, they chant the Lord's Name, each and every instant, the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh janam sakaarathaa niramal mal khoee ||
english: The birth of the Gurmukh is fruitful and certified; pure and unstained, his filth is washed away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak jeevadaa purakh dhiaaiaa amaraa pad hoee ||25||
english: O Nanak, meditating on the Lord of eternal life, the status of immortality is obtained. ||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa bahu karam kamaavahi hor ||
english: Those who forget the Naam and do other things,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਨੑੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jam pur badhe maareeahi jiu sa(n)nhee upar chor ||1||
english: O Nanak, will be bound and gagged and beaten in the City of Death, like the thief caught red-handed. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਜਪੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dharat suhaavaRee aakaas suha(n)daa japa(n)diaa har naau ||
english: The earth is beauteous, and the sky is lovely, chanting the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਤਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vihooniaa tinh tan khaavahi kaau ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who lack the Naam - their carcasses are eaten by the crows. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਮਹਲੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: naam salaahan bhaau kar nij mahalee vaasaa ||
english: Those who lovingly praise the Naam, and dwell in the mansion of the self deep within,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: oi baahuR jon na aavanee phir hohi na binaasaa ||
english: do not enter into reincarnation ever again; they shall never be destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har setee ra(n)g rav rahe sabh saas giraasaa ||
english: They remain immersed and absorbed in the love of the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa ra(n)g kade na utarai guramukh paragaasaa ||
english: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; the Gurmukhs are enlightened.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: oi kirapaa kar kai melian naanak har paasaa ||26||
english: Granting His Grace, He unites them with Himself; O Nanak, the Lord keeps them by His side. ||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jichar ihu man laharee vich hai haumai bahut aha(n)kaar ||
english: As long as his mind is disturbed by waves, he is caught in ego and egotistical pride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad na aavaee naam na lagai piaar ||
english: He does not find the taste of the Shabad, and he does not embrace love for the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sevaa thaai na pavaee tis kee khap khap hoi khuaar ||
english: His service is not accepted; worrying and worrying, he wastes away in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak sevak soee aakheeai jo sir dhare utaar ||
english: O Nanak, he alone is called a selfless servant, who cuts off his head, and offers it to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n lae sabad rakhai ur dhaar ||1||
english: He accepts the Will of the True Guru, and enshrines the Shabad within his heart. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੋ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so jap tap sevaa chaakaree jo khasamai bhaavai ||
english: That is chanting and meditation, work and selfless service, which is pleasing to our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਆਪਤੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase mel lae aapat gavaavai ||
english: The Lord Himself forgives, and takes away self-conceit, and unites the mortals with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: miliaa kade na veechhuRai jotee jot milaavai ||
english: United with the Lord, the mortal is never separated again; his light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee so bujhasee jis aap bujhaavai ||2||
english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, the mortal understands, when the Lord allows him to understand. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko lekhe vich hai manamukh aha(n)kaaree ||
english: All are held accountable, even the egotistical self-willed manmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har naam kade na chetaee jamakaal sir maaree ||
english: They never even think of the Name of the Lord; the Messenger of Death shall hit them on their heads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨੂਰ ਸਭਿ ਲਦੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paap bikaar manoor sabh lade bahu bhaaree ||
english: Their sin and corruption are like rusty slag; they carry such a heavy load.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maarag bikham daraavanaa kiu tareeai taaree ||
english: The path is treacherous and terrifying; how can they cross over to the other side?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak gur raakhe se ubare har naam udhaaree ||27||
english: O Nanak, those whom the Guru protects are saved. They are saved in the Name of the Lord. ||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vin satigur seve sukh nahee mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds peace; mortals die and are reborn, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: moh thagaulee paaeean bahu doojai bhaai vikaar ||
english: They have been given the drug of emotional attachment; in love with duality, they are totally corrupt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik gur parasaadee ubare tis jan kau karahi sabh namasakaar ||
english: Some are saved, by Guru's Grace. Everyone humbly bows before such humble beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak anadin naam dhiaai too a(n)tar jit paavahi mokh duaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, deep within yourself, day and night. You shall find the Door of Salvation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi visaariaa sach maranaa har naam ||
english: Emotionally attached to Maya, the mortal forgets truth, death and the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karatiaa janam gaiaa a(n)dar dukh sahaam ||
english: Engaged in worldly affairs, his life wastes away; deep within himself, he suffers in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sev sukh paaiaa jinh poorab likhiaa karaam ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who have the karma of such pre-ordained destiny, serve the True Guru and find peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa paReeai har naam phir lekh na hoee ||
english: Read the account of the Name of the Lord, and you shall never again be called to account.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਦ ਢੋਈ ॥
transliteration: puchh na sakai koi har dar sad dhoee ||
english: No one will question you, and you will always be safe in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦੇ ਭੇਟ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal milai de bhet sevak nit hoee ||
english: The Messenger of Death will meet you, and be your constant servant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te mahal paaiaa pat paragat loee ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, you shall find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. You shall be famous throughout the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak anahad dhunee dar vajade miliaa har soee ||28||
english: O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates at your door; come and merge with the Lord. ||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa kahiaa je kare sukhee hoo sukh saar ||
english: Whoever follows the Guru's Teachings, attains the most sublime peace of all peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kee karanee bhau kateeai naanak paavahi paar ||1||
english: Acting in accordance with the Guru, his fear is cut away; O Nanak, he is carried across. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach puraanaa naa theeai naam na mailaa hoi ||
english: The True Lord does not grow old; His Naam is never dirtied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai je chalai bahuR na aavan hoi ||
english: Whoever walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall not be reborn again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam visaariai aavan jaanaa doi ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam, come and go in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gat jan jaachai daan har dehu subhaai ||
english: I am a beggar; I ask this blessing of You: O Lord, please embellish me with Your Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har darasan kee piaas hai darasan tripataai ||
english: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; His Darshan brings me satisfaction.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਾਂ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khin pal ghaRee na jeevaoo bin dekhe maraa(n) maai ||
english: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without seeing Him, O my mother.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur naal dikhaaliaa rav rahiaa sabh thaai ||
english: The Guru has shown me that the Lord is always with me; He is permeating and pervading all places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਉਠਾਲਿ ਦੇਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: sutiaa aap uthaal dei naanak liv laai ||29||
english: He Himself wakes the sleepers, O Nanak, and lovingly attunes them to Himself. ||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bol na jaananhee onaa a(n)dar kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not even know how to speak. They are filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: thaau kuthaau na jaananee sadaa chitavahi bikaar ||
english: They do not know the difference between good and bad; they constantly think of corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਓਥੈ ਹੋਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: daragah lekhaa ma(n)geeai othai hohi kooRiaar ||
english: In the Lord's Court, they are called to account, and they are judged to be false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat upaaeean aap kare beechaar ||
english: He Himself creates the Universe. He Himself contemplates it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kis no aakheeai sabh varatai aap sachiaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, whom should we tell? The True Lord is permeating and pervading all. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har guramukh tinhee araadhiaa jinh karam paraapat hoi ||
english: The Gurmukhs worship and adore the Lord; they receive the good karma of their actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak hau balihaaree tinh kau jinh har man vasiaa soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aas kare sabh lok bahu jeevan jaaniaa ||
english: All people cherish hope, that they will live long lives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੜੑ ਮੰਡਪ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nit jeevan kau chit gaRh ma(n)dap savaariaa ||
english: They wish to live forever; they adorn and embellish their forts and mansions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਿਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: valava(n)ch kar upaav maaiaa hir aaniaa ||
english: By various frauds and deceptions, they steal the wealth of others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਸਾਸ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal nihaale saas aav ghatai betaaliaa ||
english: But the Messenger of Death keeps his gaze on their breath, and the life of those goblins decreases day by day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਖਵਾਲਿਆ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak gur saranaaee ubare har gur rakhavaaliaa ||30||
english: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Guru, and is saved. The Guru, the Lord, is his Protector. ||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit vaad vakhaanade maaiaa moh suaai ||
english: Reading and writing, the Pandits engage in debates and disputes; they are attached to the flavors of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai naam visaariaa man moorakh milai sajaai ||
english: In the love of duality, they forget the Naam. Those foolish mortals shall receive their punishment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੇਵਨੑੀ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinhi keete tisai na sevanhee dedaa rijak samaai ||
english: They do not serve the One who created them, who gives sustenance to all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jam kaa phaahaa galahu na kateeai phir phir aavahi jaai ||
english: The noose of Death around their necks is not cut off; they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa satigur miliaa tin aai ||
english: The True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin naam dhiaaide naanak sach samaai ||1||
english: Night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; O Nanak, they merge into the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sach vanajahi sach sevade j guramukh pairee paahi ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who fall at His Feet deal with the True Lord and serve the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur kai bhaanai je chalahi sahaje sach samaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who walk in harmony with the Guru's Will are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aasaa vich at dukh ghanaa manamukh chit laaiaa ||
english: In hope, there is very great pain; the self-willed manmukh focuses his consciousness on it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhae niraas param sukh paaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs become desireless, and attain supreme peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: viche girah udaas alipat liv laaiaa ||
english: In the midst of their household, they remain detached; they are lovingly attuned to the Detached Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: onaa sog vijog na viaapaee har bhaanaa bhaaiaa ||
english: Sorrow and separation do not cling to them at all. They are pleased with the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak har setee sadaa rav rahe dhur lae milaaiaa ||31||
english: O Nanak, they remain forever immersed in the Primal Lord, who blends them with Himself. ||31||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਈ ਅਮਾਣ ਕਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ਦਿਤੀ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: paraaee amaan kiu rakheeai ditee hee sukh hoi ||
english: Why keep what is held in trust for another? Giving it back, peace is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਥੈ ਟਿਕੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad gur thai tikai hor thai paragat na hoi ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad rests in the Guru; it does not appear through anyone else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੑੇ ਵਸਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਵੇਚਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)nhe vas maanak paiaa ghar ghar vechan jaai ||
english: The blind man finds a jewel, and goes from house to house selling it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਰਖ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: onaa parakh na aavaee adh na palai paai ||
english: But they cannot appraise it, and they do not offer him even half a shell for it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਖ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤਾਂ ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਲਇਓੁ ਪਰਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je aap parakh na aavaee taa(n) paarakheeaa thaavahu laiou parakhaai ||
english: If he cannot appraise it himself, then he should have it appraised by an appraiser.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਵਥੁ ਲਹੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je os naal chit laae taa(n) vath lahai nau nidh palai paai ||
english: If he focuses his consciousness, then he obtains the true object, and he is blessed with the nine treasures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਧਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghar hodai dhan jag bhukhaa muaa bin satigur sojhee na hoi ||
english: The wealth is within the house, while the world is dying of hunger. Without the True Guru, no one has a clue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad seetal man tan vasai tithai sog vijog na koi ||
english: When the cooling and soothing Shabad comes to dwell in the mind and body, there is no sorrow or separation there.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vasat paraaee aap garab kare moorakh aap ganaae ||
english: The object belongs to someone else, but the fool is proud of it, and shows his shallow nature.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bin boojhe kinai na paaio phir phir aavai jaae ||1||
english: O Nanak, without understanding, no one obtains it; they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਰਸੇ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man anad bhaiaa miliaa har preetam sarase sajan sa(n)t piaare ||
english: My mind is in ecstasy; I have met my Beloved Lord. My beloved friends, the Saints, are delighted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur mile na vichhuRahi kabahoo j aap mele karataare ||
english: Those who are united with the Primal Lord shall never be separated again. The Creator has united them with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad raviaa gur paaiaa sagale dookh nivaare ||
english: The Shabad permeates my inner being, and I have found the Guru; all my sorrows are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖਾਂ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa sadaa salaahee a(n)tar rakhaa(n) ur dhaare ||
english: I praise forever the Lord, the Giver of peace; I keep Him enshrined deep within my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh tin kee bakheelee k kare j sachai sabad savaare ||
english: How can the self-willed manmukh gossip about those who are embellished and exalted in the True Word of the Shabad?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਏ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: onaa dee aap pat rakhasee meraa piaaraa saranaagat pae gur duaare ||
english: My Beloved Himself preserves the honor of those who have come to the Guru's Door seeking Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਏ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh se suhele bhae mukh oojal darabaare ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are filled with joy; their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: isataree purakhai bahu preet mil mohu vadhaaiaa ||
english: The husband and wife are very much in love; joining together, their love increases.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr nit vekhai vigasai mohi maaiaa ||
english: Gazing on his children and his wife, the man is pleased and attached to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਧਨੁ ਚੋਰਾਇ ਆਣਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: des parades dhan choraai aan muhi paaiaa ||
english: Stealing the wealth of his own country and other lands, he brings it home and feeds them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t hovai vair virodh ko sakai na chhadaaiaa ||
english: In the end, hatred and conflict well up, and no one can save him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak vin naavai dhrig mohu jit lag dukh paaiaa ||32||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, those loving attachments are cursed; engrossed in them, he suffers in pain. ||32||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)mrit naam hai jit khaadhai sabh bhukh jaai ||
english: The Guru's Word is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam. Eating it, all hunger departs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa mool na hovaee naam vasai man aai ||
english: There is no thirst or desire at all, when the Naam comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai j hor khaanaa tit rog lagai tan dhaai ||
english: Eating anything other than the Name, disease runs to afflict the body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ras kas sabad salaahanaa aape lae milaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, whoever takes the Praise of the Shabad as his spices and flavors - the Lord unites him in His Union. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jeeaa a(n)dar jeeu sabad hai jit sah melaavaa hoi ||
english: The life within all living beings is the Word of the Shabad. Through it, we meet our Husband Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗਿ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai jag aanher hai sabade paragat hoi ||
english: Without the Shabad, the world is in darkness. Through the Shabad, it is enlightened.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਤਨੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit monee paR paR thake bhekh thake tan dhoi ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages read and write until they are weary. The religious fanatics are tired of washing their bodies.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai kinai na paaio dukheee chale roi ||
english: Without the Shabad, no one attains the Lord; the miserable depart weeping and wailing.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai karam paraapat hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the Merciful Lord is attained. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਅਤਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਬਹਿ ਮੰਦੁ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: isatree purakhai at nehu bahi ma(n)d pakaaiaa ||
english: The husband and wife are very much in love; sitting together, they make evil plans.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: disadaa sabh kichh chalasee mere prabh bhaaiaa ||
english: All that is seen shall pass away. This is the Will of my God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਕੋ ਕਢਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kiu raheeai thir jag ko kadhahu upaaiaa ||
english: How can anyone remain in this world forever? Some may try to devise a plan.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee chaakaree thir ka(n)dh sabaaiaa ||
english: Working for the Perfect Guru, the wall becomes permanent and stable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak bakhas milaaian har naam samaaiaa ||33||
english: O Nanak, the Lord forgives them, and merges them into Himself; they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||33||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi visaariaa gur kaa bhau het apaar ||
english: Attached to Maya, the mortal forgets the Fear of God and Guru, and love for the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਗਈ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lobh lahar sudh mat gaee sach na lagai piaar ||
english: The waves of greed take away his wisdom and understanding, and he does not embrace love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jinaa sabad man vasai daragah mokh duaar ||
english: The Word of the Shabad abides in the mind of the Gurmukhs, who find the Gate of Salvation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aape mel lae aape bakhasanahaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself forgives them, and unites them in Union with Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਸਰੈ ਨ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: naanak jis bin ghaRee na jeevanaa visare sarai na bi(n)d ||
english: O Nanak, without Him, we could not live for a moment. Forgetting Him, we could not succeed for an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨ ਰੂਸੀਐ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis siu kiu man rooseeai jisahi hamaaree chi(n)d ||2||
english: O mortal, how can you be angry with the One who cares for you? ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਝਿਮਝਿਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: saavan aaiaa jhimajhimaa har guramukh naam dhiaai ||
english: The rainy season of Saawan has come. The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਕਾੜਾ ਸਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh bhukh kaaRaa sabh chukaaisee meehu vuthaa chhahabar laai ||
english: All pain, hunger and misfortune end, when the rain falls in torrents.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਧਰਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਬੋਹਲ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh dharat bhaee hareeaavalee a(n)n ja(n)miaa bohal laai ||
english: The entire earth is rejuvenated, and the grain grows in abundance.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har achi(n)t bulaavai kripaa kar har aape paavai thaai ||
english: The Carefree Lord, by His Grace, summons that mortal whom the Lord Himself approves.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har tisahi dhiaavahu sa(n)t janahu j a(n)te lae chhadaai ||
english: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He shall save you in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: har keerat bhagat ana(n)d hai sadaa sukh vasai man aai ||
english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and devotion to Him is bliss; peace shall come to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa guramukh naam araadhiaa tinaa dukh bhukh lahi jaai ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their pain and hunger departs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak tripatai gaai gun har darasan dehu subhaai ||3||
english: Servant Nanak is satisfied, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. Please embellish him with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee daat nit devai chaRai savaaeeaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru bestows His gifts, which increase day by day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: tus devai aap daiaal na chhapai chhapaaeeaa ||
english: The Merciful Lord Himself bestows them; they cannot be concealed by concealment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: hiradai kaval pragaas unaman liv laaeeaa ||
english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mortal is lovingly absorbed in the state of supreme bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: je ko kare us dee rees sir chhaaee paaeeaa ||
english: If anyone tries to challenge him, the Lord throws dust on his head.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak apaR koi na sakaee poore satigur kee vadiaaeeaa ||34||
english: O Nanak, no one can equal the glory of the Perfect True Guru. ||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: amar veparavaahu hai tis naal siaanap na chalaee na hujat karanee jaai ||
english: The Order of the Lord is beyond challenge. Clever tricks and arguments will not work against it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap chhod saranaai pavai ma(n)n lae rajaai ||
english: So abandon your self-conceit, and take to His Sanctuary; accept the Order of His Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jam da(n)d na lagaee haumai vichahu jaai ||
english: The Gurmukh eliminates self-conceit from within himself; he shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sevak soee aakheeai j sach rahai liv laai ||1||
english: O Nanak, he alone is called a selfless servant, who remains lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: daat jot sabh soorat teree ||
english: All gifts, light and beauty are Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bahut siaanap haumai meree ||
english: Excessive cleverness and egotism are mine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bahu karam kamaavahi lobh mohi viaape haumai kade na chookai pheree ||
english: The mortal performs all sorts of rituals in greed and attachment; engrossed in egotsim, he shall never escape the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਗਲ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aap karaae karataa jo tis bhaavai saaee gal cha(n)geree ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Creator Himself inspires all to act. Whatever pleases Him is good. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: pauRee mah 5 ||
english: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sach naam adhaar ||
english: Let Truth be your food, and Truth your clothes, and take the Support of the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai melaaiaa prabh devanahaar ||
english: The True Guru shall lead you to meet God, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaag pooraa tin jaagiaa japiaa nira(n)kaar ||
english: When perfect destiny is activated, the mortal meditates on the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat lagiaa tariaa sa(n)saar ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: naanak siphat salaah kar prabh kaa jaikaar ||35||
english: O Nanak, chant God's Praises, and celebrate His Victory. ||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhe jee samaal apanee mihar kar ||
english: In Your Mercy, You care for all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਮੁਚੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਤਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n paanee much upaai dukh daalad bha(n)n tar ||
english: You produce corn and water in abundance; You eliminate pain and poverty, and carry all beings across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਠਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aradaas sunee daataar hoee sisat thar ||
english: The Great Giver listened to my prayer, and the world has been cooled and comforted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਅਪਦਾ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ॥
transliteration: levahu ka(n)th lagaai apadaa sabh har ||
english: Take me into Your Embrace, and take away all my pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਘਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai prabh kaa saphal ghar ||1||
english: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the House of God is fruitful and prosperous. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vuthe megh suhaavane hukam keetaa karataar ||
english: Rain is falling from the clouds - it is so beautiful! The Creator Lord issued His Order.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: rijak upaaion agalaa thaa(n)dh paee sa(n)saar ||
english: Grain has been produced in abundance; the world is cooled and comforted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tan man hariaa hoiaa simarat agam apaar ||
english: The mind and body are rejuvenated, meditating in remembrance on the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sache sirajanahaar ||
english: O my True Creator Lord God, please shower Your Mercy on me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: keetaa loRahi so karahi naanak sad balihaar ||2||
english: He does whatever He pleases; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: vadaa aap aga(n)m hai vadee vadiaaee ||
english: The Great Lord is Inaccessible; His glorious greatness is glorious!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee vekh vigasiaa a(n)tar saa(n)t aaee ||
english: Gazing upon Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I blossom forth in ecstasy; tranquility comes to my inner being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape hai bhaaee ||
english: All by Himself, He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਭ ਨਥੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aap naath sabh natheean sabh hukam chalaaee ||
english: He Himself is the Lord and Master of all. He has subdued all, and all are under the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩੬॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak har bhaavai so kare sabh chalai rajaaee ||36||1|| sudh ||
english: O Nanak, the Lord does whatever He pleases. Everyone walks in harmony with His Will. ||36||1|| Sudh||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: raag saara(n)g baanee bhagataa(n) kee || kabeer jee ||
english: Raag Saarang, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਨਰ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
transliteration: kahaa nar garabas thoree baat ||
english: O mortal, why are you so proud of small things?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਦਸ ਨਾਜੁ ਟਕਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਾਂਠੀ ਐਂਡੌ ਟੇਢੌ ਜਾਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man das naaj takaa chaar gaa(n)thee ai(n)dau tedhau jaat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With a few pounds of grain and a few coins in your pocket, you are totally puffed up with pride. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਗਾਂਉ ਸਉ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਇ ਲਖ ਟਕਾ ਬਰਾਤ ॥
transliteration: bahut prataap gaa(n)u sau paae dui lakh takaa baraat ||
english: With great pomp and ceremony, you control a hundred villages, with an income of hundreds of thousands of dollars.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: divas chaar kee karahu saahibee jaise ban har paat ||1||
english: The power you exert will last for only a few days, like the green leaves of the forest. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਆਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naa kooo lai aaio ihu dhan naa kooo lai jaat ||
english: No one has brought this wealth with him, and no one will take it with him when he goes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਨ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raavan hoo(n) te adhik chhatrapat khin mahi gae bilaat ||2||
english: Emperors, even greater than Raawan, passed away in an instant. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sadaa thir poojahu jo har naam japaat ||
english: The Lord's Saints are steady and stable forever; they worship and adore Him, and chant the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin kau kripaa karat hai gobid te satasa(n)g milaat ||3||
english: Those who are mercifully blessed by the Lord of the Universe, join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਚਲਤ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa banitaa sut sa(n)pat a(n)t na chalat sa(n)gaat ||
english: Mother, father, spouse, children and wealth will not go along with you in the end.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer raam bhaj baure janam akaarath jaat ||4||1||
english: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate on the Lord, O madman. Your life is uselessly wasting away. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾਸ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raajaasram mit nahee jaanee teree ||
english: I do not know the limits of Your Royal Ashram.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere sa(n)tan kee hau cheree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am the humble slave of Your Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੋ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੋਵਤੁ ਆਵੈ ਰੋਵਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
transliteration: hasato jaai s rovat aavai rovat jaai s hasai ||
english: The one who goes laughing returns crying, and the one who goes crying returns laughing.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤੋ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੋੁ ਊਜਰੁ ਊਜਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: basato hoi hoi sou oojar oojar hoi s basai ||1||
english: What is inhabited becomes deserted, and what is deserted becomes inhabited. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਥਲ ਕਰਿ ਥਲ ਤੇ ਕੂਆ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jal te thal kar thal te kooaa koop te mer karaavai ||
english: The water turns into a desert, the desert turns into a well, and the well turns into a mountain.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਤੇ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਚਢਾਵੈ ਚਢੇ ਅਕਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharatee te aakaas chadhaavai chadhe akaas giraavai ||2||
english: From the earth, the mortal is exalted to the Akaashic ethers; and from the ethers on high, he is thrown down again. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਤੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhekhaaree te raaj karaavai raajaa te bhekhaaree ||
english: The beggar is transformed into a king, and the king into a beggar.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਖਲ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਰਿਬੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਤੇ ਮੁਗਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khal moorakh te pa(n)dit karibo pa(n)dit te mugadhaaree ||3||
english: The idiotic fool is transformed into a Pandit, a religious scholar, and the Pandit into a fool. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naaree te jo purakh karaavai purakhan te jo naaree ||
english: The woman is transformed into a man, and the men into women.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer saadhoo ko preetam tis moorat balihaaree ||4||2||
english: Says Kabeer, God is the Beloved of the Holy Saints. I am a sacrifice to His image. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g baanee naamadeu jee kee ||
english: Saarang, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਏਂ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaae(n) re man bikhiaa ban jaai ||
english: O mortal, why are you going into the forest of corruption?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੌ ਰੇ ਠਗਮੂਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhoolau re thagamooree khaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have been misled into eating the toxic drug. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jaise meen paanee mahi rahai ||
english: You are like a fish living in the water;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: kaal jaal kee sudh nahee lahai ||
english: you do not see the net of death.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸੁਆਦੀ ਲੀਲਿਤ ਲੋਹ ॥
transliteration: jihabaa suaadee leelit loh ||
english: Trying to taste the flavor, you swallow the hook.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮੋਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aise kanik kaamanee baadhio moh ||1||
english: You are bound by attachment to wealth and woman. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਸੰਚੈ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jiu madh maakhee sa(n)chai apaar ||
english: The bee stores up loads of honey;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: madh leeno mukh deenee chhaar ||
english: then someone comes and takes the honey, and throws dust in its mouth.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਬਾਛ ਕਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਖੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gaoo baachh kau sa(n)chai kheer ||
english: The cow stores up loads of milk;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਲਾ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਦੁਹਿ ਲੇਇ ਅਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: galaa baa(n)dh duhi lei aheer ||2||
english: then the milkman comes and ties it by its neck and milks it. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran sram at karai ||
english: For the sake of Maya, the mortal works very hard.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਗਾਡੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so maaiaa lai gaadai dharai ||
english: He takes the wealth of Maya, and buries it in the ground.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੰਚੈ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਮੂੜੑ ॥
transliteration: at sa(n)chai samajhai nahee mooRh ||
english: He acquires so much, but the fool does not appreciate it.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਧੂੜਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhan dharatee tan hoi gaio dhooR ||3||
english: His wealth remains buried in the ground, while his body turns to dust. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਜਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa at jarai ||
english: He burns in tremendous sexual desire, unresolved anger and desire.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kabahoo nahee karai ||
english: He never joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਾ ਚੀ ਆਣਿ ॥
transliteration: kahat naamadeu taa chee aan ||
english: Says Naam Dayv, seek God's Shelter;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਜੀਐ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: nirabhai hoi bhajeeai bhagavaan ||4||1||
english: be fearless, and vibrate on the Lord God. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਦਹੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਹੋਡ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: badahu kee na hod maadhau mo siu ||
english: Why not make a bet with me, O Lord of Wealth?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਤੋ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: thaakur te jan jan te thaakur khel pario hai to siu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: From the master comes the servant, and from the servant, comes the master. This is the game I play with You. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਦੇਉ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: aapan deu dehuraa aapan aap lagaavai poojaa ||
english: You Yourself are the deity, and You are the temple of worship. You are the devoted worshipper.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੇ ਹੈ ਜਲੁ ਕਹਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jal te tara(n)g tara(n)g te hai jal kahan sunan kau doojaa ||1||
english: From the water, the waves rise up, and from the waves, the water. They are only different by figures of speech. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aapahi gaavai aapahi naachai aap bajaavai tooraa ||
english: You Yourself sing, and You Yourself dance. You Yourself blow the bugle.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਨੁ ਊਰਾ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: kahat naamadeu too(n) mero thaakur jan ooraa too pooraa ||2||2||
english: Says Naam Dayv, You are my Lord and Master. Your humble servant is imperfect; You are perfect. ||2||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਨਿੰਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: daas ani(n)n mero nij roop ||
english: Says God: my slave is devoted only to me; he is in my very image.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਤਾਪ ਤ੍ਰਈ ਮੋਚਨ ਪਰਸਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੂਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan nimakh taap traee mochan parasat mukat karat grih koop ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sight of him, even for an instant, cures the three fevers; his touch brings liberation from the deep dark pit of household affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਭਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਭਗਤੁ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: meree baa(n)dhee bhagat chhadaavai baa(n)dhai bhagat na chhootai mohi ||
english: The devotee can release anyone from my bondage, but I cannot release anyone from his.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗਹਿ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਤਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੋ ਪੈ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek samai mo kau gahi baa(n)dhai tau phun mo pai jabaab na hoi ||1||
english: If, at any time, he grabs and binds me, even then, I cannot protest. ||1||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: mai gun ba(n)dh sagal kee jeevan meree jeevan mere daas ||
english: I am bound by virtue; I am the Life of all. My slaves are my very life.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੀ ਤੈਸੋ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: naamadev jaa ke jee aisee taiso taa kai prem pragaas ||2||3||
english: Says Naam Dayv, as is the quality of his soul, so is my love which illuminates him. ||2||3||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g ||
english: Saarang:

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਨਰ ਕਿਆ ਪੁਰਾਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tai nar kiaa puraan sun keenaa ||
english: So what have you accomplished by listening to the Puraanas?

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਅਨਪਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਭੂਖੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anapaavanee bhagat nahee upajee bhookhai daan na deenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Faithful devotion has not welled up within you, and you have not been inspired to give to the hungry. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਲੋਭੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam na bisario krodh na bisario lobh na chhootio devaa ||
english: You have not forgotten sexual desire, and you have not forgotten anger; greed has not left you either.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਨਿਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa mukh te nahee chhootee niphal bhaee sabh sevaa ||1||
english: Your mouth has not stopped slandering and gossiping about others. Your service is useless and fruitless. ||1||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਬਾਟ ਪਾਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਿ ਬਿਰਾਨੋ ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰੈ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: baat paar ghar moos biraano pet bharai apraadhee ||
english: By breaking into the houses of others and robbing them, you fill your belly, you sinner.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਜਾਇ ਅਪਕੀਰਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਬਿਦਿਆ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jihi paralok jaai apakeerat soee abidiaa saadhee ||2||
english: But when you go to the world beyond, your guilt will be well known, by the acts of ignorance which you committed. ||2||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)saa tau man te nahee chhootee jee daiaa nahee paalee ||
english: Cruelty has not left your mind; you have not cherished kindness for other living beings.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: paramaana(n)d saadhasa(n)gat mil kathaa puneet na chaalee ||3||1||6||
english: Parmaanand has joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Why have you not followed the sacred teachings? ||3||1||6||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਮੁਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: chhaad man har bimukhan ko sa(n)g ||
english: O mind, do not even associate with those who have turned their backs on the Lord.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 5 sooradaas ||
english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Sur Daas:

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਬਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)g base har lok ||
english: The people of the Lord dwell with the Lord.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਝੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man arap sarabas sabh arapio anad sahaj dhun jhok ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They dedicate their minds and bodies to Him; they dedicate everything to Him. They are intoxicated with the celestial melody of intuitive ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਬਿਖਈ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੋਕ ॥
transliteration: darasan pekh bhae nirabikhaee paae hai sagale thok ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, they are cleansed of corruption. They obtain absolutely everything.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਦਨ ਅਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan basat siu kaaj na kachhooai su(n)dar badan alok ||1||
english: They have nothing to do with anything else; they gaze on the beauteous Face of God. ||1||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਜੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਤਨਿ ਜੋਕ ॥
transliteration: siaam su(n)dar taj aan j chaahat jiu kusatee tan jok ||
english: But one who forsakes the elegantly beautiful Lord, and harbors desire for anything else, is like a leech on the body of a leper.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਥਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਲੋਕ ॥੨॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: sooradaas man prabh hath leeno deeno ihu paralok ||2||1||8||
english: Says Sur Daas, God has taken my mind in His Hands. He has blessed me with the world beyond. ||2||1||8||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g kabeer jeeu ||
english: Saarang, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har bin kaun sahaaee man kaa ||
english: Other than the Lord, who is the Help and Support of the mind?

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਭ ਫਨ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa hit laago sabh phan kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Love and attachment to mother, father, sibling, child and spouse, is all just an illusion. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਆਗੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਧਨ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: aage kau kichh tulahaa baa(n)dhahu kiaa bharavaasaa dhan kaa ||
english: So build a raft to the world hereafter; what faith do you place in wealth?

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਇਸ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਕਾ ਇਤਨਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਠਨਕਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahaa bisaasaa is bhaa(n)de kaa itanak laagai thanakaa ||1||
english: What confidence do you place in this fragile vessel; it breaks with the slightest stroke. ||1||

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਹੁ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal dharam pu(n)n phal paavahu dhoor baa(n)chhahu sabh jan kaa ||
english: You shall obtain the rewards of all righteousness and goodness, if you desire to be the dust of all.

author: Bhagat Parmanand
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਉਡਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਬਨ ਕਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu ihu man udan pa(n)kheroo ban kaa ||2||1||9||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: this mind is like the bird, flying above the forest. ||2||1||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar chaupade mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Malaar, Chau-Padhay, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਹਸਣਾ ਸਉਣਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: khaanaa peenaa hasanaa saunaa visar gaiaa hai maranaa ||
english: Eating, drinking, laughing and sleeping, the mortal forgets about dying.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khasam visaar khuaaree keenee dhrig jeevan nahee rahanaa ||1||
english: Forgetting his Lord and Master, the mortal is ruined, and his life is cursed. He cannot remain forever. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: praanee eko naam dhiaavahu ||
english: O mortal, meditate on the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apanee pat setee ghar jaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall go to your true home with honor. ||1 Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਲੇਵਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tudhano sevahi tujh kiaa devahi maa(n)gahi levahi rahahi nahee ||
english: Those who serve You - what can they give You? They beg for and receive what cannot remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too daataa jeeaa sabhanaa kaa jeeaa a(n)dar jeeu tuhee ||2||
english: You are the Great Giver of all souls; You are the Life within all living beings. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਸੂਚੇ ਹੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh dhiaavahi s a(n)mrit paavahi seee sooche hohee ||
english: The Gurmukhs meditate, and receive the Ambrosial Nectar; thus they become pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੈਲੇ ਹਛੇ ਹੋਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ahinis naam japahu re praanee maile hachhe hohee ||3||
english: Day and night, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal. It makes the filthy immacuate. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਰੁਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
