transliteration: jehee rut kaaiaa sukh tehaa teho jehee dehee ||
english: As is the season, so is the comfort of the body, and so is the body itself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਕੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak rut suhaavee saaee bin naavai rut kehee ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, that season is beautiful; without the Name, what season is it? ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: karau binau gur apane preetam har var aan milaavai ||
english: I offer prayers to my Beloved Guru, that He may unite me with my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਘਨ ਘੋਰ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਲਾਲ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sun ghan ghor seetal man moraa laal ratee gun gaavai ||1||
english: I hear the thunder in the clouds, and my mind is cooled and soothed; imbued with the Love of my Dear Beloved, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: baras ghanaa meraa man bheenaa ||
english: The rain pours down, and my mind is drenched with His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਨੀ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit boo(n)d suhaanee heearai gur mohee man har ras leenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The drop of Ambrosial Nectar pleases my heart; the Guru has fascinated my mind, which is drenched in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sukhee var kaaman piaaree jis gur bachanee man maaniaa ||
english: With intuitive peace and poise, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband Lord; her mind is pleased and appeased by the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਭਈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਖਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har var naar bhaee sohaagan man tan prem sukhaaniaa ||2||
english: She is the happy soul-bride of her Husband Lord; her mind and body are filled with joy by His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: avagan tiaag bhaee bairaagan asathir var sohaag haree ||
english: Discarding her demerits, she becomes detached; with the Lord as her Husband, her marriage is eternal.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sog vijog tis kade na viaapai har prabh apanee kirapaa karee ||3||
english: She never suffers separation or sorrow; her Lord God showers her with His Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan nahee man nihachal poore gur kee ot gahee ||
english: Her mind is steady and stable; she does not come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam jap guramukh dhan sohaagan sach sahee ||4||2||
english: She takes the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam; you shall be accepted as the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saachee surat naam nahee tripate haumai karat gavaaiaa ||
english: They pretend to understand the Truth, but they are not satisfied by the Naam; they waste their lives in egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: par dhan par naaree rat ni(n)daa bikh khaaee dukh paaiaa ||
english: Caught in slander and attachment to the wealth and women of others, they eat poison and suffer in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭੈ ਕਪਟ ਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheen bhai kapat na chhoote man mukh maaiaa maaiaa ||
english: They think about the Shabad, but they are not released from their fear and fraud; the minds and mouths are filled with Maya, Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ajagar bhaar lade at bhaaree mar janame janam gavaaiaa ||1||
english: Loading the heavy and crushing load, they die, only to be reborn, and waste their lives again. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man bhaavai sabad suhaaiaa ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is so very beautiful; it is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhram jon bhekh bahu keenhe gur raakhe sach paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The mortal wanders lost in reincarnation, wearing various robes and clothes; when he is saved and protected by the Guru, then he finds the Truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਨੑਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: teerath tej nivaar na nhaate har kaa naam na bhaaiaa ||
english: He does not try to wash away his angry passions by bathing at sacred shrines. He does not love the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਜਤ ਕੋ ਤਤ ਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath parahar tiaagiaa jat ko tat hee aaiaa ||
english: He abandons and discards the priceless jewel, and he goes back from where he came.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੀਟ ਭਏ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bisataa keet bhae ut hee te ut hee maahi samaaiaa ||
english: And so he becomes a maggot in manure, and in that, he is absorbed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਸੁਆਦ ਰੋਗ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: adhik suaad rog adhikaaee bin gur sahaj na paaiaa ||2||
english: The more he tastes, the more he is diseased; without the Guru, there is no peace and poise. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sevaa surat rahas gun gaavaa guramukh giaan beechaaraa ||
english: Focusing my awareness on selfless service, I joyfully sing His Praises. As Gurmukh, I contemplate spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khojee upajai baadee binasai hau bal bal gur karataaraa ||
english: The seeker comes forth, and the debater dies down; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਹੋੁਤੇ ਹੀਣਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਤੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham neech houte heenamat jhoothe too sabad savaaranahaaraa ||
english: I am low and wretched, with shallow and false understanding; You embellish and exalt me through the Word of Your Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਣ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aatam cheen tahaa too taaran sach taare taaranahaaraa ||3||
english: And wherever there is self-realization, You are there; O True Lord Savior, You save us and carry us across. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਉ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bais suthaan kahaa(n) gun tere kiaa kiaa kathau apaaraa ||
english: Where should I sit to chant Your Praises; which of Your Infinite Praises should I chant?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: alakh na lakheeai agam ajonee too(n) naathaa(n) naathanahaaraa ||
english: The Unknown cannot be known; O Inaccessible, Unborn Lord God, You are the Lord and Master of masters.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਉ ਤੂ ਕੈਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਕ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kis pahi dekh kahau too kaisaa sabh jaachak too daataaraa ||
english: How can I compare You to anyone else I see? All are beggars - You are the Great Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagatiheen naanak dar dekhahu ik naam milai ur dhaaraa ||4||3||
english: Lacking devotion, Nanak looks to Your Door; please bless him with Your One Name, that he may enshrine it in his heart. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਾ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jin dhan pir kaa saad na jaaniaa saa bilakh badan kumalaanee ||
english: The soul-bride who has not known delight with her Husband Lord, shall weep and wail with a wretched face.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaee niraasee karam kee phaasee bin gur bharam bhulaanee ||1||
english: She becomes hopeless, caught in the noose of her own karma; without the Guru, she wanders deluded by doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baras ghanaa meraa pir ghar aaiaa ||
english: So rain down, O clouds. My Husband Lord has come home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਾਂ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bal jaavaa(n) gur apane preetam jin har prabh aan milaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has led me to meet my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉਤਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
transliteration: nautan preet sadaa thaakur siu anadin bhagat suhaavee ||
english: My love, my Lord and Master is forever fresh; I am embellished with devotional worship night and day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukat bhae gur daras dikhaaiaa jug jug bhagat subhaavee ||2||
english: I am liberated, gazing on the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Devotional worship has made me glorious and exalted throughout the ages. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਗੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham thaare tribhavan jag tumaraa too meraa hau teraa ||
english: I am Yours; the three worlds are Yours as well. You are mine, and I am Yours.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur miliai nira(n)jan paaiaa bahur na bhavajal pheraa ||3||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I shall not be consigned to this terrifying world-ocean ever again. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਿਰ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: apune pir har dekh vigaasee tau dhan saach seegaaro ||
english: If the soul-bride is filled with delight on seeing her Husband Lord, then her decorations are true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: akul nira(n)jan siu sach saachee guramat naam adhaaro ||4||
english: With the Immaculate Celestial Lord, she becomes the truest of the true. Following the Guru's Teachings, she leans on the Support of the Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੑੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mukat bhaee ba(n)dhan gur kholhe sabad surat pat paaee ||
english: She is liberated; the Guru has untied her bonds. Focusing her awareness on the Shabad, she attains honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam rid a(n)tar guramukh mel milaaee ||5||4||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is deep within her heart; as Gurmukh, she is united in His Union. ||5||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 malaar ||
english: First Mehl, Malaar:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਰ ਲੋਭਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: par daaraa par dhan par lobhaa haumai bikhai bikaar ||
english: Others' wives, others' wealth, greed, egotism, corruption and poison;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਭਾਉ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dusat bhaau taj ni(n)d paraaee kaam krodh cha(n)daar ||1||
english: evil passions, slander of others, sexual desire and anger - give up all these. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mahal mahi baithe agam apaar ||
english: The Inaccessible, Infinite Lord is sitting in His Mansion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bheetar a(n)mrit soee jan paavai jis gur kaa sabad ratan aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That humble being, whose conduct is in harmony with the jewel of the Guru's Shabad, obtains the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦੋਊ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh dooo sam kar jaanai buraa bhalaa sa(n)saar ||
english: He sees pleasure and pain as both the same, along with good and bad in the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sudh budh surat naam har paaeeai satasa(n)gat gur piaar ||2||
english: Wisdom, understanding and awareness are found in the Name of the Lord. In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, embrace love for the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ahinis laahaa har naam paraapat gur daataa devanahaar ||
english: Day and night, profit is obtained through the Lord's Name. The Guru, the Giver, has given this gift.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh sikh soee jan paae jis no nadar kare karataar ||3||
english: That Sikh who becomes Gurmukh obtains it. The Creator blesses him with His Glance of Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa mahal ma(n)dar ghar har kaa tis mahi raakhee jot apaar ||
english: The body is a mansion, a temple, the home of the Lord; He has infused His Infinite Light into it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh mahal bulaaeeai har mele melanahaar ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is invited to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; the Lord unites him in His Union. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: pavanai paanee jaanai jaat ||
english: Know that the creation was formed through air and water;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆਂ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa(n) agan kare nibharaa(n)t ||
english: have no doubt that the body was made through fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)mahi jee jaanai je thaau ||
english: And if you know where the soul comes from,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: surataa pa(n)dit taa kaa naau ||1||
english: you shall be known as a wise religious scholar. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d na jaaneeahi maai ||
english: Who can know the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਣਡੀਠਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadeethaa kichh kahan na jaai ||
english: Without seeing Him, we cannot say anything about Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kar aakh vakhaaneeai maai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How can anyone speak and describe Him, O mother? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
transliteration: oopar dar asamaan paiaal ||
english: He is high above the sky, and beneath the nether worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kiu kar kaheeai dehu veechaar ||
english: How can I speak of Him? Let me understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਹਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bin jihavaa jo japai hiaai ||
english: Who knows what sort of Name is chanted,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੈਸਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: koee jaanai kaisaa naau ||2||
english: In the heart, without the tongue? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee rahai nibharaa(n)t ||
english: Undoubtedly, words fail me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: so boojhai hovai jis daat ||
english: He alone understands, who is blessed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis a(n)tar rahai liv laai ||
english: Day and night, deep within, he remains lovingly attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: soee purakh j sach samaai ||3||
english: He is the true person, who is merged in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲੀਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaat kuleen sevak je hoi ||
english: If someone of high social standing becomes a selfless servant,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa kahanaa kahahu na koi ||
english: then his praises cannot even be expressed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਸਨਾਤਂੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vich sanaata(n)ee sevak hoi ||
english: And if someone from a low social class becomes a selfless servant,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਣ੍ਹੀਆ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak panheeaa pahirai soi ||4||1||6||
english: O Nanak, he shall wear shoes of honor. ||4||1||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: dukh vechhoRaa ik dukh bhookh ||
english: The pain of separation - this is the hungry pain I feel.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਕਤਵਾਰ ਜਮਦੂਤ ॥
transliteration: ik dukh sakatavaar jamadoot ||
english: Another pain is the attack of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik dukh rog lagai tan dhaai ||
english: Another pain is the disease consuming my body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੈਦ ਨ ਭੋਲੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vaid na bhole daaroo laai ||1||
english: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੈਦ ਨ ਭੋਲੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaid na bhole daaroo laai ||
english: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: darad hovai dukh rahai sareer ||
english: The pain persists, and the body continues to suffer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aisaa daaroo lagai na beer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your medicine has no effect on me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: khasam visaar keee ras bhog ||
english: Forgetting his Lord and Master, the mortal enjoys sensual pleasures;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਤਨਿ ਉਠਿ ਖਲੋਏ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: taa(n) tan uth khaloe rog ||
english: then, disease rises up in his body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)dhe kau milai sajaai ||
english: The blind mortal receives his punishment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੈਦ ਨ ਭੋਲੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vaid na bhole daaroo laai ||2||
english: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan kaa phal cha(n)dan vaas ||
english: The value of sandalwood lies in its fragrance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: maanas kaa phal ghat mahi saas ||
english: The value of the human lasts only as long as the breath in the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਇਐ ਕਾਇਆ ਢਲਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saas gaiai kaaiaa dhal paai ||
english: When the breath is taken away, the body crumbles into dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kai paachhai koi na khaai ||3||
english: After that, no one takes any food. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa niramal ha(n)s ||
english: The mortal's body is golden, and the soul-swan is immaculate and pure,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅੰਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jis mahi naam nira(n)jan a(n)s ||
english: if even a tiny particle of the Immaculate Naam is within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog sabh gaiaa gavaai ||
english: All pain and disease are eradicated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak chhootas saachai naai ||4||2||7||
english: O Nanak, the mortal is saved through the True Name. ||4||2||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਮਹੁਰਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dukh mahuraa maaran har naam ||
english: Pain is the poison. The Lord's Name is the antidote.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਲਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਪੀਸਣੁ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: silaa sa(n)tokh peesan hath daan ||
english: Grind it up in the mortar of contentment, with the pestle of charitable giving.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: nit nit lehu na chheejai deh ||
english: Take it each and every day, and your body shall not waste away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਠੇਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal jam maarai theh ||1||
english: At the very last instant, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਖਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aisaa daaroo khaahi gavaar ||
english: So take such medicine, O fool,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit khaadhai tere jaahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: by which your corruption shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਂਵ ॥
transliteration: raaj maal joban sabh chhaa(n)v ||
english: Power, wealth and youth are all just shadows,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਥਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੈ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਥਾਵ ॥
transliteration: rath phira(n)dai deesahi thaav ||
english: as are the vehicles you see moving around.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: deh na naau na hovai jaat ||
english: Neither your body, nor your fame, nor your social status shall go along with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਦਿਹੁ ਐਥੈ ਸਭ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: othai dihu aithai sabh raat ||2||
english: In the next world it is day, while here, it is all night. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਧਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਘਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: saad kar samadhaa(n) trisanaa ghiu tel ||
english: Let your taste for pleasures be the firewood, let your greed be the ghee,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aganee siu mel ||
english: and your sexual desire and anger the cooking oil; burn them in the fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: hom jag ar paath puraan ||
english: Some make burnt offerings, hold sacred feasts, and read the Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan ||3||
english: Whatever pleases God is acceptable. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਪੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tap kaagad teraa naam neesaan ||
english: Intense meditation is the paper, and Your Name is the insignia.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kau likhiaa ehu nidhaan ||
english: Those for whom this treasure is ordered,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se dhanava(n)t disahi ghar jaai ||
english: look wealthy when they reach their true home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਨੀ ਧੰਨੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak jananee dha(n)nee maai ||4||3||8||
english: O Nanak, blessed is that mother who gave birth to them. ||4||3||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਗੇ ਕਾਪੜ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੈਣ ॥
transliteration: baage kaapaR bolai bain ||
english: You wear white clothes, and speak sweet words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੰਮਾ ਨਕੁ ਕਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨੈਣ ॥
transliteration: la(n)maa nak kaale tere nain ||
english: Your nose is sharp, and your eyes are black.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭੈਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kabahoo(n) saahib dekhiaa bhain ||1||
english: Have you ever seen your Lord and Master, O sister? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਡਾਂ ਊਡਿ ਚੜਾਂ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: oodaa(n) ood chaRaa(n) asamaan ||
english: O my All-powerful Lord and Master,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: saahib sa(n)mrith terai taan ||
english: By Your power, I fly and soar, and ascend to the heavens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jal thal doo(n)gar dekhaa(n) teer ||
english: I see Him in the water, on the land, in the mountains, on the river-banks,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar saahib beer ||2||
english: in all places and interspaces, O brother. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਦੀਏ ਨਾਲਿ ਖੰਭ ॥
transliteration: jin tan saaj deee naal kha(n)bh ||
english: He fashioned the body, and gave it wings;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਡਣੈ ਕੀ ਡੰਝ ॥
transliteration: at trisanaa udanai kee da(n)jh ||
english: He gave it great thirst and desire to fly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਬੰਧਾਂ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa(n) ba(n)dhaa(n) dheer ||
english: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, I am comforted and consoled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਤਿਉ ਵੇਖਾਂ ਬੀਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu vekhaale tiu vekhaa(n) beer ||3||
english: As He makes me see, so do I see, O brother. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਨ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਖੰਭ ॥
transliteration: na ihu tan jaaigaa na jaahige kha(n)bh ||
english: Neither this body, nor its wings, shall go to the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥
transliteration: paunai paanee aganee kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
english: It is a fusion of air, water and fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak karam hovai japeeai kar gur peer ||
english: O Nanak, if it is in the mortal's karma, then he meditates on the Lord, with the Guru as his Spiritual Teacher.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: sach samaavai ehu sareer ||4||4||9||
english: This body is absorbed in the Truth. ||4||4||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar aakaar hai aape aape bharam bhulaae ||
english: The Formless Lord is formed by Himself. He Himself deludes in doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kar karataa aape vekhai jit bhaavai tit laae ||
english: Creating the Creation, the Creator Himself beholds it; He enjoins us as He pleases.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sevak kau ehaa vadiaaee jaa kau hukam manaae ||1||
english: This is the true greatness of His servant, that he obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa bhaanaa aape jaanai gur kirapaa te laheeai ||
english: Only He Himself knows His Will. By Guru's Grace, it is grasped.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ehaa sakat sivai ghar aavai jeevadiaa mar raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When this play of Shiva and Shakti comes to his home, he remains dead while yet alive. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ved paRai paR vaad vakhaanai brahamaa bisan mahesaa ||
english: They read the Vedas, and read them again, and engage in arguments about Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ ॥
transliteration: eh trigun maaiaa jin jagat bhulaaiaa janam maran kaa sahasaa ||
english: This three-phased Maya has deluded the whole world into cynicism about death and birth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanai chookai manahu a(n)desaa ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, know the One Lord, and the anxiety of your mind will be allayed. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ham deen moorakh aveechaaree tum chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
english: I am meek, foolish and thoughtless, but still, You take care of me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal kar daas daasaa kaa sevaa karee tumaaree ||
english: Please be kind to me, and make me the slave of Your slaves, so that I may serve You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek nidhaan dehi too apanaa ahinis naam vakhaanee ||3||
english: Please bless me with the treasure of the One Name, that I may chant it, day and night. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak gur parasaadee boojhahu koee aisaa kare veechaaraa ||
english: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, understand. Hardly anyone considers this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਊਪਰਿ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu jal oopar phen budabudaa taisaa ihu sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Like foam bubbling up on the surface of the water, so is this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਚੂਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jis te hoaa tisahi samaanaa chook gaiaa paasaaraa ||4||1||
english: It shall eventually merge back into that from which it came, and all its expanse shall be gone. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee hukam pachhaaniaa se mele haumai sabad jalaai ||
english: Those who realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command are united with Him; through the Word of His Shabad, their egotism is burnt away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagat karahi din raatee sach rahe liv laai ||
english: They perform true devotional worship day and night; they remain lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sach har vekhade gur kai sabad subhaai ||1||
english: They gaze on their True Lord forever, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with loving ease. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man re hukam ma(n)n sukh hoi ||
english: O mortal, accept His Will and find peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhaanaa apanaa bhaavadaa jis bakhase tis bighan na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God is pleased by the Pleasure of His Own Will. Whomever He forgives, meets no obstacles on the way. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai naa har bhagat na bhaai ||
english: Under the influence of the three gunas, the three dispositions, the mind wanders everywhere, without love or devotion to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gat mukat kade na hovaee haumai karam kamaahi ||
english: No one is ever saved or liberated, by doing deeds in ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saahib bhaavai so theeai paiai kirat phiraahi ||2||
english: Whatever our Lord and Master wills, comes to pass. People wander according to their past actions. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetiai man mar rahai har naam vasai man aai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, the mind is overpowered; the Lord's Name comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee keemat naa pavai kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
english: The value of such a person cannot be estimated; nothing at all can be said about him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chauthai pad vaasaa hoiaa sachai rahai samaai ||3||
english: He comes to dwell in the fourth state; he remains merged in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa har prabh agam agochar hai keemat kahan na jaai ||
english: My Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. His value cannot be expressed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bujheeai sabade kaar kamaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he comes to understand, and live the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too har har dar sobhaa paai ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh koee viralaa boojhai jis no nadar karei ||
english: Rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, understands; the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਖਸੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin daataa koee naahee bakhase nadar karei ||
english: There is no Giver except the Guru. He grants His Grace and forgives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur miliai saa(n)t oopajai anadin naam laei ||1||
english: Meeting the Guru, peace and tranquility well up; chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man har a(n)mrit naam dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh milai naau paaeeai har naame sadaa samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru and the Primal Being, the Name is obtained, and one remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sadaa vichhuRe phirahi koi na kis hee naal ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are forever separated from the Lord; no one is with them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai vadaa rog hai sir maare jamakaal ||
english: They are stricken with the great disease of egotism; they are hit on the head by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramat satasa(n)gat na vichhuRahi anadin naam samhaal ||2||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are never separated from the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. They dwell on the Naam, night and day. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa karataa ek too nit kar dekhahi veechaar ||
english: You are the One and Only Creator of all. You continually create, watch over and contemplate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik guramukh aap milaaiaa bakhase bhagat bha(n)daar ||
english: Some are Gurmukh - You unite them with Yourself. You bless then with the treasure of devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too aape sabh kichh jaanadaa kis aagai karee pookaar ||3||
english: You Yourself know everything. Unto whom should I complain? ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam a(n)mrit hai nadaree paaiaa jaai ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. By the Lord's Grace, it is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin har har ucharai gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, night and day, the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan hai naame hee chit laai ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. Focus your consciousness on the Naam. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur saalaahee sadaa sukhadaataa prabh naaraain soee ||
english: I praise the Guru, the Giver of peace, forever. He truly is the Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa vadee vadiaaee hoee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. His glorious greatness is glorious!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavai nit saache sach samaavai soee ||1||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, merges in the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man re guramukh ridai veechaar ||
english: O mortal, contemplate the Guru's Word in your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚਲਣੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taj kooR kuta(n)b haumai bikh trisanaa chalan ridai samhaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Abandon your false family, poisonous egotism and desire; remember in your heart, that you will have to leave. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa raam naam kaa hor daataa koee naahee ||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of the Lord's Name. There is no other giver at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jee daan dei tripataase sachai naam samaahee ||
english: Bestowing the gift of the soul, He satisfies the mortal beings, and merges them in the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin har raviaa rid a(n)tar sahaj samaadh lagaahee ||2||
english: Night and day, they ravish and enjoy the Lord within the heart; they are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigurasabadee ihu man bhediaa hiradai saachee baanee ||
english: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, has pierced my mind. The True Word of His Bani permeates my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh alakh na jaaee lakhiaa guramukh akath kahaanee ||
english: My God is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Gurmukh speaks the Unspoken.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape daiaa kare sukhadaataa japeeai saari(n)gapaanee ||3||
english: When the Giver of peace grants His Grace, the mortal being meditates on the Lord, the Life of the Universe. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa bahuR na hovai guramukh sahaj dhiaaiaa ||
english: He does not come and go in renicarnation any longer; the Gurmukh meditates intuitively.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man hee te man miliaa suaamee man hee ma(n)n samaaiaa ||
english: From the mind, the mind merges into our Lord and Master; the mind is absorbed into the Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saache hee sach saach pateejai vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||4||
english: In truth, the True Lord is pleased with truth; eradicate egotism from within yourself. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: eko ek vasai man suaamee doojaa avar na koee ||
english: Our One and Only Lord and Master dwells within the mind; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਜਗਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ekou naam a(n)mrit hai meethaa jag niramal sach soee ||
english: The One Name is Sweet Ambrosial Nectar; it is Immaculate Truth in the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam prabhoo te paaeeai jin kau dhur likhiaa hoee ||5||4||
english: O Nanak, the Name of God is obtained, by those who are so predestined. ||5||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gan ga(n)dharab naame sabh udhare gur kaa sabad veechaar ||
english: All the heavenly heralds and celestial singers are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar sad ma(n)n vasaaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: They contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Subduing their ego, the Name abides in their minds; they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jisahi bujhaae soee boojhai jis no aape lae milaai ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; the Lord unites him with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਗਾਂਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin baanee sabade gaa(n)vai saach rahai liv laai ||1||
english: Night and day, he sings the Word of the Shabad and the Guru's Bani; he remains lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere khin khin naam samhaal ||
english: O my mind, each and every moment, dwell on the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kee daat sabad sukh a(n)tar sadaa nibahai terai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Shabad is the Guru's Gift. It shall bring you lasting peace deep within; it shall always stand by you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh paakha(n)d kade na chookai doojai bhaai dukh paae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs never give up their hypocrisy; in the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar bikhiaa man raate birathaa janam gavaae ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, their minds are imbued with corruption. They waste away their lives uselessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ih velaa phir hath na aavai anadin sadaa pachhutaae ||
english: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; night and day, they shall always regret and repent.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mar mar janamai kade na boojhai visataa maahi samaae ||2||
english: They die and die again and again, only to be reborn, but they never understand. They rot away in manure. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam rate se udhare gur kaa sabad veechaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Naam, and are saved; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat har naam dhiaaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, they are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive. They enshrine the Lord within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal niramal mat ootam ootam baanee hoee ||
english: Their minds and bodies are immaculate, their intellect is immaculate and sublime. Their speech is sublime as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: eko purakh ek prabh jaataa doojaa avar na koee ||3||
english: They realize the One Primal Being, the One Lord God. There is no other at all. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae prabh aape aape nadar karei ||
english: God Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause of causes. He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੇਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan raataa gur kee baanee sevaa surat samei ||
english: My mind and body are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani. My consciousness is immersed in His service.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasiaa alakh abhevaa guramukh hoi lakhaai ||
english: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord dwells deep within. He is seen only by the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jis bhaavai tis aape devai bhaavai tivai chalaai ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, He gives to whomever He pleases. According to the Pleasure of His Will, He leads the mortals on. ||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 dutuke ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur te paavai ghar dar mahal s thaan ||
english: Through the True Guru, the mortal obtains the special place, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence in his own home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurasabadee chookai abhimaan ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his egotistical pride is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kau lilaat likhiaa dhur naam ||
english: Those who have the Naam inscribed on their foreheads,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam sadaa sadaa dhiaavahi saachee daragah paavahi maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: meditate on the Naam night and day, forever and ever. They are honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man kee bidh satigur te jaanai anadin laagai sad har siu dhiaan ||
english: From the True Guru, they learn the ways and means of the mind. Night and day, they focus their meditation on the Lord forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur sabad rate sadaa bairaagee har daragah saachee paavahi maan ||2||
english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they remain forever detached. They are honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਹੁਕਮ ਕਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man khelai hukam kaa baadhaa ik khin mahi dah dis phir aavai ||
english: This mind plays, subject to the Lord's Will; in an instant, it wanders out in the ten directions and returns home again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa(n) aape nadar kare har prabh saachaa taa(n) ihu man guramukh tatakaal vas aavai ||3||
english: When the True Lord God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then this mind is instantly brought under control by the Gurmukh. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: is man kee bidh man hoo jaanai boojhai sabad veechaar ||
english: The mortal comes to know the ways and means of the mind, realizing and contemplating the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sadaa too bhav saagar jit paavahi paar ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d praan sabh tis ke ghat ghat rahiaa samaaee ||
english: Soul, body and breath of life are all His; He is permeating and pervading each and every heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ekas bin mai avar na jaanaa satigur deeaa bujhaaee ||1||
english: Except the One Lord, I do not know any other at all. The True Guru has revealed this to me. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man mere naam rahau liv laaee ||
english: O my mind, remain lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: adisat agochar apara(n)par karataa gur kai sabad har dhiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I meditate on the Lord, the Unseen, Unfathomable and Infinite Creator. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man tan bheejai ek liv laagai sahaje rahe samaaee ||
english: Mind and body are pleased, lovingly attuned to the One Lord, intuitively absorbed in peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bhram bhau bhaagai ek naam liv laaee ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, doubt and fear are dispelled, being lovingly attuned to the One Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee sach kaar kamaavai gat mat tab hee paaee ||
english: When the mortal follows the Guru's Teachings, and lives the Truth, then he attains the state of emancipation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot madhe kisahi bujhaae tin raam naam liv laaee ||3||
english: Among millions, how rare is that one who understands, and is lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਇਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah eko soee ih guramat budh paaee ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see the One. This understanding has come through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਰਂੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: man tan praan dhara(n)ee tis aagai naanak aap gavaaee ||4||7||
english: I place my mind, body and breath of life in offering before Him; O Nanak, self-conceit is gone. ||4||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa dookh nivaaran sabade paaiaa jaaee ||
english: My True Lord God, the Eradicator of suffering, is found through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagatee raate sad bairaagee dar saachai pat paaee ||1||
english: Imbued with devotional worship, the mortal remains forever detached. He is honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਉ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man re man siu rahau samaaee ||
english: O mind, remain absorbed in the Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam man bheejai har setee liv laaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the Lord's Name, lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh at agam agochar guramat dei bujhaaee ||
english: My God is totally Inaccessible and Unfathomable; through the Guru's Teachings, He is understood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee har keerat har setee liv laaee ||2||
english: True self-discipline rests in singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape sabad sach saakhee aape jinh jotee jot milaaee ||
english: He Himself is the Shabad, and He Himself is the True Teachings; He merges our light into the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dehee kaachee paun vajaae guramukh a(n)mrit paaee ||3||
english: The breath vibrates through this frail body; the Gurmukh obtains the ambrosial nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape saaje sabh kaarai laae so sach rahiaa samaaee ||
english: He Himself fashions, and He Himself links us to our tasks; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam binaa koee kichh naahee naame dei vadaaee ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is anything. Through the Naam,we are blessed with glory. ||4||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਲਦਿਆ ਅਜਗਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: haumai bikh man mohiaa ladiaa ajagar bhaaree ||
english: The mortal is enticed by the poison of corruption, burdened with such a heavy load.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garuR sabad mukh paaiaa haumai bikh har maaree ||1||
english: The Lord has placed the magic spell of the Shabad into his mouth, and destroyed the poison of ego. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man re haumai mohu dukh bhaaree ||
english: O mortal, egotism and attachment are such heavy loads of pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਰਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu bhavajal jagat na jaaee taranaa guramukh tar har taaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed; through the Lord's Name, the Gurmukh crosses over to the other side. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa mohu pasaaraa sabh varatai aakaaree ||
english: Attachment to the three-phased show of Maya pervades all the created forms.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tureeaa gun satasa(n)gat paaeeai nadaree paar utaaree ||2||
english: In the Sat Sangat, the Society of the Saints, the state of supreme awareness is attained. The Merciful Lord carries us across. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਹਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan ga(n)dh suga(n)dh hai bahu baasanaa bahakaar ||
english: The smell of sandalwood is so sublime; its fragrance spreads out far and wide.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har jan karanee ootam hai har keerat jag bisathaar ||3||
english: The lifestyle of the Lord's humble servant is exalted and sublime. He spreads the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises throughout the world. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar thaakur mere har har har ur dhaar ||
english: O my Lord and Master, please be merciful, merciful to me, that I may enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, Har, within my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak satigur pooraa paaiaa man japiaa naam muraar ||4||9||
english: Nanak has found the Perfect True Guru; in his mind, he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ghar 2 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu man girahee k ihu man udaasee ||
english: Is this mind a householder, or is this mind a detached renunciate?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਰਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: k ihu man avaran sadaa avinaasee ||
english: Is this mind beyond social class, eternal and unchanging?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: k ihu man cha(n)chal k ihu man bairaagee ||
english: Is this mind fickle, or is this mind detached?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: is man kau mamataa kithahu laagee ||1||
english: How has this mind been gripped by possessiveness? ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit is man kaa karahu beechaar ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, reflect on this in your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar k bahutaa paRahi uthaavahi bhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why do you read so many other things, and carry such a heavy load? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mamataa karatai laaee ||
english: The Creator has attached it to Maya and possessiveness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ehu hukam kar srisat upaaee ||
english: Enforcing His Order, He created the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee boojhahu bhaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, understand this, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa rahahu har kee saranaaee ||2||
english: Remain forever in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਹਾਂ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਪੰਡ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so pa(n)dit jo tihaa(n) gunaa kee pa(n)d utaarai ||
english: He alone is a Pandit, who sheds the load of the three qualities.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: anadin eko naam vakhaanai ||
english: Night and day, he chants the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee ohu deekhiaa lei ||
english: He accepts the Teachings of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur aagai sees dharei ||
english: He offers his head to the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਗੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa alag rahai nirabaan ||
english: He remains forever unattached in the state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so pa(n)dit daragah paravaan ||3||
english: Such a Pandit is accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾਂ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa(n) mahi eko ek vakhaanai ||
english: He preaches that the One Lord is within all beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) eko vekhai taa(n) eko jaanai ||
english: As he sees the One Lord, he knows the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bakhase mele soi ||
english: That person, whom the Lord forgives, is united with Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aithai othai sadaa sukh hoi ||4||
english: He finds eternal peace, here and hereafter. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak kavan bidh kare kiaa koi ||
english: Says Nanak, what can anyone do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: soee mukat jaa kau kirapaa hoi ||
english: He alone is liberated, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin har gun gaavai soi ||
english: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: saasatr bed kee phir kook na hoi ||5||1||10||
english: Then, he no longer bothers with the proclamations of the Shaastras or the Vedas. ||5||1||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhram jon manamukh bharamaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in reincarnation, confused and deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal maare nit pat gavaaee ||
english: The Messenger of Death constantly beats them and disgraces them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevaa jam kee kaan chukaaee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the mortal's subservience to Death is ended.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har prabh miliaa mahal ghar paaee ||1||
english: He meets the Lord God, and enters the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: praanee guramukh naam dhiaai ||
english: O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath dubidhaa khoiaa kaudee badalai jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In duality, you are ruining and wasting this priceless human life. You trade it away in exchange for a shell. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa guramukh lagai piaar ||
english: The Gurmukh falls in love with the Lord, by His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bhagat har har ur dhaar ||
english: He enshrines loving devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, deep within his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal sabad la(n)ghaavanahaar ||
english: The Word of the Shabad carries him across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dar saachai disai sachiaar ||2||
english: He appears true in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bahu karam kare satigur nahee paaiaa ||
english: Performing all sorts of rituals, they do not find the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin gur bharam bhoole bahu maaiaa ||
english: Without the Guru, so many wander lost and confused in Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਬਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa bahu mohu vadhaaiaa ||
english: Egotism, possessiveness and attachment rise up and increase within them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai manamukh dukh paaiaa ||3||
english: In the love of dualty, the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa agam athaahaa ||
english: The Creator Himself is Inaccessible and Infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee japeeai sach laahaa ||
english: Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and earn the true profit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਾਜਰੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: haajar hajoor har veparavaahaa ||
english: The Lord is Independent, Ever-present, here and now.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam samaahaa ||4||2||11||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in the Naam. ||4||2||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jeevat mukat guramatee laage ||
english: Those who are attached to the Guru's Teachings, are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat anadin sad jaage ||
english: They remain forever awake and aware night and day, in devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi aap gavaai ||
english: They serve the True Guru, and eradicate their self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau tin jan ke sad laagau paai ||1||
english: I fall at the feet of such humble beings. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hau jeevaa(n) sadaa har ke gun gaaee ||
english: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meethaa har kai naam mukat gat paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is such totally sweet elixir. Through the Name of the Lord, I have attained the state of liberation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu agiaan gubaar ||
english: Attachment to Maya leads to the darkness of ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mohe mugadh gavaar ||
english: The self-willed manukhs are attached, foolish and ignorant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin dha(n)dhaa karat vihaai ||
english: Night and day, their lives pass away in worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi milai sajaai ||2||
english: They die and die again and again, only to be reborn and receive their punishment. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam liv laaee ||
english: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਨਾ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kooRai laalach naa lapataaee ||
english: He does not cling to false greed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh hovai sahaj subhaai ||
english: Whatever he does, he does with intuitive poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ras peevai rasan rasaai ||3||
english: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; his tongue delights in its flavor. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe kisahi bujhaaee ||
english: Among millions, hardly any understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase de vadiaaee ||
english: The Lord Himself forgives, and bestows His glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur miliaa s vichhuR na jaaee ||
english: Whoever meets with the Primal Lord God, shall never be separated again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak har har naam samaaee ||4||3||12||
english: Nanak is absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa naam sabh koee kahai ||
english: Everyone speaks the Name of the Lord with the tongue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa naam lahai ||
english: But only by serving the True Guru does the mortal receive the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRe mukat ghar rahai ||
english: His bonds are shattered, and he stays in the house of liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurasabadee asathir ghar bahai ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sits in the eternal, unchanging house. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: mere man kaahe ros kareejai ||
english: O my mind, why are you angry?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laahaa kalajug raam naam hai guramat anadin hiradai raveejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the source of profit. Contemplate and appreciate the Guru's Teachings within your heart, night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa khin khin bilalaai ||
english: Each and every instant, the rainbird cries and calls.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin pir dekhe na(n)eed na paai ||
english: Without seeing her Beloved, she does not sleep at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਸਹਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu vechhoRaa sahiaa na jaai ||
english: She cannot endure this separation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur milai taa(n) milai subhaai ||2||
english: When she meets the True Guru, then she intuitively meets her Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਣੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naamaheen binasai dukh paai ||
english: Lacking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal suffers and dies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਿਆ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa jaliaa bhookh na jaai ||
english: He is burnt in the fire of desire, and his hunger does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin bhaagaa naam na paaiaa jaai ||
english: Without good destiny, he cannot find the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bahu bidh thaakaa karam kamaai ||3||
english: He performs all sorts of rituals until he is exhausted. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: trai gun baanee bed beechaar ||
english: The mortal thinks about the Vedic teachings of the three gunas, the three dispositions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa mail bikhiaa vaapaar ||
english: He deals in corruption, filth and vice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mar janamahi phir hohi khuaar ||
english: He dies, only to be reborn; he is ruined over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh tureeaa gun ur dhaar ||4||
english: The Gurmukh enshrines the glory of the supreme state of celestial peace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur maanai maanai sabh koi ||
english: One who has faith in the Guru - everyone has faith in him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee man seetal hoi ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, the mind is cooled and soothed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chahu jug sobhaa niramal jan soi ||
english: Throughout the four ages, that humble being is known to be pure.

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: naanak guramukh viralaa koi ||5||4||13||9||13||22||
english: O Nanak, that Gurmukh is so rare. ||5||4||13||9||13||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar mahalaa 4 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Raag Malaar, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin har har dhiaaio hiradai mat guramat dookh visaaree ||
english: Night and day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; through the Guru's Teachings, my pain is forgotten.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh aasaa manasaa ba(n)dhan toote har har prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||1||
english: The chains of all my hopes and desires have been snapped; my Lord God has showered me with His Mercy. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nainee har har laagee taaree ||
english: My eyes gaze eternally on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur dekh meraa man bigasio jan har bhetio banavaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing on the True Guru, my mind blossoms forth. I have met with the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jin aisaa naam visaariaa meraa har har tis kai kul laagee gaaree ||
english: One who forgets such a Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his family is dishonored.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਿ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har tis kai kul parasoot na kareeahu tis bidhavaa kar mahataaree ||2||
english: His family is sterile and barren, and his mother is made a widow. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har har aan milaavahu gur saadhoo jis ahinis har ur dhaaree ||
english: O Lord, let me meet the Holy Guru, who night and day keep the Lord enshrined in his heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਡੀਠੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur deethai gur kaa sikh bigasai jiu baarik dekh mahataaree ||3||
english: Seeing the Guru, the GurSikh blossoms forth, like the child seeing his mother. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਇਕ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan pir kaa ik hee sa(n)g vaasaa vich haumai bheet karaaree ||
english: The soul-bride and the Husband Lord live together as one, but the hard wall of egotism has come between them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਤੋਰੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai haumai bheet toree jan naanak mile banavaaree ||4||1||
english: The Perfect Guru demolishes the wall of egotism; servant Nanak has met the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਸਰਸੁਤੀ ਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa jamunaa godaavaree sarasutee te karahi udam dhoor saadhoo kee taaee ||
english: The Ganges, the Jamunaa, the Godaavari and the Saraswati - these rivers strive for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਪਰੇ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kilavikh mail bhare pare hamarai vich hamaree mail saadhoo kee dhoor gavaaee ||1||
english: Overflowing with their filthy sins, the mortals take cleansing baths in them; the rivers' pollution is washed away by the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: teerath athasath majan naaee ||
english: Instead of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, take your cleansing bath in the Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਉਡਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat kee dhoor paree ud netree sabh duramat mail gavaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the dust of the feet of the Sat Sangat rises up into the eyes, all filthy evil-mindedness is removed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਹਰਨਵੀ ਤਪੈ ਭਾਗੀਰਥਿ ਆਣੀ ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਮਹਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaaharanavee tapai bhaageerath aanee kedaar thaapio mahasaaee ||
english: Bhaageerat'h the penitent brought the Ganges down, and Shiva established Kaydaar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਸੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaa(n)see krisan charaavat gaaoo mil har jan sobhaa paaee ||2||
english: Krishna grazed cows in Kaashi; through the humble servant of the Lord, these places became famous. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jitane teerath devee thaape sabh titane lochahi dhoor saadhoo kee taaee ||
english: And all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage established by the gods, long for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa sa(n)t milai gur saadhoo lai tis kee dhoor mukh laaee ||3||
english: Meeting with the Lord's Saint, the Holy Guru, I apply the dust of His feet to my face. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਤਨੀ ਲੋਚੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jitanee srisat tumaree mere suaamee sabh titanee lochai dhoor saadhoo kee taaee ||
english: And all the creatures of Your Universe, O my Lord and Master, long for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak lilaat hovai jis likhiaa tis saadhoo dhoor de har paar la(n)ghaaee ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Holy; the Lord carries him across. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 ||
