english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tis jan kau har meeth lagaanaa jis har har kripaa karai ||
english: The Lord seems sweet to that humble being who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis kee bhookh dookh sabh utarai jo har gun har ucharai ||1||
english: His hunger and pain are totally taken away; he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jap man har har har nisatarai ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, the mortal is emancipated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur ke bachan karan sun dhiaavai bhav saagar paar parai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who listens to the Guru's Teachings and meditates on them, is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਹਾਝੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tis jan ke ham haat bihaajhe jis har har kripaa karai ||
english: I am the slave of that humble being, who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har jan kau miliaa(n) sukh paaeeai sabh duramat mail harai ||2||
english: Meeting with the Lord's humble servant, peace is obtained; all the pollution and filth of evil-mindedness is washed away. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har jan kau har bhookh lagaanee jan tripatai jaa har gun bicharai ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord feels hunger only for the Lord. He is satisfied only when he chants the Lord's Glories.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa jan har jal kaa meenaa har bisarat phoot marai ||3||
english: The humble servant of the Lord is a fish in the Water of the Lord. Forgetting the Lord, he would dry up and die. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jin eh preet laaee so jaanai kai jaanai jis man dharai ||
english: He alone knows this love, who enshrines it within his mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਟਰੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak har dekh sukh paavai sabh tan kee bhookh tarai ||4||3||
english: Servant Nanak gazes upon the Lord and is at peace; The hunger of his body is totally satisfied. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਲਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jitane jee ja(n)t prabh keene titane sir kaar likhaavai ||
english: All the beings and creatures which God has created - on their foreheds, He has written their destiny.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੑ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jan kau har deenh vadaaee har jan har kaarai laavai ||1||
english: The Lord blesses His humble servant with glorious greatness. The Lord enjoins him to his tasks. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur har har naam driRaavai ||
english: The True Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bolahu gur ke sikh mere bhaaee har bhaujal jagat taraavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O Sikhs of the Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny. Only the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo gur kau jan pooje seve so jan mere har prabh bhaavai ||
english: That humble being who worships, adores and serves the Guru is pleasing to my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kee sevaa satigur poojahu kar kirapaa aap taraavai ||2||
english: To worship and adore the True Guru is to serve the Lord. In His Mercy, He saves us and carries us across. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਫੂਲ ਤੋਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhoole agiaanee a(n)dhule bhram bhram phool toraavai ||
english: The ignorant and the blind wander deluded by doubt; deluded and confused, they pick flowers to offer to their idols.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੇਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nirajeeu poojahi maRaa sarevahi sabh birathee ghaal gavaavai ||3||
english: They worship lifeless stones and serve the tombs of the dead; all their efforts are useless. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: braham bi(n)de so satigur kaheeai har har kathaa sunaavai ||
english: He alone is said to be the True Guru, who realizes God, and proclaims the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tis gur kau chhaadan bhojan paat pata(n)bar bahu bidh sat kar mukh sa(n)chahu tis pu(n)n kee phir tot na aavai ||4||
english: Offer the Guru sacred foods, clothes, silk and satin robes of all sorts; know that He is True. The merits of this shall never leave you lacking. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਉ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur deu paratakh har moorat jo a(n)mrit bachan sunaavai ||
english: The Divine True Guru is the Embodiment, the Image of the Lord; He utters the Ambrosial Word.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak bhaag bhale tis jan ke jo har charanee chit laavai ||5||4||
english: O Nanak, blessed and good is the destiny of that humble being, who focuses his consciousness on the Feet of the Lord. ||5||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਭਲ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jinh kai heearai basio meraa satigur te sa(n)t bhale bhal bhaa(n)t ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with my True Guru - those Saints are good and noble in every way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tinh dekhe meraa man bigasai hau tin kai sad bal jaa(n)t ||1||
english: Seeing them, my mind blossoms forth in bliss; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: giaanee har bolahu din raat ||
english: O spiritual teacher, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tinh kee trisanaa bhookh sabh utaree jo guramat raam ras khaa(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All hunger and thirst are satisfied, for those who partake of the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਸਖਾ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke daas saadh sakhaa jan jin miliaa lahi jaai bharaa(n)t ||
english: The slaves of the Lord are our Holy companions. Meeting with them, doubt is taken away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਾਢੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਹੀ ਤੇ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਾਢੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu jal dudh bhi(n)n bhi(n)n kaadhai chun ha(n)sulaa tiu dehee te chun kaadhai saadhoo haumai taat ||2||
english: As the swan separates the milk from the water, the Holy Saint removes the fire of egotism from the body. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਕਪਟੀ ਨਰ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kai preet naahee har hiradai te kapatee nar nit kapat kamaa(n)t ||
english: Those who do not love the Lord in their hearts are deceitful; they continually practice deception.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਲੈ ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin kau kiaa koee dei khavaalai oi aap beej aape hee khaa(n)t ||3||
english: What can anyone give them to eat? Whatever they themselves plant, they must eat. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa chihan soee har jan kaa har aape jan mahi aap rakhaa(n)t ||
english: This is the Quality of the Lord, and of the Lord's humble servants as well; the Lord places His Own Essence within them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਰੀ ਤਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo naanak samadarasee jin ni(n)daa usatat taree taraa(n)t ||4||5||
english: Blessed, blessed, is Guru Nanak, who looks impartially on all; He crosses over and transcends both slander and praise. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar naam har ootam har kirapaa te jap laiaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord is inaccessible, unfathomable, exalted and sublime. It is chanted by the Lord's Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat saadh paaee vadabhaagee sa(n)g saadhoo paar paiaa ||1||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the True Congregation, and in the Company of the Holy, I am carried across. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: merai man anadin anad bhaiaa ||
english: My mind is in ecstasy, night and day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad naam har japiaa mere man kaa bhram bhau gaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I chant the Name of the Lord. Doubt and fear are gone from my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin har gaaiaa jin har japiaa tin sa(n)gat har melahu kar maiaa ||
english: Those who chant and meditate on the Lord - O Lord, in Your Mercy, please unite me with them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kaa daras dekh sukh paaiaa dukh haumai rog gaiaa ||2||
english: Gazing upon them, I am at peace; the pain and disease of egotism are gone. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo anadin hiradai naam dhiaavahi sabh janam tinaa kaa saphal bhaiaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord in their hearts - their lives become totally fruitful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi aap tare srisat sabh taaree sabh kul bhee paar paiaa ||3||
english: They themselves swim across, and carry the world across with them. Their ancestors and family cross over as well. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape aap upaaiaa sabh jag tudh aape vas kar laiaa ||
english: You Yourself created the whole world, and You Yourself keep it under Your control.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa dhaaree bikh dubadaa kaadh laiaa ||4||6||
english: God has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has lifted him up, and rescued him from the ocean of poison. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee a(n)mrit nahee peeaa trisanaa bhookh na jaaee ||
english: Those who do not drink in the Ambrosial Nectar by Guru's Grace - their thirst and hunger are not relieved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜੑ ਜਲਤ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mooRh jalat aha(n)kaaree haumai vich dukh paaee ||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukh burns in the fire of egotistical pride; he suffers painfully in egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat birathaa janam gavaaiaa dukh laagai pachhutaaee ||
english: Coming and going, he wastes his life uselessly; afflicted with pain, he regrets and repents.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis te upaje tisahi na chetahi dhrig jeevan dhrig khaaee ||1||
english: He does not even think of the One, from whom he originated. Cursed is his life, and cursed is his food. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: praanee guramukh naam dhiaaee ||
english: O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa kare gur mele har har naam samaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy leads the mortal to meet the Guru; he is absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh janam bhaiaa hai birathaa aavat jaat lajaaee ||
english: The life of the self-willed manmukh is useless; he comes and goes in shame.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh doobe abhimaanee haumai vich jal jaaee ||
english: In sexual desire and anger, the proud ones are drowned. They are burnt in their egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tin sidh na budh bhaee mat madhim lobh lahar dukh paaee ||
english: They do not attain perfection or understanding; their intellect is dimmed. Tossed by the waves of greed, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਪਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur bihoon mahaa dukh paaiaa jam pakare bilalaaee ||2||
english: Without the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. Seized by Death, they weep and wail. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam agochar paaiaa guramukh sahaj subhaaee ||
english: As Gurmukh, I have attained the Unfathomable Name of the Lord, with intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghat a(n)tar rasanaa har gun gaaee ||
english: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within my heart. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee ek sabad liv laaee ||
english: I am forever in bliss, day and night, lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam padaarath sahaje paaiaa ih satigur kee vadiaaee ||3||
english: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease; this is the glorious greatness of the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur te har har man vasiaa satigur kau sad bal jaaee ||
english: Through the True Guru, the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within my mind. I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man tan arap rakhau sabh aagai gur charanee chit laaee ||
english: I have dedicated my mind and body to Him, and placed everything before Him in offering. I focus my consciousness on His Feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apanee kripaa karahu gur poore aape laihu milaaee ||
english: Please be merciful to me, O my Perfect Guru, and unite me with Yourself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਵ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: ham loh gur naav bohithaa naanak paar la(n)ghaaee ||4||7||
english: I am just iron; the Guru is the boat, to carry me across. ||4||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 paRataal ghar 3 ||
english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬੋਲਤ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jan bolat sreeraam naamaa mil saadhasa(n)gat har tor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name of the Supreme Lord; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Lord's Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬਨਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har dhan banajahu har dhan sa(n)chahu jis laagat hai nahee chor ||1||
english: Deal only in the wealth of the Lord, and gather only the wealth of the Lord. No thief can ever steal it. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੋਰ ਬੋਲਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਘਨਿਹਰ ਕੀ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaatrik mor bolat din raatee sun ghanihar kee ghor ||2||
english: The rainbirds and the peacocks sing day and night, hearing the thunder in the clouds. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਤ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo bolat hai mrig meen pa(n)kheroo s bin har jaapat hai nahee hor ||3||
english: Whatever the deer, the fish and the birds sing, they chant to the Lord, and no other. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਇਓ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਸੋਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak jan har keerat gaaee chhoot gaio jam kaa sabh sor ||4||1||8||
english: Servant Nanak sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the sound and fury of Death has totally gone away. ||4||1||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: raam raam bol bol khojate badabhaagee ||
english: They speak and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the very fortunate ones seek Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਕੋਊ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kaa pa(n)th kooo bataavai hau taa kai paai laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever shows me the Way of the Lord - I fall at his feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: har hamaaro meet sakhaaee ham har siu preet laagee ||
english: The Lord is my Friend and Compansion; I am in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ham gaavahi har ham bolahi aur duteeaa preet ham tiaagee ||1||
english: I sing of the Lord, and I speak of the Lord; I have discarded all other loves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: manamohan moro preetam raam har paramaana(n)d bairaagee ||
english: My Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; The Detached Lord God is the Embodiment of Supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੯॥੩੧॥
transliteration: har dekhe jeevat hai naanak ik nimakh palo mukh laagee ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||
english: Nanak lives by gazing upon the Lord; may I see Him for a moment, for even just an instant. ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kiaa too sochahi kiaa too chitavahi kiaa too(n) karahi upaae ||
english: What are you so worried about? What are you thinking? What have you tried?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kau kahahu paravaah kaahoo kee jih gopaal sahaae ||1||
english: Tell me - the Lord of the Universe - who controls Him? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੈ ਮੇਘੁ ਸਖੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: barasai megh sakhee ghar paahun aae ||
english: The rain showers down from the clouds, O companion. The Guest has come into my home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi deen kripaa nidh thaakur nav nidh naam samaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am meek; my Lord and Master is the Ocean of Mercy. I am absorbed in the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaar bhojan bahu keee bahu bi(n)jan misataae ||
english: I have prepared all sorts of foods in various ways, and all sorts of sweet deserts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ ਸੋਚ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karee paakasaal soch pavitraa hun laavahu bhog har raae ||2||
english: I have made my kitchen pure and sacred. Now, O my Sovereign Lord King, please sample my food. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹਸੇ ਇਹਿ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਘਰ ਅਪਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dusat bidaare saajan rahase ihi ma(n)dir ghar apanaae ||
english: The villains have been destroyed, and my friends are delighted. This is Your Own Mansion and Temple, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਰੰਗੀਓ ਆਇਆ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jau grihi laal ra(n)geeo aaiaa tau mai sabh sukh paae ||3||
english: When my Playful Beloved came into my household, then I found total peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa ot gur poore dhur masatak lekh likhaae ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, I have the Support and Protection of the Perfect Guru; this is the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak ka(n)t ra(n)geelaa paaiaa phir dookh na laagai aae ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak has found his Playful Husband Lord. He shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਜਬ ਹੋਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਰੈ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kheer adhaar baarik jab hotaa bin kheerai rahan na jaaee ||
english: When the baby's only food is milk, it cannot survive without its milk.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨੀਰੈ ਤਬ ਓਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saar samhaal maataa mukh neerai tab ohu tripat aghaaee ||1||
english: The mother takes care of it, and pours milk into its mouth; then, it is satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik pitaa prabh daataa ||
english: I am just a baby; God, the Great Giver, is my Father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ਅਨ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਹ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhoolahi baarik anik lakh bareeaa an thaur naahee jah jaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The child is so foolish; it makes so many mistakes. But it has nowhere else to go. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਪ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਰ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal mat baarik bapure kee sarap agan kar melai ||
english: The mind of the poor child is fickle; he touches even snakes and fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜਿ ਤਬ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maataa pitaa ka(n)th laai raakhai anad sahaj tab khelai ||2||
english: His mother and father hug him close in their embrace, and so he plays in joy and bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭੂਖ ਕੈਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa pitaa too hai mere suaamee tis baarik bhookh kaisee ||
english: What hunger can the child ever have, O my Lord and Master, when You are his Father?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਸੋ ਲੈਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nav nidh naam nidhaan grihi terai man baa(n)chhai so laisee ||3||
english: The treasure of the Naam and the nine treasures are in Your celestial household. You fulfill the desires of the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਇਹ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pitaa kripaal aagiaa ih deenee baarik mukh maa(n)gai so denaa ||
english: My Merciful Father has issued this Command: whatever the child asks for, is put into his mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਾਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak baarik daras prabh chaahai mohi hridai basahi nit charanaa ||4||2||
english: Nanak, the child, longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. May His Feet always dwell within my heart. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧੀ ਜੁਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਤਜਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal bidhee jur aahar kariaa tajio sagal a(n)desaa ||
english: I tried everything, and gathered all devices together; I have discarded all my anxieties.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਰੰਭਿਓ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੋਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaraj sagal ara(n)bhio ghar kaa thaakur kaa bhaarosaa ||1||
english: I have begun to set all my household affairs right; I have placed my faith in my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੀਐ ਬਾਜੈ ਬਾਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
transliteration: suneeai baajai baaj suhaavee ||
english: I listen to the celestial vibrations resonating and resounding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖ ਪੇਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਹਲਾਵੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhor bhaiaa mai pri mukh pekhe grihi ma(n)gal suhalaavee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sunrise has come, and I gaze upon the Face of my Beloved. My household is filled with peace and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manooaa laai savaare thaanaa(n) poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||
english: I focus my mind, and embellish and adorn the place within; then I go out to speak with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khojat khojat mai paahun milio bhagat karau niv paae ||2||
english: Seeking and searching, I have found my Husband Lord; I bow at His Feet and worship Him with devotion. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਸਨਿ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jab pri aai base grihi aasan tab ham ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
english: When my Beloved came to live in my house, I began to sing the songs of bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: meet saajan mere bhae suhele prabh pooraa guroo milaaiaa ||3||
english: My friends and companions are happy; God leads me to meet the Perfect Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਹਮਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sakhee sahelee bhae ana(n)daa gur kaaraj hamare poore ||
english: My friends and companions are in ecstasy; the Guru has completed all my projects.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak var miliaa sukhadaataa chhod na jaaee doore ||4||3||
english: Says Nanak, I have met my Husband, the Giver of peace; He shall never leave me and go away. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਕੀਟ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਖ ਜਠਰ ਕਉ ਭਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raaj te keet keet te surapat kar dokh jathar kau bharate ||
english: From a king to a worm, and from a worm to the lord of gods, they engage in evil to fill their bellies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ਹਰਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kripaa nidh chhod aan kau poojahi aatam ghaatee harate ||1||
english: They renounce the Lord, the Ocean of Mercy, and worship some other; they are thieves and killers of the soul. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat te dukh dukh marate ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow and die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਰਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik baar bhramahi bahu jonee tek na kaahoo dharate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They wander lost in reincarnation through all sorts of species; they do not find shelter anywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਖਲ ਖਰ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tiaag suaamee aan kau chitavat mooR mugadh khal khar te ||
english: Those who abandon their Lord and Master and think of some other, are foolish, stupid, idiotic donkeys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਰ ਨਾਵ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਕਤ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਕਥਤ ਹਮ ਤਰਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaagar naav la(n)ghahi kat saagar brithaa kathat ham tarate ||2||
english: How can they cross over the ocean in a paper boat? Their eogtistical boasts that they will cross over are meaningless. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੁਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: siv bira(n)ch asur sur jete kaal agan mahi jarate ||
english: Shiva, Brahma, angels and demons, all burn in the fire of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨ ਕੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਨ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak saran charan kamalan kee tumh na daarahu prabh karate ||3||4||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet; O God, Creator, please do not send me into exile. ||3||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਓਇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh mere oi bairaagee tiaagee ||
english: My God is detached and free of desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau ik khin tis bin rahi na sakau preet hamaaree laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant. I am so in love with Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: un kai sa(n)g mohi prabh chit aavai sa(n)t prasaad mohi jaagee ||
english: Associating with the Saints, God has come into my consciousness. By their Grace, I have been awakened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਂਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sun upades bhae man niramal gun gaae ra(n)g raa(n)gee ||1||
english: Hearing the Teachings, my mind has become immaculate. Imbued with the Lord's Love, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਕੀਏ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਬਡਭਾਗਂੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu man dei keee sa(n)t meetaa kripaal bhae badabhaaga(n)ee ||
english: Dedicating this mind, I have made friends with the Saints. They have become merciful to me; I am very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਰੇਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: mahaa sukh paaiaa baran na saakau ren naanak jan paagee ||2||1||5||
english: I have found absolute peace - I cannot describe it. Nanak has obtained the dust of the feet of the humble. ||2||1||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaee mohi preetam dehu milaaee ||
english: O mother, please lead me to union with my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸੁਖ ਭਰਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਜਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal sahelee sukh bhar sootee jih ghar laal basaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All my friends and companions sleep totally in peace; their Beloved Lord has come into the homes of their hearts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mohi avagan prabh sadaa daiaalaa mohi niragun kiaa chaturaaee ||
english: I am worthless; God is forever Merciful. I am unworthy; what clever tricks could I try?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਂੀ ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੀਠਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karau baraabar jo pri sa(n)g raata(n)ee ih haumai kee dheethaaee ||1||
english: I claim to be on a par with those who are imbued with the Love of their Beloved. This is my stubborn egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਇਕ ਤਾਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhaee nimaanee saran ik taakee gur satigur purakh sukhadaaee ||
english: I am dishonored - I seek the Sanctuary of the One, the Guru, the True Guru, the Primal Being, the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: ek nimakh mahi meraa sabh dukh kaatiaa naanak sukh rain bihaaee ||2||2||6||
english: In an instant, all my pains have been taken away; Nanak passes the night of his life in peace. ||2||2||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਮੇਘ ਜੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baras megh jee til bilam na laau ||
english: Rain down, O cloud; do not delay.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baras piaare manahi sadhaare hoi anad sadaa man chaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O beloved cloud, O support of the mind, you bring lasting bliss and joy to the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਰ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham teree dhar suaameeaa mere too kiu manahu bisaare ||
english: I take to Your Support, O my Lord and Master; how could You forget me?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਰੂਪ ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਭ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: isatree roop cheree kee niaaee sobh nahee bin bharataare ||1||
english: I am Your beautiful bride, Your servant and slave. I have no nobility without my Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਜਬ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੈ ਬੇਗਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: binau sunio jab thaakur merai beg aaio kirapaa dhaare ||
english: When my Lord and Master listened to my prayer, He hurried to shower me with His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਨਿਓ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ ਪਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੇ ਅਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mero banio suhaago pat sobhaa bhale achaare ||2||3||7||
english: Says Nanak, I have become just like my Husband Lord; I am blessed with honor, nobility and the lifestyle of goodness. ||2||3||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: preetam saachaa naam dhiaai ||
english: Meditate on the True Name of your Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad binasai bhav saagar gur kee moorat ridai basaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The pains and sorrows of the terrifying world-ocean are dispelled, by enshrining the Image of the Guru within your heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਹਤੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dusaman hate dokhee sabh viaape har saranaaee aaiaa ||
english: Your enemies shall be destroyed, and all the evil-doers shall perish, when you come to the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raakhanahaarai haath de raakhio naam padaarath paaiaa ||1||
english: The Savior Lord has given me His Hand and saved me; I have obtained the wealth of the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa kilavikh sabh kaate naam niramal man deeaa ||
english: Granting His Grace, He has eradicated all my sins; He has placed the Immaculate Naam within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan naanak man vasiaa baahuR dookh na theeaa ||2||4||8||
english: O Nanak, the Treasure of Virtue fills my mind; I shall never again suffer in pain. ||2||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh mere preetam praan piaare ||
english: My Beloved God is the Lover of my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਪਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat apano naam deejai daiaal anugrahu dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please bless me with the loving devotional worship of the Naam, O Kind and Compassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਚਰਨ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: simarau charan tuhaare preetam ridai tuhaaree aasaa ||
english: I meditate in remembrance on Your Feet, O my Beloved; my heart is filled with hope.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa pahi karau benatee man darasan kee piaasaa ||1||
english: I offer my prayer to the humble Saints; my mind thirsts for the Blssed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bichhurat maran jeevan har milate jan kau darasan deejai ||
english: Separation is death, and Union with the Lord is life. Please bless Your humble servant with Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
transliteration: naam adhaar jeevan dhan naanak prabh mere kirapaa keejai ||2||5||9||
english: O my God, please be Merciful, and bless Nanak with the support, the life and wealth of the Naam. ||2||5||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ab apane preetam siu ban aaee ||
english: Now, I have become just like my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਰਸੁ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam ramat sukh paaio baras megh sukhadaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dwelling on my Sovereign Lord King, I have found peace. Rain down, O peace-giving cloud. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ik pal bisarat nahee sukh saagar naam navai nidh paaee ||
english: I cannot forget Him, even for an instant; He is the Ocean of peace. Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦੌਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਵੀ ਕੋ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: udaut bhaio pooran bhaavee ko bhete sa(n)t sahaaee ||1||
english: My perfect destiny has been activated, meeting with the Saints, my help and support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sukh upaje dukh sagal binaase paarabraham liv laaee ||
english: Peace has welled up, and all pain has been dispelled, lovingly attuned to the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਠਿਨ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
transliteration: tario sa(n)saar kathin bhai saagar har naanak charan dhiaaee ||2||6||10||
english: The arduous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, O Nanak, by meditating on the Feet of the Lord. ||2||6||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਨਿਹਰ ਬਰਸਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghanihar baras sagal jag chhaaiaa ||
english: The clouds have rained down all over the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal preetam prabh mere anad ma(n)gal sukh paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Beloved Lord God has become merciful to me; I am blessed with ecstasy, bliss and peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਕਲੇਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mite kales trisan sabh boojhee paarabraham man dhiaaiaa ||
english: My sorrows are erased, and all my thirsts are quenched, meditating on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g janam maran nivaare bahur na katahoo dhaaiaa ||1||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, death and birth come to an end, and the mortal does not wander anywhere, ever again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤਉ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan naam nira(n)jan raatau charan kamal liv laaiaa ||
english: My mind and body are imbued with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; I am lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apanai naanak daas saranaaiaa ||2||7||11||
english: God has made Nanak His Own; slave Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||2||7||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੇ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਨ ॥
transliteration: bichhurat kiu jeeve oi jeevan ||
english: Separated from the Lord, how can any living being live?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਉਲਾਸ ਆਸ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ ਪੀਵਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chitahi ulaas aas milabe kee charan kamal ras peevan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My consciousness is filled with yearning and hope to meet my Lord, and drink in the sublime essence of His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kau piaas tumaaree preetam tin kau a(n)tar naahee ||
english: Those who are thirsty for You, O my Beloved, are not separated from You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇ ਮੂਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹੀਂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin kau bisarai mero raam piaaraa se mooe mar jaa(n)hee(n) ||1||
english: Those who forget my Beloved Lord are dead and dying. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa jagadeesur pekhat sadaa hajoore ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading my mind and body; I see Him Ever-present, here and now.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak rav rahio sabh a(n)tar sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||2||8||12||
english: O Nanak, He is permeating the inner being of all; He is all-pervading everywhere. ||2||8||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਨਿ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhajan kaun kaun na taare ||
english: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord, who has not been carried across?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਗ ਤਨ ਮੀਨ ਤਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤਨ ਬਰਾਹ ਤਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khag tan meen tan mrig tan baraah tan saadhoo sa(n)g udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those reborn into the body of a bird, the body of a fish, the body of a deer, and the body of a bull - in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they are saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਦੈਤ ਕੁਲ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dev kul dait kul jakhy ki(n)nar nar saagar utare paare ||
english: The families of gods, the families of demons, titans, celestial singers and human beings are carried across the ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jo bhajan karai saadhoo sa(n)g taa ke dookh bidaare ||1||
english: Whoever meditates and vibrates on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat - his pains are taken away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh mahaa bikhiaa ras in te bhae niraare ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and the pleasures of terrible corruption - he keeps away from these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
transliteration: deen daiaal japahi karunaa mai naanak sad balihaare ||2||9||13||
english: He meditates on the Lord, Merciful to the meek, the Embodiment of Compassion; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਮੈ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
transliteration: aaj mai baisio har haat ||
english: Today, I am seated in the Lord's store.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਝੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਂਉ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਘਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam raas saajhee kar jan siu jaa(n)u na jam kai ghaat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With the wealth of the Lord, I have entered into partnership with the humble; I shall not have take the Highway of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham raakhe bhram ke khulhe kapaat ||
english: Showering me with His Kindness, the Supreme Lord God has saved me; the doors of doubt have been opened wide.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਸਾਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਾਟ ॥੧॥
transliteration: besumaar saahu prabh paaiaa laahaa charan nidh khaat ||1||
english: I have found God, the Banker of Infinity; I have earned the profit of the wealth of His Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਢੇ ਹੈ ਛਾਂਟਿ ॥
transliteration: saran gahee achut abinaasee kilabikh kaadhe hai chhaa(n)t ||
english: I have grasped the protection of the Sanctuary of the Unchanging, Unmoving, Imperishable Lord; He has picked up my sins and thrown them out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kal kales mite daas naanak bahur na jonee maat ||2||10||14||
english: Slave Nanak's sorrow and suffering has ended. He shall never again be squeezed into the mold of reincarnation. ||2||10||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: bahu bidh maaiaa moh hiraano ||
english: In so many ways, attachment to Maya leads to ruin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਚਿਰਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe kooo biralaa sevak pooran bhagat chiraano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Among millions, it is very rare to find a selfless servant who remains a perfect devotee for very long. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: it ut dol dol sram paaio tan dhan hot biraano ||
english: Roaming and wandering here and there, the mortal finds only trouble; his body and wealth become strangers to himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਿਆਈ ਹੋਤੌ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: log duraai karat thagiaaee hotau sa(n)g na jaano ||1||
english: Hiding from people, he practices deception; he does not know the One who is always with him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪੰਖੀ ਮੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਨੀਚ ਇਹ ਸੰਕਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
transliteration: mrig pa(n)khee meen deen neech ih sa(n)kat phir aano ||
english: He wanders through troubled incarnations of low and wretched species as a deer, a bird and a fish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak paahan prabh taarahu saadhasa(n)gat sukh maano ||2||11||15||
english: Says Nanak, O God, I am a stone - please carry me across, that I may enjoy peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dusat mue bikh khaaee ree maaee ||
english: The cruel and evil ones died after taking poison, O mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis ke jee tin hee rakh leene mere prabh kau kirapaa aaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: And the One, to whom all creatures belong, has saved us. God has granted His Grace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee sabh mahi varatai taa(n) bhau kaisaa bhaaee ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is contained within all; why should I be afraid, O Siblings of Destiny?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਠਾਈਁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee chhod na jaaee prabh deesai sabhanee thaaee(n) ||1||
english: God, my Help and Support, is always with me. He shall never leave; I see Him everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anaathaa naath deen dukh bha(n)jan aap leee laR laaee ||
english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; He has attached me to the hem of His robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੬॥
transliteration: har kee ot jeevahi daas tere naanak prabh saranaaee ||2||12||16||
english: O Lord, Your slaves live by Your Support; Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||2||12||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man mere har ke charan raveejai ||
english: O my mind, dwell on the Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਲਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daras piaas mero man mohio har pa(n)kh lagaai mileejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind is enticed by thirst for the Blessed Vision of the Lord; I would take wings and fly out to meet Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat maarag paaio saadhoo sev kareejai ||
english: Searching and seeking, I have found the Path, and now I serve the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere naam mahaa ras peejai ||1||
english: O my Lord and Master, please be kind to me, that I may drink in Your most sublime essence. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਏ ਜਲਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: traahi traahi kar saranee aae jalatau kirapaa keejai ||
english: Begging and pleading, I have come to Your Sanctuary; I am on fire - please shower me with Your Mercy!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kar gahi lehu daas apune kau naanak apuno keejai ||2||13||17||
english: Please give me Your Hand - I am Your slave, O Lord. Please make Nanak Your Own. ||2||13||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mah 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: prabh ko bhagat bachhal biradaaio ||
english: It is God's Nature to love His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak maar charan tal deene apuno jas varataaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He destroys the slanderers, crushing them beneath His Feet. His Glory is manifest everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦਇਆ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar keeno sabh jag mahi daiaa jeean mahi paaio ||
english: His Victory is celebrated all throughout the world. He blesses all creatures with compassion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai apuno daas raakhio taatee vaau na laaio ||1||
english: Hugging him close in His Embrace, the Lord saves and protects His slave. The hot winds cannot even touch him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਸੁਖਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo mere suaamee bhram bhau met sukhaaio ||
english: My Lord and Master has made me His Own; dispelling my doubts and fears, He has made me happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੮॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d karahu daas har ke naanak bisvaas man aaio ||2||14||18||
english: The Lord's slaves enjoy ultimate ecstasy; O Nanak, faith has welled up in my mind. ||2||14||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh deesai braham pasaar ||
english: The Gurmukh sees God pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣੀਆਂ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh trai guneeaa(n) bisathaar ||
english: The Gurmukh knows that the universe is the extension of the three gunas, the three dispositions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naad bed beechaar ||
english: The Gurmukh reflects on the Sound-current of the Naad, and the wisdom of the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin gur poore ghor a(n)dhaar ||1||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur gur karat sadaa sukh paaeeai ||
english: O my mind, calling on the Guru, eternal peace is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਓ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur upades har hiradai vasio saas giraas apanaa khasam dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord comes to dwell within the heart; I meditate on my Lord and Master with every breath and morsel of food. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan vitahu bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur ke gun anadin nit gaau ||
english: Night and day, I continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਕਰਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee dhooR karau isanaan ||
english: I take my cleansing bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachee daragah paaeeai maan ||2||
english: I am honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur bohith bhavajal taaranahaar ||
english: The Guru is the boat, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur bhetiai na hoi jon autaar ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I shall not be reincarnated ever again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa so jan paae ||
english: That humble being serves the Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau karam likhiaa dhur aae ||3||
english: who has such karma inscribed on his forehead by the Primal Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur meree jeevan gur aadhaar ||
english: The Guru is my life; the Guru is my support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur meree varatan gur paravaar ||
english: The Guru is my way of life; the Guru is my family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur meraa khasam satigur saranaaee ||
english: The Guru is my Lord and Master; I seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak gur paarabraham jaa kee keem na paaee ||4||1||19||
english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God; His value cannot be estimated. ||4||1||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaae ||
english: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aap milaae ||
english: in His Mercy, God has united me with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau lae prabh laai ||
english: God enjoins His servant to his tasks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahee na jaai ||1||
english: His worth cannot be expressed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa pooran sukhadaate ||
english: Please be merciful to me, O Perfect Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te too(n) chit aavahi aath pahar terai ra(n)g raate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Your Grace, You come to mind; I am imbued with Your Love, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਣੁ ਸੁਨਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gaavan sunan sabh teraa bhaanaa ||
english: Singing and listening, it is all by Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam boojhai so saach samaanaa ||
english: One who understands the Hukam of Your Command is absorbed in Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਂਉ ॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevahi teraa naa(n)u ||
english: Chanting and meditating on Your Name, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa naahee thaau ||2||
english: Without You, there is no place at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh karate hukam rajaai ||
english: Pain and pleasure come by Your Command, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸ ਭਾਣੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai bakhas bhaanai dei sajaai ||
english: By the Pleasure of Your Will You forgive, and by the Pleasure of Your Will You award punishment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਸਿਰਿਆਂ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: duhaa(n) siriaa(n) kaa karataa aap ||
english: You are the Creator of both realms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਂਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kurabaan jaa(n)ee tere parataap ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your Glorious Grandeur. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teree keemat toohai jaanahi ||
english: You alone know Your value.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too aape boojhahi sun aap vakhaanahi ||
english: You alone understand, You Yourself speak and listen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: seee bhagat jo tudh bhaane ||
english: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai sad kurabaane ||4||2||20||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: paramesar hoaa daiaal ||
english: The Transcendent Lord God has become merciful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: megh varasai a(n)mrit dhaar ||
english: Ambrosial Nectar is raining down from the clouds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sagale jee ja(n)t tripataase ||
english: All beings and creatures are satisfied;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਆਏ ਪੂਰੇ ਰਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaraj aae poore raase ||1||
english: their affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa man naam samhaal ||
english: O my mind, dwell on the Lord, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee sevaa paaiaa aithai othai nibahai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serving the Perfect Guru, I have obtained it. It shall stay with me both here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਭੰਨਾ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)naa bhai bha(n)janahaar ||
english: He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਜੀਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aapaniaa jeeaa kee keetee saar ||
english: He takes care of His beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar sadaa miharavaan ||
english: The Savior Lord is kind and compassionate forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaeeai kurabaan ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to Him, forever and ever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: kaal gavaaiaa karatai aap ||
english: The Creator Himself has eliminated death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa man tis no jaap ||
english: Meditate on Him forever and ever, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: drisat dhaar raakhe sabh ja(n)t ||
english: He watches all with His Glance of Grace and protects them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun gaavahu nit nit bhagava(n)t ||3||
english: Continually and continuously, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: eko karataa aape aap ||
english: The One and Only Creator Lord is Himself by Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: har ke bhagat jaanahi parataap ||
english: The Lord's devotees know His Glorious Grandeur.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naavai kee paij rakhadaa aaiaa ||
english: He preserves the Honor of His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak bolai tis kaa bolaaiaa ||4||3||21||
english: Nanak speaks as the Lord inspires him to speak. ||4||3||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: gur saranaaee sagal nidhaan ||
english: All treasures are found in the Sanctuary of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee daragahi paaeeai maan ||
english: Honor is obtained in the True Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhau dookh darad sabh jaai ||
english: Doubt, fear, pain and suffering are taken away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g sad har gun gaai ||1||
english: forever singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere gur pooraa saalaahi ||
english: O my mind, praise the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan japahu din raatee man chi(n)de phal paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur jevad avar na koi ||
english: No one else is as great as the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur paarabraham paramesar soi ||
english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੂਖ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dookh te raakhai ||
english: He saves us from the pains of death and birth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa bikh phir bahuR na chaakhai ||2||
english: and we will not have to taste the poison of Maya ever again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee mahimaa kathan na jaai ||
english: The Guru's glorious grandeur cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar saachai naai ||
english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, in the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚੀ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee sabh saachee ||
english: True is His self-discipline, and True are all His actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so man niramal jo gur sa(n)g raachee ||3||
english: Immaculate and pure is that mind, which is imbued with love for the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaeeai vad bhaag ||
english: The Perfect Guru is obtained by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh man te tiaag ||
english: Drive out sexual desire, anger and greed from your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur charan nivaas ||
english: By His Grace, the Guru's Feet are enshrined within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh sach aradaas ||4||4||22||
english: Nanak offers his prayer to the True Lord God. ||4||4||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar mahalaa 5 paRataal ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਨਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਇਆਰ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur manaar pri daiaar siu ra(n)g keeaa ||
english: Pleasing the Guru, I have fallen in love with my Merciful Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਨੋ ਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਸਂੀਗਾਰ ॥
transliteration: keeno ree sagal sa(n)eegaar ||
english: I have made all my decorations,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿਓ ਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tajio ree sagal bikaar ||
english: and renounced all corruption;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੋ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhaavato asathir theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: my wandering mind has become steady and stable. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aise re man paai kai aap gavaai kai kar saadhan siu sa(n)g ||
english: O my mind, lose your self-conceit by associating with the Holy, and you shall find Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜਹਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਧੁਰ ਬੈਨ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baaje bajahi mrida(n)g anaahad kokil ree raam naam bolai madhur bain at suheeaa ||1||
english: The unstruck celestial melody vibrates and resounds; like a song-bird, chant the Lord's Name, with words of sweetness and utter beauty. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅਮੋਘ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਬਨੇ ॥
transliteration: aisee tere darasan kee sobh at apaar pri amogh taise hee sa(n)g sa(n)t bane ||
english: Such is the glory of Your Darshan, so utterly inifinte and fruitful, O my Love; so do we become by associating with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥
transliteration: bhav utaar naam bhane ||
english: Vibrating, chanting Your Name, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ram raam raam maal ||
english: They dwell on the Lord, Raam, Raam, chanting on their malas;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਫੇਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: man pherate har sa(n)g sa(n)geeaa ||
english: their minds are turned towards the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak priu preetam theeaa ||2||1||23||
english: O servant Nanak, their Beloved Lord seems so sweet to them. ||2||1||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਘਨੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਬਨੈ ॥
transliteration: man ghanai bhramai banai ||
english: My mind wanders through the dense forest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਮਕਿ ਤਰਸਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: umak taras chaalai ||
english: It walks with eagerness and love,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh milabe kee chaah ||1|| rahaau ||
english: hoping to meet God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਈ ਕਹੰਉ ਬੇਦਨ ਕਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trai gun maaee mohi aaee kaha(n)u bedan kaahi ||1||
english: Maya with her three gunas - the three dispositions - has come to entice me; whom can I tell of my pain? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਰ ਕੀਏ ਨਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aan upaav sagar keee nahi dookh saakahi laahi ||
english: I tried everything else, but nothing could rid me of my sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੪॥
transliteration: bhaj saran saadhoo naanakaa mil gun gobi(n)dahi gaahi ||2||2||24||
english: So hurry to the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak; joining them, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||2||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
transliteration: pri kee sobh suhaavanee neekee ||
english: The glory of my Beloved is noble and sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਹਾ ਹੂਹੂ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਅਪਸਰਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਗਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haahaa hoohoo ga(n)dhrab apasaraa ana(n)d ma(n)gal ras gaavanee neekee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The celestial singers and angels sing His Sublime Praises in ecstasy, happiness and joy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਗੁਨਗੵ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhunit lalit gunagy anik bhaa(n)t bahu bidh roop dikhaavanee neekee ||1||
english: The most worthy beings sing God's Praises in beautiful harmonies, in all sorts of ways, in myriads of sublime forms. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਥਲ ਜਲ ਭਵਨ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਲਾਲਨ ਛਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
transliteration: gir tar thal jal bhavan bharapur ghat ghat laalan chhaavanee neekee ||
english: Throughout the mountains, trees, deserts, oceans and galaxies, permeating each and every heart, the sublime grandeur of my Love is totally pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੫॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g raamaeeaa ras paaio naanak jaa kai bhaavanee neekee ||2||3||25||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Love of the Lord is found; O Nanak, sublime is that faith. ||2||3||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur preet piaare charan kamal rid a(n)tar dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With love for the Guru, I enshrine the Lotus Feet of my Lord deep within my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਗਏ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: daras saphalio daras pekhio gae kilabikh gae ||
english: I gaze on the Blessed Vision of His Fruitful Darshan; my sins are erased and taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਉਜੀਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man niramal ujeeaare ||1||
english: My mind is immaculate and enlightened. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: bisam bisamai bisam bhaee ||
english: I am wonderstruck, stunned and amazed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਘ ਕੋਟਿ ਹਰਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਲਈ ॥
transliteration: agh kot harate naam laee ||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of sins are destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਪਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur charan masatak daar pahee ||
english: I fall at His Feet, and touch my forehead to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਏਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh ek too(n)hee ek tuhee ||
english: You alone are, You alone are, O God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat tek tuhaare ||
english: Your devotees take Your Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak saran duaare ||2||4||26||
english: Servant Nanak has come to the Door of Your Sanctuary. ||2||4||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਸਰਸੁ ਆਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: baras saras aagiaa ||
english: Rain down with happiness in God's Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਗਲ ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hohi aana(n)d sagal bhaag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bless me with total bliss and good fortune. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਘ ਧਰ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sa(n)ge man paraphaRai mil megh dhar suhaag ||1||
english: My mind blossoms forth in the Society of the Saints; soaking up the rain, the earth is blessed and beautified. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਨਘੋਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: ghanaghor preet mor ||
english: The peacock loves the thunder of the rain clouds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਓਰ ॥
transliteration: chit chaatrik boo(n)d or ||
english: The rainbird's mind is drawn to the rain-drop

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨ ਮੋਹ ॥
transliteration: aiso har sa(n)ge man moh ||
english: - so is my mind enticed by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹ ॥
transliteration: tiaag maaiaa dhoh ||
english: I have renounced Maya, the deceiver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੭॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)t naanak jaagiaa ||2||5||27||
english: Joining with the Saints, Nanak is awakened. ||2||5||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਗਾਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gun goupaal gaau neet ||
english: Sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰਿ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhaar cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's Name in your consciousness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: chhod maan taj gumaan mil saadhooaa kai sa(n)g ||
english: Forsake your pride, and abandon your ego; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simar ek ra(n)g mit jaa(n)hi dokh meet ||1||
english: Meditate in loving remembrance on the One Lord; your sorrows shall be ended, O friend. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham bhae daiaal ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: binas gae bikhai ja(n)jaal ||
english: corrupt entanglements have come to an end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa(n) kai charan laag ||
english: Grasping the feet of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨੀਤ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak gaavai gobi(n)d neet ||2||6||28||
english: Nanak sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World. ||2||6||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਨੁ ਗਰਜਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: ghan garajat gobi(n)d roop ||
english: The Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe roars like the thunder-cloud.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਚੈਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat sukh chain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Singing His Glorious Praises brings peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤਾ ਰਸ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har charan saran taran saagar dhun anahataa ras bain ||1||
english: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet carries us across the world-ocean. His Sublime Word is the unstruck celestial melody. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਥਿਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਆਤਮ ਜਲੁ ਲੈਨ ॥
transliteration: pathik piaas chit sarovar aatam jal lain ||
english: The thirsty traveller's consciousness obtains the water of the soul from the pool of nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੈਨ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੯॥
transliteration: har daras prem jan naanak kar kirapaa prabh dain ||2||7||29||
english: Servant Nanak loves the Blessed Vision of the Lord; in His Mercy, God has blessed him with it. ||2||7||29||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: he gobi(n)d he gopaal he daiaal laal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, O Lord of the World, O Dear Merciful Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: praan naath anaath sakhe deen darad nivaar ||1||
english: You are the Master of the breath of life, the Companion of the lost and forsaken, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਗਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: he samrath agam pooran mohi maiaa dhaar ||2||
english: O All-powerful, Inaccessible, Perfect Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahaa bhaiaan naanak paar utaar ||3||8||30||
