english: Please, carry Nanak across the terrible, deep dark pit of the world to the other side. ||3||8||30||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ghar 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਕਵੀ ਨੈਨ ਨਂੀਦ ਨਹਿ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chakavee nain na(n)eed nahi chaahai bin pir na(n)eed na paaee ||
english: The chakvi bird does not long for sleepy eyes; without her beloved, she does not sleep.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੁ ਚਰ੍ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਨੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soor charhai priu dekhai nainee niv niv laagai paa(n)ee ||1||
english: When the sun rises, she sees her beloved with her eyes; she bows and touches his feet. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pir bhaavai prem sakhaaee ||
english: The Love of my Beloved is pleasing; it is my Companion and Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਐਸੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis bin ghaRee nahee jag jeevaa aisee piaas tisaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without Him, I cannot live in this world even for an instant; such is my hunger and thirst. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saravar kamal kiran aakaasee bigasai sahaj subhaaee ||
english: The lotus in the pool blossoms forth intuitively and naturally, with the rays of the sun in the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਭ ਐਸੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: preetam preet banee abh aisee jotee jot milaaee ||2||
english: Such is the love for my Beloved which imbues me; my light has merged into the Light. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਟੇਰੈ ਬਿਲਪ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chaatrik jal bin priu priu terai bilap karai bilalaaee ||
english: Without water, the rainbird cries out, "Pri-o! Pri-o! - Beloved! Beloved!" It cries and wails and laments.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਨਹਰ ਘੋਰ ਦਸੌ ਦਿਸਿ ਬਰਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghanahar ghor dasau dis barasai bin jal piaas na jaaee ||3||
english: The thundering clouds rain down in the ten directions; its thirst is not quenched until it catches the rain-drop in its mouth. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meen nivaas upajai jal hee te sukh dukh purab kamaaee ||
english: The fish lives in water, from which it was born. It finds peace and pleasure according to its past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਲੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਂਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: khin til rahi na sakai pal jal bin maran jeevan tis taa(n)ee ||4||
english: It cannot survive without water for a moment, even for an instant. Life and death depend on it. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਸ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਠਾਈਁ ॥
transliteration: dhan vaa(n)dhee pir des nivaasee sache gur pahi sabad pathaaee(n) ||
english: The soul-bride is separated from her Husband Lord, who lives in His Own Country. He sends the Shabad, His Word, through the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gun sa(n)grahi prabh ridai nivaasee bhagat ratee harakhaaee ||5||
english: She gathers virtues, and enshrines God within her heart. Imbued with devotion, she is happy. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਾਈਁ ॥
transliteration: priu priu karai sabhai hai jetee gur bhaavai priu paaee(n) ||
english: Everyone cries out, "Beloved! Beloved!" But she alone finds her Beloved, who is pleasing to the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: priu naale sad hee sach sa(n)ge nadaree mel milaaee ||6||
english: Our Beloved is always with us; through the Truth, He blesses us with His Grace, and unites us in His Union. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi jeeu jeeu hai soee ghat ghat rahiaa samaaee ||
english: He is the life of the soul in each and every soul; He permeates and pervades each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur parasaad ghar hee paragaasiaa sahaje sahaj samaaee ||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed within the home of my heart; I am intuitively, naturally, absorbed into Him. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੋਸਾਂਈਁ ॥
transliteration: apanaa kaaj savaarahu aape sukhadaate gosaa(n)ee(n) ||
english: He Himself shall resolve all your affairs, when you meet with the Giver of peace, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaad ghar hee pir paaiaa tau naanak tapat bujhaaee ||8||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Husband Lord within your own home; then, O Nanak, the fire within you shall be quenched. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaagat jaag rahai gur sevaa bin har mai ko naahee ||
english: Remain awake and aware, serving the Guru; except for the Lord, no one is mine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਚੁ ਕਾਚੁ ਢਰਿ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar rahan na paavai aach kaach dhar paa(n)hee ||1||
english: Even by making all sorts of efforts, you shall not remain here; it shall melt like glass in the fire. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: is tan dhan kaa kahahu garab kaisaa ||
english: Tell me - why are you so proud of your body and wealth?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਵਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਖਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binasat baar na laagai bavare haumai garab khapai jag aisaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They shall vanish in an instant; O madman, this is how the world is wasting away, in egotism and pride. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jai jagadees prabhoo rakhavaare raakhai parakhai soee ||
english: Hail to the Lord of the Universe, God, our Saving Grace; He judges and saves the mortal beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jetee hai tetee tujh hee te tumh sar avar na koee ||2||
english: All that is, belongs to You. No one else is equal to You. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jee upaai jugat vas keenee aape guramukh a(n)jan ||
english: Creating all beings and creatures, their ways and means are under Your control; You bless the Gurmukhs with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਰਬ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਖੰਜਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: amar anaath sarab sir moraa kaal bikaal bharam bhai kha(n)jan ||3||
english: My Eternal, Unmastered Lord is over the heads of all. He is the Destroyer of death and rebirth, doubt and fear. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਦ ਕੋਟੁ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਚਿਹਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaagad kot ihu jag hai bapuro ra(n)gan chihan chaturaaee ||
english: This wretched world is a fortress of paper, of color and form and clever tricks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨੑੀ ਸੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਾਈਁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanhee see boo(n)d pavan pat khovai janam marai khin taaee(n) ||4||
english: A tiny drop of water or a little puff of wind destroys its glory; in an instant, its life is ended. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਉਪਕੰਠਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: nadee upaka(n)th jaise ghar taravar sarapan ghar ghar maahee ||
english: It is like a tree-house near the bank of a river, with a serpent's den in that house.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦੀ ਕਹਾਂ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ulatee nadee kahaa(n) ghar taravar sarapan dasai doojaa man maa(n)hee ||5||
english: When the river overflows, what happens to the tree house? The snake bites, like duality in the mind. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਰੁੜ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gaaruR gur giaan dhiaan gur bachanee bikhiaa guramat jaaree ||
english: Through the magic spell of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, and meditation on the Word of the Guru's Teachings, vice and corruption are burnt away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੇਂਵ ਭਏ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: man tan he(n)v bhae sach paaiaa har kee bhagat niraaree ||6||
english: The mind and body are cooled and soothed and Truth is obtained, through the wondrous and unique devotional worship of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆਂ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai too sarab jeeaa(n) daiaalaa ||
english: All that exists begs of You; You are merciful to all beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tumhree saran pare pat raakhahu saach milai gopaalaa ||7||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary; please save my honor, O Lord of the World, and bless me with Truth. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੀ ਧੰਧਿ ਅੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: baadhee dha(n)dh a(n)dh nahee soojhai badhik karam kamaavai ||
english: Bound in worldly affairs and entanglements, the blind one does not understand; he acts like a murderous butcher.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੂਝਸਿ ਸਚ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta soojhas boojhas sach man giaan samaavai ||8||
english: But if he meets with the True Guru, then he comprehends and understands, and his mind is imbued with true spiritual wisdom. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਚੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਛਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: niragun deh saach bin kaachee mai poochhau gur apanaa ||
english: Without the Truth, this worthless body is false; I have consulted my Guru on this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੯॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so prabh prabhoo dikhaavai bin saache jag supanaa ||9||2||
english: O Nanak, that God has revealed God to me; without the Truth, all the world is just a dream. ||9||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaatrik meen jal hee te sukh paavahi saari(n)g sabad suhaaee ||1||
english: The rainbird and the fish find peace in water; the deer is pleased by the sound of the bell. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੈਨਿ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਬੋਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rain babeehaa bolio meree maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The rainbird chirps in the night, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਲਟੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pri siu preet na ulatai kabahoo jo tai bhaavai saaee ||2||
english: O my Beloved, my love for You shall never end, if it is Your Will. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸਚ ਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: need gaee haumai tan thaakee sach mat ridai samaaee ||3||
english: Sleep is gone, and egotism is exhausted from my body; my heart is permeated with the Teachings of Truth. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਖਂੀ ਬਿਰਖਂੀ ਊਡਉ ਭੂਖਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: rookha(n)ee birakha(n)ee oodau bhookhaa peevaa naam subhaaee ||4||
english: Flying among the trees and plants, I remain hungry; lovingly drinking in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਤਾਰ ਲਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: lochan taar lalataa bilalaatee darasan piaas rajaaee ||5||
english: I stare at You, and my tongue cries out to You; I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ਤੇਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: pri bin seegaar karee tetaa tan taapai kaapar a(n)g na suhaaee ||6||
english: Without my Beloved, the more I decorate myself, the more my body burns; these clothes do not look good on my body. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਂਉ ਬਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: apane piaare bin ik khin rahi na saka(n)u bin mile na(n)eed na paaee ||7||
english: Without my Beloved, I cannot survive even for an instant; without meeting Him, I cannot sleep. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: pir najeek na boojhai bapuRee satigur deeaa dikhaaee ||8||
english: Her Husband Lord is nearby, but the wretched bride does not know it. The True Guru reveals Him to her. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sahaj miliaa tab hee sukh paaiaa trisanaa sabad bujhaaee ||9||
english: When she meets Him with intuitive ease, she finds peace; the Word of the Shabad quenches the fire of desire. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tujh te man maaniaa keemat kahan na jaaee ||10||3||
english: Says Nanak, through You, O Lord, my mind is pleased and appeased; I cannot express Your worth. ||10||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਲੀ ਊਂਡੀ ਜਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: akhalee oo(n)dee jal bhar naal ||
english: The earth bends under the weight of the water,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡੂਗਰੁ ਊਚਉ ਗੜੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: doogar oochau gaR paataal ||
english: the lofty mountains and the caverns of the underworld.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saagar seetal gurasabad veechaar ||
english: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the oceans become calm.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maarag mukataa haumai maar ||1||
english: The path of liberation is found by subduing the ego. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mai a(n)dhule naavai kee jot ||
english: I am blind; I seek the Light of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਚਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam adhaar chalaa gur kai bhai bhet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I walk on the path of mystery of the Guru's Fear. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: satigurasabadee paadhar jaan ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the Path is known.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਤਕੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai takeeai saachai taan ||
english: With the Guru's Support, one is blessed with the strength of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਸਿ ਰੂੜੑੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: naam samhaalas rooRhee baan ||
english: Dwell on the Naam, and realize the Beauteous Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥੈਂ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਰੁ ਲਹਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: thai(n) bhaavai dar lahas piraan ||2||
english: If it is Your Will, Lord, You lead me to find Your Door. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਡਾਂ ਬੈਸਾ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: oodaa(n) baisaa ek liv taar ||
english: Flying high or sitting down, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad naam aadhaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I take the Naam as my Suppport.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਨ ਊਚੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naa jal doo(n)gar na oochee dhaar ||
english: There is no ocean of water, no mountain ranges rising up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਹ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa tah mag na chaalanahaar ||3||
english: I dwell within the home of my own inner being, where there is no path and no one travelling on it. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬੀਜਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jit ghar vasahi toohai bidh jaanahi beejau mahal na jaapai ||
english: You alone know the way to that House in which You dwell. No one else knows the Mansion of Your Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦਬਿਆ ਛਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu samajh na hovee sabh jag dabiaa chhaapai ||
english: Without the True Guru, there is no understanding. The whole world is buried under its nightmare.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: karan palaav karai bilalaatau bin gur naam na jaapai ||
english: The mortal tries all sorts of things, and weeps and wails, but without the Guru, he does not know the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pal pa(n)kaj mahi naam chhadaae je gurasabad sinjaapai ||4||
english: In the twinkling of an eye, the Naam saves him, if he realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik moorakh a(n)dhe mugadh gavaar ||
english: Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik satigur kai bhai naam adhaar ||
english: Some, through fear of the True Guru, take the Support of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saachee baanee meethee a(n)mrit dhaar ||
english: The True Word of His Bani is sweet, the source of ambrosial nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jin peetee tis mokh duaar ||5||
english: Whoever drinks it in, finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naam bhai bhaai ridai vasaahee gur karanee sach baanee ||
english: One who, through the love and fear of God, enshrines the Naam within his heart, acts according to the Guru's Instructions and knows the True Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: i(n)d varasai dharat suhaavee ghat ghat jot samaanee ||
english: When the clouds release their rain, the earth becomes beautiful; God's Light permeates each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਰਿ ਬੀਜਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਐਸੀ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kaalar beejas duramat aisee nigure kee neesaanee ||
english: The evil-minded ones plant their seed in the barren soil; such is the sign of those who have no Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu ghor a(n)dhaaraa doob mue bin paanee ||6||
english: Without the True Guru, there is utter darkness; they drown there, even without water. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh keeno s prabhoo rajaai ||
english: Whatever God does, is by His Own Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s metanaa na jaai ||
english: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hukame baadhaa kaar kamaai ||
english: Bound to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal does his deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ek sabad raachai sach samaai ||7||
english: Permeated by the One Word of the Shabad, the mortal is immersed in Truth. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਤਾਲੰ ॥
transliteration: chahu dis hukam varatai prabh teraa chahu dis naam pataala(n) ||
english: Your Command, O God, rules in the four directions; Your Name pervades the four corners of the nether regions as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਆਲੰ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi sabad varatai prabh saachaa karam milai baiaala(n) ||
english: The True Word of the Shabad is pervading amongst all. By His Grace, the Eternal One unites us with Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਊਭੌ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n)man maranaa deesai sir oobhau khudhiaa nidraa kaala(n) ||
english: Birth and death hang over the heads of all beings, along with hunger, sleep and dying.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai man bhaavai saachee nadar rasaala(n) ||8||1||4||
english: The Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind; O True Lord, Source of bliss, please bless me with Your Grace. ||8||1||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 1 ||
english: Malaar, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: maran mukat gat saar na jaanai ||
english: You do not understand the nature of death and liberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠੇ ਬੈਠੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ka(n)the baithee gur sabad pachhaanai ||1||
english: You are sitting on the river-bank; realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕੈਸੇ ਆੜਿ ਫਾਥੀ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: too kaise aaR phaathee jaal ||
english: You stork! - how were you caught in the net?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: alakh na jaachahi ridai samhaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You do not remember in your heart the Unseen Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਜੀਆ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ek jee kai jeeaa khaahee ||
english: For your one life, you consume many lives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਤਰਤੀ ਬੂਡੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal taratee boodee jal maahee ||2||
english: You were supposed to swim in the water, but you are drowning in it instead. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਤਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sarab jee keee pratapaanee ||
english: You have tormented all beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਪਕੜੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jab pakaRee tab hee pachhutaanee ||3||
english: When Death seizes you, then you shall regret and repent. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸ ਪੜੀ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jab gal phaas paRee at bhaaree ||
english: When the heavy noose is placed around your neck,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਡਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੰਖ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ood na saakai pa(n)kh pasaaree ||4||
english: you may spread your wings, but you shall not be able to fly. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਚੂਗਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ras choogahi manamukh gaavaar ||
english: You enjoy the tastes and flavors, you foolish self-willed manmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਥੀ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: phaathee chhootahi gun giaan beechaar ||5||
english: You are trapped. You can only be saved by virtuous conduct, spiritual wisdom and contemplation. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev tootai jamakaal ||
english: Serving the True Guru, you will shatter the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hiradai saachaa sabad samhaal ||6||
english: In your heart, dwell on the True Word of the Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramat saachee sabad hai saar ||
english: The Guru's Teachings, the True Word of the Shabad, is excellent and sublime.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaar ||7||
english: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਆਗੈ ਜਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: se dukh aagai j bhog bilaase ||
english: One who is obsessed with enjoying pleasures here, shall suffer in pain hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak mukat nahee bin naavai saache ||8||2||5||
english: O Nanak, there is no liberation without the True Name. ||8||2||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ghar 1 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai taa satigur paaeeai vin karamai paaiaa na jaai ||
english: If it is in his karma, then he finds the True Guru; without such karma, He cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur miliai ka(n)chan hoeeai jaa(n) har kee hoi rajaai ||1||
english: He meets the True Guru, and he is transformed into gold, if it is the Lord's Will. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere har har naam chit laai ||
english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur te har paaeeai saachaa har siu rahai samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is found through the True Guru, and then he remains merged with the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur te giaan oopajai taa(n) ih sa(n)saa jaai ||
english: Spiritual wisdom wells up through the True Guru, and then this cynicism is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur te har bujheeai garabh jonee nah paai ||2||
english: Through the True Guru, the Lord is realized, and then, he is not consigned to the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai mar jeevai sabad kamaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal dies in life, and by so dying, lives to practice the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mukat duaaraa soee paae j vichahu aap gavaai ||3||
english: He alone finds the Door of Salvation, who eradicates self-conceit from within himself. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee siv ghar ja(n)mai vichahu sakat gavaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is reincarnated into the Home of the Lord, having eradicated Maya from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: achar charai bibek budh paae purakhai purakh milaai ||4||
english: He eats the uneatable, and is blessed with a discriminating intellect; he meets the Supreme Person, the Primal Lord God. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhaatur baajee sa(n)saar achet hai chalai mool gavaai ||
english: The world is unconscious, like a passing show; the mortal departs, having lost his capital.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: laahaa har satasa(n)gat paaeeai karamee palai paai ||5||
english: The profit of the Lord is obtained in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; by good karma, it is found. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur vin kinai na paaiaa man vekhahu ridai beechaar ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one finds it; see this in your mind, and consider this in your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur paaiaa bhavajal utare paar ||6||
english: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Guru, and crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har naamaa(n) har tek hai har har naam adhaar ||
english: The Name of the Lord is my Anchor and Support. I take only the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kripaa karahu gur melahu har jeeu paavau mokh duaar ||7||
english: O Dear Lord, please be kind and lead me to meet the Guru, that I may find the Door of Salvation. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: masatak lilaat likhiaa dhur thaakur metanaa na jaai ||
english: The pre-ordained destiny inscribed on the mortal's forehead by our Lord and Master cannot be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak se jan pooran hoe jin har bhaanaa bhaai ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings are perfect, who are pleased by the Lord's Will. ||8||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bed baanee jag varatadaa trai gun kare beechaar ||
english: The world is involved with the words of the Vedas, thinking about the three gunas - the three dispositions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai jam da(n)d sahai mar janamai vaaro vaar ||
english: Without the Name, it suffers punishment by the Messenger of Death; it comes and goes in reincarnation, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur bhete mukat hoi paae mokh duaar ||1||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, the world is liberated, and finds the Door of Salvation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re satigur sev samaai ||
english: O mortal, immerse yourself in service to the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag gur pooraa paaiaa har har naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Perfect Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har aapanai bhaanai srisat upaaee har aape dei adhaar ||
english: The Lord, by the Pleasure of His Own Will, created the Universe, and the Lord Himself gives it sustenance and support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har aapanai bhaanai man niramal keeaa har siu laagaa piaar ||
english: The Lord, by His Own Will, makes the mortal's mind immaculate, and lovingly attunes him to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai satigur bhetiaa sabh janam savaaranahaar ||2||
english: The Lord, by His Own Will, leads the mortal to meet the True Guru, the Embellisher of all his lives. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee sat hai guramukh boojhai koi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Word of His Bani. Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu kar prabh saalaaheeai tis jevad avar na koi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Praise God as Great! No one else is as Great as He.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape bakhase mel lae karam paraapat hoi ||3||
english: When God's Grace is received, He Himself forgives the mortal, and unites him with Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਾਹਰੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib maaharo satigur deeaa dikhaai ||
english: The True Guru has revealed our True, Supreme Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit varasai man sa(n)tokheeai sach rahai liv laai ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down and the mind is satisfied, remaining lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੁਕੈ ਨਾ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har kai naai sadaa hareeaavalee phir sukai naa kumalaai ||4||
english: In the Lord's Name, it is forever rejuvenated; it shall never wither and dry up again. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio man vekhahu ko pateeaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; anyone can try and see.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te satigur paaeeai bhetai sahaj subhaai ||
english: By the Lord's Grace, the True Guru is found, and then the Lord is met with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: manamukh bharam bhulaaiaa bin bhaagaa har dhan na paai ||5||
english: The self-willed manmukh is deluded by doubt; without good destiny, the Lord's wealth is not obtained. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai paR paR karahi veechaar ||
english: The three dispositions are completely distracting; people read and study and contemplate them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹੁ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mukat kade na hovaee nahu paainhi mokh duaar ||
english: Those people are never liberated; they do not find the Door of Salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੁਟਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin satigur ba(n)dhan na tutahee naam na lagai piaar ||6||
english: Without the True Guru, they are never released from bondage; they do not embrace love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਬੇਦਾਂ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thake bedaa(n) kaa abhiaas ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages, reading and studying the Vedas, have grown weary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਹ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: har naam chit na aavaee nah nij ghar hovai vaas ||
english: They do not even think of the Lord's Name; they do not dwell in the home of their own inner being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jamakaal sirahu na utarai a(n)tar kapat vinaas ||7||
english: The Messenger of Death hovers over their heads; they are ruined by the deceit within themselves. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har naavai no sabh ko parataapadaa vin bhaagaa(n) paaiaa na jaai ||
english: Everyone longs for the Name of the Lord; without good destiny, it is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare gur bheteeai har naam vasai man aai ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal meets the True Guru, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naame hee pat oopajai har siu rahaa(n) samaai ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Name, honor wells up, and the mortal remains immersed in the Lord. ||8||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: malaar mahalaa 3 asatapadee ghar 2 ||
english: Malaar, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa kare gur kee kaarai laae ||
english: When the Lord shows His Mercy, He enjoins the mortal to work for the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਲੑਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dukh palhr har naam vasaae ||
english: His pains are taken away, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachee gat saachai chit laae ||
english: True deliverance comes by focusing one's consciousness on the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee sabad sunaae ||1||
english: Listen to the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere har har sev nidhaan ||
english: O my mind, serve the Lord, Har, Har, the true treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te har dhan paaeeai anadin laagai sahaj dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. Night and day, focus your meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਂੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin pir kaaman kare sa(n)eegaar ||
english: The soul-bride who adorns herself without her Husband Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: duhachaaranee kaheeai nit hoi khuaar ||
english: is ill-mannered and vile, wasted away into ruin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kaa ihu baad aachaar ||
english: This is the useless way of life of the self-willed manmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bahu karam driRaavahi naam visaar ||2||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he performs all sorts of empty rituals. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kaaman baniaa seegaar ||
english: The bride who is Gurmukh is beautifully embellished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabade pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, she enshrines her Husband Lord within her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ek pachhaanai haumai maar ||
english: She realizes the One Lord, and subdues her ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sobhaava(n)tee kaheeai naar ||3||
english: That soul-bride is virtuous and noble. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin gur daate kinai na paaiaa ||
english: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੋਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh lobh doojai lobhaaiaa ||
english: The greedy self-willed manmukh is attracted and engrossed in duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aise giaanee boojhahu koi ||
english: Only a few spiritual teachers realize this,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin gur bhete mukat na hoi ||4||
english: that without meeting the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kahi kahi kahan kahai sabh koi ||
english: Everyone tells the stories told by others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin man mooe bhagat na hoi ||
english: Without subduing the mind, devotional worship does not come.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਕਮਲ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: giaan matee kamal paragaas ||
english: When the intellect achieves spiritual wisdom, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tit ghat naamai naam nivaas ||5||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in that heart. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai bhagat kare sabh koi ||
english: In egotism, everyone can pretend to worship God with devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naa man bheejai naa sukh hoi ||
english: But this does not soften the mind, and it does not bring peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kahi kahi kahan aap jaanaae ||
english: By speaking and preaching, the mortal only shows off his self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: birathee bhagat sabh janam gavaae ||6||
english: His devotional worship is useless, and his life is a total waste. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se bhagat satigur man bhaae ||
english: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam rahe liv laae ||
english: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sad hee naam vekhahi hajoor ||
english: They behold the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ever-present, near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||7||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase dei piaar ||
english: God Himself forgives, and bestows His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog vadaa sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is suffering from the terrible disease of egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te ehu rog jaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, this disease is cured.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak saache saach samaai ||8||1||3||5||8||
english: O Nanak, through the Truth, the mortal remains immersed in the True Lord. ||8||1||3||5||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Malaar, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: preetam prem bhagat ke daate ||
english: My Beloved Lord is the Giver of loving devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: apane jan sa(n)g raate ||
english: His humble servants are imbued with His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jan sa(n)g raate dinas raate ik nimakh manahu na veesarai ||
english: He is imbued with His servants, day and night; He does not forget them from His Mind, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gopaal gun nidh sadaa sa(n)ge sarab gun jagadeesarai ||
english: He is the Lord of the World, the Treasure of virtue; He is always with me. All glorious virtues belong to the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: man mohi leenaa charan sa(n)ge naam ras jan maate ||
english: With His Feet, He has fascinated my mind; as His humble servant, I am intoxicated with love for His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸਦਹੂੰ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak preetam kripaal sadahoo(n) kinai kot madhe jaate ||1||
english: O Nanak, my Beloved is forever Merciful; out of millions, hardly anyone realizes Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: preetam teree gat agam apaare ||
english: O Beloved, Your state is inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa patit tumh taare ||
english: You save even the worst sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan bhagat vachhal kripaa si(n)dh suaameeaa ||
english: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Ocean of mercy, our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਰਂਉ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)ge bhaj nisa(n)ge ra(n)u sadaa a(n)tarajaameeaa ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, vibrate and meditate on Him with commitment forever; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot janam bhrama(n)t jonee te naam simarat taare ||
english: Those who wander in reincarnation through millions of births, are saved and carried across, by meditating in remembrance on the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak daras piaas har jeeu aap lehu samhaare ||2||
english: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Dear Lord; please take care of him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har charan kamal man leenaa ||
english: My mind is absorbed in the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jal jan tere meenaa ||
english: O God, You are the water; Your humble servants are fish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੈ ਭਿੰਨ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jal meen prabh jeeu ek toohai bhi(n)n aan na jaaneeai ||
english: O Dear God, You alone are the water and the fish. I know that there is no difference between the two.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa levahu naam devahu tau prasaadee maaneeai ||
english: Please take hold of my arm and bless me with Your Name. I am honored only by Your Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਰੰਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaj saadhasa(n)ge ek ra(n)ge kripaal gobid deenaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate with love on the One Lord of the Universe, who is Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨੀਚ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anaath neech saranaai naanak kar maiaa apunaa keenaa ||3||
english: Nanak, the lowly and helpless, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, who in His Kindness has made him His Own. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau aap milaaiaa ||
english: He unites us with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhram bha(n)jan har raaiaa ||
english: Our Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਚਰਜ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aacharaj suaamee a(n)tarajaamee mile gun nidh piaariaa ||
english: My Wondrous Lord and Master is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. My Beloved, the Treasure of virtue, has met me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ma(n)gal sookh upaje gobi(n)d gun nit saariaa ||
english: Supreme happiness and peace well up, as I cherish the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)g sohe dekh mohe purab likhiaa paaiaa ||
english: Meeting with Him, I am embellished and exalted; gazing on Him, I am fascinated, and I realize my pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran tin kee jinhee har har dhiaaiaa ||4||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਮਲਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਰਾਣੇ ਕੈਲਾਸ ਤਥਾ ਮਾਲਦੇ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ॥
transliteration: vaar malaar kee mahalaa 1 raane kailaas tathaa maalade kee dhun ||
english: Vaar Of Malaar, First Mehl, Sung To The Tune Of Rana Kailaash And Malda:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਵੁਠੈ ਧਰਣਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai man rahaseeai jiu vuthai dharan seegaar ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is delighted, like the earth embellished by the rain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦਿਸੈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਸਰ ਭਰੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sabh disai hareeaavalee sar bhare subhar taal ||
english: Everything becomes green and lush; the pools and ponds are filled to overflowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਿਉ ਮੰਜੀਠੈ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar rachai sach ra(n)g jiu ma(n)jeethai laal ||
english: The inner self is imbued with the deep crimson color of love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kamal vigasai sach man gur kai sabad nihaal ||
english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth and the mind becomes true; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is ecstatic and exalted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh doojee taraph hai vekhahu nadar nihaal ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is on the wrong side. You can see this with your own eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: phaahee phaathe mirag jiu sir deesai jamakaal ||
english: He is caught in the trap like the deer; the Messenger of Death hovers over his head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਕਰਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: khudhiaa trisanaa ni(n)daa buree kaam krodh vikaraal ||
english: Hunger, thirst and slander are evil; sexual desire and anger are horrible.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਅਖੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: enee akhee nadar na aavaee jichar sabad na kare beechaar ||
english: These cannot be seen with your eyes, until you contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai sa(n)tokheeaa(n) chookai aal ja(n)jaal ||
english: Whoever is pleasing to You is content; all his entanglements are gone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ॥
transliteration: mool rahai gur seviai gur pauRee bohith ||
english: Serving the Guru, his capital is preserved. The Guru is the ladder and the boat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak lagee tat lai too(n) sachaa man sach ||1||
english: O Nanak, whoever is attached to the Lord receives the essence; O True Lord, You are found when the mind is true. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੇਕੋ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹੇਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: heko paadhar hek dar gur pauRee nij thaan ||
english: There is one path and one door. The Guru is the ladder to reach one's own place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rooRau thaakur naanakaa sabh sukh saachau naam ||2||
english: Our Lord and Master is so beautiful, O Nanak; all comfort and peace are in the Name of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aapeenhai aap saaj aap pachhaaniaa ||
english: He Himself created Himself; He Himself understands Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ਚੰਦੋਆ ਤਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bar dharat vichhoR cha(n)doaa taaniaa ||
english: Separating the sky and the earth, He has spread out His canopy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮੑਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: vin tha(n)mhaa gagan rahaai sabad neesaaniaa ||
english: Without any pillars, He supports the sky, through the insignia of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sooraj cha(n)d upaai jot samaaniaa ||
english: Creating the sun and the moon, He infused His Light into them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਏ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: keee raat dina(n)t choj vidaaniaa ||
english: He created the night and the day; Wondrous are His miraculous plays.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਨਾਵਣ ਪੁਰਬਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: teerath dharam veechaar naavan purabaaniaa ||
english: He created the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where people contemplate righteousness and Dharma, and take cleansing baths on special occasions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh sar avar na koi k aakh vakhaaniaa ||
english: There is no other equal to You; how can we speak and describe You?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੋਰ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachai takhat nivaas hor aavan jaaniaa ||1||
english: You are seated on the throne of Truth; all others come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak saavan je vasai chahu omaahaa hoi ||
english: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four are delighted:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਗਾਂ ਮਿਰਗਾਂ ਮਛੀਆਂ ਰਸੀਆਂ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naagaa(n) miragaa(n) machheeaa(n) raseeaa(n) ghar dhan hoi ||1||
english: the snake, the deer, the fish and the wealthy people who seek pleasure. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak saavan je vasai chahu vechhoRaa hoi ||
english: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four suffer the pains of separation:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਈ ਪੁਤਾ ਨਿਰਧਨਾ ਪੰਥੀ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gaaee putaa niradhanaa pa(n)thee chaakar hoi ||2||
english: the cow's calves, the poor, the travellers and the servants. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too sachaa sachiaar jin sach varataaiaa ||
english: You are True, O True Lord; You dispense True Justice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਕਵਲੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baithaa taaRee laai kaval chhapaaiaa ||
english: Like a lotus, You sit in the primal celestial trance; You are hidden from view.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamai vadaa kahaai a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Brahma is called great, but even he does not know Your limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa tis baap na maai kin too jaaiaa ||
english: You have no father or mother; who gave birth to You?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਵਰਨ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa tis roop na rekh varan sabaaiaa ||
english: You have no form or feature; You transcend all social classes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੁਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa tis bhukh piaas rajaa dhaaiaa ||
english: You have no hunger or thirst; You are satisfied and satiated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਮੋਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur mahi aap samoi sabad varataaiaa ||
english: You have merged Yourself into the Guru; You are pervading through the Word of Your Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sache hee pateeaai sach samaaiaa ||2||
english: When he is pleasing to the True Lord, the mortal merges in Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੈਦੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਵੈਦਗੀ ਪਕੜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ਬਾਂਹ ॥
transliteration: vaid bulaaiaa vaidagee pakaR dha(n)dhole baa(n)h ||
english: The physician was called in; he touched my arm and felt my pulse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਰਕ ਕਲੇਜੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bholaa vaid na jaanaee karak kaleje maahi ||1||
english: The foolish physician did not know that the pain was in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੈਦਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਵੈਦੁ ਤੂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: vaidaa vaid suvaid too pahilaa(n) rog pachhaan ||
english: O physician, you are a competent physician, if you first diagnose the disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: aisaa daaroo loR lahu jit va(n)njai rogaa ghaan ||
english: Prescribe such a remedy, by which all sorts of illnesses may be cured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਰੋਗ ਉਠਿਅਹਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jit daaroo rog uthiahi tan sukh vasai aai ||
english: Administer that medicine, which will cure the disease, and allow peace to come and dwell in the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੈਦੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rog gavaaihi aapanaa ta naanak vaid sadaai ||2||
english: Only when you are rid of your own disease, O Nanak, will you be known as a physician. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes dev upaaiaa ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the deities were created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahame dite bed poojaa laaiaa ||
english: Brahma was given the Vedas, and enjoined to worship God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: das avataaree raam raajaa aaiaa ||
english: The ten incarnations, and Rama the king, came into being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੈਤਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਧਾਇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: daitaa maare dhaai hukam sabaaiaa ||
english: According to His Will, they quickly killed all the demons.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਈਸ ਮਹੇਸੁਰੁ ਸੇਵ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ees mahesur sev tinhee a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Shiva serves Him, but cannot find His limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachee keemat paai takhat rachaaiaa ||
english: He established His throne on the principles of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ਆਪੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa dha(n)dhai laai aap chhapaaiaa ||
english: He enjoined all the world to its tasks, while He keeps Himself hidden from view.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਮ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dharam karaae karam dhurahu phuramaaiaa ||3||
english: The Primal Lord has ordained that mortals must practice righteousness. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saavan aaiaa he sakhee ka(n)tai chit karehu ||
english: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; think of your Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jhoor marahi dohaaganee jinh avaree laagaa nehu ||1||
english: O Nanak, the discarded bride is in love with another; now she weeps and wails, and dies. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਬਰਸਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saavan aaiaa he sakhee jalahar barasanahaar ||
english: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; the clouds have burst forth with rain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sukh savan sohaaganee jinh sah naal piaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the blessed soul-brides sleep in peace; they are in love with their Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਛਿੰਝ ਪਵਾਇ ਮਲਾਖਾੜਾ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape chhi(n)jh pavaai malaakhaaRaa rachiaa ||
english: He Himself has staged the tournament, and arranged the arena for the wrestlers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਥੇ ਭੜਥੂ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਚਿਆ ॥
transliteration: lathe bhaRathoo paai guramukh machiaa ||
english: They have entered the arena with pomp and ceremony; the Gurmukhs are joyful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਰੇ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਚਿਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maare pachhaaR moorakh kachiaa ||
english: The false and foolish self-willed manmukhs are defeated and overcome.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭਿੜੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aap bhiRai maare aap aap kaaraj rachiaa ||
english: The Lord Himself wrestles, and He Himself defeats them. He Himself staged this play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa khasam ek hai guramukh jaaneeai ||
english: The One God is the Lord and Master of all; this is known by the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukamee likhai sir lekh vin kalam masavaaneeai ||
english: He writes the inscription of His Hukam on the foreheads of all, without pen or ink.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat melaap jithai har gun sadaa vakhaaneeai ||
english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, Union with Him is obtained; there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are chanted forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa sabad salaahi sach pachhaaneeai ||4||
english: O Nanak, praising the True Word of His Shabad, one comes to realize the Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰੇਂਦਾ ਵੰਨ ॥
transliteration: oo(n)nav oo(n)nav aaiaa avar kare(n)daa va(n)n ||
english: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds are changing color.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਸੀ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanaa tis saah siu kev rahasee ra(n)g ||
english: How do I know whether my love for my Husband Lord shall endure?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rahiaa tinh kaamanee jinh man bhau bhaau hoi ||
english: The love of those soul-brides endures, if their minds are filled with the Love and the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhai bhaai baaharee tin tan sukh na hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, she who has no Love and Fear of God - her body shall never find peace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਪੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: oo(n)nav oo(n)nav aaiaa varasai neer nipa(n)g ||
english: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and pure water rains down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੰਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dukh laagaa tinh kaamanee jinh ka(n)tai siu man bha(n)g ||2||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride suffers in pain, whose mind is torn away from her Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dovai taraphaa upaai ik varatiaa ||
english: The One Lord created both sides and pervades the expanse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bed baanee varataai a(n)dar vaad ghatiaa ||
english: The words of the Vedas became pervasive, with arguments and divisions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰੈਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paravirat niravirat haathaa dovai vich dharam phirai raibaariaa ||
english: Attachment and detachment are the two sides of it; Dharma, true religion, is the guide between the two.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kache kooRiaar tinhee nihachau daragah haariaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are worthless and false. Without a doubt, they lose in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramatee sabad soor hai kaam krodh jinhee maariaa ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are the true spiritual warriors; they have conquered sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachai a(n)dar mahal sabad savaariaa ||
english: They enter into the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, embellished and exalted by the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: se bhagat tudh bhaavade sachai naai piaariaa ||
english: Those devotees are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord; they dearly love the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa tinhaa vitahu hau vaariaa ||5||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਲਾਇ ਝੜੀ ॥
transliteration: oo(n)nav oo(n)nav aaiaa varasai laai jhaRee ||
english: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and water rains down in torrents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhaanai chalai ka(n)t kai s maane sadaa ralee ||1||
english: O Nanak, she walks in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord; she enjoys peace and pleasure forever. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬਪੁੜੇਂ ਇਸੁ ਮੇਘੈ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa uth uth dekhahu bapuRe(n) is meghai hath kichh naahi ||
english: Why are you standing up, standing up to look? You poor wretch, this cloud has nothing in its hands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin ehu megh pathaaiaa tis raakhahu man maa(n)hi ||
english: The One who sent this cloud - cherish Him in your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: tis no ma(n)n vasaaisee jaa kau nadar karei ||
english: He alone enshrines the Lord in his mind, upon whom the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree baaharee sabh karan palaah karei ||2||
english: O Nanak, all those who lack this Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: so har sadaa sareveeai jis karat na laagai vaar ||
english: Serve the Lord forever; He acts in no time at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aadaane aakaas kar khin mahi dhaahi usaaranahaar ||
english: He stretched the sky across the heavens; in an instant, He creates and destroys.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aape jagat upaai kai kudarat kare veechaar ||
english: He Himself created the world; He contemplates His Creative Omnipotence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh agai lekhaa ma(n)geeai bahutee hovai maar ||
english: The self-willed manmukh will be called to account hereafter; he will be severely punished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: guramukh pat siu lekhaa nibaRai bakhase siphat bha(n)daar ||
english: The Gurmukh's account is settled with honor; the Lord blesses him with the treasure of His Praise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: othai hath na apaRai kook na suneeai pukaar ||
english: No one's hands can reach there; no one will hear anyone's cries.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: othai satigur belee hovai kadh lae a(n)tee vaar ||
english: The True Guru will be your best friend there; at the very last instant, He will save you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: enaa ja(n)taa no hor sevaa nahee satigur sir karataar ||6||
english: These beings should serve no other than the True Guru or the Creator Lord above the heads of all. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪੂਕਾਰਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa jis no too pookaaradaa tis no lochai sabh koi ||
english: O rainbird, the One unto whom you call - everyone longs for that Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਸੀ ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: apanee kirapaa kar kai vasasee van trin hariaa hoi ||
english: When He grants His Grace, it rains, and the forests and fields blossom forth in their greenery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai viralaa boojhai koi ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is found; only a rare few understand this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahadiaa uthadiaa nit dhiaaeeai sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: Sitting down and standing up, meditate continually on Him, and be at peace forever and ever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)mrit sad hee varasadaa guramukh devai har soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down forever; the Lord gives it to the Gurmukh. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਮਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kalamal hoee medanee aradaas kare liv laai ||
english: When the people of the world are suffering in pain, they call upon the Lord in loving prayer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਕੰਨੁ ਦੇ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachai suniaa ka(n)n de dheerak devai sahaj subhaai ||
english: The True Lord naturally listens and hears and gives comfort.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: i(n)drai no phuramaaiaa vuthaa chhahabar laai ||
english: He commands the god of rain, and the rain pours down in torrents.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: an dhan upajai bahu ghanaa keemat kahan na jaai ||
english: Corn and wealth are produced in great abundance and prosperity; their value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too sabhanaa jeeaa dedaa rijak sa(n)baahi ||
english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jit khaadhai sukh oopajai phir dookh na laagai aai ||2||
english: Eating this, peace is produced, and the mortal never again suffers in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੇ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sachaa sach too sache laihi milaai ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. You blend those who are truthful into Your Own Being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai doojee taraph hai kooR milai na miliaa jaai ||
english: Those caught in duality are on the side of duality; entrenched in falsehood, they cannot merge into the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਐ ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape joR vichhoRiai aape kudarat dei dikhaai ||
english: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; You display Your Creative Omnipotence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mohu sog vijog hai poorab likhiaa kamaai ||
english: Attachment brings the sorrow of separation; the mortal acts in accordance with pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jo har charanee rahai liv laai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who remain lovingly attached to the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu jal mahi kamal alipat hai aisee banat banaai ||
english: They are like the lotus which remains detached, floating upon the water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se sukheee sadaa sohane jinh vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: They are peaceful and beautiful forever; they eradicate self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tinh sog vijog kade nahee jo har kai a(n)k samaai ||7||
english: They never suffer sorrow or separation; they are merged in the Being of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai jis vas sabh kichh hoi ||
english: O Nanak, praise the Lord; everything is in His power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਿਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tisai sarevihu praaneeho tis bin avar na koi ||
english: Serve Him, O mortal beings; there is none other than Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har prabh man vasai taa(n) sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: The Lord God abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, and then he is at peace, forever and ever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa mool na hovaee sabh chi(n)taa vichahu jaai ||
english: He is never cynical; all anxiety has been taken out from within him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh hoi s sahaje hoi kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
english: Whatever happens, happens naturally; no one has any say about it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib man vasai taa(n) man chi(n)diaa phal paai ||
english: When the True Lord abides in the mind, then the mind's desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin kaa aakhiaa aap sune j laian pa(n)nai paai ||1||
english: O Nanak, He Himself hears the words of those, whose accounts are in His Hands. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sadaa varasadaa boojhan boojhanahaar ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down continually; realize this through realization.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jinhee bujhiaa har a(n)mrit rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: Those who, as Gurmukh, realize this, keep the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar enshrined within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit peevahi sadaa ra(n)g raate haumai trisanaa maar ||
english: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and remain forever imbued with the Lord; they conquer egotism and thirsty desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai varasai kirapaa dhaar ||
english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; the Lord showers His Grace, and it rains down.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh nadaree aaiaa har aatam raam muraar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh comes to behold the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: atul kiu toleeai vin tole paaiaa na jaai ||
english: How can the unweighable be weighed? Without weighing Him, He cannot be obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad veechaareeai gun mahi rahai samaai ||
english: Reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and immerse yourself in His Glorious Virtues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: apanaa aap aap tolasee aape milai milaai ||
english: He Himself weighs Himself; He unites in Union with Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee keemat naa pavai kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
english: His value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਦਿਤੀ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree gur aapane jin sachee boojh ditee bujhaai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; He has made me realize this true realization.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jagat musai a(n)mrit luteeai manamukh boojh na paai ||
english: The world has been deceived, and the Ambrosial Nectar is being plundered. The self-willed manmukh does not realize this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai naal na chalasee jaasee janam gavaai ||
english: Without the Name, nothing will go along with him; he wastes his life, and departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਦੂਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: guramatee jaage tinhee ghar rakhiaa dootaa kaa kichh na vasaai ||8||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and remain awake and aware, preserve and protect the home of their heart; demons have no power against them. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
