gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਨਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਇ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa naa bilalaai naa tarasaai ehu man khasam kaa hukam ma(n)n ||
english: O rainbird, do not cry out. Do not let this mind of yours be so thirsty for a drop of water. Obey the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਲਿ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hukam ma(n)niai tikh utarai chaRai chavagal va(n)n ||1||
english: and your thirst shall be quenched. Your love for Him shall increase four-fold. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa jal mahi teraa vaas hai jal hee maahi phiraahi ||
english: O rainbird, your place is in the water; you move around in the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਕੂਕਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jal kee saar na jaanahee taa(n) too(n) kookan paahi ||
english: But you do not appreciate the water, and so you cry out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jal thal chahu dis varasadaa khaalee ko thaau naahi ||
english: In the water and on the land, it rains down in the ten directions. No place is left dry.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੈ ਜਲਿ ਵਰਸਦੈ ਤਿਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: etai jal varasadai tikh marahi bhaag tinaa ke naahi ||
english: With so much rain, those who are die of thirst are very unfortunate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh tin sojhee paee jin vasiaa man maahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs understand; the Lord abides within their minds. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਥ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naath jatee sidh peer kinai a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: The Yogic Masters, celibates, Siddhas and spiritual teachers - none of them has found the limits of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaai tujhai samaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and merge in You, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jug chhateeh gubaar tis hee bhaaiaa ||
english: For thirty-six ages, God remained in utter darkness, as He pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਾ ਬਿੰਬੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jalaa bi(n)b asaraal tinai varataaiaa ||
english: The vast expanse of water swirled around.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਲੁ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਸਰਜੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: neel aneel aga(n)m sarajeet sabaaiaa ||
english: The Creator of all is Infinite, Endless and Inaccessible.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵਾਦੁ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agan upaaee vaad bhukh tihaaiaa ||
english: He formed fire and conflict, hunger and thirst.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa kai sir kaal doojaa bhaaiaa ||
english: Death hangs over the heads of the people of the world, in the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਖੈ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: rakhai rakhanahaar jin sabad bujhaaiaa ||9||
english: The Savior Lord saves those who realize the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਵਰਸੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu jal sabh tai varasadaa varasai bhaai subhaai ||
english: This rain pours down on all; it rains down in accordance with God's Loving Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se birakhaa hareeaavale jo guramukh rahe samaai ||
english: Those trees become green and lush, which remain immersed in the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree sukh hoi enaa ja(n)taa kaa dukh jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, there is peace; the pain of these creatures is gone. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਮਕਿਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhi(n)nee rain chamakiaa vuthaa chhahabar laai ||
english: The night is wet with dew; lightning flashes, and the rain pours down in torrents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੈ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jit vuthai an dhan bahut oopajai jaa(n) sahu kare rajaai ||
english: Food and wealth are produced in abundance when it rains, if it is the Will of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਜੀਆਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jit khaadhai man tripateeai jeeaa(n) jugat samaai ||
english: Consuming it, the minds of His creatures are satisfied, and they adopt the lifestyle of the way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਦੇ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu dhan karate kaa khel hai kade aavai kade jaai ||
english: This wealth is the play of the Creator Lord. Sometimes it comes, and sometimes it goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sad hee rahai samaai ||
english: The Naam is the wealth of the spiritually wise. It is permeating and pervading forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jin kau nadar kare taa(n) ihu dhan palai paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace receive this wealth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siu karee pukaar ||
english: He Himself does, and causes all to be done. Unto whom can I complain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aape lekhaa ma(n)gasee aap karaae kaar ||
english: He Himself calls the mortal beings to account; He Himself causes them to act.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai hukam kare gaavaar ||
english: Whatever pleases Him happens. Only a fool issues commands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap chhadaae chhuteeai aape bakhasanahaar ||
english: He Himself saves and redeems; He Himself is the Forgiver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape vekhai sune aap sabhasai de aadhaar ||
english: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; He gives His Support to all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ek varatadaa sir sir kare beechaar ||
english: He alone is pervading and permeating all; He considers each and every one.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aap veechaareeai lagai sach piaar ||
english: The Gurmukh reflects on the self, lovingly attached to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak kis no aakheeai aape devanahaar ||10||
english: O Nanak, whom can we ask? He Himself is the Great Giver. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa ehu jagat hai mat ko bharam bhulaai ||
english: This world is a rainbird; let no one be deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਬਾਬੀਂਹਾ ਪਸੂ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu baabee(n)haa pasoo hai is no boojhan naahi ||
english: This rainbird is an animal; it has no understanding at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai jit peetai tikh jaai ||
english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh jinh peeaa tinh bahuR na laagee aai ||1||
english: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who drink it in shall never again be afflicted by thirst. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: malaar seetal raag hai har dhiaaiai saa(n)t hoi ||
english: Malaar is a calming and soothing raga; meditating on the Lord brings peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu apanee kripaa kare taa(n) varatai sabh loi ||
english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then the rain falls on all the people of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੈ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਧਰਣੀ ਨੋ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vuthai jeeaa jugat hoi dharanee no seegaar hoi ||
english: From this rain, all creatures find the ways and means to live, and the earth is embellished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak ihu jagat sabh jal hai jal hee te sabh koi ||
english: O Nanak, this world is all water; everything came from water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ko viralaa boojhai so jan mukat sadaa hoi ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few realize the Lord; such humble beings are liberated forever. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sachaa veparavaahu iko too dhanee ||
english: O True and Independent Lord God, You alone are my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
transliteration: too sabh kichh aape aap dooje kis ganee ||
english: You Yourself are everything; who else is of any account?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਕੂੜਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਣੀ ॥
transliteration: maanas kooRaa garab sachee tudh manee ||
english: False is the pride of man. True is Your glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun rachaai upaaee medanee ||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation, the beings and species of the world came into being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve aapanaa aaiaa tis ganee ||
english: But if the mortal serves his True Guru, his coming into the world is judged to be worthwhile.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਕੇਹੀ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀ ॥
transliteration: je haumai vichahu jaai ta kehee ganat ganee ||
english: And if he eradicates eogtism from within himself, then how can he be judged?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਭੁਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mohi gubaar jiu bhulaa ma(n)jh vanee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is lost in the darkness of emotional attachment, like the man lost in the wilderness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਕਣੀ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kate paap asa(n)kh naavai ik kanee ||11||
english: Countless sins are erased, by even a tiny particle of the Lord's Name. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa khasamai kaa mahal na jaanahee mahal dekh aradaas paai ||
english: O rainbird, you do not know the Mansion of your Lord and Master's Presence. Offer your prayers to see this Mansion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aapanai bhaanai bahutaa bolahi boliaa thaai na paai ||
english: You speak as you please, but your speech is not accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khasam vadaa daataar hai jo ichhe so phal paai ||
english: Your Lord and Master is the Great Giver; whatever you desire, you shall receive from Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਗਤੈ ਕੀ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baabeehaa kiaa bapuRaa jagatai kee tikh jaai ||1||
english: Not only the thirst of the poor rainbird, but the thirst of the whole world is quenched. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa bhi(n)nee rain boliaa sahaje sach subhaai ||
english: The night is wet with dew; the rainbird sings the True Name with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu jal meraa jeeu hai jal bin rahan na jaai ||
english: This water is my very soul; without water, I cannot survive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee jal paaeeai vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this water is obtained, and egotism is eradicated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jis bin chasaa na jeevadee so satigur deeaa milaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, I cannot live without Him, even for a moment; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d pataal asa(n)kh mai ganat na hoee ||
english: There are countless worlds and nether regions; I cannot calculate their number.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too karataa govi(n)d tudh sirajee tudhai goee ||
english: You are the Creator, the Lord of the Universe; You create it, and You destroy it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh medanee tujh hee te hoee ||
english: The 8.4 million species of beings issued forth from You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ik raaje khaan malook kahahi kahaavahi koee ||
english: Some are called kings, emperors and nobles.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਾਹ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ik saah sadaavahi sa(n)ch dhan doojai pat khoee ||
english: Some claim to be bankers and accumulate wealth, but in duality they lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ik daate ik ma(n)gate sabhanaa sir soee ||
english: Some are givers, and some are beggars; God is above the heads of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀਆ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai baajaareeaa bheehaaval hoee ||
english: Without the Name, they are vulgar, dreadful and wretched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kooR nikhute naanakaa sach kare s hoee ||12||
english: Falsehood shall not last, O Nanak; whatever the True Lord does, comes to pass. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa gunava(n)tee mahal paaiaa auganava(n)tee door ||
english: O rainbird, the virtuous soul-bride attains the Mansion of her Lord's Presence; the unworthy, unvirtuous one is far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar terai har vasai guramukh sadaa hajoor ||
english: Deep within your inner being, the Lord abides. The Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kook pukaar na hovaee nadaree nadar nihaal ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal no longer weeps and wails.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sahaje mile sabad guroo kai ghaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam intuitively merge with the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa benatee kare kar kirapaa dehu jee daan ||
english: The rainbird prays: O Lord, grant Your Grace, and bless me with the gift of the life of the soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਊਤਰੈ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jal bin piaas na ootarai chhutak jaa(n)hi mere praan ||
english: Without the water, my thirst is not quenched, and my breath of life is ended and gone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨੇਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: too sukhadaataa bea(n)t hai gunadaataa nedhaan ||
english: You are the Giver of peace, O Infinite Lord God; You are the Giver of the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh bakhas lae a(n)t belee hoi bhagavaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is forgiven; in the end, the Lord God shall be your only friend. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape jagat upaai kai gun augan kare beechaar ||
english: He created the world; He considers the merits and demerits of the mortals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: trai gun sarab ja(n)jaal hai naam na dhare piaar ||
english: Those who are entangled in the three gunas - the three dispositions - do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gun chhod augan kamaavade daragah hohi khuaar ||
english: Forsaking virtue, they practice evil; they shall be miserable in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jooai janam tinee haariaa kit aae sa(n)saar ||
english: They lose their life in the gamble; why did they even come into the world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad man maariaa ahinis naam piaar ||
english: But those who conquer and subdue their minds, through the True Word of the Shabad - night and day, they love the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jinee purakhee ur dhaariaa sachaa alakh apaar ||
english: Those people enshrine the True, Invisible and Infinite Lord in their hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਹਿ ਅਸੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: too gunadaataa nidhaan hahi asee avaganiaar ||
english: You, O Lord, are the Giver, the Treasure of virtue; I am unvirtuous and unworthy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jis bakhase so paaisee gurasabadee veechaar ||13||
english: He alone finds You, whom You bless and forgive, and inspire to contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਕਤਾਂ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raat na vihaavee saakataa(n) jinhaa visarai naau ||
english: The faithless cynics forget the Name of the Lord; the night of their lives does not pass in peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raatee dinas suheleeaa naanak har gun gaa(n)u ||1||
english: Their days and nights become comfortable, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਹਭੇ ਮਣੀ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ratan javehar maanakaa habhe manee matha(n)n ||
english: All sorts of jewels and gems, diamonds and rubies, shine forth from their foreheads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa sachai dar soha(n)n ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa satigur sev sach samhaaliaa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, I dwell on the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਖਲੋਆ ਆਇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t khaloaa aai j satigur agai ghaaliaa ||
english: The work you have done for the True Guru shall be very useful in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pohi na sakai jamakaal sachaa rakhavaaliaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that person who is protected by the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur saakhee jot jagaai deevaa baaliaa ||
english: Lighting the lamp of the Guru's Teachings, my awareness has been awakened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh vin naavai kooRiaar phirahi betaaliaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are false; without the Name, they wander around like demons.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਚੰਮਿ ਪਲੇਟੇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pasoo maanas cha(n)m palete a(n)darahu kaaliaa ||
english: They are nothing more than beasts, wrapped up in human skin; they are black-hearted within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabho varatai sach sachai sabad nihaaliaa ||
english: The True Lord is pervading all; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is seen.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan hai poorai gur dekhaaliaa ||14||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. The Perfect Guru has revealed it to me. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehai hukam pachhaaniaa gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: The rainbird realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command with intuitive ease through the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: megh varasai daiaa kar gooRee chhahabar laai ||
english: The clouds mercifully burst forth, and the rain pours down in torrents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹੇ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਰਹਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehe kook pukaar rahi gaee sukh vasiaa man aai ||
english: The cries and wailings of the rainbird have ceased, and peace has come to abide in its mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai j de(n)daa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa rijak samaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, praise that Lord, who reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings and creatures. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaatrik too na jaanahee kiaa tudh vich tikhaa hai kit peetai tikh jaai ||
english: O rainbird, you do not know what thirst is within you, or what you can drink to quench it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bhara(n)miaa a(n)mrit jal palai na paai ||
english: You wander in the love of duality, and you do not obtain the Ambrosial Water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare je aapanee taa(n) satigur milai subhaai ||
english: When God casts His Glance of Grace, then the mortal automatically meets the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur te a(n)mrit jal paaiaa sahaje rahiaa samaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Water is obtained from the True Guru, and then the mortal remains merged in the Lord with intuitive ease. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ik van kha(n)d baisahi jaai sad na devahee ||
english: Some go and sit in the forest realms, and do not answer any calls.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੇਂਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ik paalaa kakar bha(n)n seetal jal he(n)vahee ||
english: Some, in the dead of winter, break the ice and immerse themselves in freezing water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਸਮ ਚੜੑਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ik bhasam chaRhaavahi a(n)g mail na dhovahee ||
english: Some rub ashes on their bodies, and never wash off their dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਕੁਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ik jataa bikat bikaraal kul ghar khovahee ||
english: Some look hideous, with their uncut hair matted and dishevelled. They bring dishonor to their family and ancestry.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ik nagan phirahi din raat na(n)eed na sovahee ||
english: Some wander naked day and night and never sleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਗੋਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ik agan jalaavahi a(n)g aap vigovahee ||
english: Some burn their limbs in fire, damaging and ruining themselves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai tan chhaar kiaa kahi rovahee ||
english: Without the Name, the body is reduced to ashes; what good is it to speak and cry then?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੀ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sohan khasam duaar j satigur sevahee ||15||
english: Those who serve the True Guru, are embellished and exalted in the Court of their Lord and Master. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa a(n)mrit velai boliaa taa(n) dar sunee pukaar ||
english: The rainbird chirps in the ambrosial hours of the morning before the dawn; its prayers are heard in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਸਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: meghai no phuramaan hoaa varasahu kirapaa dhaar ||
english: The order is issued to the clouds, to let the rains of mercy shower down.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinee sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who enshrine the True Lord within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naame sabh hareeaavalee gur kai sabad veechaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, through the Name, all are rejuvenated, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਇਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa iv teree tikhaa na utarai je sau karahi pukaar ||
english: O rainbird, this is not the way to quench your thirst, even though you may cry out a hundred times.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nadaree satigur paaeeai nadaree upajai piaar ||
english: By God's Grace, the True Guru is found; by His Grace, love wells up.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai vichahu jaahi vikaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, when the Lord and Master abides in the mind, corruption and evil leave from within. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜੈਨੀ ਉਝੜ ਪਾਇ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik jainee ujhaR paai dhurahu khuaaiaa ||
english: Some are Jains, wasting their time in the wilderness; by their pre-ordained destiny, they are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨੑਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin mukh naahee naam na teerath nhaaiaa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not on their lips; they do not bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਥੀ ਸਿਰ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਨ ਭਦੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hathee sir khohaai na bhad karaaiaa ||
english: They pull out their hair with their hands, instead of shaving.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kuchil rahahi din raat sabad na bhaaiaa ||
english: They remain unclean day and night; they do not love the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin jaat na pat na karam janam gavaaiaa ||
english: They have no status, no honor, and no good karma. They waste away their lives in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man joothai vejaat joothaa khaaiaa ||
english: Their minds are false and impure; that which they eat is impure and defiled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai aachaar na kin hee paaiaa ||
english: Without the Shabad, no one achieves a lifestyle of good conduct.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: guramukh oa(n)kaar sach samaaiaa ||16||
english: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord God, the Universal Creator. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saavan sarasee kaamanee gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: In the month of Saawan, the bride is happy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sadaa suhaaganee gur kai het apaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever; her love for the Guru is unlimited. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਦਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saavan dajhai gun baaharee jis doojai bhaai piaar ||
english: In Saawan, she who has no virtue is burned, in attachment and love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak pir kee saar na jaanaee sabh seegaar khuaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, she does not appreciate the value of her Husband Lord; all her decorations are worthless. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa alakh abheu hath na pateejaee ||
english: The True, Unseen, Mysterious Lord is not won over by stubbornness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀਆ ਰਾਗਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: ik gaavahi raag pareeaa raag na bheejaee ||
english: Some sing according to traditional ragas, but the Lord is not pleased by these ragas.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: ik nach nach poorahi taal bhagat na keejaee ||
english: Some dance and dance and keep the beat, but they do not worship Him with devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: ik a(n)n na khaahi moorakh tinaa kiaa keejaee ||
english: Some refuse to eat; what can be done with these fools?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਧੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa hoee bahut kivai na dheejaee ||
english: Thirst and desire have greatly increased; nothing brings satisfaction.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਵਧਹਿ ਕੈ ਲੋਅ ਖਪਿ ਮਰੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: karam vadhahi kai lo khap mareejaee ||
english: Some are tied down by rituals; they hassle themselves to death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: laahaa naam sa(n)saar a(n)mrit peejaee ||
english: In this world, profit comes by drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘੀਜਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: har bhagatee asanehi guramukh gheejaee ||17||
english: The Gurmukhs gather in loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਲਾਰ ਰਾਗੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh malaar raag jo karahi tin man tan seetal hoi ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who sing in the Raga of Malaar - their minds and bodies become cool and calm.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee ek pachhaaniaa eko sachaa soi ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they realize the One, the One True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan sachaa sach man sache sachee soi ||
english: Their minds and bodies are true; they obey the True Lord, and they are known as true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar sachee bhagat hai sahaje hee pat hoi ||
english: True devotional worship is deep within them; they are automatically blessed with honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kalijug mahi ghor a(n)dhaar hai manamukh raahu na koi ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is utter darkness; the self-willed manmukh cannot find the way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee naanakaa jin guramukh paragat hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, very blessed are those Gurmukhs, unto whom the Lord is revealed. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: i(n)d varasai kar daiaa lokaa(n) man upajai chaau ||
english: The clouds rain down mercifully, and joy wells up in the minds of the people.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਂਉ ॥
transliteration: jis kai hukam i(n)d varasadaa tis kai sad balihaarai jaa(n)u ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the One, by whose Command the clouds burst forth with rain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad samhaaleeai sache ke gun gaau ||
english: The Gurmukhs dwell on the Word of the Shabad. They sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate jan niramale sahaje sach samaau ||2||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings who are imbued with the Naam are pure and immaculate. They are intuitively merged in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur sev pooraa paaiaa ||
english: Serving the Perfect True Guru, I have found the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai karam dhiaai pooraa sabad ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Meditating on the Perfect Lord, by perfect karma, I have enshrined the Shabad within my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai giaan dhiaan mail chukaaiaa ||
english: Through perfect spiritual wisdom and meditation, my filth has been washed away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har sar teerath jaan manooaa naaiaa ||
english: The Lord is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage and pool of purification; I wash my mind in Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai man maar dha(n)n janedee maaiaa ||
english: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind - blessed is the mother who gave birth to him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dar sachai sachiaar sachaa aaiaa ||
english: He is true in the Court of the Lord, and his coming into this world is judged to be true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਾਂ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: puchh na sakai koi jaa(n) khasamai bhaaiaa ||
english: No one can challenge that person, with whom our Lord and Master is pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak sach salaahi likhiaa paaiaa ||18||
english: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, his pre-ordained destiny is activated. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਹਾਂ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਵਡੇ ਨਿਲਜ ॥
transliteration: kulahaa(n) de(n)de baavale lai(n)de vade nilaj ||
english: Those who give out ceremonial hats of recognition are fools; those who receive them have no shame.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੂਹਾ ਖਡ ਨ ਮਾਵਈ ਤਿਕਲਿ ਬੰਨੑੈ ਛਜ ॥
transliteration: choohaa khad na maavaee tikal ba(n)nhai chhaj ||
english: The mouse cannot enter its hole with a basket tied around its waist.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਨੑਿ ਦੁਆਈ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਨਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: denhi duaaee se marahi jin kau den s jaahi ||
english: Those who give out blessings shall die, and those that they bless shall also depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukam na jaapaee kithai jaai samaahi ||
english: O Nanak, no one knows the Lord's Command, by which all must depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਸਲਿ ਅਹਾੜੀ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: phasal ahaaRee ek naam saavanee sach naau ||
english: The spring harvest is the Name of the One Lord; the harvest of autumn is the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਹਦੂਦੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mai mahadood likhaaiaa khasamai kai dar jaai ||
english: I receive a letter of pardon from my Lord and Master, when I reach His Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਰ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa ke dar ketaRe kete aavahi jaa(n)hi ||
english: There are so many courts of the world, and so many who come and go there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kete ma(n)gahi ma(n)gate kete ma(n)g ma(n)g jaahi ||1||
english: There are so many beggars begging; so many beg and beg until death. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਉ ਮਣੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਪੰਜਿ ਸੈ ਦਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sau man hasatee ghiu guR khaavai pa(n)j sai daanaa khaai ||
english: The elephant eats a hundred pounds of ghee and molasses, and five hundred pounds of corn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਕੈ ਫੂਕੈ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਗਇਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dakai phookai kheh udaavai saahi gaiai pachhutaai ||
english: He belches and grunts and scatters dust, and when the breath leaves his body, he regrets it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਫੂਕਿ ਮੁਈ ਦੇਵਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhee phook muee devaanee ||
english: The blind and arrogant die insane.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: khasam mitee phir bhaanee ||
english: Submitting to the Lord, one become pleasing to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧੁ ਗੁਲ੍ਹਾ ਚਿੜੀ ਕਾ ਚੁਗਣੁ ਗੈਣਿ ਚੜੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: adh gulhaa chiRee kaa chugan gain chaRee bilalaai ||
english: The sparrow eats only half a grain, then it flies through the sky and chirps.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹਾ ਚੰਗੀ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khasamai bhaavai ohaa cha(n)gee j kare khudaai khudaai ||
english: The good sparrow is pleasing to her Lord and Master, if she chirps the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੈ ਮਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਿਛੈ ਪੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sakataa seehu maare sai miriaa sabh pichhai pai khaai ||
english: The powerful tiger kills hundreds of deer, and all sorts of other animals eat what it leaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸਤਾਣਾ ਘੁਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਗਇਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hoi sataanaa ghurai na maavai saahi gaiai pachhutaai ||
english: It becomes very strong, and cannot be contained in its den, but when it must go, it regrets.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬੁਕਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa kis no buk sunaavai ||
english: So who is impressed by the roar of the blind beast?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: khasamai mool na bhaavai ||
english: He is not pleasing at all to his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਕ ਤਿਡਾ ਅਕ ਡਾਲੀ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ak siu preet kare ak tidaa ak daalee bahi khaai ||
english: The insect loves the milkweed plant; perched on its branch, it eats it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹੋ ਚੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khasamai bhaavai oho cha(n)gaa j kare khudaai khudaai ||
english: It becomes good and pleasing to its Lord and Master, if it chirps the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak duneeaa chaar dihaaRe sukh keetai dukh hoee ||
english: O Nanak, the world lasts for only a few days; indulging in pleasures, pain is produced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੈਨਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਛਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: galaa vaale hain ghanere chhad na sakai koee ||
english: There are many who boast and brag, but none of them can remain detached from the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਖਂੀ ਮਿਠੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: makha(n)ee mithai maranaa ||
english: The fly dies for the sake of sweets.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin too rakhahi tin neR na aavai tin bhau saagar taranaa ||2||
english: O Lord, death does not even approach those whom You protect. You carry them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar too dhanee sachaa alakh apaar ||
english: You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable, O Invisible and Infinite True Lord Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕੋ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too daataa sabh ma(n)gate iko devanahaar ||
english: You are the Giver, all are beggars of You. You alone are the Great Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jinee seviaa tinee sukh paaiaa guramatee veechaar ||
english: Those who serve You find peace, reflecting on the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa no tudh evai bhaavadaa maaiaa naal piaar ||
english: Some, according to Your Will, are in love with Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad salaaheeai a(n)tar prem piaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praise the Lord with love and affection within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vin preetee bhagat na hovaee vin satigur na lagai piaar ||
english: Without love, there is no devotion. Without the True Guru, love is not enshrined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਇਕ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: too prabh sabh tudh sevade ik dhaadhee kare pukaar ||
english: You are the Lord God; everyone serves You. This is the prayer of Your humble minstrel.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: dehi daan sa(n)tokheeaa sachaa naam milai aadhaar ||19||
english: Please bless me with the gift of contentment, that I may receive the True Name as my Support. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: raatee kaal ghatai din kaal ||
english: Through the night the time ticks away; through the day the time ticks away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਿਜੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: chhijai kaaiaa hoi paraal ||
english: The body wears away and turns to straw.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: varatan varatiaa sarab ja(n)jaal ||
english: All are involved and entangled in worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਚੁਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਪ ਤਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bhuliaa chuk gaiaa tap taal ||
english: The mortal has mistakenly renounced the way of service.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਪਇਆ ਝੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa jhakh jhakh paiaa jher ||
english: The blind fool is caught in conflict, bothered and bewildered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਲਿਆਵਹਿ ਫੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pichhai rovahi liaavahi pher ||
english: Those who weep after someone has died - can they bring him back to life?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe kichh soojhai naahee ||
english: Without realization, nothing can be understood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਇਆ ਰੋਂਹਿ ਰੋਂਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਂੀ ॥
transliteration: moiaa ro(n)hi ro(n)de mar jaa(n)ha(n)ee ||
english: The weepers who weep for the dead shall themselves die as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak khasamai evai bhaavai ||
english: O Nanak, this is the Will of our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: seee mue jin chit na aavai ||1||
english: Those who do not remember the Lord, are dead. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਆ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਈ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਾਦੀ ॥
transliteration: muaa piaar preet muee muaa vair vaadee ||
english: Love dies, and affection dies; hatred and strife die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੰਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਰੂਪੁ ਵਿਣਸਿਆ ਦੁਖੀ ਦੇਹ ਰੁਲੀ ॥
transliteration: va(n)n gaiaa roop vinasiaa dukhee deh rulee ||
english: The color fades, and beauty vanishes; the body suffers and collapses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਥਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਹ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kithahu aaiaa kah gaiaa kihu na seeo kihu see ||
english: Where did he come from? Where is he going? Did he exist or not?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਲਾ ਗੋਈਆ ਕੀਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਰਲੀ ॥
transliteration: man mukh galaa goeeaa keetaa chaau ralee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh made empty boasts, indulging in parties and pleasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam bin sir khur pat paatee ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, his honor is torn away, from head to foot. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa a(n)te hoi sakhaaee ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of peace. It shall be your Help and Support in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo jagat bauraanaa naavai saar na paaee ||
english: Without the Guru, the world is insane. It does not appreciate the worth of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se paravaan jinh jotee jot milaaee ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are accepted and approved. Their light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so saahib so sevak tehaa jis bhaanaa ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: That servant who enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind, becomes just like his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanai bhaanai kahu kin sukh paaiaa a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaaee ||
english: Tell me, who has ever found peace by following his own will? The blind act in blindness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹੀ ਰਜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa kade hee rajai naahee moorakh bhukh na jaaee ||
english: No one is ever satisfied and fulfilled by evil and corruption. The hunger of the fool is not satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਗਿ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: doojai sabh ko lag vigutaa bin satigur boojh na paaee ||
english: Attached to duality, all are ruined; without the True Guru, there is no understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: satigur seve so sukh paae jis no kirapaa kare rajaaee ||20||
english: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are blessed with Grace by the Will of the Lord. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saram dharam dui naanakaa je dhan palai paai ||
english: Modesty and righteousness both, O Nanak, are qualities of those who are blessed with true wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so dhan mitr na kaa(n)dheeai jit sir chotaa(n) khaai ||
english: Do not refer to that wealth as your friend, which leads you to get your head beaten.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਲੈ ਧਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਫਕੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jin kai palai dhan vasai tin kaa naau phakeer ||
english: Those who possess only this worldly wealth are known as paupers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinh kai hiradai too vasahi te nar gunee gaheer ||1||
english: But those, within whose hearts You dwell, O Lord - those people are oceans of virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਹੇੜੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
transliteration: dukhee dunee saheReeai jaai ta lagahi dukh ||
english: Worldly possessions are obtained by pain and suffering; when they are gone, they leave pain and suffering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh ||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, hunger is never satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਾਂ ਭੁਖ ॥
transliteration: roopee bhukh na utarai jaa(n) dekhaa(n) taa(n) bhukh ||
english: Beauty does not satisfy hunger; when the man sees beauty, he hungers even more.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jete ras sareer ke tete lagahi dukh ||2||
english: As many as are the pleasures of the body, so many are the pains which afflict it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhee ka(n)mee a(n)dh man man a(n)dhai tan a(n)dh ||
english: Acting blindly, the mind becomes blind. The blind mind makes the body blind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਕੜਿ ਲਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: chikaR laaiai kiaa theeai jaa(n) tutai pathar ba(n)dh ||
english: Why make a dam with mud and plaster? Even a dam made of stones gives way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਨਾ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dh tutaa beRee nahee naa tulahaa naa haath ||
english: The dam has burst. There is no boat. There is no raft. The water's depth is unfathomable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੇਤੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਾਥ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam vin kete dube saath ||3||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, many multitudes have drowned. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਮਣ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਲਖ ਮਣ ਰੁਪਾ ਲਖ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: lakh man suinaa lakh man rupaa lakh saahaa sir saah ||
english: Thousands of pounds of gold, and thousands of pounds of silver; the king over the heads of thousands of kings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖੀ ਘੋੜੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakhee ghoRee paatisaah ||
english: Thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and spearmen; the emperor of thousands of horsemen.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਲੰਘਣਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: jithai saair la(n)ghanaa agan paanee asagaah ||
english: The unfathomable ocean of fire and water must be crossed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਧਾਹੀ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਾਹ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)dhee dis na aavaee dhaahee pavai kahaah ||
english: The other shore cannot be seen; only the roar of pitiful cries can be heard.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਹ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak othai jaaneeahi saah keee paatisaah ||4||
english: O Nanak, there, it shall be known, whether anyone is a king or an emperor. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਗਲੀਂ ਜੰਜੀਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa galee(n) ja(n)jeer ba(n)d rabaaneeai ||
english: Some have chains around their necks, in bondage to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਧੇ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: badhe chhutahi sach sach pachhaaneeai ||
english: They are released from bondage, realizing the True Lord as True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: likhiaa palai paai so sach jaaneeai ||
english: One whose pre-ordained destiny is activated, comes to know the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukamee hoi nibeR gaiaa jaaneeai ||
english: By God's Command, it is ordained. When the mortal goes, he knows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhaujal taaranahaar sabad pachhaaneeai ||
english: Realize the Word of the Shabad, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: chor jaar jooaar peeRe ghaaneeai ||
english: Thieves, adulterers and gamblers are pressed like seeds in the mill.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹੜੑਵਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak laaitabaar mile haRhvaaneeai ||
english: Slanderers and gossipers are hand-cuffed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: guramukh sach samaai s daragah jaaneeai ||21||
english: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord, and is famous in the Court of the Lord. ||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਫਕੀਰੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naau phakeerai paatisaahu moorakh pa(n)dit naau ||
english: The beggar is known as an emperor, and the fool is known as a religious scholar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਏਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe kaa naau paarakhoo evai kare guaau ||
english: The blind man is known as a seer; this is how people talk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਲਤਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ilat kaa naau chaudharee kooRee poore thaau ||
english: The trouble-maker is called a leader, and the liar is seated with honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh jaaneeai kal kaa ehu niaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs know that this is justice in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਣਾਂ ਬਾਜਾਂ ਤੈ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾਂ ਏਨੑਾ ਪੜੑਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haranaa(n) baajaa(n) tai sikadaaraa(n) enhaa paRhiaa naau ||
english: Deer, falcons and government officials are known to be trained and clever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਂਧੀ ਲਗੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਫਹਾਇਨਿ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: phaa(n)dhee lagee jaat phahaain agai naahee thaau ||
english: When the trap is set, they trap their own kind; hereafter they will find no place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so paRiaa so pa(n)dit beenaa jinhee kamaanaa naau ||
english: He alone is learned and wise, and he alone is a scholar, who practices the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਜੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਤਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਛਾਂਉ ॥
transliteration: pahilo de jaR a(n)dar ja(n)mai taa upar hovai chhaa(n)u ||
english: First, the tree puts down its roots, and then it spreads out its shade above.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਸੀਹ ਮੁਕਦਮ ਕੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raaje seeh mukadam kute ||
english: The kings are tigers, and their officials are dogs;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਜਗਾਇਨੑਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jaai jagaainhi baithe sute ||
english: they go out and awaken the sleeping people to harass them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰ ਨਹਦਾ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਘਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chaakar nahadaa paainhi ghaau ||
english: The public servants inflict wounds with their nails.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤੁ ਪਿਤੁ ਕੁਤਿਹੋ ਚਟਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: rat pit kutiho chat jaahu ||
english: The dogs lick up the blood that is spilled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜੀਆਂ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jithai jeeaa(n) hosee saar ||
english: But there, in the Court of the Lord, all beings will be judged.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਕਂੀ ਵਢਂੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naka(n)ee vadha(n)ee laaitabaar ||2||
english: Those who have violated the people's trust will be disgraced; their noses will be cut off. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae medanee aape karadaa saar ||
english: He Himself creates the world, and He himself takes care of it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai bin bharam na kateeai naam na lagai piaar ||
english: Without the Fear of God, doubt is not dispelled, and love for the Name is not embraced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: satigur te bhau oopajai paaeeai mokh duaar ||
english: Through the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and the Door of Salvation is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhai te sahaj paaeeai mil jotee jot apaar ||
english: Through the Fear of God, intuitive ease is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light of the Infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਭੈਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai te bhaijal la(n)gheeai guramatee veechaar ||
english: Through the Fear of God, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, reflecting on the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai te nirabhau paaeeai jis daa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is found; He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhai kee saar na jaananee trisanaa jalate karahi pukaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of the Fear of God. Burning in desire, they weep and wail.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak naavai hee te sukh paaiaa guramatee ur dhaar ||22||
english: O Nanak, through the Name, peace is obtained, by enshrining the Guru's Teachings within the heart. ||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੈ ਕਾਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੁਖੈ ਸਾਦੈ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
transliteration: roopai kaamai dosatee bhukhai saadai ga(n)dh ||
english: Beauty and sexual desire are friends; hunger and tasty food are tied together.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੈ ਮਾਲੈ ਘੁਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਚਲਿ ਊਂਘੈ ਸਉੜਿ ਪਲੰਘੁ ॥
transliteration: labai maalai ghul mil michal oo(n)ghai sauR pala(n)gh ||
english: Greed is bound up in its search for wealth, and sleep will use even a tiny space as a bed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੰਉਕੈ ਕੋਪੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)ukai kop khuaar hoi phakaR pite a(n)dh ||
english: Anger barks and brings ruin on itself, blindly pursuing useless conflicts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chupai cha(n)gaa naanakaa vin naavai muhi ga(n)dh ||1||
english: It is good to be silent, O Nanak; without the Name, one's mouth spews forth only filth. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਪੰਜੇ ਠਗ ॥
transliteration: raaj maal roop jaat joban pa(n)je thag ||
english: Royal power, wealth, beauty, social status and youth are the five thieves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਠਗੀਂ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਰਖੀ ਲਜ ॥
transliteration: enee thagee(n) jag thagiaa kinai na rakhee laj ||
english: These thieves have plundered the world; no one's honor has been spared.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਨਾ ਠਗਨੑਿ ਠਗ ਸੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: enaa thaganhi thag se j gur kee pairee paahi ||
english: But these thieves themselves are robbed, by those who fall at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak karamaa baahare hor kete muthe jaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the multitudes who do not have good karma are plundered. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਆ ਲੇਖੇਦਾਰੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: paRiaa lekhedaar lekhaa ma(n)geeai ||
english: The learned and educated are called to account for their actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਤੰਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai kooRiaar aukhaa ta(n)geeai ||
english: Without the Name, they are judged false; they become miserable and suffer hardship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਘਟ ਰੁਧੇ ਰਾਹ ਗਲੀਆਂ ਰੋਕੀਆਂ ॥
transliteration: aughat rudhe raah galeeaa(n) rokeeaa(n) ||
english: Their path becomes treacherous and difficult, and their way is blocked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ॥
transliteration: sachaa veparavaahu sabad sa(n)tokheeaa(n) ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True and Independent Lord God, one becomes content.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ॥
transliteration: gahir gabheer athaahu haath na labhaee ||
english: The Lord is deep and profound and unfathomable; His depth cannot be measured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ ॥
transliteration: muhe muhi chotaa khaahu vin gur koi na chhutasee ||
english: Without the Guru, the mortals are beaten and punched in the face and the mouth, and no one is released.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: pat setee ghar jaahu naam vakhaaneeai ||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one returns to his true home with honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਹ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: hukamee saah giraah de(n)daa jaaneeai ||23||
english: Know that the Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, gives sustenance and the breath of life. ||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਪੀੜ ॥
transliteration: paunai paanee aganee jeeu tin kiaa khuseeaa kiaa peeR ||
english: Living beings are formed of air, water and fire. They are subject to pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਵਜੀਰ ॥
transliteration: dharatee paataalee aakaasee ik dar rahan vajeer ||
english: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic ethers of the heavens, some remain ministers in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਹੀਰ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa vadee aarajaa ik mar hohi jaheer ||
english: Some live long lives, while others suffer and die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਕੀਰ ॥
transliteration: ik de khaahi nikhutai naahee ik sadaa phirahi phakeer ||
english: Some give and consume, and still their wealth is not exhausted, while others remain poor forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਲਖ ॥
transliteration: hukamee saaje hukamee dhaahe ek chase mahi lakh ||
english: In His Will He creates, and in His Will He destroys thousands in an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਥੈ ਨਥਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਤੋੜੇ ਨਥ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko nathai nathiaa bakhase toRe nath ||
english: He has harnessed everyone with His harness; when He forgives, he breaks the harness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਅਲਖੁ ॥
transliteration: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa lekhe baajh alakh ||
english: He has no color or features; He is invisible and beyond calculation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: kiu katheeai kiu aakheeai jaapai sacho sach ||
english: How can He be described? He is known as the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਾ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਾਰ ਸਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
transliteration: karanaa kathanaa kaar sabh naanak aap akath ||
english: All the actions which are done and described, O Nanak, are done by the Indescribable Lord Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੇਇ ॥
transliteration: akath kee kathaa sunei ||
english: Whoever hears the description of the indescribable,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ridh budh sidh giaan sadaa sukh hoi ||1||
english: is blessed with wealth, intelligence, perfection, spiritual wisdom and eternal peace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਤ ਨਉ ਕੁਲ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: ajar jarai ta nau kul ba(n)dh ||
english: One who bears the unbearable, controls the nine holes of the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: poojai praan hovai thir ka(n)dh ||
english: One who worships and adores the Lord with his breath of life, gains stability in his body-wall.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਹਾਂ ਏਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kahaa(n) te aaiaa kahaa(n) ehu jaan ||
english: Where has he come from, and where will he go?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marat rahai paravaan ||
english: Remaining dead while yet alive, he is accepted and approved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhai tat pachhaanai ||
english: Whoever understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, realizes the essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu parasaad guroo te jaanai ||
english: This is known by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਂਦਾ ਫੜੀਅਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ho(n)daa phaReeag naanak jaan ||
english: O Nanak, know this: egotism leads to bondage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naa hau naa mai joonee paan ||2||
english: Only those who have no ego and no self-conceit, are not consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜੑੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਹੋਰਿ ਬੁਧਂੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paRheeai naam saalaah hor budha(n)ee mithiaa ||
english: Read the Praise of the Lord's Name; other intellectual pursuits are false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bin sache vaapaar janam birathiaa ||
english: Without dealing in Truth, life is worthless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na paaraavaar na kin hee paaiaa ||
english: No one has ever found the Lord's end or limitation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag garab gubaar tin sach na bhaaiaa ||
english: All the world is enveloped by the darkness of egotistical pride. It does not like the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਤਾਵਣਿ ਤਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chale naam visaar taavan tatiaa ||
english: Those who depart from this world, forgetting the Naam, shall be roasted in the frying pan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: baladee a(n)dar tel dubidhaa ghatiaa ||
english: They pour the oil of duality within, and burn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਉਠੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਉਵਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa uthee khel phirai uvatiaa ||
english: They come into the world and wander around aimlessly; they depart when the play is finished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak sachai mel sachai ratiaa ||24||
english: O Nanak, imbued with Truth, the mortals merge in Truth. ||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਮਾਸੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa(n) maasahu ni(n)miaa maasai a(n)dar vaas ||
english: First, the mortal is conceived in the flesh, and then he dwells in the flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਡੁ ਚੰਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu paai maas muhi miliaa had cha(n)m tan maas ||
english: When he comes alive, his mouth takes flesh; his bones, skin and body are flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਢਿਆ ਮੰਮਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: maasahu baahar kadhiaa ma(n)maa maas giraas ||
english: He comes out of the womb of flesh, and takes a mouthful of flesh at the breast.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੁ ਮਾਸੈ ਕਾ ਜੀਭ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਸੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: muhu maasai kaa jeebh maasai kee maasai a(n)dar saas ||
english: His mouth is flesh, his tongue is flesh; his breath is in the flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਵੀਆਹਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: vadaa hoaa veeaahiaa ghar lai aaiaa maas ||
english: He grows up and is married, and brings his wife of flesh into his home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: maasahu hee maas oopajai maasahu sabho saak ||
english: Flesh is produced from flesh; all relatives are made of flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai hukam bujheeai taa(n) ko aavai raas ||
english: When the mortal meets the True Guru, and realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he comes to be reformed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap chhute nah chhooteeai naanak bachan binaas ||1||
english: Releasing himself, the mortal does not find release; O Nanak, through empty words, one is ruined. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਝਗੜੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: maas maas kar moorakh jhagaRe giaan dhiaan nahee jaanai ||
english: The fools argue about flesh and meat, but they know nothing about meditation and spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਸਾਗੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: kaun maas kaun saag kahaavai kis mahi paap samaane ||
english: What is called meat, and what is called green vegetables? What leads to sin?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੈਂਡਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਕੀਏ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: gai(n)daa maar hom jag keee devatiaa kee baane ||
english: It was the habit of the gods to kill the rhinoceros, and make a feast of the burnt offering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਨਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: maas chhod bais nak pakaRahi raatee maanas khaane ||
english: Those who renounce meat, and hold their noses when sitting near it, devour men at night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੋ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: phaR kar lokaa(n) no dikhalaavahi giaan dhiaan nahee soojhai ||
english: They practice hypocrisy, and make a show before other people, but they do not understand anything about meditation or spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)dhe siu kiaa kaheeai kahai na kahiaa boojhai ||
english: O Nanak, what can be said to the blind people? They cannot answer, or even understand what is said.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa soi j a(n)dh kamaavai tis ridai s lochan naahee ||
english: They alone are blind, who act blindly. They have no eyes in their hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਨਿਪੰਨੇ ਮਛੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa kee rakat nipa(n)ne machhee maas na khaa(n)hee ||
english: They are produced from the blood of their mothers and fathers, but they do not eat fish or meat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਿਸਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਓਥੈ ਮੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: isatree purakhai jaa(n) nis melaa othai ma(n)dh kamaahee ||
english: But when men and women meet in the night, they come together in the flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥
transliteration: maasahu ni(n)me maasahu ja(n)me ham maasai ke bhaa(n)de ||
english: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan kachh soojhai naahee chatur kahaavai paa(n)de ||
english: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baahar kaa maas ma(n)daa suaamee ghar kaa maas cha(n)geraa ||
english: O master, you believe that flesh on the outside is bad, but the flesh of those in your own home is good.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੋਏ ਜੀਇ ਲਇਆ ਵਾਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh maasahu hoe jeei laiaa vaaseraa ||
english: All beings and creatures are flesh; the soul has taken up its home in the flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਭਖੁ ਭਖਹਿ ਭਖੁ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: abhakh bhakhahi bhakh taj chhodahi a(n)dh guroo jin keraa ||
english: They eat the uneatable; they reject and abandon what they could eat. They have a teacher who is blind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥
transliteration: maasahu ni(n)me maasahu ja(n)me ham maasai ke bhaa(n)de ||
english: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan kachh soojhai naahee chatur kahaavai paa(n)de ||
english: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਤੇਬਂੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: maas puraanee maas kateba(n)ee chahu jug maas kamaanaa ||
english: Meat is allowed in the Puraanas, meat is allowed in the Bible and the Koran. Throughout the four ages, meat has been used.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਜਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਵੀਆਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਓਥੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jaj kaaj veeaahi suhaavai othai maas samaanaa ||
english: It is featured in sacred feasts and marriage festivities; meat is used in them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਪਜਹਿ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: isatree purakh nipajahi maasahu paatisaah sulataanaa(n) ||
english: Women, men, kings and emperors originate from meat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਉਨੑ ਕਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
transliteration: je oi disahi narak jaa(n)de taa(n) unh kaa daan na lainaa ||
english: If you see them going to hell, then do not accept charitable gifts from them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਲੈਦੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: de(n)daa narak surag laide dekhahu ehu dhingaanaa ||
english: The giver goes to hell, while the receiver goes to heaven - look at this injustice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: aap na boojhai lok bujhaae paa(n)de kharaa siaanaa ||
english: You do not understand your own self, but you preach to other people. O Pandit, you are very wise indeed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਉਪੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)de too jaanai hee naahee kithahu maas upa(n)naa ||
english: O Pandit, you do not know where meat originated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾਂ ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਗੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: toiahu a(n)n kamaad kapaahaa(n) toiahu tribhavan ga(n)naa ||
english: Corn, sugar cane and cotton are produced from water. The three worlds came from water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੋਆ ਆਖੈ ਹਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਛਾ ਤੋਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: toaa aakhai hau bahu bidh hachhaa toai bahut bikaaraa ||
english: Water says, "I am good in many ways." But water takes many forms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ete ras chhod hovai sa(n)niaasee naanak kahai vichaaraa ||2||
english: Forsaking these delicacies, one becomes a true Sannyaasee, a detached hermit. Nanak reflects and speaks. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ ਇਕ ਜੀਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau kiaa aakhaa ik jeebh teraa a(n)t na kin hee paaiaa ||
english: What can I say with only one tongue? I cannot find your limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad veechaar se tujh hee maahi samaaiaa ||
english: Those who contemplate the True Word of the Shabad are absorbed into You, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik bhagavaa ves kar bharamade vin satigur kinai na paaiaa ||
english: Some wander around in saffron robes, but without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: des disa(n)tar bhav thake tudh a(n)dar aap lukaaiaa ||
english: They wander in foreign lands and countries until they grow weary, but You hide Yourself within them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad rata(n)n hai kar chaanan aap dikhaaiaa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, through which the Lord shines forth and reveals Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa guramatee sach samaaiaa ||
english: Realizing one's own self, following the Guru's Teachings, the mortal is absorbed into Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਬਜਾਰੀਆ ਬਾਜਾਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
