transliteration: aavaa gaun bajaareeaa baajaar jinee rachaaiaa ||
english: Coming and going, the tricksters and magicians put on their magic show.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: ik thir sachaa saalaahanaa jin man sachaa bhaaiaa ||25||
english: But those whose minds are pleased by the True Lord, praise the True One, the Ever-stable Lord. ||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਵਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak maaiaa karam birakh phal a(n)mrit phal vis ||
english: O Nanak, the tree of actions done in Maya yields ambrosial fruit and poisonous fruit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kaaran karataa kare jis khavaale tis ||1||
english: The Creator does all deeds; we eat the fruits as He ordains. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆਂ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak duneeaa keeaa(n) vadiaaeeaa(n) agee setee jaal ||
english: O Nanak, burn worldly greatness and glory in the fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਜਲੀਈਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: enee jaleeee(n) naam visaariaa ik na chaleeaa naal ||2||
english: These burnt offerings have caused mortals to forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Not even one of them will go along with you in the end. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sir sir hoi nibeR hukam chalaaiaa ||
english: He judges each and every being; by the Hukam of His Command, He leads us on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: terai hath nibeR toohai man bhaaiaa ||
english: Justice is in Your Hands, O Lord; You are pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਬੰਨਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kaal chalaae ba(n)n koi na rakhasee ||
english: The mortal is bound and gagged by Death and lead away; no one can rescue him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਕੰਨੑਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਚਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jar jaravaanaa ka(n)nhi chaRiaa nachasee ||
english: Old age, the tyrant, dances on the mortal's shoulders.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਬੇੜੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਖਸੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur bohith beR sachaa rakhasee ||
english: So climb aboard the boat of the True Guru, and the True Lord will rescue you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾੜੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਖਸੀ ॥
transliteration: agan bhakhai bhaRahaaR anadin bhakhasee ||
english: The fire of desire burns like an oven, consuming mortals night and day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੁਗੈ ਚੋਗ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ॥
transliteration: phaathaa chugai chog hukamee chhutasee ||
english: Like trapped birds, the mortals peck at the corn; only through the Lord's Command will they find release.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਸੀ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: karataa kare s hog kooR nikhutasee ||26||
english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass; falsehood shall fail in the end. ||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਦੇਖਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi ghar dekhaai dei so satigur purakh sujaan ||
english: The True Guru is the All-knowing Primal Being; He shows us our true home within the home of the self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿਕਾਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਤਹ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad dhunikaar dhun tah baajai sabad neesaan ||
english: The Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, resonate and resound within; the insignia of the Shabad is revealed there, vibrating gloriously.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਤਹ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: deep lo paataal tah kha(n)d ma(n)dal hairaan ||
english: Worlds and realms, nether regions, solar systems and galaxies are wondrously revealed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਬਾਜਿੰਤ੍ਰ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: taar ghor baaji(n)tr tah saach takhat sulataan ||
english: The strings and the harps vibrate and resound; the true throne of the Lord is there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਮਨ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਗੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sukhaman kai ghar raag sun su(n)n ma(n)dal liv laai ||
english: Listen to the music of the home of the heart - Sukhmani, peace of mind. Lovingly tune in to His state of celestial ecstasy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa beechaareeai manasaa manahi samaai ||
english: Contemplate the Unspoken Speech, and the desires of the mind are dissolved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ulat kamal a(n)mrit bhariaa ihu man katahu na jaai ||
english: The heart-lotus is turned upside-down, and is filled with Ambrosial Nectar. This mind does not go out; it does not get distracted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ajapaa jaap na veesarai aad jugaad samaai ||
english: It does not forget the Chant which is chanted without chanting; it is immersed in the Primal Lord God of the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh sakheeaa pa(n)che mile guramukh nij ghar vaas ||
english: All the sister-companions are blessed with the five virtues. The Gurmukhs dwell in the home of the self deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਇਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabad khoj ihu ghar lahai naanak taa kaa daas ||1||
english: Nanak is the slave of that one who seeks the Shabad and finds this home within. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਲਿਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਫਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: chilimil biseeaar duneeaa phaanee ||
english: The extravagant glamor of the world is a passing show.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੂਬਿ ਅਕਲ ਮਨ ਗੋਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaloob akal man gor na maanee ||
english: My twisted mind does not believe that it will end up in a grave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਮੀਨ ਕਮਤਰੀਨ ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man kameen kamatareen too dareeaau khudaaiaa ||
english: I am meek and lowly; You are the great river.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਚੀਜੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਵਰ ਜਹਰ ਚੀਜ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ek cheej mujhai dehi avar jahar cheej na bhaaiaa ||
english: Please, bless me with the one thing; everything else is poison, and does not tempt me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਾਬ ਖਾਮ ਕੂਜੈ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: puraab khaam koojai hikamat khudaaiaa ||
english: You filled this fragile body with the water of life, O Lord, by Your Creative Power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੁਆਨਾ ਤੂ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tuaanaa too kudaratee aaiaa ||
english: By Your Omnipotence, I have become powerful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਸਤਾਨਾ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sag naanak deebaan masataanaa nit chaRai savaaiaa ||
english: Nanak is a dog in the Court of the Lord, intoxicated more and more, all the time.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਸ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੁਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aatas duneeaa khunak naam khudaaiaa ||2||
english: The world is on fire; the Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਨਵੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: pauRee navee mah 5 ||
english: New Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਚਲਤੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabho varatai chalat chalat vakhaaniaa ||
english: His wonderful play is all-pervading; it is wonderful and amazing!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesar guramukh jaaniaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, I know the the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਥੇ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: lathe sabh vikaar sabad neesaaniaa ||
english: All my sins and corruption are washed away, through the insignia of the Shabad, the Word of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar bhae nikaaniaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and becomes free.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: simar simar daataar sabh ra(n)g maaniaa ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Great Giver, I enjoy all comforts and pleasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਮਿਹਰ ਛਾਵਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paragat bhaiaa sa(n)saar mihar chhaavaaniaa ||
english: I have become famous throughout the world, under the canopy of His kindness and grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhas milaae sad kurabaaniaa ||
english: He Himself has forgiven me, and united me with Himself; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak lae milaai khasamai bhaaniaa ||27||
english: O Nanak, by the Pleasure of His Will, my Lord and Master has blended me with Himself. ||27||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਸੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s kaagad kalam dha(n)n dhan bhaa(n)daa dhan mas ||
english: Blessed is the paper, blessed is the pen, blessed is the inkwell, and blessed is the ink.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan lekhaaree naanakaa jin naam likhaaiaa sach ||1||
english: Blessed is the writer, O Nanak, who writes the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਭਿ ਤੂੰ ॥
transliteration: aape patee kalam aap upar lekh bh too(n) ||
english: You Yourself are the writing tablet, and You Yourself are the pen. You are also what is written on it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੂ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eko kaheeai naanakaa doojaa kaahe koo ||2||
english: Speak of the One Lord, O Nanak; how could there be any other? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape aap varatadaa aap banat banaaee ||
english: You Yourself are all-pervading; You Yourself made the making.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojaa ko nahee too rahiaa samaaee ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all; You are permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: teree gat mit toohai jaanadaa tudh keemat paaee ||
english: You alone know Your state and extent. Only You can estimate Your worth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too alakh agochar agam hai guramat dikhaaee ||
english: You are invisible, imperceptible and inaccessible. You are revealed through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan dukh bharam hai gur giaan gavaaee ||
english: Deep within, there is ignorance, suffering and doubt; through the spiritual wisdom of the Guru, they are eradicated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jis kripaa karahi tis mel laihi so naam dhiaaee ||
english: He alone meditates on the Naam, whom You unite with Yourself, in Your Mercy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too karataa purakh aga(n)m hai raviaa sabh thaaee ||
english: You are the Creator, the Inaccessible Primal Lord God; You are all-pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਸਚਿਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੨੮॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: jit too laaihi sachiaa tit ko lagai naanak gun gaaee ||28||1|| sudh
english: To whatever You link the mortal, O True Lord, to that he is linked. Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises. ||28||1|| Sudh||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag malaar baanee bhagat naamadev jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Malaar, The Word Of The Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵੀਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ॥
transliteration: seveele gopaal raai akul nira(n)jan ||
english: Serve the King, the Sovereign Lord of the World. He has no ancestry; He is immaculate and pure.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat daan deejai jaachahi sa(n)t jan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please bless me with the gift of devotion, which the humble Saints beg for. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਦਿਗ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਰਾਇਚਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਭਵਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਸਾਲਾ ਸਪਤ ਲੋਕ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar dig disai saraaichaa baiku(n)th bhavan chitrasaalaa sapat lok saamaan pooreeale ||
english: His Home is the pavilion seen in all directions; His ornamental heavenly realms fill the seven worlds alike.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੀਵੜੇ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਕੋਟਵਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਕਰਾ ਸਿਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar lachhimee kuaaree cha(n)d sooraj deevaRe kautak kaal bapuRaa kotavaal s karaa siree ||
english: In His Home, the virgin Lakshmi dwells. The moon and the sun are His two lamps; the wretched Messenger of Death stages his dramas, and levies taxes on all.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: s aisaa raajaa sree naraharee ||1||
english: Such is my Sovereign Lord King, the Supreme Lord of all. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੁਲਾਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖੁ ਡਾਂਵੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰਾਚੀਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar kulaal brahamaa chatur mukh daa(n)vaRaa jin bisv sa(n)saar raacheele ||
english: In His House, the four-faced Brahma, the cosmic potter lives. He created the entire universe.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਾਵਲਾ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਤਤ ਸਾਰਖਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਾਖੀਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) kai ghar eesar baavalaa jagat guroo tat saarakhaa giaan bhaakheele ||
english: In His House, the insane Shiva, the Guru of the World, lives; he imparts spiritual wisdom to expain the essence of reality.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਡਾਂਗੀਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲੇਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n jaa(n) chai daa(n)geeaa duaarai chitr gupat lekheeaa ||
english: Sin and virtue are the standard-bearers at His Door; Chitr and Gupt are the recording angels of the conscious and subconscious.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਪਰੁਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai parulee pratihaar ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, the Lord of Destruction, is the door-man.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sou aisaa raajaa sree gopaal ||2||
english: Such is the Supreme Sovereign Lord of the World. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਰਿਖੀ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਢਾਢੀਆ ਗਾਵੰਤ ਆਛੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar gan ga(n)dharab rikhee bapuRe dhaadheeaa gaava(n)t aachhai ||
english: In His Home are the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, Rishis and poor minstrels, who sing so sweetly.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀਆ ਅਨਗਰੂਆ ਆਖਾੜਾ ਮੰਡਲੀਕ ਬੋਲ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕਾਛੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab saasatr bahu roopeeaa anagarooaa aakhaaRaa ma(n)daleek bol bolahi kaachhe ||
english: All the Shaastras take various forms in His theater, singing beautiful songs.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚਉਰ ਢੂਲ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ॥
transliteration: chaur dhool jaa(n) chai hai pavan ||
english: The wind waves the fly-brush over Him;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚੇਰੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਲੇ ਭਵਣੁ ॥
transliteration: cheree sakat jeet le bhavan ||
english: His hand-maiden is Maya, who has conquered the world.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡ ਟੂਕ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਭਸਮਤੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)d took jaa chai bhasamatee ||
english: The shell of the earth is His fireplace.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਪਤੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sou aisaa raajaa tribhavan patee ||3||
english: Such is the Sovereign Lord of the three worlds. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੂਰਮਾ ਪਾਲੁ ਸਹਸ੍ਰ ਫਨੀ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸੇਜ ਵਾਲੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar kooramaa paal sahasr phanee baasak sej vaalooaa ||
english: In His Home, the celestial turtle is the bed-frame, woven with the strings of the thousand-headed snake.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਮਾਲਣੀ ਛਿਨਵੈ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਮੇਘ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾਣੀਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: athaarah bhaar banaasapatee maalanee chhinavai karoRee megh maalaa paaneehaareeaa ||
english: His flower-girls are the eighteen loads of vegetation; His water-carriers are the nine hundred sixty million clouds.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਖ ਪ੍ਰਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nakh prasev jaa chai surasaree ||
english: His sweat is the Ganges River.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਪਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘੜਥਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sapat samu(n)d jaa(n) chai ghaRathalee ||
english: The seven seas are His water-pitchers.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਵਰਤਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ete jee jaa(n) chai varatanee ||
english: The creatures of the world are His household utensils.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sou aisaa raajaa tribhavan dhanee ||4||
english: Such is the Sovereign Lord King of the three worlds. ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਕਟ ਵਰਤੀ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਨੇਜੈ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਬਾਨਵੈ ਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar nikat varatee arajan dhroo prahalaad a(n)bareek naarad nejai sidh budh gan ga(n)dharab baanavai helaa ||
english: In His home are Arjuna, Dhroo, Prahlaad, Ambreek, Naarad, Nayjaa, the Siddhas and Buddhas, the ninety-two heavenly heralds and celestial singers in their wondrous play.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹਹਿ ਘਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ete jee jaa(n) chai hahi gharee ||
english: All the creatures of the world are in His House.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪਿਕ ਅੰਤਰ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sarab biaapik a(n)tar haree ||
english: The Lord is diffused in the inner beings of all.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਾਂ ਚੀ ਆਣਿ ॥
transliteration: pranavai naamadeu taa(n) chee aan ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, seek His Protection.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal bhagat jaa chai neesaan ||5||1||
english: All the devotees are His banner and insignia. ||5||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: malaar ||
english: Malaar:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mo kau too(n) na bisaar too na bisaar ||
english: Please do not forget me; please do not forget me,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too na bisaare raamaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: please do not forget me, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਲਾਵੰਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜੋ ਹੈ ਮੁਝ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋਪਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aalaava(n)tee ihu bhram jo hai mujh oopar sabh kopilaa ||
english: The temple priests have doubts about this, and everyone is furious with me.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੂਦੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਉਠਾਇਓ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sood sood kar maar uthaaio kahaa karau baap beethulaa ||1||
english: Calling me low-caste and untouchable, they beat me and drove me out; what should I do now, O Beloved Father Lord? ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਹੂਏ ਜਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੇਹੁਗੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: mooe hooe jau mukat dehuge mukat na jaanai koilaa ||
english: If You liberate me after I am dead, no one will know that I am liberated.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਢੇਢ ਕਹਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਪਿਛੰਉਡੀ ਹੋਇਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: e pa(n)deeaa mo kau dhedh kahat teree paij pichha(n)udee hoilaa ||2||
english: These Pandits, these religious scholars, call me low-born; when they say this, they tarnish Your honor as well. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ਅਤਿਭੁਜ ਭਇਓ ਅਪਾਰਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too j daiaal kripaal kaheeat hai(n) atibhuj bhaio apaaralaa ||
english: You are called kind and compassionate; the power of Your Arm is absolutely unrivalled.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਉ ਪੰਡੀਅਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਛਵਾਰਲਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: pher deeaa dehuraa naame kau pa(n)deean kau pichhavaaralaa ||3||2||
english: The Lord turned the temple around to face Naam Dayv; He turned His back on the Brahmins. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: malaar baanee bhagat ravidaas jee kee ||
english: Malaar, The Word Of The Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਗਰ ਜਨਾਂ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆਤ ਚੰਮਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: naagar janaa(n) meree jaat bikhiaat cha(n)maara(n) ||
english: O humble townspeople, I am obviously just a shoemaker.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ridai raam gobi(n)d gun saara(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In my heart I cherish the Glories of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸਲਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਰੁਨੀ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: surasaree salal krit baarunee re sa(n)t jan karat nahee paana(n) ||
english: Even if wine is made from the water of the Ganges, O Saints, do not drink it.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਾ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਤ ਅਵਰ ਜਲ ਰੇ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਨੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: suraa apavitr nat avar jal re surasaree milat nahi hoi aana(n) ||1||
english: This wine, and any other polluted water which mixes with the Ganges, is not separate from it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਰ ਤਾਰਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਰੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗਰਾ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: tar taar apavitr kar maaneeai re jaise kaagaraa karat beechaara(n) ||
english: The palmyra palm tree is considered impure, and so its leaves are considered impure as well.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਗਉਤੁ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਊਪਰੇ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaagaut likheeai tih oopare poojeeai kar namasakaara(n) ||2||
english: But if devotional prayers are written on paper made from its leaves, then people bow in reverence and worship before it. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਟ ਬਾਂਢਲਾ ਢੋਰ ਢੋਵੰਤਾ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ ਆਸ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: meree jaat kut baa(n)dhalaa dhor dhova(n)taa nitahi baanaarasee aas paasaa ||
english: It is my occupation to prepare and cut leather; each day, I carry the carcasses out of the city.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤਿਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: ab bipr paradhaan tihi karahi da(n)daut tere naam saranaai ravidaas daasaa ||3||1||
english: Now, the important Brahmins of the city bow down before me; Ravi Daas, Your slave, seeks the Sanctuary of Your Name. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: malaar ||
english: Malaar:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਤੇਊ ਜਨਾ ਪਦਮ ਕਵਲਾਸ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਸ ਸਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: har japat teoo janaa padam kavalaas pat taas sam tul nahee aan kooo ||
english: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Lotus Feet - none are equal to them.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਹੀ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਸਥਰਿਓ ਆਨ ਰੇ ਆਨ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸੋਊ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek hee ek anek hoi bisathario aan re aan bharapoor sooo || rahaau ||
english: The Lord is One, but He is diffused in many forms. Bring in, bring in, that All-pervading Lord. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗਵਤੁ ਲੇਖੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਤਾਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਆਛੋਪ ਛੀਪਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai bhaagavat lekheeai avar nahee pekheeai taas kee jaat aachhop chheepaa ||
english: He who writes the Praises of the Lord God, and sees nothing else at all, is a low-class, untouchable fabric-dyer by trade.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਸ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੀਐ ਸਨਕ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਾਮਨਾ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: biaas mahi lekheeai sanak mahi pekheeai naam kee naamanaa sapat deepaa ||1||
english: The Glory of the Name is seen in the writings of Vyaas and Sanak, throughout the seven continents. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਈਦਿ ਬਕਰੀਦਿ ਕੁਲ ਗਊ ਰੇ ਬਧੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਾਨੀਅਹਿ ਸੇਖ ਸਹੀਦ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai eed bakareed kul gaoo re badh karahi maaneeahi sekh saheed peeraa ||
english: And he whose family used to kill cows at the festivals of Eed and Bakareed, who worshipped Shayks, martyrs and spiritual teachers,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਪ ਵੈਸੀ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਐਸੀ ਸਰੀ ਤਿਹੂ ਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਸਿਧ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kai baap vaisee karee poot aisee saree tihoo re lok parasidh kabeeraa ||2||
english: whose father used to do such things - his son Kabeer became so successful that he is now famous throughout the three worlds. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਕੇ ਢੇਢ ਸਭ ਢੋਰ ਢੋਵੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਜਹੁ ਬੰਨਾਰਸੀ ਆਸ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke kuta(n)b ke dhedh sabh dhor dhova(n)t phirahi ajahu ba(n)naarasee aas paasaa ||
english: And all the leather-workers in those families still go around Benares removing the dead cattle

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰ ਸਹਿਤ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਤਨੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: aachaar sahit bipr karahi da(n)daut tin tanai ravidaas daasaan daasaa ||3||2||
english: - the ritualistic Brahmins bow in reverence before their son Ravi Daas, the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: malaar ||
english: Malaar:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: milat piaaro praan naath kavan bhagat te ||
english: What sort of devotional worship will lead me to meet my Beloved, the Lord of my breath of life?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat paaee param gate || rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained the supreme status. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਧੋਵਉ ॥
transliteration: maile kapare kahaa lau dhovau ||
english: How long shall I wash these dirty clothes?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈਗੀ ਨੀਦ ਕਹਾ ਲਗੁ ਸੋਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavaigee need kahaa lag sovau ||1||
english: How long shall I remain asleep? ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਰਿਓ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਫਾਟਿਓ ॥
transliteration: joee joee jorio soee soee phaatio ||
english: Whatever I was attached to, has perished.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਬਨਜਿ ਉਠਿ ਹੀ ਗਈ ਹਾਟਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jhoothai banaj uth hee gaee haatio ||2||
english: The shop of false merchandise has closed down. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਇਓ ਜਬ ਲੇਖੋ ॥
transliteration: kahu ravidaas bhaio jab lekho ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, when the account is called for and given,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਖਿਓ ॥੩॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: joee joee keeno soee soee dekhio ||3||1||3||
english: whatever the mortal has done, he shall see. ||3||1||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਾਨੜਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag kaanaRaa chaupade mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Kaanraa, Chau-Padhay, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa man saadh janaa(n) mil hariaa ||
english: Meeting with the Holy people, my mind blossoms forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau bal bal bal bal saadh janaa(n) kau mil sa(n)gat paar utariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those Holy beings; joining the Sangat, the Congregation, I am carried across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਪਗ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa karahu prabh apanee ham saadh janaa(n) pag pariaa ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, please bless me with Your Mercy, God, that I may fall at the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan dhan saadh jin har prabh jaaniaa mil saadhoo patit udhariaa ||1||
english: Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who know the Lord God. Meeting with the Holy, even sinners are saved. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਚਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: manooaa chalai chalai bahu bahu bidh mil saadhoo vasagat kariaa ||
english: The mind roams and rambles all around in all directions. Meeting with the Holy, it is overpowered and brought under control,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉਂ ਜਲ ਤੰਤੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਬਧਕਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਮੀਨਾ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu(n) jal ta(n)t pasaario badhak gras meenaa vasagat khariaa ||2||
english: just as when the fisherman spreads his net over the water, he catches and overpowers the fish. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਭਲ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sa(n)t bhal neeke mil sa(n)t janaa mal laheeaa ||
english: The Saints, the Saints of the Lord, are noble and good. Meeting with the humble Saints, filth is washed away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਬੁਨਿ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai durat gaiaa sabh neekar jiu saabun kaapar kariaa ||3||
english: All the sins and egotism are washed away, like soap washing dirty clothes. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: masatak lilaat likhiaa dhur thaakur gur satigur charan ur dhariaa ||
english: According to that pre-ordained destiny inscribed on my forehead by my Lord and Master, I have enshrined the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru, within my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh daalad dookh bha(n)j prabh paaiaa jan naanak naam udhariaa ||4||1||
english: I have found God, the Destroyer of all poverty and pain; servant Nanak is saved through the Naam. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: meraa man sa(n)t janaa pag ren ||
english: My mind is the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੋਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kathaa sunee mil sa(n)gat man koraa har ra(n)g bhen ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Sangat, the Congregation, I listen to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. My crude and uncultured mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਚਿਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਚਿਤੇਨ ॥
transliteration: ham achit achet na jaanahi gat mit gur keee suchit chiten ||
english: I am thoughtless and unconscious; I do not know God's state and extent. The Guru has made me thoughtful and conscious.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਕੀਓ ਅੰਗੀਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh deen daiaal keeo a(n)geekrit man har har naam japen ||1||
english: God is Merciful to the meek; He has made me His Own. My mind chants and meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਟਿ ਦੇਵਉ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਤੇਨ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t milahi man preetam kat devau heearaa ten ||
english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, the Beloveds of the mind, I would cut out my heart, and offer it to them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੇਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t mile har miliaa ham keee patit paven ||2||
english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I meet with the Lord; this sinner has been sanctified. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜਗਿ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਾਥਰ ਸੇਨ ॥
transliteration: har ke jan ootam jag kaheeahi jin miliaa paathar sen ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord are said to be exalted in this world; meeting with them, even stones are softened.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਓਇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan kee mahimaa baran na saakau oi ootam har har ken ||3||
english: I cannot even describe the noble grandeur of such humble beings; the Lord, Har, Har, has made them sublime and exalted. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਨ ॥
transliteration: tumh har saah vade prabh suaamee ham vanajaare raas den ||
english: You, Lord are the Great Merchant-Banker; O God, my Lord and Master, I am just a poor peddler; please bless me with the wealth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਲਦਿ ਵਾਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਨ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau daiaa prabh dhaarahu lad vaakhar har har len ||4||2||
english: Please bestow Your Kindness and Mercy upon servant Nanak, God, so that he may load up the merchandise of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam paragaas ||
english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and be enlightened.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t mil preet lagaanee viche girah udaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meet with the Saints of the Lord, and focus your love; remain balanced and detached within your own household. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ham har hiradai japio naam narahar prabh kripaa karee kirapaas ||
english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Nar-Har, within my heart; God the Merciful has shown His Mercy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ ਉਦਮ ਭਏ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin anad bhaiaa man bigasiaa udam bhae milan kee aas ||1||
english: Night and day, I am in ecstasy; my mind has blossomed forth, rejuvenated. I am trying - I hope to meet my Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਿਤਨੇ ਸਾਸ ਲੀਏ ਹਮ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ham har suaamee preet lagaaee jitane saas leee ham graas ||
english: I am in love with the Lord, my Lord and Master; I love Him with every breath and morsel of food I take.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂਟਿ ਗਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਫਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kilabikh dahan bhae khin a(n)tar toot gae maaiaa ke phaas ||2||
english: My sins were burnt away in an instant; the noose of the bondage of Maya was loosened. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਿਰਮ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਰਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ham kiram kiaa karam kamaavahi moorakh mugadh rakhe prabh taas ||
english: I am such a worm! What karma am I creating? What can I do? I am a fool, a total idiot, but God has saved me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਨੀਆਰੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਭਾਰੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਰੇ ਤਰਾਸ ॥੩॥
transliteration: avaganeeaare paathar bhaare satasa(n)gat mil tare taraas ||3||
english: I am unworthy, heavy as stone, but joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am carried across to the other side. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਊਚ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਖਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jetee srisat karee jagadeesar te sabh ooch ham neech bikhiaas ||
english: The Universe which God created is all above me; I am the lowest, engrossed in corruption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: hamare avagun sa(n)g gur mete jan naanak mel leee prabh paas ||4||3||
english: With the Guru, my faults and demerits have been erased. Servant Nanak has been united with God Himself. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕ ॥
transliteration: merai man raam naam japio gur vaak ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, through the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਇਓ ਸਭ ਝਾਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa karee jagadeesar duramat doojaa bhaau gaio sabh jhaak ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, has shown me His Mercy, and my evil-mindedness, love of duality and sense of alienation are totally gone, thanks to the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਗੁਪਲਾਕ ॥
transliteration: naanaa roop ra(n)g har kere ghat ghat raam ravio gupalaak ||
english: There are so many forms and colors of the Lord. The Lord is pervading each and every heart, and yet He is hidden from view.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਉਘਰਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਤਾਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t mile har pragate ughar gae bikhiaa ke taak ||1||
english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, the Lord is revealed, and the doors of corruption are shattered. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਿਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਕ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee bahut bahu sobhaa jin ur dhaario har rasik rasaak ||
english: The glory of the Saintly beings is absolutely great; they lovingly enshrine the Lord of Bliss and Delight within their hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਗਊ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਛਰਾਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t mile har miliaa jaise gaoo dekh bachharaak ||2||
english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I meet with the Lord, just as when the calf is seen - the cow is there as well. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜਨਕ ਜਨਾਕ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t janaa mahi har har te jan ootam janak janaak ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is within the humble Saints of the Lord; they are exalted - they know, and they inspire others to know as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਾਨੀ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਮੁਸਕੀ ਮੁਸਕਾਕ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin har hiradai baas basaanee chhoot gaee musakee musakaak ||3||
english: The fragrance of the Lord permeates their hearts; they have abandoned the foul stench. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਅਪਨਾਕ ॥
transliteration: tumare jan tumh hee prabh keee har raakh lehu aapan apanaak ||
english: You make those humble beings Your Own, God; You protect Your Own, O Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਕ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke sakhaa har bhaaee maat pitaa ba(n)dhap har saak ||4||4||
english: The Lord is servant Nanak's companion; the Lord is his sibling, mother, father, relative and relation. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man har har raam naam jap cheet ||
english: O my mind, consciously chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗੜੑਿ ਵੇੜੑੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੀਓ ਗੜੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har vasat maaiaa gaRhi veRhee gur kai sabad leeo gaR jeet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The commodity of the Lord, Har, Har, is locked in the fortress of Maya; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have conquered the fortress. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਲੁਬਧੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮੋਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa bharam bharam bahu bhramiaa lubadho putr kalatr moh preet ||
english: In false doubt and superstition, people wander all around, lured by love and emotional attachment to their children and families.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਤੁਛ ਛਾਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਹ ਭੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaise taravar kee tuchh chhaaiaa khin mahi binas jaai deh bheet ||1||
english: But just like the passing shade of the tree, your body-wall shall crumble in an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: hamare praan preetam jan ootam jin miliaa man hoi prateet ||
english: The humble beings are exalted; they are my breath of life and my beloveds; meeting them, my mind is filled with faith.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਚੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: parachai raam raviaa ghat a(n)tar asathir raam raviaa ra(n)g preet ||2||
english: Deep within the heart, I am happy with the Pervading Lord; with love and joy, I dwell upon the Steady and Stable Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆਂ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sa(n)t jan neeke jin miliaa(n) man ra(n)g ra(n)geet ||
english: The humble Saints, the Saints of the Lord, are noble and sublime; meeting them, the mind is tinged with love and joy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g lahai na utarai kabahoo har har jaai milai har preet ||3||
english: The Lord's Love never fades away, and it never wears off. Through the Lord's Love, one goes and meets the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਟਿਤ ਕਟੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ham bahu paap keee aparaadhee gur kaate katit kateet ||
english: I am a sinner; I have committed so many sins. The Guru has cut them, cut them, and hacked them off.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: har har naam deeo mukh aukhadh jan naanak patit puneet ||4||5||
english: The Guru has placed the healing remedy of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, into my mouth. Servant Nanak, the sinner, has been purified and sanctified. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam jaga(n)naath ||
english: Chant, O my mind, the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ ਪਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghooman gher pare bikh bikhiaa satigur kaadh leee de haath ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I was caught in the whirlpool of poisonous sin and corruption. The True Guru gave me His Hand; He lifted me up and pulled me out. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥ ॥
transliteration: suaamee abhai nira(n)jan narahar tumh raakh lehu ham paapee paath ||
english: O my Fearless, Immaculate Lord and Master, please save me - I am a sinner, a sinking stone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਤੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਤਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam krodh bikhiaa lobh lubhate kaasat loh tare sa(n)g saath ||1||
english: I am lured and enticed by sexual desire, anger, greed and corruption, but associating with You, I am carried across, like iron in the wooden boat. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹਮ ਢੂਢਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: tumh vad purakh bad agam agochar ham dhoodh rahe paaee nahee haath ||
english: You are the Great Primal Being, the most Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord God; I search for You, but cannot find Your depth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too parai parai apara(n)par suaamee too aapan jaanahi aap jaga(n)naath ||2||
english: You are the farthest of the far, beyond the beyond, O my Lord and Master; You alone know Yourself, O Lord of the Universe. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਥ ॥
transliteration: adrisat agochar naam dhiaae satasa(n)gat mil saadhoo paath ||
english: I meditate on the Name of the Unseen and Unfathomable Lord; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have found the Path of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਅਕਥ ਕਥ ਕਾਥ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har kathaa sunee mil sa(n)gat har har japio akath kath kaath ||3||
english: Joining the congregation, I listen to the Gospel of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: hamare prabh jagadees gusaaee ham raakh lehu jaga(n)naath ||
english: My God is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe; please save me, O Lord of all Creation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਜਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak daas daas daasan ko prabh karahu kripaa raakhahu jan saath ||4||6||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the slave of Your slaves. O God, please bless me with Your Grace; please protect me and keep me with Your humble servants. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 paRataal ghar 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Fifth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: man jaapahu raam gupaal ||
english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har ratan javehar laal ||
english: The Lord is the Jewel, the Diamond, the Ruby.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘੜਿ ਟਕਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har guramukh ghaR takasaal ||
english: The Lord fashions the Gurmukhs in His Mint.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ho ho kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, please, please, be Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: tumare gun agam agochar ek jeeh kiaa kathai bichaaree raam raam raam raam laal ||
english: Your Glorious Virtues are inaccessible and unfathomable; how can my one poor tongue describe them? O my Beloved Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree jee akath kathaa too too too hee jaanahi hau har jap bhaee nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
english: O Dear Lord, You, You, You alone know Your Unspoken Speech. I have become enraptured, enraptured, enraptured, meditating on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜੀਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ॥
transliteration: hamare har praan sakhaa suaamee har meetaa mere man tan jeeh har hare hare raam naam dhan maal ||
english: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is my Companion and my Breath of Life; the Lord is my Best Friend. My mind, body and tongue are attuned to the Lord, Har, Haray, Haray. The Lord is my Wealth and Property.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਓ ਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: jaa ko bhaag tin leeo ree suhaag har har hare hare gun gaavai guramat hau bal bale hau bal bale jan naanak har jap bhaee nihaal nihaal nihaal ||2||1||7||
english: She alone obtains her Husband Lord, who is so pre-destined. Through the Guru's Teachings, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord Har.  am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord, O servant Nanak. Meditating on the Lord, I have become enraptured.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahu jagadees ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਜੀਹ ਕੀਚੈ ਲਖ ਬੀਸ ॥
transliteration: ekaa jeeh keechai lakh bees ||
english: Let my one tongue become two hundred thousand

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਪੀਸ ॥
transliteration: jap har har sabad japees ||
english: with them all, I will meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and chant the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪੀਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ho ho kirapees ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, please, please, be Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: har kirapaa kar suaamee ham laai har sevaa har jap jape har jap jape jap jaapau jagadees ||
english: O Lord, my Lord and Master, please be Merciful to me; please enjoin me to serve You. I chant and meditate on the Lord, I chant and meditate on the Lord, I chant and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮੇ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਜੀਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumare jan raam japahi te ootam tin kau hau ghum ghume ghum ghum jees ||1||
english: Your humble servants chant and meditate on You, O Lord; they are sublime and exalted. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੀਸ ॥
transliteration: har tum vad vade vade vad ooche so karahi j tudh bhaavees ||
english: O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great, the Greatest of the Great, the most Lofty and High. You do whatever You please.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬੀਸ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak a(n)mrit peeaa guramatee dhan dha(n)n dhan dha(n)n dha(n)n guroo saabees ||2||2||8||
english: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar through the Guru's Teachings. Blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed and praised is the Guru. ||2||2||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhaj raamo man raam ||
english: O mind, meditate and vibrate on the Lord, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਵਡਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jis roop na rekh vadaam ||
english: He has no form or feature - He is Great!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil bhaj raam ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, vibrate and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਡ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bad ho ho bhaag mathaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the high destiny written on your forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਨਦੋ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jit grihi ma(n)dar har hot jaas tit ghar aanado aana(n)d bhaj raam raam raam ||
english: That household, that mansion, in which the Lord's Praises are sung - that home is filled with ecstasy and joy; so vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam gun gaavahu har preetam upades guroo gur satiguraa sukh hot har hare har hare hare bhaj raam raam raam ||1||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Name of the Lord, the Beloved Lord. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru, you shall find peace. So vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Haray, the Lord, Raam |1|

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh sisat dhaar har tum kirapaal karataa sabh too too too raam raam raam ||
english: You are the Support of the whole universe, Lord; O Merciful Lord, You, You, You are the Creator of all, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੋ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: jan naanako saranaagatee dehu guramatee bhaj raam raam raam ||2||3||9||
english: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; please bless him with the Guru's Teachings, that he may vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam. ||2||3||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਾਟਉ ਪਗ ਚਾਟ ॥
transliteration: satigur chaatau pag chaat ||
english: I eagerly kiss the Feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਧਰ ਬਾਟ ॥
transliteration: jit mil har paadhar baat ||
english: Meeting Him, the Path to the Lord becomes smooth and easy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਟ ॥
transliteration: bhaj har ras ras har gaat ||
english: I lovingly vibrate and meditate on the Lord, and gulp down His Sublime Essence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ho ho likhe lilaat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord has written this destiny on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਜਟ ਜਟਾ ਜਟ ਜਾਟ ॥
transliteration: khat karam kiriaa kar bahu bahu bisathaar sidh saadhik jogeeaa kar jat jataa jat jaat ||
english: Some perform the six rituals and rites; the Siddhas, seekers and Yogis put on all sorts of pompous shows, with their hair all tangled and matted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar bhekh na paaeeai har braham jog har paaeeai satasa(n)gatee upades guroo gur sa(n)t janaa khol khol kapaat ||1||
english: Yoga - Union with the Lord God - is not obtained by wearing religious robes; the Lord is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the Guru's Teachings. The humble Saints throw the doors wide open. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਾਹੁ ਤੂ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਲ ਥਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕ ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਟ ॥
transliteration: too apara(n)par suaamee at agaahu too bharapur rahiaa jal thale har ik iko ik ekai har thaat ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are the farthest of the far, utterly unfathomable. You are totally pervading the water and the land. You alone are the One and Only Unique Lord of all creation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਟ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: too jaanahi sabh bidh boojhahi aape jan naanak ke prabh ghat ghate ghat ghate ghat har ghaat ||2||4||10||
english: You alone know all Your ways and means. You alone understand Yourself. Servant Nanak's Lord God is in each heart, in every heart, in the home of each and every heart. ||2||4||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: jap man gobid maadho ||
english: O mind, chant and meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: har har agam agaadho ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: mat guramat har prabh laadho ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect attains the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਧੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhur ho ho likhe lilaadho ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the pre-ordained destiny written on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚਿ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: bikh maaiaa sa(n)ch bahu chitai bikaar sukh paaeeai har bhaj sa(n)t sa(n)t sa(n)gatee mil satiguroo gur saadho ||
english: Collecting the poison of Maya, people think of all sorts of evil. But peace is found only by vibrating and meditating on the Lord; with the Saints, in the Sangat, the Society of the Saints, meet the True Guru, the Holy Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਛੁਹਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਨੂਰ ਭਏ ਕੰਚਨ ਤਿਉ ਪਤਿਤ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸੁਧ ਹੋਵਤ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਧ ਹਾਧੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu chhuhi paaras manoor bhae ka(n)chan tiu patit jan mil sa(n)gatee sudh hovat guramatee sudh haadho ||1||
english: Just as when the iron slag is transmuted into gold by touching the Philosopher's Stone - when the sinner joins the Sangat, he becomes pure, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸਟ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਬਹੁ ਤਰਤਾ ਤਿਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: jiu kaasat sa(n)g lohaa bahu tarataa tiu paapee sa(n)g tare saadh saadh sa(n)gatee gur satiguroo gur saadho ||
english: Just like the heavy iron which is carried across on the wooden raft, sinners are carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the Guru, the True Guru, the Holy Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਾਧੋ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: chaar baran chaar aasram hai koee milai guroo gur naanak so aap tarai kul sagal taraadho ||2||5||11||
english: There are four castes, four social classes, and four stages of life. Whoever meets the Guru, Guru Nanak, is himself carried across, and he carries all his ancestors and generations across as well. ||2||5||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: har jas gaavahu bhagavaan ||
english: Sing the Praises of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jas gaavat paap lahaan ||
english: Singing His Praises, sins are washed away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨ ॥
transliteration: mat guramat sun jas kaan ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, listen to His Praises with your ears.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ho ho kirapaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord shall be Merciful to you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: tere jan dhiaavahi ik man ik chit te saadhoo sukh paavahi jap har har naam nidhaan ||
english: Your humble servants focus their consciousness and meditate on You with one-pointed mind; those Holy beings find peace, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Treasure of Bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: usatat karahi prabh tereeaa mil saadhoo saadh janaa gur satiguroo bhagavaan ||1||
english: They sing Your Praises, God, meeting with the Holy, the Holy people, and the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਤਰੇ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਤੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jin kai hiradai too suaamee te sukh phal paavahi te tare bhav si(n)dh te bhagat har jaan ||
english: They alone obtain the fruit of peace, within whose hearts You, O my Lord and Master, abide. They cross over the terrifying world-ocean - they are known as the Lord's devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰੇ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
transliteration: tin sevaa ham laai hare ham laai hare jan naanak ke har too too too too too bhagavaan ||2||6||12||
english: Please enjoin me to their service, Lord, please enjoin me to their service. O Lord God, You, You, You, You, You are the Lord of servant Nanak. ||2||6||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਈਐ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: gaaeeai gun gopaal kripaa nidh ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, the Treasure of Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukh bidaaran sukhadaate satigur jaa kau bhetat hoi sagal sidh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru is the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of peace; meeting Him, one is totally fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam manahi saadhaarai ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Support of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot paraadhee khin mahi taarai ||1||
english: Millions of sinners are carried across in an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau cheet aavai gur apanaa ||
english: Whoever remembers his Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kau dookh nahee til supanaa ||2||
english: shall not suffer sorrow, even in dreams. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau satigur apanaa raakhai ||
english: Whoever keeps his Guru enshrined within

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so jan har ras rasanaa chaakhai ||3||
english: - that humble being tastes the sublime essence of the Lord with his tongue. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur keenee maiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has been Kind to me;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: halat palat mukh oojal bhaiaa ||4||1||
english: here and herafter, my face is radiant. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰਾਧਉ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
transliteration: aaraadhau tujhahi suaamee apane ||
english: I worship and adore You, my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat saas saas saas har japane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, with each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: taa kai hiradai basio naam ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within the hearts of those,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kau suaamee keeno daan ||1||
english: whose Lord and Master blesses them with this gift. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਆਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: taa kai hiradai aaee saa(n)t ||
english: Peace and tranquility come into the hearts of those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਾਂਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: thaakur bhete gur bachanaa(n)t ||2||
english: who meet their Lord and Master, through the Word of the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa soee parabeen ||
english: Those whom the Guru blesses with the Mantra of the Naam

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam ma(n)tr jaa kau gur deen ||3||
english: are wise, and blessed with all powers. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kai bal jaau ||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kalijug mahi paaiaa jin naau ||4||2||
english: who are blessed with the Name in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਸਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: keerat prabh kee gaau meree rasanaa(n) ||
english: Sing the Praises of God, O my tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਊਹਾਂ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik baar kar ba(n)dan sa(n)tan oohaa(n) charan gobi(n)d jee ke basanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Humbly bow to the Saints, over and over again; through them, the Feet of the Lord of the Universe shall come to abide within you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t kar duaar na paavau ||
english: The Door to the Lord cannot be found by any other means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi kripaal ta har har dhiaavau ||1||
english: When He becomes Merciful, we come to meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
transliteration: kot karam kar deh na sodhaa ||
english: The body is not purified by millions of rituals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mahi man parabodhaa ||2||
english: The mind is awakened and enlightened only in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: trisan na boojhee bahu ra(n)g maaiaa ||
english: Thirst and desire are not quenched by enjoying the many pleasures of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam lait sarab sukh paaiaa ||3||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is found. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jab bhae daiaal ||
english: When the Supreme Lord God becomes Merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tau chhoote ja(n)jaal ||4||3||
english: says Nanak, then one is rid of worldly entanglements. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਮਾਂਗੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: aisee maa(n)g gobid te ||
english: Beg for such blessings from the Lord of the Universe:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਜਪਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tahal sa(n)tan kee sa(n)g saadhoo kaa har naamaa(n) jap param gate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: to work for the Saints, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Chanting the Name of the Lord, the supreme status is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਰਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: poojaa charanaa thaakur saranaa ||
english: Worship the Feet of Your Lord and Master, and seek His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soee kusal j prabh jeeu karanaa ||1||
english: Take joy in whatever God does. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਹੋਤ ਇਹ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saphal hot ih duralabh dehee ||
english: This precious human body becomes fruitful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਇਆ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kau satigur maiaa karehee ||2||
english: when the True Guru shows His Kindness. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agiaan bharam binasai dukh deraa ||
english: The house of ignorance, doubt and pain is destroyed,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kai hridai basahi gur pairaa ||3||
english: for those within whose hearts the Guru's Feet abide. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g ra(n)g prabh dhiaaiaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, lovingly meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tin pooraa paaiaa ||4||4||
english: Says Nanak, you shall obtain the Perfect Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਹੂੰ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhagatan hoo(n) ban aaee ||
english: Devotion is the natural quality of God's devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ ਭਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਆਪਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man galat bhae thaakur siu aapan leee milaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Their bodies and minds are blended with their Lord and Master; He unites them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gaavanahaaree gaavai geet ||
english: The singer sings the songs,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਸੇ ਜਿਹ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: te udhare base jih cheet ||1||
english: but she alone is saved, within whose consciousness the Lord abides. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੇ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਪਰੋਸਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: pekhe bi(n)jan parosanahaarai ||
english: The one who sets the table sees the food,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jih bhojan keeno te tripataarai ||2||
english: but only one who eats the food is satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗ ਕਾਛੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anik svaa(n)g kaachhe bhekhadhaaree ||
english: People disguise themselves with all sorts of costumes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਸਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaiso saa taiso drisataaree ||3||
english: but in the end, they are seen as they truly are. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kahan kahaavan sagal ja(n)jaar ||
english: Speaking and talking are all just entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak daas sach karanee saar ||4||5||
english: O slave Nanak, the true way of life is excellent. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tero jan har jas sunat umaahio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your humble servant listens to Your Praises with delight. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manahi pragaas pekh prabh kee sobhaa jat kat pekhau aahio ||1||
english: My mind is enlightened, gazing upon the Glory of God. Wherever I look, there He is. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh te parai parai te oochaa gahir ga(n)bheer athaahio ||2||
english: You are the farthest of all, the highest of the far, profound, unfathomable and unreachable. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਦਾ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ot pot milio bhagatan kau jan siu paradaa laahio ||3||
english: You are united with Your devotees, through and through; You have removed Your veil for Your humble servants. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: gur prasaad gaavai gun naanak sahaj samaadh samaahio ||4||6||
english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; he is intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan pahi aap udhaaran aaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have come to the Saints to save myself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan bhetat hot puneetaa har har ma(n)tr driRaaio ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I am sanctified; they have implanted the Mantra of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaate rog bhae man niramal har har aukhadh khaaio ||2||
english: The disease has been eradicated, and my mind has become immaculate. I have taken the healing medicine of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਤ ਭਏ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: asathit bhae base sukh thaanaa bahur na katahoo dhaaio ||3||
english: I have become steady and stable, and I dwell in the home of peace. I shall never again wander anywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਲੋਗਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad tare kul logaa naanak lipat na maaio ||4||7||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, the people and all their generations are saved; O Nanak, they are not engrossed in Maya. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bisar gaee sabh taat paraaee ||
english: I have totally forgotten my jealousy of others,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab te saadhasa(n)gat mohi paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: since I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa ko bairee nahee bigaanaa sagal sa(n)g ham kau ban aaee ||1||
english: No one is my enemy, and no one is a stranger. I get along with everyone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo prabh keeno so bhal maanio eh sumat saadhoo te paaee ||2||
english: Whatever God does, I accept that as good. This is the sublime wisdom I have obtained from the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਈ ॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: sabh mahi rav rahiaa prabh ekai pekh pekh naanak bigasaaee ||3||8||
english: The One God is pervading in all. Gazing upon Him, beholding Him, Nanak blossoms forth in happiness. ||3||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਪਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: thaakur jeeu tuhaaro paranaa ||
english: O my Dear Lord and Master, You alone are my Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maan mahat tumhaarai oopar tumhree ot tumhaaree saranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my Honor and Glory; I seek Your Support, and Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tumhree aas bharosaa tumhraa tumaraa naam ridai lai dharanaa ||
english: You are my Hope, and You are my Faith. I take Your Name and enshrine it within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਬਲੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaro bal tum sa(n)g suhele jo jo kahahu soee soee karanaa ||1||
english: You are my Power; associating with You, I am embellished and exalted. I do whatever You say. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਤ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tumaree daiaa maiaa sukh paavau hohu kripaal ta bhaujal taranaa ||
english: Through Your Kindness and Compassion, I find peace; when You are Merciful, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਿਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: abhai daan naam har paaio sir daario naanak sa(n)t charanaa ||2||9||
english: Through the Name of the Lord, I obtain the gift of fearlessness; Nanak places his head on the feet of the Saints. ||2||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadh saran charan chit laaiaa ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, I focus my consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: supan kee baat sunee pekhee supanaa naam ma(n)tr satiguroo driRaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When I was dreaming, I heard and saw only dream-objects. The True Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੋ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nah tripataano raaj joban dhan bahur bahur phir dhaaiaa ||
english: Power, youth and wealth do not bring satisfaction; people chase after them again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukh paaiaa trisanaa sabh bujhee hai saa(n)t paaee gun gaaiaa ||1||
english: I have found peace and tranquility, and all my thirsty desires have been quenched, singing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੂ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe pasoo kee niaaee bhram mohi biaapio maaiaa ||
english: Without understanding, they are like beasts, engrossed in doubt, emotional attachment and Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jam jevaree kaatee naanak sahaj samaaiaa ||2||10||
english: But in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the noose of Death is cut, O Nanak, and one intuitively merges in celestial peace. ||2||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan hiradai gaai ||
english: Sing of the Lord's Feet within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: seetalaa sukh saa(n)t moorat simar simar nit dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate, meditate in constant remembrance on God, the Embodiment of soothing peace and cooling tranquility. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਹੋਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal aas hot pooran kot janam dukh jaai ||1||
english: All your hopes shall be fulfilled, and the pain of millions of deaths and births shall be gone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan anek kiriaa saadhoo sa(n)g samaai ||
english: Immerse yourself in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall obtain the benefits of giving charitable gifts, and all sorts of good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: taap sa(n)taap mite naanak baahuR kaal na khaai ||2||11||
english: Sorrow and suffering shall be erased, O Nanak, and you shall never again be devoured by death. ||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
