gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥੀਐ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: katheeai sa(n)tasa(n)g prabh giaan ||
english: Speak of God's Wisdom in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooran param jot paramesur simarat paaeeai maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Supreme Divine Light, the Transcendent Lord God, honor and glory are obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਰਹੇ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat rahe sram naase simarat saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: One's comings and goings in reincarnation cease, and suffering is dispelled, meditating in remembrance in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: patit puneet hohi khin bheetar paarabraham kai ra(n)g ||1||
english: Sinners are sanctified in an instant, in the love of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਥੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jo jo kathai sunai har keeratan taa kee duramat naas ||
english: Whoever speaks and listens to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is rid of evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sagal manorath paavai naanak pooran hovai aas ||2||1||12||
english: All hopes and desires, O Nanak, are fulfilled. ||2||1||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat nidh har ko naam ||
english: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee jee kai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is the Companion of the soul, its Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ren nit majan karai ||
english: Continually bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh harai ||1||
english: the sins of countless incarnations are washed away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਚੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee oochee baanee ||
english: The words of the humble Saints are lofty and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩॥
transliteration: simar simar tare naanak praanee ||2||2||13||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, mortal beings are carried across and saved. ||2||2||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo har hare gun gaai ||
english: O Holy people, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Haray.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maan tan dhan praan prabh ke simarat dukh jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Mind, body, wealth and the breath of life - all come from God; remembering Him in meditation, pain is taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਹਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਵਹਿ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eet oot kahaa loubhaavahi ek siu man laai ||1||
english: Why are you entangled in this and that? Let your mind be attuned to the One. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤ ਆਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mahaa pavitr sa(n)t aasan mil sa(n)g gobid dhiaai ||2||
english: The place of the Saints is utterly sacred; meet with them, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag saran aaio naanak lehu milaai ||3||3||14||
english: O Nanak, I have abandoned everything and come to Your Sanctuary. Please let me merge with You. ||3||3||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਉ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਇਕਾਂਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pekh pekh bigasaau saajan prabh aapanaa ikaa(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon and beholding my Best Friend, I blossom forth in bliss; my God is the One and Only. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aanadaa sukh sahaj moorat tis aan naahee bhaa(n)t ||1||
english: He is the Image of Ecstasy, Intuitive Peace and Poise. There is no other like Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਜਾਂਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simarat ik baar har har mit kot kasamal jaa(n)t ||2||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, even once, millions of sins are erased. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਰਿਦ ਭਇਅੰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun rama(n)t dookh naasahi rid bhaia(n)t saa(n)t ||3||
english: Uttering His Glorious Praises, suffering is eradicated, and the heart becomes tranquil and calm. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: a(n)mritaa ras peeu rasanaa naanak har ra(n)g raat ||4||4||15||
english: Drink in the Sweet, Sublime Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, and be imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||4||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਆਉ ਮੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saajanaa sa(n)t aau merai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O friends, O Saints, come to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਸਮਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਰੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aanadaa gun gaai ma(n)gal kasamalaa mit jaahi parerai ||1||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with pleasure and joy, the sins will be erased and thrown away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਧਰਉ ਮਾਥੈ ਚਾਂਦਨਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t charan dharau maathai chaa(n)danaa grihi hoi a(n)dherai ||2||
english: Touch your forehead to the feet of the Saints, and your dark household shall be illumined. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad kamal bigasai gobi(n)d bhajau pekh nerai ||3||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and see Him near at hand. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਏ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਹ ਬੇਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
transliteration: prabh kripaa te sa(n)t paae vaar vaar naanak uh berai ||4||5||16||
english: By the Grace of God, I have found the Saints. Over and over again, Nanak is a sacrifice to that moment. ||4||5||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: charan saran gopaal teree ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਧੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਾਟਿ ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: moh maan dhoh bharam raakh leejai kaat beree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Save me from emotional attachment, pride, deception and doubt; please cut away these ropes which bind me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
transliteration: boodat sa(n)saar saagar ||
english: I am drowning in the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: udhare har simar ratanaagar ||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Source of Jewels, I am saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: seetalaa har naam teraa ||
english: Your Name, Lord, is cooling and soothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poorano thaakur prabh meraa ||2||
english: God, my Lord and Master, is Perfect. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ॥
transliteration: deen darad nivaar taaran ||
english: You are the Deliverer, the Destroyer of the sufferings of the meek and the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kripaa nidh patit udhaaran ||3||
english: The Lord is the Treasure of Mercy, the Saving Grace of sinners. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਦੂਖ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kot janam dookh kar paaio ||
english: I have suffered the pains of millions of incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sukhee naanak gur naam driRaaio ||4||6||17||
english: Nanak is at peace; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||4||6||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan uh preet charan sa(n)g laagee ||
english: Blessed is that love, which is attuned to the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot jaap taap sukh paae aai mile pooran badabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The peace which comes from millions of chants and deep meditations is obtained by perfect good fortune and destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: mohi anaath daas jan teraa avar ot sagalee mohi tiaagee ||
english: I am Your helpless servant and slave; I have given up all other support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਰ ਭਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhor bharam kaate prabh simarat giaan a(n)jan mil sovat jaagee ||1||
english: Every trace of doubt has been eradicated, remembering God in meditation. I have applied the ointment of spiritual wisdom, and awakened from my sleep. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਤਨਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: too athaahu at bado suaamee kripaa si(n)dh pooran ratanaagee ||
english: You are Unfathomably Great and Utterly Vast, O my Lord and Master, Ocean of Mercy, Source of Jewels.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਆਨਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak jaachak har har naam maa(n)gai masatak aan dhario prabh paagee ||2||7||18||
english: Nanak, the beggar, begs for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he rests his forehead upon God's Feet. ||2||7||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਪਟ ਕਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: kuchil kathor kapat kaamee ||
english: I am filthy, hard-hearted, deceitful and obsessed with sexual desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu jaanahi tiu taar suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please carry me across, as You wish, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too samarath saran jog too raakhahi apanee kal dhaar ||1||
english: You are All-powerful and Potent to grant Sanctuary. Exerting Your Power, You protect us. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap nem such sa(n)jam naahee in bidhe chhutakaar ||
english: Chanting and deep meditation, penance and austere self-discipline, fasting and purification - salvation does not come by any of these means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੯॥
transliteration: garat ghor a(n)dh te kaadhahu prabh naanak nadar nihaar ||2||8||19||
english: Please lift me up and out of this deep, dark ditch; O God, please bless Nanak with Your Glance of Grace. ||2||8||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naaraain narapat namasakaarai ||
english: The one who bows in humble reverence to the Primal Lord, the Lord of all beings

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aise gur kau bal bal jaaeeai aap mukat mohi taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to such a Guru; He Himself is liberated, and He carries me across as well. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan kavan kavan gun kaheeai a(n)t nahee kachh paarai ||
english: Which, which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I chant? There is no end or limitation to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਕਈ ਕੋਰੈ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਐਸੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laakh laakh laakh kaee korai ko hai aiso beechaarai ||1||
english: There are thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, many millions of them, but those who contemplate them are very rare. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੀ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਲ ਰੰਗਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bisam bisam bisam hee bhaee hai laal gulaal ra(n)gaarai ||
english: I am wonder-struck, wonder-struck, wonder-struck and amazed, dyed in the deep crimson color of my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸੁ ਆਈ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਖਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)tan ras aaee hai jiu chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaarai ||2||1||20||
english: Says Nanak, the Saints savor this sublime essence, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but only smiles. ||2||1||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ॥
transliteration: na jaanee sa(n)tan prabh bin aan ||
english: The Saints do not know any other except God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ooch neech sabh pekh samaano mukh bakano man maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They look upon all equally, the high and the low; they speak of Him with their mouths, and honor Him in their minds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat poor rahe sukh saagar bhai bha(n)jan mere praan ||
english: He is pervading and permeating each and every heart; He is the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of fear. He is my praanaa - the Breath of Life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਨਾਸਿਓ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manahi pragaas bhaio bhram naasio ma(n)tr deeo gur kaan ||1||
english: My mind was enlightened, and my doubt was dispelled, when the Guru whispered His Mantra into my ears. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਰਹੇ ਕ੍ਰਤਗੵ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਗੵਿਾਨ ॥
transliteration: karat rahe kratagy karunaa mai a(n)tarajaamee gyiaan ||
english: He is All-powerful, the Ocean of Mercy, the All-knowing Searcher of Hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਂਗਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar naanak jas gaavai maa(n)gan kau har daan ||2||2||21||
english: Twenty-four hours a day Nanak sings His Praises, and begs for the Gift of the Lord. ||2||2||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਕਈ ਕੇਤੈ ॥
transliteration: kahan kahaavan kau kaee ketai ||
english: Many speak and talk about God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਤਤ ਜੋਗ ਕਉ ਬੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aiso jan biralo hai sevak jo tat jog kau betai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But one who understands the essence of Yoga - such a humble servant is very rare||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੀ ਨੇਤੈ ॥
transliteration: dukh naahee sabh sukh hee hai re ekai ekee netai ||
english: He has no pain - he is totally at peace. With his eyes, he sees only the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਭਲਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਜੇਤੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: buraa nahee sabh bhalaa hee hai re haar nahee sabh jetai ||1||
english: No one seems evil to him - all are good. There is no defeat - he is totally victorious. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਤੈ ॥
transliteration: sog naahee sadaa harakhee hai re chhod naahee kichh letai ||
english: He is never in sorrow - he is always happy; but he gives this up, and does not take anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਰਮਤੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jan har har har hai kat aavai kat ramatai ||2||3||22||
english: Says Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is himself the Lord, Har, Har; he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||3||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੀਏ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: heee ko preetam bisar na jaai ||
english: I pray that my heart may never forget my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ ਭਏ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man galat bhae tih sa(n)ge mohanee mohi rahee moree maai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My body and mind are blended with Him, but the Enticer, Maya, is enticing me, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਹਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਤੇਊ ਤੇਊ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਟਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jai jai pahi kahau brithaa hau apunee teoo teoo gahe rahe atakaai ||
english: Those unto whom I tell my pain and frustration - they themselves are caught and stuck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗੰਠਿ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t kee ekai jaalee taa kee ga(n)th nahee chhoraai ||1||
english: In all sorts of ways, Maya has cast the net; the knots cannot be loosened. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਆਇਓ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat naanak daas aaio sa(n)tan hee saranaai ||
english: Wandering and roaming, slave Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੀਓ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
transliteration: kaate agiaan bharam moh maaiaa leeo ka(n)th lagaai ||2||4||23||
english: The bonds of ignorance, doubt, emotional attachment and the love of Maya have been cut; God hugs me close in His Embrace. ||2||4||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aanad ra(n)g binod hamaarai ||
english: My home is filled with ecstasy, pleasure and joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naamo gaavan naam dhiaavan naam hamaare praan adhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I sing the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. The Naam is the Support of my breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naamo giaan naam isanaanaa har naam hamaare kaaraj savaarai ||
english: The Naam is spiritual wisdom, the Naam is my purifying bath. The Naam resolves all my affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਡਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naamo sobhaa naam badaaee bhaujal bikham naam har taarai ||1||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious grandeur; the Naam is glorious greatness. The Name of the Lord carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: agam padaarath laal amolaa bhaio paraapat gur charanaarai ||
english: The Unfathomable Treasure, the Priceless Gem - I have received it, through the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਦਰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh bhae kripaalaa magan bhae heearai darasaarai ||2||5||24||
english: Says Nanak, God has become Merciful; my heart is intoxicated by the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||2||5||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet suaamee nero ||
english: My Friend, my Best Friend, my Lord and Master, is near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਥੋਰੈ ਕਾਜ ਬੁਰੋ ਕਹ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pekhat sunat sabhan kai sa(n)ge thorai kaaj buro kah phero ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He sees and hears everything; He is with everyone. You are here for such short time - why do you do evil? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੇਤੋ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਕਛੂ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa jeto lapataaio kachhoo nahee naahee kachh tero ||
english: Except for the Naam, whatever you are involved with is nothing - nothing is yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵਤ ਸਭ ਪਰਗਟ ਈਹਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagai drisat aavat sabh paragat eehaa mohio bharam a(n)dhero ||1||
english: Hereafter, everything is revealed to your gaze; but in this world, all are enticed by the darkness of doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਕਿਓ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਬਿਸੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: atakio sut banitaa sa(n)g maaiaa devanahaar daataar bisero ||
english: People are caught in Maya, attached to their children and spouses. They have forgotten the Great and Generous Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਰੋਸਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ekai bhaarosau ba(n)dhan kaatanahaar gur mero ||2||6||25||
english: Says Nanak, I have one article of faith; my Guru is the One who releases me from bondage. ||2||6||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਦਲੁ ਸੰਤਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਗਾਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: bikhai dal sa(n)tan tumhrai gaahio ||
english: Your Saints have overwhelmed the wicked army of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumaree tek bharosaa thaakur saran tumhaaree aahio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They take Your Support and place their faith in You, O my Lord and Master; they seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਿਟਾਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke mahaa paraachhat darasan bhet mitaahio ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the terrible sins of countless lifetimes are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨਦ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaio pragaas anad ujeeaaraa sahaj samaadh samaahio ||1||
english: I am illumined, enlightened and filled with ecstasy. I am intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਥਾਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kaun kahai tum te kachh naahee tum samarath athaahio ||
english: Who says that You cannot do everything? You are Infinitely All-powerful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan ra(n)g roop ras naam naanak lai laahio ||2||7||26||
english: O Treasure of Mercy, Nanak savors Your Love and Your Blissful Form, earning the Profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: boodat praanee har jap dheerai ||
english: The drowning mortal is comforted and consoled, meditating on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੀਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binasai mohu bharam dukh peerai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is rid of emotional attachment, doubt, pain and suffering. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: simarau din rain gur ke charanaa ||
english: I meditate in remembrance, day and night, on the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau tumaree saranaa ||1||
english: Wherever I look, I see Your Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad har ke gun gaaiaa ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
transliteration: gur bhetat naanak sukh paaiaa ||2||8||27||
english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has found peace. ||2||8||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam manahi sukh paaeeai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, peace of mind is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa mil har jas gaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting the Holy Saint, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh ridai basero ||
english: Granting His Grace, God has come to dwell within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਥਾ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan sa(n)tan kai maathaa mero ||1||
english: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kau simarahu manaa(n) ||
english: Meditate, O my mind, on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੮॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak har jas sunaa(n) ||2||9||28||
english: As Gurmukh, Nanak listens to the Praises of the Lord. ||2||9||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਸਨ ॥
transliteration: mere man preet charan prabh parasan ||
english: My mind loves to touch the Feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ਅਖੀਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har har bhojan tripataanee akheean kau sa(n)tokh prabh darasan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My tongue is satisfied with the Food of the Lord, Har, Har. My eyes are contented with the Blessed Vision of God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਲਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ ਮਲ ਹਰਸਨ ॥
transliteration: karanan poor rahio jas preetam kalamal dokh sagal mal harasan ||
english: My ears are filled with the Praise of my Beloved; all my foul sins and faults are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਧਾਵਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਸਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paavan dhaavan suaamee sukh pa(n)thaa a(n)g sa(n)g kaaiaa sa(n)t sarasan ||1||
english: My feet follow the Path of Peace to my Lord and Master; my body and limbs joyfully blossom forth in the Society of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕਿਤ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਸਨ ॥
transliteration: saran gahee pooran abinaasee aan upaav thakit nahee karasan ||
english: I have taken Sanctuary in my Perfect, Eternal, Imperishable Lord. I do not bother trying anything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੯॥
transliteration: kar gahi leee naanak jan apane a(n)dh ghor saagar nahee marasan ||2||10||29||
english: Taking them by the hand, O Nanak, God saves His humble servants; they shall not perish in the deep, dark world-ocean. ||2||10||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਹਕਤ ਕਪਟ ਖਪਟ ਖਲ ਗਰਜਤ ਮਰਜਤ ਮੀਚੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kuhakat kapat khapat khal garajat marajat meech anik bareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those fools who bellow with rage and destructive deceit, are crushed and killed innumerable times. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰ ਮਤ ਅਨ ਰਤ ਕੁਮਿਤ ਹਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪੇਖਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਲਾਖ ਗਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aha(n) mat an rat kumit hit preetam pekhat bhramat laakh gareeaa ||1||
english: Intoxicated with egotism and imbued with other tastes, I am in love with my evil enemies. My Beloved watches over me as I wander through thousands of incarnations. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੀਨਤ ਮਮ ਮਦ ਮਾਤ ਕੋਪ ਜਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: anit biuhaar achaar bidh heenat mam mad maat kop jareeaa ||
english: My dealings are false, and my lifestyle is chaotic. Intoxicated with the wine of emotion, I am burning in the fire of anger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
transliteration: karun kripaal goupaal deen ba(n)dh naanak udhar saran pareeaa ||2||11||30||
english: O Merciful Lord of the World, Embodiment of Compassion, Relative of the meek and the poor, please save Nanak; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||11||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jee praan maan daataa ||
english: The Giver of the soul, the breath of life and honor

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤੇ ਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bisarate hee haan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - forgetting the Lord, all is lost. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੋ ਡਾਰਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਾਗਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d tiaag aan laagahi a(n)mrito daar bhoom paagahi ||
english: You have forsaken the Lord of the Universe, and become attached to another - you are throwing away the Ambrosial Nectar, to take dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਸਿਉ ਆਸਕਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikhai ras siu aasakat mooRe kaahe sukh maan ||1||
english: What do you expect from corrupt pleasures? You fool! What makes you think that they will bring peace? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਜਨਮ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh biaapio janam hee kee khaan ||
english: Engrossed in unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and greed, you shall be consigned to reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੧॥
transliteration: patit paavan saran aaio udhar naanak jaan ||2||12||31||
english: But I have entered the Sanctuary of the Purifier of sinners. O Nanak, I know that I shall be saved. ||2||12||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਲੋਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਖਾਰਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: avilokau raam ko mukhaarabi(n)d ||
english: I gaze on the Lotus-like Face of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat ratan paaio bisaree sabh chi(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Searching and seeking, I have found the Jewel. I am totally rid of all anxiety. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal ridai dhaar ||
english: Enshrining His Lotus Feet within my heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: utariaa dukh ma(n)d ||1||
english: pain and wickedness have been dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: raaj dhan paravaar merai sarabaso gobi(n)d ||
english: The Lord of all the Universe is my kingdom, wealth and family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰੰਦ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam laabh paaio naanak phir na mara(n)d ||2||13||32||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has earned the Profit; he shall never die again. ||2||13||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਜਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh poojaho naam araadh ||
english: Worship God, and adore His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur charanee laag ||
english: Grasp the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: har paavahu man agaadh ||
english: The Unfathomable Lord shall come into your mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jag jeeto ho ho gur kirapaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and by Guru's Grace, you shall be victorious in this world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਜੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: anik poojaa mai bahu bidh khojee saa poojaa j har bhaavaas ||
english: I have studied countless ways of worship in all sorts of ways, but that alone is worship, which is pleasing to the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਏਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: maatee kee ih putaree joree kiaa eh karam kamaas ||
english: This body-puppet is made of clay - what can it do by itself?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh baah pakar jis maarag paavahu so tudh ja(n)t milaas ||1||
english: O God, those humble beings meet You, whom You grasp by the arm, and place on the Path. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: avar ot mai koi na soojhai ik har kee ot mai aas ||
english: I do not know of any other support; O Lord, You are my only Hope and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa deen kare aradaas ||
english: I am meek and poor - what prayer can I offer?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸਭ ਘਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jau sabh ghat prabhoo nivaas ||
english: God abides in every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: prabh charanan kee man piaas ||
english: My mind is thirsty for the Feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak daas kaheeat hai tumhraa hau bal bal sad bal jaas ||2||1||33||
english: Servant Nanak, Your slave, speaks: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jagat udhaaran naam pri terai ||
english: Your Name, O my Beloved, is the Saving Grace of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nav nidh naam nidhaan har kerai ||
english: The Lord's Name is the wealth of the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੂਪੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g ra(n)g ra(n)g anooperai ||
english: One who is imbued with the Love of the Incomparably Beautiful Lord is joyful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaahe re man mohi maganerai ||
english: O mind, why do you cling to emotional attachments?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nainahu dekh saadh daraserai ||
english: With your eyes, gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so paavai jis likhat lilerai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They alone find it, who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sevau saadh sa(n)t charanerai ||
english: I serve at the feet of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: baa(n)chhau dhoor pavitr karerai ||
english: I long for the dust of their feet, which purifies and sanctifies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਟੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: athasath majan mail katerai ||
english: Just like the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, it washes away filth and pollution.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saas saas dhiaavahu mukh nahee morai ||
english: With each and every breath I meditate on Him, and never turn my face away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kichh sa(n)g na chaalai laakh karorai ||
english: Of your thousands and millions, nothing shall go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੁਕਰੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh jee ko naam a(n)t pukarorai ||1||
english: Only the Name of God will call to you in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਨਿ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: manasaa maan ek nira(n)kerai ||
english: Let it be your wish to honor and obey the One Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaagahu bhaau doojerai ||
english: Abandon the love of everything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan kahaa(n) hau gun pri terai ||
english: What Glorious Praises of Yours can I utter, O my Beloved?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਏਕ ਟੁਲੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: baran na saakau ek tulerai ||
english: I cannot describe even one of Your Virtues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: darasan piaas bahut man merai ||
english: My mind is so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: mil naanak dev jagat gur kerai ||2||1||34||
english: Please come and meet Nanak, O Divine Guru of the World. ||2||1||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਕਉਨ ਬਿਧੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aisee kaun bidhe darasan parasanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਉਮਗਿ ਹੀਉ ਤਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aas piaas saphal moorat umag heeu tarasanaa ||1||
english: I hope and thirst for Your wish-fulfilling image; my heart yearns and longs for You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਲੀਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੀਨ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ॥
transliteration: deen leen piaas meen sa(n)tanaa har sa(n)tanaa ||
english: The meek and humble Saints are like thirsty fish; the Saints of the Lord are absorbed in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)tanaa kee ren ||
english: I am the dust of the feet of the Lord's Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੀਉ ਅਰਪਿ ਦੇਨ ॥
transliteration: heeu arap den ||
english: I dedicate my heart to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਕਿਰਪੇਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhae hai kirapen ||
english: God has become Merciful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭੇਟਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
transliteration: maan mohu tiaag chhodio tau naanak har jeeu bhetanaa ||2||2||35||
english: Renouncing pride and leaving behind emotional attachment, O Nanak, one meets with the Dear Lord. ||2||2||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਾ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਨ ਕੇ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)gaa ra(n)g ra(n)gan ke ra(n)gaa ||
english: The Playful Lord imbues all with the Color of His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keet hasat pooran sabh sa(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: From the ant to the elephant, He is permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਹਿਤ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: barat nem teerath sahit ga(n)gaa ||
english: Some go on fasts, make vows, and take pilgrimages to sacred shrines on the Ganges.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਹੇਵਤ ਭੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਨੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jal hevat bhookh ar na(n)gaa ||
english: They stand naked in the water, enduring hunger and poverty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਮੇਲੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: poojaachaar karat mela(n)gaa ||
english: They sit cross-legged, perform worship services and do good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਕਰਮ ਤਿਲਕ ਖਾਟੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: chakr karam tilak khaata(n)gaa ||
english: They apply religious symbols to their bodies, and ceremonial marks to their limbs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan bhete bin satasa(n)gaa ||1||
english: They read through the Shaastras, but they do not join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਟੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: hath nigrahi at rahat bita(n)gaa ||
english: They stubbornly practice ritualistic postures, standing on their heads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਭੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: hau rog biaapai chukai na bha(n)gaa ||
english: They are afflicted with the disease of egotism, and their faults are not covered up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਜਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh at trisan jara(n)gaa ||
english: They burn in the fire of sexual frustration, unresolved anger and compulsive desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੬॥
transliteration: so mukat naanak jis satigur cha(n)gaa ||2||3||36||
english: He alone is liberated, O Nanak, whose True Guru is Good. ||2||3||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਖ ਬੂਝਿ ਗਈ ਗਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tikh boojh gaee gaee mil saadh janaa ||
english: My thirst has been quenched, meeting with the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭਾਗੇ ਚੋਰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੈਨੋ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bhaage chor sahaje sukhaino hare gun gaavatee gaavatee gaavatee daras piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The five thieves have run away, and I am in peace and poise; singing, singing, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I obtain the Blessed Vision of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਐਸੀ ਹਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: jaisee karee prabh mo siu mo siu aisee hau kaise karau ||
english: That which God has done for me - how can I do that for Him in return?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੀਉ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: heeu tumhaare bal bale bal bale bal gaee ||1||
english: I make my heart a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pahile pai sa(n)t paai dhiaai dhiaai preet laai ||
english: First, I fall at the feet of the Saints; I meditate, meditate, lovingly attuned to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੇਹਰੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh thaan tero keharo jit ja(n)tan kar beechaar ||
english: O God, where is that Place, where You contemplate all Your beings?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anik daas keerat karahi tuhaaree ||
english: Countless slaves sing Your Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: soee milio jo bhaavato jan naanak thaakur rahio samaai ||
english: He alone meets You, who is pleasing to Your Will. Servant Nanak remains absorbed in his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: ek toohee toohee toohee ||2||1||37||
english: You, You, You alone, Lord. ||2||1||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 8 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਪੇਖਤਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ਹਾਂ ਹਾਂ ਮਨ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tiaageeai gumaan maan pekhataa daiaal laal haa(n) haa(n) man charan ren ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Give up your pride and your self-conceit; the Loving, Merciful Lord is watching over all. O mind, become the dust of His Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har sa(n)t ma(n)t gupaal giaan dhiaan ||1||
english: Through the Mantra of the Lord's Saints, experience the spiritual wisdom and meditation of the Lord of the World. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hiradai gobi(n)d gaai charan kamal preet laai deen daiaal mohanaa ||
english: Within your heart, sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and be lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet. He is the Fascinating Lord, Merciful to the meek and the humble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kripaal daiaa maiaa dhaar ||
english: O Merciful Lord, please bless me with Your Kindness and Compassion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak maagai naam daan ||
english: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੮॥
transliteration: taj mohu bharam sagal abhimaan ||2||1||38||
english: I have abandoned emotional attachment, doubt and all egotistical pride. ||2||1||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਨ ਮਲਨ ਦਹਨ ਲਹਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh kahan malan dahan lahan gur mile aan nahee upaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Speaking of God, filth and pollution are burnt away; This comes by meeting with the Guru, and not by any other efforts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਟਨ ਖਟਨ ਜਟਨ ਹੋਮਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੰਡਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tatan khatan jatan homan naahee da(n)dadhaar suaau ||1||
english: Making pilgrimages to sacred rivers, observing the six rituals, wearing matted and tangled hair, performing fire sacrifices and carrying ceremonial walking sticks - none of these are of any use. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਭਾਂਤਨ ਤਪਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਥਨ ਕਥਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jatan bhaa(n)tan tapan bhraman anik kathan kathate nahee thaah paaee thaau ||
english: All sorts of efforts, austerities, wanderings and various speeches - none of these will lead you to find the Lord's Place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਿ ਸਗਰ ਸੋਧਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੯॥
transliteration: sodh sagar sodhanaa sukh naanakaa bhaj naau ||2||2||39||
english: I have considered all considerations, O Nanak, but peace comes only by vibrating and meditating on the Name. ||2||2||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 9 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan bhagat bachhal bhai haran taaran taran ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear - He carries us across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਤਿਪਤੇ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੋਖਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਰਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nain tipate daras pekh jas tokh sunat karan ||1||
english: My eyes are satisfied, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; my ears are satisfied, hearing His Praise. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਨ ॥
transliteration: praan naath anaath daate deen gobid saran ||
english: He is the Master of the praanaa, the breath of life; He is the Giver of Support to the unsupported. I am meek and poor - I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੦॥
transliteration: aas pooran dukh binaasan gahee ot naanak har charan ||2||1||40||
english: He is the Fulfiller of hope, the Destroyer of pain. Nanak grasps the Support of the Feet of the Lord. ||2||1||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: charan saran daiaal thaakur aan naahee jaai ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Feet of my Merciful Lord and Master; I do not go anywhere else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਧਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan birad suaamee udharate har dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is the Inherent Nature of our Lord and Master to purify sinners. Those who meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੈਸਾਰ ਗਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਤਿਤ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਅੰਧ ॥
transliteration: saisaar gaar bikaar saagar patit moh maan a(n)dh ||
english: The world is a swamp of wickedness and corruption. The blind sinner has fallen into the ocean of emotional attachment and pride,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਕਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੰਧ ॥
transliteration: bikal maaiaa sa(n)g dha(n)dh ||
english: bewildered by the entanglements of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar gahe prabh aap kaadhahu raakh lehu gobi(n)d raai ||1||
english: God Himself has taken me by the hand and lifted me up and out of it; save me, O Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: anaath naath sanaath sa(n)tan kot paap binaas ||
english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Supporting Lord of the Saints, the Neutralizer of millions of sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੈ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: man darasanai kee piaas ||
english: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabh pooran gunataas ||
english: God is the Perfect Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੧॥
transliteration: kripaal daiaal gupaal naanak har rasanaa gun gaai ||2||2||41||
english: O Nanak, sing and savor the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Kind and Compassionate Lord of the World. ||2||2||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਉ ਅਨਿਕ ਡਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: vaar vaarau anik daarau ||
english: Countless times, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਪਲਕ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh pri suhaag palak raat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: to that moment of peace, on that night when I was joined with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਮੰਦਰ ਪਾਟ ਸੇਜ ਸਖੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kanik ma(n)dar paat sej sakhee mohi naahi in siu taat ||1||
english: Mansions of gold, and beds of silk sheets - O sisters, I have no love for these. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤ ਲਾਲ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਾਤ ॥
transliteration: mukat laal anik bhog bin naam naanak haat ||
english: Pearls, jewels and countless pleasures, O Nanak, are useless and destructive without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਖੋ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸੈਨ ਸਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਤ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੨॥
transliteration: rookho bhojan bhoom sain sakhee pri sa(n)g sookh bihaat ||2||3||42||
english: Even with only dry crusts of bread, and a hard floor on which to sleep, my life passes in peace and pleasure with my Beloved, O sisters. ||2||3||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰ ਤੋਰੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aha(n) toro mukh joro ||
english: Give up your ego, and turn your face to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਰੋ ॥
transliteration: gur gur karat man loro ||
english: Let your yearning mind call out, "Guru, Guru".

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਮੋਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pri preet piaaro moro ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Beloved is the Lover of Love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਆਗਨਿ ਚੈਨਾ ਤੋਰੋ ਰੀ ਤੋਰੋ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੋਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: grihi sej suhaavee aagan chainaa toro ree toro pa(n)ch dootan siu sa(n)g toro ||1||
english: The bed of your household shall be cozy, and your courtyard shall be comfortable; shatter and break the bonds which tie you to the five thieves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨਿ ਊਂਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸੋਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aai na jaai base nij aasan oo(n)dh kamal bigasoro ||
english: You shall not come and go in reincarnation; you shall dwell in your own home deep within, and your inverted heart-lotus shall blossom forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੁਟਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਰੋ ॥
transliteration: chhutakee haumai soro ||
english: The turmoil of egotism shall be silenced.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਗਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੩॥
transliteration: gaaio ree gaaio prabh naanak gunee gahero ||2||4||43||
english: Nanak sings - he sings the Praises of God, the Ocean of Virtue. ||2||4||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਃ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mah 5 ghar 9 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: taa(n) te jaap manaa har jaap ||
english: This is why you should chant and meditate on the Lord, O mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦ ਕਹਤ ਪੰਥੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo sa(n)t bed kahat pa(n)th gaakharo moh magan aha(n) taap || rahaau ||
english: The Vedas and the Saints say that the path is treacherous and difficult. You are intoxicated with emotional attachment and the fever of egotism. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo raate maate sa(n)g bapuree maaiaa moh sa(n)taap ||1||
english: Those who are imbued and intoxicated with the wretched Maya, suffer the pains of emotional attachment. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਊ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: naam japat sooo jan udharai jisahi udhaarahu aap ||
english: That humble being is saved, who chants the Naam; You Yourself save him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੪੪॥
transliteration: binas jaai moh bhai bharamaa naanak sa(n)t prataap ||2||5||44||
english: Emotional attachment, fear and doubt are dispelled, O Nanak, by the Grace of the Saints. ||2||5||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 10 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Tenth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਜੀਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aiso daan dehu jee sa(n)tahu jaat jeeu balihaar ||
english: Give me that blessing, O Dear Saints, for which my soul would be a sacrifice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਹੀ ਉਰਝਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maan mohee pa(n)ch dohee urajh nikat basio taakee saran saadhooaa doot sa(n)g nivaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Enticed by pride, entrapped and plundered by the five thieves, still, you live near them. I have come to the Sanctuary of the Holy, and I have been rescued from my association with those demons. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot janam jon bhramio haar pario duaar ||1||
english: I wandered through millions of lifetimes and incarnations. I am so very tired - I have fallen at God's Door. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa gobi(n)d bhaee milio naam adhaar ||
english: The Lord of the Universe has become Kind to me; He has blessed me with the Support of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੫॥
transliteration: dulabh janam saphal naanak bhav utaar paar ||2||1||45||
english: This precious human life has become fruitful and prosperous; O Nanak, I am carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 11 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Eleventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਆਪਨ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaae aapan aae ||
english: He Himself has come to me, in His Natural Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੌ ਕਛੂ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kachhoo na jaanau kachhoo dikhaae ||
english: I know nothing, and I show nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਲੇ ਭੋਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh milio sukh baale bhole ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have met God through innocent faith, and He has blessed me with peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jog milaae saadh sa(n)gaae ||
english: By the good fortune of my destiny, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਘਰਹਿ ਬਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: katahoo na jaae gharahi basaae ||
english: I do not go out anywhere; I dwell in my own home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਇਹ ਚੋਲੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan pragatio ih cholai ||1||
english: God, the Treasure of Virtue, has been revealed in this body-robe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਲੁਭਾਏ ਆਨ ਤਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: charan lubhaae aan tajaae ||
english: I have fallen in love with His Feet; I have abandoned everything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: thaan thanaae sarab samaae ||
english: In the places and interspaces, He is All-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਨ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੬॥
transliteration: rasak rasak naanak gun bolai ||2||1||46||
english: With loving joy and excitement, Nanak speaks His Praises. ||2||1||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਨ ਦੁਰਾਈਁ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d thaakur milan duraaee(n) ||
english: It is so hard to meet the Lord of the Universe, my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paramit roop aga(n)m agochar rahio sarab samaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His Form is Immeasurable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; He is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨਿ ਭਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਕਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahan bhavan naahee paaio paaio anik ukat chaturaaee ||1||
english: By speaking and wandering, nothing is gained; nothing is obtained by clever tricks and devices. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਜਤਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਰੇ ਤਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jatan jatan anik upaav re tau milio jau kirapaaee ||
english: People try all sorts of things, but the Lord is only met when He shows His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੭॥
transliteration: prabhoo daiaar kripaar kripaa nidh jan naanak sa(n)t renaaee ||2||2||47||
english: God is Kind and Compassionate, the Treasure of Mercy; servant Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaee simarat raam raam raam ||
english: O mother, I meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh binaa naahee hor ||
english: Without God, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਾਸਨ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chitavau charanaarabi(n)d saasan nis bhor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I remember His Lotus Feet with every breath, night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਨ ਆਪਨ ਤੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: laai preet keen aapan tootat nahee jor ||
english: He loves me and makes me His Own; my union with Him shall never be broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੋੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧੇ ਸੁਖ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: praan man dhan sarabasou har gun nidhe sukh mor ||1||
english: He is my breath of life, mind, wealth and everything. The Lord is the Treasure of Virtue and Peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਰਾਮ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਿਦ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: eet oot raam pooran nirakhat rid khor ||
english: Here and hereafter, the Lord is perfectly pervading; He is seen deep within the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੮॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saran taran naanak binasio dukh ghor ||2||3||48||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, I am carried across; O Nanak, the terrible pain has been taken away. ||2||3||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jan ko prabh sa(n)ge asanehu ||
english: God's humble servant is in love with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saajano too meet meraa grihi terai sabh kehu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my Friend, my very best Friend; everything is in Your Home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਤਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maan maa(n)gau taan maa(n)gau dhan lakhamee sut deh ||1||
english: I beg for honor, I beg for strength; please bless me with wealth, property and children. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: mukat jugat bhugat pooran paramaana(n)d param nidhaan ||
english: You are the Technology of liberation, the Way to worldly success, the Perfect Lord of Supreme Bliss, the Transcendent Treasure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੯॥
transliteration: bhai bhaai bhagat nihaal naanak sadaa sadaa kurabaan ||2||4||49||
english: In the Fear of God and loving devotion, Nanak is exalted and enraptured, forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||49||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karat karat charach charach characharee ||
english: The debaters debate and argue their arguments.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਭੇਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਚਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jog dhiaan bhekh giaan phirat phirat dharat dharat dharacharee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Yogis and meditators, religious and spiritual teachers roam and ramble, wandering endlessly all over the earth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰ ਅਹੰ ਅਹੈ ਅਵਰ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਬਵਰਈ ॥
transliteration: aha(n) aha(n) ahai avar mooR mooR mooR bavaraee ||
english: They are egotistical, self-centered and conceited, foolish, stupid, idiotic and insane.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲ ਹਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jat jaat jaat jaat sadaa sadaa sadaa sadaa kaal haee ||1||
english: Wherever they go and wander, death is always with them, forever and ever and ever and ever. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਈ ॥
transliteration: maan maan maan tiaag mirat mirat nikat nikat sadaa haee ||
english: Give up your pride and stubborn self-conceit; death, yes, death, is always close and near at hand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਭਾਜੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੫੦॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
transliteration: har hare hare bhaaj kahat naanak sunahu re mooR bin bhajan bhajan bhajan ahilaa janam gaee ||2||5||50||12||62||
english: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Haray, Haray. Says Nanak, listen you fool: without vibrating, and meditating, and dwelling on Him, your life is uselessly wasting away. ||2||5||50||12||62||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa asatapadeeaa mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Kaanraa, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam sukh paavaigo ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and find peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu jiu japai tivai sukh paavai satigur sev samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The more you chant and meditate, the more you will be at peace; serve the True Guru, and merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੋਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa(n) kee khin khin lochaa naam japat sukh paavaigo ||
english: Each and every instant, the humble devotees long for Him; chanting the Naam, they find peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: an ras saad gae sabh neekar bin naavai kichh na sukhaavaigo ||1||
english: The taste of other pleasures is totally eradicated; nothing pleases them, except the Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਠੇ ਬਚਨ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: guramat har har meethaa laagaa gur meethe bachan kadhaavaigo ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord seems sweet to them; the Guru inspires them to speak sweet words.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur baanee purakh purakhotam baanee siu chit laavaigo ||2||
english: Through the Word of the True Guru's Bani, the Primal Lord God is revealed; so focus your consciousness on His Bani. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee sunat meraa man draviaa man bheenaa nij ghar aavaigo ||
english: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, my mind has been softened and saturated with it; my mind has returned to its own home deep within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨੀ ਬਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਨੀਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tah anahat dhunee baajahi nit baaje neejhar dhaar chuaavaigo ||3||
english: The Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds there continuously; the stream of nectar trickles down constantly. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ik til til gaavai man guramat naam samaavaigo ||
english: Singing the Name of the One Lord each and every instant, and following the Guru's Teachings, the mind is absorbed in the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam sunai naamo man bhaavai naame hee tripataavaigo ||4||
english: Listening to the Naam, the mind is pleased with the Naam, and satisfied with the Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਨਿਕ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਗਨਾ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਨਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: kanik kanik pahire bahu ka(n)ganaa kaapar bhaa(n)t banaavaigo ||
english: People wear lots of bracelets, glittering with gold; they wear all sorts of fine clothes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕ ਫਿਕਾਨੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naam binaa sabh pheek phikaane janam marai phir aavaigo ||5||
english: But without the Naam, they are all bland and insipid. They are born, only to die again, in the cycle of reincarnation. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਪਟਲ ਪਟਲ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਘਰੁ ਘੂਮਨਿ ਘੇਰਿ ਘੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa patal patal hai bhaaree ghar ghooman gher ghulaavaigo ||
english: The veil of Maya is a thick and heavy veil, a whirlpool which destroys one's home.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨੂਰ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
transliteration: paap bikaar manoor sabh bhaare bikh dutar tario na jaavaigo ||6||
english: Sins and corrupt vices are totally heavy, like rusted slag. They will not let you cross over the poisonous and treacherous world-ocean. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: bhau bairaag bhaiaa hai bohith gur khevat sabad taraavaigo ||
english: Let the Fear of God and neutral detachment be the boat; the Guru is the Boatman, who carries us across in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
transliteration: raam naam har bheteeai har raamai naam samaavaigo ||7||
english: Meeting with the Lord, the Name of the Lord, merge in the Lord, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: agiaan laai savaaliaa gur giaanai laai jagaavaigo ||
english: Attached to ignorance, people are falling asleep; attached to the Guru's spiritual wisdom, they awaken.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhaanai aapanai jiu bhaavai tivai chalaavaigo ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, by His Will, He makes us walk as He pleases. ||8||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: jap man har har naam taraavaigo ||
english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and be carried across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo japai soee gat paavai jiu dhroo prahilaad samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever chants and meditates on it is emancipated. Like Dhroo and Prahlaad, they merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kripaa kar har jeeu kar kirapaa naam lagaavaigo ||
english: Mercy, mercy, mercy - O Dear Lord, please shower Your Mercy on me, and attach me to Your Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa satiguroo milaavahu mil satigur naam dhiaavaigo ||1||
english: Please be Merciful, and lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kee haumai mal laagee mil sa(n)gat mal lahi jaavaigo ||
english: The filth of egotism from countless incarnations sticks to me; joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, this filth is washed away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu lohaa tario sa(n)g kaasat lag sabad guroo har paavaigo ||2||
english: As iron is carried across if it is attached to wood, one who is attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad finds the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat sa(n)t milahu satasa(n)gat mil sa(n)gat har ras aavaigo ||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall come to receive the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕਢਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਚੀਕੜੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin sa(n)gat karam karai abhimaanee kadh paanee cheekaR paavaigo ||3||
english: But not joining the Sangat, and committing actions in egotistical pride, is like drawing out clean water, and throwing it in the mud. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa ke har rakhavaare jan har ras meeth lagaavaigo ||
english: The Lord is the Protector and Saving Grace of His humble devotees. The Lord's Sublime Essence seems so sweet to these humble beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: khin khin naam dei vadiaaee satigur upades samaavaigo ||4||
english: Each and every instant, they are blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam; through the Teachings of the True Guru, they are absorbed in Him. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜਨ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਫਲ ਗੁਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kau sadaa niv raheeai jan nivahi taa phal gun paavaigo ||
english: Bow forever in deep respect to the humble devotees; if you bow to those humble beings, you shall obtain the fruit of virtue.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਜਿਉ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo ni(n)daa dusat karahi bhagataa kee haranaakhas jiu pach jaavaigo ||5||
english: Those wicked enemies who slander the devotees are destroyed, like Harnaakhash. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਪੁਤੁ ਮੀਨ ਬਿਆਸਾ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: braham kamal put meen biaasaa tap taapan pooj karaavaigo ||
english: Brahma, the son of the lotus, and Vyaas, the son of the fish, practiced austere penance and were worshipped.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਰਮਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jo jo bhagat hoi so poojahu bharaman bharam chukaavaigo ||6||
english: Whoever is a devotee - worship and adore that person. Get rid of your doubts and superstitions. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤ ਨਜਾਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਤ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ ਪਗੀਂ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: jaat najaat dekh mat bharamahu suk janak pagee(n) lag dhiaavaigo ||
english: Do not be fooled by appearances of high and low social class. Suk Dayv bowed at the feet of Janak, and meditated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਨ ਜੂਠਿ ਪਈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਡੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
transliteration: joothan jooth paee sir oopar khin manooaa til na dulaavaigo ||7||
english: Even though Janak threw his left-overs and garbage on Suk Dayv's head, his mind did not waver, even for an instant. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਕ ਜਨਕ ਬੈਠੇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਨਉ ਮੁਨੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲੈ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: janak janak baithe si(n)ghaasan nau munee dhoor lai laavaigo ||
english: Janak sat upon his regal throne, and applied the dust of the nine sages to his forehead.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kripaa kripaa kar thaakur mai daasan daas karaavaigo ||8||2||
english: Please shower Nanak with your Mercy, O my Lord and Master; make him the slave of Your slaves. ||8||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: man guramat ras gun gaavaigo ||
english: O mind, follow the Guru's Teachings, and joyfully sing God's Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਹੋਇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa ek hoi lakh kotee lakh kotee kot dhiaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If my one tongue became hundreds of thousands and millions, I would meditate on Him millions and millions of times. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇਖਨਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: sahas phanee japio sekhanaagai har japatiaa a(n)t na paavaigo ||
english: The serpent king chants and meditates on the Lord with his thousands of heads, but even by these chants, he cannot find the Lord's limits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too athaahu at agam agam hai mat guramat man thaharaavaigo ||1||
english: You are Utterly Unfathomable, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes steady and balanced. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਜਪਿਓ ਤੇਈ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਅਹੁ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: jin too japio teee jan neeke har japatiahu kau sukh paavaigo ||
english: Those humble beings who meditate on You are noble and exalted. Meditating on the Lord, they are at peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਰ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਛੋਕ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bidar daasee sut chhok chhoharaa krisan a(n)k gal laavaigo ||2||
english: Bidur, the son of a slave-girl, was an untouchable, but Krishna hugged him close in His Embrace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਕਾਸਟ ਕਾਸਟ ਅੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: jal te opat bhaee hai kaasat kaasat a(n)g taraavaigo ||
english: Wood is produced from water, but by holding onto wood, one is saved from drowning.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam janaa har aap savaare apanaa birad rakhaavaigo ||3||
english: The Lord Himself embellishes and exalts His humble servants; He confirms His Innate Nature. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਲੋਹ ਲੋਹ ਬਡ ਪਾਥਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: ham paathar loh loh bad paathar gur sa(n)gat naav taraavaigo ||
english: I am like a stone, or a piece of iron, heavy stone and iron; in the Boat of the Guru's Congregation, I am carried across,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jiu satasa(n)gat tario julaaho sa(n)t janaa man bhaavaigo ||4||
english: like Kabeer the weaver, who was saved in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. He became pleasing to the minds of the humble Saints. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਰੇ ਖਰੋਏ ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: khare kharoe baithat oothat maarag pa(n)th dhiaavaigo ||
english: Standing up, sitting down, rising up and walking on the path, I meditate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਬਚਨ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਨਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur bachan bachan hai satigur paadhar mukat janaavaigo ||5||
english: The True Guru is the Word, and the Word is the True Guru, who teaches the Path of Liberation. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
