gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਬਲੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਨਿਹਸਾਸਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: saasan saas saas bal paaee hai nihasaasan naam dhiaavaigo ||
english: By His Training, I find strength with each and every breath; now that I am trained and tamed, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤੌ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee haumai boojhai tau guramat naam samaavaigo ||6||
english: By Guru's Grace, egotism is extinguished, and then, through the Guru's Teachings, I merge in the Naam. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa jee jeean ko bhaagaheen nahee bhaavaigo ||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul, but the unfortunate ones do not love Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
transliteration: phir eh velaa haath na aavai parataapai pachhutaavaigo ||7||
english: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; in the end, they will suffer in torment and regret. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਭਲ ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: je ko bhalaa loRai bhal apanaa gur aagai dhahi dhahi paavaigo ||
english: If a good person seeks goodness for himself, he should bow low in humble surrender to the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak daiaa daiaa kar thaakur mai satigur bhasam lagaavaigo ||8||3||
english: Nanak prays: please show kindness and compassion to me, O my Lord and Master, that I may apply the dust of the True Guru to my forehead. ||8||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: man har ra(n)g raataa gaavaigo ||
english: O mind, be attuned to His Love, and sing.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhai traas bhae hai niramal guramat laag lagaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Fear of God makes me fearless and immaculate; I am dyed in the color of the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raataa sad bairaagee har nikat tinaa ghar aavaigo ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Lord's Love remain balanced and detached forever; they live near the Lord, who comes into their house.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kee pa(n)k milai taa(n) jeevaa kar kirapaa aap divaavaigo ||1||
english: If I am blessed with the dust of their feet, then I live. Granting His Grace, He Himself bestows it. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa lobh lage hai praanee man korai ra(n)g na aavaigo ||
english: Mortal beings are attached to greed and duality. Their minds are unripe and unfit, and will not accept the Dye of His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਉਲਟਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phir ulatio janam hovai gur bachanee gur purakh milai ra(n)g laavaigo ||2||
english: But their lives are transformed through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. Meeting with the Guru, the Primal Being, they are dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਦਸੇ ਦਸੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵਤ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣੀਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dree dase dase phun dhaavat trai guneeaa khin na tikaavaigo ||
english: There are ten organs of sense and action; the ten wander unrestrained. Under the influence of the three dispositions, they are not stable, even for an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur parachai vasagat aavai mokh mukat so paavaigo ||3||
english: Coming in contact with the True Guru, they are brought under control; then, salvation and liberation are attained. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਸ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar eko rav rahiaa sabh ekas maahi samaavaigo ||
english: The One and Only Creator of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. All shall once again merge into the One.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਤੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: eko roop eko bahu ra(n)gee sabh ekat bachan chalaavaigo ||4||
english: His One Form has one, and many colors; He leads all according to His One Word. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: guramukh eko ek pachhaataa guramukh hoi lakhaavaigo ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes the One and Only Lord; He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਜ ਮਹਲੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh jaai milai nij mahalee anahad sabad bajaavaigo ||5||
english: The Gurmukh goes and meets the Lord in His Mansion deep within; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates there. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh sisat upaaee guramukh sobhaa paavaigo ||
english: God created all the beings and creatures of the universe; He blesses the Gurmukh with glory.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin gur bhete ko mahal na paavai aai jaai dukh paavaigo ||6||
english: Without meeting the Guru, no one obtains the Mansion of His Presence. They suffer the agony of coming and going in reincarnation. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: anek janam vichhuRe mere preetam kar kirapaa guroo milaavaigo ||
english: For countless lifetimes, I have been separated from my Beloved; in His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਨ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur milat mahaa sukh paaiaa mat maleen bigasaavaigo ||7||
english: Meeting the True Guru, I have found absolute peace, and my polluted intellect blossoms forth. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਸਰਧਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa karahu jagajeevan mai saradhaa naam lagaavaigo ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, please grant Your Grace; O Life of the World, instill faith in the Naam within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak guroo guroo hai satigur mai satigur saran milaavaigo ||8||4||
english: Nanak is the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru; I am immersed in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||8||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: man guramat chaal chalaavaigo ||
english: O mind, walk on the Path of the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਮਸਤੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਲਿ ਕੁੰਡੇ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu maigal masat deejai tal ku(n)de gur a(n)kas sabad driRaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Just as the wild elephant is subdued by the prod, the mind is disciplined by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤੌ ਚਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: chalatau chalai chalai dah dah dis gur raakhai har liv laavaigo ||
english: The wandering mind wanders, roams and rambles in the ten directions; but the Guru holds it, and lovingly attunes it to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur sabad dei rid a(n)tar mukh a(n)mrit naam chuaavaigo ||1||
english: The True Guru implants the Word of the Shabad deep within the heart; the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, trickles into the mouth. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਬਿਸੂ ਭਰੇ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: biseear bisoo bhare hai pooran gur garuR sabad mukh paavaigo ||
english: The snakes are filled with poisonous venom; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the antidote - place it in your mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਰਿ ਝਾਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa bhuia(n)g tis neR na aavai bikh jhaar jhaar liv laavaigo ||2||
english: Maya, the serpent, does not even approach one who is rid of the poison, and lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਨੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: suaan lobh nagar mahi sabalaa gur khin mahi maar kadhaavaigo ||
english: The dog of greed is very powerful in the village of the body; the Guru strikes it and drives it out in an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਆਨਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh dharam aan raakhe har nagaree har gun gaavaigo ||3||
english: Truth, contentment, righteousness and Dharma have settled there; in the village of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਘਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)kaj moh nigharat hai praanee gur nigharat kaadh kadhaavaigo ||
english: The mortal beings are sinking in the swamp of emotional attachment; the Guru lifts them up, and saves them from sinking.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਾਥੀ ਦੇ ਨਿਕਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: traahi traahi saran jan aae gur haathee de nikalaavaigo ||4||
english: Crying, "Save me! Save me!", the humble come to His Sanctuary; the Guru reaches out His Hand, and lifts them up. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: supana(n)tar sa(n)saar sabh baajee sabh baajee khel khilaavaigo ||
english: The whole world is like a game in a dream, all a game. God plays and causes the game to be played.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
transliteration: laahaa naam guramat lai chaalahu har daragah paidhaa jaavaigo ||5||
english: So earn the Profit of the Naam by following the Guru's Teachings; you shall go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਇਲੇ ਆਨਿ ਜਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: haumai karai karaavai haumai paap koile aan jamaavaigo ||
english: They act in egotism, and make others act in egotism; they collect and gather up the blackness of sin.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੋਏ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਵਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aaiaa kaal dukhadaaee hoe jo beeje so khavalaavaigo ||6||
english: And when death comes, they suffer in agony; they must eat what they have planted. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਲੈ ਖਰਚੁ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu raam naam dhan sa(n)chahu lai kharach chale pat paavaigo ||
english: O Saints, gather the Wealth of the Lord's Name; if you depart after packing these provisions, you shall be honored.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
transliteration: khaai kharach devahi bahuteraa har dede tot na aavaigo ||7||
english: So eat, spend, consume and give abundantly; the Lord will give - there will be no deficiency. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan hai rid a(n)tar dhan gur saranaaee paavaigo ||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is deep within the heart. In the Sanctuary of the Guru, this wealth is found.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak daiaa daiaa kar deenee dukh daalad bha(n)j samaavaigo ||8||5||
english: O Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; He has blessed me. Removing pain and poverty, He has blended me with Himself. ||8||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: man satigur saran dhiaavaigo ||
english: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਹਿਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਨੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lohaa hiran hovai sa(n)g paaras gun paaras ko hoi aavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Iron is transformed into gold by touching the philosopher's stone; it takes on its qualities. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: satigur mahaa purakh hai paaras jo laagai so phal paavaigo ||
english: The True Guru, the Great Primal Being, is the philosopher's stone. Whoever is attached to Him receives fruitful rewards.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਤਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu gur upades tare prahilaadaa gur sevak paij rakhaavaigo ||1||
english: Just as Prahlaad was saved by the Guru's Teachings, the Guru protects the honor of His servant. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਚਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: satigur bachan bachan hai neeko gur bachanee a(n)mrit paavaigo ||
english: The Word of the True Guru is the most Sublime and Noble Word. Through the Guru's Word, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਬਰੀਕਿ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu a(n)bareek amaraa pad paae satigur mukh bachan dhiaavaigo ||2||
english: Ambreek the king was blessed with the status of immortality, meditating on the Word of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: satigur saran saran man bhaaee sudhaa sudhaa kar dhiaavaigo ||
english: The Sanctuary, the Protection and Sanctuary of the True Guru is pleasing to the mind. It is sacred and pure - meditate on it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੀਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daiaal deen bhae hai satigur har maarag pa(n)th dikhaavaigo ||3||
english: The True Guru has become Merciful to the meek and the poor; He has shown me the Path, the Way to the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਏ ਸੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: satigur saran pae se thaape tin raakhan kau prabh aavaigo ||
english: Those who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru are firmly established; God comes to protect them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੈ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਲਟੋ ਤਿਸੈ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: je ko sar sa(n)dhai jan oopar phir ulato tisai lagaavaigo ||4||
english: If someone aims an arrow at the Lord's humble servant, it will turn around and hit him instead. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: har har har har har sar sevahi tin daragah maan divaavaigo ||
english: Those who bathe in the Sacred Pool of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are blessed with honor in His Court.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramat guramat guramat dhiaavahi har gal mil mel milaavaigo ||5||
english: Those who meditate on the Guru's Teachings, the Guru's Instructions, the Guru's Wisdom, are united in the Lord's Union; He hugs them close in His Embrace. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naad bed hai guramukh gur parachai naam dhiaavaigo ||
english: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad, The Guru's Word is the wisdom of the Vedas; coming in contact with the Guru, meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har har roop har roopo hovai har jan kau pooj karaavaigo ||6||
english: In the Image of the Lord, Har, Har, one becomes the Embodiment of the Lord. The Lord makes His humble servant worthy of worship. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: saakat nar satigur nahee keeaa te bemukh har bharamaavaigo ||
english: The faithless cynic does not submit to the True Guru; the Lord makes the non-believer wander in confusion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰੰਗਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
transliteration: lobh lahar suaan kee sa(n)gat bikh maaiaa kara(n)g lagaavaigo ||7||
english: The waves of greed are like packs of dogs. The poison of Maya sticks to the body-skeleton. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕਾ ਤਾਰਕੁ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
transliteration: raam naam sabh jag kaa taarak lag sa(n)gat naam dhiaavaigo ||
english: The Lord's Name is the Saving Grace of the whole world; join the Sangat, and meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: naanak raakh raakh prabh mere satasa(n)gat raakh samaavaigo ||8||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: O my God, please protect and preserve Nanak in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; save him, and let him merge in You. ||8||6|| First Set of Six ||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRaa chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaanraa, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: se udhare jin raam dhiaae ||
english: They alone are saved, who meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: jatan maaiaa ke kaam na aae ||
english: Working for Maya is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raam dhiaae sabh phal paae dhan dha(n)n te badabhaageeaa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, all fruits and rewards are obtained. They are blessed, blessed and very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)g jaage naam laage ek siu liv laageeaa ||
english: They are awake and aware in the True Congregation; attached to the Naam, they are lovingly attuned to the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: taj maan moh bikaar saadhoo lag tarau tin kai paae ||
english: I have renounced pride, emotional attachment, wickedness and corruption; attached to the Holy, I am carried across at their feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਡਭਾਗਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee badabhaag darasan paae ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I have come to the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; by great good fortune, I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਿਤ ਭਜਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo nit bhajah naaraain ||
english: The Holy meet together, and continually vibrate and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: rasak rasak suaamee gun gaain ||
english: With love and excitement, they sing the Glorious Praises of their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਵਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਗਏ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai jeevah har amiu peevah janam maranaa bhaagae ||
english: Singing His Praises they live, drinking in the Lord's Nectar; the cycle of birth and death is over for them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਏ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)g paaeeai har dhiaaeeai bahuR dookh na laagae ||
english: Finding the True Congregation and meditating on the Lord, one is never again afflicted with pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਤੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: kar daiaa daate purakh bidhaate sa(n)t sev kamaain ||
english: By the Grace of the Great Giver, the Architect of Destiny, we work to serve the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਣ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak jan dhoor baa(n)chhahi har daras sahaj samaain ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I long for the dust of the feet of the humble; I am intuitively absorbed in the Blessed Vision of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sagale ja(n)t bhajahu gopaalai ||
english: All beings vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam pooran ghaalai ||
english: This brings the merits of chanting and meditation, austere self-discipline and perfect service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit bhajahu suaamee a(n)tarajaamee saphal janam sabaaiaa ||
english: Vibrating and meditating continuously on our Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, one's life becomes totally fruitful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gobid gaaeeai nit dhiaaeeai paravaan soee aaiaa ||
english: Those who sing and meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe - their coming into the world is blessed and approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jap taap sa(n)jam har har nira(n)jan gobi(n)d dhan sa(n)g chaalai ||
english: The Immaculate Lord, Har, Har, is meditation and chanting, and austere self-discipline; only the Wealth of the Lord of the Universe shall go along with you in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਾਧਉ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak kar daiaa deejai har ratan baadhau paalai ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and bless me with the Jewel, that I may carry it in my pocket. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰ ਚੋਜ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)galachaar choj aana(n)daa ||
english: His Wondrous and Amazing Plays are blissful

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mile paramaana(n)daa ||
english: granting His Grace, He bestows supreme ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹਗਾਮੀ ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh mile suaamee sukhahagaamee ichh man kee pu(n)neeaa ||
english: God, my Lord and Master, the Bringer of peace, has met me, and the desires of my mind are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਜੀ ਬਧਾਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਰੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bajee badhaaee sahaje samaaee bahuR dookh na ru(n)neeaa ||
english: Congratulations pour in; I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. I shall never again cry out in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: le ka(n)th laae sukh dikhaae bikaar binase ma(n)daa ||
english: He hugs me close in His Embrace, and blesses me with peace; the evil of sin and corruption is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak mile suaamee purakh paramaana(n)daa ||4||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I have met my Lord and Master, the Primal Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਮੂਸੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaanaRe kee vaar mahalaa 4 moose kee vaar kee dhunee ||
english: Vaar Of Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl, Sung To The Tune Of The Ballad Of Musa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam nidhaan har guramat rakh ur dhaar ||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and enshrine the Treasure of the Lord's Name within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daasan daasaa hoi rahu haumai bikhiaa maar ||
english: Become the slave of the Lord's slaves, and conquer egotism and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath jeetiaa kade na aavai haar ||
english: You shall win this treasure of life; you shall never lose.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan dhan vadabhaagee naanakaa jin guramat har ras saar ||1||
english: Blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who savor the Sublime Essence of the Lord through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d govid govid har govid gunee nidhaan ||
english: Govind, Govind, Govind - the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: govid govid guramat dhiaaeeai taa(n) daragah paaeeai maan ||
english: Meditating on Govind, Govind, the Lord of the Universe, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: govid govid govid jap mukh oojalaa paradhaan ||
english: Meditating on God, chanting Govind, Govind, Govind, your face shall be radiant; you shall be famous and exalted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur govi(n)d har jit mil har paaiaa naam ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe; meeting Him, you shall obtain the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕੋ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape hee sidh saadhiko too aape hee jug jogeeaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Siddha and the seeker; You Yourself are the Yoga and the Yogi.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਸ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape hee ras raseeaRaa too aape hee bhog bhogeeaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Taster of tastes; You Yourself are the Enjoyer of pleasures.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape aap varatadaa too aape karahi s hogeeaa ||
english: You Yourself are All-pervading; whatever You do comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੋੁ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨ ਧਨੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਲਗ ਬੁਲੋਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat satigur dha(n)n dhanou dha(n)n dha(n)n dhano jit mil har bulag bulogeeaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru. Join them - speak and chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੋਗੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kahahu mukhahu har har hare har har hare har bolat sabh paap lahogeeaa ||1||
english: Let everyone chant together the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray, Har, Har, Haray; chanting Har, all sins are washed away. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har har har har naam hai guramukh paavai koi ||
english: Har, Har, Har, Har is the Name of the Lord; rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtain it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa naas hoi duramat kadhai dhoi ||
english: Egotism and possessiveness are eradicated, and evil-mindedness is washed away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak anadin gun ucharai jin kau dhur likhiaa hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny chants the Lord's Praises, night and day. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har aape aap daiaal har aape kare s hoi ||
english: The Lord Himself is Merciful; whatever the Lord Himself does, comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har aape aap varatadaa har jevad avar na koi ||
english: The Lord Himself is All-pervading. There is no other as Great as the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo har prabh bhaavai so theeai jo har prabh kare s hoi ||
english: Whatever pleases the Lord God's Will comes to pass; whatever the Lord God does is done.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeeaa bea(n)t prabhoo har soi ||
english: No one can appraise His Value; the Lord God is Endless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har saalaahiaa tan man seetal hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, praise the Lord; your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jot teree jagajeevanaa too ghat ghat har ra(n)g ra(n)ganaa ||
english: You are the Light of all, the Life of the World; You imbue each and every heart with Your Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਤੂ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh dhiaavahi tudh mere preetamaa too sat sat purakh nira(n)janaa ||
english: All meditate on You, O my Beloved; You are the True, True Primal Being, the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸਭ ਮੰਗ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ik daataa sabh jagat bhikhaareeaa har jaachahi sabh ma(n)g ma(n)ganaa ||
english: The One is the Giver; the whole world is the beggar. All the beggars beg for His Gifts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗ ਚੰਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak thaakur sabh toohai toohai guramatee har cha(n)g cha(n)ganaa ||
english: You are the servant, and You are the Lord and Master of all. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are ennobled and uplifted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸੁ ਹਰੇ ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸੁ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਫਲਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh kahahu mukhahu rikheekes hare rikheekes hare jit paavahi sabh phal phalanaa ||2||
english: Let everyone say that the Lord is the Master of the senses, the Master of all faculties; through Him, we obtain all fruits and rewards. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaai man har daragah paavahi maan ||
english: O mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhahi so phal paaisee gurasabadee lagai dhiaan ||
english: You shall obtain the fruits that you desire, focusing your meditation on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh paap sabh kateeahi haumai chukai gumaan ||
english: All your sins and mistakes shall be wiped away, and you shall be rid of egotism and pride.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kamal vigasiaa sabh aatam braham pachhaan ||
english: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, recognizing God within every soul.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har kirapaa dhaar prabh jan naanak jap har naam ||1||
english: O Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may chant the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam pavit hai naam japat dukh jaai ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Sacred and Immaculate. Chanting the Naam, pain is dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin man vasiaa aai ||
english: God comes to abide in the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਨ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tin daalad dukh lahi jaai ||
english: Those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru are rid of pain and poverty.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: aapanai bhaanai kinai na paaio jan vekhahu man pateeaai ||
english: No one finds the Lord by his own will; see this, and satisfy your mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak daasan daas hai jo satigur laage paai ||2||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the slave of those who fall at the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) thaan thana(n)tar bharapoor hahi karate sabh teree banat banaavanee ||
english: You are pervading and permeating all places and interspaces, O Creator. You made all that has been made.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਉਪਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g para(n)g sisat sabh saajee bahu bahu bidh bhaa(n)t upaavanee ||
english: You created the entire universe, with all its colors and shades; in so many ways and means and forms You formed it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh teree jot jotee vich varatahi guramatee tudhai laavanee ||
english: O Lord of Light, Your Light is infused within all; You link us to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jin hohi daiaal tin satigur melahi mukh guramukh har samajhaavanee ||
english: They alone meet the True Guru, unto whom You are Merciful; O Lord, You instruct them in the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੋ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh bolahu raam ramo sree raam ramo jit daalad dukh bhukh sabh lahi jaavanee ||3||
english: Let everyone chant the Name of the Lord, chant the Name of the Great Lord; all poverty, pain and hunger shall be taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har har a(n)mrit naam ras har a(n)mrit har ur dhaar ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet; enshrine this Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord within your heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਬੁਝਹੁ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vich sa(n)gat har prabh varatadaa bujhahu sabad veechaar ||
english: The Lord God prevails in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation; reflect upon the Shabad and understand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੀ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man har har naam dhiaaiaa bikh haumai kadhee maar ||
english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within the mind, the poison of egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jin har har naam na chetio tin jooai janam sabh haar ||
english: One who does not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, shall totally lose this life in the gamble.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai har chetaaiaa har naamaa har ur dhaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one remembers the Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within the heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak te mukh ujale tit sachai darabaar ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, his face shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har keerat utam naam hai vich kalijug karanee saar ||
english: To chant the Lord's Praise and His Name is sublime and exalted. This is the most excellent deed in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mat guramat keerat paaeeai har naamaa har ur haar ||
english: His Praises come through the Guru's Teachings and Instructions; wear the Necklace of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee jin har dhiaaiaa tin saupiaa har bha(n)daar ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord are very fortunate. They are entrusted with the Treasure of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai j karam kamaavane nit haumai hoi khuaar ||
english: Without the Name, no matter what people may do, they continue to waste away in egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਵਾਲੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jal hasatee mal naavaaleeai sir bhee phir paavai chhaar ||
english: Elephants can be washed and bathed in water, but they only throw dust on their heads again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har melahu satigur daiaa kar man vasai eka(n)kaar ||
english: O Kind and Compassionate True Guru, please unite me with the Lord, that the One Creator of the Universe may abide within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin guramukh sun har ma(n)niaa jan naanak tin jaikaar ||2||
english: Those Gurmukhs who listen to the Lord and believe in Him - servant Nanak salutes them. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਹੈ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam vakhar hai ootam har naaik purakh hamaaraa ||
english: The Lord's Name is the most sublime and precious merchandise. The Primal Lord God is my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har khel keeaa har aape varatai sabh jagat keeaa vanajaaraa ||
english: The Lord has staged His Play, and He Himself permeates it. The whole world deals in this merchandise.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jot teree jotee vich karate sabh sach teraa paasaaraa ||
english: Your Light is the light in all beings, O Creator. All Your Expanse is True.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਫਲ ਸੇ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh dhiaavahi tudh saphal se gaavahi guramatee har nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: All those who meditate on You become prosperous; through the Guru's Teachings, they sing Your Praises, O Formless Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਚਵਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh chavahu mukhahu jaga(n)naath jaga(n)naath jagajeevano jit bhavajal paar utaaraa ||4||
english: Let everyone chant the Lord, the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
transliteration: hamaree jihabaa ek prabh har ke gun agam athaah ||
english: I have only one tongue, and the Glorious Virtues of the Lord God are Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਪਹ ਇਆਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: ham kiu kar japah iaaniaa har tum vad agam agaah ||
english: I am ignorant - how can I meditate on You, Lord? You are Great, Unapproachable and Immeasurable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਗਿ ਪਾਹ ॥
transliteration: har dehu prabhoo mat ootamaa gur satigur kai pag paah ||
english: O Lord God, please bless me with that sublime wisdom, that I may fall at the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਹ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat har mel prabh ham paapee sa(n)g taraah ||
english: O Lord God, please lead me to the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where even a sinner like myself may be saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har bakhas laihu har tuthai mel milaah ||
english: O Lord, please bless and forgive servant Nanak; please unite him in Your Union.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਿਰਮ ਤਰਾਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kirapaa kar sun benatee ham paapee kiram taraah ||1||
english: O Lord, please be merciful and hear my prayer; I am a sinner and a worm - please save me! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: har karahu kripaa jagajeevanaa gur satigur mel daiaal ||
english: O Lord, Life of the World, please bless me with Your Grace, and lead me to meet the Guru, the Merciful True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਭਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa har ham bhaaeeaa har hoaa har kirapaal ||
english: I am happy to serve the Guru; the Lord has become merciful to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh aasaa manasaa visaree man chookaa aal ja(n)jaal ||
english: All my hopes and desires have been forgotten; my mind is rid of its worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai naam driRaaiaa ham keee sabad nihaal ||
english: The Guru, in His Mercy, implanted the Naam within me; I am enraptured with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak atut dhan paaiaa har naamaa har dhan maal ||2||
english: Servant Nanak has obtained the inexhaustible wealth; the Lord's Name is his wealth and property. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੌਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har tumh vad vade vade vad ooche sabh oopar vade vadaunaa ||
english: O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great, the Greatest of the Great, the Most Lofty and Exalted of all, the Greatest of the Great.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰੇ ਤੇ ਹੋਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo dhiaavahi har apara(n)par har har har dhiaai hare te honaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Infinite Lord, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are rejuvenated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੋਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo gaavahi sunahi teraa jas suaamee tin kaate paap katonaa ||
english: Those who sing and listen to Your Praises, O my Lord and Master, have millions of sins destroyed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਜਾਨੇ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੋਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tum jaise har purakh jaane mat guramat mukh vad vad bhaag vadonaa ||
english: I know that those divine beings who follow the Guru's Teachings are just like You, Lord. They are the greatest of the great, so very fortunate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਸਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸੋਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabh dhiaavahu aad sate jugaad sate paratakh sate sadaa sadaa sate jan naanak daas dasonaa ||5||
english: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, who was True in the primal beginning, and True throughout the ages; He is revealed as True here and now, and He shall be True forever and ever. Servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: hamare har jagajeevanaa har japio har gur ma(n)t ||
english: I meditate on my Lord, the Life of the World, the Lord, chanting the Guru's Mantra.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ॥
transliteration: har agam agochar agam har har miliaa aai achi(n)t ||
english: The Lord is Unapproachable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; the Lord, Har, Har, has spontaneously come to meet me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਅੰਤ ॥
transliteration: har aape ghat ghat varatadaa har aape aap bia(n)t ||
english: The Lord Himself is pervading each and every heart; the Lord Himself is Endless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤ ॥
transliteration: har aape sabh ras bhogadaa har aape kavalaa ka(n)t ||
english: The Lord Himself enjoys all pleasures; the Lord Himself is the Husband of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: har aape bhikhiaa paaidaa sabh sisat upaaee jee ja(n)t ||
english: The Lord Himself gives in charity to the whole world, and all the beings and creatures which He created.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥
transliteration: har devahu daan daiaal prabh har maa(n)gahi har jan sa(n)t ||
english: O Merciful Lord God, please bless me with Your Bountiful Gifts; the humble Saints of the Lord beg for them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh aai mil ham gaavah har gun chha(n)t ||1||
english: O God of servant Nanak, please come and meet me; I sing the Songs of the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sajan naam har mai man tan naam sareer ||
english: The Name of the Lord God is my Best Friend. My mind and body are drenched with the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh aasaa guramukh pooreeaa jan naanak sun har dheer ||2||
english: All the hopes of the Gurmukh are fulfilled; servant Nanak is comforted, hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har ootam hariaa naam hai har purakh nira(n)jan maulaa ||
english: The Lord's Sublime Name is energizing and rejuvenating. The Immaculate Lord, the Primal Being, blossoms forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਕਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jo japade har har dinas raat tin seve charan nit kaulaa ||
english: Maya serves at the feet of those who chant and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, day and night.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: nit saar samhaale sabh jee ja(n)t har vasai nikat sabh jaulaa ||
english: The Lord always looks after and cares for all His beings and creatures; He is with all, near and far.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujhaaisee jis satigur purakh prabh saulaa ||
english: Those whom the Lord inspires to understand, understand; the True Guru, God, the Primal Being, is pleased with them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਉਲਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabh gaavahu gun govi(n)d hare govi(n)d hare govi(n)d hare gun gaavat gunee samaulaa ||6||
english: Let everyone sing the Praise of the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe; singing the Praise of the Lord, one is absorbed in His Glorious Virtues. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sutiaa har prabh chet man har sahaj samaadh samaai ||
english: O mind, even in sleep, remember the Lord God; let yourself be intuitively absorbed into the Celestial State of Samaadhi.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har har chaau man gur tuthaa mele maai ||1||
english: Servant Nanak's mind longs for the Lord, Har, Har. As the Guru pleases, he is absorbed into the Lord, O mother. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har ikas setee pirahaRee har iko merai chit ||
english: I am in love with the One and Only Lord; the One Lord fills my consciousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਕਸ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak ik adhaar har prabh ikas te gat pat ||2||
english: Servant Nanak takes the Support of the One Lord God; through the One, he obtains honor and salvation. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚੇ ਸਬਦ ਵਜੇ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)che sabad vaje mat guramat vadabhaagee anahad vajiaa ||
english: The Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrate with the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings; by great good fortune, the Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aanad mool raam sabh dekhiaa gurasabadee govid gajiaa ||
english: I see the Lord, the Source of Bliss, everywhere; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord of the Universe is revealed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਵੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad ves har eko mat guramat har prabh bhajiaa ||
english: From the primal beginning, and throughout the ages, the Lord has One Form. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, I vibrate and meditate on the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har devahu daan daiaal prabh jan raakhahu har prabh lajiaa ||
english: O Merciful Lord God, please bless me with Your Bounty; O Lord God, please preserve and protect the honor of Your humble servant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਕਜਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabh dha(n)n kahahu gur satiguroo gur satiguroo jit mil har paRadaa kajiaa ||7||
english: Let everyone proclaim: Blessed is the Guru, the True Guru, the Guru, the True Guru; meeting Him, the Lord covers their faults and deficiencies. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਉਛਲੈ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਵਹੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sarovar uchhalai subhar bhare vaha(n)n ||
english: The sacred pool of devotional worship is filled to the brim and overflowing in torrents.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur ma(n)niaa jan naanak vadabhaag laha(n)n ||1||
english: Those who obey the True Guru, O servant Nanak, are very fortunate - they find it. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har har naam asa(n)kh har har ke gun kathan na jaahi ||
english: The Names of the Lord, Har, Har, are countless. The Glorious Virtues of the Lord, Har, Har, cannot be described.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har har agam agaadh har jan kit bidh milahi milaahi ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; how can the humble servants of the Lord be united in His Union?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਜਪੰਤ ਜਨ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har jas japat japa(n)t jan ik til nahee keemat paai ||
english: Those humble beings meditate and chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, but they do not attain even a tiny bit of His Worth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har agam prabh har mel laihu laR laai ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, the Lord God is Inaccessible; the Lord has attached me to His Robe, and united me in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: har agam agochar agam har kiu kar har darasan pikhaa ||
english: The Lord is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. How will I see the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਵਰਨੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: kichh vakhar hoi s varaneeai tis roop na rikhaa ||
english: If He were a material object, then I could describe Him, but He has no form or feature.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਦਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jis bujhaae aap bujhaai dei soee jan dikhaa ||
english: Understanding comes only when the Lord Himself gives understanding; only such a humble being sees it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਟਸਾਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat satigur chatasaal hai jit har gun sikhaa ||
english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru, is the school of the soul, where the Glorious Virtues of the Lord are studied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਰ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਪਾਧਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n s rasanaa dha(n)n kar dha(n)n s paadhaa satiguroo jit mil har lekhaa likhaa ||8||
english: Blessed, blessed is the tongue, blessed is the hand, and blessed is the Teacher, the True Guru; meeting Him, the Account of the Lord is written. ||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam a(n)mrit hai har japeeai satigur bhaai ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Meditate on the Lord, with love for the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam pavit hai har japat sunat dukh jaai ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har is Sacred and Pure. Chanting it and listening to it, pain is taken away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har naam tinee aaraadhiaa jin masatak likhiaa dhur paai ||
english: They alone worship and adore the Lord's Name, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਨ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: har daragah jan painaaeean jin har man vasiaa aai ||
english: Those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord; the Lord comes to abide in their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak te mukh ujale jin har suniaa man bhaai ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, their faces are radiant. They listen to the Lord; their minds are filled with love. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam nidhaan hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the greatest treasure. The Gurmukhs obtain it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin dhur masatak likhiaa tin satigur miliaa aai ||
english: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: tan man seetal hoiaa saa(n)t vasee man aai ||
english: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed; peace and tranquility come to dwell in their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak har har chaudiaa sabh daalad dukh lahi jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all poverty and pain is dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaariaa tin kau sadaa sadaa jinaa satigur meraa piaaraa dekhiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, forever and ever, to those who have seen my Beloved True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tin kau miliaa meraa satiguroo jin kau dhur masatak lekhiaa ||
english: They alone meet my True Guru, who have such pre-ordaind destiny written upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har agam dhiaaiaa guramatee tis roop nahee prabh rekhiaa ||
english: I meditate on the Inaccessible Lord, according to the Guru's Teachings; God has no form or feature.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਲਿ ਏਕਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur bachan dhiaaiaa jinaa agam har te thaakur sevak ral ekiaa ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Inaccessible Lord, merge with their Lord and Master and become one with Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖਿਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sabh kahahu mukhahu nar narahare nar narahare nar narahare har laahaa har bhagat visekhiaa ||9||
english: Let everyone proclaim out loud, the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord; the profit of devotional worship of the Lord is blessed and sublime. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਰਮੁ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ram rav rahe ram raamo raam rameet ||
english: The Lord's Name is permeating and pervading all. Repeat the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat aatam raam hai prabh khel keeo ra(n)g reet ||
english: The Lord is in the home of each and every soul. God created this play with its various colors and forms.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕੀਓ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har nikat vasai jagajeevanaa paragaas keeo gur meet ||
english: The Lord, the Life of the World, dwells near at hand. The Guru, my Friend, has made this clear.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har suaamee har prabh tin mile jin likhiaa dhur har preet ||
english: They alone meet the Lord, the Lord God, their Lord and Master, whose love for the Lord is pre-ordained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gur bachan japio man cheet ||1||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, chant it consciously with your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sajan loR lahu bhaag vasai vadabhaag ||
english: Seek the Lord God, your Best Friend; by great good fortune, He comes to dwell with the very fortunate ones.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poorai dekhaaliaa naanak har liv laag ||2||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed, O Nanak, and one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਫਲ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan suhaavee saphal ghaRee jit har sevaa man bhaanee ||
english: Blessed, blessed, beauteous and fruitful is that moment, when service to the Lord becomes pleasing to the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har kathaa sunaavahu mere gurasikhahu mere har prabh akath kahaanee ||
english: So proclaim the story of the Lord, O my GurSikhs; speak the Unspoken Speech of my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kiu paaeeai kiu dekheeai meraa har prabh sughaR sujaanee ||
english: How can I attain Him? How can I see Him? My Lord God is All-knowing and All-seeing.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har mel dikhaae aap har gur bachanee naam samaanee ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself; we merge in absorption in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: tin vitahu naanak vaariaa jo japade har nirabaanee ||10||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice unto those who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: har prabh rate loinaa giaan a(n)jan gur dei ||
english: One's eyes are anointed by the Lord God, when the Guru bestows the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai prabh sajan paaiaa jan naanak sahaj milei ||1||
english: I have found God, my Best Friend; servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar saa(n)t hai man tan naam samaai ||
english: The Gurmukh is filled with peace and tranquility deep within. His mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam chitavai naamo paRai naam rahai liv laai ||
english: He thinks of the Naam, and reads the Naam; he remains lovingly attuned to the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath paaeeai chi(n)taa gaee bilaai ||
english: He obtains the Treasure of the Naam, and is rid of anxiety.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai naam oopajai trisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, the Naam wells up, and all hunger and thirst depart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Naam, gathers the Naam in his lap. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape jagat upaai kai tudh aape vasagat keetaa ||
english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself control it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਨਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ik manamukh kar haaraaian ikanaa mel guroo tinaa jeetaa ||
english: Some are self-willed manmukhs - they lose. Others are united with the Guru - they win.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har ootam har prabh naam hai gur bachan sabhaagai leetaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, the Lord God is Sublime. The fortunate ones chant it, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਸਭੋ ਲਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dukh daalad sabho lahi gaiaa jaa(n) naau guroo har deetaa ||
english: All pain and poverty are taken away, when the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਨੋ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੋ ਜਗਮੋਹਨੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਭੋ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sabh sevahu mohano manamohano jagamohano jin jagat upaai sabho vas keetaa ||11||
english: Let everyone serve the Enticing Enticer of the Mind, the Enticer of the World, who created the world, and controls it all. ||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)tar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manamukh durajanaa ||
english: The disease of egotism is deep within the mind; the self-willed manmukhs and the evil beings are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak rog vanjaai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the disease is cured only by meeting with the True Guru, the Holy Friend. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਸਗਾਰਵਾ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣੇ ॥
transliteration: man tan taam sagaaravaa jaa(n) dekhaa har naine ||
english: My mind and body are embellished and exalted, when I behold the Lord with my eyes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so prabh mai milai hau jeevaa sad sune ||2||
english: O Nanak, meeting with that God, I live, hearing His Voice. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath jagadeesar karate apara(n)par purakh atol ||
english: The Creator is the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, the Infinite Primal Immeasurable Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaavahu mere gurasikhahu har ootam har naam amol ||
english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, O my GurSikhs; the Lord is Sublime, the Lord's Name is Invaluable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jin dhiaaiaa hiradai dinas raat te mile nahee har rol ||
english: Those who meditate on Him in their hearts, day and night, merge with the Lord - there is no doubt about it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee sa(n)gat milai gur satigur pooraa bol ||
english: By great good fortune, they join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, and speak the Word of the Guru, the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੋ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਝਗੜੁ ਝਗੋਲੁ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sabh dhiaavahu nar naaraaino naaraaino jit chookaa jam jhagaR jhagol ||12||
english: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, by which all disputes and conflicts with Death are ended. ||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har jan har har chaudiaa sar sa(n)dhiaa gaavaar ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name, Har, Har. The foolish idiot shoots arrows at him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak har jan har liv ubare jin sa(n)dhiaa tis phir maar ||1||
english: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is saved by the Love of the Lord. The arrow is turned around, and kills the one who shot it. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਖੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: akhee prem kasaaeeaa har har naam pikha(n)nhi ||
english: The eyes which are attracted by the Lord's Love behold the Lord through the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਢਿ ਦਿਚੰਨੑਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je kar doojaa dekhade jan naanak kadh dicha(n)nhi ||2||
english: If they gaze upon something else, O servant Nanak, they ought to be gouged out. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal poorano apara(n)par soee ||
english: The Infinite Lord totally permeates the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t pratipaaladaa jo kare s hoee ||
english: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures; whatever He does comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut bhraat meet tis bin nahee koee ||
english: Without Him, we have no mother, father, children, sibling or friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar rav rahiaa japiahu jan koee ||
english: He is permeating and pervading deep within each and every heart; let everyone meditate on Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਨ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sagal japahu gopaal gun paragat sabh loee ||13||
english: Let all chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, who is manifest all over the world. ||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mile s sajanaa har prabh paaiaa ra(n)g ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who meet as friends are blessed with the Lord God's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਲੁਡਿ ਲੁਡਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too lud lud daragahi va(n)nj ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall go to His court in joyous high spirits. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har toohai daataa sabhas daa sabh jee tumhaare ||
english: Lord, You are the Great Giver of all; all beings are Yours.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh tudhai no aaraadhade daan dehi piaare ||
english: They all worship You in adoration; You bless them with Your Bounty, O Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਕਢਿਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har daatai daataar hath kadhiaa meehu vuthaa saisaare ||
english: The Generous Lord, the Great Giver reaches out with His Hands, and the rain pours down on the world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਖੇਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n ja(n)miaa khetee bhaau kar har naam samhaare ||
english: The corn germinates in the fields; contemplate the Lord's Name with love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak ma(n)gai daan prabh har naam adhaare ||2||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the Gift of the Support of the Name of his Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਛਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ichhaa man kee pooreeai japeeai sukh saagar ||
english: The desires of the mind are satisfied, meditating on the Ocean of Peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਾਧੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan araadheeahi gur sabad ratanaagar ||
english: Worship and adore the Feet of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the jewel mine.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar hoi phaatai jam kaagar ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and the Decree of Death is torn up.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤੀਐ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath jeeteeai jap har bairaagar ||
english: The treasure of this human life is won, meditating on the Lord of Detachment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਗਰੁ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sabh pavahu saran satiguroo kee binasai dukh daagar ||14||
english: Let everyone seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru; let the black spot of pain, the scar of suffering, be erased. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂੰਢੇਂਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hau dhoo(n)dhe(n)dee sajanaa sajan maidai naal ||
english: I was seeking, searching for my Friend, but my Friend is right here with me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak alakh na lakheeai guramukh dehi dikhaal ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, the Unseen is not seen, but the Gurmukh is given to see Him. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak preet laaee tin sachai tis bin rahan na jaaee ||
english: O Nanak, I am in love with the True Lord; I cannot survive without Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai har ras rasan rasaaee ||2||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the Perfect Lord is found, and the tongue savors His Sublime Essence. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋ ਉਚਰਿ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: koee gaavai ko sunai ko uchar sunaavai ||
english: Some sing, some listen, and some speek and preach.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kee mal utarai man chi(n)diaa paavai ||
english: The filth and pollution of countless lifetimes is washed away, and the wishes of the mind are fulfilled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa meteeai har ke gun gaavai ||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਰਾਹਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap tarahi sa(n)gee taraahi sabh kuta(n)b taraavai ||
english: They save themselves, and save their companions; they save all their generations as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੫॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo mere har prabh bhaavai ||15||1|| sudh ||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||15||1|| Sudh||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਾਨੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag kaanaRaa baanee naamadev jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Kaanraa, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: aiso raam raai a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: Such is the Sovereign Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਦਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise darapan maahi badan paravaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He sees everything as clearly as one's face reflected in a mirror. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੈ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ ਲੀਪ ਨ ਛੀਪੈ ॥
transliteration: basai ghataa ghat leep na chheepai ||
english: He dwells in each and every heart; no stain or stigma sticks to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan mukataa jaat na deesai ||1||
english: He is liberated from bondage; He does not belong to any social class. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: paanee maahi dekh mukh jaisaa ||
english: As one's face is reflected in the water,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਐਸਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: naame ko suaamee beethal aisaa ||2||1||
english: so does Naam Dayv's Beloved Lord and Master appear. ||2||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raamaa ram raamai a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: The Lord, the Beauteous Lord - no one has found His limits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤੂ ਬਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik pratipaare tumare too bad purakh pitaa meraa maaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a child - You cherish and sustain me. You are the Great Primal Being, my Mother and Father. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਗਮ ਹਹਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam asa(n)kh agam hahi agam agam har raaiaa ||
english: The Names of the Lord are Countless and Unfathomable. My Sovereign Lord is Unfathomable and Incomprehensible.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gunee giaanee surat bahu keenee ik til nahee keemat paaiaa ||1||
english: The virtuous and the spiritual teachers have given it great thought, but they have not found even an iota of His Value. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gobid gun gobid sad gaavahi gun gobid a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe forever. They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, but they do not find His limits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too amit atol apara(n)par suaamee bahu japeeai thaah na paaiaa ||2||
