english: You are Immeasurable, Unweighable, and Infinite, O Lord and Master; no matter how much one may meditate on You, Your Depth cannot be fathomed. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜਨ ਮਾਧੌ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: usatat karahi tumaree jan maadhau gun gaavahi har raaiaa ||
english: Lord, Your humble servants praise You, singing Your Glorious Praises, O Sovereign Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਮੀਨੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tumh jal nidh ham meene tumare teraa a(n)t na katahoo paaiaa ||3||
english: You are the ocean of water, and I am Your fish. No one has ever found Your limits. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jan kau kripaa karahu madhasoodan har devahu naam japaaiaa ||
english: Please be Kind to Your humble servant, Lord; please bless me with the meditation of Your Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: mai moorakh a(n)dhule naam tek hai jan naanak guramukh paaiaa ||4||1||
english: I am a blind fool; Your Name is my only Support. Servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, has found it. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਹਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har jan gun gaavat hasiaa ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord sings the Lord's Praise, and blossoms forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har bhagat banee mat guramat dhur masatak prabh likhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My intellect is embellished with devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, through the Guru's Teachings. This is the destiny which God has recorded on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur ke pag simarau din raatee man har har har basiaa ||
english: I meditate in remembrance on the Guru's Feet, day and night. The Lord, Har, Har, Har, comes to dwell in my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਘਸਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har har keerat jag saaree ghas cha(n)dan jas ghasiaa ||1||
english: The Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is Excellent and Sublime in this world. His Praise is the sandalwood paste which I rub. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har jan har har har liv laaee sabh saakat khoj paiaa ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har, Har; all the faithless cynics pursue him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪਗੁ ਨਾਗਨਿ ਛੁਹਿ ਜਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu kirat sa(n)jog chalio nar ni(n)dak pag naagan chhuhi jaliaa ||2||
english: The slanderous person acts in accordance with the record of his past deeds; his foot trips over the snake, and he is stung by its bite. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jan ke tumh har raakhe suaamee tumh jug jug jan rakhiaa ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are the Saving Grace, the Protector of Your humble servants. You protect them, age after age.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਦੈਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਝਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahaa bhaiaa dait karee bakheelee sabh kar kar jhar pariaa ||3||
english: What does it matter, if a demon speaks evil? By doing so, he only gets frustrated. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jete jee ja(n)t prabh keee sabh kaalai mukh grasiaa ||
english: All the beings and creatures created by God are caught in the mouth of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: har jan har har har prabh raakhe jan naanak saran paiaa ||4||2||
english: The humble servants of the Lord are protected by the Lord God, Har, Har, Har; servant Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap jap jaga(n)naathe ||
english: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Master of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur upades har naam dhiaaio sabh kilabikh dukh laathe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, meditate on the Lord's Name, and be rid of all the painful past sins. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਹੁ ਰਸੁਨਥੇ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ek jas gaai na saakai bahu keejai bahu rasunathe ||
english: I have only one tongue - I cannot sing His Praises. Please bless me with many, many tongues.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲ ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਨਥੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baar baar khin pal sabh gaavahi gun kahi na sakahi prabh tumanathe ||1||
english: Again and again, each and every instant, with all of them, I would sing His Glorious Praises; but even then, I would not be able to sing all of Your Praises, God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਲੋਚਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਿਖਨਥੇ ॥
transliteration: ham bahu preet lagee prabh suaamee ham lochah prabh dikhanathe ||
english: I am so deeply in love with God, my Lord and Master; I long to see God's Vision.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਬਡ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਬਿਰਥੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tum bad daate jee jeean ke tum jaanahu ham birathe ||2||
english: You are the Great Giver of all beings and creatures; only You know our inner pain. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਦਿਨਥੇ ॥
transliteration: koee maarag pa(n)th bataavai prabh kaa kahu tin kau kiaa dinathe ||
english: If only someone would show me the Way, the Path of God. Tell me - what could I give him?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਅਰਪਿ ਅਰਾਪਉ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਥੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh tan man arapau arap araapau koee melai prabh milathe ||3||
english: I would surrender, offer and dedicate all my body and mind to him; if only someone would unite me in God's Union! ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਮ ਤੁਛ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਰਨਥੇ ॥
transliteration: har ke gun bahut bahut bahu sobhaa ham tuchh kar kar baranathe ||
english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are so many and numerous; I can describe only a tiny bit of them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: hamaree mat vasagat prabh tumarai jan naanak ke prabh samarathe ||4||3||
english: My intellect is under Your control, God; You are the All-powerful Lord God of servant Nanak. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਨਥਈ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap har gun akath sunathaee ||
english: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, which are said to be inexpressible.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਮੋਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਗਿ ਫਿਰਥਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dharam arath sabh kaam mokh hai jan peechhai lag phirathaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Rightousness and Dharmic faith, success and prosperity, pleasure, the fulfillment of desires and liberation - all follow the humble servant of the Lord like a shadow. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਈ ॥
transliteration: so har har naam dhiaavai har jan jis badabhaag mathaee ||
english: That humble servant of the Lord who has such good fortune written on his forehead meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਤਹ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਥਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah daragahi prabh lekhaa maagai tah chhutai naam dhiaaithaee ||1||
english: In that Court, where God calls for the accounts, there, you shall be saved only by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗਥਈ ॥
transliteration: hamare dokh bahu janam janam ke dukh haumai mail lagathaee ||
english: I am stained with the filth of the mistakes of countless lifetimes, the pain and pollution of egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਥਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur dhaar kripaa har jal naavaae sabh kilabikh paap gathaee ||2||
english: Showering His Mercy, the Guru bathed me in the Water of the Lord, and all my sins and mistakes were taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਥਈ ॥
transliteration: jan kai rid a(n)tar prabh suaamee jan har har naam bhajathaee ||
english: God, our Lord and Master, is deep within the hearts of His humble servants. They vibrate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਥਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jah a(n)tee ausar aai banat hai tah raakhai naam saathaee ||3||
english: And when that very last moment comes, then the Naam is our Best Friend and Protector. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਗੰਨਥਈ ॥
transliteration: jan teraa jas gaavahi har har prabh har japio jaga(n)nathaee ||
english: Your humble servants sing Your Praises, O Lord, Har, Har; they chant and meditate on the Lord God, the Master of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਰਖੁ ਬੁਡਥਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh raakhe suaamee ham paathar rakh budathaee ||4||4||
english: O God, my Saving Grace, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, please save me, the sinking stone. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਚਿਤਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: hamaree chitavanee har prabh jaanai ||
english: Only the Lord God knows my innermost thoughts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aur koee ni(n)d karai har jan kee prabh taa kaa kahiaa ik til nahee maanai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If someone slanders the humble servant of the Lord, God does not believe even a tiny bit of what he says. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਅਚੁਤ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: aur sabh tiaag sevaa kar achut jo sabh te ooch thaakur bhagavaanai ||
english: So give up everything else, and serve the Imperishable; The Lord God, our Lord and Master, is the Highest of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਚਰਨੀ ਆਇ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har sevaa te kaal johi na saakai charanee aai pavai har jaanai ||1||
english: When you serve the Lord, Death cannot even see you. It comes and falls at the feet of those who know the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪੈ ਕਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau raakh lei meraa suaamee taa kau sumat dei pai kaanai ||
english: Those whom my Lord and Master protects - a balanced wisdom comes to their ears.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਅਪਰਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kau koee apar na saakai jaa kee bhagat meraa prabh maanai ||2||
english: No one can equal them; their devotional worship is accepted by my God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨ ਦੇਖੁ ਜਨ ਜੋ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: har ke choj vidaan dekh jan jo khotaa kharaa ik nimakh pachhaanai ||
english: So behold the Wondrous and Amazing Play of the Lord. In an instant, He distinguishes the genuine from the counterfeit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਰਿਦ ਸੁਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa te jan kau anad bhaiaa hai rid sudh mile khote pachhutaanai ||3||
english: And that is why His humble servant is in bliss. Those of pure heart meet together, while the evil ones regret and repent. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: tum har daate samarath suaamee ik maagau tujh paasahu har daanai ||
english: Lord, You are the Great Giver, our All-powerful Lord and Master; O Lord, I beg for only one gift from You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਦ ਬਸਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਾਨੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har kripaa kar deejai sad basahi ridai mohi har charaanai ||4||5||
english: Lord, please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace, that Your Feet may abide forever within my heart. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਗੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh keejai kripaa nidhaan ham har gun gaavahage ||
english: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless me, that I may sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau tumaree karau nit aas prabh mohi kab gal laavahige ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I always place my hopes in You; O God, when will you take me in Your Embrace? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik mugadh iaan pitaa samajhaavahige ||
english: I am a foolish and ignorant child; Father, please teach me!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਭਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sut khin khin bhool bigaar jagat pit bhaavahige ||1||
english: Your child makes mistakes again and again, but still, You are pleased with him, O Father of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਮ ਪਾਵਹਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jo har suaamee tum dehu soee ham paavahage ||
english: Whatever You give me, O my Lord and Master - that is what I receive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਵਹਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mohi doojee naahee thaur jis pahi ham jaavahage ||2||
english: There is no other place where I can go. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jo har bhaavahi bhagat tinaa har bhaavahige ||
english: Those devotees who are pleasing to the Lord - the Lord is pleasing to them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jotee jot milaai jot ral jaavahage ||3||
english: Their light merges into the Light; the lights are merged and blended together. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
transliteration: har aape hoi kripaal aap liv laavahige ||
english: The Lord Himself has shown mercy; He lovingly attunes me to Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak saran duaar har laaj rakhaavahige ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Door of the Lord, who protects his honor. ||4||6|| First Set of Six ||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਭੋਪਾਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan bhopaalee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan Bhopaalee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesur suaamee dookh nivaaran naaraaine ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord and Master, Destroyer of pain, Transcendental Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhagat jaachahi sukh saagar bhav nidh taran har chi(n)taamane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All Your devotees beg of You. Ocean of peace, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean; You are the Wish-fulfilling Jewel. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal jagadees damodar har a(n)tarajaamee gobi(n)de ||
english: Merciful to the meek and poor, Lord of the world, Support of the earth, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: te nirabhau jin sreeraam dhiaaiaa guramat muraar har muka(n)de ||1||
english: Those who meditate on the Supreme Lord become fearless. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, they meditate on the Lord, the Liberator Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਜੋ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jagadeesur charan saran jo aae te jan bhav nidh paar pare ||
english: Those who come to Sanctuary at the Feet of the Lord of the Universe - those humble beings cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kee paij har raakhai jan naanak aap har kripaa kare ||2||1||7||
english: The Lord preserves the honor of His humble devotees; O servant Nanak, the Lord Himself showers them with His Grace. ||2||1||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag kaliaan mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਏਹ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: hamaarai eh kirapaa keejai ||
english: Please grant me this blessing:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਲਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: al makara(n)d charan kamal siu man pher pher reejhai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: May the bumble-bee of my mind be immersed again and again in the Honey of Your Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਜਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan jalaa siu kaaj na kachhooai har boo(n)d chaatrik kau deejai ||1||
english: I am not concerned with any other water; please bless this songbird with a Drop of Your Water, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: bin milabe naahee sa(n)tokhaa pekh darasan naanak jeejai ||2||1||
english: Unless I meet my Lord, I am not satisfied. Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||2||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
transliteration: jaachik naam jaachai jaachai ||
english: This beggar begs and begs for Your Name, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab dhaar sarab ke naaik sukh samooh ke daate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the Support of all, the Master of all, the Giver of absolute peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀ ਕੇਤੀ ਮਾਂਗਨਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਭਾਵਨੀਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ketee ketee maa(n)gan maagai bhaavaneeaa so paaeeai ||1||
english: So many, so very many, beg for charity at Your Door; they receive only what You are pleased to give. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਰੇ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saphal saphal saphal daras re paras paras gun gaaeeai ||
english: Fruitful, fruitful, fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; touching His Touch, I sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tat tat siu mileeai heerai heer bidhaaeeai ||2||2||
english: O Nanak, one's essence is blended into the Essence; the diamond of the mind is pierced through by the Diamond of the Lord. ||2||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
transliteration: mere laalan kee sobhaa ||
english: O, the Wondrous Glory of my Beloved!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨ ਮਨ ਰੰਗੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sad navatan man ra(n)gee sobhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind is rejuvenated forever by His Wondrous Love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: braham mahes sidh mun i(n)draa bhagat daan jas ma(n)gee ||1||
english: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra beg for the charity of His Praise and devotion to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੇਖਨਾਗੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਪਹਿ ਤਰੰਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jog giaan dhiaan sekhanaagai sagal japahi tara(n)gee ||
english: Yogis, spiritual teachers, meditators and the thousand-headed serpent all meditate on the Waves of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)tan balihaarai jo prabh ke sad sa(n)gee ||2||3||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Saints, who are the Eternal Companions of God. ||2||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: terai maan har har maan ||
english: Belief in You, Lord, brings honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗੇ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nain bain sravan suneeai a(n)g a(n)ge sukh praan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: To see with my eyes, and hear with my ears - every limb and fiber of my being, and my breath of life are in bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਮੇਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: it ut dah dis ravio mer tinahi samaan ||1||
english: Here and there, and in the ten directions You are pervading, in the mountain and the blade of grass. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤਾ ਤਤ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jat kataa tat pekheeai har purakh pat paradhaan ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, the Supreme Lord, the Primal Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਥੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhram bhai mite kathe naanak braham giaan ||2||1||4||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, doubt and fear are dispelled. Nanak speaks the Wisdom of God. ||2||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਬੇਦ ॥
transliteration: gun naad dhun ana(n)d bed ||
english: The Glory of God is the Sound-current of the Naad, the Celestial Music of Bliss, and the Wisdom of the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kathat sunat mun janaa mil sa(n)t ma(n)dalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Speaking and listening, the silent sages and humble beings join together, in the Realm of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਮਨ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਹ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan maan daan man rasik rasan naam japat tah paap kha(n)dalee ||1||
english: Spiritual wisdom, meditation, faith and charity are there; their minds savor the Taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting it, sins are destroyed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਤਤ ਬੇਤੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਅਖੰਡਲੀ ॥
transliteration: jog jugat giaan bhugat surat sabad tat bete jap tap akha(n)dalee ||
english: This is the technology of Yoga, spiritual wisdom, devotion, intuitive knowledge of the Shabad, certain knowledge of the Essence of Reality, chanting and unbroken intensive meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਛੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਡੰਡਲੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: ot pot mil jot naanak kachhoo dukh na da(n)dalee ||2||2||5||
english: Through and through, O Nanak, merging into the Light, you shall never again suffer pain and punishment. ||2||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: kaun bidh taa kee kahaa karau ||
english: What should I do, and how should I do it?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਗਿਆ ਅਜਰ ਪਦੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dharat dhiaan giaan sasatragiaa ajar pad kaise jarau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Should I center myself in meditation, or study the spiritual wisdom of the Shaastras? How can I endure this unendurable state? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisan mahes sidh mun i(n)draa kai dar saran parau ||1||
english: Vishnu, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - at whose door should I seek sanctuary? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਉ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo pahi raaj kaahoo pahi suragaa kot madhe mukat kahau ||
english: Some have power and influence, and some are blessed with heavenly paradise, but out of millions, will anyone find liberation?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਗਹਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak naam ras paaeeai saadhoo charan gahau ||2||3||6||
english: Says Nanak, I have attained the Sublime Essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I touch the feet of the Holy. ||2||3||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਖੇ ॥
transliteration: praanapat daiaal purakh prabh sakhe ||
english: The Lord of the Breath of Life, the Merciful Primal Lord God, is my Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: garabh jon kal kaal jaal dukh binaasan har rakhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord saves us from the womb of reincarnation and the noose of death in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; He takes away our pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naam dhaaree saran teree ||
english: I enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh daiaal tek meree ||1||
english: O Merciful Lord God, You are my only Support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਆਸਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: anaath deen aasava(n)t ||
english: You are the only Hope of the helpless, the meek and the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam suaamee manahi ma(n)t ||2||
english: Your Name, O my Lord and Master, is the Mantra of the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੂ ॥
transliteration: tujh binaa prabh kichhoo na jaanoo ||
english: I know of nothing except You, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sarab jug mahi tum pachhaanoo ||3||
english: Throughout all the ages, I realize You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸਰੋ ॥
transliteration: har man base nis baasaro ||
english: O Lord, You dwell in my mind night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਰੋ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d naanak aasaro ||4||4||7||
english: The Lord of the Universe is Nanak's only Support. ||4||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: man tan jaapeeai bhagavaan ||
english: Within my mind and body I meditate on the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore suprasa(n)n bhae sadaa sookh kaliaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru is pleased and satisfied; I am blessed with eternal peace and happiness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sarab kaaraj sidh bhae gaai gun gupaal ||
english: All affairs are successfuly resolved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਨਾਠਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat prabhoo simare naathiaa dukh kaal ||1||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I dwell upon God, and the pain of death is taken away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh meriaa karau din rain sev ||
english: Please take pity on me, O my God, that I may serve You day and night.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak daas saranaagatee har purakh pooran dev ||2||5||8||
english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Perfect, Divine Primal Being. ||2||5||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh meraa a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
english: My God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa pooran paramesar nihachal sach sabad neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Take pity on me, O Perfect Transcendent Lord; bless me with the True Eternal Insignia of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har bin aan na koee samarath teree aas teraa man taan ||
english: O Lord, other than You, no one is all-powerful. You are the Hope and the Strength of my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab ghataa ke daate suaamee dehi s pahiran khaan ||1||
english: You are the Giver to the hearts of all beings, O Lord and Master. I eat and wear whatever You give me. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: surat mat chaturaaee sobhaa roop ra(n)g dhan maan ||
english: Intuitive understanding, wisdom and cleverness, glory and beauty, pleasure, wealth and honor,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੯॥
transliteration: sarab sookh aana(n)d naanak jap raam naam kaliaan ||2||6||9||
english: all comforts, bliss, happiness and salvation, O Nanak, come by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||6||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਕਲਿਆਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
transliteration: har charan saran kaliaan karan ||
english: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet bring salvation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh naam patit paavano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God's Name is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jap nisa(n)g jamakaal tis na khaavano ||1||
english: Whoever chants and meditates in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall undoubtedly escape being consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਨੋ ॥
transliteration: mukat jugat anik sookh har bhagat lavai na laavano ||
english: Liberation, the key to success, and all sorts of comforts do not equal loving devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਲੁਬਧ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਨੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੦॥
transliteration: prabh daras lubadh daas naanak bahuR jon na dhaavano ||2||7||10||
english: Slave Nanak longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; he shall never again wander in reincarnation. ||2||||7||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raamaa ram raamo sun man bheejai ||
english: Hearing the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, my mind is drenched with joy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam a(n)mrit ras meethaa guramat sahaje peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar, the most Sweet and Sublime Essence; through the Guru's Teachings, drink it in with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਹੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਮਥਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kaasat mahi jiu hai baisa(n)tar math sa(n)jam kaadh kadheejai ||
english: The potential energy of fire is within the wood; it is released if you know how to rub it and generate friction.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam hai jot sabaaee tat guramat kaadh laeejai ||1||
english: In just the same way, the Lord's Name is the Light within all; the Essence is extracted by following the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜ ਨਵੇ ਦਰ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦਸਵੇ ਚੁਈਜੈ ॥
transliteration: nau daravaaj nave dar pheeke ras a(n)mrit dasave chueejai ||
english: There are nine doors, but the taste of these nine doors is bland and insipid. The Essence of Ambrosial Nectar trickles down through the Tenth Door.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kirapaa kar piaare gurasabadee har ras peejai ||2||
english: Please take pity on me - be kind and compassionate, O my Beloved, that I may drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਨਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar nagar hai neeko vich saudaa har ras keejai ||
english: The body-village is the most sublime and exalted village, in which the merchandise of the Lord's Sublime Essence is traded.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ratan laal amol amolak satigur sevaa leejai ||3||
english: The most precious and priceless gems and jewels are obtained by serving the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਰਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur agam agam hai thaakur bhar saagar bhagat kareejai ||
english: The True Guru is Inaccessible; Inaccessible is our Lord and Master. He is the overflowing Ocean of bliss - worship Him with loving devotion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਮ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar deen ham saari(n)g ik boo(n)d naam mukh deejai ||4||
english: Please take pity on me, and be Merciful to this meek song-bird; please pour a drop of Your Name into my mouth. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਰੰਗਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: laalan laal laal hai ra(n)gan man ra(n)gan kau gur deejai ||
english: O Beloved Lord, please color my mind with the Deep Crimson Color of Your Love; I have surrendered my mind to the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਗਟਕ ਨਿਤ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: raam raam raam ra(n)g raate ras rasik gatak nit peejai ||5||
english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, continually drink in this essence in big gulps, savoring its sweet taste. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਢਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: basudhaa sapat deep hai saagar kadh ka(n)chan kaadh dhareejai ||
english: If all the gold of the seven continents and the oceans was taken out and placed before them,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਇਨਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: mere thaakur ke jan inahu na baachhahi har maagahi har ras deejai ||6||
english: the humble servants of my Lord and Master would not even want it. They beg for the Lord to bless them with the Lord's Sublime Essence. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਖੇ ਨਿਤ ਭੂਖਨ ਭੂਖ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saakat nar praanee sad bhookhe nit bhookhan bhookh kareejai ||
english: The faithless cynics and mortal beings remain hungry forever; they continually cry out in hunger.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਖ ਕੋਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਥਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: dhaavat dhaai dhaavahi preet maaiaa lakh kosan kau bith deejai ||7||
english: They hurry and run, and wander all around, caught in the love of Maya; they cover hundreds of thousands of miles in their wanderings. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har har har har har jan ootam kiaa upamaa tinh deejai ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are sublime and exalted. What praise can we bestow upon them?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam tul aur na upamaa jan naanak kripaa kareejai ||8||1||
english: Nothing else can equal the Glory of the Lord's Name; please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace. ||8||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raam gur paaras paras kareejai ||
english: O Lord, please bless me with the Touch of the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀ ਮਨੂਰ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham niragunee manoor at pheeke mil satigur paaras keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I was unworthy, utterly useless, rusty slag; meeting with the True Guru, I was transformed by the Philosopher's Stone. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: surag mukat baiku(n)th sabh baa(n)chhahi nit aasaa aas kareejai ||
english: Everyone longs for paradise, liberation and heaven; all place their hopes in them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har darasan ke jan mukat na maa(n)gahi mil darasan tripat man dheejai ||1||
english: The humble long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they do not ask for liberation. Their minds are satisfied and comforted by His Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗ ਲਗੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabal hai bhaaree mohu kaalakh daag lageejai ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is very powerful; this attachment is a black stain which sticks.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਪੰਕੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mere thaakur ke jan alipat hai mukate jiu muragaaee pa(n)k na bheejai ||2||
english: The humble servants of my Lord and Master are unattached and liberated. They are like ducks, whose feathers do not get wet. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਵੇੜੀ ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan vaas bhuia(n)gam veRee kiv mileeai cha(n)dan leejai ||
english: The fragrant sandalwood tree is encircled by snakes; how can anyone get to the sandalwood?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਛੇਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaadh khaRag gur giaan karaaraa bikh chhed chhed ras peejai ||3||
english: Drawing out the Mighty Sword of the Guru's Spiritual Wisdom, I slaughter and kill the poisonous snakes, and drink in the Sweet Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਸਮਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਪਲੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਭਸਮ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aan aan samadhaa bahu keenee pal baisa(n)tar bhasam kareejai ||
english: You may gather wood and stack it in a pile, but in an instant, fire reduces it to ashes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਪਾਪ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੂਕੀ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mahaa ugr paap saakat nar keene mil saadhoo lookee deejai ||4||
english: The faithless cynic gathers the most horrendous sins, but meeting with the Holy Saint, they are placed in the fire. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke jin a(n)tar naam dhareejai ||
english: The Holy, Saintly devotees are sublime and exalted. They enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸ ਨਿਪਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਦਿਖੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: paras niparas bhae saadhoo jan jan har bhagavaan dikheejai ||5||
english: By the touch of the Holy and the humble servants of the Lord, the Lord God is seen. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੂਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਰਝੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਨੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saakat soot bahu gurajhee bhariaa kiu kar taan taneejai ||
english: The thread of the faithless cynic is totally knotted and tangled; how can anything be woven with it?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ta(n)t soot kichh nikasai naahee saakat sa(n)g na keejai ||6||
english: This thread cannot be woven into yarn; do not associate with those faithless cynics. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur saadhasa(n)gat hai neekee mil sa(n)gat raam raveejai ||
english: The True Guru and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are exalted and sublime. Joining the Congregation, meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ratan javehar maanak gur kirapaa te leejai ||7||
english: The gems, jewels and precious stones are deep within; by Guru's Grace, they are found. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa thaakur vadaa vadaa hai suaamee ham kiu kar milah mileejai ||
english: My Lord and Master is Glorious and Great. How can I be united in His Union?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak mel milaae gur pooraa jan kau pooran deejai ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, the Perfect Guru unites His humble servant in His Union, and blesses him with perfection. ||8||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raamaa ram raamo raam raveejai ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke mil saadhoo har ra(n)g keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Holy, the humble and Holy, are noble and sublime. Meeting with the Holy, I joyfully love the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh jag hai jetaa man dolat dol kareejai ||
english: The minds of all the beings and creatures of the world waver unsteadily.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਥੰਮਨ ਕਉ ਥੰਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar saadh milaavahu jag tha(n)man kau tha(n)m deejai ||1||
english: Please take pity on them, be merciful to them, and unite them with the Holy; establish this support to support the world. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਰੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: basudhaa talai talai sabh oopar mil saadhoo charan ruleejai ||
english: The earth is beneath us, and yet its dust falls down on all; let yourself be covered by the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: at ootam at ootam hovahu sabh sisat charan tal deejai ||2||
english: You shall be utterly exalted, the most noble and sublime of all; the whole world will place itself at your feet. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਸਿਵ ਨੀਕੀ ਆਨਿ ਪਾਨੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jot bhalee siv neekee aan paanee sakat bhareejai ||
english: The Gurmukhs are blessed with the Divine Light of the Lord; Maya comes to serve them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਨਦੰਤ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਚਬਿ ਚਬਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mainada(n)t nikase gur bachanee saar chab chab har ras peejai ||3||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, they bite with teeth of wax and chew iron, drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam anugrahu bahu keeaa gur saadhoo purakh mileejai ||
english: The Lord has shown great mercy, and bestowed His Name; I have met with the Holy Guru, the Primal Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gun raam naam bisatheeran keee har sagal bhavan jas deejai ||4||
english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name have spread out everywhere; the Lord bestows fame all over the world. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo saadh saadh man preetam bin dekhe rahi na sakeejai ||
english: The Beloved Lord is within the minds of the Holy, the Holy Saadhus; without seeing Him, they cannot survive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਜਲੰ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jiu jal meen jala(n) jal preet hai khin jal bin phoot mareejai ||5||
english: The fish in the water loves only the water. Without water, it bursts and dies in an instant. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਭਾਗ ਅਭਾਗ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਨ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: mahaa abhaag abhaag hai jin ke tin saadhoo dhoor na peejai ||
english: Those who have terrible luck and bad fortune do not drink in the water which washes the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਜਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tinaa tisanaa jalat jalat nahee boojhahi da(n)d dharam raai kaa deejai ||6||
english: The burning fire of their desires is not extinguished; they are beaten and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਜਗੵ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਿਵੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਗਾਲਿ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh teerath barat jagy pu(n)n keee hivai gaal gaal tan chheejai ||
english: You may visit all the sacred shrines, observe fasts and sacred feasts, give generously in charity and waste away the body, melting it in the snow.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: atulaa tol raam naam hai guramat ko pujai na tol tuleejai ||7||
english: The weight of the Lord's Name is unweighable, according to the Guru's Teachings; nothing can equal its weight. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: tav gun braham braham too jaanahi jan naanak saran pareejai ||
english: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues. Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੀਨ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: too jal nidh meen ham tere kar kirapaa sa(n)g rakheejai ||8||3||
english: You are the Ocean of water, and I am Your fish. Please be kind, and keep me always with You. ||8||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raamaa ram raamo pooj kareejai ||
english: I worship and adore the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan arap dharau sabh aagai ras guramat giaan driReejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I surrender my mind and body, and place everything before Him; following the Guru's Teachings, spiritual wisdom is implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਨਿਤ ਚੁਨਿ ਚੁਨਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: braham naam gun saakh tarovar nit chun chun pooj kareejai ||
english: God's Name is the tree, and His Glorious Virtues are the branches. Picking and gathering up the fruit, I worship Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aatam deu deu hai aatam ras laagai pooj kareejai ||1||
english: The soul is divine; divine is the soul. Worship Him with love. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bibek budh sabh jag mahi niramal bichar bichar ras peejai ||
english: One of keen intellect and precise understanding is immaculate in all this world. In thoughtful consideration, he drinks in the sublime essence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaad padaarath paaiaa satigur kau ihu man deejai ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, the treasure is found; dedicate this mind to the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਤਿ ਹੀਰੋ ਨੀਕੋ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: niramolak at heero neeko heerai heer bidheejai ||
english: Priceless and utterly sublime is the Diamond of the Lord. This Diamond pierces the diamond of the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man motee saal hai gurasabadee jit heeraa parakh laeejai ||3||
english: The mind becomes the jeweller, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; it appraises the Diamond of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਊਚੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਪ ਪਲਾਸ ਖਾਇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat sa(n)t sa(n)g lag ooche jiu peep palaas khaai leejai ||
english: Attaching oneself to the Society of the Saints, one is exalted and uplifted, as the palaas tree is absorbed by the peepal tree.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh nar mahi praanee ootam hovai raam naamai baas baseejai ||4||
english: That mortal being is supreme among all people, who is perfumed by the fragrance of the Lord's Name. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ ਜੜੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: niramal niramal karam bahu keene nit saakhaa haree jaReejai ||
english: One who continually acts in goodness and immaculate purity, sprouts green branches in great abundance.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਹਕਾਰ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਗਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dharam phul phal gur giaan driRaaiaa bahakaar baas jag deejai ||5||
english: The Guru has taught me that Dharmic faith is the flower, and spiritual wisdom is the fruit; this fragrance permeates the world. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ek jot eko man vasiaa sabh braham drisat ik keejai ||
english: The One, the Light of the One, abides within my mind; God, the One, is seen in all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਪਸਰੇ ਸਭ ਚਰਨ ਤਲੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aatam raam sabh ekai hai pasare sabh charan tale sir deejai ||6||
english: The One Lord, the Supreme Soul, is spread out everywhere; all place their heads beneath His Feet. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਾਕ ਵਢੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa nakate nar dekhahu tin ghas ghas naak vadheejai ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, people look like criminals with their noses cut off; bit by bit, their noses are cut off.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: saakat nar aha(n)kaaree kaheeahi bin naavai dhrig jeeveejai ||7||
english: The faithless cynics are called egotistical; without the Name, their lives are cursed. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੇਗਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jab lag saas saas man a(n)tar tat begal saran pareejai ||
english: As long as the breath breathes through the mind deep within, hurry and seek God's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak kripaa kripaa kar dhaarahu mai saadhoo charan pakheejai ||8||4||
english: Please shower Your Kind Mercy and take pity upon Nanak, that he may wash the feet of the Holy. ||8||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਧੁਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raamaa mai saadhoo charan dhuveejai ||
english: O Lord, I wash the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਹਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh dahan hohi khin a(n)tar mere thaakur kirapaa keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: May my sins be burnt away in an instant; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਖਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਅਤਿ ਤਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gat jan deen khare dar thaadhe at tarasan kau daan deejai ||
english: The meek and humble beggars stand begging at Your Door. Please be generous and give to those who are yearning.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: traahi traahi saran prabh aae mo kau guramat naam driReejai ||1||
english: Save me, save me, O God - I have come to Your Sanctuary. Please implant the Guru's Teachings, and the Naam within me. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜੂਝੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh nagar mahi sabalaa nit uth uth joojh kareejai ||
english: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the body-village; I rise up to fight the battle against them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar karahu rakh levahu gur pooraa kaadh kadheejai ||2||
english: Please make me Your Own and save me; through the Perfect Guru, I drive them out. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਬਲ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਹਿਵ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agan sabal at bikhiaa hiv seetal sabad gur deejai ||
english: The powerful fire of corruption is raging violently within; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the ice water which cools and soothes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tan man saa(n)t hoi adhikaaee rog kaatai sookh saveejai ||3||
english: My mind and body are calm and tranquil; the disease has been cured, and now I sleep in peace. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਸਭ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu sooraj kiran raviaa sarab thaaee sabh ghat ghat raam raveejai ||
english: As the rays of the sun spread out everywhere, the Lord pervades each and every heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saadhoo saadh mile ras paavai tat nij ghar baithiaa peejai ||4||
english: Meeting the Holy Saint, one drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord; sitting in the home of your own inner being, drink in the essence. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੂਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jan kau preet lagee gur setee jiu chakavee dekh sooreejai ||
english: The humble being is in love with the Guru, like the chakvi bird which loves to see the sun.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਖੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਢੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nirakhat nirakhat rain sabh nirakhee mukh kaadhai a(n)mrit peejai ||5||
english: She watches, and keeps on watching all through the night; and when the sun shows its face, she drinks in the Amrit. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੁਆਨ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saakat suaan kaheeahi bahu lobhee bahu duramat mail bhareejai ||
english: The faithless cynic is said to be very greedy - he is a dog. He is overflowing with the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਸੁਆਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aapan suaai karahi bahu baataa tinaa kaa visaahu kiaa keejai ||6||
english: He talks excessively about his own interests. How can he be trusted? ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo saadh saran mil sa(n)gat jit har ras kaadh kadheejai ||
english: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: paraupakaar bolahi bahu guneeaa mukh sa(n)t bhagat har deejai ||7||
english: They do good deeds for others, and speak of the Lord's many Glorious Virtues; please bless me to meet these Saints, these devotees of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: too agam daiaal daiaa pat daataa sabh daiaa dhaar rakh leejai ||
english: You are the Inaccessible Lord, Kind and Compassionate, the Great Giver; please shower us with Your Mercy, and save us.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: sarab jee jagajeevan eko naanak pratipaal kareejai ||8||5||
english: You are the Life of all the beings of the world; please cherish and sustain Nanak. ||8||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raamaa ham daasan daas kareejai ||
english: O Lord, please make me the slave of Your slaves.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਿਵੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab lag saas hoi man a(n)tar saadhoo dhoor piveejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As long as there is breath deep within my mind, let me drink in the dust of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਸੇਖਨਾਗ ਮੁਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਲੋਚੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kar naarad sekhanaag mun dhoor saadhoo kee locheejai ||
english: Shiva, Naarad, the thousand-headed cobra king and the silent sages long for the dust of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhavan bhavan pavit hohi sabh jah saadhoo charan dhareejai ||1||
english: All the worlds and realms where the Holy place their feet are sanctified. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਜੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: taj laaj aha(n)kaar sabh tajeeai mil saadhoo sa(n)g raheejai ||
english: So let go of your shame and renounce all your egotism; join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and remain there.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharam raai kee kaan chukaavai bikh dubadaa kaadh kadheejai ||2||
english: Give up your fear of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and you shall be lifted up and saved from drowning in the sea of poison. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਸੂਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਉਭਿ ਸੁਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bharam sooke bahu ubh suk kaheeahi mil saadhoo sa(n)g hareejai ||
english: Some are standing, parched and shrivelled up by their doubts; joining the Saadh Sangat, they are rejuvenated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਪਲੁ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਗੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa te bilam pal dhil na keejai jaai saadhoo charan lageejai ||3||
english: So do not delay, even for an instant - go and fall at the feet of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਰਤਨ ਵਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam keeratan ratan vath har saadhoo paas rakheejai ||
english: The Kirtan of the Praise of the Lord's Name is a priceless jewel. The Lord has given it for the Holy to keep.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo bachan gur sat sat kar maanai tis aagai kaadh dhareejai ||4||
english: Whoever accepts and follows the Word of the Guru's Teachings as True - this Jewel is taken out and given to him. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਬਾਹ ਕੁਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu sunahu sunahu jan bhaaee gur kaadhee baah kukeejai ||
english: Listen, O Saints; listen, humble Siblings of Destiny: the Guru raises His Arms and sends out the call.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਿਤ ਲੋੜਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਵੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: je aatam kau sukh sukh nit loRahu taa(n) satigur saran paveejai ||5||
english: If you long for everlasting peace and comfort for your soul, then enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਤਾਂ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: je vadabhaag hoi at neekaa taa(n) guramat naam driReejai ||
english: If you have great good fortune and are very noble, then implant the Guru's Teachings and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabh maaiaa mohu bikham jag tareeai sahaje har ras peejai ||6||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is totally treacherous; drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, you shall easily, intuitively cross over the world-ocean. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਚੈ ਪਚੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa maaiaa ke jo adhikaaee vich maaiaa pachai pacheejai ||
english: Those who are totally in love with Maya, Maya, shall rot away in Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dher mahaa pa(n)th bikhaRaa aha(n)kaar bhaar lad leejai ||7||
english: The path of ignorance and darkness is utterly treacherous; they are loaded down with the crushing load of egotism. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਮ ਰਮੁ ਰਮ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak raam ram ram ram ram raamai te gat keejai ||
english: O Nanak, chanting the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, one is emancipated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਲੈ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai taa naam driRaae raam naamai ralai mileejai ||8||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the Naam is implanted within; we are united and blended with the Lord's Name. ||8||6|| First Set of Six||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag parabhaatee bibhaas mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Parbhaatee Bibhaas, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਰਣਾ ਨਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜ ॥
transliteration: naai terai taranaa naai pat pooj ||
english: Your Name carries us across; Your Name brings respect and worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ਮਤਿ ਮਕਸੂਦੁ ॥
transliteration: naau teraa gahanaa mat makasood ||
english: Your Name embellishes us; it is the object of the awakened mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naai terai naau ma(n)ne sabh koi ||
english: Your Name brings honor to everyone's name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vin naavai pat kabahu na hoi ||1||
english: Without Your Name, no one is ever respected. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: avar siaanap sagalee paaj ||
english: All other clever tricks are just for show.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਤੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jai bakhase tai pooraa kaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever the Lord blesses with forgiveness - his affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naau teraa taan naau deebaan ||
english: Your Name is my strength; Your Name is my support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naau teraa lasakar naau sulataan ||
english: Your Name is my army; Your Name is my king.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naai terai maan mahat paravaan ||
english: Your Name brings honor, glory and approval.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teree nadaree karam pavai neesaan ||2||
english: By Your Grace, one is blessed with the banner and the insignia of Your Mercy. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: naai terai sahaj naai saalaah ||
english: Your Name brings intuitive peace and poise; Your Name brings praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naau teraa a(n)mrit bikh uth jaai ||
english: Your Name is the Ambrosial Nectar which cleans out the poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: naai terai sabh sukh vasahi man aai ||
english: Through Your Name, all peace and comfort comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin naavai baadhee jam pur jaai ||3||
english: Without the Name, they are bound and gagged, and dragged off to the City of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: naaree beree ghar dar des ||
english: Man is involved with his wife, hearth and home, land and country,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: man keeaa khuseeaa keechahi ves ||
english: the pleasures of the mind and fine clothes;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਸਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) sade taa(n) dhil na paai ||
english: but when the call comes, he cannot delay.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kooR kooRo hoi jaai ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, in the end, the false turn out to be false. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: teraa naam ratan karam chaanan surat tithai loi ||
english: Your Name is the Jewel, and Your Grace is the Light. In awareness, there is Your Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਅੰਧੀ ਵਾਪਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਲੀਜੈ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dher a(n)dhee vaaparai sagal leejai khoi ||1||
english: Darkness fills the dark, and then everything is lost. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar sagal bikaar ||
english: This whole world is corrupt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa naam daaroo avar naasat karanahaar apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Name is the only cure; nothing else works, O Infinite Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਭਾਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: paataal pureeaa ek bhaar hovahi laakh karoR ||
english: One side of the scale holds tens of thousands, millions of nether regions and realms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਪਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tere laal keemat taa pavai jaa(n) sirai hovahi hor ||2||
english: O my Beloved, Your Worth could only be estimated if something else could be placed on the other side of the scale. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਸੂਖੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
transliteration: dookhaa te sukh oopajahi sookhee hovahi dookh ||
english: Out of pain, pleasure is produced, and out of pleasure comes pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jit mukh too saalaaheeahi tit mukh kaisee bhookh ||3||
english: That mouth which praises You - what hunger could that mouth ever suffer? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak moorakh ek too avar bhalaa saisaar ||
english: O Nanak, you alone are foolish; all the rest of the world is good.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jit tan naam na oopajai se tan hohi khuaar ||4||2||
english: That body in which the Naam does not well up - that body becomes miserable. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਉਚਰੇ ਸੰਕਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jai kaaran bed brahamai uchare sa(n)kar chhodee maaiaa ||
english: For His sake, Brahma uttered the Vedas, and Shiva renounced Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jai kaaran sidh bhae udaasee devee maram na paaiaa ||1||
english: For His sake, the Siddhas became hermits and renunciates; even the gods have not realized His Mystery. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: baabaa man saachaa mukh saachaa kaheeai tareeai saachaa hoee ||
english: O Baba, keep the True Lord in your mind, and utter the Name of the True Lord with your mouth; the True Lord will carry you across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dusaman dookh na aavai neRai har mat paavai koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Enemies and pain shall not even approach you; only a rare few realize the Wisdom of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਪਵਣੈ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: agan bi(n)b pavanai kee baanee teen naam ke daasaa ||
english: Fire, water and air make up the world; these three are the slaves of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਤਸਕਰ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵਹਿ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਕੋਟ ਪੰਚਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: te tasakar jo naam na levahi vaasahi kot pa(n)chaasaa ||2||
english: One who does not chant the Naam is a thief, dwelling in the fortress of the five thieves. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਫਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko ek karai cha(n)giaaee man chit bahut baphaavai ||
english: If someone does a good deed for someone else, he totally puffs himself up in his conscious mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਤੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ete gun eteeaa cha(n)giaaeeaa dei na pachhotaavai ||3||
english: The Lord bestows so many virtues and so much goodness; He does not ever regret it. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh saalaahan tin dhan palai naanak kaa dhan soee ||
english: Those who praise You gather the wealth in their laps; this is Nanak's wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਕਹੈ ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: je ko jeeu kahai onaa kau jam kee talab na hoee ||4||3||
english: Whoever shows respect to them is not summoned by the Messenger of Death. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai roop naahee jaat naahee naahee mukh maasaa ||
english: One who has no beauty, no social status, no mouth, no flesh

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur mile nira(n)jan paaiaa terai naam hai nivaasaa ||1||
english: - meeting with the True Guru, he finds the Immaculate Lord, and dwells in Your Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਧੂ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: audhoo sahaje tat beechaar ||
english: O detached Yogi, contemplate the essence of reality,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa te phir na aavahu saisaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and you shall never again come to be born into the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਚਿ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai karam naahee dharam naahee naahee such maalaa ||
english: One who does not have good karma or Dharmic faith, sacred rosary or mala

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੰਨਹੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: siv jot ka(n)nahu budh paaee satiguroo rakhavaalaa ||2||
english: - through the Light of God, wisdom is bestowed; the True Guru is our Protector. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਕਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai barat naahee nem naahee naahee bakabaaee ||
english: One who does not observe any fasts, make religious vows or chant

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gat avagat kee chi(n)t naahee satiguroo phuramaaee ||3||
english: - he does not have to worry about good luck or bad, if he obeys the Command of the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai aas naahee niraas naahee chit surat samajhaaee ||
english: One who is not hopeful, nor hopeless, who has trained his intuitive consciousness

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: ta(n)t kau param ta(n)t miliaa naanakaa budh paaee ||4||4||
english: - his being blends with the Supreme Being. O Nanak, his awareness is awakened. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa kahiaa dar paravaan ||
english: What he says is approved in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikh a(n)mrit dui sam kar jaan ||1||
english: He looks upon poison and nectar as one and the same. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kaheeai sarabe rahiaa samaai ||
english: What can I say? You are permeating and pervading all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever happens, is all by Your Will. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pragatee jot chookaa abhimaan ||
english: The Divine Light shines radiantly, and egotistical pride is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur deeaa a(n)mrit naam ||2||
english: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi aaiaa so jan jaan ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, one's birth is approved,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saachee daragah paavai maan ||3||
english: if one is honored in the True Court. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਅਕਥ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahanaa sunanaa akath ghar jaai ||
english: Speaking and listening, one goes to the Celestial Home of the Indescribable Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee naanak jal jaai ||4||5||
english: Mere words of mouth, O Nanak, are burnt away. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਹੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit neer giaan man majan athasath teerath sa(n)g gahe ||
english: One who bathes in the Ambrosial Water of spiritual wisdom takes with him the virtues of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੋੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur upades javaahar maanak seve sikh sou khoj lahai ||1||
english: The Guru's Teachings are the gems and jewels; the Sikh who serves Him searches and finds them. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur samaan teerath nahee koi ||
english: There is no sacred shrine equal to the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sar sa(n)tokh taas gur hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru encompasses the ocean of contentment. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur dareeaau sadaa jal niramal miliaa duramat mail harai ||
english: The Guru is the River, from which the Pure Water is obtained forever; it washes away the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur paaiai pooraa naavan pasoo paretahu dev karai ||2||
english: Finding the True Guru, the perfect cleansing bath is obtained, which transforms even beasts and ghosts into gods. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਲ ਹੀਅਲੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: rataa sach naam tal heeal so gur paramal kaheeai ||
english: He is said to be the Guru, with the scent of sandalwood, who is imbued with the True Name to the bottom of His Heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਸਉਰੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kee vaas banaasapat saurai taas charan liv raheeai ||3||
english: By His Fragrance, the world of vegetation is perfumed. Lovingly focus yourself on His Feet. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jee praan upajahi guramukh siv ghar jaaeeai ||
english: The life of the soul wells up for the Gurmukh; the Gurmukh goes to the House of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak sach samaaeeai guramukh nij pad paaeeai ||4||6||
english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, merges in the True One; the Gurmukh attains the exalted state of the self. ||4||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee vidiaa veechaarai paR paR paavai maan ||
english: By Guru's Grace, contemplate spiritual knowledge; read it and study it, and you shall be honored.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਾ ਮਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aapaa madhe aap paragaasiaa paaiaa a(n)mrit naam ||1||
english: Within the self, the self is revealed, when one is blessed with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: karataa too meraa jajamaan ||
english: O Creator Lord, You alone are my Benefactor.

author: Guru Nanak
