gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦਖਿਣਾ ਹਉ ਤੈ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ik dakhinaa hau tai pahi maagau dehi aapanaa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I beg for only one blessing from You: please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tasakar dhaavat raakhe chookaa man abhimaan ||
english: The five wandering thieves are captured and held, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: disat bikaaree duramat bhaagee aisaa braham giaan ||2||
english: Visions of corruption, vice and evil-mindedness run away. Such is the spiritual wisdom of God. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਚਾਵਲ ਦਇਆ ਕਣਕ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਪਾਤੀ ਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jat sat chaaval daiaa kanak kar praapat paatee dhaan ||
english: Please bless me with the rice of truth and self-restraint, the wheat of compassion, and the leaf-plate of meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਘੀਉ ਕਰਿ ਐਸਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: doodh karam sa(n)tokh gheeu kar aisaa maa(n)gau daan ||3||
english: Bless me with the milk of good karma, and the clarified butter, the ghee, of compassion. Such are the gifts I beg of You, Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਊ ਲਵੇਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਛਰਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: khimaa dheeraj kar gaoo laveree sahaje bachharaa kheer peeai ||
english: Let forgiveness and patience be my milk-cows, and let the calf of my mind intuitively drink in this milk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰਮ ਕਾ ਕਪੜਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: siphat saram kaa kapaRaa maa(n)gau har gun naanak ravat rahai ||4||7||
english: I beg for the clothes of modesty and the Lord's Praise; Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aavat kinai na raakhiaa jaavat kiu raakhiaa jaai ||
english: No one can hold anyone back from coming; how could anyone hold anyone back from going?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis te hoaa soee par jaanai jaa(n) us hee maahi samaai ||1||
english: He alone thoroughly understands this, from whom all beings come; all are merged and immersed in Him. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: toohai hai vaahu teree rajaai ||
english: Waaho! - You are Great, and Wondrous is Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਇਬਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karahi soee par hoibaa avar na karanaa jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever You do, surely comes to pass. Nothing else can happen. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਹਟ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਟਿੰਡ ਲਗਤ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਸਖਨੀ ਹੋਰ ਫੇਰ ਭਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jaise harahat kee maalaa ti(n)d lagat hai ik sakhanee hor pher bhareeat hai ||
english: The buckets on the chain of the Persian wheel rotate; one empties out to fill another.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taiso hee ihu khel khasam kaa jiu us kee vadiaaee ||2||
english: This is just like the Play of our Lord and Master; such is His Glorious Greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਿ ਕੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: suratee kai maarag chal kai ulatee nadar pragaasee ||
english: Following the path of intuitive awareness, one turns away from the world, and one's vision is enlightened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man veechaar dekh braham giaanee kaun girahee kaun udaasee ||3||
english: Contemplate this in your mind, and see, O spiritual teacher. Who is the householder, and who is the renunciate? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸਉਪਿ ਕੈ ਏਹੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis kee aasaa tis hee saup kai ehu rahiaa nirabaan ||
english: Hope comes from the Lord; surrendering to Him, we remain in the state of nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: jis te hoaa soee kar maaniaa naanak girahee udaasee so paravaan ||4||8||
english: We come from Him; surrendering to Him, O Nanak, one is approved as a householder, and a renunciate. ||4||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: disat bikaaree ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhai hau tis kai bal jaaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that one who binds in bondage his evil and corrupted gaze.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n kee saar na jaanai bhoolaa phirai ajaaee ||1||
english: One who does not know the difference between vice and virtue wanders around uselessly. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bolahu sach naam karataar ||
english: Speak the True Name of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: phun bahuR na aavan vaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Then, you shall never again have to come into this world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: oochaa te phun neech karat hai neech karai sulataan ||
english: The Creator transforms the high into the low, and makes the lowly into kings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinee jaan sujaaniaa jag te poore paravaan ||2||
english: Those who know the All-knowing Lord are approved and certified as perfect in this world. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਣ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kau samajhaavan jaaeeai je ko bhoolaa hoee ||
english: If anyone is mistaken and fooled, you should go to instruct him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape khel kare sabh karataa aisaa boojhai koee ||3||
english: The Creator Himself plays all the games; only a few understand this. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਪਰੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naau prabhaatai sabad dhiaaeeai chhodahu dunee pareetaa ||
english: Meditate on the Name, and the Word of the Shabad, in the early hours before dawn; leave your worldly entanglements behind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਜਗਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa jag haariaa tin jeetaa ||4||9||
english: Prays Nanak, the slave of God's slaves: the world loses, and he wins. ||4||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: man maaiaa man dhaaiaa man pa(n)khee aakaas ||
english: The mind is Maya, the mind is a chaser; the mind is a bird flying across the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tasakar sabad nivaariaa nagar vuthaa saabaas ||
english: The thieves are overpowered by the Shabad, and then the body-village prospers and celebrates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa too raakhahi raakh laihi saabat hovai raas ||1||
english: Lord, when You save someone, he is saved; his capital is safe and sound. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam ratan nidh merai ||
english: Such is my Treasure, the Jewel of the Naam;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਲਗਉ ਪਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat dehi lagau pag terai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: please bless me with the Guru's Teachings, so that I may fall at Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਭੋਗੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man jogee man bhogeeaa man moorakh gaavaar ||
english: The mind is a Yogi, the mind is a pleasure-seeker; the mind is foolish and ignorant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਗਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man daataa man ma(n)gataa man sir gur karataar ||
english: The mind is the giver, the mind is the beggar; the mind is the Great Guru, the Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch maar sukh paaiaa aisaa braham veechaar ||2||
english: The five thieves are conquered, and peace is attained; such is the contemplative wisdom of God. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ek vakhaaneeai kahau na dekhiaa jaai ||
english: The One Lord is said to be in each and every heart, but no one can see Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੋ ਪੂਠੋ ਰਾਲੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khoto pootho raaleeai bin naavai pat jaai ||
english: The false are cast upside-down into the womb of reincarnation; without the Name, they lose their honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa too melahi taa mil rahaa(n) jaa(n) teree hoi rajaai ||3||
english: Those whom You unite, remain united, if it is Your Will. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹ ਪੂਛੀਐ ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaat janam nah poochheeai sach ghar lehu bataai ||
english: God does not ask about social class or birth; you must find your true home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saa jaat saa pat hai jehe karam kamaai ||
english: That is your social class and that is your status - the karma of what you have done.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kaateeai naanak chhootas naai ||4||10||
english: The pains of death and rebirth are eradicated; O Nanak, salvation is in the Lord's Name. ||4||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮੂਠੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: jaagat bigasai mootho a(n)dhaa ||
english: He is awake, and even happy, but he is being plundered - he is blind!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: gal phaahee sir maare dha(n)dhaa ||
english: The noose is around his neck, and yet, his head is busy with worldly affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa aavai manasaa jaai ||
english: In hope, he comes and in desire, he leaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝੀ ਤਾਣੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: urajhee taanee kichh na basaai ||1||
english: The strings of his life are all tangled up; he is utterly helpless. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਸਿ ਜੀਵਣ ਜਾਗਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaagas jeevan jaaganahaaraa ||
english: The Lord of Awareness, the Lord of Life is awake and aware.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar a(n)mrit bha(n)daaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Ocean of peace, the Treasure of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭੋਂਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahio na boojhai a(n)dh na soojhai bho(n)dee kaar kamaaee ||
english: He does not understand what he is told; he is blind - he does not see, and so he does his evil deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape preet prem paramesur karamee milai vadaaee ||2||
english: The Transcendent Lord Himself showers His Love and Affection; by His Grace, He bestows glorious greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: din din aavai til til chheejai maaiaa mohu ghataaee ||
english: With the coming of each and every day, his life is wearing away, bit by bit; but still, his heart is attached to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੋ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin gur boodo thaur na paavai jab lag doojee raaee ||3||
english: Without the Guru, he is drowned, and finds no place of rest, as long as he is caught in duality. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ahinis jeeaa dekh samhaalai sukh dukh purab kamaaee ||
english: Day and night, God watches over and takes care of His living beings; they receive pleasure and pain according to their past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਹੀਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: karamaheen sach bheekhiaa maa(n)gai naanak milai vadaaee ||4||11||
english: Nanak, the unfortunate one, begs for the charity of Truth; please bless him with this glory. ||4||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਸਟਿ ਕਰਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਗਿ ਕਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: masat karau moorakh jag kaheeaa ||
english: If I remain silent, the world calls me a fool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਬਕਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: adhik bakau teree liv raheeaa ||
english: If I talk too much, I miss out on Your Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhool chook terai darabaar ||
english: My mistakes and faults will be judged in Your Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam binaa kaise aachaar ||1||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can I maintain good conduct? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aise jhooth muthe sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Such is the falsehood which is plundering the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਮੁਝੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak ni(n)dai mujhai piaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The slanderer slanders me, but even so, I love him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jis ni(n)dahi soee bidh jaanai ||
english: He alone knows the way, who has been slandered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade dar neesaanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is stamped with the Lord's Insignia in His Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: kaaran naam a(n)taragat jaanai ||
english: He realizes the Naam, the Cause of causes, deep within himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee bidh jaanai ||2||
english: He alone knows the way, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੈਲੌ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mai mailau oojal sach soi ||
english: I am filthy and polluted; the True Lord is Immaculate and Sublime.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ootam aakh na oochaa hoi ||
english: Calling oneself sublime, one does not become exalted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਖੂਲੑਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh khoolhi mahaa bikh khaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh openly eats the great poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi s raachai naai ||3||
english: But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੌ ਬੋਲੌ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhau bolau mugadh gavaar ||
english: I am blind, deaf, foolish and ignorant,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੀਣੌ ਨੀਚੁ ਬੁਰੌ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: heenau neech burau buriaar ||
english: the lowest of the low, the worst of the worst.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਧਨ ਕੌ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: needhan kau dhan naam piaar ||
english: I am poor, but I have the Wealth of Your Name, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ihu dhan saar hor bikhiaa chhaar ||4||
english: This is the most excellent wealth; all else is poison and ashes. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa sabad veechaar ||
english: I pay no attention to slander and praise; I contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo devai tis kau jaikaar ||
english: I celebrate the One who blesses me with His Bounty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too bakhasahi jaat pat hoi ||
english: Whomever You forgive, O Lord, is blessed with status and honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahai kahaavai soi ||5||12||
english: Says Nanak, I speak as He causes me to speak. ||5||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: khaaiaa mail vadhaaiaa paidhai ghar kee haan ||
english: Eating too much, one's filth only increases; wearing fancy clothes, one's home is disgraced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਕਿ ਬਕਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bak bak vaad chalaaiaa bin naavai bikh jaan ||1||
english: Talking too much, one only starts arguments. Without the Name, everything is poison - know this well. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਜਾਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: baabaa aisaa bikham jaal man vaasiaa ||
english: O Baba, such is the treacherous trap which has caught my mind;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਬਲੁ ਝਾਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bibal jhaag sahaj paragaasiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: riding out the waves of the storm, it will be enlightened by intuitive wisdom. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bikh khaanaa bikh bolanaa bikh kee kaar kamaai ||
english: They eat poison, speak poison and do poisonous deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jam dar baadhe maareeahi chhootas saachai naai ||2||
english: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are punished; they can be saved only through the True Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਵ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiv aaiaa tiv jaaisee keeaa likh lai jaai ||
english: As they come, they go. Their actions are recorded, and go along with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh mool gavaaiaa daragah milai sajaai ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukh loses his capital, and is punished in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਖੋਟੌ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੌ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀਂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jag khotau sach niramalau gurasabadee(n) veechaar ||
english: The world is false and polluted; only the True One is Pure. Contemplate Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: te nar virale jaaneeahi jin a(n)tar giaan muraar ||4||
english: Those who have God's spiritual wisdom within, are known to be very rare. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਨੀਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਅਮਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: ajar jarai neejhar jharai amar ana(n)d saroop ||
english: They endure the unendurable, and the Nectar of the Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss, trickles into them continuously.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਲ ਕੌ ਮੀਨੁ ਸੈ ਥੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak jal kau meen sai the bhaavai raakhahu preet ||5||13||
english: O Nanak, the fish is in love with the water; if it pleases You, Lord, please enshrine such love within me. ||5||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਹਰਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: geet naad harakh chaturaaee ||
english: Songs, sounds, pleasures and clever tricks;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹਸ ਰੰਗ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rahas ra(n)g phuramaais kaaee ||
english: joy, love and the power to command;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: painhn khaanaa cheet na paaee ||
english: fine clothes and food - these have no place in one's consciousness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saach sahaj sukh naam vasaaee ||1||
english: True intuitive peace and poise rest in the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾਂ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanaa(n) kiaa karai karaavai ||
english: What do I know about what God does?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਤਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa tan kichh na sukhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing makes my body feel good. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jog binod svaad aana(n)daa ||
english: Yoga, thrills, delicious flavors and ecstasy;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: mat sat bhaai bhagat gobi(n)daa ||
english: wisdom, truth and love all come from devotion to the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਰ ਨਿਜ ਸੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: keerat karam kaar nij sa(n)daa ||
english: My own occupation is to work to praise the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਤੌ ਰਾਜ ਰਵਿੰਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ravatau raaj ravi(n)daa ||2||
english: Deep within, I dwell on the Lord of the sun and the moon. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: priu priu preet prem ur dhaaree ||
english: I have lovingly enshrined the love of my Beloved within my heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਪੀਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath peeu banavaaree ||
english: My Husband Lord, the Lord of the World, is the Master of the meek and the poor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam daan bratakaaree ||
english: Night and day, the Naam is my giving in charity and fasting.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tripat tara(n)g tat beechaaree ||3||
english: The waves have subsided, contemplating the essence of reality. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੌ ਕਥਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: akathau kathau kiaa mai jor ||
english: What power do I have to speak the Unspoken?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karee karaaihi mor ||
english: I worship You with devotion; You inspire me to do so.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasai chookai mai mor ||
english: You dwell deep within; my egotism is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kis sevee doojaa nahee hor ||4||
english: So whom should I serve? There is no other than You. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meethaa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is utterly sweet and sublime.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa a(n)mrit a(n)tar deethaa ||
english: Such is the Ambrosial Nectar I see deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jin chaakhiaa pooraa pad hoi ||
english: Those who taste this, attain the state of perfection.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਓ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak dhraapio tan sukh hoi ||5||14||
english: O Nanak, they are satisfied, and their bodies are at peace. ||5||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਂਗਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar dekh sabad man maaniaa avar na raa(n)ganahaaraa ||
english: Deep within, I see the Shabad, the Word of God; my mind is pleased and appeased. Nothing else can touch and imbue me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ahinis jeeaa dekh samaale tis hee kee sarakaaraa ||1||
english: Day and night, God watches over and cares for His beings and creatures; He is the Ruler of all. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਘਣੌ ਅਤਿ ਰੂੜੌ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh raa(n)g ghanau at rooRau ||
english: My God is dyed in the most beautiful and glorious color.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਰਸ ਲਾਲ ਸਗੂੜੌ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal preetam manamohan at ras laal sagooRau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Merciful to the meek and the poor, my Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; He is so very sweet, imbued with the deep crimson color of His Love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: oopar koop gagan panihaaree a(n)mrit peevanahaaraa ||
english: The Well is high up in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Nectar flows, and I drink it in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis kee rachanaa so bidh jaanai guramukh giaan veechaaraa ||2||
english: The creation is His; He alone knows its ways and means. The Gurmukh contemplates spiritual wisdom. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਸਰੀ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pasaree kiran ras kamal bigaase sas ghar soor samaaiaa ||
english: The rays of light spread out, and the heart-lotus joyfully blossoms forth; the sun enters into the house of the moon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਧੁੰਸਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaal bidhu(n)s manasaa man maaree gur prasaad prabh paaiaa ||3||
english: I have conquered death; the desires of the mind are destroyed. By Guru's Grace, I have found God. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: at ras ra(n)g chaloolai raatee doojaa ra(n)g na koee ||
english: I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. I am not colored by any other color.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak rasan rasaae raate rav rahiaa prabh soee ||4||15||
english: O Nanak, my tongue is saturated with the taste of God, who is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਛਿਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
transliteration: baarah mahi raaval khap jaavahi chahu chhi mahi sa(n)niaasee ||
english: The Yogis are divided into twelve schools, the Sannyaasees into ten.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਸਿਰਖੂਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jogee kaapaReeaa sirakhoothe bin sabadai gal phaasee ||1||
english: The Yogis and those wearing religious robes, and the Jains with their all hair plucked out - without the Word of the Shabad, the noose is around their necks. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate poore bairaagee ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are the perfectly detached renunciates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਚੀ ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: auhath hasat mahi bheekhiaa jaachee ek bhaai liv laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They beg to receive charity in the hands of their hearts, embracing love and affection for the One. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: brahaman vaad paRahi kar kiriaa karanee karam karaae ||
english: The Brahmins study and argue about the scriptures; they perform ceremonial rituals, and lead others in these rituals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin boojhe kichh soojhai naahee manamukh vichhuR dukh paae ||2||
english: Without true understanding, those self-willed manmukhs understand nothing. Separated from God, they suffer in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sabad mile se soochaachaaree saachee daragah maane ||
english: Those who receive the Shabad are sanctified and pure; they are approved in the True Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin naam ratan liv laage jug jug saach samaane ||3||
english: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Naam; throughout the ages, they are merged in the True One. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sagale karam dharam such sa(n)jam jap tap teerath sabad vase ||
english: Good deeds, righteousness and Dharmic faith, purification, austere self-discipline, chanting, intense meditation and pilgrimages to sacred shrines - all these abide in the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਕਾਲ ਨਸੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak satigur milai milaaiaa dookh paraachhat kaal nase ||4||16||
english: O Nanak, united in union with the True Guru, suffering, sin and death run away. ||4||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa kee ren saadh jan sa(n)gat har keerat tar taaree ||
english: The dust of the feet of the Saints, the Company of the Holy, and the Praises of the Lord carry us across to the other side.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahaa karai bapuraa jam darapai guramukh ridai muraaree ||1||
english: What can the wretched, terrified Messenger of Death do to the Gurmukhs? The Lord abides in their hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jal jaau jeevan naam binaa ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life might just as well be burnt down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jap jaap japau japamaalee guramukh aavai saad manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh chants and meditates on the Lord, chanting the chant on the mala; the Flavor of the Lord comes into the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gur upades saach sukh jaa kau kiaa tis upamaa kaheeai ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find true peace - how can I even describe the glory of such a person?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਖੋਜਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laal javehar ratan padaarath khojat guramukh laheeai ||2||
english: The Gurmukh seeks and finds the gems and jewels, diamonds, rubies and treasures. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੀਨੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚੌ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: cheenai giaan dhiaan dhan saachau ek sabad liv laavai ||
english: So center yourself on the treasures of spiritual wisdom and meditation; remain lovingly attuned to the One True Lord, and the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਨਿਰਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: niraala(n)b nirahaar nihakeval nirabhau taaRee laavai ||3||
english: Remain absorbed in the Primal State of the Fearless, Immaculate, Independent, Self-sufficient Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saair sapat bhare jal niramal ulatee naav taraavai ||
english: The seven seas are overflowing with the Immaculate Water; the inverted boat floats across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: baahar jaatau thaak rahaavai guramukh sahaj samaavai ||4||
english: The mind which wandered in external distractions is restrained and held in check; the Gurmukh is intuitively absorbed in God. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so girahee so daas udaasee jin guramukh aap pachhaaniaa ||
english: He is a householder, he is a renunciate and God's slave, who, as Gurmukh, realizes his own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੫॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak kahai avar nahee doojaa saach sabad man maaniaa ||5||17||
english: Says Nanak, his mind is pleased and appeased by the True Word of the Shabad; there is no other at all. ||5||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag prabhaatee mahalaa 3 chaupade ||
english: Raag Prabhaatee, Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa koee boojhai sabade rahiaa samaaee ||
english: Those who become Gurmukh and understand are very rare; God is permeating and pervading through the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam rate sadaa sukh paavai saach rahai liv laaee ||1||
english: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find everlasting peace; they remain lovingly attuned to the True One. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu jan bhaaee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad man asathir hovai anadin har ras rahiaa aghaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes steady and stable; night and day, it remains satisfied with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahu din raatee is jug kaa laahaa bhaaee ||
english: Night and day, perform devotional worship service to the Lord, day and night; this is the profit to be obtained in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa jan niramal mail na laagai sach naam chit laaee ||2||
english: The humble beings are forever immaculate; no filth ever sticks to them. They focus their consciousness on the True Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sukh seegaar satiguroo dikhaaiaa naam vadee vadiaaee ||
english: The True Guru has revealed the ornamentation of peace; the Glorious Greatness of the Naam is Great!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: akhut bha(n)daar bhare kade tot na aavai sadaa har sevahu bhaaee ||3||
english: The Inexhaustible Treasures are overflowing; they are never exhausted. So serve the Lord forever, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa jis no devai tis vasai man aaee ||
english: The Creator comes to abide in the minds of those whom He Himself has blessed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sadaa too satigur deeaa dikhaaee ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, which the True Guru has revealed. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: niraguneeaare kau bakhas lai suaamee aape laihu milaaee ||
english: I am unworthy; please forgive me and bless me, O my Lord and Master, and unite me with Yourself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too bia(n)t teraa a(n)t na paaiaa sabade dehu bujhaaee ||1||
english: You are Endless; no one can find Your limits. Through the Word of Your Shabad, You bestow understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu tudh vitahu bal jaaee ||
english: O Dear Lord, I am a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man arapee tudh aagai raakhau sadaa rahaa(n) saranaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I dedicate my mind and body and place them in offering before You; I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aapane bhaane vich sadaa rakh suaamee har naamo dehi vadiaaee ||
english: Please keep me forever under Your Will, O my Lord and Master; please bless me with the Glorious Greatness of Your Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਾਣਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poore gur te bhaanaa jaapai anadin sahaj samaaee ||2||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, God's Will is revealed; night and day, remain absorbed in peace and poise. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: terai bhaanai bhagat je tudh bhaavai aape bakhas milaaee ||
english: Those devotees who accept Your Will are pleasing to You, Lord; You Yourself forgive them, and unite them with Yourself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: terai bhaanai sadaa sukh paaiaa gur trisanaa agan bujhaaee ||3||
english: Accepting Your Will, I have found everlasting peace; the Guru has extinguished the fire of desire. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo too karahi s hovai karate avar na karanaa jaaee ||
english: Whatever You do comes to pass, O Creator; nothing else can be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naavai jevad avar na daataa poore gur te paaee ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, nothing is as great as the Blessing of the Name; it is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har saalaahiaa ji(n)naa tin salaahi har jaataa ||
english: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord; praising the Lord, they know Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vichahu bharam gaiaa hai doojaa gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||1||
english: Doubt and duality are gone from within; they realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu too meraa ik soee ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are my One and Only.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tudh japee tudhai saalaahee gat mat tujh te hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I meditate on You and praise You; salvation and wisdom come from You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saalaahan se saad paain meethaa a(n)mrit saar ||
english: The Gurmukhs praise You; they receive the most excellent and sweet Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa meethaa kade na pheekaa gurasabadee veechaar ||2||
english: This Nectar is forever sweet; it never loses its taste. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin meethaa laaiaa soee jaanai tis vitahu bal jaaee ||
english: He makes it seem so sweet to me; I am a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad salaahee sadaa sukhadaataa vichahu aap gavaaee ||3||
english: Through the Shabad, I praise the Giver of peace forever. I have eradicated self-conceit from within. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa hai daataa jo ichhai so phal paae ||
english: My True Guru is forever the Giver. I receive whatever fruits and rewards I desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee gurasabadee sach paae ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True One is found. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jo teree saranaaee har jeeu tin too raakhan jog ||
english: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, are saved by Your Protective Power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudh jevad mai avar na soojhai naa ko hoaa na hog ||1||
english: I cannot even conceive of any other as Great as You. There never was, and there never shall be. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sadaa teree saranaaee ||
english: O Dear Lord, I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu mere suaamee eh teree vadiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As it pleases You, You save me, O my Lord and Master; this is Your Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jo teree saranaaee har jeeu tin kee karahi pratipaal ||
english: O Dear Lord, You cherish and sustain those who seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap kripaa kar raakhahu har jeeu pohi na sakai jamakaal ||2||
english: O Dear Lord, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch those whom You, in Your Mercy, protect. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾ ਓਹ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: teree saranaaee sachee har jeeu naa oh ghatai na jaai ||
english: True Is Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; it never diminishes or goes away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo har chhod doojai bhaai laagai ohu ja(n)mai tai mar jaai ||3||
english: Those who abandon the Lord, and become attached to the love of duality, shall continue to die and be reborn. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo teree saranaaee har jeeu tinaa dookh bhookh kichh naahi ||
english: Those who seek Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, shall never suffer in pain or hunger for anything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi sadaa too sachai sabad samaahi ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har jeeu sadaa dhiaavahu jab lag jee paraan ||
english: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Dear Lord forever, as long as there is the breath of life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee man niramal hoaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind becomes immaculate, and egotistical pride is expelled from the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saphal janam tis praanee keraa har kai naam samaan ||1||
english: Fruitful and prosperous is the life of that mortal being, who is absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur kee sikh suneejai ||
english: O my mind, listen to the Teachings of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa sukhadaataa sahaje har ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace forever. With intuitive ease, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mool pachhaanan tin nij ghar vaasaa sahaje hee sukh hoee ||
english: Those who understand their own origin dwell within the home of their inner being, in intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal paragaasiaa haumai duramat khoee ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and egotism and evil-mindedness are eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabhanaa mahi eko sach varatai viralaa boojhai koee ||2||
english: The One True Lord is pervading amongst all; those who realize this are very rare. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: guramatee man niramal hoaa a(n)mrit tat vakhaanai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes immaculate, speaking the Ambrosial Essence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa man vasiaa vich man hee man maanai ||
english: The Name of the Lord dwells in the mind forever; within the mind, the mind is pleased and appeased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sad balihaaree gur apune vitahu jit aatam raam pachhaanai ||3||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, through whom I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam satiguroo na seviaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Those human beings who do not serve the True Guru - their lives are uselessly wasted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa(n) satigur mele sahaje sahaj samaaiaa ||
english: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, then we meet the True Guru, merging in intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee poorai bhaag dhiaaiaa ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Naam is bestowed; by perfect destiny, meditate. ||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਣਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aape bhaa(n)t banaae bahu ra(n)gee sisat upaai prabh khel keeaa ||
english: God Himself fashioned the many forms and colors; He created the Universe and staged the play.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਨੋ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai kare karaae sarab jeeaa no rijak deeaa ||1||
english: Creating the creation, He watches over it. He acts, and causes all to act; He gives sustenance to all beings. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kalee kaal mahi raviaa raam ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord is All-pervading.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat poor rahiaa prabh eko guramukh paragat har har naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One God is pervading and permeating each and every heart; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gupataa naam varatai vich kalajug ghat ghat har bharapoor rahiaa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is hidden, but it is pervasive in the Dark Age. The Lord is totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam ratan tinaa hiradai pragatiaa jo gur saranaaee bhaj paiaa ||2||
english: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed within the hearts of those who hurry to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਪੰਚੇ ਵਸਿ ਆਣੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dree pa(n)ch pa(n)che vas aanai khimaa sa(n)tokh guramat paavai ||
english: Whoever overpowers the five sense organs, is blessed with forgiveness, patience and contentment, through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੋ ਭੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so dhan dhan har jan vad pooraa jo bhai bairaag har gun gaavai ||3||
english: Blessed, blessed, perfect and great is that humble servant of the Lord, who is inspired by the Fear of God and detached love, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur te muhu phere je koee gur kaa kahiaa na chit dharai ||
english: If someone turns his face away from the Guru, and does not enshrine the Guru's Words in his consciousness

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kar aachaar bahu sa(n)pau sa(n)chai jo kichh karai s narak parai ||4||
english: - he may perform all sorts of rituals and accumulate wealth, but in the end, he will fall into hell. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: eko sabad eko prabh varatai sabh ekas te utapat chalai ||
english: The One Shabad, the Word of the One God, is prevailing everywhere. All the creation came from the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੈ ॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh mel milaae guramukh har har jaai ralai ||5||6||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is united in union. When the Gurmukh goes, he blends into the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur apanaa saalaahi ||
english: O my mind, praise your Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooraa bhaag hovai mukh masatak sadaa har ke gun gaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Perfect destiny is inscribed upon your forehead and face; sing the Praises of the Lord forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam bhojan har dei ||
english: The Lord bestows the Ambrosial Food of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe koee viralaa lei ||
english: Out of millions, only a rare few receive it

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis no apanee nadar karei ||1||
english: - only those who are blessed by God's Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan man maahi vasaai ||
english: Whoever enshrines the Guru's Feet within his mind,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਅਨੑੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh anheraa a(n)darahu jaai ||
english: is rid of pain and darkness from within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape saachaa lae milaai ||2||
english: The True Lord unites him with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee siu laai piaar ||
english: So embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aithai othai ehu adhaar ||
english: Here and hereafter, this is your only Support.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape devai sirajanahaar ||3||
english: The Creator Lord Himself bestows it. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਮਨਾਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa manaae apanaa bhaanaa ||
english: One whom the Lord inspires to accept His Will,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: soee bhagat sughaR soujaanaa ||
english: is a wise and knowing devotee.

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: naanak tis kai sad kurabaanaa ||4||7||17||7||24||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||4||7||17||7||24||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 bibhaas ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl, Bibhaas:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨ ॥
transliteration: rasak rasak gun gaavah guramat liv unaman naam lagaan ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with joyous love and delight; I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras peeaa gurasabadee ham naam vitahu kurabaan ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I drink in the Ambrosial Essence; I am a sacrifice to the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: hamare jagajeevan har praan ||
english: The Lord, the Life of the World, is my Breath of Life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ootam rid a(n)tar bhaaio gur ma(n)t deeo har kaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lofty and Exalted Lord became pleasing to my heart and my inner being, when the Guru breathed the Mantra of the Lord into my ears. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t milahu mere bhaaee mil har har naam vakhaan ||
english: Come, O Saints: let us join together, O Siblings of Destiny; let us meet and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kit bidh kiu paaeeai prabh apunaa mo kau karahu upades har daan ||2||
english: How am I to find my God? Please bless me with the Gift of the Lord's Teachings. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi har har vasiaa mil sa(n)gat har gun jaan ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, abides in the Society of the Saints; joining this Sangat, the Lord's Glories are known.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag satasa(n)gat paaee gur satigur paras bhagavaan ||3||
english: By great good fortune, the Society of the Saints is found. Through the Guru, the True Guru, I receive the Touch of the Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavah prabh agam thaakur ke gun gaai rahe hairaan ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of God, my Inaccessible Lord and Master; singing His Praises, I am enraptured.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਖਿਨ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree har naam deeo khin daan ||4||1||
english: The Guru has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; in an instant, He blessed him with the Gift of the Lord's Name. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ugavai soor guramukh har bolahi sabh rain samhaalahi har gaal ||
english: With the rising of the sun, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord. All through the night, he dwells upon the Sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਮ ਲੋਚ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hamarai prabh ham loch lagaaee ham karah prabhoo har bhaal ||1||
english: My God has infused this longing within me; I seek my Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: meraa man saadhoo dhoor ravaal ||
english: My mind is the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਹ ਹਮ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam driRaaio gur meethaa gur pag jhaarah ham baal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has implanted the Sweet Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. I dust the Guru's Feet with my hair. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saakat kau din rain a(n)dhaaree mohi phaathe maaiaa jaal ||
english: Dark are the days and nights of the faithless cynics; they are caught in the trap of attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਰਿਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khin pal har prabh ridai na vasio rin baadhe bahu bidh baal ||2||
english: The Lord God does not dwell in their hearts, even for an instant; every hair of their heads is totally tied up in debts. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਉ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil mat budh paaee hau chhoote mamataa jaal ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, wisdom and understanding are obtained, and one is released from the traps of egotism and possessiveness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har naamaa har meeth lagaanaa gur keee sabad nihaal ||3||
english: The Lord's Name, and the Lord, seem sweet to me. Through the Word of His Shabad, the Guru has made me happy. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik gur agam gusaaee gur kar kirapaa pratipaal ||
english: I am just a child; the Guru is the Unfathomable Lord of the World. In His Mercy, He cherishes and sustains me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: bikh bhaujal dubade kaadh lehu prabh gur naanak baal gupaal ||4||2||
english: I am drowning in the ocean of poison; O God, Guru, Lord of the World, please save Your child, Nanak. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰਸਕ ਰਸੀਕ ॥
transliteration: ik khin har prabh kirapaa dhaaree gun gaae rasak raseek ||
english: The Lord God showered me with His Mercy for an instant; I sing His Glorious Praises with joyous love and delight.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੋਊ ਭਏ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gaavat sunat dooo bhae mukate jinaa guramukh khin har peek ||1||
english: Both the singer and the listener are liberated, when, as Gurmukh, they drink in the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੀਕ ॥
transliteration: merai man har har raam naam ras teek ||
english: The Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is enshrined within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਝੀਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam seetal jal paaiaa har har naam peeaa ras jheek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the cooling, soothing Water of the Naam. I eagerly drink in the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਊਜਲ ਟੀਕ ॥
transliteration: jin har hiradai preet lagaanee tinaa masatak oojal teek ||
english: Those whose hearts are imbued with the Love of the Lord have the mark of radiant purity upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਡਵਾ ਸਸਿ ਕੀਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har jan sobhaa sabh jag oopar jiu vich udavaa sas keek ||2||
english: The Glory of the Lord's humble servant is manifest throughout the world, like the moon among the stars. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਫੀਕ ॥
transliteration: jin har hiradai naam na vasio tin sabh kaaraj pheek ||
english: Those whose hearts are not filled with the Lord's Name - all their affairs are worthless and insipid.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਕ ਕੀਕ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaise seegaar karai deh maanukh naam binaa nakate nak keek ||3||
english: They may adorn and decorate their bodies, but without the Naam, they look like their noses have been cut off. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਈਕ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa ramat raam raai sabh varatai sabh mahi eek ||
english: The Sovereign Lord permeates each and every heart; the One Lord is all-pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਘਰੀ ਮੀਕ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree gur bachan dhiaaio gharee meek ||4||3||
english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have meditated on the Lord in an instant. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਕਹੇ ॥
transliteration: agam daiaal kripaa prabh dhaaree mukh har har naam ham kahe ||
english: God, the Inaccessible and Merciful, has showered me with His Mercy; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with my mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: patit paavan har naam dhiaaio sabh kilabikh paap lahe ||1||
english: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; I am rid of all my sins and mistakes. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam rav rahe ||
english: O mind, chant the Name of the All-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal dukh bha(n)jan gaaio guramat naam padaarath lahe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain. Following the Guru's Teachings, I gather in the Wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਨਗਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar nagar har basio mat guramat har har sahe ||
english: The Lord abides in the body-village; through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sareer sarovar naam har pragatio ghar ma(n)dar har prabh lahe ||2||
english: In the lake of the body, the Lord's Name has been revealed. Within my own home and mansion, I have obtained the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jo nar bharam bharam udiaane te saakat mooR muhe ||
english: Those beings who wander in the wilderness of doubt - those faithless cynics are foolish, and are plundered.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਭਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਝਾਰ ਗਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu mrig naabh basai baas basanaa bhram bhramio jhaar gahe ||3||
english: They are like the deer: the scent of musk comes from its own navel, but it wanders and roams around, searching for it in the bushes. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਹੇ ॥
transliteration: tum vad agam agaadh bodh prabh mat devahu har prabh lahe ||
english: You are Great and Unfathomable; Your Wisdom, God, is Profound and Incomprehensible. Please bless me with that wisdom, by which I might attain You, O Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau gur haath sir dhario har raam naam rav rahe ||4||4||
english: The Guru has placed His Hand upon servant Nanak; he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਫਾ ॥
transliteration: man laagee preet raam naam har har japio har prabh vadaphaa ||
english: My mind is in love with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate on the Great Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਫਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur bachan sukhaane heearai har dhaaree har prabh kripaphaa ||1||
english: The Word of the True Guru has become pleasing to my heart. The Lord God has showered me with His Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naam har nimakhaphaa ||
english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord's Name every instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਫਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har daan deeo gur poorai har naamaa man tan basaphaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name abides in my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਵਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਪਫਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar vasio ghar ma(n)dar jap sobhaa guramukh karapaphaa ||
english: The Lord abides in the body-village, in my home and mansion. As Gurmukh, I meditate on His Glory.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਫਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: halat palat jan bhae suhele mukh oojal guramukh taraphaa ||2||
english: Here and hereafter, the Lord's humble servants are embellished and exalted; their faces are radiant; as Gurmukh, they are carried across. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
transliteration: anabhau har har har liv laagee har ur dhaario gur nimakhaphaa ||
english: I am lovingly attuned to the Fearless Lord, Har, Har, Har; through the Guru, I have enshrined the Lord within my heart in an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਪਲਫਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot kot ke dokh sabh jan ke har door keee ik palaphaa ||3||
english: Millions upon millions of the faults and mistakes of the Lord's humble servant are all taken away in an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖਫਾ ॥
transliteration: tumare jan tum hee te jaane prabh jaanio jan te mukhaphaa ||
english: Your humble servants are known only through You, God; knowing You, they becomes supreme.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਭਾ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaio har har ham mue jeeve har japibhaa ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me. I was dead, but chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been brought back to life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਇ ਕਢਿਭਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo gur satigur pooraa bikh dubade baah dei kadhibhaa ||1||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru; He reached out to me with His Arm, and pulled me up and out of the ocean of poison. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਧਾਂਭਾ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam aradhaa(n)bhaa ||
english: O mind, meditate and worship the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਤਹੂ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: upaja(n)p upaai na paaeeai katahoo gur poorai har prabh laabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God is never found, even by making all sorts of new efforts. The Lord God is obtained only through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਭਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ras raam rasaain ras peeaa guramat rasabhaa ||
english: The Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name is the source of nectar and bliss; drinking in this Sublime Essence, following the Guru's Teachings, I have become happy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹ ਮਨੂਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿਭਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: loh manoor ka(n)chan mil sa(n)gat har ur dhaario gur haribhaa ||2||
english: Even iron slag is transformed into gold, joining the Lord's Congregation. Through the Guru, the Lord's Light is enshrined within the heart. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੇ ਪੁਤ ਕਲਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੁਭਿਭਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai bikhiaa nit lobh lubhaane put kalat mohi lubhibhaa ||
english: Those who are continually lured by greed, egotism and corruption, who are lured away by emotional attachment to their children and spouse

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਪਗ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂੰਭਰ ਭਰਭਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin pag sa(n)t na seve kabahoo te manamukh bhoo(n)bhar bharabhaa ||3||
english: - they never serve at the feet of the Saints; those self-willed manmukhs are filled with ashes. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਹਾਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਭਾ ॥
transliteration: tumare gun tum hee prabh jaanahu ham pare haar tum saranabhaa ||
english: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues; I have grown weary - I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਨਭਾ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu raakhahu suaamee jan naanak daas tumanabhaa ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: As You know best, You preserve and protect me, O my Lord and Master; servant Nanak is Your slave. ||4||6|| First Set of Six||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee bibhaas paRataal mahalaa 4 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Bibhaas, Partaal, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jap man har har naam nidhaan ||
english: O mind, meditate on the Treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: har daragah paavahi maan ||
english: You shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin japiaa te paar paraan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who chant and meditate shall be carried across to the other shore. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sun man har har naam kar dhiaan ||
english: Listen, O mind: meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sun man har keerat athasath majaan ||
english: Listen, O mind: the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is equal to bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sun man guramukh paavahi maan ||1||
english: Listen, O mind: as Gurmukh, you shall be blessed with honor. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jap man paramesur paradhaan ||
english: O mind, chant and meditate on the Supreme Transcendent Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਖੋਵੈ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਾਨ ॥
transliteration: khin khovai paap kotaan ||
english: Millions of sins shall be destroyed in an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: mil naanak har bhagavaan ||2||1||7||
english: O Nanak, you shall meet with the Lord God. ||2||1||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 bibhaas ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Bibhaas:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man har keeaa tan sabh saajiaa ||
english: The Lord created the mind, and fashioned the entire body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਰਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat rach jot nivaajiaa ||
english: From the five elements, He formed it, and infused His Light within it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sihajaa dharat baratan kau paanee ||
english: He made the earth its bed, and water for it to use.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nimakh na visaarahu sevahu saarigapaanee ||1||
english: Do not forget Him for an instant; serve the Lord of the World. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: man satigur sev hoi param gate ||
english: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain the supreme status.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog te rahahi niraaraa taa(n) too paavahi praanapate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If you remain unattached and unaffected by sorrow and joy, then you shall find the Lord of Life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੁੰਚਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaapaR bhog ras anik bhu(n)chaae ||
english: He makes all the various pleasures, clothes and foods for you to enjoy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa kuta(n)b sagal banaae ||
english: He made your mother, father and all relatives.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: rijak samaahe jal thal meet ||
english: He provides sustenance to all, in the water and on the land, O friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so har sevahu neetaa neet ||2||
english: So serve the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tahaa sakhaaee jah koi na hovai ||
english: He shall be your Helper and Support there, where no one else can help you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kot apraadh ik khin mahi dhovai ||
english: He washes away millions of sins in an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਛੋੁਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: daat karai nahee pachhoutaavai ||
english: He bestows His Gifts, and never regrets them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਬਖਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ekaa bakhas phir bahur na bulaavai ||3||
english: He forgives, once and for all, and never asks for one's account again. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕਫਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: har har aap dhario har jan mahi jan naanak har prabh ikaphaa ||4||5||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined Himself within His humble servant. O Nanak, the Lord God and His servant are one and the same. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kirat sa(n)jogee paaiaa bhaal ||
english: By pre-ordained destiny, I have searched and found God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mahi base gupaal ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: gur mil aae tumarai duaar ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I have come to Your Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak darasan dehu muraar ||4||1||
english: O Lord, please bless servant Nanak with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee sevaa jan kee sobhaa ||
english: Serving God, His humble servant is glorified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਲੋਭਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh mite tis lobhaa ||
english: Unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and unsatisfied greed are eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਭੰਡਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naam teraa jan kai bha(n)daar ||
english: Your Name is the treasure of Your humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi prabh daras piaar ||1||
english: Singing His Praises, I am in love with the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tumaree bhagat prabh tumahi janaaee ||
english: You are known, O God, by Your devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaat jevaree jan leee chhadaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Breaking their bonds, You emancipate them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jo jan raataa prabh kai ra(n)g ||
english: Those humble beings who are imbued with God's Love

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: tin sukh paaiaa prabh kai sa(n)g ||
english: find peace in God's Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jis ras aaiaa soee jaanai ||
english: They alone understand this, to whom this subtle essence comes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pekh pekh man mahi hairaanai ||2||
english: Beholding it, and gazing upon it, in their minds they are wonderstruck. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: so sukheeaa sabh te ootam soi ||
english: They are at peace, the most exalted of all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai hridai vasiaa prabh soi ||
english: within whose hearts God dwells.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: soee nihachal aavai na jaai ||
english: They are stable and unchanging; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin prabh ke har gun gaai ||3||
