english: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: taa kau karahu sagal namasakaar ||
english: All bow down in humble respect to those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man pooran nira(n)kaar ||
english: whose minds are filled with the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi thaakur devaa ||
english: Show mercy unto me, O my Divine Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak udharai jan kee sevaa ||4||2||
english: May Nanak be saved, by serving these humble beings. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat man hoi ana(n)d ||
english: Singing His Glorious Praises, the mind is in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar simarau bhagava(n)t ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran kalamal jaahi ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, the sins go away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis gur kee ham charanee paahi ||1||
english: I fall at the Feet of that Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sumat devahu sa(n)t piaare ||
english: O beloved Saints, please bless me with wisdom;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simarau naam mohi nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: let me meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and be emancipated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੀਧਾ ॥
transliteration: jin gur kahiaa maarag seedhaa ||
english: The Guru has shown me the straight path;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੀਧਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag naam har geedhaa ||
english: I have abandoned everything else. I am enraptured with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kai sadaa bal jaaeeai ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har simaran jis gur te paaeeai ||2||
english: I meditate in remembrance on the Lord, through the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: boodat praanee jin gurahi taraaiaa ||
english: The Guru carries those mortal beings across, and saves them from drowning.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis prasaad mohai nahee maaiaa ||
english: By His Grace, they are not enticed by Maya;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: halat palat jin gurahi savaariaa ||
english: in this world and the next, they are embellished and exalted by the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis gur oopar sadaa hau vaariaa ||3||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਤੇ ਕੀਆ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: mahaa mugadh te keeaa giaanee ||
english: From the most ignorant, I have been made spiritually wise,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee akath kahaanee ||
english: through the Unspoken Speech of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham naanak guradev ||
english: The Divine Guru, O Nanak, is the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag paaeeai har sev ||4||3||
english: By great good fortune, I serve the Lord. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sagale dookh mite sukh deee apanaa naam japaaiaa ||
english: Eradicating all my pains, He has blessed me with peace, and inspired me to chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanee sevaa laae sagalaa durat mitaaiaa ||1||
english: In His Mercy, He has enjoined me to His service, and has purged me of all my sins. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik saran prabh daiaal ||
english: I am only a child; I seek the Sanctuary of God the Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avagan kaat keee prabh apune raakh leee merai gur gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Erasing my demerits and faults, God has made me His Own. My Guru, the Lord of the World, protects me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taap paap binase khin bheetar bhae kripaal gusaaee ||
english: My sicknesses and sins were erased in an instant, when the Lord of the World became merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saas saas paarabraham araadhee apune satigur kai bal jaaee ||2||
english: With each and very breath, I worship and adore the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar bia(n)t suaamee taa kaa a(n)t na paaeeai ||
english: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Infinite. His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: laahaa khaat hoeeai dhanava(n)taa apunaa prabhoo dhiaaeeai ||3||
english: We earn the profit, and become wealthy, meditating on our God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar paarabraham dhiaaee sadaa sadaa gun gaaiaa ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Supreme Lord God; I sing His Glorious Praises forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mere poore manorath paarabraham gur paaiaa ||4||4||
english: Says Nanak, my desires have been fulfilled; I have found my Guru, the Supreme Lord God. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam kilabikh sabh naase ||
english: Meditating in rememberance on the Naam, all my sins have been erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sach naam gur deenee raase ||
english: The Guru has blessed me with the Capital of the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee daragah sobhaava(n)te ||
english: God's servants are embellished and exalted in His Court;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹੰਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sevak sev sadaa soha(n)te ||1||
english: serving Him, they look beauteous forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagale rog dokh sabh binasahi agiaan a(n)dheraa man te jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All sickness and sin shall be erased; your mind shall be rid of the darkness of ignorance. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: janam maran gur raakhe meet ||
english: The Guru has saved me from death and rebirth, O friend;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam siu laagee preet ||
english: I am in love with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
transliteration: kot janam ke gae kales ||
english: The suffering of millions of incarnations is gone;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲ ਹੋਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so bhal hos ||2||
english: whatever pleases Him is good. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau hau sad bal jaaee ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jis prasaad har naam dhiaaee ||
english: by His Grace, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aisaa gur paaeeai vadabhaagee ||
english: By great good fortune, such a Guru is found;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis milate raam liv laagee ||3||
english: meeting Him, one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee ||
english: Please be merciful, O Supreme Lord God, O Lord and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar apunee liv laai ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I am lovingly attuned to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak prabh kee saranaai ||4||5||
english: Servant Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apune prabh keee ||
english: In His Mercy, God has made me His Own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japan kau deee ||
english: He has blessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun gaai gubi(n)d ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhai binase utaree sabh chi(n)d ||1||
english: Fear is dispelled, and all anxiety has been alleviated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: ubare satigur charanee laag ||
english: I have been saved, touching the Feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo gur kahai soee bhal meethaa man kee mat tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever the Guru says is good and sweet to me. I have renounced the intellectual wisdom of my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man tan vasiaa har prabh soee ||
english: That Lord God abides within my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kal kales kichh bighan na hoee ||
english: There are no conflicts, pains or obstacles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh jee kai sa(n)g ||
english: Forever and ever, God is with my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: utaree mail naam kai ra(n)g ||2||
english: Filth and pollution are washed away by the Love of the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laago piaar ||
english: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: binase kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: I am no longer consumed by sexual desire, anger and egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: prabh milan kaa maarag jaanaa(n) ||
english: Now, I know the way to meet God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat har siu man maanaa(n) ||3||
english: Through loving devotional worship, my mind is pleased and appeased with the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sun sajan sa(n)t meet suhele ||
english: Listen, O friends, Saints, my exalted companions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan har agah atole ||
english: The Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is unfathomable and immeasurable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh gun nidh gaaeeai ||
english: Forever and ever, sing the Glories of God, the Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak vadabhaagee paaeeai ||4||6||
english: Says Nanak, by great good fortune, He is found. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: se dhanava(n)t seee sach saahaa ||
english: They are wealthy, and they are the true merchants,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kee daragah naam visaahaa ||1||
english: who have the credit of the Naam in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu man meet ||
english: So chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your mind, my friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaeeai vadabhaagee niramal pooran reet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune, and then one's lifestyle becomes perfect and immaculate. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa laabh vajee vaadhaaee ||
english: They earn the profit, and the congratulations pour in;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad har ke gun gaaee ||2||
english: by the Grace of the Saints, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam jeevan paravaan ||
english: Their lives are fruitful and prosperous, and their birth is approved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ra(n)g maan ||3||
english: by Guru's Grace, they enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: binase kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh utarahi paar ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, they are carried across to the other shore. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa pooree taa kee kalaa ||
english: The Guru is Perfect, and Perfect is His Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਅਟਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad sadaa sad atalaa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is unchanging, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee jis man vasai ||
english: Those, whose minds are filled with the Word of the Guru's Bani,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh darad sabh taa kaa nasai ||1||
english: All pains and afflictions run away from them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raataa man raam gun gaavai ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੋੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mukatou saadhoo dhooree naavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They are liberated, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee utare paar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are carried across to the other shore;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhau bharam binase bikaar ||
english: they are rid of fear, doubt and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar base gur charanaa ||
english: The Guru's Feet abide deep within their minds and bodies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਸਾਧ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nirabhai saadh pare har saranaa ||2||
english: The Holy are fearless; they take to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anad sahaj ras sookh ghanere ||
english: They are blessed with abundant bliss, happiness, pleasure and peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dusaman dookh na aavai nere ||
english: Enemies and pains do not even approach them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai apune kar raakhe ||
english: The Perfect Guru makes them His Own, and protects them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har naam japat kilabikh sabh laathe ||3||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are rid of all their sins. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਖ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saajan sikh bhae suhele ||
english: The Saints, spiritual companions and Sikhs are exalted and uplifted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲੈ ਮੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai prabh siu lai mele ||
english: The Perfect Guru leads them to meet God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਫਾਹਾ ਕਾਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh phaahaa kaatiaa ||
english: The painful noose of death and rebirth is snapped.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਢਾਕਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur paRadaa dhaakiaa ||4||8||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru covers their faults. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur poorai naam deeaa ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has bestowed the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anad ma(n)gal kaliaan sadaa sukh kaaraj sagalaa raas theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am blessed with bliss and happiness, emancipation and eternal peace. All my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal gur ke man voothe ||
english: The Lotus Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਝੂਠੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh darad bhram binase jhoothe ||1||
english: I am rid of pain, suffering, doubt and fraud. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: nit uth gaavahu prabh kee baanee ||
english: Rise early, and sing the Glorious Word of God's Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aath pahar har simarahu praanee ||2||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, O mortal. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar baahar prabh sabhanee thaaee ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, God is everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਹ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee jah hau jaaee ||3||
english: Wherever I go, He is always with me, my Helper and Support. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR karee aradaas ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: sadaa jape naanak gunataas ||4||9||
english: O Nanak, I meditate forever on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh sughaR sujaan ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is All-wise and All-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaeeai vadabhaagee darasan kau jaaeeai kurabaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh mete sabad sa(n)tokh ||
english: My sins are cut away, through the Word of the Shabad, and I have found contentment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਨ ਹੋਆ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naam araadhan hoaa jog ||
english: I have become worthy of worshipping the Naam in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g hoaa paragaas ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have been enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal man maahi nivaas ||1||
english: The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਰਾਖਿ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tin leeaa raakh ||
english: The One who made us, protects and preserves us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਾ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh pooraa anaath kaa naath ||
english: God is Perfect, the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jisahi nivaaje kirapaa dhaar ||
english: Those, upon whom He showers His Mercy

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pooran karam taa ke aachaar ||2||
english: - they have perfect karma and conduct. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਵੇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai nit nit nit nave ||
english: They sing the Glories of God, continually, continuously, forever fresh and new.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਭਵੇ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon na bhave ||
english: They do not wander in the 8.4 million incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾਂ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: eehaa(n) oohaa(n) charan poojaare ||
english: Here and hereafter, they worship the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mukh oojal saache darabaare ||3||
english: Their faces are radiant, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: jis masatak gur dhariaa haath ||
english: That person, upon whose forehead the Guru places His Hand

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe ko viralaa daas ||
english: out of millions, how rare is that slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pekhai bharapoor ||
english: He sees God pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak udharas tis jan kee dhoor ||4||10||
english: Nanak is saved by the dust of the feet of such a humble being. ||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
transliteration: kurabaan jaaee gur poore apane ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis prasaad har har jap japane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By His Grace, I chant and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee sunat nihaal ||
english: Listening to the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, I am exalted and enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binas gae bikhiaa ja(n)jaal ||1||
english: My corrupt and poisonous entanglements are gone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: saach sabad siu laagee preet ||
english: I am in love with the True Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਆਇਆ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har prabh apunaa aaiaa cheet ||2||
english: The Lord God has come into my consciousness. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naam japat hoaa paragaas ||
english: Chanting the Naam, I am enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gurasabade keenaa ridai nivaas ||3||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has come to dwell within my heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: gur samarath sadaa daiaal ||
english: The Guru is All-powerful and Merciful forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: har jap jap naanak bhae nihaal ||4||11||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, Nanak is exalted and enraptured. ||4||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur gur karat sadaa sukh paaiaa ||
english: Chanting Guru, Guru, I have found eternal peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal bhae kirapaalaa apanaa naam aap japaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God, Merciful to the meek, has become kind and compassionate; He has inspired me to chant His Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil bhaiaa pragaas ||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I am illumined and enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har japat pooran bhaee aas ||1||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my hopes have been fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh man voothe ||
english: I am blessed with total salvation, and my mind is filled with peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
transliteration: har gun gaae gur naanak toothe ||2||12||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; O Nanak, the Guru has been gracious to me. ||2||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 bibhaas ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Bibhaas:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar na doojaa thaau ||
english: There is no other place of rest,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naahee bin har naau ||
english: none at all, without the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: sarab sidh kaliaan ||
english: There is total success and salvation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran hohi sagal kaam ||1||
english: and all affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har ko naam japeeai neet ||
english: Constantly chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar binasai lagai ekai preet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away; let yourself fall in love with the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਲਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naam laagai dookh bhaagai saran paalan jog ||
english: Attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, pain runs away. In His Sanctuary, He cherishes and sustains us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਤੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai jam na tetai jis dhur hovai sa(n)jog ||2||
english: Whoever has such pre-ordained destiny meets with the True Guru; the Messenger of Death cannot grab him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas dhiaai har har tajahu man ke bharam ||
english: Night and day, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; abandon the doubts of your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat har milai jisahi pooran karam ||3||
english: One who has perfect karma joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meets the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਖਾਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: janam janam bikhaad binase raakh leene aap ||
english: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, and one is protected by the Lord Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩॥
transliteration: maat pitaa meet bhaaee jan naanak har har jaap ||4||1||13||
english: He is our Mother, Father, Friend and Sibling; O servant Nanak, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 bibhaas paRataal ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Bibhaas, Partaal:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਪ ॥
transliteration: ram raam raam raam jaap ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kal kales lobh moh binas jaai aha(n) taap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Conflict, suffering, greed and emotional attachment shall be dispelled, and the fever of egotism shall be relieved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap tiaag sa(n)t charan laag man pavit jaahi paap ||1||
english: Renounce your selfishness, and grasp the feet of the Saints; your mind shall be sanctified, and your sins shall be taken away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak baarik kachhoo na jaanai raakhan kau prabh maaee baap ||2||1||14||
english: Nanak, the child, does not know anything at all. O God, please protect me; You are my Mother and Father. ||2||1||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal saran tek ||
english: I have taken the Shelter and Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ooch mooch bea(n)t thaakur sarab oopar tuhee ek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are Lofty and Exalted, Grand and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; You alone are above all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: praan adhaar dukh bidaar dainahaar budh bibek ||1||
english: He is the Support of the breath of life, the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of discriminating understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਰਖਨਹਾਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਕ ॥
transliteration: namasakaar rakhanahaar man araadh prabhoo mek ||
english: So bow down in respect to the Savior Lord; worship and adore the One God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ren karau majan naanak paavai sukh anek ||2||2||15||
english: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints, Nanak is blessed with countless comforts. ||2||2||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 bibhaas ||
english: Prabhaatee, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, Bibhaas:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਉਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa bauree man bauraaiaa ||
english: The insanity of duality has driven the mind insane.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jhoothai laalach janam gavaaiaa ||
english: In false greed, life is wasting away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: lapat rahee phun ba(n)dh na paaiaa ||
english: Duality clings to the mind; it cannot be restrained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur raakhe naam driRaaiaa ||1||
english: The True Guru saves us, implanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord within. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naa man marai na maaiaa marai ||
english: Without subduing the mind, Maya cannot be subdued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin kichh keeaa soee jaanai sabad veechaar bhau saagar tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One who created this, He alone understands. Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, one is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa sa(n)ch raaje aha(n)kaaree ||
english: Gathering the wealth of Maya, kings become proud and arrogant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa saath na chalai piaaree ||
english: But this Maya that they love so much shall not go along with them in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mamataa hai bahu ra(n)gee ||
english: There are so many colors and flavors of attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin naavai ko saath na sa(n)gee ||2||
english: Except for the Name, no one has any friend or companion. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਪਰ ਮਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu man dekhahi par man taisaa ||
english: According to one's own mind, one sees the minds of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਤੈਸੀ ਦਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jaisee manasaa taisee dasaa ||
english: According to one's desires, one's condition is determined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa karam taisee liv laavai ||
english: According to one's actions, one is focused and tuned in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur poochh sahaj ghar paavai ||3||
english: Seeking the advice of the True Guru, one finds the home of peace and poise. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗਿ ਨਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raag naad man doojai bhaai ||
english: In music and song, the mind is caught by the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kapat mahaa dukh paai ||
english: Filled with deception deep within, one suffers in terrible pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai sojhee paai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with clear understanding,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sachai naam rahai liv laai ||4||
english: and remains lovingly attuned to the True Name. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sach kamaavai ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, one practices Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee har gun gaavai ||
english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaas amar pad paavai ||
english: He dwells in the home of his own heart deep within, and obtains the immortal status.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: taa dar saachai sobhaa paavai ||5||
english: Then, he is blessed with honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hoee ||
english: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: anek jatan karai je koee ||
english: even though one may make all sorts of efforts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa sabade khoee ||
english: If one eradicates egotism and selfishness through the Shabad,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: niramal naam vasai man soee ||6||
english: the Immaculate Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: is jag mahi sabad karanee hai saar ||
english: In this world, the practice of the Shabad is the most excellent occupation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai hor mohu gubaar ||
english: Without the Shabad, everything else is the darkness of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabade naam rakhai ur dhaar ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Naam is enshrined within the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabade gat mat mokh duaar ||7||
english: Through the Shabad, one obtains clear understanding and the door of salvation. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: avar naahee kar dekhanahaaro ||
english: There is no other Creator except the All-seeing Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: saachaa aap anoop apaaro ||
english: The True Lord Himself is Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਊਤਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ootam gat hoee ||
english: Through the Lord's Name, one obtains the most sublime and exalted state.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak khoj lahai jan koee ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, how rare are those humble beings, who seek and find the Lord. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sagal jag chhaaiaa ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is spread out all over the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaaman dekh kaam lobhaaiaa ||
english: Seeing a beautiful woman, the man is overcome with sexual desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਕੰਚਨ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sut ka(n)chan siu het vadhaaiaa ||
english: His love for his children and gold steadily increases.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kichh apanaa ik raam paraaiaa ||1||
english: He sees everything as his own, but he does not own the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: aisaa jaap japau japamaalee ||
english: I meditate as I chant on such a mala,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh parahar bhagat niraalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that I rise above pleasure and pain; I attain the most wondrous devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan teraa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: O Treasure of Virtue, Your limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saach sabad tujh maahi samaaiaa ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, I am absorbed into You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun tudh aap rachaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself created the comings and goings of reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: seee bhagat jin sach chit laaiaa ||2||
english: They alone are devotees, who focus their consciousness on You. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan narahar nirabaanee ||
english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the Lord, the Lord of Nirvaanaa

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete koi na jaanee ||
english: - without meeting the True Guru, no one knows this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal sarovar jot samaanee ||
english: The Lord's Light fills the sacred pools of all beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aanad roop vitahu kurabaanee ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Embodiment of Bliss. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhaau bhagat guramatee paae ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, one achieves loving devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai vichahu sabad jalaae ||
english: The Shabad burns away egotism from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhai thaak rahaae ||
english: The wandering mind is restrained and held in its place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sachaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||4||
english: The True Name is enshrined in the mind. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਰਹੇ ਪਰਮਾਦੀ ॥
transliteration: bisam binod rahe paramaadee ||
english: The exciting and intoxicating worldly plays come to an end,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: guramat maaniaa ek liv laagee ||
english: for those who accept the Guru's Teachings, and become lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: dekh nivaariaa jal mahi aagee ||
english: Seeing this, the fire in the water is extinguished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: so boojhai hovai vadabhaagee ||5||
english: They alone realize this, who are blessed by great good fortune. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve bharam chukaae ||
english: Serving the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin jaagai sach liv laae ||
english: Those who are lovingly attuned to the True Lord remain awake and aware night and day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko jaanai avar na koi ||
english: They know the One Lord, and no other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa seve niramal hoi ||6||
english: Serving the Giver of peace, they become immaculate. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sevaa surat sabad veechaar ||
english: Selfless service and intuitive awareness come by reflecting upon the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam haumai maar ||
english: Chanting, intensive meditation and austere self-discipline come by subduing the ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat jaa sabad sunaae ||
english: One becomes Jivan-mukta - liberated while yet alive, by listening to the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਰਹਤ ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sachee rahat sachaa sukh paae ||7||
english: Living a truthful way of life, one finds true peace. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa dukh metanahaaraa ||
english: The Giver of peace is the Eradicator of pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੀਜੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: avar na soojhas beejee kaaraa ||
english: I cannot conceive of serving any other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan har aagai raakhiaa ||
english: I place my body, mind and wealth in offering before Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahai mahaa ras chaakhiaa ||8||2||
english: Says Nanak, I have tasted the supreme, sublime Essence of the Lord. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਭਾਠੀ ਰੇਚਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਕੁੰਭ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nivalee karam bhua(n)gam bhaathee rechak poorak ku(n)bh karai ||
english: You may perform exercises of inner purification, and fire up the furnace of the Kundalini, inhaling and exhaling and holding the breath.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kichh sojhee naahee bharame bhoolaa bood marai ||
english: Without the True Guru, you will not understand; deluded by doubt, you shall drown and die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa bhariaa bhar bhar dhovai a(n)tar kee mal kade na lahai ||
english: The spiritually blind are filled with filth and pollution; they may wash, but the filth within shall never depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਫੋਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam binaa phokat sabh karamaa jiu baajeegar bharam bhulai ||1||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all their actions are useless, like the magician who deceives through illuions. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: khat karam naam nira(n)jan soee ||
english: The merits of the six religious rituals are obtained through the Immaculate Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too gun saagar avagun mohee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You, O Lord, are the Ocean of virtue; I am so unworthy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਣੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa dha(n)dhaa dhaavanee duramat kaar bikaar ||
english: Running around chasing the entanglements of Maya is an evil-minded act of corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ਬੂਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: moorakh aap ganaaidaa boojh na sakai kaar ||
english: The fool makes a show of his self-conceit; he does not know how to behave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: manasaa maaiaa mohanee manamukh bol khuaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is enticed by his desires for Maya; his words are useless and empty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਜਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕਾ ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਂਗਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: majan jhoothaa cha(n)daal kaa phokat chaar see(n)gaar ||2||
english: The ritual cleansings of the sinner are fradulent; his rituals and decorations are useless and empty. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jhoothee man kee mat hai karanee baad bibaad ||
english: False is the wisdom of the mind; its actions inspire useless disputes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ ਹੈ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jhoothe vich aha(n)karan hai khasam na paavai saad ||
english: The false are filled with egotism; they do not obtain the sublime taste of their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai hor kamaavanaa phikaa aavai saad ||
english: Without the Name, whatever else they do is tasteless and insipid.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟੀ ਸਭਾ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਾਤੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dusatee sabhaa vigucheeai bikh vaatee jeevan baad ||3||
english: Associating with their enemies, they are plundered and ruined. Their speech is poison, and their lives are useless. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: e bhram bhoole marahu na koee ||
english: Do not be deluded by doubt; do not invite your own death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh hoee ||
english: Serve the True Guru, and you shall be at peace forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur mukat kinai na paaee ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one is liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aavahi jaa(n)hi marahi mar jaaee ||4||
english: They come and go in reincarnation; they die, only to be reborn and die again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ehu sareer hai trai gun dhaat ||
english: This body wanders, caught in the three dispositions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: is no viaapai sog sa(n)taap ||
english: It is afflicted by sorrow and suffering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: so sevahu jis maaee na baap ||
english: So serve the One who has no mother or father.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਆਪੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: vichahu chookai tisanaa ar aap ||5||
english: Desire and selfishness shall depart from within. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah tah soee ||
english: Wherever I look, I see Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete mukat na hoee ||
english: Without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hiradai sach eh karanee saar ||
english: Enshrine the True One in your heart; this is the most excellent action.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hor sabh paakha(n)d pooj khuaar ||6||
english: All other hypocritical actions and devotions bring only ruin. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa chookai taa(n) sabad pachhaan ||
english: When one is rid of duality, then he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ghar baahar eko kar jaan ||
english: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ehaa mat sabad hai saar ||
english: This is the most Excellent Wisdom of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਵੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: vich dubidhaa maathai pavai chhaar ||7||
english: Ashes fall on the heads of those who are in duality. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karanee keerat guramat saar ||
english: To praise the Lord through the Guru's Teachings is the most excellent action.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa gun giaan beechaar ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, contemplate the Glories of God and His spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: man maare jeevat mar jaan ||
english: Whoever subdues his mind, knows the state of being dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree nadar pachhaan ||8||3||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Gracious Lord is realized. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 dakhanee ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl, Dakhnee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੋਤਮੁ ਤਪਾ ਅਹਿਲਿਆ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gotam tapaa ahiliaa isatree tis dekh i(n)dr lubhaaiaa ||
english: Ahalyaa was the wife of Gautam the seer. Seeing her, Indra was enticed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਭਗ ਹੂਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahas sareer chihan bhag hooe taa man pachhotaaiaa ||1||
english: When he received a thousand marks of disgrace on his body, then he felt regret in his mind. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: koee jaan na bhoolai bhaaee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, no one knowingly makes mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so bhoolai jis aap bhulaae boojhai jisai bujhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is mistaken, whom the Lord Himself makes so. He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰੀ ਚੰਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੈ ਕਾਗਦਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tin haree cha(n)d prithamee pat raajai kaagad keem na paaee ||
english: Harichand, the king and ruler of his land, did not appreciate the value of his pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਨੇਖਾਸਿ ਬਿਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: augan jaanai ta pu(n)n kare kiu kiu nekhaas bikaaee ||2||
english: If he had known that it was a mistake, he would not have made such a show of giving in charity, and he would not have been sold in the market. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਅਢਾਈ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪਿ ਬਹਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: karau adhaaee dharatee maa(n)gee baavan roop bahaanai ||
english: The Lord took the form of a dwarf, and asked for some land.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੀਐ ਜੇ ਬਲਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kiu paiaal jaai kiu chhaleeai je bal roop pachhaanai ||3||
english: If Bal the king has recognized Him, he would not have been deceived, and sent to the underworld. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਦੇ ਮਤਂੀ ਬਰਜਿ ਬਿਆਸਿ ਪੜੑਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raajaa janamejaa de mata(n)ee baraj biaas paRhaaiaa ||
english: Vyaas taught and warned the king Janmayjaa not to do three things.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਘਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tinhi kar jag athaarah ghaae kirat na chalai chalaaiaa ||4||
english: But he performed the sacred feast and killed eighteen Brahmins; the record of one's past deeds cannot be erased. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਂੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਬੋਲੀ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ganat na gana(n)ee hukam pachhaanaa bolee bhaai subhaaee ||
english: I do not try to calculate the account; I accept the Hukam of God's Command. I speak with intuitive love and respect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਲਾਹਂੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo kichh varatai tudhai salaaha(n)ee sabh teree vadiaaee ||5||
english: No matter what happens, I will praise the Lord. It is all Your Glorious Greatness, O Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh alipat lep kade na laagai sadaa rahai saranaaee ||
english: The Gurmukh remains detached; filth never attaches itself to him. He remains forever in God's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: manamukh mugadh aagai chetai naahee dukh laagai pachhutaaee ||6||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not think of the future; he is overtaken by pain, and then he regrets. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa jin eh rachanaa racheeai ||
english: The Creator who created this creation acts, and causes all to act.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੇ ਪੈ ਪਚੀਐ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har abhimaan na jaaee jeeahu abhimaane pai pacheeai ||7||
english: O Lord, egotistical pride does not depart from the soul. Falling into egotistical pride, one is ruined. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
transliteration: bhulan vich keeaa sabh koee karataa aap na bhulai ||
english: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Creator does not make mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਘੁਲੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak sach naam nisataaraa ko gur parasaad aghulai ||8||4||
english: O Nanak, salvation comes through the True Name. By Guru's Grace, one is released. ||8||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aakhanaa sunanaa naam adhaar ||
english: To chant and listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa chhutak gaiaa vekaar ||
english: Worthless entanglements are ended and gone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu manamukh doojai pat khoee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh, caught in duality, loses his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin naavai mai avar na koee ||1||
english: Except for the Name, I have no other at all. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sun man a(n)dhe moorakh gavaar ||
english: Listen, O blind, foolish, idiotic mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat laaj nahee laagai bin gur boodai baaro baar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Aren't you ashamed of your comings and goings in reincarnation? Without the Guru, you shall drown, over and over again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: is man maaiaa mohi binaas ||
english: This mind is ruined by its attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: dhur hukam likhiaa taa(n) kaheeai kaas ||
english: The Command of the Primal Lord is pre-ordained. Before whom should I cry?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa cheenhai koee ||
english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam bihoonaa mukat na hoee ||2||
english: Without the Naam, no one is liberated. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਡੋਲੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhram dolai lakh chauraasee ||
english: People wander lost, staggering and stumbling through 8.4 million incarnations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bin gur boojhe jam kee phaasee ||
english: Without knowing the Guru, they cannot escape the noose of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa khin khin oobh paiaal ||
english: This mind, from one moment to the next, goes from the heavens to the underworld.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh chhootai naam samhaal ||3||
english: The Gurmukh contemplates the Naam, and is released. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape sade dhil na hoi ||
english: When God sends His Summons, there is no time to delay.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai sahilaa jeevai soi ||
english: When one dies in the Word of the Shabad, he lives in peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur sojhee kisai na hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, no one understands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape karai karaavai soi ||4||
english: The Lord Himself acts, and inspires all to act. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jhagaR chukaavai har gun gaavai ||
english: Inner conflict comes to an end, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur sahaj samaavai ||
english: Through the Perfect True Guru, one is intuitively absorbed into the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਤਉ ਠਹਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man dolat tau thaharaavai ||
english: This wobbling, unsteady mind is stabilized,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sach karanee kar kaar kamaavai ||5||
english: and one lives the lifestyle of true actions. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar joothaa kiu such hoi ||
english: If someone is false within his own self, then how can he be pure?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabadee dhovai viralaa koi ||
english: How rare are those who wash with the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh koee sach kamaavai ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, live the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa thaak rahaavai ||6||
english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation are over and done. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhau khaanaa peenaa sukh saar ||
english: Those who eat and drink the Fear of God, find the most excellent peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har jan sa(n)gat paavai paar ||
english: Associating with the humble servants of the Lord, they are carried across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach bolai bolaavai piaar ||
english: They speak the Truth, and lovingly inspire others to speak it as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad karanee hai saar ||7||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the most excellent occupation. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: har jas karam dharam pat poojaa ||
english: Those who take the Lord's Praises as their karma and Dharma, their honor and worship service

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਭੂੰਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aganee mahi bhoo(n)jaa ||
english: their sexual desire and anger are burnt off in the fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras chaakhiaa tau man bheejaa ||
english: They taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and their minds are drenched with it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak avar na doojaa ||8||5||
english: Prays Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jap a(n)tar poojaa ||
english: Chant the Lord's Name, and worship Him deep within your being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurasabad veechaar avar nahee doojaa ||1||
english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and no other. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: eko rav rahiaa sabh thaaee ||
english: The One is pervading all places.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar na deesai kis pooj chaRaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I do not see any other; unto whom should I offer worship? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan aagai jeeaRaa tujh paas ||
english: I place my mind and body in offering before You; I dedicate my soul to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakhahu aradaas ||2||
english: As it pleases You, You save me, Lord; this is my prayer. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sach jihavaa har rasan rasaaee ||
english: True is that tongue which is delighted by the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramat chhootas prabh saranaaee ||3||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one is saved in the Sanctuary of God. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam prabh merai keee ||
english: My God created religious rituals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਕੀਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam vadaaee sir karamaa(n) keee ||4||
english: He placed the glory of the Naam above these rituals. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai vas chaar padaarath ||
english: The four great blessings are under the control of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥ ॥੫॥
transliteration: teen samaae ek kritaarath ||5||
english: When the first three are put aside, one is blessed with the fourth. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: satigur deee mukat dhiaanaa(n) ||
english: Those whom the True Guru blesses with liberation and meditation

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਭਏ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har pad cheenhi bhae paradhaanaa ||6||
english: realize the Lord's State, and become sublime. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal gur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed; the Guru imparts this understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: prabh nivaaje kin keemat paaee ||7||
english: Who can estimate the value of those whom God has exalted? ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has imparted this understanding;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: naam binaa gat kinai na paaee ||8||6||
english: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is emancipated. ||8||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ik dhur bakhas lae gur poorai sachee banat banaaee ||
english: Some are forgiven by the Primal Lord God; the Perfect Guru makes the true making.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raate sadaa ra(n)g saachaa dukh bisare pat paaee ||1||
english: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord are imbued with Truth forever; their pains are dispelled, and they obtain honor. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jhoothee duramat kee chaturaaee ||
english: False are the clever tricks of the evil-minded.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binasat baar na laagai kaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They shall disappear in no time at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kau dukh darad viaapas manamukh dukh na jaaee ||
english: Pain and suffering afflict the self-willed manmukh. The pains of the self-willed manmukh shall never depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sukh dukh daataa guramukh jaataa mel lae saranaaee ||2||
english: The Gurmukh recognizes the Giver of pleasure and pain. He merges in His Sanctuary. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਅਭ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਸਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh te abh bhagat na hovas haumai pachahi divaane ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know loving devotional worship; they are insane, rotting away in their egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa khin oobh paiaalee jab lag sabad na jaane ||3||
english: This mind flies in an instant from the heavens to the underworld, as long as it does not know the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhookh piaasaa jag bhaiaa tipat nahee bin satigur paae ||
english: The world has become hungry and thirsty; without the True Guru, it is not satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sahajai sahaj milai sukh paaeeai daragah paidhaa jaae ||4||
english: Merging intuitively in the Celestial Lord, peace is obtained, and one goes to the Lord's Court wearing robes of honor. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: daragah daanaa beenaa ik aape niramal gur kee baanee ||
english: The Lord in His Court is Himself the Knower and Seer; the Word of the Guru's Bani is Immaculate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape surataa sach veechaaras aape boojhai pad nirabaanee ||5||
english: He Himself is the Awareness of Truth; He Himself understands the state of nirvaanaa. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਵਨੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jal tara(n)g aganee pavanai phun trai mil jagat upaaiaa ||
english: He made the waves of water, the fire and the air, and then joined the three together to form the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aisaa bal chhal tin kau deeaa hukamee thaak rahaaiaa ||6||
english: He blessed these elements with such power, that they remain subject to His Command. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aise jan virale jag a(n)dar parakh khajaanai paaiaa ||
english: How rare are those humble beings in this world, whom the Lord tests and places in His Treasury.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jaat varan te bhae ateetaa mamataa lobh chukaaiaa ||7||
english: They rise above social status and color, and rid themselves of possessiveness and greed. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam rate teerath se niramal dukh haumai mail chukaaiaa ||
english: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are like immaculate sacred shrines; they are rid of the pain and pollution of egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak tin ke charan pakhaalai jinaa guramukh saachaa bhaaiaa ||8||7||
english: Nanak washes the feet of those who, as Gurmukh, love the True Lord. ||8||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 bibhaas ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl, Bibhaas:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee vekh too har ma(n)dar terai naal ||
english: By Guru's Grace, see that the Temple of the Lord is within you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar sabade khojeeai har naamo lehu samhaal ||1||
english: The Temple of the Lord is found through the Word of the Shabad; contemplate the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere sabad rapai ra(n)g hoi ||
english: O my mind, be joyfully attuned to the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagat sachaa har ma(n)dar pragatee saachee soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: True is devotional worship, and True is the Temple of the Lord; True is His Manifest Glory. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar ehu sareer hai giaan ratan paragat hoi ||
english: This body is the Temple of the Lord, in which the jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਾਣਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukh mool na jaananee maanas har ma(n)dar na hoi ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know anything at all; they do not believe that the Lord's Temple is within. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar har jeeu saajiaa rakhiaa hukam savaar ||
english: The Dear Lord created the Temple of the Lord; He adorns it by His Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhur lekh likhiaa s kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||3||
english: All act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheenhi sukh paaiaa sachai naai piaar ||
english: Contemplating the Shabad, peace is obtained, loving the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar sabade sohanaa ka(n)chan kot apaar ||4||
english: The Temple of the Lord is embellished with the Shabad; it is an Infinite Fortress of God. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੰਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar ehu jagat hai gur bin ghora(n)dhaar ||
english: This world is the Temple of the Lord; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: doojaa bhaau kar poojade manamukh a(n)dh gavaar ||5||
english: The blind and foolish self-willed manmukhs worship in the love of duality. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਦੇਹ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai deh jaat na jaai ||
english: One's body and social status do not go along to that place, where all are called to account.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saach rate se ubare dukheee doojai bhaai ||6||
english: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; those in the love of duality are miserable. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar mahi naam nidhaan hai naa boojhahi mugadh gavaar ||
english: The treasure of the Naam is within the Temple of the Lord. The idiotic fools do not realize this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee cheenhiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have realized this. I keep the Lord enshrined within my heart. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee gur te jaatee j sabad rate ra(n)g laai ||
english: Those who are attuned to the love of the Shabad know the Guru, through the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: pavit paavan se jan niramal har kai naam samaai ||8||
english: Sacred, pure and immaculate are those humble beings who are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਟੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar har kaa haat hai rakhiaa sabad savaar ||
english: The Temple of the Lord is the Lord's Shop; He embellishes it with the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: tis vich saudaa ek naam guramukh lain savaar ||9||
english: In that shop is the merchandise of the One Name; the Gurmukhs adorn themselves with it. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਹਟੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar mahi man lohat hai mohiaa doojai bhaai ||
english: The mind is like iron slag, within the Temple of the Lord; it is lured by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: paaras bhetiai ka(n)chan bhaiaa keemat kahee na jaai ||10||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, the mind is transformed into gold. Its value cannot be described. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar mahi har vasai sarab nira(n)tar soi ||
english: The Lord abides within the Temple of the Lord. He is pervading in all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh vanajeeai sachaa saudaa hoi ||11||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs trade in the merchandise of Truth. ||11||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhaai jaage se jan jaagran karahi haumai mail utaar ||
english: Those who remain awake and aware in the Love and Fear of God, rid themselves of the filth and pollution of egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਕਾਢਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa jaagahi ghar apanaa raakhahi pa(n)ch tasakar kaadhahi maar ||1||
english: They remain awake and aware forever, and protect their homes, by beating and driving out the five thieves. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere guramukh naam dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit maarag har paaeeai man seee karam kamaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O mind, do only those deeds which will lead you to the Path of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sahaj dhun oopajai dukh haumai vichahu jaai ||
english: The celestial melody wells up in the Gurmukh, and the pains of egotism are taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naamaa har man vasai sahaje har gun gaai ||2||
english: The Name of the Lord abides in the mind, as one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramatee mukh sohane har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings - their faces are radiant and beautiful. They keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aithai othai sukh ghanaa jap har har utare paar ||3||
english: Here and hereafter, they find absolute peace; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are carried across to the other shore. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
