transliteration: haumai vich jaagran na hovaee har bhagat na pavaee thaai ||
english: In egotism, one cannot remain awake and aware, and one's devotional worship of the Lord is not accepted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਹਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: manamukh dar dhoee naa lahahi bhaai doojai karam kamaai ||4||
english: The self-willed manmukhs find no place in the Court of the Lord; they do their deeds in the love of duality. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਾ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dhrig khaanaa dhrig painhnaa jinhaa doojai bhaai piaar ||
english: Cursed is the food, and cursed are the clothes, of those who are attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bisataa ke keeRe bisataa raate mar ja(n)mahi hohi khuaar ||5||
english: They are like maggots in manure, sinking into manure. In death and rebirth, they are wasted away to ruin. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin kau satigur bhetiaa tinaa vitahu bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who meet with the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat mil rahaa(n) sache sach samaau ||6||
english: I shall continue to associate with them; devoted to Truth, I am absorbed in Truth. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gur paaeeai upaai kitai na paaiaa jaai ||
english: By perfect destiny, the Guru is found. He cannot be found by any efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur te sahaj oopajai haumai sabad jalaai ||7||
english: Through the True Guru, intuitive wisdom wells up; through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is burnt away. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har saranaaee bhaj man mere sabh kichh karanai jog ||
english: O my mind, hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord; He is Potent to do everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai jo kichh karai s hog ||8||2||7||2||9||
english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Whatever He does, comes to pass. ||8||2||7||2||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bibhaas prabhaatee mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa ||
english: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੂਗਹਿ ਚੋਗ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: choogahi chog ana(n)d siu jugataa ||
english: involved with them, people eat the food of bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਮੋੁਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: urajh pario man meeth mouhaaraa ||
english: The mind is entangled in sweet emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gaahak mere praan adhaaraa ||1||
english: Those who seek God's Glorious Virtues are the support of my breath of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: ek hamaaraa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: My One Lord is the Inner-Knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰ ਏਕਾ ਮੈ ਟਿਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhar ekaa mai tik ekas kee sir saahaa vad purakh suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is my Support; He is my only Protection. My Great Lord and Master is over and above the heads of kings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਲ ਨਾਗਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਟੂਟਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: chhal naagan siu meree tootan hoee ||
english: I have broken my ties to that deceitful serpent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਇਹ ਝੂਠੀ ਧੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa ih jhoothee dhohee ||
english: The Guru has told me that it is false and fraudulent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਖਾਈ ਕਉਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mukh meethee khaaee kauraai ||
english: Its face is sweet, but it tastes very bitter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam man rahiaa aghaai ||2||
english: My mind remains satisfied with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਸਿਉ ਗਈ ਵਿਖੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: lobh moh siu gaee vikhot ||
english: I have broken my ties with greed and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kripaal mohi keenee chhot ||
english: The Merciful Guru has rescued me from them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਠਗਵਾਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਰ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ih thagavaaree bahut ghar gaale ||
english: These cheating thieves have plundered so many homes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham gur raakh leee kirapaale ||3||
english: The Merciful Guru has protected and saved me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ ਠਾਟੁ ਨ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh siu thaat na baniaa ||
english: I have no dealings whatsoever with sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur upades mohi kaanee suniaa ||
english: I listen to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਮਹਾ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah mahaa cha(n)daal ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the most horrible goblins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੪॥
transliteration: raakh leee apunai gur gopaal ||4||
english: My Guru, the Lord of the World, has saved me from them. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਕਰੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
transliteration: das naaree mai karee duhaagan ||
english: I have made widows of the ten sensory organs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਏਹ ਰਸਹਿ ਬਿਖਾਗਨਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa eh rasahi bikhaagan ||
english: The Guru has told me that these pleasures are the fires of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: in sanaba(n)dhee rasaatal jaai ||
english: Those who associate with them go to hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ham gur raakhe har liv laai ||5||
english: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਸਿਉ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਛੋਡੀ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)mev siu masalat chhodee ||
english: I have forsaken the advice of my ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਡੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa ihu moorakh hodee ||
english: The Guru has told me that this is foolish stubbornness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਨੀਘਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu neeghar ghar kahee na paae ||
english: This ego is homeless; it shall never find a home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ham gur raakh leee liv laae ||6||
english: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: in logan siu ham bhae bairaaee ||
english: I have become alienated from these people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਖਟਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: ek grih mahi dui na khataa(n)ee ||
english: We cannot both live together in one home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਅੰਚਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: aae prabh pahi a(n)char laag ||
english: Grasping the hem of the Guru's Robe, I have come to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬਾਗਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: karahu tapaavas prabh sarabaag ||7||
english: Please be fair with me, All-knowing Lord God. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਸਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਆਂਏਂ ॥
transliteration: prabh has bole keee niaa(n)e(n) ||
english: God smiled at me and spoke, passing judgement.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sagal doot meree sevaa laae ||
english: He made all the demons perform service for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) thaakur ihu grihu sabh teraa ||
english: You are my Lord and Master; all this home belongs to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur keeaa niberaa ||8||1||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has passed judgement. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man mahi krodh mahaa aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: Within the mind dwell anger and massive ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: poojaa karahi bahut bisathaaraa ||
english: Worship services are performed with great pomp and ceremony.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਤਨਿ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar isanaan tan chakr banaae ||
english: Ritual cleansing baths are taken, and sacred marks are applied to the body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee mal kab hee na jaae ||1||
english: But still, the filth and pollution within never depart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: it sa(n)jam prabh kin hee na paaiaa ||
english: No one has ever found God in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagautee mudraa man mohiaa maaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sacred mudras - ritualistic hand gestures - are made, but the mind remains enticed by Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੰਚਾਂ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paap karahi pa(n)chaa(n) ke bas re ||
english: They commit sins, under the influence of the five thieves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teerath naai kahahi sabh utare ||
english: They bathe at sacred shrines, and claim that everything has been washed off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਕ ॥
transliteration: bahur kamaavahi hoi nisa(n)k ||
english: Then they commit them again, without fear of the consequences.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਖਰੇ ਕਾਲੰਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jam pur baa(n)dh khare kaala(n)k ||2||
english: The sinners are bound and gagged, and taken to the City of Death. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੂਘਰ ਬਾਧਿ ਬਜਾਵਹਿ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ghooghar baadh bajaavahi taalaa ||
english: The ankle-bells shake and the cymbals vibrate,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kapat phirahi betaalaa ||
english: but those who have deception within wander lost like demons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: varamee maaree saap na mooaa ||
english: By destroying its hole, the snake is not killed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabh sabh kichh jaanai jin too keeaa ||3||
english: God, who created you, knows everything. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਅਰ ਤਾਪ ਗੇਰੀ ਕੇ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
transliteration: poo(n)ar taap geree ke basatraa ||
english: You worship fire and wear saffron colored robes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਦਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤੇ ਨਸਤਾ ॥
transliteration: apadaa kaa maariaa grih te nasataa ||
english: Stung by your misfortune, you abandon your home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਹਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: des chhod paradesahi dhaaiaa ||
english: Leaving your own country, you wander in foreign lands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਨਾਲੇ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch cha(n)daal naale lai aaiaa ||4||
english: But you bring the five rejects with you. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨ ਫਰਾਇ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਟੂਕਾ ॥
transliteration: kaan pharaai hiraae tookaa ||
english: You have split your ears, and now you steal crumbs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar maa(n)gai tripataavan te chookaa ||
english: You beg from door to door, but you fail to be satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਦ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: banitaa chhod bad nadar par naaree ||
english: You have abandoned your own wife, but now you sneak glances at other women.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਸਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖਿਆਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ves na paaeeai mahaa dukhiaaree ||5||
english: God is not found by wearing religious robes; you are utterly miserable! ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਮੋਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bolai naahee hoi baithaa monee ||
english: He does not speak; he is on silence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਲਪ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਜੋਨੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kalap bhavaaeeai jonee ||
english: But he is filled with desire; he is made to wander in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n te rahataa dukh dehee sahataa ||
english: Abstaining from food, his body suffers in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਮਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hukam na boojhai viaapiaa mamataa ||6||
english: He does not realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command; he is afflicted by possessiveness. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaee param gate ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one has attained the supreme status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੇ ॥
transliteration: poochhahu sagal bed si(n)mrite ||
english: Go ahead and ask all the Vedas and the Simritees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam karai ajaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do useless deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jiu baaloo ghar thaur na thaaee ||7||
english: They are like a house of sand, which cannot stand. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਏ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no bhae goubi(n)d daiaalaa ||
english: One unto whom the Lord of the Universe becomes Merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan tin baadhio paalaa ||
english: sews the Word of the Guru's Shabad into his robes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe koee sa(n)t dikhaaiaa ||
english: Out of millions, it is rare that such a Saint is seen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai sa(n)g taraaiaa ||8||
english: O Nanak, with him, we are carried across. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je hovai bhaag taa darasan paaeeai ||
english: If one has such good destiny, then the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap tarai sabh kuta(n)b taraaeeai ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||2||
english: He saves himself, and carries across all his family as well. ||1||SECOND PAUSE||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam kilabikh sabh kaate ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, all the sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਕਾਗਰ ਫਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai ke kaagar phaate ||
english: The accounts held by the Righteous Judge of Dharma are torn up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mil har ras paaiaa ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham rid maahi samaaiaa ||1||
english: I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord. The Supreme Lord God has melted into my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raam ramat har har sukh paaiaa ||
english: Dwelling on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere daas charan saranaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your slaves seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੂਕਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chookaa gaun mitiaa a(n)dhiaar ||
english: The cycle of reincarnation is ended, and darkness is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur dikhalaaiaa mukat duaar ||
english: The Guru has revealed the door of liberation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har prem bhagat man tan sad raataa ||
english: My mind and body are forever imbued with loving devotion to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਨਾਇਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabhoo janaaiaa tab hee jaataa ||2||
english: Now I know God, because He has made me know Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar raviaa soi ||
english: He is contained in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis bin beejo naahee koi ||
english: Without Him, there is no one at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਛੇਦੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾਂ ॥
transliteration: bair birodh chhede bhai bharamaa(n) ||
english: Hatred, conflict, fear and doubt have been eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabh pu(n)n aatamai keene dharamaa ||3||
english: God, the Soul of Pure Goodness, has manifested His Righteousness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੇ ਕਾਂਢੈ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: mahaa tara(n)g te kaa(n)dhai laagaa ||
english: He has rescued me from the most dangerous waves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਂਢਾ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa tootaa gaa(n)dhaa ||
english: Separated from Him for countless lifetimes, I am united with Him once again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam naam samhaaliaa ||
english: Chanting, intense meditation and strict self-discipline are the contemplation of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: apunai thaakur nadar nihaaliaa ||4||
english: My Lord and Master has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਤਿਥਾਈਂ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gal sookh kaliaan tithaaee(n) ||
english: Bliss, peace and salvation are found in that place,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸੇਵਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah sevak gopaal gusaaee ||
english: where the servants of the Lord of the World abide.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: prabh suprasa(n)n bhae gopaal ||
english: God, the Lord of the World, is pleased and satisfied with me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਤਾਲ ॥੫॥
transliteration: janam janam ke mite bitaal ||5||
english: My disharmony with Him of so many lifetimes is ended. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: hom jag uradh tap poojaa ||
english: Burnt offerings, sacred feasts, intense meditations with the body upside-down, worship services

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kot teerath isanaan kareejaa ||
english: and taking millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਮਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal nimakh ridai dhaare ||
english: - the merits of all these are obtained by enshrining the Lord's Lotus Feet within the heart, even for an instant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d japat sabh kaaraj saare ||6||
english: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, all one's affairs are resolved. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ooche te oochaa prabh thaan ||
english: God's Place is the highest of the high.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har jan laavahi sahaj dhiaan ||
english: The Lord's humble servants intuitively focus their meditation on Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daas daasan kee baa(n)chhau dhoor ||
english: I long for the dust of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa preetam bharapoor ||7||
english: My Beloved Lord is overflowing with all powers. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa har preetam neraa ||
english: My Beloved Lord, my Mother and Father, is always near.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meet saajan bharavaasaa teraa ||
english: O my Friend and Companion, You are my Trusted Support.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene apune daas ||
english: God takes His slaves by the hand, and makes them His Own.

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: jap jeevai naanak gunataas ||8||3||2||7||12||
english: Nanak lives by meditating on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||8||3||2||7||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: bibhaas prabhaatee baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ||
english: Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਕਾ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: maran jeevan kee sa(n)kaa naasee ||
english: My anxious fears of death and rebirth have been taken away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਹਜ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aapan ra(n)g sahaj paragaasee ||1||
english: The Celestial Lord has shown His Love for me. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pragatee jot mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: The Divine Light has dawned, and darkness has been dispelled.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ratan paaiaa karat beechaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Contemplating the Lord, I have obtained the Jewel of His Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jah ana(n)d dukh door paiaanaa ||
english: Pain runs far away from that place where there is bliss.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਕੁ ਲਿਵ ਤਤੁ ਲੁਕਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man maanak liv tat lukaanaa ||2||
english: The jewel of the mind is focused and attuned to the essence of reality. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh hoaa s teraa bhaanaa ||
english: Whatever happens is by the Pleasure of Your Will.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਵ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo iv boojhai s sahaj samaanaa ||3||
english: Whoever understands this, is intuitively merged in the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ਖੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer kilabikh gae kheenaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, my sins have been obliterated.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: man bhaiaa jagajeevan leenaa ||4||1||
english: My mind has merged into the Lord, the Life of the World. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee ||
english: Prabhaatee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: alahu ek maseet basat hai avar mulakh kis keraa ||
english: If the Lord Allah lives only in the mosque, then to whom does the rest of the world belong?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਦੁਹ ਮਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo moorat naam nivaasee duh mahi tat na heraa ||1||
english: According to the Hindus, the Lord's Name abides in the idol, but there is no truth in either of these claims. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: alah raam jeevau tere naaee ||
english: O Allah, O Raam, I live by Your Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਹਰਾਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too kar miharaamat saaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please show mercy to me, O Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਖਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ ਪਛਿਮਿ ਅਲਹ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: dakhan des haree kaa baasaa pachhim alah mukaamaa ||
english: The God of the Hindus lives in the southern lands, and the God of the Muslims lives in the west.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਦਿਲੈ ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਏਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dil mahi khoj dilai dil khojahu ehee thaur mukaamaa ||2||
english: So search in your heart - look deep into your heart of hearts; this is the home and the place where God lives. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨ ਗਿਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਉਬੀਸਾ ਕਾਜੀ ਮਹ ਰਮਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: brahaman giaas karahi chaubeesaa kaajee mah ramajaanaa ||
english: The Brahmins observe twenty-four fasts during the year, and the Muslims fast during the month of Ramadaan.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਪਾਸ ਕੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: giaarah maas paas kai raakhe ekai maahi nidhaanaa ||3||
english: The Muslims set aside eleven months, and claim that the treasure is only in the one month. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਉਡੀਸੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਂਏਂ ॥
transliteration: kahaa udeese majan keeaa kiaa maseet sir naa(n)e(n) ||
english: What is the use of bathing at Orissa? Why do the Muslims bow their heads in the mosque?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਂਏਂ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dil mahi kapat nivaaj gujaarai kiaa haj kaabai jaa(n)e(n) ||4||
english: If someone has deception in his heart, what good is it for him to utter prayers? And what good is it for him to go on pilgrimage to Mecca? ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਅਉਰਤ ਮਰਦਾ ਸਾਜੇ ਏ ਸਭ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ete aurat maradaa saaje e sabh roop tumhaare ||
english: You fashioned all these men and women, Lord. All these are Your Forms.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂੰਗਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਅਲਹ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kabeer poo(n)garaa raam alah kaa sabh gur peer hamaare ||5||
english: Kabeer is the child of God, Allah, Raam. All the Gurus and prophets are mine. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਰਵੈ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu nar naravai parahu ek kee saranaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O men and women: seek the Sanctuary of the One.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਹਚੈ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੬॥੨॥
transliteration: keval naam japahu re praanee tab hee nihachai taranaa ||6||2||
english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortals, and you shall surely be carried across. ||6||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee ||
english: Prabhaatee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਲਹ ਨੂਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਬੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aval alah noor upaaiaa kudarat ke sabh ba(n)de ||
english: First, Allah created the Light; then, by His Creative Power, He made all mortal beings.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨੂਰ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਕਉਨ ਭਲੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek noor te sabh jag upajiaa kaun bhale ko ma(n)de ||1||
english: From the One Light, the entire universe welled up. So who is good, and who is bad? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: logaa bharam na bhoolahu bhaaee ||
english: O people, O Siblings of Destiny, do not wander deluded by doubt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਿਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਖਲਕ ਮਹਿ ਖਾਲਿਕੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khaalik khalak khalak mahi khaalik poor rahio srab thaa(n)ee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Creation is in the Creator, and the Creator is in the Creation, totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: maatee ek anek bhaa(n)t kar saajee saajanahaarai ||
english: The clay is the same, but the Fashioner has fashioned it in various ways.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਕੁੰਭਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naa kachh poch maatee ke bhaa(n)de naa kachh poch ku(n)bhaarai ||2||
english: There is nothing wrong with the pot of clay - there is nothing wrong with the Potter. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi sachaa eko soee tis kaa keeaa sabh kachh hoee ||
english: The One True Lord abides in all; by His making, everything is made.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaanai s eko jaanai ba(n)daa kaheeai soee ||3||
english: Whoever realizes the Hukam of His Command, knows the One Lord. He alone is said to be the Lord's slave. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੁੜੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: alahu alakh na jaaee lakhiaa gur guR deenaa meethaa ||
english: The Lord Allah is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Guru has blessed me with this sweet molasses.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਕਾ ਨਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer meree sa(n)kaa naasee sarab nira(n)jan deethaa ||4||3||
english: Says Kabeer, my anxiety and fear have been taken away; I see the Immaculate Lord pervading everywhere. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee ||
english: Prabhaatee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਹੁ ਮਤ ਝੂਠੇ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bed kateb kahahu mat jhoothe jhoothaa jo na bichaarai ||
english: Do not say that the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran are false. Those who do not contemplate them are false.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਰਗੀ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau sabh mahi ek khudaai kahat hau tau kiu muragee maarai ||1||
english: You say that the One Lord is in all, so why do you kill chickens? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਹਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mulaa(n) kahahu niaau khudaaee ||
english: O Mullah, tell me: is this God's Justice?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere man kaa bharam na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The doubts of your mind have not been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਕਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਨਿਆ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: pakar jeeu aaniaa deh binaasee maatee kau bisamil keeaa ||
english: You seize a living creature, and then bring it home and kill its body; you have killed only the clay.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਹਤ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਹੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jot saroop anaahat laagee kahu halaal kiaa keeaa ||2||
english: The light of the soul passes into another form. So tell me, what have you killed? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਉਜੂ ਪਾਕੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਧੋਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ujoo paak keeaa muhu dhoiaa kiaa maseet sir laaiaa ||
english: And what good are your purifications? Why do you bother to wash your face? And why do you bother to bow your head in the mosque?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jau dil mahi kapat nivaaj gujaarahu kiaa haj kaabai jaaiaa ||3||
english: Your heart is full of hypocrisy; what good are your prayers or your pilgrimage to Mecca? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ਪਾਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) naapaak paak nahee soojhiaa tis kaa maram na jaaniaa ||
english: You are impure; you do not understand the Pure Lord. You do not know His Mystery.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer bhisat te chookaa dojak siu man maaniaa ||4||4||
english: Says Kabeer, you have missed out on paradise; your mind is set on hell. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee ||
english: Prabhaatee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਕਰ ਅਧਪਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n sa(n)dhiaa teree dev devaakar adhapat aad samaaee ||
english: Hear my prayer, Lord; You are the Divine Light of the Divine, the Primal, All-pervading Master.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sidh samaadh a(n)t nahee paaiaa laag rahe saranaaee ||1||
english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi have not found Your limits. They hold tight to the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੇਹੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: lehu aaratee ho purakh nira(n)jan satigur poojahu bhaaee ||
english: Worship and adoration of the Pure, Primal Lord comes by worshipping the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਠਾਢਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਨਿਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: thaadhaa brahamaa nigam beechaarai alakh na lakhiaa jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Standing at His Door, Brahma studies the Vedas, but he cannot see the Unseen Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤੀ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਦੇਹ ਉਜੵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tat tel naam keeaa baatee deepak deh ujyaaraa ||
english: With the oil of knowledge about the essence of reality, and the wick of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, this lamp illluminates my body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਗਾਇਆ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jot laai jagadees jagaaiaa boojhai boojhanahaaraa ||2||
english: I have applied the Light of the Lord of the Universe, and lit this lamp. God the Knower knows. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)che sabad anaahad baaje sa(n)ge saari(n)gapaanee ||
english: The Unstruck Melody of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds. I dwell with the Lord of the World.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: kabeer daas teree aaratee keenee nira(n)kaar nirabaanee ||3||5||
english: Kabeer, Your slave, performs this Aartee, this lamp-lit worship service for You, O Formless Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||3||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee ||
english: Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਲ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: man kee birathaa man hee jaanai kai boojhal aagai kaheeai ||
english: The mind alone knows the state of the mind; I tell it to the Knowing Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਂਈ ਮੈ ਡਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਚਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee raam ravaa(n)ee mai dar kaise chaheeai ||1||
english: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts - why should I be afraid? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bedheeale gopaal gousaaee ||
english: My mind is pierced through by the love of the Lord of the World.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੇ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh raviaa sarabe thaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My God is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹਾਟੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਾਟੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maanai haat maanai paat maanai hai paasaaree ||
english: The mind is the shop, the mind is the town, and the mind is the shopkeeper.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਬਾਸੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਭੇਦੀ ਭਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maanai baasai naanaa bhedee bharamat hai sa(n)saaree ||2||
english: The mind abides in various forms, wandering all across the world. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad ehu man raataa dubidhaa sahaj samaanee ||
english: This mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and duality is easily overcome.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabho hukam hukam hai aape nirabhau samat beechaaree ||3||
english: He Himself is the Commander; all are under His Command. The Fearless Lord looks on all alike. ||3||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਤਾ ਚੀ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jo jan jaan bhajahi purakhotam taa chee abigat baanee ||
english: That humble being who knows, and meditates on the Supreme Primal Being - his word becomes eternal.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naamaa kahai jagajeevan paaiaa hiradai alakh bidaanee ||4||1||
english: Says Naam Dayv, I have found the Invisible, Wondrous Lord, the Life of the World, within my heart. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee ||
english: Prabhaatee:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad jugaad jugo jug taa kaa a(n)t na jaaniaa ||
english: He existed in the beginning, in the primeval age, and all throughout the ages; His limits cannot be known.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਐਸਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਬਖਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar raam rahiaa rav aisaa roop bakhaaniaa ||1||
english: The Lord is pervading and permeating amongst all; this is how His Form can be described. ||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gobid gaajai sabad baajai ||
english: The Lord of the Universe appears when the Word of His Shabad is chanted.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੀ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aanad roopee mero raamaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Lord is the Embodiment of Bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਬੀਖੂ ਬਾਨੈ ਬੀਖੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਗਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: baavan beekhoo baanai beekhe baas te sukh laagilaa ||
english: The beautiful fragrance of sandalwood emanates from the sandalwood tree, and attaches to the other trees of the forest.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਲਾਦਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarabe aad paramalaad kaasat cha(n)dan bhaiilaa ||2||
english: God, the Primal Source of everything, is like the sandalwood tree; He transforms us woody trees into fragrant sandalwood. ||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਚੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹਮ ਚੇ ਲੋਹਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tumh che paaras ham che lohaa sa(n)ge ka(n)chan bhaiilaa ||
english: You, O Lord, are the Philosopher's Stone, and I am iron; associating with You, I am transformed into gold.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਲਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: too daiaal ratan laal naamaa saach samaailaa ||3||2||
english: You are Merciful; You are the gem and the jewel. Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Truth. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee ||
english: Prabhaatee:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: akul purakh ik chalit upaaiaa ||
english: The Primal Being has no ancestry; He has staged this play.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar braham lukaaiaa ||1||
english: God is hidden deep within each and every heart. ||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jee kee jot na jaanai koee ||
english: No one knows the Light of the soul.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tai mai keeaa s maaloom hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever I do, is known to You, Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੁੰਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu pragaasiaa maatee ku(n)bheu ||
english: Just as the pitcher is made from clay,

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਠੁਲੁ ਦੇਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap hee karataa beethul deu ||2||
english: everything is made from the Beloved Divine Creator Himself. ||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jee kaa ba(n)dhan karam biaapai ||
english: The mortal's actions hold the soul in the bondage of karma.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo kichh keeaa s aapai aapai ||3||
english: Whatever he does, he does on his own. ||3||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਸੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: pranavat naamadeu ihu jeeu chitavai s lahai ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, whatever this soul wants, it obtains.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਦ ਆਕੁਲ ਰਹੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: amar hoi sad aakul rahai ||4||3||
english: Whoever abides in the Lord, becomes immortal. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਭਗਤ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: prabhaatee bhagat benee jee kee ||
english: Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: tan cha(n)dan masatak paatee ||
english: You rub your body with sandalwood oil, and place basil leaves on your forehead.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: rid a(n)tar kar tal kaatee ||
english: But you hold a knife in the hand of your heart.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਠਗ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਗਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: thag disat bagaa liv laagaa ||
english: You look like a thug; pretending to meditate, you pose like a crane.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੁਖ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dekh baisano praan mukh bhaagaa ||1||
english: You try to look like a Vaishnaav, but the breath of life escapes through your mouth. ||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਭਗਵਤ ਬੰਦ ਚਿਰਾਂਮੰ ॥
transliteration: kal bhagavat ba(n)d chiraa(n)ma(n) ||
english: You pray for hours to God the Beautiful.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਰਤਾ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਦੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kroor disat rataa nis baada(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But your gaze is evil, and your nights are wasted in conflict. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸਰੀਰੰ ॥
transliteration: nitaprat isanaan sareera(n) ||
english: You perform daily cleansing rituals,

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਖੀਰੰ ॥
transliteration: dui dhotee karam mukh kheera(n) ||
english: wear two loin-cloths, perform religious rituals and put only milk in your mouth.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਛੁਰੀ ਸੰਧਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ridai chhuree sa(n)dhiaanee ||
english: But in your heart, you have drawn out the sword.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: par darab hiran kee baanee ||2||
english: You routinely steal the property of others. ||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਣੇਸੰ ॥
transliteration: sil poojas chakr ganesa(n) ||
english: You worship the stone idol, and paint ceremonial marks of Ganesha.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੰ ॥
transliteration: nis jaagas bhagat pravesa(n) ||
english: You remain awake throughout the night, pretending to worship God.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਨਾਚਸਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਕਰਮੰ ॥
transliteration: pag naachas chit akarama(n) ||
english: You dance, but your consciousness is filled with evil.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਏ ਲੰਪਟ ਨਾਚ ਅਧਰਮੰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: e la(n)pat naach adharama(n) ||3||
english: You are lewd and depraved - this is such an unrighteous dance! ||3||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਆਸਣੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: mrig aasan tulasee maalaa ||
english: You sit on a deer-skin, and chant on your mala.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਊਜਲ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar oojal tilak kapaalaa ||
english: You put the sacred mark, the tilak, on your forehead.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਰੁਦ੍ਰਾਖੰ ॥
transliteration: ridai kooR ka(n)th rudraakha(n) ||
english: You wear the rosary beads of Shiva around your neck, but your heart is filled with falsehood.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਲੰਪਟ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਅਭਾਖੰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: re la(n)pat krisan abhaakha(n) ||4||
english: You are lewd and depraved - you do not chant God's Name. ||4||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin aatam tat na cheenhiaa ||
english: Whoever does not realize the essence of the soul

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਧਰਮ ਅਬੀਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh phokat dharam abeeniaa ||
english: all his religious actions are hollow and false.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu benee guramukh dhiaavai ||
english: Says Baynee, as Gurmukh, meditate.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: bin satigur baat na paavai ||5||1||
english: Without the True Guru, you shall not find the Way. ||5||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਇਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: raam simar raam simar ihai terai kaaj hai ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord - meditate on the Lord; this alone shall be of use to you.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ko sa(n)g tiaag prabh joo kee saran laag ||
english: Abandon your association with Maya, and take shelter in the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਝੂਠੋ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jagat sukh maan mithiaa jhootho sabh saaj hai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remember that the pleasures of the world are false; this whole show is just an illusion. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਧਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਪਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: supane jiu dhan pachhaan kaahe par karat maan ||
english: You must understand that this wealth is just a dream. Why are you so proud?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੂ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baaroo kee bheet jaise basudhaa ko raaj hai ||1||
english: The empires of the earth are like walls of sand. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਬਾਤ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜੈਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਗਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak jan kahat baat binas jaihai tero gaat ||
english: Servant Nanak speaks the Truth: your body shall perish and pass away.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੁ ਆਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: chhin chhin kar gaio kaal taise jaat aaj hai ||2||1||
english: Moment by moment, yesterday passed. Today is passing as well. ||2||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: raam bhaj raam bhaj janam siraat hai ||
english: Meditate on the Lord - vibrate on the Lord; your life is slipping away.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਿਉ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kahau kahaa baar baar samajhat nah kiu gavaar ||
english: Why am I telling you this again and again? You fool - why don't you understand?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਰ ਓਰੇ ਸਮ ਗਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binasat nah lagai baar ore sam gaat hai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your body is like a hail-stone; it melts away in no time at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਰਮ ਡਾਰਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal bharam daar dehi gobi(n)d ko naam lehi ||
english: So give up all your doubts, and utter the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਬਾਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਇਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t baar sa(n)g terai ihai ek jaat hai ||1||
english: At the very last moment, this alone shall go along with you. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੌ ਜਸੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa bikh jiu bisaar prabh kau jas heee dhaar ||
english: Forget the poisonous sins of corruption, and enshrine the Praises of God in your heart.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬਿਹਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jan kahi pukaar ausar bihaat hai ||2||2||
english: Servant Nanak proclaims that this opportunity is slipping away. ||2||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਉਨ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: re man kaun gat hoi hai teree ||
english: O mortal, what will your condition be?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ih jag mahi raam naam so tau nahee sunio kaan ||
english: In this world, you have not listened to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਤਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bikhian siu at lubhaan mat naahin pheree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are totally engrossed in corruption and sin; you have not turned your mind away from them at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਕੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹ ਨਿਮਖ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maanas ko janam leen simaran nah nimakh keen ||
english: You obtained this human life, but you have not remembered the Lord in meditation, even for an instant.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦਾਰਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਇਓ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਗਹੁ ਪਰੀ ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daaraa sukh bhaio deen pagahu paree beree ||1||
english: For the sake of pleasure, you have become subservient to your woman, and now your feet are bound. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਗ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak jan kahi pukaar supanai jiu jag pasaar ||
english: Servant Nanak proclaims that the vast expanse of this world is just a dream.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਹ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: simarat nah kiu muraar maaiaa jaa kee cheree ||2||3||
english: Why not meditate on the Lord? Even Maya is His slave. ||2||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬੀਤ ਜੈਹੈ ਬੀਤ ਜੈਹੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਜੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: beet jaihai beet jaihai janam akaaj re ||
english: Slipping away - your life is uselessly slipping away.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹ ਰੇ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: nis din sun kai puraan samajhat nah re ajaan ||
english: Night and day, you listen to the Puraanas, but you do not understand them, you ignorant fool!

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਤਉ ਪਹੂਚਿਓ ਆਨਿ ਕਹਾ ਜੈਹੈ ਭਾਜਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaal tau pahoochio aan kahaa jaihai bhaaj re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Death has arrived; now where will you run? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਦੇਹ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਤੇਰਉ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: asathir jo maanio deh so tau terau hoi hai kheh ||
english: You believed that this body was permanent, but it shall turn to dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਨਿਲਾਜ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiu na har ko naam lehi moorakh nilaaj re ||1||
english: Why don't you chant the Name of the Lord, you shameless fool? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਏ ਆਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: raam bhagat heee aan chhaad de tai man ko maan ||
english: Let devotional worship of the Lord enter into your heart, and abandon the intellectualism of your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਖਾਨਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਰਾਜੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jan ih bakhaan jag mahi biraaj re ||2||4||
english: O Servant Nanak, this is the way to live in the world. ||2||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok sahasakritee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Salok Sehskritee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜੑਿ ਪੁਸ੍ਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
transliteration: paRhi pustak sa(n)dhiaa baada(n) ||
english: You study the scriptures, say your prayers and argue;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
transliteration: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
english: you worship stones and sit like a crane, pretending to meditate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਬਿਭੂਖਨ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: mukh jhooth bibhookhan saara(n) ||
english: You speak lies and well-ornamented falsehood,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
english: and recite your daily prayers three times a day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
transliteration: gal maalaa tilak lilaata(n) ||
english: The mala is around your neck, and the sacred tilak mark is on your forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
transliteration: dui dhotee basatr kapaata(n) ||
english: You wear two loin cloths, and keep your head covered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
transliteration: jo jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
english: If you know God and the nature of karma,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚੈ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
transliteration: sabh phokat nisachai karama(n) ||
english: you know that all these rituals and beliefs are useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਚੌ ਧੵਿਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak nisachau dhyiaavai ||
english: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord with faith.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin satigur baat na paavai ||1||
english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸੵ ਜਨਮਸੵ ਜਾਵਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
transliteration: nihaphala(n) tasy janamasy jaavad braham na bi(n)date ||
english: The mortal's life is fruitless, as long as he does not know God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸੵ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: saagara(n) sa(n)saarasy gur parasaadee tarahi ke ||
english: Only a few, by Guru's Grace, cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar ||
english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful. Thus speaks Nanak, after deep deliberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar ||2||
english: The Creation is under the control of the Creator. By His Power, He sustains and supports it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
transliteration: jog sabada(n) giaan sabada(n) bed sabada(n) ta braahamanah ||
english: The Shabad is Yoga, the Shabad is spiritual wisdom; the Shabad is the Vedas for the Brahmin.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੵਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
transliteration: khytree sabada(n) soor sabada(n) soodr sabada(n) paraa kritah ||
english: The Shabad is heroic bravery for the Khshaatriya; the Shabad is service to others for the Soodra.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sabada(n) ta ek sabada(n) je ko jaanas bheu ||
english: The Shabad for all is the Shabad, the Word of the One God, for one who knows this secret.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak taa ko daas hai soee nira(n)jan deu ||3||
english: Nanak is the slave of the Divine, Immaculate Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨੰ ਤ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਹ ॥
transliteration: ek krisna(n) ta sarab devaa dev devaa ta aatamah ||
english: The One Lord is the Divinity of all divinities. He is the Divinity of the soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਾਸ੍ਵਦੇਵਸੵ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
transliteration: aatama(n) sree baasvadevasy je koee jaanas bhev ||
english: Nanak is the slave of that one who knows the Secrets of the soul and the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak taa ko daas hai soee nira(n)jan dev ||4||
english: He is the Divine Immaculate Lord Himself. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok sahasakritee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Salok Sehskritee , Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਤੰਚ ਮਾਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
transliteration: kata(n)ch maataa kata(n)ch pitaa kata(n)ch banitaa binod sutah ||
english: Who is the mother, and who is the father? Who is the son, and what is the pleasure of marriage?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਤੰਚ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਹਿਤ ਬੰਧਵ ਕਤੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੵਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kata(n)ch bhraat meet hit ba(n)dhav kata(n)ch moh kuta(n)byte ||
english: Who is the brother, friend, companion and relative? Who is emotionally attached to the family?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਤੰਚ ਚਪਲ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਰੂਪੰ ਪੇਖੰਤੇ ਤਿਆਗੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kata(n)ch chapal mohanee roopa(n) pekha(n)te tiaaga(n) karot ||
english: Who is restlessly attached to beauty? It leaves, as soon as we see it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੰਤ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਤਨਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raha(n)t sa(n)g bhagavaan simaran naanak labadhy(n) achut tanah ||1||
english: Only the meditative remembrance of God remains with us. O Nanak, it brings the blessings of the Saints, the sons of the Imperishable Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵਹ ॥
transliteration: dhriga(n)t maat pitaa saneha(n) dhrig saneha(n) bhraat baa(n)dhavah ||
english: Cursed is loving attachment to one's mother and father; cursed is loving attachment to one's siblings and relatives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹੰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
transliteration: dhrig sneha(n) banitaa bilaas sutah ||
english: Cursed is attachment to the joys of family life with one's spouse and children.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹੰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਾਰਥ ਕਹ ॥
transliteration: dhrig sneha(n) grihaarath kah ||
english: Cursed is attachment to household affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹ ਸਤੵਿੰ ਸੁਖਯੰ ਬਸੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g sneh satyi(n) sukhaya(n) basa(n)t naanakah ||2||
english: Only loving attachment to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is True. Nanak dwells there in peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥੵੰਤ ਦੇਹੰ ਖੀਣੰਤ ਬਲਨੰ ॥
transliteration: mithy(n)t deha(n) kheena(n)t balana(n) ||
english: The body is false; its power is temporary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਧੰਤਿ ਜਰੂਆ ਹਿਤੵੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baradha(n)t jarooaa hity(n)t maaiaa ||
english: It grows old; its love for Maya increases greatly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤੵੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਆਥਿਤੵ ਭਵਨੰ ॥
transliteration: aty(n)t aasaa aathity bhavana(n) ||
english: The human is only a temporary guest in the home of the body, but he has high hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਨੰਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਸਾ ਭੈਯਾਨ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
transliteration: gana(n)t svaasaa bhaiyaan dharama(n) ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is relentless; he counts each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤੰਤਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪ ਦੁਰਲਭੵ ਦੇਹੰ ਤਤ ਆਸ੍ਰਯੰ ਨਾਨਕ ॥
transliteration: pata(n)t moh koop duralabhy deha(n) tat aasraya(n) naanak ||
english: The human body, so difficult to obtain, has fallen into the deep dark pit of emotional attachment. O Nanak, its only support is God, the Essence of Reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gobi(n)d gobi(n)d gopaal kripaa ||3||
english: O God, Lord of the World, Lord of the Universe, Master of the Universe, please be kind to me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਟੰ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਤੋਯੰ ਲੇਪਨੰ ਰਕਤ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
transliteration: kaach kota(n) racha(n)t toya(n) lepana(n) rakat charamanah ||
english: This fragile body-fortress is made up of water, plastered with blood and wrapped in skin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵੰਤ ਦੁਆਰੰ ਭੀਤ ਰਹਿਤੰ ਬਾਇ ਰੂਪੰ ਅਸਥੰਭਨਹ ॥
transliteration: nava(n)t duaara(n) bheet rahita(n) baai roopa(n) asatha(n)bhanah ||
english: It has nine gates, but no doors; it is supported by pillars of wind, the channels of the breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੰਤਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d naama(n) nah simara(n)t agiaanee jaana(n)t asathira(n) ||
english: The ignorant person does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe; he thinks that this body is permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਉਧਰੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ॥
transliteration: duralabh deh udhara(n)t saadh saran naanak ||
english: This precious body is saved and redeemed in the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਜਪੰਤਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har har har har har hare japa(n)t ||4||
english: chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭੰਤ ਤੁਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਗੁਣਗੵੰ ਪੂਰਨੰ ਬਹੁਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: subha(n)t tuya(n) achut gunagy(n) poorana(n) bahulo kripaalaa ||
english: O Glorious, Eternal and Imperishable, Perfect and Abundantly Compassionate,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੰਭੀਰੰ ਊਚੈ ਸਰਬਗਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)bheera(n) oochai sarabag apaaraa ||
english: Profound and Unfathomable, Lofty and Exalted, All-knowing and Infinite Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਿਤਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅੰ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਚਰਣੰ ॥
transliteration: bhritiaa pria(n) bisraam charana(n) ||
english: O Lover of Your devoted servants, Your Feet are a Sanctuary of Peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: anaath naathe naanak sarana(n) ||5||
english: O Master of the masterless, Helper of the helpless, Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀ ਪੇਖੰਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇਣ ਲਖੵ ਆਵਧਹ ॥
transliteration: mrigee pekha(n)t badhik prahaaren lakhy aavadhah ||
english: Seeing the deer, the hunter aims his weapons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੋ ਜਸੵ ਰਖੇਣ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਛੇਦੵਤੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aho jasy rakhen gopaalah naanak rom na chhedyte ||6||
english: But if one is protected by the Lord of the World, O Nanak, not a hair on his head will be touched. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਲਵੰਤ ਕਾਰੀ ਸੇਵੰਤ ਸੂਰਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਿਸਹ ॥
transliteration: bahu jatan karataa balava(n)t kaaree seva(n)t sooraa chatur disah ||
english: He may be surrounded on all four sides by servants and powerful warriors;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨ ਬਸੰਤ ਊਚਹ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਮਰਣੰ ਕਦਾਂਚਹ ॥
transliteration: bikham thaan basa(n)t oochah nah simara(n)t marana(n) kadaa(n)chah ||
english: he may dwell in a lofty place, difficult to approach, and never even think of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੰਤਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਟੀ ਸਾਸ ਅਕਰਖਤੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: hova(n)t aagiaa bhagavaan purakhah naanak keetee saas akarakhate ||7||
english: But when the Order comes from the Primal Lord God, O Nanak, even an ant can take away his breath of life. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੰ ਰਤੰ ਹਿਤੰ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਰਤੰ ਕਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੁਆ ॥
transliteration: sabada(n) rata(n) hita(n) maiaa keerata(n) kalee karam krituaa ||
english: To be imbued and attuned to the Word of the Shabad; to be kind and compassionate; to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - these are the most worthwhile actions in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੰਤਿ ਤਤ੍ਰਾਗਤ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹੰ ॥
transliteration: mita(n)t tatraagat bharam moha(n) ||
english: In this way, one's inner doubts and emotional attachments are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਵਾਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਥਾਨੵਿੰ ॥
transliteration: bhagavaan ramana(n) sarabatr thaanyi(n) ||
english: God is pervading and permeating all places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਤੁਯੰ ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨੰ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: drisat tuya(n) amogh darasana(n) basa(n)t saadh rasanaa ||
english: So obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He dwells upon the tongues of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅੰ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: har har har hare naanak pria(n) jaap japanaa ||8||
english: O Nanak, meditate and chant the Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, Har, Haray. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟੰਤ ਰੂਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ ਦੀਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ ਰਵਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਗਗਨੰ ॥
transliteration: ghata(n)t roopa(n) ghata(n)t deepa(n) ghata(n)t rav saseear nakhytr gagana(n) ||
english: Beauty fades away, islands fade away, the sun, moon, stars and sky fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟੰਤ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਸਿਖੰਡੰ ॥
transliteration: ghata(n)t basudhaa gir tar sikha(n)da(n) ||
english: The earth, mountains, forests and lands fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟੰਤ ਲਲਨਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੀਤੰ ॥
transliteration: ghata(n)t lalanaa sut bhraat heeta(n) ||
english: One's spouse, children, siblings and loved friends fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟੰਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪੰ ॥
transliteration: ghata(n)t kanik maanik maaiaa svaroopa(n) ||
english: Gold and jewels and the incomparable beauty of Maya fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਘਟੰਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ॥
transliteration: nah ghata(n)t keval gopaal achut ||
english: Only the Eternal, Unchanging Lord does not fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥੯॥
transliteration: asathira(n) naanak saadh jan ||9||
english: O Nanak, only the humble Saints are steady and stable forever. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਧਰਮੰ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਪਾਪੰ ॥
transliteration: nah bila(n)b dharama(n) bila(n)b paapa(n) ||
english: Do not delay in practicing righteousness; delay in committing sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤ ਨਾਮੰ ਤਜੰਤ ਲੋਭੰ ॥
transliteration: driRa(n)t naama(n) taja(n)t lobha(n) ||
english: Implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within yourself, and abandon greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੰ ਧਰਮ ਲਖੵਿਣ ॥
transliteration: saran sa(n)ta(n) kilabikh naasa(n) praapata(n) dharam lakhyin ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, the sins are erased. The character of righteousness is received by that person,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak jih suprasa(n)n maadhavah ||10||
english: O Nanak, with whom the Lord is pleased and satisfied. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤ ਮੋਹੰ ਅਲਪ ਬੁਧੵੰ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਾਹੰ ॥
transliteration: mirat moha(n) alap budhy(n) racha(n)t banitaa binod saaha(n) ||
english: The person of shallow understanding is dying in emotional attachment; he is engrossed in pursuits of pleasure with his wife.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੌਬਨ ਬਹਿਕ੍ਰਮ ਕਨਿਕ ਕੁੰਡਲਹ ॥
transliteration: jauban bahikram kanik ku(n)dalah ||
english: With youthful beauty and golden earrings,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਸੋਭੰਤਿ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਾ ਇਤੵੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੵਾਪਿਤੰ ॥
transliteration: bachitr ma(n)dir sobha(n)t basatraa ity(n)t maaiaa byaapita(n) ||
english: wondrous mansions, decorations and clothes - this is how Maya clings to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋ ਭਗਵਾਨਏ ਨਮਹ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: he achut saran sa(n)t naanak bho bhagavaanae namah ||11||
english: O Eternal, Unchanging, Benevolent Lord God, O Sanctuary of the Saints, Nanak humbly bows to You. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣੰ ਹਰਖੰ ਤ ਸੋਗੰ ਭੋਗੰ ਤ ਰੋਗੰ ॥
transliteration: janama(n) ta marana(n) harakha(n) ta soga(n) bhoga(n) ta roga(n) ||
english: If there is birth, then there is death. If there is pleasure, then there is pain. If there is enjoyment, then there is disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੰ ਤ ਨੀਚੰ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਸੁ ਮੂਚੰ ॥
transliteration: oocha(n) ta neecha(n) naanhaa s moocha(n) ||
english: If there is high, then there is low. If there is small, then there is great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੰ ਤ ਮਾਨੰ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੰ ਤ ਹੀਨੰ ॥
transliteration: raaja(n) ta maana(n) abhimaana(n) ta heena(n) ||
english: If there is power, then there is pride. If there is egotistical pride, then there will be a fall.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਰਗੰ ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥
transliteration: pravirat maaraga(n) varata(n)t binaasana(n) ||
english: Engrossed in worldly ways, one is ruined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d bhajan saadh sa(n)gen asathira(n) naanak bhagava(n)t bhajanaasana(n) ||12||
english: Meditating and vibrating on the Lord of the Universe in the Company of the Holy, you shall become steady and stable. Nanak vibrates and meditates on the Lord God. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪੰਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ਮਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
transliteration: kirapa(n)t hareea(n) mat tat giaana(n) ||
english: By the Grace of God, genuine understanding comes to the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਸੀਧੵਿ ਬੁਧਾ ਕੁਸਲ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: bigaseedhy budhaa kusal thaana(n) ||
english: The intellect blossoms forth, and one finds a place in the realm of celestial bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੵਿੰਤ ਰਿਖਿਅੰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: basyi(n)t rikhia(n) tiaag maana(n) ||
english: The senses are brought under control, and pride is abandoned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲੰਤ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸੰਤ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
transliteration: seetala(n)t ridaya(n) driR sa(n)t giaana(n) ||
english: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the wisdom of the Saints is implanted within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: raha(n)t janama(n) har daras leenaa ||
english: Reincarnation is ended, and the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਣਾਂ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: baaja(n)t naanak sabad beenaa(n) ||13||
english: O Nanak, the musical instrument of the Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੰਤ ਬੇਦਾ ਗੁਣੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਣੰਤ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaha(n)t bedaa guna(n)t guneeaa suna(n)t baalaa bahu bidh prakaaraa ||
english: The Vedas preach and recount God's Glories; people hear them by various ways and means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤ ਸੁਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: driRa(n)t subidiaa har har kripaalaa ||
english: The Merciful Lord, Har, Har, implants spiritual wisdom within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naam daan jaacha(n)t naanak dainahaar gur gopaalaa ||14||
english: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Guru is the Great Giver, the Lord of the World. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਹ ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਲੋਕ ਕਹ ॥
transliteration: nah chi(n)taa maat pit bhraatah nah chi(n)taa kachh lok kah ||
english: Do not worry so much about your mother, father and siblings. Do not worry so much about other people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਨਬੰਧਨਹ ॥
transliteration: nah chi(n)taa banitaa sut meetah pravirat maaiaa sanaba(n)dhanah ||
english: Do not worry about your spouse, children and friends. You are obsessed with your involvements in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕਹ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: daiaal ek bhagavaan purakhah naanak sarab jee pratipaalakah ||15||
english: The One Lord God is Kind and Compassionate, O Nanak. He is the Cherisher and Nurturer of all living beings. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਵਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਚਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਆਸਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: anity vita(n) anity chita(n) anity aasaa bahu bidh prakaara(n) ||
english: Wealth is temporary; conscious existence is temporary; hopes of all sorts are temporary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਹੇਤੰ ਅਹੰ ਬੰਧੰ ਭਰਮ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲਨੰ ਬਿਕਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: anity heta(n) aha(n) ba(n)dha(n) bharam maaiaa malana(n) bikaara(n) ||
english: The bonds of love, attachment, egotism, doubt, Maya and the pollution of corruption are temporary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰੰਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਠਰਾਗਨਿ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਮਲੀਣ ਬੁਧੵੰ ॥
transliteration: phira(n)t jon anek jatharaagan nah simara(n)t maleen budhy(n) ||
english: The mortal passes through the fire of the womb of reincarnation countless times. He does not remember the Lord in meditation; his understanding is polluted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਤ ਮਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: he gobi(n)d karat maiaa naanak patit udhaaran saadh sa(n)gamah ||16||
english: O Lord of the Universe, when You grant Your Grace, even sinners are saved. Nanak dwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਤਾਲੰ ਜਲੰਤ ਦੇਦੀਪੵ ਬੈਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਰਹ ॥
transliteration: gira(n)t gir patit paataala(n) jala(n)t dedeepy baisvaa(n)tarah ||
english: You may drop down from the mountains, and fall into the nether regions of the underworld, or be burnt in the blazing fire,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੰਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਤੋਯੰ ਤਰੰਗੰ ਦੁਖੰਤ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: baha(n)t agaah toya(n) tara(n)ga(n) dukha(n)t grah chi(n)taa janama(n) ta maranah ||
english: or swept away by the unfathomable waves of water; but the worst pain of all is household anxiety, which is the source of the cycle of death and rebirth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਧਨੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: anik saadhana(n) na sidhyte naanak asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) sabad saadh svajanah ||17||
english: No matter what you do, you cannot break its bonds, O Nanak. Man's only Support, Anchor and Mainstay is the Word of the Shabad, and the Holy, Friendly Saints. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖੵੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਹਤੵੰ ਜਨਮ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੵਾਦੰ ॥
transliteration: ghor dukhy(n) anik haty(n) janam daaridra(n) mahaa bikhyaada(n) ||
english: Excruciating pain, countless killings, reincarnation, poverty and terrible misery

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਭਸਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: mita(n)t sagal simara(n)t har naam naanak jaise paavak kaasat bhasama(n) karot ||18||
english: are all destroyed by meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, O Nanak, just as fire reduces piles of wood to ashes. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar simarat prakaasa(n) gun rama(n)t agh kha(n)danah ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the darkness is illuminated. Dwelling on His Glorious Praises, the ugly sins are destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦ ਬਸੰਤਿ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਦੂਤਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਹ ॥
transliteration: rid basa(n)t bhai bheet dootah karam karat mahaa niramalah ||
english: Enshrining the Lord deep within the heart, and with the immaculate karma of doing good deeds, one strikes fear into the demons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥
transliteration: janam maran raha(n)t srotaa sukh samooh amogh darasanah ||
english: The cycle of coming and going in reincarnation is ended, absolute peace is obtained, and the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੰ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਖੇਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: saran joga(n) sa(n)t pri naanak so bhagavaan khema(n) karot ||19||
english: He is Potent to give Protection, He is the Lover of His Saints. O Nanak, the Lord God blesses all with bliss. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਣੀਵਹ ਨਿਰਾਸੰ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
transliteration: paachha(n) karot agraneevah niraasa(n) aas pooranah ||
english: Those who were left behind - the Lord brings them to the front. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਭਯੰ ਧਨਵੰਤਹ ਰੋਗੀਅੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
transliteration: niradhan bhaya(n) dhanava(n)tah rogeea(n) rog kha(n)danah ||
english: He makes the poor rich, and cures the illnesses of the ill.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੵੰ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: bhagaty(n) bhagat daana(n) raam naam gun keeratanah ||
english: He blesses His devotees with devotion. They sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿੰ ਨ ਲਭੵਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: paarabraham purakh daataarah naanak gur sevaa ki(n) na labhyte ||20||
english: O Nanak, those who serve the Guru find the Supreme Lord God, the Great Giver||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਧਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਧਾਰਣਹ ਨਿਰਧਨੰ ਧਨ ਨਾਮ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
transliteration: adhara(n) dhara(n) dhaaranah niradhana(n) dhan naam naraharah ||
english: He gives Support to the unsupported. The Name of the Lord is the Wealth of the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਬਲਹੀਣ ਬਲ ਕੇਸਵਹ ॥
transliteration: anaath naath gobi(n)dah balaheen bal kesavah ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is the Master of the masterless; the Beautiful-haired Lord is the Power of the weak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਦਯਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਦਾਮੋਦਰਹ ॥
transliteration: sarab bhoot dayaal achut deen baa(n)dhav daamodarah ||
english: The Lord is Merciful to all beings, Eternal and Unchanging, the Family of the meek and humble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਗੵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥
transliteration: sarabagy pooran purakh bhagavaanah bhagat vachhal karunaa mayah ||
english: The All-knowing, Perfect, Primal Lord God is the Lover of His devotees, the Embodiment of Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਹ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat basa(n)t baasudevah paarabraham paramesurah ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent, Luminous Lord, dwells in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੰ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: jaacha(n)t naanak kripaal prasaada(n) nah bisara(n)t nah bisara(n)t naaraainah ||21||
english: Nanak begs for this blessing from the Merciful Lord, that he may never forget Him, never forget Him. ||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸਮਰਥੰ ਨਹ ਸੇਵਕੰ ਨਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੰ ॥
transliteration: nah samaratha(n) nah sevaka(n) nah preet param purakhotama(n) ||
english: I have no power; I do not serve You, and I do not love You, O Supreme Sublime Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤੇ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: tav prasaad simarate naama(n) naanak kripaal har har gura(n) ||22||
english: By Your Grace, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har. ||22||

author: Guru Arjan
