gurmukhi: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਕਰੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਛਾਦਨ ਦੇਵੰਤ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: bharan pokhan kara(n)t jeeaa bisraam chhaadan deva(n)t daana(n) ||
english: The Lord feeds and sustains all living beings; He blesses them gifts of restful peace and fine clothes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਜੰਤ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੇਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: srija(n)t ratan janam chatur chetanah ||
english: He created the jewel of human life, with all its cleverness and intelligence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਹ ॥ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਰਚਨਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਤੇ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: varata(n)t sukh aana(n)d prasaadah || simara(n)t naanak har har hare || anity rachanaa niramoh te ||23||
english: By His Grace, mortals abide in peace and bliss. O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, Haray, The mortal is released from attachment to the world. ||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬੇਣ ਭੁੰਚੰਤੇ ਮਹੀਪਤੇ ॥
transliteration: daana(n) paraa pooraben bhu(n)cha(n)te maheepate ||
english: The kings of the earth are eating up the blessings of the good karma of their past lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਪਰੀਤ ਬੁਧੵੰ ਮਾਰਤ ਲੋਕਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੋਗਤੇ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: bipareet budhy(n) maarat lokah naanak chira(n)kaal dukh bhogate ||24||
english: Those cruel-minded rulers who oppress the people, O Nanak, shall suffer in pain for a very long time. ||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਜਸੵ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਹ ॥
transliteration: brithaa anugraha(n) gobi(n)dah jasy simaran rida(n)tarah ||
english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the Lord in their hearts, look upon even pain as God's Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰੋਗੵੰ ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੵੰ ਬਿਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੇ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: aarogy(n) mahaa rogy(n) bisimrite karunaa mayah ||25||
english: The healthy person is very sick, if he does not remember the Lord, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਣੰ ਕੇਵਲੰ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸੁਧਰਮੰ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: ramana(n) kevala(n) keeratana(n) sudharama(n) deh dhaaranah ||
english: To sing the Kirtan of God's Praises is the righteous duty incurred by taking birth in this human body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਵਤੰ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam naaraain naanak peevata(n) sa(n)t na tripyte ||26||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak. The Saints drink it in, and never have enough of it. ||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਣ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਸੵ ਦੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
transliteration: sahan seel sa(n)ta(n) sam mitrasy durajanah ||
english: The Saints are tolerant and good-natured; friends and enemies are the same to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੇਣ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਆਵਧ ਹੋਇ ਉਪਤਿਸਟਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak bhojan anik prakaaren ni(n)dak aavadh hoi upatisatate ||27||
english: O Nanak, it is all the same to them, whether someone offers them all sorts of foods, or slanders them, or draws weapons to kill them. ||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਰਸਕਾਰ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗਨਹ ॥
transliteration: tirasakaar nah bhava(n)t nah bhava(n)t maan bha(n)ganah ||
english: They pay no attention to dishonor or disrespect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਹੀਨ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੰਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਖਨਹ ॥
transliteration: sobhaa heen nah bhava(n)t nah poha(n)t sa(n)saar dukhanah ||
english: They are not bothered by gossip; the miseries of the world do not touch them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d naam japa(n)t mil saadh sa(n)gah naanak se praanee sukh baasanah ||28||
english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, those mortals abide in peace. ||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੂਰ ਅਜਿਤੰ ਸੰਨਾਹੰ ਤਨਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾਹ ॥
transliteration: sainaa saadh samooh soor ajita(n) sa(n)naaha(n) tan ni(n)mrataah ||
english: The Holy people are an invincible army of spiritual warriors; their bodies are protected by the armor of humility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਓਟ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਕਰ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
transliteration: aavadhah gun gobi(n)d ramana(n) ot gurasabad kar charamanah ||
english: Their weapons are the Glorious Praises of the Lord which they chant; their Shelter and Shield is the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰੂੜਤੇ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਰਥ ਨਾਗਹ ਬੁਝੰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗਹ ॥
transliteration: aarooRate asv rath naagah bujha(n)te prabh maaragah ||
english: The horses, chariots and elephants they ride are their way to realize God's Path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਚਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਯੰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੈਨਾ ਧਾਯੰਤੇ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: bicharate nirabhaya(n) satr sainaa dhaaya(n)te goupaal keeratanah ||
english: They walk fearlessly through the armies of their enemies; they attack them with the Kirtan of God's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਤੇ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: jitate bisv sa(n)saarah naanak vasy(n) karot pa(n)ch tasakarah ||29||
english: They conquer the entire world, O Nanak, and overpower the five thieves. ||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਗਰੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਯਾ ਰਚਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿਹ ॥
transliteration: mrig trisanaa ga(n)dharab nagara(n) drum chhaayaa rach duramatih ||
english: Misled by evil-mindedness, mortals are engrossed in the mirage of the illusory world, like the passing shade of a tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥੵਾ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਹ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: tatah kuta(n)b moh mithyaa simara(n)t naanak raam raam naamah ||30||
english: Emotional attachment to family is false, so Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਗਮੰ ਨਚ ਗੁਣਗੵ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: nach bidiaa nidhaan nigama(n) nach gunagy naam keeratanah ||
english: I do not possess the treasure of the wisdom of the Vedas, nor do I possess the merits of the Praises of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਕੰਠੰ ਨਹ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਾਤੁਰਹ ॥
transliteration: nach raag ratan ka(n)tha(n) nah cha(n)chal chatur chaaturah ||
english: I do not have a beautiful voice to sing jewelled melodies; I am not clever, wise or shrewd.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗ ਉਦਿਮ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਲ ਪੰਡਿਤਹ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: bhaag udim labadhy(n) maaiaa naanak saadhasa(n)g khal pa(n)ditah ||31||
english: By destiny and hard work, the wealth of Maya is obtained. O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even fools become religious scholars. ||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠ ਰਮਣੀਯ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲਾ ਹਸਤ ਊਚ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਧਾਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)th ramaneey raam raam maalaa hasat ooch prem dhaaranee ||
english: The mala around my neck is the chanting of the Lord's Name. The Love of the Lord is my silent chanting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਹ ਭਣਿ ਜੋ ਉਤਮ ਸਲੋਕ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਨੈਨ ਨੰਦਨੀ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: jeeh bhan jo utam salok udharana(n) nain na(n)danee ||32||
english: Chanting this most Sublime Word brings salvation and joy to the eyes. ||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਣਸੵ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਸਟਣਹ ॥
transliteration: gur ma(n)tr heenasy jo praanee dhriga(n)t janam bhrasatanah ||
english: That mortal who lacks the Guru's Mantra - cursed and contaminated is his life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂਕਰਹ ਸੂਕਰਹ ਗਰਧਭਹ ਕਾਕਹ ਸਰਪਨਹ ਤੁਲਿ ਖਲਹ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: kookarah sookarah garadhabhah kaakah sarapanah tul khalah ||33||
english: That blockhead is just a dog, a pig, a jackass, a crow, a snake. ||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨੰ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: charanaarabi(n)d bhajana(n) ridaya(n) naam dhaaranah ||
english: Whoever contemplates the Lord's Lotus Feet, and enshrines His Name within the heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਨਹ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: keeratana(n) saadhasa(n)gen naanak nah drisata(n)t jamadootanah ||34||
english: and sings the Kirtan of His Praises in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, shall never see the Messenger of Death. ||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਧਨੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
transliteration: nach duralabha(n) dhana(n) roopa(n) nach duralabha(n) svarag raajanah ||
english: Wealth and beauty are not so difficult to obtain. Paradise and royal power are not so difficult to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਭੋਜਨੰ ਬਿੰਜਨੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਅੰਬਰਹ ॥
transliteration: nach duralabha(n) bhojana(n) bi(n)jana(n) nach duralabha(n) svachh a(n)barah ||
english: Foods and delicacies are not so difficult to obtain. Elegant clothes are not so difficuilt to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸੁਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸਹ ॥
transliteration: nach duralabha(n) sut mitr bhraat baa(n)dhav nach duralabha(n) banitaa bilaasah ||
english: Children, friends, siblings and relatives are not so difficult to obtain. The pleasures of woman are not so difficult to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਣੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੰਚਲਹ ॥
transliteration: nach duralabha(n) bidiaa prabeena(n) nach duralabha(n) chatur cha(n)chalah ||
english: Knowledge and wisdom are not so difficult to obtain. Cleverness and trickery are not so difficult to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਨਾਮਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵਿੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: duralabha(n) ek bhagavaan naamah naanak labadhyi(n) saadhasa(n)g kripaa prabha(n) ||35||
english: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is difficult to obtain. O Nanak, it is only obtained by God's Grace, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤਹ ਤਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਮਰਤ ਪਯਾਲ ਲੋਕਹ ॥
transliteration: jat katah tatah drisata(n) svarag marat payaal lokah ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, whether in this world, in paradise, or the nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: sarabatr ramana(n) gobi(n)dah naanak lep chhep na lipyte ||36||
english: The Lord of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਯਾ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟਾਂ ਸਖਾ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥
transliteration: bikhayaa bhaya(n)t a(n)mrita(n) drusataa(n) sakhaa svajanah ||
english: Poison is transformed into nectar, and enemies into friends and companions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੰ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਸੁਖੵੰ ਭੈ ਭੀਤੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਯਹ ॥
transliteration: dukha(n) bhaya(n)t sukhy(n) bhai bheeta(n) ta nirabhayah ||
english: Pain is changed into pleasure, and the fearful become fearless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਹ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: thaan bihoon bisraam naama(n) naanak kripaal har har gurah ||37||
english: Those who have no home or place find their place of rest in the Naam, O Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੀਲ ਮਮੰ ਸੀਲੰ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਮ ਪਾਵਨਹ ॥
transliteration: sarab seel mama(n) seela(n) sarab paavan mam paavanah ||
english: He blesses all with humility; He has blessed me with humility as well. He purifies all, and He has purified me as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਰਤਬ ਮਮੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: sarab karatab mama(n) karataa naanak lep chhep na lipyte ||38||
english: The Creator of all is the Creator of me as well. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਵਹ ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
transliteration: nah seetala(n) cha(n)dr devah nah seetala(n) baavan cha(n)danah ||
english: The moon-god is not cool and calm, nor is the white sandalwood tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸੀਤ ਰੁਤੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: nah seetala(n) seet ruten naanak seetala(n) saadh svajanah ||39||
english: The winter season is not cool; O Nanak, only the Holy friends, the Saints, are cool and calm. ||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)tra(n) raam raam naama(n) dhyaana(n) sarabatr pooranah ||
english: Through the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one meditates on the All-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੵਾਨੰ ਸਮ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖੰ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: gyaana(n) sam dukh sukha(n) jugat niramal niravairanah ||
english: Those who have the wisdom to look alike upon pleasure and pain, live the immaculate lifestyle, free of vengeance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਯਾਲੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਵਰਜਿਤਹ ॥
transliteration: dayaala(n) sarabatr jeeaa pa(n)ch dokh bivarajitah ||
english: They are kind to all beings; they have overpowered the five thieves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਯਾ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਰਹਤਹ ॥
transliteration: bhojana(n) gopaal keeratana(n) alap maayaa jal kamal rahatah ||
english: They take the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise as their food; they remain untouched by Maya, like the lotus in the water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥
transliteration: upadesa(n) sam mitr satrah bhagava(n)t bhagat bhaavanee ||
english: They share the Teachings with friend and enemy alike; they love the devotional worship of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਹ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਆਪੁ ਤੵਿਾਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਣੁਕਹ ॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa nah srot sravana(n) aap tyiaag sagal renukah ||
english: They do not listen to slander; renouncing self-conceit, they become the dust of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਲਖੵਣ ਪੂਰਨੰ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: khat lakhyn poorana(n) purakhah naanak naam saadh svajanah ||40||
english: Whoever has these six qualities, O Nanak, is called a Holy friend. ||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾ ਭੋਗੰਤ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੰ ਬਸੰਤੇ ਸਮੀਪਿ ਕੇਹਰਹ ॥
transliteration: ajaa bhoga(n)t ka(n)d moola(n) basa(n)te sameep keharah ||
english: The goat enjoys eating fruits and roots, but if it lives near a tiger, it is always anxious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤ੍ਰ ਗਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਬਿਆਪਤੇ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: tatr gate sa(n)saarah naanak sog harakha(n) biaapate ||41||
english: This is the condition of the world, O Nanak; it is afflicted by pleasure and pain. ||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨੰ ਅਪਰਾਧੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਮਲੰ ॥
transliteration: chhala(n) chhidra(n) kot bighana(n) aparaadha(n) kilabikh mala(n) ||
english: Fraud, false accusations, millions of diseases, sins and the filthy residues of evil mistakes;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹੰ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨੰ ਮਦੰ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਆਪਿਤੰ ॥
transliteration: bharam moha(n) maan apamaana(n) mada(n) maayaa biaapita(n) ||
english: doubt, emotional attachment, pride, dishonor and intoxication with Maya

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਤੵੁ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਨਰਕਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ॥
transliteration: mrity janam bhrama(n)t narakah anik upaava(n) na sidhyte ||
english: these lead mortals to death and rebirth, wandering lost in hell. In spite of all sorts of efforts, salvation is not found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: niramala(n) saadh sa(n)gah japa(n)t naanak gopaal naama(n) ||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, mortals become immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮੰਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਹ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: rama(n)t gun gobi(n)d nit pratah ||42||
english: They continually dwell upon the Glorious Praises of God. ||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਣ ਸੀਲ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
transliteration: taran saran suaamee raman seel paramesurah ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Kind-hearted Lord, our Transcendent Lord and Master, we are carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਹ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarathah daan det prabh pooranah ||
english: God is the Perfect, All-powerful Cause of causes; He is the Giver of gifts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਸ ਆਸ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਗਲ ਅਰਥ ਆਲਯਹ ॥
transliteration: niraas aas karana(n) sagal arath aalayah ||
english: He gives hope to the hopeless. He is the Source of all riches.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਜਾਚਿਕਹ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan simara(n)t naanak sagal jaacha(n)t jaachikah ||43||
english: Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Treasure of Virtue; we are all beggars, begging at His Door. ||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਗਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸੁਗਮੰ ਮਹਾ ਦੂਖ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖਣਹ ॥
transliteration: duragam sathaan sugama(n) mahaa dookh sarab sookhanah ||
english: The most difficult place becomes easy, and the worst pain turns into pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਬਚਨ ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮੰ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਿਸਨੰ ਤ ਸੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
transliteration: durabachan bhed bharama(n) saakat pisana(n) ta surajanah ||
english: Evil words, differences and doubts are obliterated, and even faithless cynics and malicious gossips become good people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਤੰ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਭੈ ਖੀਣੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਵਹ ॥
transliteration: asathita(n) sog harakha(n) bhai kheena(n) ta nirabhavah ||
english: They become steady and stable, whether happy or sad; their fears are taken away, and they are fearless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਅਟਵੀਅੰ ਮਹਾ ਨਗਰ ਬਾਸੰ ਧਰਮ ਲਖੵਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhai ataveea(n) mahaa nagar baasa(n) dharam lakhyn prabh maiaa ||
english: The dreadful woods become a well-populated city; such are the merits of the righteous life of Dharma, given by God's Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਯਾਲ ਚਰਣੰ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: saadh sa(n)gam raam raam ramana(n) saran naanak har har dayaal charana(n) ||44||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, the Lotus Feet of the Merciful Lord are found. ||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਜਿਤ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਅਤਿ ਬਲਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
transliteration: he ajit soor sa(n)graama(n) at balanaa bahu maradanah ||
english: O emotional attachment, you are the invincible warrior of the battlefield of life; you totally crush and destroy even the most powerful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਦੇਵ ਮਾਨੁਖੵੰ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਮੋਹਨਹ ॥
transliteration: gan ga(n)dharab dev maanukhy(n) pas pa(n)khee bimohanah ||
english: You entice and fascinate even the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, gods, mortals, beasts and birds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: har karanahaara(n) namasakaara(n) saran naanak jagadeesvarah ||45||
english: Nanak bows in humble surrender to the Lord; he seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe. ||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਕਾਮੰ ਨਰਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
transliteration: he kaama(n) narak bisraama(n) bahu jonee bhramaavanah ||
english: O sexual desire, you lead the mortals to hell; you make them wander in reincarnation through countless species.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਹਰਣੰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਗੰਮੵੰ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੀਲ ਬਿਦਾਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: chit harana(n) trai lok ga(n)my(n) jap tap seel bidaaranah ||
english: You cheat the consciousness, and pervade the three worlds. You destroy meditation, penance and virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਅਵਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
transliteration: alap sukh avit cha(n)chal ooch neech samaavanah ||
english: But you give only shallow pleasure, while you make the mortals weak and unsteady; you pervade the high and the low.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਵ ਭੈ ਬਿਮੁੰਚਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੪੬॥
transliteration: tav bhai bimu(n)chit saadh sa(n)gam ot naanak naaraainah ||46||
english: Your fear is dispelled in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, through the Protection and Support of the Lord. ||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਕਲਿ ਮੂਲ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ਕਦੰਚ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨ ਉਪਰਜਤੇ ॥
transliteration: he kal mool krodha(n) kada(n)ch karunaa na uparajate ||
english: O anger, you are the root of conflict; compassion never rises up in you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਯੰਤ ਜੀਵੰ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਨਿਰਤੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਜਥਾ ਮਰਕਟਹ ॥
transliteration: bikhaya(n)t jeeva(n) vasy(n) karot niraty(n) karot jathaa marakatah ||
english: You take the corrupt, sinful beings in your power, and make them dance like monkeys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਨ ਤਾੜੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਹ ਤਵ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਧਮੰ ਨਰਹ ॥
transliteration: anik saasan taaRa(n)t jamadootah tav sa(n)ge adhama(n) narah ||
english: Associating with you, mortals are debased and punished by the Messenger of Death in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਰਖੵਾ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੪੭॥
transliteration: deen dukh bha(n)jan dayaal prabh naanak sarab jee rakhyaa karot ||47||
english: O Destroyer of the pains of the poor, O Merciful God, Nanak prays for You to protect all begins from such anger. ||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਲੋਭਾ ਲੰਪਟ ਸੰਗ ਸਿਰਮੋਰਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਕਲੋਲਤੇ ॥
transliteration: he lobhaa la(n)pat sa(n)g siramorah anik laharee kalolate ||
english: O greed, you cling to even the great, assaulting them with countless waves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਡੋਲਤੇ ॥
transliteration: dhaava(n)t jeeaa bahu prakaara(n) anik bhaa(n)t bahu dolate ||
english: You cause them to run around wildly in all directions, wobbling and wavering unsteadily.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਚ ਇਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਬਾਧਵ ਨਚ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਵ ਲਜਯਾ ॥
transliteration: nach mitra(n) nach isata(n) nach baadhav nach maat pitaa tav lajayaa ||
english: You have no respect for friends, ideals, relations, mother or father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਰਣੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਖਾਦੵਿ ਖਾਦੵੰ ਅਸਾਜੵੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਜਯਾ ॥
transliteration: akarana(n) karot akhaady khaady(n) asaajy(n) saaj samajayaa ||
english: You make them do what they should not do. You make them eat what they should not eat. You make them accomplish what they should not accomplish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਗੵਾਪ੍ਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥੪੮॥
transliteration: traahi traahi saran suaamee bigyaapt naanak har naraharah ||48||
english: Save me, save me - I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Nanak prays to the Lord. ||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੂਲੰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੰ ਪਾਪਾਤਮਾ ॥
transliteration: he janam maran moola(n) aha(n)kaara(n) paapaatamaa ||
english: O egotism, you are the root of birth and death and the cycle of reincarnation; you are the very soul of sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਤਜੰਤਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਤੀਰਨਹ ॥
transliteration: mitra(n) taja(n)t satra(n) driRa(n)t anik maayaa bisteeranah ||
english: You forsake friends, and hold tight to enemies. You spread out countless illusions of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵੰਤ ਜਾਵੰਤ ਥਕੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗਣਹ ॥
transliteration: aava(n)t jaava(n)t thaka(n)t jeeaa dukh sukh bahu bhoganah ||
english: You cause the living beings to come and go until they are exhausted. You lead them to experience pain and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਯਾਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhayaan udiaan ramana(n) mahaa bikat asaadh roganah ||
english: You lead them to wander lost in the terrible wilderness of doubt; you lead them to contract the most horrible, incurable diseases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਦੵੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪੯॥
transliteration: baidy(n) paarabraham paramesvar aaraadh naanak har har hare ||49||
english: The only Physician is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God. Nanak worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਗਦ ਗੁਰੋ ॥
transliteration: he praan naath gobi(n)dah kripaa nidhaan jagad guro ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, Master of the Breath of life, Treasure of Mercy, Guru of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਣਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੋ ॥
transliteration: he sa(n)saar taap haranah karunaa mai sabh dukh haro ||
english: O Destroyer of the fever of the world, Embodiment of Compassion, please take away all my pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਮਯਾ ਕਰੋ ॥
transliteration: he saran jog dayaalah deenaa naath mayaa karo ||
english: O Merciful Lord, Potent to give Sanctuary, Master of the meek and humble, please be kind to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰ ਸ੍ਵਸਥ ਖੀਣ ਸਮਏ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੫੦॥
transliteration: sareer svasath kheen samae simara(n)t naanak raam daamodar maadhavah ||50||
english: Whether his body is healthy or sick, let Nanak meditate in remembrance on You, Lord. ||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣੰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal sarana(n) ramana(n) gopaal keeratanah ||
english: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet, where I sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਤਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥੫੧॥
transliteration: saadh sa(n)gen tarana(n) naanak mahaa saagar bhai dutarah ||51||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak is carried across the utterly terrifying, difficult world-ocean. ||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਮਸ੍ਤਕ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਾਯਾ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
transliteration: sir mastak rakhyaa paarabrahama(n) hast kaayaa rakhyaa paramesvarah ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has procted my head and forehead; the Transcendent Lord has protected my hands and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਨ ਚਰਣ ਰਖੵਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
transliteration: aatam rakhyaa gopaal suaamee dhan charan rakhyaa jagadeesvarah ||
english: God, my Lord and Master, has saved my soul; the Lord of the Universe has saved my wealth and feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਭੈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨਹ ॥
transliteration: sarab rakhyaa gur dayaalah bhai dookh binaasanah ||
english: The Merciful Guru has protected everything, and destroyed my fear and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤਹ ॥੫੨॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal anaath naathe saran naanak purakh achutah ||52||
english: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Master of the masterless. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Imperishable Primal Lord God. ||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਆਕਾਸੰ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੰ ਕਾਸਟ ਬੇਸਟੰ ॥
transliteration: jen kalaa dhaario aakaasa(n) baisa(n)tara(n) kaasat besata(n) ||
english: His Power supports the sky, and locks fire within wood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਤੵਿੰ ਸਾਸੰ ਸਰੀਰ ਧਾਰਣੰ ॥
transliteration: jen kalaa sas soor nakhytr jotyi(n) saasa(n) sareer dhaarana(n) ||
english: His Power supports the moon, the sun and the stars, and infuses light and breath into the body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੰ ਨਹ ਛੇਦੰਤ ਜਠਰ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
transliteration: jen kalaa maat garabh pratipaala(n) nah chheda(n)t jathar roganah ||
english: His Power provides nourishment in the womb of the mother, and does not let disease strike.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਰੋਵਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਛਿਜੰਤਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੋਯਣਹ ॥੫੩॥
transliteration: ten kalaa asatha(n)bha(n) sarovara(n) naanak nah chhija(n)t tara(n)g toyanah ||53||
english: His Power holds back the ocean, O Nanak, and does not allow the waves of water to destroy the land. ||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਸਾਂਈ ਗਰਿਸ੍ਟ ਰੂਪੇਣ ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਵਣਹ ॥
transliteration: gusaa(n)ee garist roopen simarana(n) sarabatr jeevanah ||
english: The Lord of the World is Supremely Beautiful; His Meditation is the Life of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਬਧੵੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਮਾਰਗ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਣਹ ॥੫੪॥
transliteration: labadhy(n) sa(n)t sa(n)gen naanak svachh maarag har bhagatanah ||54||
english: In the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, He is found on the path of devotional worship of the Lord. ||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਸਕੰ ਭਗਨੰਤ ਸੈਲੰ ਕਰਦਮੰ ਤਰੰਤ ਪਪੀਲਕਹ ॥
transliteration: masaka(n) bhagana(n)t saila(n) karadama(n) tara(n)t papeelakah ||
english: The mosquito pierces the stone, the ant crosses the swamp,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਲੰਘੰਤਿ ਪਿੰਗੰ ਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਅੰਧਕਹ ॥
transliteration: saagara(n) la(n)gha(n)t pi(n)ga(n) tam paragaas a(n)dhakah ||
english: the cripple crosses the ocean, and the blind sees in the darkness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੫੫॥
transliteration: saadh sa(n)gen simara(n)t gobi(n)d saran naanak har har hare ||55||
english: meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਾ ਅਮਰ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
transliteration: tilak heena(n) jathaa bipraa amar heena(n) jathaa raajanah ||
english: Like a Brahmin without a sacred mark on his forehead, or a king without the power of command,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਧ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਸੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਰਮ ਹੀਣੰ ਤਥਾ ਬੈਸ੍ਨਵਹ ॥੫੬॥
transliteration: aavadh heena(n) jathaa sooraa naanak dharam heena(n) tathaa baisnavah ||56||
english: or a warrior without weapons, so is the devotee of God without Dharmic Faith. ||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨ ਸੰਖੰ ਨ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਗਦਾ ਨ ਸਿਆਮੰ ॥
transliteration: na sa(n)kha(n) na chakra(n) na gadaa na siaama(n) ||
english: God has no conch-shell, no religious mark, no paraphernalia; he does not have blue skin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸ੍ਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੰ ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ॥
transliteration: ascharaj roopa(n) raha(n)t janama(n) ||
english: His Form is Wondrous and Amazing. He is beyond incarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਥੰਤਿ ਬੇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: net net katha(n)t bedaa ||
english: The Vedas say that He is not this, and not that.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ॥
transliteration: ooch mooch apaar gobi(n)dah ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is Lofty and High, Great and Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਬੁਝੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਅਹ ॥੫੭॥
transliteration: basa(n)t saadh ridaya(n) achut bujha(n)t naanak badabhaageeah ||57||
english: The Imperishable Lord abides in the hearts of the Holy. He is understood, O Nanak, by those who are very fortunate. ||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਸਨੰ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਿਆਲ ਖਰਹ ॥
transliteration: udiaan basana(n) sa(n)saara(n) sanaba(n)dhee svaan siaal kharah ||
english: Living in the world, it is like a wild jungle. One's relatives are like dogs, jackals and donkeys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦਿਰੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥
transliteration: bikham sathaan man moh madira(n) mahaa(n) asaadh pa(n)ch tasakarah ||
english: In this difficult place, the mind is intoxicated with the wine of emotional attachment; the five unconquered thieves lurk there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੀਤ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੰ ਅਹੰ ਫਾਂਸ ਤੀਖੵਣ ਕਠਿਨਹ ॥
transliteration: heet moh bhai bharam bhramana(n) aha(n) phaa(n)s teekhyn kathinah ||
english: The mortals wander lost in love and emotional attachment, fear and doubt; they are caught in the sharp, strong noose of egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕ ਤੋਅ ਅਸਾਧ ਘੋਰੰ ਅਗਮ ਤੀਰ ਨਹ ਲੰਘਨਹ ॥
transliteration: paavak to asaadh ghora(n) agam teer nah la(n)ghanah ||
english: The ocean of fire is terrifying and impassable. The distant shore is so far away; it cannot be reached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਉਧਰਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ॥੫੮॥
transliteration: bhaj saadhasa(n)g goupaal naanak har charan saran udharan kripaa ||58||
english: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; O Nanak, by His Grace, we are saved at the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||58||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੰਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਸਗਲੵੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kara(n)t gobi(n)d gopaalah sagaly(n) rog kha(n)danah ||
english: When the Lord of the Universe grants His Grace, all illnesses are cured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੫੯॥
transliteration: saadh sa(n)gen gun ramat naanak saran pooran paramesurah ||59||
english: Nanak chants His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, in the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord God. ||59||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਮਲੰ ਮਧੁਰ ਮਾਨੁਖੵੰ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਭੂਮਿ ਵੈਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: siaamala(n) madhur maanukhy(n) ridaya(n) bhoom vairanah ||
english: The mortal is beautiful and speaks sweet words, but in the farm of his heart, he harbors cruel vengeance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵੰਤਿ ਹੋਵੰਤਿ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚੇਤਨੰ ਸੰਤ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੬੦॥
transliteration: niva(n)t hova(n)t mithiaa chetana(n) sa(n)t svajanah ||60||
english: He pretends to bow in worship, but he is false. Beware of him, O friendly Saints. ||60||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜਾ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤ ਘਟੰਤ ਸਾਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: achet mooRaa na jaana(n)t ghata(n)t saasaa nit prate ||
english: The thoughtless fool does not know that each day, his breaths are being used up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਿਜੰਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕਾਲ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਤੇ ॥
transliteration: chhija(n)t mahaa su(n)daree kaa(n)iaa kaal ka(n)niaa graasate ||
english: His most beautiful body is wearing away; old age, the daughter of death, has seized it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਲੀਲਾ ਅਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਨੋਦ ॥
transliteration: racha(n)t purakhah kuta(n)b leelaa anit aasaa bikhiaa binod ||
english: He is engrossed in family play; placing his hopes in transitory things, he indulges in corrupt pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥੬੧॥
transliteration: bhrama(n)t bhrama(n)t bahu janam haario saran naanak karunaa mayah ||61||
english: Wandering lost in countless incarnations, he is exhausted. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Embodiment of Mercy. ||61||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਬੇ ਹੇ ਰਸਗੇ ਮਧੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੁਯੰ ॥
transliteration: he jihabe he rasage madhur pri tuya(n) ||
english: O tongue, you love to enjoy the sweet delicacies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਹਤੰ ਪਰਮ ਬਾਦੰ ਅਵਰਤ ਏਥਹ ਸੁਧ ਅਛਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: sat hata(n) param baada(n) avarat ethah sudh achharanah ||
english: You are dead to the Truth, and involved in great disputes. Instead, repeat the holy words:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧਵੇ ॥੬੨॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d daamodar maadhave ||62||
english: Gobind, Daamodar, Maadhav. ||62||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੰਤਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਦੋਨ ਮਤੰ ॥
transliteration: garaba(n)t naaree madon mata(n) ||
english: Those who are proud, and intoxicated with the pleasures of sex,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਵੰਤ ਬਲਾਤ ਕਾਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: balava(n)t balaat kaaranah ||
english: and asserting their power over others,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਹ ਭਜੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਨਮਨਹ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal nah bhaja(n)t trin samaan dhrig janamanah ||
english: never contemplate the Lord's Lotus Feet. Their lives are cursed, and as worthless as straw.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਪਪੀਲਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਟੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਯੰ ਧਨੇ ॥
transliteration: he papeelakaa grasate gobi(n)d simaran tuya(n) dhane ||
english: You are as tiny and insignificant as an ant, but you shall become great, by the Wealth of the Lord's Meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਨਮੋ ਨਮਹ ॥੬੩॥
transliteration: naanak anik baar namo namah ||63||
english: Nanak bows in humble worship, countless times, over and over again. ||63||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੰ ਤ ਮੇਰੰ ਸਹਕੰ ਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ॥
transliteration: trina(n) ta mera(n) sahaka(n) ta hareea(n) ||
english: The blade of grass becomes a mountain, and the barren land becomes green.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡੰ ਤ ਤਰੀਅੰ ਊਣੰ ਤ ਭਰੀਅੰ ॥
transliteration: booda(n) ta tareea(n) oona(n) ta bhareea(n) ||
english: The drowning one swims across, and the empty is filled to overflowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਜਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar kot soor ujaara(n) ||
english: Millions of suns illuminate the darkness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਰੰ ॥੬੪॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak har gur dayaara(n) ||64||
english: prays Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||64||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਜਿ ਪੂਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: brahamanah sa(n)g udharana(n) braham karam j pooranah ||
english: Associating with the Brahmin, one is saved, if his actions are perfect and God-like.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਤੰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਗਹੰ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਫਲਹ ॥੬੫॥
transliteration: aatam rata(n) sa(n)saar gaha(n) te nar naanak nihaphalah ||65||
english: Those whose souls are imbued with the world - O Nanak, their lives are fruitless. ||65||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਹਿਰਣੰ ਬਹੁ ਵਿਘਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਉਚਰਣੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਕਹ ॥
transliteration: par darab hirana(n) bahu vighan karana(n) ucharana(n) sarab jee kah ||
english: The mortal steals the wealth of others, and makes all sorts of problems; his preaching is only for his own livelihood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਉ ਲਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਤਿਪਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਏ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਸਿ ਸੂਕਰਹ ॥੬੬॥
transliteration: lau laee trisanaa atipat man maae karam karat s sookarah ||66||
english: His desire for this and that is not satisfied; his mind is caught in Maya, and he is acting like a pig. ||66||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤੇ ਸਮੇਵ ਚਰਣੰ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥
transliteration: mate samev charana(n) udharana(n) bhai dutarah ||
english: Those who are intoxicated and absorbed in the Lord's Lotus Feet are saved from the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਹਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਨ ਸੰਸਯਹ ॥੬੭॥੪॥
transliteration: anek paatik harana(n) naanak saadh sa(n)gam na sa(n)sayah ||67||4||
english: Countless sins are destroyed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; there is no doubt about this. ||67||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 gaathaa ||
english: Fifth Mehl, Gaat'haa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਪੂਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਸੁਗੰਧਾ ਪਰਸ ਮਾਨੁਖੵ ਦੇਹੰ ਮਲੀਣੰ ॥
transliteration: karapoor puhap suga(n)dhaa paras maanukhy deha(n) maleena(n) ||
english: Camphor, flowers and perfume become contaminated, by coming into contact with the human body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਜਾ ਰੁਧਿਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਥਿ ਗਰਬੇਣ ਅਗੵਾਨਣੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: majaa rudhir druga(n)dhaa naanak ath garaben agyaanano ||1||
english: O Nanak, the ignorant one is proud of his foul-smelling marrow, blood and bones. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਾਣੋ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਆਕਾਸਹ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਸਿਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
transliteration: paramaano paraja(n)t aakaasah deep lo sikha(n)danah ||
english: Even if the mortal could reduce himself to the size of an atom, and shoot through the ethers,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਛੇਣ ਨੈਣ ਭਾਰੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gachhen nain bhaaren naanak binaa saadhoo na sidhyte ||2||
english: Worlds and realms in the blink of an eye, O Nanak, without the Holy Saint, he shall not be saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੋ ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵੰਤੋ ਮਰਣੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਣ ਮਿਥਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jaano sat hova(n)to marano drisaten mithiaa ||
english: Know for sure that death will come; whatever is seen is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਚਲੰਥੋ ਭਣੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ॥੩॥
transliteration: keerat saath chala(n)tho bhana(n)t naanak saadh sa(n)gen ||3||
english: So chant the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; this alone shall go along with you in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਯਾ ਚਿਤ ਭਰਮੇਣ ਇਸਟ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੇਖੁ ਬਾਂਧਵਹ ॥
transliteration: maayaa chit bharamen isat mitrekh baa(n)dhavah ||
english: The consciousness wanders lost in Maya, attached to friends and relatives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਬਧੵੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਅਸਥਾਨੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਜਣੰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: labadhy(n) saadh sa(n)gen naanak sukh asathaana(n) gopaal bhajana(n) ||4||
english: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, the eternal place of rest is found. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਿ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
transliteration: mailaagar sa(n)gen ni(n)m birakh s cha(n)danah ||
english: The lowly nim tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes just like the sandalwood tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੰਤੋ ਬਾਂਸੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੋਹਤੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nikat basa(n)to baa(n)so naanak aha(n) budh na bohate ||5||
english: But the bamboo tree, also growing near it, does not pick up its fragrance; it is too tall and proud. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਥਾ ਗੁੰਫ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕਥੰ ਮਥੰ ਮਾਨ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
transliteration: gaathaa gu(n)ph gopaal katha(n) matha(n) maan maradanah ||
english: In this Gaat'haa, the Lord's Sermon is woven; listening to it, pride is crushed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਤੰ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ੍ਰੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਣਹ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hata(n) pa(n)ch satren naanak har baane prahaaranah ||6||
english: The five enemies are killed, O Nanak, by shooting the Arrow of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਲਹੰਥਾ ਬਡ ਕਰਮਣਹ ॥
transliteration: bachan saadh sukh pa(n)thaa laha(n)thaa bad karamanah ||
english: The Words of the Holy are the path of peace. They are obtained by good karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹੰਤਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੇਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥੭॥
transliteration: raha(n)taa janam maranen ramana(n) naanak har keeratanah ||7||
english: The cycle of birth and death is ended, O Nanak, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤ੍ਰ ਭੁਰਿਜੇਣ ਝੜੀਯੰ ਨਹ ਜੜੀਅੰ ਪੇਡ ਸੰਪਤਾ ॥
transliteration: patr bhurijen jhaReeya(n) nah jaReea(n) ped sa(n)pataa ||
english: When the leaves wither and fall, they cannot be attached to the branch again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣ ਬਿਖਮਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੰਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਰੈਣੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naam bihoon bikhamataa naanak baha(n)t jon baasaro rainee ||8||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, there is misery and suffering. The mortal wanders in reincarnation day and night. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਲਭੰਤੰ ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ ॥
transliteration: bhaavanee saadh sa(n)gen labha(n)ta(n) bad bhaaganah ||
english: One is blessed with love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪਣਹ ॥੯॥
transliteration: har naam gun ramana(n) naanak sa(n)saar saagar nah biaapanah ||9||
english: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is not affected by the world-ocean. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਥਾ ਗੂੜ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਸਮਝਣੰ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਨਹ ॥
transliteration: gaathaa gooR apaara(n) samajhana(n) biralaa janah ||
english: This Gaat'haa is profound and infinite; how rare are those who understand it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਾਮ ਤਜਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar kaam tajana(n) naanak gobi(n)d ramana(n) saadh sa(n)gamah ||10||
english: They forsake sexual desire and worldly love, O Nanak, and praise the Lord in the Saadh Sangat. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨਹ ॥
transliteration: suma(n)tr saadh bachanaa kot dokh binaasanah ||
english: The Words of the Holy are the most sublime Mantra. They eradicate millions of sinful mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: har charan kamal dhyaana(n) naanak kul samooh udhaaranah ||11||
english: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, O Nanak, all one's generations are saved. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੈਣਹ ਜੇਣ ਮਧੵ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar ma(n)dar sainah jen madhy har keeratanah ||
english: That palace is beautiful, in which the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਰਮਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: mukate raman gobi(n)dah naanak labadhy(n) bad bhaaganah ||12||
english: Those who dwell on the Lord of the Universe are liberated. O Nanak, only the most fortunate are so blessed. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਲਬਧੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਮਿਤੋ ॥
transliteration: har labadho mitr sumito ||
english: I have found the Lord, my Friend, my very Best Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਾਰਣ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚਿਤੋ ॥
transliteration: bidaaran kade na chito ||
english: He shall never break my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅਸਥਲੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਮਿਤੋ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa asathal tol amito ||
english: His dwelling is eternal; His weight cannot be weighed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋੁਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਖਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਤੋ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: souee naanak sakhaa jee sa(n)g kito ||13||
english: Nanak has made Him the Friend of his soul. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਜਸੰ ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਹ ॥ ਸਿਮਰਤਬੵ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: apajasa(n) mita(n)t sat putrah || simarataby ridai gur ma(n)tranah ||
english: One's bad reputation is erased by a true son, Who meditates in his heart on the Guru's Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਅਚੁਤ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਣਹ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: preetam bhagavaan achut || naanak sa(n)saar saagar taaranah ||14||
english: The Beloved Eternal Lord God, O Nanak, carries us across the world-ocean. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੰ ਬਿਸਰਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ॥ ਜੀਵਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੵਾਵਣਹ ॥
transliteration: marana(n) bisarana(n) gobi(n)dah || jeevana(n) har naam dhyaavanah ||
english: It is death to forget the Lord of the Universe. It is life to meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਭਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਣਹ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: labhana(n) saadh sa(n)gen || naanak har poorab likhanah ||15||
english: The Lord is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, by pre-ordained destiny. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਭੁਯੰਗੰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਗਾਰੁੜੀ ਨਿਵਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: dasan bihoon bhuya(n)ga(n) ma(n)tra(n) gaaruRee nivaara(n) ||
english: The snake-charmer, by his spell, neutralizes the poison and leaves the snake without fangs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੵਾਧਿ ਉਪਾੜਣ ਸੰਤੰ ॥
transliteration: byaadh upaaRan sa(n)ta(n) ||
english: Just so, the Saints remove suffering;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧ ਕਰਮਣਹ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak labadh karamanah ||16||
english: O Nanak, they are found by good karma. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਥ ਕਥ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਅਣਹ ॥
transliteration: jath kath ramana(n) sarana(n) sarabatr jeeanah ||
english: The Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He gives Sanctuary to all living beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਥ ਲਗਣੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ ॥ ਪਰਸਾਦੰ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: tath lagana(n) prem naanak || parasaada(n) gur darasanah ||17||
english: The mind is touched by His Love, O Nanak, By Guru's Grace, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਮਨ ਬਿਧੵੰ ॥ ਸਿਧੵੰ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲਣਹ ॥
transliteration: charanaarabi(n)d man bidhy(n) || sidhy(n) sarab kusalanah ||
english: My mind is pierced through by the Lord's Lotus Feet. I am blessed with total happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਥਾ ਗਾਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਬੵੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਣਹ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: gaathaa gaava(n)t naanak bhaby(n) paraa poorabanah ||18||
english: Holy people have been singing this Gaat'haa, O Nanak, since the very beginning of time. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਗਵਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਉਧਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: subh bachan ramana(n) gavana(n) saadh sa(n)gen udharanah ||
english: Chanting and singing the Sublime Word of God in the Saadh Sangat, mortals are saved from the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਲਭੵਤੇ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagara(n) naanak punarap janam na labhyte ||19||
english: O Nanak, they shall never again be consigned to reincarnation. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan saasatr beechaara(n) ||
english: People contemplate the Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਮ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: eka(n)kaar naam ur dhaara(n) ||
english: But by enshrining in their hearts the Naam, the Name of the One and Only Creator of the Universe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: kulah samooh sagal udhaara(n) ||
english: everyone can be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਤਾਰੰ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: badabhaagee naanak ko taara(n) ||20||
english: By great good fortune, O Nanak, a few cross over like this. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੰ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਣਹ ॥
transliteration: simarana(n) gobi(n)d naama(n) udharana(n) kul samoohanah ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of Lord of the Universe, all one's generations are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਬਧਿਅੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਭੇਟੰਤਿ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: labadhia(n) saadh sa(n)gen naanak vadabhaagee bheta(n)t darasanah ||21||
english: It is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is seen. ||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੰਤਿਆਗੀ ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤਣਃ ॥
transliteration: sarab dokh para(n)tiaagee sarab dharam driRa(n)tanah ||
english: Abandon all your evil habits, and implant all Dharmic faith within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਬਧੇਣਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੵਣਃ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: labadhen saadh sa(n)gen naanak masatak likhynah ||22||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is obtained, O Nanak, by those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads. ||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਯੋ ਹੈ ਹੋਵੰਤੋ ਹਰਣ ਭਰਣ ਸੰਪੂਰਣਃ ॥
transliteration: hoyo hai hova(n)to haran bharan sa(n)pooranah ||
english: God was, is, and shall always be. He sustains and destroys all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਮ ਜਾਣੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਾਰਣੰ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: saadhoo satam jaano naanak preet kaarana(n) ||23||
english: Know that these Holy people are true, O Nanak; they are in love with the Lord. ||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੇਣ ਬੈਣ ਰਤਨੰ ਰਚਨੰ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਰੰਗਣਃ ॥
transliteration: sukhen bain ratana(n) rachana(n) kasu(n)bh ra(n)ganah ||
english: The mortal is engrossed in sweet words and transitory pleasures which shall soon fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੁਪਨਹ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: rog sog bioga(n) naanak sukh na supanah ||24||
english: Disease, sorrow and separation afflict him; O Nanak, he never finds peace, even in dreams. ||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: phunahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Phunhay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥਿ ਕਲੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਾਵਤੀ ॥
transliteration: haath kala(n)m aga(n)m masatak lekhaavatee ||
english: With Pen in Hand, the Unfathomable Lord writes the mortal's destiny upon his forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
transliteration: urajh rahio sabh sa(n)g anoop roopaavatee ||
english: The Incomparably Beautiful Lord is involved with all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: usatat kahan na jaai mukhahu tuhaareeaa ||
english: I cannot utter Your Praises with my mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohee dekh daras naanak balihaareeaa ||1||
english: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa mahi bais k keerat mai kahaa(n) ||
english: Seated in the Society of the Saints, I chant the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਦਿਵਾ ॥
transliteration: arapee sabh seegaar ehu jeeu sabh divaa ||
english: I dedicate all my adornments to Him, and give all this soul to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਛਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aas piaasee sej s ka(n)t vichhaaeeai ||
english: With hopeful yearning for Him, I have made the bed for my Husband.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) masatak hovai bhaag ta saajan paaeeai ||2||
english: O Lord! If such good destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, then I shall find my Friend. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਕਾਜਲ ਹਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਸਭੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sakhee kaajal haar ta(n)bol sabhai kichh saajiaa ||
english: O my companion, I have prepared everything: make-up, garlands and betel-leaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਲਹ ਕੀਏ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਿ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: solah keee seegaar k a(n)jan paajiaa ||
english: I have embellished myself with the sixteen decorations, and applied the mascara to my eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je ghar aavai ka(n)t ta sabh kichh paaeeai ||
english: If my Husband Lord comes to my home, then I obtain everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) ka(n)tai baajh seegaar sabh birathaa jaaeeai ||3||
english: O Lord! Without my Husband, all these adornments are useless. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jis ghar vasiaa ka(n)t saa vadabhaagane ||
english: Very fortunate is she, within whose home the Husband Lord abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਾਈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੇ ॥
transliteration: tis baniaa habh seegaar saaee sohaagane ||
english: She is totally adorned and decorated; she is a happy soul-bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੁਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: hau sutee hoi achi(n)t man aas puraaeeaa ||
english: I sleep in peace, without anxiety; the hopes of my mind have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) jaa ghar aaiaa ka(n)t ta sabh kichh paaeeaa ||4||
english: O Lord! When my Husband came into the home of my heart, I obtained everything. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਇਤੀ ਆਸ ਕਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aasaa itee aas k aas puraaeeai ||
english: My hope is so intense, that this hope alone should fulfill my hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhae daiaal ta pooraa paaeeai ||
english: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then I attain the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai tan avagan bahut k avagan chhaaiaa ||
english: My body is filled with so many demerits; I am covered with faults and demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) satigur bhae daiaal ta man thaharaaiaa ||5||
english: O Lord! When the True Guru becomes Merciful, then the mind is held in place. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bea(n)t bea(n)t dhiaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, I have meditated on the Lord, Infinite and Endless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dutar ihu sa(n)saar satiguroo taraaiaa ||
english: This world-ocean is so difficult to cross; the True Guru has carried me across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਜਾਂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mitiaa aavaa gaun jaa(n) pooraa paaiaa ||
english: My comings and goings in reincarnation ended, when I met the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) a(n)mrit har kaa naam satigur te paaiaa ||6||
english: O Lord! I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord from the True Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪਦਮੁ ਆਗਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: merai haath padam aagan sukh baasanaa ||
english: The lotus is in my hand; in the courtyard of my heart I abide in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਮੋਰੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sakhee morai ka(n)th rata(n)n pekh dukh naasanaa ||
english: O my companion, the Jewel is around my neck; beholding it, sorrow is taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: baasau sa(n)g gupaal sagal sukh raas har ||
english: I abide with the Lord of the World, the Treasury of Total Peace. O Lord!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) ridh sidh nav nidh basahi jis sadaa kar ||7||
english: All wealth, spiritual perfection and the nine treasures are in His Hand. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਤਾ ਲਾਜੀਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: par tri raavan jaahi seee taa laajeeahi ||
english: Those men who go out to enjoy other men's women shall suffer in shame.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਕਤ ਢਾਕੀਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nitaprat hirahi par darab chhidr kat dhaakeeahi ||
english: Those who steal the wealth of others - how can their guilt be concealed?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਈ ॥
transliteration: har gun ramat pavitr sagal kul taaraee ||
english: Those who chant the Sacred Praises of the Lord save and redeem all their generations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) sunate bhae puneet paarabraham beechaaraee ||8||
english: O Lord! Those who listen and contemplate the Supreme Lord God become pure and holy. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਬਨੈ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਤਲੈ ਧਰ ਸੋਹਤੀ ॥
transliteration: oopar banai akaas talai dhar sohatee ||
english: The sky above looks lovely, and the earth below is beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਮਕੈ ਬੀਜੁਲਿ ਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਤੀ ॥
transliteration: dah dis chamakai beejul mukh kau johatee ||
english: Lightning flashes in the ten directions; I behold the Face of my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਉ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਪੀਉ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: khojat phirau bides peeu kat paaeeai ||
english: If I go searching in foreign lands, how can I find my Beloved?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) je masatak hovai bhaag ta daras samaaeeai ||9||
english: O Lord! If such destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, I am absorbed in the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭੇ ਥਾਵ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dithe sabhe thaav nahee tudh jehiaa ||
english: I have seen all places, but none can compare to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਧੋਹੁ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: badhohu purakh bidhaatai taa(n) too sohiaa ||
english: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has established You; thus You are adorned and embellished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਸਦੀ ਸਘਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰ ॥
transliteration: vasadee saghan apaar anoop raamadaas pur ||
english: Ramdaspur is prosperous and thickly populated, and incomparably beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਸਮਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਇਐ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) naanak kasamal jaahi naaiai raamadaas sar ||10||
english: O Lord! Bathing in the Sacred Pool of Raam Daas, the sins are washed away, O Nanak. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਸੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਚਾਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: chaatrik chit suchit s saajan chaaheeai ||
english: The rainbird is very smart; in its consciousness, it longs for the friendly rain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਆਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis sa(n)g laage praan tisai kau aaheeai ||
english: It longs for that, to which its breath of life is attached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: ban ban phirat udaas boo(n)d jal kaarane ||
english: It wanders depressed, from forest to forest, for the sake of a drop of water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) tiu har jan maa(n)gai naam naanak balihaarane ||11||
english: O Lord! In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਮਰੰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mit kaa chit anoop mara(n)m na jaaneeai ||
english: The Consciousness of my Friend is incomparably beautiful. Its mystery cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਹਕ ਗੁਨੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gaahak gunee apaar s tat pachhaaneeai ||
english: One who purchases the priceless virtues realizes the essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਸਮਾਇ ਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
transliteration: chitahi chit samaai ta hovai ra(n)g ghanaa ||
english: When the consciousness is absorbed in the supreme consciousness, great joy and bliss are found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਚੰਚਲ ਚੋਰਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) cha(n)chal chorahi maar ta paavahi sach dhanaa ||12||
english: O Lord! When the fickle thieves are overcome, the true wealth is obtained. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਊਭੀ ਭਈ ਗਹਿਓ ਕੀ ਨ ਅੰਚਲਾ ॥
transliteration: supanai oobhee bhaee gahio kee na a(n)chalaa ||
english: In a dream, I was lifted up; why didn't I grasp the hem of His Robe?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੰਚਲਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar purakh biraajit pekh man ba(n)chalaa ||
english: Gazing upon the Beautiful Lord relaxing there, my mind was charmed and fascinated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਉ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: khojau taa ke charan kahahu kat paaeeai ||
english: I am searching for His Feet - tell me, where can I find Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸੋਈ ਜਤੰਨੁ ਬਤਾਇ ਸਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) soee jata(n)n bataai sakhee priu paaeeai ||13||
english: O Lord! Tell me how I can find my Beloved, O my companion. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਿ ਨੈਣ ਬਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nain na dekhahi saadh s nain bihaaliaa ||
english: The eyes which do not see the Holy - those eyes are miserable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਕਰਨ ਮੁੰਦਿ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karan na sunahee naad karan mu(n)d ghaaliaa ||
english: The ears which do not hear the Sound-current of the Naad - those ears might just as well be plugged.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੈ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa japai na naam til til kar kateeai ||
english: The tongue which does not chant the Naam ought to be cut out, bit by bit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜਬ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ਦਿਨੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਘਟੀਐ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) jab bisarai gobid raai dino din ghateeai ||14||
english: O Lord! When the mortal forgets the Lord of the Universe, the Sovereign Lord King, he grows weaker day by day. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜ ਫਾਥੇ ਪੰਕ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਗੁੰਫਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)kaj phaathe pa(n)k mahaa mad gu(n)phiaa ||
english: The wings of the bumble bee are caught in the intoxicating fragrant petals of the lotus.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਬਿਸਰਤੇ ਸੁੰਫਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)g sa(n)g urajhaai bisarate su(n)phiaa ||
english: With its limbs entangled in the petals, it loses its senses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜਿ ਤੋਰੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਂਠਿ ॥
transliteration: hai kooo aisaa meet j torai bikham gaa(n)th ||
english: Is there any such friend, who can untie this difficult knot?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਜਿ ਟੂਟੇ ਲੇਇ ਸਾਂਠਿ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak ik sreedhar naath j toote lei saa(n)th ||15||
english: O Nanak, the One Supreme Lord and Master of the earth reunites the separated ones. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਉ ਦਸਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: dhaavau dasaa anek prem prabh kaarane ||
english: I run around in all directions, searching for the love of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਤਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਤ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sataavahi doot kavan bidh maarane ||
english: The five evil enemies are tormenting me; how can I destroy them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਖਣ ਬਾਣ ਚਲਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: teekhan baan chalaai naam prabh dhyaaeeai ||
english: Shoot them with the sharp arrows of meditation on the Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਮਹਾਂ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਘਾਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) mahaa(n) bikhaadee ghaat pooran gur paaeeai ||16||
english: O Lord! The way to slaughter these terrible sadistic enemies is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur keenee daat mool na nikhutaee ||
english: The True Guru has blessed me with the bounty which shall never be exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟਈ ॥
transliteration: khaavahu bhu(n)chahu sabh guramukh chhutaee ||
english: Eating and consuming it, all the Gurmukhs are emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤੁਸਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan ditaa tus har ||
english: The Lord, in His Mercy, has blessed me with the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮਰਿ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak sadaa araadh kade na jaa(n)hi mar ||17||
english: O Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, who never dies. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਏ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jithai jaae bhagat s thaan suhaavanaa ||
english: Wherever the Lord's devotee goes is a blessed, beautiful place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sagale hoe sukh har naam dhiaavanaa ||
english: All comforts are obtained, meditating on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕਰਨਿ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮੁਏ ਪਚਿ ॥
transliteration: jee karan jaikaar ni(n)dak mue pach ||
english: People praise and congratulate the devotee of the Lord, while the slanderers rot and die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: saajan man aana(n)d naanak naam jap ||18||
english: Says Nanak, O friend, chant the Naam, and your mind shall be filled with bliss. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਤਹ ਨਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ॥
transliteration: paavan patit puneet katah nahee seveeai ||
english: The mortal never serves the Immaculate Lord, the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਲਗੁ ਖੇਵੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jhoothai ra(n)g khuaar kahaa(n) lag kheveeai ||
english: The mortal wastes away in false pleasures. How long can this go on?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: haricha(n)dauree pekh kaahe sukh maaniaa ||
english: Why do you take such pleasure, looking at this mirage?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਜਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) hau balihaaree ti(n)n j daragahi jaaniaa ||19||
english: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who are known and approved in the Court of the Lord. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਗਵਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘਨ ॥
transliteration: keene karam anek gavaar bikaar ghan ||
english: The fool commits countless foolish actions and so many sinful mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧਤ ਵਾਸੁ ਸਠ ਕਾ ਛਾਰੁ ਤਨ ॥
transliteration: mahaa druga(n)dhat vaas sath kaa chhaar tan ||
english: The fool's body smells rotten, and turns to dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤਉ ਗਰਬ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਹ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
transliteration: phiratau garab gubaar maran nah jaanaee ||
english: He wanders lost in the darkness of pride, and never thinks of dying.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਨਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) haricha(n)dauree pekh kaahe sach maanaee ||20||
english: O Lord! The mortal gazes upon the mirage; why does he think it is true? ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਅਉਧ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਰਾਖਈ ॥
transliteration: jis kee poojai audh tisai kaun raakhaee ||
english: When someone's days are over, who can save him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਦਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਹਾਂ ਲਉ ਭਾਖਈ ॥
transliteration: baidak anik upaav kahaa(n) lau bhaakhaee ||
english: How long can the physicians go on, suggesting various therapies?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਿ ਗਵਾਰ ਕਾਜਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵਈ ॥
transliteration: eko chet gavaar kaaj terai aavaee ||
english: You fool, remember the One Lord; only He shall be of use to you in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਵਈ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) bin naavai tan chhaar brithaa sabh jaavaee ||21||
english: O Lord! Without the Name, the body turns to dust, and everything goes to waste. ||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh naam apaar amolak peejaee ||
english: Drink in the medicine of the Incomparable, Priceless Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਦੀਜਈ ॥
transliteration: mil mil khaavahi sa(n)t sagal kau deejaee ||
english: Meeting and joining together, the Saints drink it in, and give it to everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਵਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jisai paraapat hoi tisai hee paavane ||
english: He alone is blessed with it, who is destined to receive it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਾਵਣੇ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) hau balihaaree ti(n)nh j har ra(n)g raavane ||22||
english: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੈਦਾ ਸੰਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਇਕਠਾ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vaidaa sa(n)daa sa(n)g ikathaa hoiaa ||
english: The physicians meet together in their assembly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਦ ਆਏ ਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aukhad aae raas vich aap khaloiaa ||
english: The medicines are effective, when the Lord Himself stands in their midst.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਓਨਾ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo jo onaa karam sukaram hoi pasariaa ||
english: Their good deeds and karma become apparent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਖਿਸਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: harihaa(n) dookh rog sabh paap tan te khisariaa ||23||
english: O Lord! Pains, diseases and sins all vanish from their bodies. ||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਉਬੋਲੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: chaubole mahalaa 5 ||
english: Chaubolas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਮਨ ਜਉ ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਦਮ ਕੵਿਹੁ ਹੋਤੀ ਸਾਟ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)man jau is prem kee dam kyihu hotee saat ||
english: O Samman, if one could buy this love with money,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਨ ਹੁਤੇ ਸੁ ਰੰਕ ਨਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raavan hute s ra(n)k nahi jin sir deene kaat ||1||
english: then consider Raawan the king. He was not poor, but he could not buy it, even though he offered his head to Shiva. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਤਨੁ ਖਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਰਾਈ ਹੋਤ ॥
transliteration: preet prem tan khach rahiaa beech na raaee hot ||
english: My body is drenched in love and affection for the Lord; there is no distance at all between us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਬੂਝਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
transliteration: charan kamal man bedhio boojhan surat sa(n)jog ||2||
english: My mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord. He is realized when one's intuitive consciousness is attuned to Him. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮੇਰ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਨ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਭਰਮ ॥
transliteration: saagar mer udiaan ban nav kha(n)d basudhaa bharam ||
english: I would cross the oceans, mountains, wilderness, forests and the nine regions of the earth in a single step,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੈ ਗਨਉ ਏਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: moosan prem pira(n)m kai ganau ek kar karam ||3||
english: O Musan, for the Love of my Beloved. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਸਕਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਰਹੀ ਜੁ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਛਾਇ ॥
transliteration: moosan masakar prem kee rahee j a(n)bar chhaai ||
english: O Musan, the Light of the Lord's Love has spread across the sky;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੀਧੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਭਵਰ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: beedhe baa(n)dhe kamal mahi bhavar rahe lapataai ||4||
english: I cling to my Lord, like the bumble bee caught in the lotus flower. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨ ਮਹਤ ਅਰੁ ਗਰਬ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam harakh sukh maan mahat ar garab ||
english: Chanting and intense meditation, austere self-discipline, pleasure and peace, honor, greatness and pride

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਨਿਮਖਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਰਬ ॥੫॥
transliteration: moosan nimakhak prem par vaar vaar de(n)u sarab ||5||
english: - O Musan, I would dedicate and sacrifice all these for a moment of my Lord's Love. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਮਰਤ ਹਿਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: moosan maram na jaanaee marat hirat sa(n)saar ||
english: O Musan, the world does not understand the Mystery of the Lord; it is dying and being plundered.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਨ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਮਿਥ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: prem pira(n)m na bedhio urajhio mith biuhaar ||6||
english: It is not pierced through by the Love of the Beloved Lord; it is entangled in false pursuits. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਬੁ ਦਬੁ ਜਬ ਜਾਰੀਐ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ghab dab jab jaareeai bichhurat prem bihaal ||
english: When someone's home and property are burnt, because of his attachment to them, he suffers in the sorrow of separation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮੂਸੀਐ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੭॥
transliteration: moosan tab hee mooseeai bisarat purakh daiaal ||7||
english: O Musan, when mortals forget the Merciful Lord God, then they are truly plundered. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਆਉ ਹੈ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤਵ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa ko prem suaau hai charan chitav man maahi ||
english: Whoever enjoys the taste of the Lord's Love, remembers His Lotus Feet in his mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak birahee braham ke aan na katahoo jaahi ||8||
english: O Nanak, the lovers of God do not go anywhere else. ||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਘਾਟੀਂ ਊਂਚੌ ਘਨੋ ਚੰਚਲ ਚੀਤ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: lakh ghaatee(n) oo(n)chau ghano cha(n)chal cheet bihaal ||
english: Climbing thousands of steep hillsides, the fickle mind becomes miserable.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਕੀਚ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਘਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਮਲ ਜਮਾਲ ॥੯॥
transliteration: neech keech nimrit ghanee karanee kamal jamaal ||9||
english: Look at the humble, lowly mud, O Jamaal: the beautiful lotus grows in it. ||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲ ਨੈਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਸਿਆਮ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਦਨ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kamal nain a(n)jan siaam cha(n)dr badan chit chaar ||
english: My Lord has lotus-eyes; His Face is so beautifully adorned.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਗਨ ਮਰੰਮ ਸਿਉ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: moosan magan mara(n)m siu kha(n)d kha(n)d kar haar ||10||
english: O Musan, I am intoxicated with His Mystery. I break the necklace of pride into bits. ||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੂਧ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅੰਗ ॥
transliteration: magan bhaio pri prem siu soodh na simarat a(n)g ||
english: I am intoxicated with the Love of my Husband Lord; remembering Him in meditation, I am not conscious of my own body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਭਇਓ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਧਮ ਪਤੰਗ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: pragat bhaio sabh lo mahi naanak adham pata(n)g ||11||
english: He is revealed in all His Glory, all throughout the world. Nanak is a lowly moth at His Flame. ||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: salok bhagat kabeer jeeu ke ||
english: Saloks Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿਮਰਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer meree simaranee rasanaa oopar raam ||
english: Kabeer, my rosary is my tongue, upon which the Lord's Name is strung.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee sagal bhagat taa ko sukh bisraam ||1||
english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, all the devotees abide in tranquil peace. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹਸਨੇਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer meree jaat kau sabh ko hasanehaar ||
english: Kabeer, everyone laughs at my social class.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਇਸ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਉ ਜਿਹ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: balihaaree is jaat kau jih japio sirajanahaar ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to this social class, in which I chant and meditate on the Creator. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਡਗਮਗ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਡੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer dagamag kiaa karahi kahaa dulaavahi jeeu ||
english: Kabeer, why do you stumble? Why does your soul waver?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਕੋ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sarab sookh ko naaiko raam naam ras peeu ||3||
english: He is the Lord of all comforts and peace; drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਬਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ka(n)chan ke ku(n)dal bane oopar laal jaRaau ||
english: Kabeer, earrings made of gold and studded with jewels,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਦਾਧੇ ਕਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: deesahi daadhe kaan jiu jinh man naahee naau ||4||
english: look like burnt twigs, if the Name is not in the mind. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisaa ek aadh jo jeevat miratak hoi ||
english: Kabeer, rare is such a person, who remains dead while yet alive.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nirabhai hoi kai gun ravai jat pekhau tat soi ||5||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he is fearless. Wherever I look, the Lord is there. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਹਉ ਮੂਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jaa din hau mooaa paachhai bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
english: Kabeer, on the day when I die, afterwards there shall be bliss.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਜਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: mohi milio prabh aapanaa sa(n)gee bhajahi goubi(n)d ||6||
english: I shall meet with my Lord God. Those with me shall meditate and vibrate on the Lord of the Universe. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਬੁਰੇ ਹਮ ਤਜਿ ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sabh te ham bure ham taj bhalo sabh koi ||
english: Kabeer, I am the worst of all. Everyone else is good.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਐਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jin aisaa kar boojhiaa meet hamaaraa soi ||7||
english: Whoever understands this is a friend of mine. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਆਈ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਸ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aaee mujhahi pahi anik kare kar bhes ||
english: Kabeer, she came to me in various forms and disguises.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ ਉਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: ham raakhe gur aapane un keeno aades ||8||
english: My Guru saved me, and now she bows humbly to me. ||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਮੂਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer soee maareeai jih mooai sukh hoi ||
english: Kabeer, kill only that, which, when killed, shall bring peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bhalo bhalo sabh ko kahai buro na maanai koi ||9||
english: Everyone shall call you good, very good, and no one shall think you are bad. ||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕਾਰੀਆ ਕਾਰੇ ਊਭੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raatee hovahi kaareeaa kaare oobhe ja(n)t ||
english: Kabeer, the night is dark, and men go about doing their dark deeds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਤੇ ਸਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧੦॥
