transliteration: lai phaahe uth dhaavate s jaan maare bhagava(n)t ||10||
english: They take the noose and run around; but rest assured that God shall destroy them. ||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਭਲਾ ਬੇੜੑਿਓ ਢਾਕ ਪਲਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kabeer cha(n)dan kaa biravaa bhalaa beRhio dhaak palaas ||
english: Kabeer, the sandalwood tree is good, even though it is surrounded by weeds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਬਸੇ ਜੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: oi bhee cha(n)dan hoi rahe base j cha(n)dan paas ||11||
english: Those who dwell near the sandalwood tree, become just like the sandalwood tree. ||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਬਡਾਈ ਬੂਡਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਤ ਡੂਬਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer baa(n)s badaaee boodiaa iu mat doobahu koi ||
english: Kabeer, the bamboo is drowned in its egotistical pride. No one should drown like this.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan kai nikate basai baa(n)s suga(n)dh na hoi ||12||
english: Bamboo also dwells near the sandalwood tree, but it does not take up its fragrance. ||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦੀਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer deen gavaaiaa dunee siu dunee na chaalee saath ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal loses his faith, for the sake of the world, but the world shall not go along with him in the end.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਗਾਫਲਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: paai kuhaaRaa maariaa gaaphal apunai haath ||13||
english: The idiot strikes his own foot with the axe by his own hand. ||13||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਕਉਤਕ ਠਾਓ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jah jah hau phirio kautak thaao thaai ||
english: Kabeer, wherever I go, I see wonders everywhere.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਊਜਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭਾਂਇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: ik raam sanehee baaharaa oojar merai bhaa(n)i ||14||
english: But without the devotees of the One Lord, it is all wilderness to me. ||14||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਝੁੰਗੀਆ ਭਲੀ ਭਠਿ ਕੁਸਤੀ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sa(n)tan kee jhu(n)geeaa bhalee bhath kusatee gaau ||
english: Kabeer, the dwelling of the Saints is good; the dwelling of the unrighteous burns like an oven.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿ ਲਗਉ ਤਿਹ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aag lagau tih dhaulahar jih naahee har ko naau ||15||
english: Those mansions in which the Lord's Name is not chanted might just as well burn down. ||15||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sa(n)t mooe kiaa roeeai jo apune grihi jaai ||
english: Kabeer, why cry at the death of a Saint? He is just going back to his home.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਜੁ ਹਾਟੈ ਹਾਟ ਬਿਕਾਇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: rovahu saakat baapure j haatai haat bikaai ||16||
english: Cry for the wretched, faithless cynic, who is sold from store to store. ||16||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਐਸਾ ਹੈ ਜੈਸੀ ਲਸਨ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saakat aisaa hai jaisee lasan kee khaan ||
english: Kabeer, the faithless cynic is like a piece of garlic.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਨੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਖਾਈਐ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kone baithe khaaeeai paragat hoi nidaan ||17||
english: Even if you eat it sitting in a corner, it becomes obvious to everyone. ||17||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਲਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maaiaa dolanee pavan jhakolanahaar ||
english: Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn, and the breath is the churning-stick.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਛਾਛਿ ਪੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu maakhan khaaiaa chhaachh peeai sa(n)saar ||18||
english: The Saints eat the butter, while the world drinks the whey. ||18||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਵਹੈ ਹਿਵ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maaiaa dolanee pavan vahai hiv dhaar ||
english: Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn; the breath flows like ice water.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿਲੋਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਅਵਰ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: jin biloiaa tin khaaiaa avar bilovanahaar ||19||
english: Whoever does the churning eats the butter; the others are just churning-sticks. ||19||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਚੋਰਟੀ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maaiaa choratee mus mus laavai haat ||
english: Kabeer, Maya is the thief, which breaks in and plunders the store.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾ ਮੁਸੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਾਰਹ ਬਾਟ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: ek kabeeraa naa musai jin keenee baarah baat ||20||
english: Only Kabeer is not plundered; he has cut her into twelve pieces. ||20||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਏਂਹ ਜੁਗਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੁ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sookh na e(n)h jug karahi j bahutai meet ||
english: Kabeer, peace does not come in this world by making lots of friends.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: jo chit raakhahi ek siu te sukh paavahi neet ||21||
english: Those who keep their consciousness focused on the One Lord shall find eternal peace. ||21||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਰਨੇ ਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਡਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jis marane te jag darai mere man aana(n)d ||
english: Kabeer, the world is afraid of death - that death fills my mind with bliss.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਨੇ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: marane hee te paaeeai pooran paramaana(n)d ||22||
english: It is only by death that perfect, supreme bliss is obtained. ||22||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਖੋਲੑ ॥
transliteration: raam padaarath paai kai kabeeraa gaa(n)th na kholh ||
english: The Treasure of the Lord is obtained, O Kabeer, but do not undo its knot.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਪਟਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਲੁ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: nahee patan nahee paarakhoo nahee gaahak nahee mol ||23||
english: There is no market to sell it, no appraiser, no customer, and no price. ||23||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer taa siu preet kar jaa ko thaakur raam ||
english: Kabeer, be in love with only that one, whose Master is the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰਾਜੇ ਭੂਪਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਉਨੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit raaje bhoopatee aavahi kaune kaam ||24||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, kings and landlords - what good is love for them? ||24||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਕ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਏ ਆਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer preet ik siu keee aan dubidhaa jaai ||
english: Kabeer, when you are in love with the One Lord, duality and alienation depart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਂਬੇ ਕੇਸ ਕਰੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਘਰਰਿ ਮੁਡਾਇ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: bhaavai laa(n)be kes kar bhaavai gharar mudaai ||25||
english: You may have long hair, or you may shave your head bald. ||25||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੀ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jag kaajal kee kotharee a(n)dh pare tis maahi ||
english: Kabeer, the world is a room filled with black soot; the blind fall into its trap.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੈਸਿ ਜੁ ਨੀਕਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau pais j neekas jaahi ||26||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who are thrown in, and still escape. ||26||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਸਕਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਹੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ihu tan jaaigaa sakahu ta lehu bahor ||
english: Kabeer, this body shall perish; save it, if you can.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਂਗੇ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇ ਗਏ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰਿ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naa(n)ge paavahu te gae jin ke laakh karor ||27||
english: Even those who have tens of thousands and millions, must depart bare-footed in the end. ||27||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਕਵਨੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ihu tan jaaigaa kavanai maarag laai ||
english: Kabeer, this body shall perish; place it on the path.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: kai sa(n)gat kar saadh kee kai har ke gun gaai ||28||
english: Either join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, or sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||28||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੂਆ ਮਰਿ ਭੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer marataa marataa jag mooaa mar bhee na jaaniaa koi ||
english: Kabeer, dying, dying, the whole world has to die, and yet, none know how to die.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਨੇ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: aise marane jo marai bahur na maranaa hoi ||29||
english: Let those who die, die such a death, that they shall never have to die again. ||29||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maanas janam dula(n)bh hai hoi na baarai baar ||
english: Kabeer, it is so difficult to obtain this human body; it does not just come over and over again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਕੇ ਭੁਇ ਗਿਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਡਾਰ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: jiu ban phal paake bhui girahi bahur na laagahi daar ||30||
english: It is like the ripe fruit on the tree; when it falls to the ground, it cannot be re-attached to the branch. ||30||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa tuhee kabeer too tero naau kabeer ||
english: Kabeer, you are Kabeer; your name means great.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਬ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਤਜਹਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: raam ratan tab paaeeai jau pahile tajahi sareer ||31||
english: O Lord, You are Kabeer. The Jewel of the Lord is obtained, when the mortal first gives up his body. ||31||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਝੰਖੁ ਨ ਝੰਖੀਐ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jha(n)kh na jha(n)kheeai tumaro kahio na hoi ||
english: Kabeer, do not struggle in stubborn pride; nothing happens just because you say so.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੀਮ ਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: karam kareem j kar rahe met na saakai koi ||32||
english: No one can erase the actions of the Merciful Lord. ||32||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kasautee raam kee jhoothaa tikai na koi ||
english: Kabeer, no one who is false can withstand the Touchstone of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: raam kasautee so sahai jo mar jeevaa hoi ||33||
english: He alone can pass the test of the Lord's Touchstone, who remains dead while yet alive. ||33||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਊਜਲ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਾਪਰੇ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer oojal pahirahi kaapare paan supaaree khaahi ||
english: Kabeer, some wear gaudy robes, and chew betel leaves and betel nuts.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: ekas har ke naam bin baadhe jam pur jaa(n)hi ||34||
english: Without the Name of the One Lord, they are bound and gagged and taken to the City of Death. ||34||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ ਫੂਟੇ ਛੇਂਕ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer beRaa jarajaraa phoote chhe(n)k hajaar ||
english: Kabeer, the boat is old, and it has thousands of holes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰੂਏ ਹਰੂਏ ਤਿਰਿ ਗਏ ਡੂਬੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: harooe harooe tir gae doobe jin sir bhaar ||35||
english: Those who are light get across, while those who carry the weight of their sins on their heads are drowned. ||35||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਾਡ ਜਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਲਾਕਰੀ ਕੇਸ ਜਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer haad jare jiu laakaree kes jare jiu ghaas ||
english: Kabeer, the bones burn like wood, and the hair burns like straw.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਰਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: ihu jag jarataa dekh kai bhaio kabeer udaas ||36||
english: Seeing the world burning like this, Kabeer has become sad. ||36||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਚਾਮ ਲਪੇਟੇ ਹਾਡ ॥
transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai chaam lapete haad ||
english: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your bones wrapped up in skin.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਤਰ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਰਨੀ ਗਾਡ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: haivar oopar chhatr tar te phun dharanee gaad ||37||
english: Those who were on their horses and under their canopies, were eventually buried under the ground. ||37||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਊਚਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai oochaa dekh avaas ||
english: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your tall mansions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲੑਿ ਭੁਇ ਲੇਟਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: aaj kaalhi bhui letanaa oopar jaamai ghaas ||38||
english: Today or tomorrow, you shall lie beneath the ground, and the grass shall grow above you. ||38||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਰੰਕੁ ਨ ਹਸੀਐ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai ra(n)k na haseeai koi ||
english: Kabeer, do not be so proud, and do not laugh at the poor.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: ajahu s naau samu(n)dr mahi kiaa jaanau kiaa hoi ||39||
english: Your boat is still out at sea; who knows what will happen? ||39||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai dehee dekh sura(n)g ||
english: Kabeer, do not be so proud, looking at your beautiful body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲੑਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਹੁਗੇ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਂਚੁਰੀ ਭੁਯੰਗ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: aaj kaalhi taj jaahuge jiu kaa(n)churee bhuya(n)g ||40||
english: Today or tomorrow, you will have to leave it behind, like the snake shedding its skin. ||40||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਲੂਟਨਾ ਹੈ ਤ ਲੂਟਿ ਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ਲੂਟਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer lootanaa hai ta loot lai raam naam hai loot ||
english: Kabeer, if you must rob and plunder, then plunder the plunder of the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੁਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਾਹਿੰਗੇ ਛੂਟਿ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: phir paachhai pachhutaahuge praan jaahi(n)ge chhoot ||41||
english: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will regret and repent, when the breath of life leaves the body. ||41||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਨਮਿਓ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisaa koee na janamio apanai ghar laavai aag ||
english: Kabeer, there is no one born, who burns his own home,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਲਰਿਕਾ ਜਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: paa(n)chau larikaa jaar kai rahai raam liv laag ||42||
english: and burning his five sons, remains lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||42||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਹੈ ਲਰਿਕਾ ਬੇਚਈ ਲਰਿਕੀ ਬੇਚੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ko hai larikaa bechaee larikee bechai koi ||
english: Kabeer, how rare are those who sell their son and sell their daughter

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਝਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: saajhaa karai kabeer siu har sa(n)g banaj karei ||43||
english: and, entering into partnership with Kabeer, deal with the Lord. ||43||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਮਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ih chetaavanee mat sahasaa rahi jaai ||
english: Kabeer, let me remind you of this. Do not be skeptical or cynical.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਭੋਗ ਜੁ ਭੋਗਵੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਗੁੜੁ ਲੈ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: paachhai bhog j bhogave tin ko guR lai khaahi ||44||
english: Those pleasures which you enjoyed so much in the past - now you must eat their fruits. ||44||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪੜਿਬੋ ਭਲੋ ਪੜਿਬੇ ਸਿਉ ਭਲ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer mai jaanio paRibo bhalo paRibe siu bhal jog ||
english: Kabeer, at first, I thought learning was good; then I thought Yoga was better.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: bhagat na chhaadau raam kee bhaavai ni(n)dau log ||45||
english: I shall never abandon devotional worship of the Lord, even though people may slander me. ||45||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਲੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer log k ni(n)dai bapuRaa jih man naahee giaan ||
english: Kabeer, how can the wretched people slander me? They have no wisdom or intelligence.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਵਰ ਤਜੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥੪੬॥
transliteration: raam kabeeraa rav rahe avar taje sabh kaam ||46||
english: Kabeer continues to dwell upon the Lord's Name; I have abandoned all other affairs. ||46||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਕੈ ਘਾਘਰੈ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer paradesee kai ghaagharai chahu dis laagee aag ||
english: Kabeer, the robe of the stranger-soul has caught fire on all four sides.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜਲਿ ਕੋਇਲਾ ਭਈ ਤਾਗੇ ਆਂਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੪੭॥
transliteration: khi(n)thaa jal koilaa bhaee taage aa(n)ch na laag ||47||
english: The cloth of the body has been burnt and reduced to charcoal, but the fire did not touch the thread of the soul. ||47||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜਲਿ ਕੋਇਲਾ ਭਈ ਖਾਪਰੁ ਫੂਟ ਮਫੂਟ ॥
transliteration: kabeer khi(n)thaa jal koilaa bhaee khaapar phoot maphoot ||
english: Kabeer, the cloth has been burnt and reduced to charcoal, and the begging bowl is shattered into pieces.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਖੇਲਿਓ ਆਸਨਿ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥੪੮॥
transliteration: jogee bapuRaa khelio aasan rahee bibhoot ||48||
english: The poor Yogi has played out his game; only ashes remain on his seat. ||48||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਥੋਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਝੀਵਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer thorai jal maachhulee jheevar melio jaal ||
english: Kabeer, the fish is in the shallow water; the fisherman has cast his net.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਟੋਘਨੈ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੪੯॥
transliteration: ih toghanai na chhootasahi phir kar samu(n)d samhaal ||49||
english: You shall not escape this little pool; think about returning to the ocean. ||49||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਜਉ ਅਤਿ ਖਾਰੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer samu(n)d na chhodeeai jau at khaaro hoi ||
english: Kabeer, do not leave the ocean, even if it is very salty.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੋਖਰਿ ਪੋਖਰਿ ਢੂਢਤੇ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਿਹੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੫੦॥
transliteration: pokhar pokhar dhoodhate bhalo na kahihai koi ||50||
english: If you poke around searching from puddle to puddle, no one will call you smart. ||50||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਗੁਸਾਂਏਂ ਬਹਿ ਗਏ ਥਾਂਘੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer nigusaa(n)e(n) bahi gae thaa(n)ghee naahee koi ||
english: Kabeer, those who have no guru are washed away. No one can help them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
transliteration: deen gareebee aapunee karate hoi s hoi ||51||
english: Be meek and humble; whatever happens is what the Creator Lord does. ||51||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਸਨਉ ਕੀ ਕੂਕਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਬੁਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer baisanau kee kookar bhalee saakat kee buree maai ||
english: Kabeer, even the dog of a devotee is good, while the mother of the faithless cynic is bad.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਉਹ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਸਾਹਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
transliteration: oh nit sunai har naam jas uh paap bisaahan jaai ||52||
english: The dog hears the Praises of the Lord's Name, while the other is engaged in sin. ||52||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਨਾ ਦੂਬਲਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਰੀਆਰਾ ਤਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer haranaa doobalaa ihu hareeaaraa taal ||
english: Kabeer, the deer is weak, and the pool is lush with green vegetation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਅਹੇਰੀ ਏਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਤਾ ਬੰਚਉ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੫੩॥
transliteration: laakh aheree ek jeeu ketaa ba(n)chau kaal ||53||
english: Thousands of hunters are chasing after the soul; how long can it escape death? ||53||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗੰਗਾ ਤੀਰ ਜੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ga(n)gaa teer j ghar karahi peevahi niramal neer ||
english: Kabeer, some make their homes on the banks of the Ganges, and drink pure water.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਇਉ ਕਹਿ ਰਮੇ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੫੪॥
transliteration: bin har bhagat na mukat hoi iu kahi rame kabeer ||54||
english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, they are not liberated. Kabeer proclaims this. ||54||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੈਸਾ ਗੰਗਾ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer man niramal bhaiaa jaisaa ga(n)gaa neer ||
english: Kabeer, my mind has become immaculate, like the waters of the Ganges.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੫੫॥
transliteration: paachhai laago har phirai kahat kabeer kabeer ||55||
english: The Lord follows after me, calling, "Kabeer! Kabeer!" ||55||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਦੀ ਪੀਅਰੀ ਚੂੰਨਾਂ ਊਜਲ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer haradee peearee choo(n)naa(n) oojal bhaai ||
english: Kabeer, tumeric is yelow, and lime is white.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਦੋਨਉ ਬਰਨ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫੬॥
transliteration: raam sanehee tau milai donau baran gavaai ||56||
english: You shall meet the Beloved Lord, only when both colors are lost. ||56||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਦੀ ਪੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰੈ ਚੂਨ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer haradee peeratan harai choon chihan na rahaai ||
english: Kabeer, tumeric has lost its yellow color, and no trace of lime's whiteness remains.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਉ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਤਿ ਬਰਨੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੫੭॥
transliteration: balihaaree ih preet kau jih jaat baran kul jaai ||57||
english: I am a sacrifice to this love, by which social class and status, color and ancestry are taken away. ||57||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੰਕੁਰਾ ਰਾਈ ਦਸਏਂ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer mukat duaaraa sa(n)kuraa raaee dasae(n) bhaai ||
english: Kabeer, the door of liberation is very narrow, less than the width of a mustard seed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਕਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਕੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੫੮॥
transliteration: man tau maigal hoi rahio nikaso kiu kai jaai ||58||
english: Your mind is larger than an elephant; how will it pass through? ||58||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisaa satigur je milai tuthaa kare pasaau ||
english: Kabeer, if I meet such a True Guru, who mercifully blesses me with the gift,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਮੋਕਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੫੯॥
transliteration: mukat duaaraa mokalaa sahaje aavau jaau ||59||
english: then the door of liberation will open wide for me, and I will easily pass through. ||59||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਾ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਛਾਨਿ ਨ ਛਾਪਰੀ ਨਾ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer naa mouhi chhaan na chhaaparee naa mouhi ghar nahee gaau ||
english: Kabeer, I have no hut or hovel, no house or village.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥੬੦॥
transliteration: mat har poochhai kaun hai mere jaat na naau ||60||
english: I hope that the Lord will not ask who I am. I have no social status or name. ||60||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਰਨੇ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ਹੈ ਮਰਉ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer muhi marane kaa chaau hai marau ta har kai duaar ||
english: Kabeer, I long to die; let me die at the Lord's Door.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਰਾ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥੬੧॥
transliteration: mat har poochhai kaun hai paraa hamaarai baar ||61||
english: I hope that the Lord does not ask, "Who is this, lying at my door?" ||61||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਆ ਨ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer naa ham keeaa na karahige naa kar sakai sareer ||
english: Kabeer, I have not done anything; I shall not do anything; my body cannot do anything.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਭਇਓ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੬੨॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanau kichh har keeaa bhaio kabeer kabeer ||62||
english: I do not know what the Lord has done, but the call has gone out: "Kabeer, Kabeer." ||62||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੂ ਬਰੜਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer supanai hoo baraRaai kai jih mukh nikasai raam ||
english: Kabeer, if someone utters the Name of the Lord even in dreams,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਕੀ ਪਾਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਚਾਮੁ ॥੬੩॥
transliteration: taa ke pag kee paanahee mere tan ko chaam ||63||
english: I would make my skin into shoes for his feet. ||63||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਪੂਤਰੇ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਰਾਖਿਓੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maatee ke ham pootare maanas raakhiou naau ||
english: Kabeer, we are puppets of clay, but we take the name of mankind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਕੇ ਪਾਹੁਨੇ ਬਡ ਬਡ ਰੂੰਧਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥੬੪॥
transliteration: chaar divas ke paahune bad bad roo(n)dhahi thaau ||64||
english: We are guests here for only a few days, but we take up so much space. ||64||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪੀਸਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer mahidee kar ghaaliaa aap peesaai peesaai ||
english: Kabeer, I have made myself into henna, and I grind myself into powder.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੀਐ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੬੫॥
transliteration: tai sah baat na poochheeai kabahu na laaee paai ||65||
english: But You, O my Husband Lord, have not asked about me; You have never applied me to Your Feet. ||65||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਹ ਦਰਿ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤਿਅਹੁ ਹਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jih dar aavat jaatiahu hatakai naahee koi ||
english: Kabeer, that door, through which people never stop coming and going

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਜੋ ਦਰੁ ਐਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੬੬॥
transliteration: so dar kaise chhodeeai jo dar aisaa hoi ||66||
english: - how can I leave such a door as that? ||66||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਡੂਬਾ ਥਾ ਪੈ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਗੁਨ ਕੀ ਲਹਰਿ ਝਬਕਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer doobaa thaa pai ubario gun kee lahar jhabak ||
english: Kabeer, I was drowning, but the waves of virtue saved me in an instant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ ਤਬ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਉ ਫਰਕਿ ॥੬੭॥
transliteration: jab dekhio beRaa jarajaraa tab utar pario hau pharak ||67||
english: When I saw that my boat was rotten, then I immediately got out. ||67||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਪੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer paapee bhagat na bhaavaee har poojaa na suhaai ||
english: Kabeer, the sinner does not like devotion to the Lord; he does not appreciate worship.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਖੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਹ ਬਿਗੰਧ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੬੮॥
transliteration: maakhee cha(n)dan paraharai jah biga(n)dh tah jaai ||68||
english: The fly abandons the sandalwood tree, and goes after the rotten smell. ||68||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਦੁ ਮੂਆ ਰੋਗੀ ਮੂਆ ਮੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer baid mooaa rogee mooaa mooaa sabh sa(n)saar ||
english: Kabeer, the physician is dead, and the patient is dead; the whole world is dead.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੬੯॥
transliteration: ek kabeeraa naa mooaa jih naahee rovanahaar ||69||
english: Only Kabeer is not dead; there is no one to mourn for him. ||69||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਟੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raam na dhiaaio motee laagee khor ||
english: Kabeer, I have not meditated on the Lord; such is the bad habit I have developed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਨਾ ਓਹ ਚਰ੍ਹੈ ਬਹੋਰਿ ॥੭੦॥
transliteration: kaaiaa haa(n)dee kaath kee naa oh charhai bahor ||70||
english: The body is a wooden pot; it cannot be put back on the fire. ||70||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਤੁ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisee hoi paree man ko bhaavat keen ||
english: Kabeer, it came to pass, that I did whatever I pleased.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਨੇ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਡਰਪਨਾ ਜਬ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਿਧਉਰਾ ਲੀਨ ॥੭੧॥
transliteration: marane te kiaa darapanaa jab haath sidhauraa leen ||71||
english: Why should I be afraid of death? I have invited death for myself. ||71||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਗਾਂਡੋ ਚੂਸੀਐ ਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਮਰੀਐ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ras ko gaa(n)do chooseeai gun kau mareeai roi ||
english: Kabeer, the mortals suck at the sugar cane, for the sake of the sweet juice. They should work just as hard for virtue.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਮਾਨਸੈ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਿਹੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੭੨॥
transliteration: avaguneeaare maanasai bhalo na kahihai koi ||72||
english: The person who lacks virtue - no one calls him good. ||72||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਭਰੀ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲੑਿ ਜੈਹੈ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer gaagar jal bharee aaj kaalhi jaihai phoot ||
english: Kabeer, the pitcher is full of water; it will break, today or tomorrow.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਆਪਨੋ ਅਧ ਮਾਝਿ ਲੀਜਹਿਗੇ ਲੂਟਿ ॥੭੩॥
transliteration: gur j na chetahi aapano adh maajh leejahige loot ||73||
english: Those who do not remember their Guru, shall be plundered on the way. ||73||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kookar raam ko muteeaa mero naau ||
english: Kabeer, I am the Lord's dog; Moti is my name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਲੇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਜਹ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥੭੪॥
transliteration: gale hamaare jevaree jah khi(n)chai tah jaau ||74||
english: There is a chain around my neck; wherever I am pulled, I go. ||74||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਪਨੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer japanee kaath kee kiaa dikhalaavahi loi ||
english: Kabeer, why do you show other people your rosary beads?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਇਹ ਜਪਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੭੫॥
transliteration: hiradai raam na chetahee ih japanee kiaa hoi ||75||
english: You do not remember the Lord in your heart, so what use is this rosary to you? ||75||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਯੰਗਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਮੰਤੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer birahu bhuya(n)gam man basai ma(n)t na maanai koi ||
english: Kabeer, the snake of separation from the Lord abides within my mind; it does not respond to any mantra.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਨਾ ਜੀਐ ਜੀਐ ਤ ਬਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭੬॥
transliteration: raam biogee naa jeeai jeeai ta bauraa hoi ||76||
english: One who is separated from the Lord does not live; if he does live, he goes insane. ||76||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਸੁਗੰਧ ॥
transliteration: kabeer paaras cha(n)danai tinh hai ek suga(n)dh ||
english: Kabeer, the philosopher's stone and sandalwood oil have the same good quality.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਤੇਊ ਊਤਮ ਭਏ ਲੋਹ ਕਾਠ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ॥੭੭॥
transliteration: tih mil teoo ootam bhae loh kaath niraga(n)dh ||77||
english: Whatever comes into contact with them is uplifted. Iron is transformed into gold, and ordinary wood becomes fragrant. ||77||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਠੇਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jam kaa the(n)gaa buraa hai ohu nahee sahiaa jaai ||
english: Kabeer, Death's club is terrible; it cannot be endured.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਤਿਨੑਿ ਲੀਆ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੭੮॥
transliteration: ek j saadhoo mouhi milio tinhi leeaa a(n)chal laai ||78||
english: I have met with the holy man; he has attached me to the hem of his robe. ||78||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਹਉ ਹੀ ਭਲਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer baid kahai hau hee bhalaa daaroo merai vas ||
english: Kabeer, the physician says that he alone is good, and all the medicine is under his control.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਤਉ ਬਸਤੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਕੀ ਜਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਲੇਇ ਖਸਿ ॥੭੯॥
transliteration: ih tau basat gupaal kee jab bhaavai lei khas ||79||
english: But these things belong to the Lord; He takes them away whenever He wishes. ||79||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਉਬਤਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਦਿਨ ਦਸ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer naubat aapanee din das lehu bajaai ||
english: Kabeer, take your drum and beat it for ten days.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਹੈ ਆਇ ॥੮੦॥
transliteration: nadee naav sa(n)jog jiu bahur na milahai aai ||80||
english: Life is like people meeting on a boat on a river; they shall not meet again. ||80||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦਹਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਉ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saat samu(n)dahi mas karau kalam karau banaraai ||
english: Kabeer, if I could change the seven seas into ink and make all the vegetation my pen,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਜਉ ਕਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੮੧॥
transliteration: basudhaa kaagad jau karau har jas likhan na jaai ||81||
english: and the earth my paper, even then, I could not write the Praises of the Lord. ||81||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jaat julaahaa kiaa karai hiradai base gupaal ||
english: Kabeer, what can my lowly status as a weaver do to me? The Lord dwells in my heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਮਈਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੮੨॥
transliteration: kabeer ramaeeaa ka(n)th mil chookahi sarab ja(n)jaal ||82||
english: Kabeer, the Lord hugs me close in His Embrace; I have forsaken all my entanglements. ||82||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisaa ko nahee ma(n)dar dei jaraai ||
english: Kabeer, will anyone set fire to his home

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਲਰਿਕੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਇ ॥੮੩॥
transliteration: paa(n)chau larike maar kai rahai raam liu laai ||83||
english: and kill his five sons (the five thieves) to remain lovingly attached to the Lord? ||83||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਫੂਕਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisaa ko nahee ihu tan devai phook ||
english: Kabeer, will anyone burn his own body?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਕੂਕਿ ॥੮੪॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa log na jaanaee rahio kabeeraa kook ||84||
english: The people are blind - they do not know, although Kabeer continues to shout at them. ||84||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਤੀ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਚਿਹ ਚੜੀ ਸੁਨੁ ਹੋ ਬੀਰ ਮਸਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kabeer satee pukaarai chih chaRee sun ho beer masaan ||
english: Kabeer, the widow mounts the funeral pyre and cries out, "Listen, O brother funeral pyre.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਚਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਮੁ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੮੫॥
transliteration: log sabaaiaa chal gaio ham tum kaam nidaan ||85||
english: All people must depart in the end; it is only you and I." ||85||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਭਇਓ ਉਡਿ ਉਡਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer man pa(n)khee bhaio ud ud dah dis jaai ||
english: Kabeer, the mind has become a bird; it soars and flies in the ten directions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੈਸੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੮੬॥
transliteration: jo jaisee sa(n)gat milai so taiso phal khaai ||86||
english: According to the company it keeps, so are the fruits it eats. ||86||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੋਈ ਠਉਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jaa kau khojate paaio soee thaur ||
english: Kabeer, you have found that place which you were seeking.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਤੂ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤਾ ਅਉਰੁ ॥੮੭॥
transliteration: soee phir kai too bhaiaa jaa kau kahataa aur ||87||
english: You have become that which you thought was separate from yourself. ||87||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਰੀ ਮਰਉ ਕੁਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਕੇਲੇ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੁ ਬੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maaree marau kusa(n)g kee kele nikat j ber ||
english: Kabeer, I have been ruined and destroyed by bad company, like the banana plant near the thorn bush.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਹ ਝੂਲੈ ਉਹ ਚੀਰੀਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੇਰਿ ॥੮੮॥
transliteration: uh jhoolai uh cheereeai saakat sa(n)g na her ||88||
english: The thorn bush waves in the wind, and pierces the banana plant; see this, and do not associate with the faithless cynics. ||88||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਾਰ ਪਰਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਚਰੈ ਚਲਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਾਟ ॥
transliteration: kabeer bhaar paraaee sir charai chalio chaahai baat ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal wants to walk on the path, carrying the load of others' sins on his head.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਾਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਡਰੈ ਆਗੈ ਅਉਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥੮੯॥
transliteration: apane bhaarahi naa darai aagai aughat ghaat ||89||
english: He is not afraid of his own load of sins; the road ahead shall be difficult and treacherous. ||89||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਨ ਕੀ ਦਾਧੀ ਲਾਕਰੀ ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰੈ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ban kee daadhee laakaree thaadhee karai pukaar ||
english: Kabeer, the forest is burning; the tree standing in it is crying out,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਬਸਿ ਪਰਉ ਲੁਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਜਾਰੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੯੦॥
transliteration: mat bas parau luhaar ke jaarai doojee baar ||90||
english: "Do not let me fall into the hands of the blacksmith, who would burn me a second time." ||90||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਏਕ ਮਰੰਤੇ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਏ ਦੋਇ ਮਰੰਤਹ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ek mara(n)te dui mooe doi mara(n)tah chaar ||
english: Kabeer, when one died, two were dead. When two died, four were dead.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਮਰੰਤਹ ਛਹ ਮੂਏ ਚਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੯੧॥
transliteration: chaar mara(n)tah chhah mooe chaar purakh dui naar ||91||
english: When four died, six were dead, four males and two females. ||91||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂੰਢਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਉਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer dekh dekh jag dhoo(n)dhiaa kahoo(n) na paaiaa thaur ||
english: Kabeer, I have seen and observed, and searched all over the world, but I have found no place of rest anywhere.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਕਹਾ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਅਉਰ ॥੯੨॥
transliteration: jin har kaa naam na chetio kahaa bhulaane aur ||92||
english: Those who do not remember the Lord's Name - why do they delude themselves in other pursuits? ||92||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sa(n)gat kareeai saadh kee a(n)t karai nirabaahu ||
english: Kabeer, associate with the Holy people, who will take you to Nirvaanaa in the end.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਹੁ ॥੯੩॥
transliteration: saakat sa(n)g na keejeeai jaa te hoi binaahu ||93||
english: Do not associate with the faithless cynics; they would bring you to ruin. ||93||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jag mahi chetio jaan kai jag mahi rahio samaai ||
english: Kabeer, I contemplate the Lord in the world; I know that He is permeating the world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਬਾਦਹਿ ਜਨਮੇਂ ਆਇ ॥੯੪॥
transliteration: jin har kaa naam na chetio baadahi janame(n) aai ||94||
english: Those who do not contemplate the Name of the Lord - their birth into this world is useless. ||94||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਆਸਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅਵਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aasaa kareeai raam kee avarai aas niraas ||
english: Kabeer, place your hopes in the Lord; other hopes lead to despair.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਮਾਨਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੯੫॥
transliteration: narak parahi te maanaee jo har naam udaas ||95||
english: Those who dissociate themselves from the Lord's Name - when they fall into hell, then they will appreciate its value. ||95||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੀਓ ਨ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sikh saakhaa bahute keee keso keeo na meet ||
english: Kabeer has made many students and disciples, but he has not made God his friend.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਲੇ ਥੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਉ ਬੀਚੈ ਅਟਕਿਓ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੯੬॥
transliteration: chaale the har milan kau beechai atakio cheet ||96||
english: He set out on a journey to meet the Lord, but his consciousness failed him half-way. ||96||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaaran bapuraa kiaa karai jau raam na karai sahaai ||
english: Kabeer, what can the poor creature do, if the Lord does not give him assistance?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਡਾਲੀ ਪਗੁ ਧਰਉ ਸੋਈ ਮੁਰਿ ਮੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੯੭॥
transliteration: jih jih daalee pag dharau soee mur mur jaai ||97||
english: Whatever branch he steps on breaks and collapses. ||97||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰਹ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਮੈ ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਰੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer avarah kau upadesate mukh mai par hai ret ||
english: Kabeer, those who only preach to others - sand falls into their mouths.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਸਿ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਰਾਖਤੇ ਖਾਯਾ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੯੮॥
transliteration: raas biraanee raakhate khaayaa ghar kaa khet ||98||
english: They keep their eyes on the property of others, while their own farm is being eaten up. ||98||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਉ ਕੀ ਭੂਸੀ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saadhoo kee sa(n)gat rahau jau kee bhoosee khaau ||
english: Kabeer, I will remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even if I have only coarse bread to eat.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੋਨਹਾਰੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਹੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥੯੯॥
transliteration: honahaar so hoihai saakat sa(n)g na jaau ||99||
english: Whatever will be, will be. I will not associate with the faithless cynics. ||99||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਦੂਨਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sa(n)gat saadh kee din din doonaa het ||
english: Kabeer, in the Saadh Sangat, love for the Lord doubles day by day.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾਰੀ ਕਾਂਬਰੀ ਧੋਏ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸੇਤੁ ॥੧੦੦॥
transliteration: saakat kaaree kaa(n)baree dhoe hoi na set ||100||
english: The faithless cynic is like a black blanket, which does not become white by being washed. ||100||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੰਡਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਕੇਸ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ਕਾਂਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer man moo(n)diaa nahee kes mu(n)daae kaa(n)i ||
english: Kabeer, you have not shaved your mind, so why do you shave your head?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮੂੰਡਾ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਅਜਾਂਇ ॥੧੦੧॥
transliteration: jo kichh keeaa so man keeaa moo(n)daa moo(n)d ajaa(n)i ||101||
english: Whatever is done, is done by the mind; it is useless to shave your head. ||101||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raam na chhodeeai tan dhan jaai ta jaau ||
english: Kabeer, do not abandon the Lord; your body and wealth shall go, so let them go.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧੦੨॥
transliteration: charan kamal chit bedhiaa raamahi naam samaau ||102||
english: My consciousness is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||102||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਹਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਬਜਾਵਤੇ ਟੂਟਿ ਗਈਂ ਸਭ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jo ham ja(n)t bajaavate toot gaee(n) sabh taar ||
english: Kabeer, all the strings of the instrument I played are broken.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੰਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਚਲੇ ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰ ॥੧੦੩॥
transliteration: ja(n)t bichaaraa kiaa karai chale bajaavanahaar ||103||
english: What can the poor instrument do, when the player has departed as well. ||103||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇ ਮੂੰਡਉ ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maai moo(n)dau tih guroo kee jaa te bharam na jaai ||
english: Kabeer, shave the mother of that guru, who does not take away one's doubt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਡੁਬੇ ਚਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਮਹਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਦੀਏ ਬਹਾਇ ॥੧੦੪॥
transliteration: aap dube chahu bed mahi chele deee bahaai ||104||
english: He himself is drowning in the four Vedas; he drowns his disciples as well. ||104||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਤਲੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jete paap keee raakhe talai duraai ||
english: Kabeer, whatever sins the mortal has committed, he tries to keep hidden under cover.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਸਭ ਜਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧੦੫॥
transliteration: paragat bhae nidaan sabh jab poochhe dharam raai ||105||
english: But in the end, they shall all be revealed, when the Righteous Judge of Dharma investigates. ||105||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran chhaad kai paalio bahut kuta(n)b ||
english: Kabeer, you have given up meditating on the Lord, and you have raised a large family.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਰਹਿਆ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ॥੧੦੬॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karataa rahi gaiaa bhaaee rahiaa na ba(n)dh ||106||
english: You continue to involve yourself in worldly affairs, but none of your brothers and relatives remain. ||106||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਗਾਵਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran chhaad kai raat jagaavan jaai ||
english: Kabeer, those who give up meditation on the Lord, and get up at night to wake the spirits of the dead,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਏ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੦੭॥
transliteration: sarapan hoi kai autarai jaae apune khaai ||107||
english: shall be reincarnated as snakes, and eat their own offspring. ||107||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਅਹੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran chhaad kai ahoee raakhai naar ||
english: Kabeer, the woman who gives up meditation on the Lord, and observes the ritual fast of Ahoi,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਦਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ ਭਾਰੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦੮॥
transliteration: gadahee hoi kai autarai bhaar sahai man chaar ||108||
english: shall be reincarnated as a donkey, to carry heavy burdens. ||108||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer chaturaaee at ghanee har jap hiradai maahi ||
english: Kabeer, it is the most clever wisdom, to chant and meditate on the Lord in the heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਖੇਲਨਾ ਗਿਰੈ ਤ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧੦੯॥
transliteration: sooree oopar khelanaa girai ta thaahar naahi ||109||
english: It is like playing on a pig; if you fall off, you will find no place of rest. ||109||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋੁਈ ਮੁਖੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer souee mukh dha(n)n hai jaa mukh kaheeai raam ||
english: Kabeer, blessed is that mouth, which utters the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਪੁਰੀ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਗ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੧੦॥
transliteration: dehee kis kee baapuree pavitr hoigo graam ||110||
english: It purifies the body, and the whole village as well. ||110||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋਈ ਕੁਲ ਭਲੀ ਜਾ ਕੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer soee kul bhalee jaa kul har ko daas ||
english: Kabeer, that family is good, in which the Lord's slave is born.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਕੁਲ ਢਾਕੁ ਪਲਾਸੁ ॥੧੧੧॥
transliteration: jih kul daas na oopajai so kul dhaak palaas ||111||
english: But that family in which the Lord's slave is not born is as useless as weeds. ||111||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹੈ ਗਇ ਬਾਹਨ ਸਘਨ ਘਨ ਲਾਖ ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer hai gai baahan saghan ghan laakh dhajaa phaharaahi ||
english: Kabeer, some have lots of horses, elephants and carriages, and thousands of banners waving.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਭਿਖੵਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧੧੨॥
transliteration: iaa sukh te bhikhyaa bhalee jau har simarat din jaahi ||112||
english: But begging is better than these comforts, if one spends his days meditating in remembrance on the Lord. ||112||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਕੰਧ ਚਢਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sabh jag hau phirio maa(n)dal ka(n)dh chadhaai ||
english: Kabeer, I have wandered all over the world, carrying the drum on my shoulder.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਬਜਾਇ ॥੧੧੩॥
transliteration: koee kaahoo ko nahee sabh dekhee thok bajaai ||113||
english: No one belongs to anyone else; I have looked and carefully studied it. ||113||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਬੀਥਰੇ ਅੰਧਾ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: maarag motee beethare a(n)dhaa nikasio aai ||
english: The pearls are scattered on the road; the blind man comes along.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਲੰਘੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੧੪॥
transliteration: jot binaa jagadees kee jagat ula(n)ghe jaai ||114||
english: Without the Light of the Lord of the Universe, the world just passes them by. ||114||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਾ ਬੰਸੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪੂਤੁ ਕਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: boodaa ba(n)s kabeer kaa upajio poot kamaal ||
english: My family is drowned, O Kabeer, since the birth of my son Kamaal.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੇ ਆਯਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧੧੫॥
transliteration: har kaa simaran chhaad kai ghar le aayaa maal ||115||
english: He has given up meditating on the Lord, in order to bring home wealth. ||115||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਨੇ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saadhoo kau milane jaaeeai saath na leejai koi ||
english: Kabeer, go out to meet the holy man; do not take anyone else with you.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧੬॥
transliteration: paachhai paau na deejeeai aagai hoi s hoi ||116||
english: Do not turn back - keep on going. Whatever will be, will be. ||116||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਤਿਹ ਮਤ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jag baadhio jih jevaree tih mat ba(n)dhahu kabeer ||
english: Kabeer, do not bind yourself with that chain, which binds the whole world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਹਹਿ ਆਟਾ ਲੋਨ ਜਿਉ ਸੋਨ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੧੧੭॥
transliteration: jaihahi aataa lon jiu son samaan sareer ||117||
english: As the salt is lost in the flour, so shall your golden body be lost. ||117||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਿਓ ਤਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਓ ਸੋਝਾਈ ਸੈਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ha(n)s udio tan gaadio sojhaaee sainaah ||
english: Kabeer, the soul-swan is flying away, and the body is being buried, and still he makes gestures.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੂ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਰੰਕਾਈ ਨੈਨਾਹ ॥੧੧੮॥
transliteration: ajahoo jeeu na chhodaee ra(n)kaaee nainaah ||118||
english: Even then, the mortal does not give up the cruel look in his eyes. ||118||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਤੁਅ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer nain nihaarau tujh kau sravan sunau tu naau ||
english: Kabeer: with my eyes, I see You, Lord; with my ears, I hear Your Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੈਨ ਉਚਰਉ ਤੁਅ ਨਾਮ ਜੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਠਾਉ ॥੧੧੯॥
transliteration: bain ucharau tu naam jee charan kamal rid thaau ||119||
english: With my tongue I chant Your Name; I enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||119||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer surag narak te mai rahio satigur ke parasaad ||
english: Kabeer, I have been spared from heaven and hell, by the Grace of the True Guru.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਮਉਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਅੰਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਆਦਿ ॥੧੨੦॥
transliteration: charan kamal kee mauj mahi rahau a(n)t ar aad ||120||
english: From beginning to end, I abide in the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||120||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਮਉਜ ਕੋ ਕਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਨਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kabeer charan kamal kee mauj ko kahi kaise unamaan ||
english: Kabeer, how can I even describe the extent of the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਬੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਾ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨੧॥
transliteration: kahibe kau sobhaa nahee dekhaa hee paravaan ||121||
english: I cannot describe its sublime glory; it has to be seen to be appreciated. ||121||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਹ ਕਹਉ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer dekh kai kih kahau kahe na ko pateeaai ||
english: Kabeer, how can I describe what I have seen? No one will believe my words.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਉਹੀ ਰਹਉ ਹਰਖਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੨੨॥
transliteration: har jaisaa taisaa uhee rahau harakh gun gaai ||122||
english: The Lord is just as He is. I dwell in delight, singing His Glorious Praises. ||122||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚੁਗੈ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ਭੀ ਚੁਗੈ ਚੁਗਿ ਚੁਗਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer chugai chitaarai bhee chugai chug chug chitaare ||
english: Kabeer, the flamingo pecks and feeds, and remembers her chicks.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਚਰਹਿ ਕੂੰਜ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧੨੩॥
transliteration: jaise bacharahi koo(n)j man maaiaa mamataa re ||123||
english: She pecks and pecks and feeds, and remembers them always. Her chicks are very dear to her, just like the love of wealth and Maya is dear to the mortal's mind. ||123||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਅੰਬਰ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਰਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kabeer a(n)bar ghanahar chhaaiaa barakh bhare sar taal ||
english: Kabeer, the sky is overcast and cloudy; the ponds and lakes are overflowing with water.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਤਰਸਤ ਰਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ ॥੧੨੪॥
transliteration: chaatrik jiu tarasat rahai tin ko kaun havaal ||124||
english: Like the rainbird, some remain thirsty - what is their condition? ||124||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਕਈ ਜਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਬੀਛੁਰੈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer chakaee jau nis beechhurai aai milai parabhaat ||
english: Kabeer, the chakvi duck is separated from her love through the night, but in the morning, she meets him again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾ ਦਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧੨੫॥
transliteration: jo nar bichhure raam siu naa din mile na raat ||125||
english: Those who are separated from the Lord do not meet Him in the day, or in the night. ||125||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰੈਨਾਇਰ ਬਿਛੋਰਿਆ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਖ ਮਝੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer rainaair bichhoriaa rahu re sa(n)kh majhoor ||
english: Kabeer: O conch shell, remain in the ocean.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵਲ ਧਾਹੜੀ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਉਗਵਤ ਸੂਰ ॥੧੨੬॥
transliteration: deval deval dhaahaRee desahi ugavat soor ||126||
english: If you are separated from it, you shall scream at sunrise from temple to temple. ||126||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾਗੁ ਰੋਇ ਭੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sootaa kiaa karahi jaag roi bhai dukh ||
english: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up and cry in fear and pain.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ ਗੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਵੈ ਸੁਖ ॥੧੨੭॥
transliteration: jaa kaa baasaa gor mahi so kiu sovai sukh ||127||
english: Those who live in the grave - how can they sleep in peace? ||127||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sootaa kiaa karahi uth k na japahi muraar ||
english: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Why not rise up and meditate on the Lord?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦਿਨ ਸੋਵਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਲਾਂਬੇ ਗੋਡ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੧੨੮॥
transliteration: ik din sovan hoigo laa(n)be god pasaar ||128||
english: One day you shall sleep with your legs outstretched. ||128||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਰਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sootaa kiaa karahi baithaa rahu ar jaag ||
english: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up, and sit up.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰਾ ਤਾ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧੨੯॥
transliteration: jaa ke sa(n)g te beechhuraa taa hee ke sa(n)g laag ||129||
english: Attach yourself to the One, from whom you have been separated. ||129||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਗੈਲ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sa(n)t kee gail na chhodeeai maarag laagaa jaau ||
english: Kabeer, do not leave the Society of the Saints; walk upon this Path.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਤ ਹੋਇ ਭੇਟਤ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੩੦॥
transliteration: pekhat hee pu(n)neet hoi bhetat japeeai naau ||130||
english: See them, and be sanctified; meet them, and chant the Name. ||130||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਦੂਰਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saakat sa(n)g na keejeeai doorahi jaaeeai bhaag ||
english: Kabeer, do not associate with the faithless cynics; run far away from them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨੁ ਕਾਰੋ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਤਉ ਕਛੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗੁ ॥੧੩੧॥
transliteration: baasan kaaro paraseeai tau kachh laagai daag ||131||
english: If you touch a vessel stained with soot, some of the soot will stick to you. ||131||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਰਾ ਪਹੂੰਚਿਓ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa raam na chetio jaraa pahoo(n)chio aai ||
english: Kabeer, you have not contemplated the Lord, and now old age has overtaken you.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੀ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਤੇ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੩੨॥
transliteration: laagee ma(n)dir duaar te ab kiaa kaadhiaa jaai ||132||
english: Now that the door of your mansion is on fire, what can you take out? ||132||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭਇਓ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaaran so bhaio jo keeno karataar ||
english: Kabeer, the Creator does whatever He pleases.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੩੩॥
transliteration: tis bin doosar ko nahee ekai sirajanahaar ||133||
english: There is none other than Him; He alone is the Creator of all. ||133||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਫਲਨਿ ਪਾਕਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਆਂਬ ॥
transliteration: kabeer phal laage phalan paakan laage aa(n)b ||
english: Kabeer, the fruit trees are bearing fruit, and the mangoes are becoming ripe.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪਹੂਚਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਉ ਜਉ ਬੀਚਿ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ਕਾਂਬ ॥੧੩੪॥
transliteration: jaai pahoochahi khasam kau jau beech na khaahee kaa(n)b ||134||
english: They will reach the owner, only if the crows do not eat them first. ||134||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੋਲਿ ਲੇ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer thaakur poojahi mol le manahath teerath jaahi ||
english: Kabeer, some buy idols and worship them; in their stubborn-mindedness, they make pilgrimages to sacred shrines.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਭਟਕਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੧੩੫॥
transliteration: dekhaa dekhee svaa(n)g dhar bhoole bhatakaa khaahi ||135||
english: They look at one another, and wear religious robes, but they are deluded and lost. ||135||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer paahan paramesur keeaa poojai sabh sa(n)saar ||
english: Kabeer, someone sets up a stone idol and all the world worships it as the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਭਰਵਾਸੇ ਜੋ ਰਹੇ ਬੂਡੇ ਕਾਲੀ ਧਾਰ ॥੧੩੬॥
transliteration: is bharavaase jo rahe boode kaalee dhaar ||136||
english: Those who hold to this belief will be drowned in the river of darkness. ||136||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੀ ਓਬਰੀ ਮਸੁ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaagad kee obaree mas ke karam kapaat ||
english: Kabeer, the paper is the prison, and the ink of rituals are the bars on the windows.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਨ ਬੋਰੀ ਪਿਰਥਮੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾੜੀ ਬਾਟ ॥੧੩੭॥
transliteration: paahan boree pirathamee pa(n)dit paaRee baat ||137||
english: The stone idols have drowned the world, and the Pandits, the religious scholars, have plundered it on the way. ||137||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਰੰਤਾ ਅਬਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਅਬ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਇ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaal kara(n)taa abahi kar ab karataa sui taal ||
english: Kabeer, that which you have to do tomorrow - do it today instead; and that which you have to do now - do it immediately!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਜਉ ਸਿਰ ਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧੩੮॥
transliteration: paachhai kachhoo na hoigaa jau sir par aavai kaal ||138||
english: Later on, you will not be able to do anything, when death hangs over your head. ||138||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜੈਸੀ ਧੋਈ ਲਾਖ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisaa ja(n)t ik dekhiaa jaisee dhoee laakh ||
english: Kabeer, I have seen a person, who is as shiny as washed wax.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਸੈ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨਾ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੧੩੯॥
transliteration: deesai cha(n)chal bahu gunaa mat heenaa naapaak ||139||
english: He seems very clever and very virtuous, but in reality, he is without understanding, and corrupt. ||139||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer meree budh kau jam na karai tisakaar ||
english: Kabeer, the Messenger of Death shall not compromise my understanding.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਮੂਆ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਸੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਪਰਵਿਦਗਾਰ ॥੧੪੦॥
transliteration: jin ihu jamooaa sirajiaa s japiaa paravidagaar ||140||
english: I have meditated on the Lord, the Cherisher, who created this Messenger of Death. ||140||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਭਇਆ ਭਵਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kasatooree bhaiaa bhavar bhae sabh daas ||
english: Kabeer, the Lord is like musk; all His slaves are like bumble bees.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧੪੧॥
transliteration: jiu jiu bhagat kabeer kee tiu tiu raam nivaas ||141||
english: The more Kabeer worships Him, the more the Lord abides within his mind. ||141||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਹਗਚਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਕੈ ਕਾਂਠੈ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਓ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer gahagach pario kuta(n)b kai kaa(n)thai rahi gaio raam ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal has fallen into the grip of family life, and the Lord has been set aside.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਪਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਬੀਚਹਿ ਧੂਮਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧੪੨॥
transliteration: aai pare dharam raai ke beechahi dhoomaa dhaam ||142||
english: The messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma descend upon the mortal, in the midst of all his pomp and ceremony. ||142||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ ਸੂਕਰ ਭਲਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਛਾ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saakat te sookar bhalaa raakhai aachhaa gaau ||
english: Kabeer, even a pig is better than the faithless cynic; at least the pig keeps the village clean.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਹੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੈਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੪੩॥
transliteration: uhu saakat bapuraa mar gaiaa koi na laihai naau ||143||
english: When the wretched, faithless cynic dies, no one even mentions his name. ||143||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਿ ਕੈ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaudee kaudee jor kai jore laakh karor ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal gathers wealth, shell by shell, accumulating thousands and millions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਲਈ ਲੰਗੋਟੀ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧੪੪॥
transliteration: chalatee baar na kachh milio laee la(n)gotee tor ||144||
english: But when the time of his departure comes, he takes nothing at all with him. He is even stripped of his loin-cloth. ||144||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਮਾਲਾ ਮੇਲੀਂ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer baisano hooaa ta kiaa bhaiaa maalaa melee(n) chaar ||
english: Kabeer, what good is it to become a devotee of Vishnu, and wear four malas?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬਾਰਹਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਰੀ ਭੰਗਾਰ ॥੧੪੫॥
transliteration: baahar ka(n)chan baarahaa bheetar bharee bha(n)gaar ||145||
english: On the outside, he may look like pure gold, but on the inside, he is stuffed with dust. ||145||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਬਾਟ ਕਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer roRaa hoi rahu baat kaa taj man kaa abhimaan ||
english: Kabeer, let yourself be a pebble on the path; abandon your egotistical pride.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੪੬॥
transliteration: aisaa koee daas hoi taahi milai bhagavaan ||146||
english: Such a humble slave shall meet the Lord God. ||146||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰੋੜਾ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਪੰਥੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer roRaa hooaa ta kiaa bhaiaa pa(n)thee kau dukh dei ||
english: Kabeer, what good would it be, to be a pebble? It would only hurt the traveller on the path.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੪੭॥
transliteration: aisaa teraa daas hai jiu dharanee mahi kheh ||147||
english: Your slave, O Lord, is like the dust of the earth. ||147||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਖੇਹ ਹੂਈ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਜਉ ਉਡਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਅੰਗ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kheh hooee tau kiaa bhaiaa jau ud laagai a(n)g ||
english: Kabeer, what then, if one could become dust? It is blown up by the wind, and sticks to the body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਚਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਸਰਬੰਗ ॥੧੪੮॥
transliteration: har jan aisaa chaaheeai jiu paanee saraba(n)g ||148||
english: The humble servant of the Lord should be like water, which cleans everything. ||148||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਨੀ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਸੀਰਾ ਤਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer paanee hooaa ta kiaa bhaiaa seeraa taataa hoi ||
english: Kabeer, what then, if one could become water? It becomes cold, then hot.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਚਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪੯॥
transliteration: har jan aisaa chaaheeai jaisaa har hee hoi ||149||
english: The humble servant of the Lord should be just like the Lord. ||149||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਭਵਨ ਕਨਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ooch bhavan kanakaamanee sikhar dhajaa phaharaai ||
english: The banners wave above the lofty mansions, filled with gold and beautiful women.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਭਲੀ ਮਧੂਕਰੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੫੦॥
transliteration: taa te bhalee madhookaree sa(n)tasa(n)g gun gaai ||150||
english: But better than these is dry bread, if one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Society of the Saints. ||150||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਟਨ ਤੇ ਊਜਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer paatan te oojar bhalaa raam bhagat jih thaai ||
english: Kabeer, the wilderness is better than a city, if the Lord's devotees live there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਮ ਪੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਂਇ ॥੧੫੧॥
transliteration: raam sanehee baaharaa jam pur mere bhaa(n)i ||151||
english: Without my Beloved Lord, it is like the City of Death for me. ||151||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨ ਕੇ ਘਾਟ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ga(n)g jamun ke a(n)tare sahaj su(n)n ke ghaat ||
english: Kabeer, between the Ganges and Jamunaa Rivers, on the shore of Celestial Silence,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਕਬੀਰੈ ਮਟੁ ਕੀਆ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਬਾਟ ॥੧੫੨॥
transliteration: tahaa kabeerai mat keeaa khojat mun jan baat ||152||
english: there, Kabeer has made his home. The silent sages and the humble servants of the Lord search for the way to get there. ||152||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੈਸੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਪੇਡ ਤੇ ਜਉ ਤੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਓੜਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jaisee upajee ped te jau taisee nibahai oR ||
english: Kabeer, if the mortal continues to love the Lord in the end, as he pledged in the beginning,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਬਾਪੁਰਾ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਨ ਰਤਨ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥੧੫੩॥
transliteration: heeraa kis kaa baapuraa pujahi na ratan karoR ||153||
english: no poor diamond, not even millions of jewels, can equal him. ||153||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਟ ਬਿਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa ek acha(n)bhau dekhio heeraa haat bikaai ||
english: Kabeer, I saw a strange and wonderful thing. A jewel was being sold in a store.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਨਜਨਹਾਰੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੫੪॥
transliteration: banajanahaare baaharaa kaudee badalai jaai ||154||
english: Because there was no buyer, it was going in exchange for a shell. ||154||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਜਹਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਹ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਹ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa jahaa giaan tah dharam hai jahaa jhooth tah paap ||
english: Kabeer, where there is spiritual wisdom, there is righteousness and Dharma. Where there is falsehood, there is sin.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਹ ਕਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥੧੫੫॥
transliteration: jahaa lobh tah kaal hai jahaa khimaa tah aap ||155||
english: Where there is greed, there is death. Where there is forgiveness, there is God Himself. ||155||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਜੀ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਜਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer maaiaa tajee ta kiaa bhaiaa jau maan tajiaa nahee jaai ||
english: Kabeer, what good is it to give up Maya, if the mortal does not give up his pride?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੁਨੀ ਮੁਨਿਵਰ ਗਲੇ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੫੬॥
transliteration: maan munee munivar gale maan sabhai kau khaai ||156||
english: Even the silent sages and seers are destroyed by pride; pride eats up everything. ||156||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਜੁ ਬਾਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saachaa satigur mai miliaa sabad j baahiaa ek ||
english: Kabeer, the True Guru has met me; He aimed the Arrow of the Shabad at me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਭੁਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਕਲੇਜੇ ਛੇਕੁ ॥੧੫੭॥
transliteration: laagat hee bhui mil gaiaa pariaa kaleje chhek ||157||
english: As soon as it struck me, I fell to the ground with a hole in my heart. ||157||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਸਿਖਾ ਮਹਿ ਚੂਕ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saachaa satigur kiaa karai jau sikhaa mahi chook ||
english: Kabeer, what can the True Guru do, when His Sikhs are at fault?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਕ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਬਜਾਈਐ ਫੂਕ ॥੧੫੮॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe ek na laagaee jiu baa(n)s bajaaeeai phook ||158||
english: The blind do not take in any of His Teachings; it is as useless as blowing into bamboo. ||158||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹੈ ਗੈ ਬਾਹਨ ਸਘਨ ਘਨ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer hai gai baahan saghan ghan chhatrapatee kee naar ||
english: Kabeer, the wife of the king has all sorts of horses, elephants and carriages.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾਸੁ ਪਟੰਤਰ ਨਾ ਪੁਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੫੯॥
transliteration: taas pata(n)tar naa pujai har jan kee panihaar ||159||
english: But she is not equal to the water-carrier of the Lord's humble servant. ||159||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਨਾਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਨਿੰਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਰੀ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer nrip naaree kiu ni(n)deeai kiu har cheree kau maan ||
english: Kabeer, why do you slander the wife of the king? Why do you honor the slave of the Lord?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਮਾਂਗ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਕਉ ਓਹ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੬੦॥
transliteration: oh maa(n)g savaarai bikhai kau oh simarai har naam ||160||
english: Because one combs her hair for corruption, while the other remembers the Name of the Lord. ||160||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਥੂਨੀ ਪਾਈ ਥਿਤਿ ਭਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧੀ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer thoonee paaee thit bhaee satigur ba(n)dhee dheer ||
english: Kabeer, with the Support of the Lord's Pillar, I have become steady and stable.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹੀਰਾ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਤੀਰ ॥੧੬੧॥
transliteration: kabeer heeraa banajiaa maan sarovar teer ||161||
english: The True Guru has given me courage. Kabeer, I have purchased the diamond, on the banks of the Mansarovar Lake. ||161||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਜਨ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਲੇ ਕੈ ਮਾਂਡੈ ਹਾਟ ॥
transliteration: kabeer har heeraa jan jauharee le kai maa(n)dai haat ||
english: Kabeer, the Lord is the Diamond, and the Lord's humble servant is the jeweller who has set up his shop.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਤਬ ਹੀਰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਟ ॥੧੬੨॥
transliteration: jab hee paaeeahi paarakhoo tab heeran kee saat ||162||
english: As soon as an appraiser is found, the price of the jewel is set. ||162||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਮ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaam pare har simareeai aisaa simarahu nit ||
english: Kabeer, you remember the Lord in meditation, only when the need arises. You should remember Him all the time.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰ ਬਾਸਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਬਹੋਰੈ ਬਿਤ ॥੧੬੩॥
transliteration: amaraa pur baasaa karahu har gaiaa bahorai bit ||163||
english: You shall dwell in the city of immortality, and the Lord shall restore the wealth you lost. ||163||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਇ ਭਲੇ ਏਕੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sevaa kau dui bhale ek sa(n)t ik raam ||
english: Kabeer, it is good to perform selfless service for two - the Saints and the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੋ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੬੪॥
transliteration: raam j daataa mukat ko sa(n)t japaavai naam ||164||
english: The Lord is the Giver of liberation, and the Saint inspires us to chant the Naam. ||164||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗਏ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੀ ਬਹੀਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jih maarag pa(n)dit gae paachhai paree baheer ||
english: Kabeer, the crowds follow the path which the Pandits, the religious scholars, have taken.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਅਵਘਟ ਘਾਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਹ ਚੜਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੧੬੫॥
transliteration: ik avaghat ghaatee raam kee tih chaR rahio kabeer ||165||
english: There is a difficult and treacherous cliff on that path to the Lord; Kabeer is climbing that cliff. ||165||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੇ ਮੂਆ ਚਾਲਤ ਕੁਲ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer duneeaa ke dokhe mooaa chaalat kul kee kaan ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal dies of his worldly troubles and pain, after worrying about his family.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਕੁਲੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਜਸੀ ਜਬ ਲੇ ਧਰਹਿ ਮਸਾਨਿ ॥੧੬੬॥
transliteration: tab kul kis kaa laajasee jab le dharahi masaan ||166||
english: Whose family is dishonored, when he is placed on the funeral pyre? ||166||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਡੂਬਹਿਗੋ ਰੇ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer doobahigo re baapure bahu logan kee kaan ||
english: Kabeer, you shall drown, you wretched being, from worrying about what other people think.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰੋਸੀ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹੂਆ ਤੂ ਅਪਨੇ ਭੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧੬੭॥
transliteration: paarosee ke jo hooaa too apane bhee jaan ||167||
english: You know that whatever happens to your neighbors, will also happen to you. ||167||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਲੀ ਮਧੂਕਰੀ ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer bhalee madhookaree naanaa bidh ko naaj ||
english: Kabeer, even dry bread, made of various grains, is good.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਾਵਾ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਡਾ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਡ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੧੬੮॥
transliteration: daavaa kaahoo ko nahee badaa des bad raaj ||168||
english: No one brags about it, throughout the vast country and great empire. ||168||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਵੈ ਦਾਝਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਦਾਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਸੰਕ ॥
transliteration: kabeer daavai daajhan hot hai niradaavai rahai nisa(n)k ||
english: Kabeer, those who brag, shall burn. Those who do not brag remain carefree.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਦਾਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਗਨੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਰੰਕ ॥੧੬੯॥
transliteration: jo jan niradaavai rahai so ganai i(n)dr so ra(n)k ||169||
english: That humble being who does not brag, looks upon the gods and the poor alike. ||169||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਲਿ ਸਮੁਹਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਭਰਾ ਪੀ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer paal samuhaa saravar bharaa pee na sakai koee neer ||
english: Kabeer, the pool is filled to overflowing, but no one can drink the water from it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗ ਬਡੇ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਤੂੰ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪੀਉ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੧੭੦॥
transliteration: bhaag bade tai paaio too(n) bhar bhar peeu kabeer ||170||
english: By great good fortune, you have found it; drink it in handfuls, O Kabeer. ||170||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਖਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਇਹੁ ਖਿਸੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer parabhaate taare khisahi tiu ihu khisai sareer ||
english: Kabeer, just as the stars disappear at dawn, so shall this body disappear.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏ ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ ਨਾ ਖਿਸਹਿ ਸੋ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੧੭੧॥
transliteration: e dui akhar naa khisahi so gahi rahio kabeer ||171||
english: Only the letters of God's Name do not disappear; Kabeer holds these tight. ||171||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋਠੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kothee kaath kee dah dis laagee aag ||
english: Kabeer, the wooden house is burning on all sides.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜਲਿ ਮੂਏ ਮੂਰਖ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਗਿ ॥੧੭੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit pa(n)dit jal mooe moorakh ubare bhaag ||172||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, have been burnt to death, while the illiterate ones run to safety. ||172||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਾਗਦ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sa(n)saa door kar kaagad deh bihaai ||
english: Kabeer, give up your skepticism; let your papers float away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧੭੩॥
transliteration: baavan akhar sodh kai har charanee chit laai ||173||
english: Find the essence of the letters of the alphabet, and focus your consciousness on the Lord. ||173||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਛਾਡੈ ਸੰਤਈ ਜਉ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਅਸੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sa(n)t na chhaadai sa(n)taee jau kotik milahi asa(n)t ||
english: Kabeer, the Saint does not forsake his Saintly nature, even though he meets with millions of evil-doers.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਲਿਆਗਰੁ ਭੁਯੰਗਮ ਬੇਢਿਓ ਤ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਨ ਤਜੰਤ ॥੧੭੪॥
transliteration: maliaagar bhuya(n)gam bedhio ta seetalataa na taja(n)t ||174||
english: Even when sandalwood is surrounded by snakes, it does not give up its cooling fragrance. ||174||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer man seetal bhaiaa paaiaa braham giaan ||
english: Kabeer, my mind is cooled and soothed; I have become God-conscious.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਰਿਆ ਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਉਦਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥੧੭੫॥
transliteration: jin juaalaa jag jaariaa s jan ke udak samaan ||175||
english: The fire which has burnt the world is like water to the Lord's humble servant. ||175||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਰੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saaree sirajanahaar kee jaanai naahee koi ||
english: Kabeer, no one knows the Play of the Creator Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਨ ਧਨੀ ਕੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਦੀਵਾਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੭੬॥
transliteration: kai jaanai aapan dhanee kai daas deevaanee hoi ||176||
english: Only the Lord Himself and the slaves at His Court understand it. ||176||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਲੀ ਭਈ ਜੋ ਭਉ ਪਰਿਆ ਦਿਸਾ ਗਈਁ ਸਭ ਭੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer bhalee bhaee jo bhau pariaa disaa gaee(n) sabh bhool ||
english: Kabeer, it is good that I feel the Fear of God; I have forgotten everything else.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਰਾ ਗਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ਭਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਢਲਿ ਕੂਲਿ ॥੧੭੭॥
transliteration: oraa gar paanee bhaiaa jaai milio dhal kool ||177||
english: The hail-stone has melted into water, and flowed into the ocean. ||177||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਕੇਲਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa dhoor sakel kai pureeaa baa(n)dhee deh ||
english: Kabeer, the body is a pile of dust, collected and packed together.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੋ ਪੇਖਨਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਖੇਹ ਕੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੭੮॥
transliteration: divas chaar ko pekhanaa a(n)t kheh kee kheh ||178||
english: It is a show which lasts for only a few days, and then dust returns to dust. ||178||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਰਜ ਚਾਂਦ ਕੈ ਉਦੈ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: kabeer sooraj chaa(n)d kai udai bhaee sabh deh ||
english: Kabeer, bodies are like the rising and setting of the sun and the moon.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਲਟਿ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੭੯॥
transliteration: gur gobi(n)d ke bin mile palat bhaee sabh kheh ||179||
english: Without meeting the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, they are all reduced to dust again. ||179||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਨਭਉ ਤਹ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਭਉ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jah anabhau tah bhai nahee jah bhau tah har naahi ||
english: Where the Fearless Lord is, there is no fear; where there is fear, the Lord is not there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧੮੦॥
transliteration: kahio kabeer bichaar kai sa(n)t sunahu man maahi ||180||
english: Kabeer speaks after careful consideration; hear this, O Saints, in your minds. ||180||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਨਹੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਨੀਦ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jinahu kichhoo jaaniaa nahee tin sukh need bihaai ||
english: Kabeer, those who do not know anything, pass their lives in peaceful sleep.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਹੁ ਜੁ ਬੂਝਾ ਬੂਝਨਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੧੮੧॥
transliteration: hamahu j boojhaa boojhanaa pooree paree balaai ||181||
english: But I have understood the riddle; I am faced with all sorts of troubles. ||181||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਅਉਰ ॥
