transliteration: kabeer maare bahut pukaariaa peer pukaarai aur ||
english: Kabeer, those who are beaten cry a lot; but the cries of the pain of separation are different.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੀ ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਠਉਰ ॥੧੮੨॥
transliteration: laagee chot mara(n)m kee rahio kabeeraa thaur ||182||
english: Struck by the Mystery of God, Kabeer remains silent. ||182||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚੋਟ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਸੇਲ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਤ ਲੇਇ ਉਸਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kabeer chot suhelee sel kee laagat lei usaas ||
english: Kabeer, the stroke of a lance is easy to bear; it takes away the breath.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੋਟ ਸਹਾਰੈ ਸਬਦ ਕੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਦਾਸ ॥੧੮੩॥
transliteration: chot sahaarai sabad kee taas guroo mai daas ||183||
english: But one who endures the stroke of the Word of the Shabad is the Guru, and I am his slave. ||183||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਮੁਨਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਢਹਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਨ ਬਹਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer mulaa(n) munaare kiaa chadhahi saa(n)ee na baharaa hoi ||
english: Kabeer: O Mullah, why do you climb to the top of the minaret? The Lord is not hard of hearing.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਂਗ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਲ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋਇ ॥੧੮੪॥
transliteration: jaa kaaran too(n) baa(n)g dehi dil hee bheetar joi ||184||
english: Look within your own heart for the One, for whose sake you shout your prayers. ||184||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sekh sabooree baaharaa kiaa haj kaabe jaai ||
english: Why does the Shaykh bother to go on pilgrimage to Mecca, if he is not content with himself?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਿਲ ਸਾਬਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਾਂ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧੮੫॥
transliteration: kabeer jaa kee dil saabat nahee taa kau kahaa(n) khudaai ||185||
english: Kabeer, one whose heart is not healthy and whole - how can he attain his Lord? ||185||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਅਲਹ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer alah kee kar ba(n)dagee jih simarat dukh jaai ||
english: Kabeer, worship the Lord Allah; meditating in remembrance on Him, troubles and pains depart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਪਰਗਟੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਲੰਤੀ ਨਾਂਇ ॥੧੮੬॥
transliteration: dil mahi saa(n)ee paragatai bujhai bala(n)tee naa(n)i ||186||
english: The Lord shall be revealed within your own heart, and the burning fire within shall be extinguished by His Name. ||186||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋਰੀ ਕੀਏ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਹਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer joree keee julam hai kahataa naau halaal ||
english: Kabeer, to use force is tyranny, even if you call it legal.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਫਤਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਂਗੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ ॥੧੮੭॥
transliteration: daphatar lekhaa maa(n)geeai tab hoigo kaun havaal ||187||
english: When your account is called for in the Court of the Lord, what will your condition be then? ||187||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਖੂਬੁ ਖਾਨਾ ਖੀਚਰੀ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੋਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer khoob khaanaa kheecharee jaa mahi a(n)mrit lon ||
english: Kabeer, the dinner of beans and rice is excellent, if it is flavored with salt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੇਰਾ ਰੋਟੀ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਗਲਾ ਕਟਾਵੈ ਕਉਨੁ ॥੧੮੮॥
transliteration: heraa rotee kaarane galaa kataavai kaun ||188||
english: Who would cut his throat, to have meat with his bread? ||188||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਮਿਟੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: kabeer gur laagaa tab jaaneeai mitai mohu tan taap ||
english: Kabeer, one is known to have been touched by the Guru, only when his emotional attachment and physical illnesses are eradicated.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦਾਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥੧੮੯॥
transliteration: harakh sog daajhai nahee tab har aapahi aap ||189||
english: He is not burned by pleasure or pain, and so he becomes the Lord Himself. ||189||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raam kahan mahi bhed hai taa mahi ek bichaar ||
english: Kabeer, it does make a difference, how you chant the Lord's Name, 'Raam'. This is something to consider.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਉਤਕਹਾਰ ॥੧੯੦॥
transliteration: soee raam sabhai kahahi soee kautakahaar ||190||
english: Everyone uses the same word for the son of Dasrath and the Wondrous Lord. ||190||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਿਬੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raamai raam kahu kahibe maahi bibek ||
english: Kabeer, use the word 'Raam', only to speak of the All-pervading Lord. You must make that distinction.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਇਆ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਏਕ ॥੧੯੧॥
transliteration: ek anekahi mil gaiaa ek samaanaa ek ||191||
english: One 'Raam' is pervading everywhere, while the other is contained only in himself. ||191||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਘਰ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਸੇਵੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jaa ghar saadh na seveeahi har kee sevaa naahi ||
english: Kabeer, those houses in which neither the Holy nor the Lord are served

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਘਰ ਮਰਹਟ ਸਾਰਖੇ ਭੂਤ ਬਸਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧੯੨॥
transliteration: te ghar marahat saarakhe bhoot basahi tin maahi ||192||
english: - those houses are like cremation grounds; demons dwell within them. ||192||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਹੂਆ ਬਾਵਰਾ ਬਹਰਾ ਹੂਆ ਕਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kabeer goo(n)gaa hooaa baavaraa baharaa hooaa kaan ||
english: Kabeer, I have become mute, insane and deaf.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇ ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਭਇਆ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਨ ॥੧੯੩॥
transliteration: paavahu te pi(n)gul bhaiaa maariaa satigur baan ||193||
english: I am crippled - the True Guru has pierced me with His Arrow. ||193||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੂਰਮੇ ਬਾਹਿਆ ਬਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer satigur soorame baahiaa baan j ek ||
english: Kabeer, the True Guru, the Spiritual Warrior, has shot me with His Arrow.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਭੁਇ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਪਰਾ ਕਰੇਜੇ ਛੇਕੁ ॥੧੯੪॥
transliteration: laagat hee bhui gir pariaa paraa kareje chhek ||194||
english: As soon as it struck me, I fell to the ground, with a hole in my heart. ||194||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਪਰਿ ਗਈ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer niramal boo(n)d akaas kee par gaee bhoom bikaar ||
english: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, onto the dirty ground.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਉ ਮਾਂਨਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਈ ਭਠ ਛਾਰ ॥੧੯੫॥
transliteration: bin sa(n)gat iu maa(n)naee hoi gaee bhath chhaar ||195||
english: You must acknowledge this, that without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, it turns into burnt ashes. ||195||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer niramal boo(n)d akaas kee leenee bhoom milaai ||
english: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, and mixes with the dust.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪਚਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੯੬॥
transliteration: anik siaane pach gae naa niravaaree jaai ||196||
english: Millions of clever people may try, but they will fail - it cannot be made separate again. ||196||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਥਾ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer haj kaabe hau jaai thaa aagai miliaa khudaai ||
english: Kabeer, I was going on a pilgrimage to Mecca, and God met me on the way.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝ ਸਿਉ ਲਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਿਨੑਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੯੭॥
transliteration: saa(n)ee mujh siu lar pariaa tujhai kinhi phuramaaee gaai ||197||
english: He scolded me and asked, "Who told you that I am only there?" ||197||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਕੇਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer haj kaabai hoi hoi gaiaa ketee baar kabeer ||
english: Kabeer, I went to Mecca - how many times, Kabeer?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਖਤਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧੯੮॥
transliteration: saa(n)ee mujh mahi kiaa khataa mukhahu na bolai peer ||198||
english: O Lord, what is the problem with me? You have not spoken to me with Your Mouth. ||198||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਅ ਜੁ ਮਾਰਹਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਤੇ ਹਹਿ ਜੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jee j maarahi jor kar kahate hahi j halaal ||
english: Kabeer, they oppress living beings and kill them, and call it proper.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਫਤਰੁ ਦਈ ਜਬ ਕਾਢਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ ॥੧੯੯॥
transliteration: daphatar daee jab kaadh hai hoigaa kaun havaal ||199||
english: When the Lord calls for their account, what will their condition be? ||199||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੈ ਲੇਇ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jor keeaa so julam hai lei jabaab khudaai ||
english: Kabeer, it is tyranny to use force; the Lord shall call you to account.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਫਤਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨੀਕਸੈ ਮਾਰ ਮੁਹੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੦੦॥
transliteration: daphatar lekhaa neekasai maar muhai muhi khaai ||200||
english: When your account is called for, your face and mouth shall be beaten. ||200||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਸੂਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer lekhaa denaa suhelaa jau dil soochee hoi ||
english: Kabeer, it is easy to render your account, if your heart is pure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਲਾ ਨ ਪਕਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨੦੧॥
transliteration: us saache deebaan mahi palaa na pakarai koi ||201||
english: In the True Court of the Lord, no one will seize you. ||201||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰ ਬਰੀ ਅਬਧ ॥
transliteration: kabeer dharatee ar aakaas mahi dui too(n) baree abadh ||
english: Kabeer: O duality, you are mighty and powerful in the earth and the sky.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਸੇ ਪਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ॥੨੦੨॥
transliteration: khat darasan sa(n)se pare ar chauraaseeh sidh ||202||
english: The six Shaastras and the eighty-four Siddhas are entrenched in skepticism. ||202||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kabeer meraa mujh mahi kichh nahee jo kichh hai so teraa ||
english: Kabeer, nothing is mine within myself. Whatever there is, is Yours, O Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸਉਪਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨੦੩॥
transliteration: teraa tujh kau saupate kiaa laagai meraa ||203||
english: If I surrender to You what is already Yours, what does it cost me? ||203||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੂਆ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਾ ਨ ਹੂੰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer too(n) too(n) karataa too hooaa mujh mahi rahaa na hoo(n) ||
english: Kabeer, repeating, "You, You", I have become like You. Nothing of me remains in myself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਪਾ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤੂ ॥੨੦੪॥
transliteration: jab aapaa par kaa mit gaiaa jat dekhau tat too ||204||
english: When the difference between myself and others is removed, then wherever I look, I see only You. ||204||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਹ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: kabeer bikaarah chitavate jhoothe karate aas ||
english: Kabeer, those who think of evil and entertain false hopes

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੂਰਿਓ ਚਾਲੇ ਊਠਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥੨੦੫॥
transliteration: manorath koi na poorio chaale ooth niraas ||205||
english: - none of their desires shall be fulfilled; they shall depart in despair. ||205||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran jo karai so sukheeaa sa(n)saar ||
english: Kabeer, whoever meditates in remembrance on the Lord, he alone is happy in this world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਜਿਸ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥੨੦੬॥
transliteration: it ut katahi na dolaee jis raakhai sirajanahaar ||206||
english: One who is protected and saved by the Creator Lord, shall never waver, here or hereafter. ||206||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ghaanee peeRate satigur leee chhadaai ||
english: Kabeer, I was being crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press, but the True Guru saved me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਆਇ ॥੨੦੭॥
transliteration: paraa poorabalee bhaavanee paragat hoee aai ||207||
english: My pre-ordained primal destiny has now been revealed. ||207||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਟਾਲੈ ਟੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਆਜੁ ਬਢੰਤਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer taalai tolai din gaiaa biaaj badha(n)tau jaai ||
english: Kabeer, my days have passed, and I have postponed my payments; the interest on my account continues to increase.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਖਤੁ ਫਟਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਹੂੰਚੋ ਆਇ ॥੨੦੮॥
transliteration: naa har bhajio na khat phatio kaal pahoo(n)cho aai ||208||
english: I have not meditated on the Lord and my account is still pending, and now, the moment of my death has come! ||208||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਭਉਕਨਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਪਿਛੈ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kookar bhaukanaa kara(n)g pichhai uth dhaai ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal is a barking dog, chasing after a carcass.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨੦੯॥
transliteration: karamee satigur paaiaa jin hau leeaa chhadaai ||209||
english: By the Grace of good karma, I have found the True Guru, who has saved me. ||209||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer dharatee saadh kee tasakar baisahi gaahi ||
english: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but it is being occupied by thieves.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੨੧੦॥
transliteration: dharatee bhaar na biaapaee un kau laahoo laahi ||210||
english: They are not a burden to the earth; they receive its blessings. ||210||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee laai ||
english: Kabeer, the rice is beaten with a mallet to get rid of the husk.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਬੈਸਤੇ ਤਬ ਪੂਛੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੨੧੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)g kusa(n)gee baisate tab poochhai dharam raai ||211||
english: When people sit in evil company, the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls them to account. ||211||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹੈ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: naamaa maaiaa mohiaa kahai tilochan meet ||
english: Trilochan says, O Naam Dayv, Maya has enticed you, my friend.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਛੀਪਹੁ ਛਾਇਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੨੧੨॥
transliteration: kaahe chheepahu chhaailai raam na laavahu cheet ||212||
english: Why are you printing designs on these sheets, and not focusing your consciousness on the Lord? ||212||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਤਿਲੋਚਨਾ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: naamaa kahai tilochanaa mukh te raam sa(n)mhaal ||
english: Naam Dayv answers, O Trilochan, chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨੧੩॥
transliteration: haath paau kar kaam sabh cheet nira(n)jan naal ||213||
english: With your hands and feet, do all your work, but let your consciousness remain with the Immaculate Lord. ||213||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa hamaraa ko nahee ham kis hoo ke naahi ||
english: Kabeer, no one belongs to me, and I belong to no one else.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੧੪॥
transliteration: jin ihu rachan rachaaiaa tis hee maahi samaahi ||214||
english: The One who created the creation - into Him I shall be absorbed. ||214||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀਚੜਿ ਆਟਾ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: kabeer keechaR aataa gir pariaa kichhoo na aaio haath ||
english: Kabeer, the flour has fallen into the mud; nothing has come into my hands.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੀਸਤ ਪੀਸਤ ਚਾਬਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਬਹਿਆ ਸਾਥ ॥੨੧੫॥
transliteration: peesat peesat chaabiaa soee nibahiaa saath ||215||
english: That which was eaten while it was being ground - that alone is of any use. ||215||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੀ ਅਉਗਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kabeer man jaanai sabh baat jaanat hee augan karai ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal knows everything, and knowing, he still makes mistakes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਕੁਸਲਾਤ ਹਾਥਿ ਦੀਪੁ ਕੂਏ ਪਰੈ ॥੨੧੬॥
transliteration: kaahe kee kusalaat haath deep kooe parai ||216||
english: What good is a lamp in one's hand, if he falls into the well? ||216||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਰਜੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer laagee preet sujaan siu barajai log ajaan ||
english: Kabeer, I am in love with the All-knowing Lord; the ignorant ones try to hold me back.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਟੂਟੀ ਕਿਉ ਬਨੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੨੧੭॥
transliteration: taa siu tootee kiu banai jaa ke jee paraan ||217||
english: How could I ever break with the One, who owns our soul and breath of life. ||217||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kothe ma(n)dap het kar kaahe marahu savaar ||
english: Kabeer, why kill yourself for your love of decorations of your home and mansion?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਹਥ ਘਨੀ ਤ ਪਉਨੇ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੨੧੮॥
transliteration: kaaraj saadhe teen hath ghanee ta paune chaar ||218||
english: In the end, only six feet, or a little more, shall be your lot. ||218||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਨਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਿਤਵੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jo mai chitavau naa karai kiaa mere chitave hoi ||
english: Kabeer, whatever I wish for does not happen. What can I accomplish by merely thinking?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਚਿਤਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੧੯॥
transliteration: apanaa chitaviaa har karai jo mere chit na hoi ||219||
english: The Lord does whatever He wishes; it is not up to me at all. ||219||

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa bh aap karaaisee achi(n)t bh aape dei ||
english: God Himself makes the mortals anxious, and He Himself takes the anxiety away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai j sabhanaa saar karei ||220||
english: O Nanak, praise the One, who takes care of all. ||220||

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਲਾਲਚ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raam na chetio phiriaa laalach maahi ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal does not remember the Lord; he wanders around, engrossed in greed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਅਉਧ ਪੁਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੨੧॥
transliteration: paap kara(n)taa mar gaiaa audh punee khin maahi ||221||
english: Committing sins, he dies, and his life ends in an instant. ||221||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਚੀ ਕਾਰਵੀ ਕੇਵਲ ਕਾਚੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaaiaa kaachee kaaravee keval kaachee dhaat ||
english: Kabeer, the body is like a clay vessel or a brittle metal pot.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਤ ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੨੨੨॥
transliteration: saabat rakhahi ta raam bhaj naahi ta binathee baat ||222||
english: If you wish to keep it safe and sound, then vibrate and meditate on the Lord; otherwise, the thing shall break. ||222||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੂਕੀਐ ਨ ਸੋਈਐ ਅਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabeer keso keso kookeeai na soeeai asaar ||
english: Kabeer, chant the Name of the Beautifully-haired Lord; do not sleep unaware.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਕੇ ਕੂਕਨੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੇ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥੨੨੩॥
transliteration: raat divas ke kookane kabahoo ke sunai pukaar ||223||
english: Chanting His Name night and day, the Lord will eventually hear your call. ||223||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਜਲੀ ਬਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਮਯ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaaiaa kajalee ban bhaiaa man ku(n)char may ma(n)t ||
english: Kabeer, the body is a banana forest, and the mind is an intoxicated elephant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਕਸੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਸੰਤੁ ॥੨੨੪॥
transliteration: a(n)kas gyaan ratan hai khevat biralaa sa(n)t ||224||
english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is the prod, and the rare Saint is the rider. ||224||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੋਥਰੀ ਪਾਰਖ ਆਗੈ ਖੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raam ratan mukh kotharee paarakh aagai khol ||
english: Kabeer, the Lord's Name is the jewel, and the mouth is the purse; open this purse to the Appraiser.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈਗੋ ਗਾਹਕੀ ਲੇਗੋ ਮਹਗੇ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੨੨੫॥
transliteration: koee aai milaigo gaahakee lego mahage mol ||225||
english: If a buyer can be found, it will go for a high price. ||225||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਕਟਕੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer raam naam jaanio nahee paalio katak kuta(n)b ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal does not know the Lord's Name, but he has raised a very large family.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੇ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਬੰਬ ॥੨੨੬॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhe hee mahi mar gaio baahar bhaee na ba(n)b ||226||
english: He dies in the midst of his worldly affairs, and then he is not heard in the external world. ||226||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਆਖੀ ਕੇਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਕੇ ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਗਈ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aakhee kere maatuke pal pal gaee bihaai ||
english: Kabeer, in the blink of an eye, moment by moment, life is passing by.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਜਮ ਦੀਆ ਦਮਾਮਾ ਆਇ ॥੨੨੭॥
transliteration: man ja(n)jaal na chhodaee jam deeaa damaamaa aai ||227||
english: The mortal does not give up his worldly entanglements; the Messenger of Death walks in and beats the drum. ||227||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਤਰਵਰ ਰੂਪੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਫਲ ਰੂਪੀ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer taravar roopee raam hai phal roopee bairaag ||
english: Kabeer, the Lord is the tree, and disillusionment with the world is the fruit.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਾਇਆ ਰੂਪੀ ਸਾਧੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ॥੨੨੮॥
transliteration: chhaaiaa roopee saadh hai jin tajiaa baad bibaad ||228||
english: The Holy man, who has abandoned useless arguments, is the shade of the tree. ||228||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਇ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਫਲੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kabeer aisaa beej boi baarah maas phala(n)t ||
english: Kabeer, plant the seeds of such a plant, which shall bear fruit throughout the twelve months,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਛਾਇਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਫਲ ਪੰਖੀ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤ ॥੨੨੯॥
transliteration: seetal chhaaiaa gahir phal pa(n)khee kel kara(n)t ||229||
english: with cooling shade and abundant fruit, upon which birds joyously play. ||229||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਦਯਾ ਫਲੁ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kabeer daataa taravar dayaa phal upakaaree jeeva(n)t ||
english: Kabeer, the Great Giver is the tree, which blesses all with the fruit of compassion.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਚਲੇ ਦਿਸਾਵਰੀ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਤ ॥੨੩੦॥
transliteration: pa(n)khee chale disaavaree birakhaa suphal phala(n)t ||230||
english: When the birds migrate to other lands, O Tree, you bear the fruits. ||230||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
transliteration: kabeer saadhoo sa(n)g paraapatee likhiaa hoi lilaat ||
english: Kabeer, the mortal finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, if he has such destiny written upon his forehead.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਅਵਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥੨੩੧॥
transliteration: mukat padaarath paaeeai thaak na avaghat ghaat ||231||
english: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and the difficult road to the Lord is not blocked. ||231||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੰਨੑਿ ਉਠਾਈ ਪੋਟਲੀ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਘਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ba(n)nhi uthaaee potalee kithai va(n)njaa ghat ||2||
english: I am so accustomed to walking in the ways of the world. I have tied and picked up the bundle; where can I go to throw it away? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਆਧੀ ਘਰੀ ਆਧੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਆਧ ॥
transliteration: kabeer ek ghaRee aadhee gharee aadhee hoo(n) te aadh ||
english: Kabeer, whether is is for an hour, half an hour, or half of that,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਗੋਸਟੇ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੋ ਲਾਭ ॥੨੩੨॥
transliteration: bhagatan setee gosate jo keene so laabh ||232||
english: whatever it is, it is worthwhile to speak with the Holy. ||232||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਾਂਗ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਸੁਰਾ ਪਾਨਿ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਖਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer bhaa(n)g maachhulee suraa paan jo jo praanee khaa(n)hi ||
english: Kabeer, those mortals who consume marijuana, fish and wine

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕੀਏ ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੨੩੩॥
transliteration: teerath barat nem keee te sabhai rasaatal jaa(n)hi ||233||
english: - no matter what pilgrimages, fasts and rituals they follow, they will all go to hell. ||233||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਉ ਲੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: neeche loin kar rahau le saajan ghat maahi ||
english: Kabeer, I keep my eyes lowered, and enshrine my Friend within my heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਖੇਲਉ ਪੀਅ ਸਉ ਕਿਸੀ ਲਖਾਵਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨੩੪॥
transliteration: sabh ras khelau pee sau kisee lakhaavau naahi ||234||
english: I enjoy all pleasures with my Beloved, but I do not let anyone else know. ||234||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਜਾਮ ਚਉਸਠਿ ਘਰੀ ਤੁਅ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aath jaam chausath gharee tu nirakhat rahai jeeu ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, every hour, my soul continues to look to You, O Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਦੇਖਉ ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੫॥
transliteration: neeche loin kiu karau sabh ghat dekhau peeu ||235||
english: Why should I keep my eyes lowered? I see my Beloved in every heart. ||235||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਪੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਕਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sakhee pee mahi jeeu basai jee mahi basai k peeu ||
english: Listen, O my companions: my soul dwells in my Beloved, and my Beloved dwells in my soul.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪੀਉ ਬੂਝਉ ਨਹੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿ ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੬॥
transliteration: jeeu peeu boojhau nahee ghat mahi jeeu k peeu ||236||
english: I realize that there is no difference between my soul and my Beloved; I cannot tell whether my soul or my Beloved dwells in my heart. ||236||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਾਮਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer baaman guroo hai jagat kaa bhagatan kaa gur naahi ||
english: Kabeer, the Brahmin may be the guru of the world, but he is not the Guru of the devotees.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰਝਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਕੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੂਆ ਚਾਰਉ ਬੇਦਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੩੭॥
transliteration: arajh urajh kai pach mooaa chaarau bedahu maahi ||237||
english: He rots and dies in the perplexities of the four Vedas. ||237||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰੀ ਹਾਥੀ ਚੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har hai khaa(n)d ret mahi bikharee haathee chunee na jaai ||
english: The Lord is like sugar, scattered in the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਕੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੩੮॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer gur bhalee bujhaaee keetee hoi kai khaai ||238||
english: Says Kabeer, the Guru has given me this sublime understanding: become an ant, and feed on it. ||238||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jau tuhi saadh pira(n)m kee sees kaat kar goi ||
english: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, then cut off your head, and make it into a ball.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੩੯॥
transliteration: khelat khelat haal kar jo kichh hoi ta hoi ||239||
english: Lose yourself in the play of it, and then whatever will be, will be. ||239||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਕੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jau tuhi saadh pira(n)m kee paake setee khel ||
english: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, play it with someone with committment.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਸਰਸਉਂ ਪੇਲਿ ਕੈ ਨਾ ਖਲਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨੪੦॥
transliteration: kaachee sarasau(n) pel kai naa khal bhaee na tel ||240||
english: Pressing the unripe mustard seeds produces neither oil nor flour. ||240||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਢੂੰਢਤ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਚੀਨਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤ ॥
transliteration: dhoo(n)dhat dolahi a(n)dh gat ar cheenat naahee sa(n)t ||
english: Searching, the mortal stumbles like a blind person, and does not recognize the Saint.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥੨੪੧॥
transliteration: kahi naamaa kiu paaeeai bin bhagatahu bhagava(n)t ||241||
english: Says Naam Dayv, how can one obtain the Lord God, without His devotee? ||241||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: har so heeraa chhaad kai karahi aan kee aas ||
english: Forsaking the Diamond of the Lord, the mortals put their hopes in another.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਦੋਜਕ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ॥੨੪੨॥
transliteration: te nar dojak jaahige sat bhaakhai ravidaas ||242||
english: Those people shall go to hell; Ravi Daas speaks the Truth. ||242||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਕਰੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jau grihu karahi ta dharam kar naahee ta kar bairaag ||
english: Kabeer, if you live the householder's life, then practice righteousness; otherwise, you might as well retire from the world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਡੋ ਅਭਾਗੁ ॥੨੪੩॥
transliteration: bairaagee ba(n)dhan karai taa ko bado abhaag ||243||
english: If someone renounces the world, and then gets involved in worldly entanglements, he shall suffer terrible misfortune. ||243||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: salok sekh phareed ke ||
english: Saloks Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਹਾੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਰੀ ਸਾਹੇ ਲਏ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jit dihaaRai dhan varee saahe lae likhaai ||
english: The day of the bride's wedding is pre-ordained.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਲਕੁ ਜਿ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: malak j ka(n)nee suneedaa muhu dekhaale aai ||
english: On that day, the Messenger of Death, of whom she had only heard, comes and shows its face.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਦੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਕਢੀਐ ਹਡਾ ਕੂ ਕੜਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ji(n)d nimaanee kadheeai hadaa koo kaRakaai ||
english: It breaks the bones of the body and pulls the helpless soul out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਨ ਚਲਨੀ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਕੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saahe likhe na chalanee ji(n)doo koo(n) samajhaai ||
english: That pre-ordained time of marriage cannot be avoided. Explain this to your soul.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਦੁ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ji(n)d vahutee maran var lai jaasee paranaai ||
english: The soul is the bride, and death is the groom. He will marry her and take her away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਜੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aapan hathee jol kai kai gal lagai dhaai ||
english: After the body sends her away with its own hands, whose neck will it embrace?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਪੁਰਸਲਾਤ ਕੰਨੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: vaalahu nikee purasalaat ka(n)nee na sunee aai ||
english: The bridge to hell is narrower than a hair; haven't you heard of it with your ears?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿੜੀ ਪਵੰਦੀਈ ਖੜਾ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phareedaa kiRee pava(n)deeee khaRaa na aap muhaai ||1||
english: Fareed, the call has come; be careful now - don't let yourself be robbed. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਚਲਾਂ ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਭਤਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa dar daravesee gaakhaRee chalaa(n) duneeaa(n) bhat ||
english: Fareed, it is so difficult to become a humble Saint at the Lord's Door.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਿਝੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਕਿਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਗੁਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kijh na bujhai kijh na sujhai duneeaa gujhee bhaahi ||
english: I know nothing; I understand nothing. The world is a smouldering fire.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈਂ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਹੰ ਭੀ ਦਝਾਂ ਆਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saa(n)ee(n) merai cha(n)gaa keetaa naahee ta ha(n) bhee dajhaa(n) aahi ||3||
english: My Lord did well to warn me about it; otherwise, I would have been burnt as well. ||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਲ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਸੰਮਲਿ ਬੁਕੁ ਭਰੀ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa je jaanaa til thoRaRe sa(n)mal buk bharee ||
english: Fareed, if I had known that I had so few sesame seeds, I would have been more careful with them in my hands.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹੁ ਨੰਢੜਾ ਤਾਂ ਥੋੜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: je jaanaa sahu na(n)dhaRaa taa(n) thoRaa maan karee ||4||
english: If I had known that my Husband Lord was so young and innocent, I would not have been so arrogant. ||4||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੜੁ ਛਿਜਣਾ ਪੀਡੀ ਪਾਈਂ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
transliteration: je jaanaa laR chhijanaa peedee paaee(n) ga(n)dh ||
english: If I had known that my robe would come loose, I would have tied a tighter knot.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਹੰਢਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tai jevad mai naahi ko sabh jag dithaa ha(n)dh ||5||
english: I have found none as great as You, Lord; I have looked and searched throughout the world. ||5||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਅਕਲਿ ਲਤੀਫੁ ਕਾਲੇ ਲਿਖੁ ਨ ਲੇਖ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa je too akal lateeph kaale likh na lekh ||
english: Fareed, if you have a keen understanding, then do not write black marks against anyone else.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਗਿਰੀਵਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਂੀਵਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aapanaRe gireevaan mahi sir na(n)eevaa(n) kar dekh ||6||
english: Look underneath your own collar instead. ||6||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਮੁਕੀਆਂ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਘੁੰਮਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa jo tai maaran mukeeaa(n) tinhaa na maare ghu(n)m ||
english: Fareed, do not turn around and strike those who strike you with their fists.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪੈਰ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੇ ਚੁੰਮਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aapanaRai ghar jaaeeai pair tinhaa de chu(n)m ||7||
english: Kiss their feet, and return to your own home. ||7||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਖਟਣ ਵੇਲ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa jaa(n) tau khatan vel taa(n) too rataa dunee siu ||
english: Fareed, when there was time for you to earn good karma, you were in love with the world instead.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਰਗ ਸਵਾਈ ਨੀਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਭਰਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਲਦਿਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: marag savaaee neehi jaa(n) bhariaa taa(n) ladiaa ||8||
english: Now, death has a strong foothold; when the load is full, it is taken away. ||8||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੁ ਥੀਆ ਦਾੜੀ ਹੋਈ ਭੂਰ ॥
transliteration: dekh phareedaa j theeaa daaRee hoee bhoor ||
english: See, Fareed, what has happened: your beard has become grey.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਛਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: agahu neRaa aaiaa pichhaa rahiaa door ||9||
english: That which is coming is near, and the past is left far behind. ||9||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿ ਥੀਆ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਈ ਵਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: dekh phareedaa j theeaa sakar hoee vis ||
english: See, Fareed, what has happened: sugar has become poison.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਵੇਦਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: saa(n)ee baajhahu aapane vedan kaheeai kis ||10||
english: Without my Lord, who can I tell of my sorrow? ||10||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣੀਆਂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੀਣੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa akhee dekh pateeneeaa(n) sun sun reene ka(n)n ||
english: Fareed, my eyes have become weak, and my ears have become hard of hearing.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਖ ਪਕੰਦੀ ਆਈਆ ਹੋਰ ਕਰੇਂਦੀ ਵੰਨ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: saakh paka(n)dee aaeeaa hor kare(n)dee va(n)n ||11||
english: The body's crop has become ripe and turned color. ||11||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲਂੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਧਉਲੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kaala(n)ee jinee na raaviaa dhaulee raavai koi ||
english: Fareed, those who did not enjoy their Spouse when their hair was black - hardly any of them enjoy Him when their hair turns grey.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kar saa(n)ee siu pirahaRee ra(n)g navelaa hoi ||12||
english: So be in love with the Lord, so that your color may ever be new. ||12||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲੀ ਧਉਲੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kaalee dhaulee saahib sadaa hai je ko chit kare ||
english: Fareed, whether one's hair is black or grey, our Lord and Master is always here if one remembers Him.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa laaiaa piram na lagaee je lochai sabh koi ||
english: This loving devotion to the Lord does not come by one's own efforts, even though all may long for it.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: ehu piram piaalaa khasam kaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||13||
english: This cup of loving devotion belongs to our Lord and Master; He gives it to whomever He likes. ||13||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਲੋਇਣ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਮੈ ਡਿਠੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa jinh loin jag mohiaa se loin mai dith ||
english: Fareed, those eyes which have enticed the world - I have seen those eyes.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਜਲ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਸਹਦਿਆ ਸੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੂਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kajal rekh na sahadiaa se pa(n)khee sooi bahith ||14||
english: Once, they could not endure even a bit of mascara; now, the birds hatch their young in them! ||14||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੂਕੇਦਿਆ ਚਾਂਗੇਦਿਆ ਮਤੀ ਦੇਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kookediaa chaa(n)gediaa matee dediaa nit ||
english: Fareed, they shouted and yelled, and constantly gave good advice.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੈਤਾਨਿ ਵੰਞਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਤ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਚਿਤ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jo saitaan va(n)njaaiaa se kit pherahi chit ||15||
english: But those whom the devil has spoiled - how can they turn their consciousness towards God? ||15||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਥੀਉ ਪਵਾਹੀ ਦਭੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa theeu pavaahee dabh ||
english: Fareed, become the grass on the path,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਾਂਈ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸਭੁ ॥
transliteration: je saa(n)ee loRahi sabh ||
english: if you long for the Lord of all.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਛਿਜਹਿ ਬਿਆ ਲਤਾੜੀਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik chhijahi biaa lataaReeahi ||
english: One will cut you down, and another will trample you underfoot;

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਸਾਈ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਾੜੀਅਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: taa(n) saaee dai dar vaaReeahi ||16||
english: then, you shall enter the Court of the Lord. ||16||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਨ ਨਿੰਦੀਐ ਖਾਕੂ ਜੇਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa khaak na ni(n)deeai khaakoo jed na koi ||
english: Fareed, do not slander the dust; noting is as great as dust.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਪੈਰਾ ਤਲੈ ਮੁਇਆ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jeevadiaa pairaa talai muiaa upar hoi ||17||
english: When we are alive, it is under our feet, and when we are dead, it is above us. ||17||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਾ ਲਬੁ ਤਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਬੁ ਤ ਕੂੜਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa jaa lab taa nehu kiaa lab ta kooRaa nehu ||
english: Fareed, when there is greed, what love can there be? When there is greed, love is false.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਿਚਰੁ ਝਤਿ ਲਘਾਈਐ ਛਪਰਿ ਤੁਟੈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: kichar jhat laghaaeeai chhapar tutai mehu ||18||
english: How long can one remain in a thatched hut which leaks when it rains? ||18||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਵਣਿ ਕੰਡਾ ਮੋੜੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa ja(n)gal ja(n)gal kiaa bhavahi van ka(n)daa moRehi ||
english: Fareed, why do you wander from jungle to jungle, crashing through the thorny trees?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵਸੀ ਰਬੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: vasee rab hiaaleeai ja(n)gal kiaa dhoodhehi ||19||
english: The Lord abides in the heart; why are you looking for Him in the jungle? ||19||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਨੀ ਨਿਕੀ ਜੰਘੀਐ ਥਲ ਡੂੰਗਰ ਭਵਿਓਮੑਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa inee nikee ja(n)gheeai thal doo(n)gar bhaviomhi ||
english: Fareed, with these small legs, I crossed deserts and mountains.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਜੁ ਫਰੀਦੈ ਕੂਜੜਾ ਸੈ ਕੋਹਾਂ ਥੀਓਮਿ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: aj phareedai koojaRaa sai kohaa(n) theeom ||20||
english: But today, Fareed, my water jug seems hundreds of miles away. ||20||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਡੀਆਂ ਧੁਖਿ ਧੁਖਿ ਉਠਨਿ ਪਾਸ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa raatee vadeeaa(n) dhukh dhukh uthan paas ||
english: Fareed, the nights are long, and my sides are aching in pain.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਧਿਗੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਆਸ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: dhig tinhaa daa jeeviaa jinaa vidaanee aas ||21||
english: Cursed are the lives of those who place their hopes in others. ||21||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਦਾ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤਾ ਆਇੜਿਆਂ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa je mai hodaa vaariaa mitaa aaiRiaa(n) ||
english: Fareed, if I had been there when my friend came, I would have made myself a sacrifice to him.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹੇੜਾ ਜਲੈ ਮਜੀਠ ਜਿਉ ਉਪਰਿ ਅੰਗਾਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: heRaa jalai majeeth jiu upar a(n)gaaraa ||22||
english: Now my flesh is burning red on the hot coals. ||22||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਦਾਖ ਬਿਜਉਰੀਆਂ ਕਿਕਰਿ ਬੀਜੈ ਜਟੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa loRai daakh bijaureeaa(n) kikar beejai jat ||
english: Fareed, the farmer plants acacia trees, and wishes for grapes.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹੰਢੈ ਉਂਨ ਕਤਾਇਦਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਪਟੁ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: ha(n)dhai u(n)n kataaidaa paidhaa loRai pat ||23||
english: He is spinning wool, but he wishes to wear silk. ||23||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਲੀਏ ਚਿਕੜੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa galeee chikaR door ghar naal piaare nehu ||
english: Fareed, the path is muddy, and the house of my Beloved is so far away.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਚਲਾ ਤ ਭਿਜੈ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਰਹਾਂ ਤ ਤੁਟੈ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: chalaa ta bhijai ka(n)balee rahaa(n) ta tutai nehu ||24||
english: If I go out, my blanket will get soaked, but if I remain at home, then my heart will be broken. ||24||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਭਿਜਉ ਸਿਜਉ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਅਲਹ ਵਰਸਉ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bhijau sijau ka(n)balee alah varasau mehu ||
english: My blanket is soaked, drenched with the downpour of the Lord's Rain.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਟਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: jaai milaa tinaa sajanaa tutau naahee nehu ||25||
english: I am going out to meet my Friend, so that my heart will not be broken. ||25||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਪਗ ਦਾ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa mai bholaavaa pag daa mat mailee hoi jaai ||
english: Fareed, I was worried that my turban might become dirty.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਲਾ ਰੂਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਭੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: gahilaa roohu na jaanaee sir bhee mitee khaai ||26||
english: My thoughtless self did not realize that one day, dust will consume my head as well. ||26||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਨਿਵਾਤ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਓੁ ਮਾਂਝਾ ਦੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa sakar kha(n)d nivaat guR maakhiou maa(n)jhaa dudh ||
english: Fareed: sugar cane, candy, sugar, molasses, honey and buffalo's milk

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਮਿਠੀਆਂ ਰਬ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: sabhe vasatoo mitheeaa(n) rab na pujan tudh ||27||
english: - all these things are sweet, but they are not equal to You. ||27||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਲਾਵਣੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa rotee meree kaath kee laavan meree bhukh ||
english: Fareed, my bread is made of wood, and hunger is my appetizer.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਖਾਧੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਘਣੇ ਸਹਨਿਗੇ ਦੁਖ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: jinaa khaadhee chopaRee ghane sahanige dukh ||28||
english: Those who eat buttered bread, will suffer in terrible pain. ||28||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਰੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rukhee sukhee khaai kai tha(n)dhaa paanee peeu ||
english: Eat dry bread, and drink cold water.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: phareedaa dekh paraaee chopaRee naa tarasaae jeeu ||29||
english: Fareed, if you see someone else's buttered bread, do not envy him for it. ||29||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਜੁ ਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਗੁ ਮੁੜੇ ਮੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aj na sutee ka(n)t siu a(n)g muRe muR jaai ||
english: This night, I did not sleep with my Husband Lord, and now my body is suffering in pain.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: jaai puchhahu dohaaganee tum kiu rain vihaai ||30||
english: Go and ask the deserted bride, how she passes her night. ||30||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saahurai dhoee naa lahai peeeai naahee thaau ||
english: She finds no place of rest in her father-in-law's home, and no place in her parents' home either.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਵਾਤੜੀ ਨ ਪੁਛਈ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: pir vaataRee na puchhaee dhan sohaagan naau ||31||
english: Her Husband Lord does not care for her; what sort of a blessed, happy soul-bride is she? ||31||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saahurai peeeai ka(n)t kee ka(n)t aga(n)m athaahu ||
english: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak so sohaaganee j bhaavai beparavaah ||32||
english: O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Carefree Lord. ||32||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਾਤੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੰਬਹੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਆਇ ਨਚਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: naatee dhotee sa(n)bahee sutee aai nachi(n)d ||
english: Bathing, washing and decorating herself, she comes and sleeps without anxiety.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਿੰਙੁ ਦੀ ਗਈ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: phareedaa rahee s beRee hi(n)ng dee gaee kathooree ga(n)dh ||33||
english: Fareed, she still smells like asafoetida; the fragrance of musk is gone. ||33||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਨਾ ਡਰਾਂ ਜੇ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: joban jaa(n)de naa daraa(n) je sah preet na jaai ||
english: I am not afraid of losing my youth, as long as I do not lose the Love of my Husband Lord.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿਤਂੀ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: phareedaa kita(n)ee joban preet bin suk gae kumalaai ||34||
english: Fareed, so many youths, without His Love, have dried up and withered away. ||34||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਖਟੋਲਾ ਵਾਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛਾਵਣ ਲੇਫੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa chi(n)t khatolaa vaan dukh birahi vichhaavan leph ||
english: Fareed, anxiety is my bed, pain is my mattress, and the pain of separation is my blanket and quilt.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਚੇ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: ehu hamaaraa jeevanaa too saahib sache vekh ||35||
english: Behold, this is my life, O my True Lord and Master. ||35||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: birahaa birahaa aakheeai birahaa too sulataan ||
english: Many talk of the pain and suffering of separation; O pain, you are the ruler of all.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਸਾਨੁ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: phareedaa jit tan birahu na oopajai so tan jaan masaan ||36||
english: Fareed, that body, within which love of the Lord does not well up - look upon that body as a cremation ground. ||36||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏ ਵਿਸੁ ਗੰਦਲਾ ਧਰੀਆਂ ਖੰਡੁ ਲਿਵਾੜਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa e vis ga(n)dalaa dhareeaa(n) kha(n)d livaaR ||
english: Fareed, these are poisonous sprouts coated with sugar.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਹੇਦੇ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਇਕਿ ਰਾਧੀ ਗਏ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: ik raahede rahi gae ik raadhee gae ujaaR ||37||
english: Some die planting them, and some are ruined, harvesting and enjoying them. ||37||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੰਢਿ ਕੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੰਮਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa chaar gavaaiaa ha(n)dh kai chaar gavaaiaa sa(n)m ||
english: Fareed, the hours of the day are lost wandering around, and the hours of the night are lost in sleep.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਆਂਹੋ ਕੇਰ੍ਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: lekhaa rab ma(n)geseeaa too aa(n)ho kerhe ka(n)m ||38||
english: God will call for your account, and ask you why you came into this world. ||38||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਉ ਡਿਠੋ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa dar daravaajai jaai kai kiu ditho ghaReeaal ||
english: Fareed, you have gone to the Lord's Door. Have you seen the gong there?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਦੋਸਾਂ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਹਮ ਦੋਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: ehu nidosaa(n) maareeai ham dosaa(n) daa kiaa haal ||39||
english: This blameless object is being beaten - imagine what is in store for us sinners! ||39||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀਏ ਘੜੀਏ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਪਹਰੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ghaReee ghaReee maareeai paharee lahai sajaai ||
english: Each and every hour, it is beaten; it is punished every day.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹੇੜਾ ਘੜੀਆਲ ਜਿਉ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: so heRaa ghaReeaal jiu dukhee rain vihaai ||40||
english: This beautiful body is like the gong; it passes the night in pain. ||40||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਕੰਬਣਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: budhaa hoaa sekh phareed ka(n)ban lagee deh ||
english: Shaykh Fareed has grown old, and his body has begun to tremble.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰੑਿਆ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਭੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: je sau varhiaa jeevanaa bhee tan hosee kheh ||41||
english: Even if he could live for hundreds of years, his body will eventually turn to dust. ||41||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa baar paraaiai baisanaa saa(n)ee mujhai na dehi ||
english: Fareed begs, O Lord, do not make me sit at another's door.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਏਵੈ ਰਖਸੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: je too evai rakhasee jeeu sareerahu lehi ||42||
english: If this is the way you are going to keep me, then go ahead and take the life out of my body. ||42||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੰਧਿ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਘੜਾ ਵਣਿ ਕੈ ਸਰੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)dh kuhaaRaa sir ghaRaa van kai sar lohaar ||
english: With the axe on his shoulder, and a bucket on his head, the blacksmith is ready to cut down the tree.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਹਉ ਲੋੜੀ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੂ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: phareedaa hau loRee sahu aapanaa too loRahi a(n)giaar ||43||
english: Fareed, I long for my Lord; you long only for the charcoal. ||43||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਆਟਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਣੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa ikanaa aataa agalaa ikanaa naahee lon ||
english: Fareed, some have lots of flour, while others do not even have salt.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਸਿੰਞਾਪਸਨਿ ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: agai gae si(n)njaapasan chotaa(n) khaasee kaun ||44||
english: When they go beyond this world, it shall be seen, who will be punished. ||44||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪਾਸਿ ਦਮਾਮੇ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਡੋ ਰਡ ॥
transliteration: paas damaame chhat sir bheree sado rad ||
english: Drums were beaten in their honor, there were canopies above their heads, and bugles announced their coming.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣ ਮਹਿ ਥੀਏ ਅਤੀਮਾ ਗਡ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: jaai sute jeeraan mahi theee ateemaa gad ||45||
english: They have gone to sleep in the cemetary, buried like poor orphans. ||45||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਉਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਭੀ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa usaarede bhee gae ||
english: Fareed, those who built houses, mansions and lofty buildings, are also gone.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਗੋਰੀ ਆਇ ਪਏ ॥੪੬॥
transliteration: kooRaa saudaa kar gae goree aai pae ||46||
english: They made false deals, and were dropped into their graves. ||46||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਿੰਥੜਿ ਮੇਖਾ ਅਗਲੀਆ ਜਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੇਖ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa khi(n)thaR mekhaa agaleeaa ji(n)d na kaaee mekh ||
english: Fareed, there are many seams on the patched coat, but there are no seams on the soul.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਲੇ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਸੇਖ ॥੪੭॥
transliteration: vaaree aapo aapanee chale masaaik sekh ||47||
english: The shaykhs and their disciples have all departed, each in his own turn. ||47||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ ਬਲੰਦਿਆ ਮਲਕੁ ਬਹਿਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa duhu deevee bala(n)diaa malak bahithaa aai ||
english: Fareed, the two lamps are lit, but death has come anyway.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਗੜੁ ਲੀਤਾ ਘਟੁ ਲੁਟਿਆ ਦੀਵੜੇ ਗਇਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੪੮॥
transliteration: gaR leetaa ghat lutiaa deevaRe gaiaa bujhaai ||48||
english: It has captured the fortress of the body, and plundered the home of the heart; it extinguishes the lamps and departs. ||48||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਕਪਾਹੈ ਜਿ ਥੀਆ ਜਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਥੀਆ ਤਿਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa vekh kapaahai j theeaa j sir theeaa tilaah ||
english: Fareed, look at what has happened to the cotton and the sesame seed,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਮਾਦੈ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਗਦੈ ਕੁੰਨੇ ਕੋਇਲਿਆਹ ॥
transliteration: kamaadai ar kaagadai ku(n)ne koiliaah ||
english: the sugar cane and paper, the clay pots and the charcoal.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਏਹ ਸਜਾਇ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥੪੯॥
transliteration: ma(n)de amal karediaa eh sajaai tinaah ||49||
english: This is the punishment for those who do evil deeds. ||49||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਸੂਫੁ ਗਲਿ ਦਿਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਗੁੜੁ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa ka(n)n musalaa sooph gal dil kaatee guR vaat ||
english: Fareed, you wear your prayer shawl on your shoulders and the robes of a Sufi; your words are sweet, but there is a dagger in your heart.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੫੦॥
transliteration: baahar disai chaananaa dil a(n)dhiaaree raat ||50||
english: Outwardly, you look bright, but your heart is dark as night. ||50||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਤੀ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਜੇ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa ratee rat na nikalai je tan cheerai koi ||
english: Fareed, not even a drop of blood would issue forth, if someone cut my body.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਨ ਰਤੇ ਰਬ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
transliteration: jo tan rate rab siu tin tan rat na hoi ||51||
english: Those bodies which are imbued with the Lord - those bodies contain no blood. ||51||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan sabho rat hai rat bin ta(n)n na hoi ||
english: This body is all blood; without blood, this body could not exist.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo sah rate aapane tit tan lobh rat na hoi ||
english: Those who are imbued with their Lord, do not have the blood of greed in their bodies.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai paiai tan kheen hoi lobh rat vichahu jaai ||
english: When the Fear of God fills the body, it becomes thin; the blood of greed departs from within.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu baisa(n)tar dhaat sudh hoi tiu har kaa bhau duramat mail gavaai ||
english: Just as metal is purified by fire, the Fear of God removes the filthy residues of evil-mindedness.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak te jan sohane j rate har ra(n)g laai ||52||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings are beautiful, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||52||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਲਭੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa soee saravar dhoodh lahu jithahu labhee vath ||
english: Fareed, seek that sacred pool, in which the genuine article is found.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਛਪੜਿ ਢੂਢੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਹਥੁ ॥੫੩॥
transliteration: chhapaR dhoodhai kiaa hovai chikaR dubai hath ||53||
english: Why do you bother to search in the pond? Your hand will only sink into the mud. ||53||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਨੰਢੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਓ ਵਡੀ ਥੀ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa na(n)dhee ka(n)t na raavio vadee thee mueeaas ||
english: Fareed, when she is young, she does not enjoy her Husband. When she grows up, she dies.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕੂਕੇਂਦੀ ਗੋਰ ਮੇਂ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੀਆਸੁ ॥੫੪॥
transliteration: dhan kooke(n)dee gor me(n) tai sah naa mileeaas ||54||
english: Lying in the grave, the soul-bride cries, "I did not meet You, my Lord." ||54||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਪਲਿਆ ਦਾੜੀ ਪਲੀ ਮੁਛਾਂ ਭੀ ਪਲੀਆਂ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa sir paliaa daaRee palee muchhaa(n) bhee paleeaa(n) ||
english: Fareed, your hair has turned grey, your beard has turned grey, and your moustache has turned grey.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਹਿਲੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਰਲੀਆਂ ॥੫੫॥
transliteration: re man gahile baavale maanahi kiaa raleeaa(n) ||55||
english: O my thoughtless and insane mind, why are you indulging in pleasures? ||55||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਧੁਕਣੁ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦੜੀ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kothe dhukan ketaRaa pir needaRee nivaar ||
english: Fareed, how long can you run on the rooftop? You are asleep to your Husband Lord - give it up!

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਿਹ ਲਧੇ ਗਾਣਵੇ ਗਏ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥੫੬॥
transliteration: jo dih ladhe gaanave gae vilaaR vilaaR ||56||
english: The days which were allotted to you are numbered, and they are passing, passing away. ||56||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਏਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa et na laae chit ||
english: Fareed, houses, mansions and balconies - do not attach your consciousness to these.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਪਈ ਅਤੋਲਵੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੫੭॥
transliteration: mitee paee atolavee koi na hosee mit ||57||
english: When these collapse into heaps of dust, none of them will be your friend. ||57||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਮਰਗ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa ma(n)dap maal na laai marag sataanee chit dhar ||
english: Fareed, do not focus on mansions and wealth; center your consciousness on death, your powerful enemy.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਜਿਥੈ ਹੀ ਤਉ ਵੰਞਣਾ ॥੫੮॥
transliteration: saaee jaai samhaal jithai hee tau va(n)njanaa ||58||
english: Remember that place where you must go. ||58||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕੰਮੜੇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa jinhee ka(n)mee naahi gun te ka(n)maRe visaar ||
english: Fareed, those deeds which do not bring merit - forget about those deeds.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਥੀਵਹੀ ਸਾਂਈ ਦੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੫੯॥
transliteration: mat sarami(n)daa theevahee saa(n)ee dai darabaar ||59||
english: Otherwise, you shall be put to shame, in the Court of the Lord. ||59||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਦਿਲ ਦੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਦਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa saahib dee kar chaakaree dil dee laahi bharaa(n)d ||
english: Fareed, work for your Lord and Master; dispel the doubts of your heart.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦਰਵੇਸਾਂ ਨੋ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਰੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਜੀਰਾਂਦਿ ॥੬੦॥
transliteration: daravesaa(n) no loReeai rukhaa(n) dee jeeraa(n)d ||60||
english: The dervishes, the humble devotees, have the patient endurance of trees. ||60||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੈਡੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੈਡਾ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kaale maide kapaRe kaalaa maidaa ves ||
english: Fareed, my clothes are black, and my outfit is black.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨਹੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ॥੬੧॥
transliteration: gunahee bhariaa mai phiraa lok kahai daraves ||61||
english: I wander around full of sins, and yet people call me a dervish - a holy man. ||61||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਤੋਇ ਨ ਪਲਵੈ ਜੇ ਜਲਿ ਟੁਬੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: tatee toi na palavai je jal tubee dei ||
english: The crop which is burnt will not bloom, even if it is soaked in water.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੋ ਡੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਬ ਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਇ ॥੬੨॥
transliteration: phareedaa jo dohaagan rab dee jhooredee jhoorei ||62||
english: Fareed, she who is forsaken by her Husband Lord, grieves and laments. ||62||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਵੀਵਾਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਮਾਮਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) kuaaree taa chaau veevaahee taa(n) maamale ||
english: When she is a virgin, she is full of desire; but when she is married, then her troubles begin.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਵਤਿ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥੬੩॥
transliteration: phareedaa eho pachhotaau vat kuaaree na theeai ||63||
english: Fareed, she has this one regret, that she cannot be a virgin again. ||63||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ ਆਇ ਉਲਥੇ ਹੰਝ ॥
transliteration: kalar keree chhapaRee aai ulathe ha(n)jh ||
english: The swans have landed in a small pond of salt water.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਜੂ ਬੋੜਨੑਿ ਨਾ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਉਡਣ ਸੰਦੀ ਡੰਝ ॥੬੪॥
transliteration: chi(n)joo boRanhi naa peevahi udan sa(n)dee da(n)jh ||64||
english: They dip in their bills, but do not drink; they fly away, still thirsty. ||64||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਰਿ ਕੋਧ੍ਰੈ ਪਇਆ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)s udar kodhrai paiaa lok vidaaran jaai ||
english: The swans fly away, and land in the fields of grain. The people go to chase them away.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਲਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੰਸੁ ਨ ਕੋਧ੍ਰਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੬੫॥
transliteration: gahilaa lok na jaanadaa ha(n)s na kodhraa khaai ||65||
english: The thoughtless people do not know, that the swans do not eat the grain. ||65||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਈਆਂ ਪੰਖੀਆਂ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਲ ॥
transliteration: chal chal gaeeaa(n) pa(n)kheeaa(n) jinhee vasaae tal ||
english: The birds which lived in the pools have flown away and left.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਭੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਥਕੇ ਕਵਲ ਇਕਲ ॥੬੬॥
transliteration: phareedaa sar bhariaa bhee chalasee thake kaval ikal ||66||
english: Fareed, the overflowing pool shall also pass away, and only the lotus flowers shall remain. ||66||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਟ ਸਿਰਾਣੇ ਭੁਇ ਸਵਣੁ ਕੀੜਾ ਲੜਿਓ ਮਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa it siraane bhui savan keeRaa laRio maas ||
english: Fareed, a stone will be your pillow, and the earth will be your bed. The worms shall eat into your flesh.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਾਪਰੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੬੭॥
transliteration: ketaRiaa jug vaapare ikat paiaa paas ||67||
english: Countless ages will pass, and you will still be lying on one side. ||67||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa bha(n)nee ghaRee sava(n)navee tutee naagar laj ||
english: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਅਜੁ ॥੬੮॥
transliteration: ajaraaeel pharesataa kai ghar naathee aj ||68||
english: In which house will the Messenger of Death be a guest today? ||68||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ ਟੂਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa bha(n)nee ghaRee sava(n)navee tootee naagar laj ||
english: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਜਣ ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੇ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਅਜੁ ॥੬੯॥
transliteration: jo sajan bhui bhaar the se kiu aavahi aj ||69||
english: Those friends who were a burden on the earth - how can they come today? ||69||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬੇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਕੁਤਿਆ ਏਹ ਨ ਭਲੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa be nivaajaa kutiaa eh na bhalee reet ||
english: Fareed: O faithless dog, this is not a good way of life.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੀ ਚਲਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਪੰਜੇ ਵਖਤ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੭੦॥
transliteration: kabahee chal na aaiaa pa(n)je vakhat maseet ||70||
english: You never come to the mosque for your five daily prayers. ||70||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਉਠੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਜੂ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੁਬਹ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: uth phareedaa ujoo saaj subah nivaaj gujaar ||
english: Rise up, Fareed, and cleanse yourself; chant your morning prayer.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਂਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਪਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥੭੧॥
transliteration: jo sir saa(n)ee naa nivai so sir kap utaar ||71||
english: The head which does not bow to the Lord - chop off and remove that head. ||71||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਂਇ ॥
transliteration: jo sir saaee naa nivai so sir keejai kaa(n)i ||
english: That head which does not bow to the Lord - what is to be done with that head?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਨੇ ਹੇਠਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ਬਾਲਣ ਸੰਦੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੭੨॥
transliteration: ku(n)ne heth jalaaeeai baalan sa(n)dai thaai ||72||
english: Put it in the fireplace, instead of firewood. ||72||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿਥੈ ਤੈਡੇ ਮਾਪਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂ ਜਣਿਓਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa kithai taide maapiaa jinhee too janiohi ||
english: Fareed, where are your mother and father, who gave birth to you?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਓਇ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਤੂੰ ਅਜੈ ਨ ਪਤੀਣੋਹਿ ॥੭੩॥
transliteration: tai paasahu oi lad gae too(n) ajai na pateenohi ||73||
english: They have left you, but even so, you are not convinced that you shall also have to go. ||73||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਏ ਟਿਬੇ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa man maidaan kar toe tibe laahi ||
english: Fareed, flatten out your mind; smooth out the hills and valleys.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਸੀ ਦੋਜਕ ਸੰਦੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭੪॥
transliteration: agai mool na aavasee dojak sa(n)dee bhaahi ||74||
english: Hereafter, the fires of hell shall not even approach you. ||74||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਮਹਿ ਖਲਕ ਵਸੈ ਰਬ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa khaalak khalak mahi khalak vasai rab maahi ||
english: Fareed, the Creator is in the Creation, and the Creation abides in God.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੭੫॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa kis no aakheeai jaa(n) tis bin koee naahi ||75||
english: Whom can we call bad? There is none without Him. ||75||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿ ਦਿਹਿ ਨਾਲਾ ਕਪਿਆ ਜੇ ਗਲੁ ਕਪਹਿ ਚੁਖ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa j dihi naalaa kapiaa je gal kapahi chukh ||
english: Fareed, if on that day when my umbilical cord was cut, my throat had been cut instead,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨਿ ਨ ਇਤੀ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਸਹਾਂ ਨ ਇਤੀ ਦੁਖ ॥੭੬॥
transliteration: pavan na itee maamale sahaa(n) na itee dukh ||76||
english: I would not have fallen into so many troubles, or undergone so many hardships. ||76||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਚਬਣ ਚਲਣ ਰਤੰਨ ਸੇ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਬਹਿ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: chaban chalan rata(n)n se suneear bahi gae ||
english: My teeth, feet, eyes and ears have stopped working.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹੇੜੇ ਮੁਤੀ ਧਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਾਨੀ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ॥੭੭॥
transliteration: heRe mutee dhaah se jaanee chal gae ||77||
english: My body cries out, "Those whom I knew have left me!" ||77||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬੁਰੇ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਹਢਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa bure daa bhalaa kar gusaa man na hadhaai ||
english: Fareed, answer evil with goodness; do not fill your mind with anger.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੭੮॥
transliteration: dehee rog na lagaee palai sabh kichh paai ||78||
english: Your body shall not suffer from any disease, and you shall obtain everything. ||78||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪੰਖ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa pa(n)kh paraahunee dunee suhaavaa baag ||
english: Fareed, the bird is a guest in this beautiful world-garden.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਉਬਤਿ ਵਜੀ ਸੁਬਹ ਸਿਉ ਚਲਣ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੁ ॥੭੯॥
transliteration: naubat vajee subah siu chalan kaa kar saaj ||79||
english: The morning drums are beating - get ready to leave! ||79||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa raat kathooree va(n)deeai sutiaa milai na bhaau ||
english: Fareed, musk is released at night. Those who are sleeping do not receive their share.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਨੈਣ ਨਂੀਦ੍ਰਾਵਲੇ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਕੁਆਉ ॥੮੦॥
transliteration: ji(n)nhaa nain na(n)eedraavale ti(n)nhaa milan kuaau ||80||
english: Those whose eyes are heavy with sleep - how can they receive it? ||80||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੁਝ ਕੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਐ ਜਗਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa mai jaaniaa dukh mujh koo dukh sabaaiai jag ||
english: Fareed, I thought that I was in trouble; the whole world is in trouble!

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹਾ ਅਗਿ ॥੮੧॥
transliteration: ooche chaR kai dekhiaa taa(n) ghar ghar ehaa ag ||81||
english: When I climbed the hill and looked around, I saw this fire in each and every home. ||81||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਬਾਗ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa bhoom ra(n)gaavalee ma(n)jh visoolaa baag ||
english: Fareed, in the midst of this beautiful earth, there is a garden of thorns.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪੀਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੮੨॥
transliteration: jo jan peer nivaajiaa ti(n)nhaa a(n)ch na laag ||82||
english: Those humble beings who are blessed by their spiritual teacher, do not suffer even a scratch. ||82||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਮਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa umar suhaavaRee sa(n)g suva(n)naRee deh ||
english: Fareed, life is blessed and beautiful, along with the beautiful body.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੮੩॥
transliteration: virale keee paaeean ji(n)nhaa piaare neh ||83||
english: Only a rare few are found, who love their Beloved Lord. ||83||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਵਹਣ ਨ ਢਾਹਿ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)dhee vahan na dhaahi tau bhee lekhaa devanaa ||
english: O river, do not destroy your banks; you too will be asked to give your account.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਧਰਿ ਰਬ ਰਜਾਇ ਵਹਣੁ ਤਿਦਾਊ ਗੰਉ ਕਰੇ ॥੮੪॥
transliteration: jidhar rab rajaai vahan tidaaoo ga(n)u kare ||84||
english: The river flows in whatever direction the Lord orders. ||84||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਡੁਖਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਦਿਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੂਲਾਂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa dukhaa setee dihu gaiaa soolaa(n) setee raat ||
english: Fareed, the day passes painfully; the night is spent in anguish.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਖੜਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਬੇੜਾ ਕਪਰ ਵਾਤਿ ॥੮੫॥
transliteration: khaRaa pukaare paatanee beRaa kapar vaat ||85||
english: The boatman stands up and shouts, "The boat is caught in the whirlpool!" ||85||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਲੰਮੀ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦੀ ਵਹੈ ਕੰਧੀ ਕੇਰੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: la(n)mee la(n)mee nadee vahai ka(n)dhee kerai het ||
english: The river flows on and on; it loves to eat into its banks.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬੇੜੇ ਨੋ ਕਪਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਪਾਤਣ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਚੇਤਿ ॥੮੬॥
transliteration: beRe no kapar kiaa kare je paatan rahai suchet ||86||
english: What can the whirlpool do to the boat, if the boatman remains alert? ||86||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਲਂੀ ਸੁ ਸਜਣ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੁ ਢੂੰਢੇਦੀ ਨ ਲਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa gala(n)ee s sajan veeh ik dhoo(n)dhedee na lahaa(n) ||
english: Fareed, there are dozens who say they are friends; I search, but I cannot find even one.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਧੁਖਾਂ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਂਲੀਹ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੮੭॥
transliteration: dhukhaa(n) jiu maa(n)leeh kaaran ti(n)nhaa maa piree ||87||
english: I yearn for my beloved like a smouldering fire. ||87||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦੁਖੀਐ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa ihu tan bhaukanaa nit nit dukheeai kaun ||
english: Fareed, this body is always barking. Who can stand this constant suffering?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੰਨੀ ਬੁਜੇ ਦੇ ਰਹਾਂ ਕਿਤੀ ਵਗੈ ਪਉਣੁ ॥੮੮॥
transliteration: ka(n)nee buje de rahaa(n) kitee vagai paun ||88||
english: I have put plugs in my ears; I don't care how much the wind is blowing. ||88||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਬ ਖਜੂਰੀ ਪਕੀਆਂ ਮਾਖਿਅ ਨਈ ਵਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa rab khajooree pakeeaa(n) maakhi naee vaha(n)nhi ||
english: Fareed, God's dates have ripened, and rivers of honey flow.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਵੰਞੈਂ ਡੀਹੜਾ ਸੋ ਉਮਰ ਹਥ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੮੯॥
transliteration: jo jo va(n)njai(n) deehaRaa so umar hath pava(n)n ||89||
english: With each passing day, your life is being stolen away. ||89||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤਲੀਆਂ ਖੂੰਡਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa tan sukaa pi(n)jar theeaa taleeaa(n) khoo(n)dahi kaag ||
english: Fareed, my withered body has become a skeleton; the crows are pecking at my palms.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰਬੁ ਨ ਬਾਹੁੜਿਓ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ॥੯੦॥
transliteration: ajai s rab na baahuRio dekh ba(n)de ke bhaag ||90||
english: Even now, God has not come to help me; behold, this is the fate of all mortal beings. ||90||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kaagaa kara(n)g dha(n)dholiaa sagalaa khaaiaa maas ||
english: The crows have searched my skeleton, and eaten all my flesh.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਏ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਛੁਹਉ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥੯੧॥
transliteration: e dui nainaa mat chhuhau pir dekhan kee aas ||91||
english: But please do not touch these eyes; I hope to see my Lord. ||91||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਾ ਚੂੰਡਿ ਨ ਪਿੰਜਰਾ ਬਸੈ ਤ ਉਡਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaagaa choo(n)d na pi(n)jaraa basai ta udar jaahi ||
english: O crow, do not peck at my skeleton; if you have landed on it, fly away.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪਿੰਜਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਤਿਦੂ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੯੨॥
transliteration: jit pi(n)jarai meraa sahu vasai maas na tidoo khaahi ||92||
english: Do not eat the flesh from that skeleton, within which my Husband Lord abides. ||92||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗੋਰ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸਡੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਘਰਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa gor nimaanee sad kare nighariaa ghar aau ||
english: Fareed, the poor grave calls out, "O homeless one, come back to your home.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਮੈਥੈ ਆਵਣਾ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਨਾ ਡਰਿਆਹੁ ॥੯੩॥
transliteration: sarapar maithai aavanaa maranahu naa dariaahu ||93||
english: You shall surely have to come to me; do not be afraid of death." ||93||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਲੋਇਣੀ ਦੇਖਦਿਆ ਕੇਤੀ ਚਲਿ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: enee loinee dekhadiaa ketee chal gaee ||
english: These eyes have seen a great many leave.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਈ ॥੯੪॥
transliteration: phareedaa lokaa(n) aapo aapanee mai aapanee paee ||94||
english: Fareed, the people have their fate, and I have mine. ||94||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap savaarahi mai milahi mai miliaa sukh hoi ||
english: God says, "If you reform yourself, you shall meet me, and meeting me, you shall be at peace.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੯੫॥
transliteration: phareedaa je too meraa hoi rahahi sabh jag teraa hoi ||95||
english: O Fareed, if you will be mine, the whole world will be yours." ||95||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਉਤੈ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਕਿਚਰਕੁ ਬੰਨੈ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)dhee utai rukhaRaa kicharak ba(n)nai dheer ||
english: How long can the tree remain implanted on the river-bank?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਕਿਚਰੁ ਤਾਈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੯੬॥
transliteration: phareedaa kachai bhaa(n)dai rakheeai kichar taaee neer ||96||
english: Fareed, how long can water be kept in a soft clay pot? ||96||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਹਲ ਨਿਸਖਣ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਵਾਸਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਲਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa mahal nisakhan rahi gae vaasaa aaiaa tal ||
english: Fareed, the mansions are vacant; those who lived in them have gone to live underground.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਾਂ ਸੇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ਬਹਸਨਿ ਰੂਹਾਂ ਮਲਿ ॥
transliteration: goraa(n) se nimaaneeaa bahasan roohaa(n) mal ||
english: They remain there, in those unhonored graves.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਖੀਂ ਸੇਖਾ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥੯੭॥
transliteration: aakhee(n) sekhaa ba(n)dagee chalan aj k kal ||97||
english: O Shaykh, dedicate yourself to God; you will have to depart, today or tomorrow. ||97||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਉਤੈ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਾ ਏਵੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਢਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa mautai daa ba(n)naa evai disai jiu dareeaavai dhaahaa ||
english: Fareed, the shore of death looks like the river-bank, being eroded away.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਤਪਿਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹੂਲ ਪਵੈ ਕਾਹਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: agai dojak tapiaa suneeai hool pavai kaahaahaa ||
english: Beyond is the burning hell, from which cries and shrieks are heard.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa no sabh sojhee aaee ik phirade veparavaahaa ||
english: Some understand this completely, while others wander around carelessly.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲ ਜਿ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਓਗਾਹਾ ॥੯੮॥
transliteration: amal j keetiaa dunee vich se daragah ogaahaa ||98||
english: Those actions which are done in this world, shall be examined in the Court of the Lord. ||98||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਕੰਨੑੈ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa dareeaavai ka(n)nhai bagulaa baithaa kel kare ||
english: Fareed, the crane perches on the river bank, playing joyfully.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਦੇ ਹੰਝ ਨੋ ਅਚਿੰਤੇ ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ॥
transliteration: kel karede ha(n)jh no achi(n)te baaj pae ||
english: While it is playing, a hawk suddenly pounces on it.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਬ ਦੇ ਕੇਲਾਂ ਵਿਸਰੀਆਂ ॥
transliteration: baaj pae tis rab de kelaa(n) visareeaa(n) ||
english: When the Hawk of God attacks, playful sport is forgotten.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੇ ਸਨਿ ਸੋ ਗਾਲੀ ਰਬ ਕੀਆਂ ॥੯੯॥
transliteration: jo man chit na chete san so gaalee rab keeaa(n) ||99||
english: God does what is not expected or even considered. ||99||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਢੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਣ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhe trai man dehuree chalai paanee a(n)n ||
english: The body is nourished by water and grain.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਬੰਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਤਿ ਆਸੂਣੀ ਬੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: aaio ba(n)daa dunee vich vat aasoonee ba(n)nhi ||
english: The mortal comes into the world with high hopes.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਲਕਲ ਮਉਤ ਜਾਂ ਆਵਸੀ ਸਭ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਭੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: malakal maut jaa(n) aavasee sabh daravaaje bha(n)n ||
