english: But when the Messenger of Death comes, it breaks down all the doors.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਭਾਈਆਂ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਤਾ ਬੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: tinhaa piaariaa bhaaeeaa(n) agai ditaa ba(n)nhi ||
english: It binds and gags the mortal, before the eyes of his beloved brothers.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਚਲਿਆ ਚਹੁ ਜਣਿਆ ਦੈ ਕੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: vekhahu ba(n)daa chaliaa chahu janiaa dai ka(n)nhi ||
english: Behold, the mortal being is going away, carried on the shoulders of four men.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਅਮਲ ਜਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਆਏ ਕੰਮਿ ॥੧੦੦॥
transliteration: phareedaa amal j keete dunee vich daragah aae ka(n)m ||100||
english: Fareed, only those good deeds done in the world will be of any use in the Court of the Lord. ||100||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਜੰਗਲਿ ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa hau balihaaree tinh pa(n)kheeaa ja(n)gal ji(n)nhaa vaas ||
english: Fareed, I am a sacrifice to those birds which live in the jungle.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਕਰੁ ਚੁਗਨਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਰਬ ਨ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਪਾਸੁ ॥੧੦੧॥
transliteration: kakar chugan thal vasan rab na chhodan paas ||101||
english: They peck at the roots and live on the ground, but they do not leave the Lord's side. ||101||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਫਿਰੀ ਵਣੁ ਕੰਬਿਆ ਪਤ ਝੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa rut phiree van ka(n)biaa pat jhaRe jhaR paahi ||
english: Fareed, the seasons change, the woods shake and the leaves drop from the trees.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂੰਢੀਆਂ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧੦੨॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa dhoo(n)dheeaa(n) rahan kithaaoo naahi ||102||
english: I have searched in the four directions, but I have not found any resting place anywhere. ||102||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪਾੜਿ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਧਜ ਕਰੀ ਕੰਬਲੜੀ ਪਹਿਰੇਉ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa paaR patolaa dhaj karee ka(n)balaRee pahireu ||
english: Fareed, I have torn my clothes to tatters; now I wear only a rough blanket.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਈ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥੧੦੩॥
transliteration: jinhee vesee sahu milai seee ves kareu ||103||
english: I wear only those clothes which will lead me to meet my Lord. ||103||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਪਾੜਤੀ ਕੰਬਲੜੀ ਪਹਿਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kaai patolaa paaRatee ka(n)balaRee pahirei ||
english: Why do you tear apart your fine clothes, and take to wearing a rough blanket?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧੦੪॥
transliteration: naanak ghar hee baithiaa sahu milai je neeat raas karei ||104||
english: O Nanak, even sitting in your own home, you can meet the Lord, if your mind is in the right place. ||104||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਆਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa garab jinhaa vadiaaeeaa dhan joban aagaah ||
english: Fareed, those who are very proud of their greatness, wealth and youth,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਟਿਬੇ ਜਿਉ ਮੀਹਾਹੁ ॥੧੦੫॥
transliteration: khaalee chale dhanee siu tibe jiu meehaahu ||105||
english: shall return empty-handed from their Lord, like sandhills after the rain. ||105||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੁਖ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa tinaa mukh daraavane jinaa visaarion naau ||
english: Fareed, the faces of those who forget the Lord's Name are dreadful.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ਅਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥੧੦੬॥
transliteration: aithai dukh ghaneriaa agai thaur na thaau ||106||
english: They suffer terrible pain here, and hereafter they find no place of rest or refuge. ||106||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਛਲ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓਹਿ ਜੀਵਦੜੋ ਮੁਇਓਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa pichhal raat na jaagiohi jeevadaRo muiohi ||
english: Fareed, if you do not awaken in the early hours before dawn, you are dead while yet alive.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੈ ਰਬੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਤ ਰਬਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਿਓਹਿ ॥੧੦੭॥
transliteration: je tai rab visaariaa ta rab na visariohi ||107||
english: Although you have forgotten God, God has not forgotten you. ||107||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa ka(n)t ra(n)gaavalaa vadaa vemuhataaj ||
english: Fareed, my Husband Lord is full of joy; He is Great and Self-sufficient.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਏਹੁ ਸਚਾਵਾਂ ਸਾਜੁ ॥੧੦੮॥
transliteration: alah setee ratiaa ehu sachaavaa(n) saaj ||108||
english: To be imbued with the Lord God - this is the most beautiful decoration. ||108||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਲ ਤੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa dukh sukh ik kar dil te laahi vikaar ||
english: Fareed, look upon pleasure and pain as the same; eradicate corruption from your heart.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਭੀ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥੧੦੯॥
transliteration: alah bhaavai so bhalaa taa(n) labhee darabaar ||109||
english: Whatever pleases the Lord God is good; understand this, and you will reach His Court. ||109||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਜਾਈ ਵਜਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਭੀ ਵਜਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa dunee vajaaee vajadee too(n) bhee vajahi naal ||
english: Fareed, the world dances as it dances, and you dance with it as well.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਵਜਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥੧੧੦॥
transliteration: soee jeeu na vajadaa jis alahu karadaa saar ||110||
english: That soul alone does not dance with it, who is under the care of the Lord God. ||110||

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਿਲੁ ਰਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa dil rataa is dunee siu dunee na kitai ka(n)m ||
english: Fareed, the heart is imbued with this world, but the world is of no use to it at all.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਲ ਫਕੀਰਾਂ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਿ ॥੧੧੧॥
transliteration: misal phakeeraa(n) gaakhaRee s paaeeai poor kara(n)m ||111||
english: It is so difficult to be like the fakeers - the Holy Saints; it is only achieved by perfect karma. ||111||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਛਾ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: pahilai paharai phulaRaa phal bhee pachhaa raat ||
english: The first watch of the night brings flowers, and the later watches of the night bring fruit.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੰਨੑਿ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਈ ਕੰਨੋ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧੧੨॥
transliteration: jo jaaga(n)nhi laha(n)n se saaee ka(n)no daat ||112||
english: Those who remain awake and aware, receive the gifts from the Lord. ||112||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: daatee saahib sa(n)deeaa kiaa chalai tis naal ||
english: The gifts are from our Lord and Master; who can force Him to bestow them?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧੧੩॥
transliteration: ik jaaga(n)de naa lahanhi ikanhaa sutiaa dei uthaal ||113||
english: Some are awake, and do not receive them, while He awakens others from sleep to bless them. ||113||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਢੂਢੇਦੀਏ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਕੂ ਤਉ ਤਨਿ ਕਾਈ ਕੋਰ ॥
transliteration: dhoodhedeee suhaag koo tau tan kaaee kor ||
english: You search for your Husband Lord; you must have some fault in your body.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਝਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥੧੧੪॥
transliteration: jinhaa naau suhaaganee tinhaa jhaak na hor ||114||
english: Those who are known as happy soul-brides, do not look to others. ||114||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਮੰਝ ਕਮਾਣ ਏ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਨੀਹਣੋ ॥
transliteration: sabar ma(n)jh kamaan e sabar kaa neehano ||
english: Within yourself, make patience the bow, and make patience the bowstring.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥੧੧੫॥
transliteration: sabar sa(n)daa baan khaalak khataa na karee ||115||
english: Make patience the arrow, the Creator will not let you miss the target. ||115||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਲੇਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: sabar a(n)dar saabaree tan evai jaalenhi ||
english: Those who are patient abide in patience; in this way, they burn their bodies.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹੋਨਿ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੈ ਭੇਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਨਿ ॥੧੧੬॥
transliteration: hon najeek khudaai dai bhet na kisai den ||116||
english: They are close to the Lord, but they do not reveal their secret to anyone. ||116||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਬਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੰਦਾ ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabar ehu suaau je too(n) ba(n)daa diR karahi ||
english: Let patience be your purpose in life; implant this within your being.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵਧਿ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਟੁਟਿ ਨ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਵਾਹੜਾ ॥੧੧੭॥
transliteration: vadh theevahi dareeaau tut na theevahi vaahaRaa ||117||
english: In this way, you will grow into a great river; you will not break off into a tiny stream. ||117||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa daravesee gaakhaRee chopaRee pareet ||
english: Fareed, it is difficult to be a dervish - a Holy Saint; it is easier to love bread when it is buttered.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਾਲੀਐ ਦਰਵੇਸਾਵੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧੧੮॥
transliteration: ikan kinai chaaleeai daravesaavee reet ||118||
english: Only a rare few follow the way of the Saints. ||118||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਬਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: tan tapai tanoor jiu baalan had bala(n)nhi ||
english: My body is cooking like an oven; my bones are burning like firewood.

author: Sheikh Farid
transliteration: pairee thakaa(n) sir julaa(n) je moo(n) piree mila(n)nhi ||119||
english: If my feet become tired, I will walk on my head, if I can meet my Beloved. ||119||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tan na tapaai tanoor jiu baalan had na baal ||
english: Do not heat up your body like an oven, and do not burn your bones like firewood.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਫੇੜਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੦॥
transliteration: sir pairee kiaa pheRiaa a(n)dar piree nihaal ||120||
english: What harm have your feet and head done to you? Behold your Beloved within yourself. ||120||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੇ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hau dhoodhedee sajanaa sajan maide naal ||
english: I search for my Friend, but my Friend is already with me.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak alakh na lakheeai guramukh dei dikhaal ||121||
english: O Nanak, the Unseen Lord cannot be seen; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh. ||121||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)saa dekh tara(n)diaa bagaa aaiaa chaau ||
english: Seeing the swans swimming, the cranes became excited.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧੨੨॥
transliteration: dub mue bag bapuRe sir tal upar paau ||122||
english: The poor cranes were drowned to death, with their heads below the water and their feet sticking out above. ||122||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mai jaaniaa vad ha(n)s hai taa(n) mai keetaa sa(n)g ||
english: I knew him as a great swan, so I associated with him.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਭੇੜੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੧੨੩॥
transliteration: je jaanaa bag bapuRaa janam na bheRee a(n)g ||123||
english: If I had known that he was a only wretched crane, I would never in my life have crossed paths with him. ||123||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ha(n)s kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadar dhare ||
english: Who is a swan, and who is a crane, if God blesses him with His Glance of Grace?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੨੪॥
transliteration: je tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu ha(n)s kare ||124||
english: If it pleases Him, O Nanak, He changes a crow into a swan. ||124||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ਫਾਹੀਵਾਲ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saravar pa(n)khee hekaRo phaaheevaal pachaas ||
english: There is only one bird in the lake, but there are fifty trappers.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਗਡੁ ਥਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੧੨੫॥
transliteration: ihu tan laharee gad thiaa sache teree aas ||125||
english: This body is caught in the waves of desire. O my True Lord, You are my only hope! ||125||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kavan s akhar kavan gun kavan s maneeaa ma(n)t ||
english: What is that word, what is that virtue, and what is that magic mantra?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਸੋ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੬॥
transliteration: kavan s veso hau karee jit vas aavai ka(n)t ||126||
english: What are those clothes, which I can wear to captivate my Husband Lord? ||126||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਖਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: nivan s akhar khavan gun jihabaa maneeaa ma(n)t ||
english: Humility is the word, forgiveness is the virtue, and sweet speech is the magic mantra.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਭੈਣੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੭॥
transliteration: e trai bhaine ves kar taa(n) vas aavee ka(n)t ||127||
english: Wear these three robes, O sister, and you will captivate your Husband Lord. ||127||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: mat hodee hoi iaanaa ||
english: If you are wise, be simple;

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਾਣ ਹੋਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਤਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: taan hode hoi nitaanaa ||
english: if you are powerful, be weak;

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anahode aap va(n)daae ||
english: and when there is nothing to share, then share with others.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥੧੨੮॥
transliteration: ko aisaa bhagat sadaae ||128||
english: How rare is one who is known as such a devotee. ||128||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਨ ਗਾਲਾਇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ik phikaa na gaalaai sabhanaa mai sachaa dhanee ||
english: Do not utter even a single harsh word; your True Lord and Master abides in all.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹਿਆਉ ਨ ਕੈਹੀ ਠਾਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਭ ਅਮੋਲਵੇ ॥੧੨੯॥
transliteration: hiaau na kaihee thaahi maanak sabh amolave ||129||
english: Do not break anyone's heart; these are all priceless jewels. ||129||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਠਾਹਣੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਮਚਾਂਗਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa man maanik thaahan mool machaa(n)gavaa ||
english: The minds of all are like precious jewels; to harm them is not good at all.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਉ ਪਿਰੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਿਕ ਹਿਆਉ ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ॥੧੩੦॥
transliteration: je tau pireeaa dee sik hiaau na thaahe kahee daa ||130||
english: If you desire your Beloved, then do not break anyone's heart. ||130||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖਬਾਕੵ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: savaye sree mukhabaaky mahalaa 5 ||
english: Swaiyas From The Mouth Of The Great Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh karataar karan kaaran sabh aape ||
english: O Primal Lord God, You Yourself are the Creator, the Cause of all causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab rahio bharapoor sagal ghat rahio biaape ||
english: You are All-pervading everywhere, totally filling all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੵਾਪਤੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਜਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਖੵਾ ਕਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ॥
transliteration: byaapat dekheeai jagat jaanai kaun teree gat sarab kee rakhyaa karai aape har pat ||
english: You are seen pervading the world; who can know Your State? You protect all; You are our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee abigat aape aap utapat ||
english: O my Imperishable and Formless Lord, You formed Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਭਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ekai toohee ekai an naahee tum bhat ||
english: You are the One and Only; no one else is like You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹੈ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)t naahee paaraavaar kaun hai karai beechaar jagat pitaa hai srab praan ko adhaar ||
english: O Lord, You have no end or limitation. Who can contemplate You? You are the Father of the world, the Support of all life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak bhagat dar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
english: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sad balihaar ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਸਰਿ ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit pravaah sar atul bha(n)daar bhar parai hee te parai apar apaar par ||
english: Streams of Ambrosial Nectar flow; Your Treasures are unweighable and overflowing in abundance. You are the Farthest of the far, Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਨ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਧਰਿ ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲੌ ਏਕੈ ਨਿਮਖ ਤੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aapuno bhaavan kar ma(n)tr na doosaro dhar opat paralau ekai nimakh t ghar ||
english: You do whatever You please; You do not take advice from anyone else. In Your Home, creation and destruction happen in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਉਜੀਆਰੋ ਨਿਰਮਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aan naahee samasar ujeeaaro niramar kot paraachhat jaahi naam leee har har ||
english: No one else is equal to You; Your Light is Immaculate and Pure. Millions of sins are washed away, chanting Your Name, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak bhagat dar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
english: Your devotees are at Your Door, God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sad balihaar ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਧਾਰੇ ਏਕ ਥੇਂ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhavan dhaare ek the(n) keee bisathaare poor rahio srab mahi aap hai niraare ||
english: You established all the worlds from within Yourself, and extended them outward. You are All-pervading amongst all, and yet You Yourself remain detached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ਪਾਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਅਲਖ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har gun naahee a(n)t paare jee ja(n)t sabh thaare sagal ko daataa ekai alakh muraare ||
english: O Lord, there is no end or limit to Your Glorious Virtues; all beings and creatures are Yours. You are the Giver of all, the One Invisible Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਾਰੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਾਰੇ ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖ ਨ ਮਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap hee dhaaran dhaare kudarat hai dekhaare baran chihan naahee mukh na masaare ||
english: He Himself supports the Universe, revealing His All-powerful Creative Potency. He has no color, form, mouth or beard.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak bhagat dar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
english: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sad balihaar ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨ ਗੵਾਨੰ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚੌ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: sarab gun nidhaana(n) keemat na gyaana(n) dhyaana(n) ooche te oochau jaaneejai prabh tero thaana(n) ||
english: You are the Treasure of all virtue; who can know the value of Your spiritual wisdom and meditation? O God, Your Place is known as the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੰ ਏਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਹਾਨੰ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਬਡੇ ਤੇ ਬਡਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: man dhan tero praana(n) ekai soot hai jahaana(n) kavan upamaa deu bade te badaana(n) ||
english: Mind, wealth and the breath of life belong to You alone, Lord. The world is strung upon Your Thread. What praises can I give to You? You are the Greatest of the great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਭੇਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਉ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਧਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: jaanai kaun tero bheu alakh apaar deu akal kalaa hai prabh sarab ko dhaana(n) ||
english: Who can know Your Mystery? O Unfathomable, Infinite, Divine Lord, Your Power is unstoppable. O God, You are the Support of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak bhagat dar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
english: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sad balihaar ||4||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰ ਅਛਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar aakaar achhal pooran abinaasee ||
english: O Formless, Formed, Undeceivable, Perfect, Imperishable,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖਵੰਤ ਆਨੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: harakhava(n)t aana(n)t roop niramal bigaasee ||
english: Blissful, Unlimited, Beautiful, Immaculate, Blossoming Lord:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi bea(n)t a(n)t ik til nahee paasee ||
english: Countless are those who sing Your Glorious Praises, but they do not know even a tiny bit of Your extent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਂਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau ho(n)hi kripaal s jan prabh tumahi milaasee ||
english: That humble being upon whom You shower Your Mercy meets with You, O God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਯਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n te dha(n)n jan jih kripaal har har bhayau ||
english: Blessed, blessed, blessed are those humble beings, upon whom the Lord, Har, Har, showers His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਰਸਿਅਉ ਸਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹ ਥੇ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har gur naanak jin parasiau s janam maran duh the rahio ||5||
english: Whoever meets with the Lord through Guru Nanak is rid of both birth and death. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ ਸਤਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sat sat har sat sat sate sat bhaneeai ||
english: The Lord is said to be True, True, True, True, the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਆਨ ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਊਰਾਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: doosar aan na avar purakh paooraatan suneeai ||
english: There is no other like Him. He is the Primal Being, the Primal Soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਮਨਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har ko naam lait man sabh sukh paae ||
english: Chanting the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, the mortal is blessed with all comforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹ ਰਸਨ ਚਾਖਿਓ ਤੇਹ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jeh rasan chaakhio teh jan tripat aghaae ||
english: Those who taste it with their tongues, those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਭਯੋੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jih thaakur suprasa(n)n bhayou satasa(n)gat tih piaar ||
english: That person who becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master, loves the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕੀਓ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har gur naanak jinh parasio tinh sabh kul keeo udhaar ||6||
english: Whoever meets with the Lord through Guru Nanak, saves all his generations. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਹਿ ਧਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: sach sabhaa deebaan sach sache pahi dhario ||
english: True is His Congregation and His Court. The True Lord has established Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਕਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: sachai takhat nivaas sach tapaavas kario ||
english: Sitting upon His Throne of Truth, He administers True Justice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਿਰਜੵਿਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਉ ॥
transliteration: sach sirajyiu sa(n)saar aap aabhul na bhulau ||
english: The True Lord Himself fashioned the Universe. He is Infallible, and does not make mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨਹੁ ਪਵੈ ਅਮੁਲਉ ॥
transliteration: ratan naam apaar keem nahu pavai amulau ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, is the jewel. Its value cannot be appraised - it is priceless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਯਉ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jih kripaal hoyau goubi(n)d sarab sukh tinahoo paae ||
english: That person, upon whom the Lord of the Universe showers His Mercy obtains all comforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har gur naanak jinh parasio te bahuR phir jon na aae ||7||
english: Those who touch the Feet of the Lord through Guru Nanak, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਸ੍ਤਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kavan jog kaun gyaan dhyaan kavan bidh ustat kareeai ||
english: What is the Yoga, what is the spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what is the way, to praise the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕੋਰਿ ਤਿਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik tetees kor tir keem na pareeai ||
english: The Siddhas and seekers and the three hundred thirty million gods cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord's Value.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸੇਖ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: brahamaadik sanakaad sekh gun a(n)t na paae ||
english: Neither Brahma, nor Sanak, nor the thousand-headed serpent king can find the limits of His Glorious Virtues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: agahu gahio nahee jaai poor srab rahio samaae ||
english: The Inapprehensible Lord cannot be apprehended. He is pervading and permeating amongst all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕਾਟੀ ਸਿਲਕ ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਇ ਜਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jih kaatee silak dayaal prabh sei jan lage bhagate ||
english: Those whom God has mercifully freed from their nooses - those humble beings are attached to His devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤੇ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: har gur naanak jinh parasio te it ut sadaa mukate ||8||
english: Those who meet with the Lord through Guru Nanak are liberated forever, here and hereafter. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਉ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਰੵਿਉ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh daatau daataar paryiu jaachak ik saranaa ||
english: I am a beggar; I seek the Sanctuary of God, the Giver of givers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਜੇਹ ਲਗਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: milai daan sa(n)t ren jeh lag bhaujal taranaa ||
english: Please bless me with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints; grasping them, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: binat karau aradaas sunahu je thaakur bhaavai ||
english: Please listen to my prayer, if it pleases You, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dehu daras man chaau bhagat ihu man thaharaavai ||
english: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. This mind abides in devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਓ ਚਰਾਗੁ ਅੰਧੵਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭ ਕਲਿ ਉਧਰੀ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਧਰਮ ॥
transliteration: balio charaag a(n)dhyaar mahi sabh kal udharee ik naam dharam ||
english: The lamp is lit in the darkness; all are saved in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, through the One Name and faith in the Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਗਲ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੯॥
transliteration: pragat sagal har bhavan mahi jan naanak gur paarabraham ||9||
english: The Lord is revealed in all the worlds. O servant Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖਬਾਕੵ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: savaye sree mukhabaaky mahalaa 5 ||
english: Swaiyas From The Mouth Of The Great Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਮੋਹ ਫੁਨਿ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਸਠ ਕਠੋਰ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਕੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaachee deh moh phun baa(n)dhee sath kathor kucheel kugiaanee ||
english: This body is frail and transitory, and bound to emotional attachment. I am foolish, stone-hearted, filthy and unwise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat bhramat rahan nahee paavat paarabraham kee gat nahee jaanee ||
english: My mind wanders and wobbles, and will not hold steady. It does not know the state of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਬਿਕਲ ਬਡੌ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: joban roop maaiaa mad maataa bicharat bikal badau abhimaanee ||
english: I am intoxicated with the wine of youth, beauty and the riches of Maya. I wander around perplexed, in excessive egotistical pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਅਪਵਾਦ ਨਾਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਯਹ ਮੀਠੀ ਜੀਅ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਿਤਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: par dhan par apavaad naar ni(n)daa yah meethee jee maahi hitaanee ||
english: The wealth and women of others, arguments and slander, are sweet and dear to my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਬੰਚ ਛਪਿ ਕਰਤ ਉਪਾਵਾ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: balaba(n)ch chhap karat upaavaa pekhat sunat prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: I try to hide my deception, but God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts, sees and hears all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲ ਧਰਮ ਦਯਾ ਸੁਚ ਨਾਸ੍ਤਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: seel dharam dayaa such naast aaio saran jee ke daanee ||
english: I have no humility, faith, compassion or purity, but I seek Your Sanctuary, O Giver of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਿਰੀਧਰ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaran karan samarath sireedhar raakh lehu naanak ke suaamee ||1||
english: The All-powerful Lord is the Cause of causes. O Lord and Master of Nanak, please save me! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਜੋਹਨ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: keerat karan saran manamohan johan paap bidaaran kau ||
english: The Praises of the Creator, the Enticer of the mind, are potent to destroy sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਉ ॥
transliteration: har taaran taran samarath sabhai bidh kulah samooh udhaaran sau ||
english: The All-powerful Lord is the boat, to carry us across; He saves all our generations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਜਾਨਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਕਤ ਧਂਉ ॥
transliteration: chit chet achet jaan satasa(n)gat bharam a(n)dher mohio kat dha(n)u ||
english: O my unconscious mind, contemplate and remember Him in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Why are you wandering around, enticed by the darkness of doubt?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ ਚਸਾ ਪਲੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਉ ॥
transliteration: moorat gharee chasaa pal simaran raam naam rasanaa sa(n)g lau ||
english: Remember Him in meditation, for an hour, for a moment, even for an instant. Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਛਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨੰਮ ਕਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਭਂਉ ॥
transliteration: hochhau kaaj alap sukh ba(n)dhan kot jana(n)m kahaa dukh bha(n)u ||
english: You are bound to worthless deeds and shallow pleasures; why do you spend millions of lifetimes wandering in such pain?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖੵਾ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਆਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਰਂਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sikhyaa sa(n)t naam bhaj naanak raam ra(n)g aatam siu ra(n)u ||2||
english: Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, through the Teachings of the Saints. Meditate on the Lord with love in your soul. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਚਕ ਰੇਤ ਖੇਤ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਿਤ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)chak ret khet tan niramit duralabh deh savaar dharee ||
english: The little sperm is planted in the body-field of the mother, and the human body, so difficult to obtain, is formed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸੋਧੇ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khaan paan sodhe sukh bhu(n)chat sa(n)kat kaat bipat haree ||
english: He eats and drinks, and enjoys pleasures; his pains are taken away, and his suffering is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਅਰੁ ਬੰਧਪ ਬੂਝਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੂਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee ar ba(n)dhap boojhan kee sabh soojh paree ||
english: He is given the understanding to recognize mother, father, siblings and relatives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਧਮਾਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਆਵਤ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਿਖੰਮ ਜਰੀ ॥
transliteration: baradhamaan hovat din prat nit aavat nikat bikha(n)m jaree ||
english: He grows day by day, as the horrible specter of old age comes closer and closer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ॥
transliteration: re gun heen deen maaiaa krim simar suaamee ek gharee ||
english: You worthless, petty worm of Maya - remember your Lord and Master, at least for an instant!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਟਿ ਭਰੰਮ ਭਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar gahi lehu kripaal kripaa nidh naanak kaat bhara(n)m bharee ||3||
english: Please take Nanak's hand, O Merciful Ocean of Mercy, and take away this heavy load of doubt. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂਸ ਬਿਲਾ ਮਹਿ ਗਰਬਤ ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾਂ ਮੁਘਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: re man moos bilaa mahi garabat karatab karat mahaa(n) mughanaa(n) ||
english: O mind, you are a mouse, living in the mousehole of the body; you are so proud of yourself, but you act like an absolute fool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਤ ਦੋਲ ਝੋਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਝੂਲਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਘੁਘਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)pat dol jhol sa(n)g jhoolat maaiaa magan bhramat ghughanaa ||
english: You swing in the swing of wealth, intoxicated with Maya, and you wander around like an owl.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਬੰਧਪ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਢਿਓ ਸੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sut banitaa saajan sukh ba(n)dhap taa siu mohu badhio s ghanaa ||
english: You take pleasure in your children, spouse, friends and relatives; your emotional attachment to them is increasing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਇਓ ਬੀਜੁ ਅਹੰ ਮਮ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਬੀਤਤ ਅਉਧ ਕਰਤ ਅਘਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: boio beej aha(n) mam a(n)kur beetat audh karat aghanaa(n) ||
english: You have planted the seeds of egotism, and the sprout of possessiveness has come up. You pass your life making sinful mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਭੁੰਚਤ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mirat ma(n)jaar pasaar mukh nirakhat bhu(n)chat bhugat bhookh bhukhanaa ||
english: The cat of death, with his mouth wide-open, is watching you. You eat food, but you are still hungry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਤ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: simar gupaal daiaal satasa(n)gat naanak jag jaanat supanaa ||4||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Merciful Lord of the World, O Nanak, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Know that the world is just a dream. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਗੇਹ ਨ ਨੇਹ ਨ ਨੀਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਗਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: deh na geh na neh na neetaa maaiaa mat kahaa lau gaarahu ||
english: Neither body, nor house, nor love last forever. You are intoxicated with Maya; how long will you be proud of them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਚਉਰ ਨ ਚਾਵਰ ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: chhatr na patr na chaur na chaavar bahatee jaat ridai na bichaarahu ||
english: Neither crown, nor canopy, nor servants last forever. You do not consider in your heart that your life is passing away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਥ ਨ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਨ ਗਜ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਤ ਨਾਂਗ ਸਿਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: rath na asv na gaj si(n)ghaasan chhin mahi tiaagat naa(n)g sidhaarahu ||
english: Neither chariots, nor horses, nor elephants or royal thrones shall last forever. In an instant, you will have to leave them, and depart naked.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰ ਨ ਬੀਰ ਨ ਮੀਰ ਨ ਖਾਨਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: soor na beer na meer na khaanam sa(n)g na kooo drisat nihaarahu ||
english: Neither warrior, nor hero, nor king or ruler last forever; see this with your eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟ ਨ ਓਟ ਨ ਕੋਸ ਨ ਛੋਟਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਝਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kot na ot na kos na chhotaa karat bikaar dooo kar jhaarahu ||
english: Neither fortress, nor shelter, nor treasure will save you; doing evil deeds, you shall depart empty-handed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਖ ਉਲਟਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਂਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: mitr na putr kalatr saajan sakh ulatat jaat birakh kee chhaa(n)rahu ||
english: Friends, children, spouses and friends - none of them last forever; they change like the shade of a tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: deen dayaal purakh prabh pooran chhin chhin simarahu agam apaarahu ||
english: God is the Perfect Primal Being, Merciful to the meek; each and every instant, meditate in remembrance on Him, the Inaccessible and Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਪਤਿ ਨਾਥ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sreepat naath saran naanak jan he bhagava(n)t kripaa kar taarahu ||5||
english: O Great Lord and Master, servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; please shower him with Your Mercy, and carry him across. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਮਗ ਜੋਹਨ ਹੀਤੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਦੇ ਲੇ ਲੇ ਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: praan maan daan mag johan heet cheet de le le paaree ||
english: I have used up my breath of life, sold my self-respect, begged for charity, committed highway robbery, and dedicated my consciousness to the love and pursuit of acquiring wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਨ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਲੇ ਰਖੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan sain meet sut bhaaee taahoo te le rakhee niraaree ||
english: I have kept it secretly hidden from my friends, relatives, companions, children and siblings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਨ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੂਰ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਅਉਧ ਤਨ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dhaavan paavan koor kamaavan ih bidh karat audh tan jaaree ||
english: I ran around practicing falsehood, burning up my body and growing old.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਚ ਨੇਮਾ ਚੰਚਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam sa(n)jam such nemaa cha(n)chal sa(n)g sagal bidh haaree ||
english: I gave up good deeds, righteousness and Dharma, self-discipline, purity, religious vows and all good ways; I associated with the fickle Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pas pa(n)khee birakh asathaavar bahu bidh jon bhramio at bhaaree ||
english: Beasts and birds, trees and mountains - in so many ways, I wandered lost in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khin pal chasaa naam nahee simario deenaa naath praanapat saaree ||
english: I did not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for a moment, or even an instant. He is the Master of the meek, the Lord of all life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਭੋਜਨ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਕਤ ਖਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khaan paan meeth ras bhojan a(n)t kee baar hot kat khaaree ||
english: The food and drink, and the sweet and tasty dishes became totally bitter at the last moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਚਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਡਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t charan sa(n)g udhare hor maaiaa magan chale sabh daaree ||6||
english: O Nanak, I was saved in the Society of the Saints, at their feet; the others, intoxicated with Maya, have gone, leaving everything behind. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਿਵ ਛੰਦ ਮੁਨੀਸੁਰ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: brahamaadik siv chha(n)d muneesur rasak rasak thaakur gun gaavat ||
english: Brahma, Shiva, the Vedas and the silent sages sing the Glorious Praises of their Lord and Master with love and delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਗੋਰਖ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਆਵਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dr muni(n)dr khojate gorakh dharan gagan aavat phun dhaavat ||
english: Indra, Vishnu and Gorakh, who come to earth and then go to heaven again, seek the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਮਨੁਖੵ ਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਦਾਨਵ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: sidh manukhy dev ar daanav ik til taa ko maram na paavat ||
english: The Siddhas, human beings, gods and demons cannot find even a tiny bit of His Mystery.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: pri prabh preet prem ras bhagatee har jan taa kai daras samaavat ||
english: The Lord's humble servants are imbued with love and affection for God their Beloved; in the delight of devotional worship, they are absorbed in the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਸਗਲ ਘਸਿ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: tisahi tiaag aan kau jaachahi mukh da(n)t rasan sagal ghas jaavat ||
english: But those who forsake Him, and beg from another, shall see their mouths, teeth and tongues wear away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਤ ॥੭॥
transliteration: re man mooR simar sukhadaataa naanak daas tujhahi samajhaavat ||7||
english: O my foolish mind, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Giver of peace. Slave Nanak imparts these teachings. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਕਰਤ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਕੂਪਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ra(n)g bira(n)g karat bhram moh kai koop gubaar pario hai ||
english: The pleasures of Maya shall fade away. In doubt, the mortal falls into the deep dark pit of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਤਾ ਗਬੁ ਅਕਾਸਿ ਨ ਮਾਵਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅਸ੍ਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਮਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: etaa gab akaas na maavat bisataa ast krim udar bhario hai ||
english: He is so proud, even the sky cannot contain him. His belly is filled with manure, bones and worms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਛੀਨਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਹਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: dah dis dhaai mahaa bikhiaa kau par dhan chheen agiaan hario hai ||
english: He runs around in the ten directions, for the sake of the great poison of corruption. He steals the wealth of others, and in the end, he is destroyed by his own ignorance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨ ਬੀਤਿ ਜਰਾ ਰੋਗਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਜਮਦੂਤਨ ਡੰਨੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: joban beet jaraa rog grasio jamadootan da(n)n mirat mario hai ||
english: His youth passes away, the illnesses of old age seize him, and the Messenger of Death punishes him; such is the death he dies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਨਰਕ ਭੁੰਚਤ ਸਾਸਨ ਦੂਖ ਗਰਤਿ ਗਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: anik jon sa(n)kat narak bhu(n)chat saasan dookh garat gario hai ||
english: He suffers the agony of hell in countless incarnations; he rots away in the pit of pain and condemnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: prem bhagat udharahi se naanak kar kirapaa sa(n)t aap kario hai ||8||
english: O Nanak, those whom the Saint mercifully takes as his own, are carried across by their loving devotional worship. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸਮੂਹ ਫਲ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gun samooh phal sagal manorath pooran hoee aas hamaaree ||
english: All virtues are obtained, all fruits and rewards, and the desires of the mind; my hopes have been totally fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਣ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh ma(n)tr ta(n)tr par dukh har sarab rog kha(n)dan gunakaaree ||
english: The Medicine, the Mantra, the Magic Charm, will cure all illnesses and totally take away all pain.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh mad matasar trisanaa binas jaahi har naam uchaaree ||
english: Lust, anger, egotism, jealousy and desire are eliminated by chanting the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਤਾਪਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: isanaan daan taapan such kiriaa charan kamal hiradai prabh dhaaree ||
english: The merits of cleansing baths, charity, penance, purity and good deeds, are obtained by enshrining the Lotus Feet of God within the heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet sakhaa har ba(n)dhap jee dhaan prabh praan adhaaree ||
english: The Lord is my Friend, my Very Best Friend, Companion and Relative. God is the Sustenance of the soul, the Support of the breath of life.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਮਰਥਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ot gahee suaamee samarathah naanak daas sadaa balihaaree ||9||
english: I have grasped the Shelter and Support of my All-powerful Lord and Master; slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||9||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਆਵਧ ਕਟਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: aavadh katio na jaat prem ras charan kamal sa(n)g ||
english: Weapons cannot cut that person who delights in the love of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦਾਵਨਿ ਬੰਧਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਧੇ ਮਨ ਦਰਸ ਮਗਿ ॥
transliteration: daavan ba(n)dhio na jaat bidhe man daras mag ||
english: Ropes cannot bind that person whose mind is pierced through by the Vision of the Lord's Way.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕ ਜਰਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਗਿ ॥
transliteration: paavak jario na jaat rahio jan dhoor lag ||
english: Fire cannot burn that person who is attached to the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਕਸਿ ਬੋਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਪਗਿ ॥
transliteration: neer na saakas bor chalahi har pa(n)th pag ||
english: Water cannot drown that person whose feet walk on the Lord's Path.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਅਘ ਮੋਹ ਛਿਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਖਗਿ ॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak rog dokh agh moh chhide har naam khag ||1||10||
english: O Nanak, diseases, faults, sinful mistakes and emotional attachment are pierced by the Arrow of the Name. ||1||10||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਚਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਖਟੂਆ ॥
transliteration: udam kar laage bahu bhaatee bicharahi anik saasatr bahu khatooaa ||
english: People are engaged in making all sorts of efforts; they contemplate the various aspects of the six Shaastras.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਇ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਸੂਖਮ ਦੇਹ ਬੰਧਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜਟੂਆ ॥
transliteration: bhasam lagaai teerath bahu bhramate sookham deh ba(n)dhahi bahu jatooaa ||
english: Rubbing ashes all over their bodies, they wander around at the various sacred shrines of pilgrimage; they fast until their bodies are emaciated, and braid their hair into tangled messes.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਤ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਢਾਇ ਸੂਤ ਕੇ ਹਟੂਆ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhajan sagal dukh paavat jiu prem badhaai soot ke hatooaa ||
english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, they all suffer in pain, caught in the tangled web of their love.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਕਰਤ ਸੋਮਪਾਕਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਥਾਟਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਟੂਆ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
transliteration: poojaa chakr karat somapaakaa anik bhaa(n)t thaatahi kar thatooaa ||2||11||20||
english: They perform worship ceremonies, draw ritual marks on their bodies, cook their own food fanatically, and make pompous shows of themselves in all sorts of ways. ||2||11||20||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਕੇ ੧ ॥
transliteration: savaeee mahale pahile ke 1 ||
english: Swaiyas In Praise Of The First Mehl:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਰਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ik man purakh dhiaai baradaataa ||
english: Meditate single-mindedly on the Primal Lord God, the Bestower of blessings.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਖਿਆਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sahaar sadaa bikhiaataa ||
english: He is the Helper and Support of the Saints, manifest forever.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਨ ਲੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: taas charan le ridai basaavau ||
english: Grasp His Feet and enshrine them in your heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau param guroo naanak gun gaavau ||1||
english: Then, let us sing the Glorious Praises of the most exalted Guru Nanak. ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਨ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਦੁਰਤ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਸਬਦ ਸਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavau gun param guroo sukh saagar durat nivaaran sabad sare ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the most exalted Guru Nanak, the Ocean of peace, the Eradicator of sins, the sacred pool of the Shabad, the Word of God.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi ga(n)bheer dheer mat saagar jogee ja(n)gam dhiaan dhare ||
english: The beings of deep and profound understanding, oceans of wisdom, sing of Him; the Yogis and wandering hermits meditate on Him.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi i(n)draad bhagat prahilaadik aatam ras jin jaanio ||
english: Indra and devotees like Prahlaad, who know the joy of the soul, sing of Him.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||2||
english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਕਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi janakaad jugat jogesur har ras pooran sarab kalaa ||
english: King Janak and the great Yogic heroes of the Lord's Way, sing the Praises of the All-powerful Primal Being, filled with the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਧਾਦਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi sanakaad saadh sidhaadik mun jan gaavahi achhal chhalaa ||
english: Sanak and Brahma's sons, the Saadhus and Siddhas, the silent sages and humble servants of the Lord sing the Praises of Guru Nanak, who cannot be deceived by the great deceiver.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਧੋਮੁ ਅਟਲ ਮੰਡਲਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: gaavai gun dhom atal ma(n)dalavai bhagat bhaai ras jaanio ||
english: Dhoma the seer and Dhroo, whose realm is unmoving, sing the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the ecstasy of loving devotional worship.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||3||
english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||3||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਪਿਲਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਵਰੋ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi kapilaad aad jogesur apara(n)par avataar varo ||
english: Kapila and the other Yogis sing of Guru Nanak. He is the Avataar, the Incarnation of the Infinite Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਜਮਦਗਨਿ ਪਰਸਰਾਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਰਘੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਹਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: gaavai jamadagan parasaraamesur kar kuthaar ragh tej hario ||
english: Parasraam the son of Jamdagan, whose axe and powers were taken away by Raghuvira, sing of Him.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਉਧੌ ਅਕ੍ਰੂਰੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਰਬਾਤਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: udhau akroor bidar gun gaavai sarabaatam jin jaanio ||
english: Udho, Akrur and Bidur sing the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the Lord, the Soul of All.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||4||
english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||4||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਿਮਰੰਥਿ ਗੁਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi gun baran chaar khat darasan brahamaadik simara(n)th gunaa ||
english: The four castes and the six Shaastras sing His Glorious Praises; Brahma and the others contemplate His Virtues.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੇਸੁ ਸਹਸ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਰਸ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਧੁਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gaavai gun ses sahas jihabaa ras aad a(n)t liv laag dhunaa ||
english: The thousand-tongued serpent king sings His Praises with delight, remaining lovingly attached to Him.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: gaavai gun mahaadeu bairaagee jin dhiaan nira(n)tar jaanio ||
english: Shiva, detached and beyond desire, sings the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the Lord's endless meditation.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||5||
english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||5||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raaj jog maanio basio niravair rida(n)tar ||
english: He mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoys sovereignty over both worlds; the Lord, beyond hate and revenge, is enshrined within His Heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਲੇ ਤਰਿਓ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: srisat sagal udharee naam le tario nira(n)tar ||
english: The whole world is saved, and carried across, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਜਨਕਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਹ ਲਗਿ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi sanakaad aad janakaad jugah lag ||
english: Sanak and Janak and the others sing His Praises, age after age.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ ਭਲੌ ਜਗਿ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur dha(n)n janam sakayath bhalau jag ||
english: Blessed, blessed, blessed and fruitful is the sublime birth of the Guru into the world.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: paataal puree jaikaar dhun kab jan kal vakhaanio ||
english: Even in the nether regions, His Victory is celebrated; so says KAL the poet.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har naam rasik naanak gur raaj jog tai maanio ||6||
english: You are blessed with the Nectar of the Lord's Name, O Guru Nanak; You have mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoy sovereignty over both worlds. ||6||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਛਲਿਓ ਬਲਿ ਬਾਵਨ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: satajug tai maanio chhalio bal baavan bhaaio ||
english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, You were pleased to deceive Baal the king, in the form of a dwarf.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਘੁਵੰਸੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: tretai tai maanio raam raghuva(n)s kahaaio ||
english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, You were called Raam of the Raghu dynasty.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਕੰਸੁ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ਕੀਓ ॥
transliteration: duaapur krisan muraar ka(n)s kirataarath keeo ||
english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, You were Krishna; You killed Mur the demon and saved Kans.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਣ ਕਉ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਭੈ ਭਗਤਹ ਜਨ ਦੀਓ ॥
transliteration: ugrasain kau raaj abhai bhagatah jan deeo ||
english: You blessed Ugrasain with a kingdom, and You blessed Your humble devotees with fearlessness.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kalijug pramaan naanak gur a(n)gad amar kahaaio ||
english: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, You are known and accepted as Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Das.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sree guroo raaj abichal atal aad purakh phuramaaio ||7||
english: The sovereign rule of the Great Guru is unchanging and permanent, according the Command of the Primal Lord God. ||7||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai ravidaas bhagat jaidev trilochan ||
english: His Glorious Praises are sung by the devotees Ravi Daas, Jai Dayv and Trilochan.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਮ ਲੋਚਨ ॥
transliteration: naamaa bhagat kabeer sadaa gaavahi sam lochan ||
english: The devotees Naam Dayv and Kabeer praise Him continually, knowing Him to be even-eyed.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਬੇਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat ben gun ravai sahaj aatam ra(n)g maanai ||
english: The devotee Baynee sings His Praises; He intuitively enjoys the ecstasy of the soul.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jog dhiaan gur giaan binaa prabh avar na jaanai ||
english: He is the Master of Yoga and meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru; He knows none other except God.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ਪਰੀਖੵਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੋਤਮ ਰਿਖਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sukhadeu pareekhyt gun ravai gotam rikh jas gaaio ||
english: Sukh Dayv and Preekhyat sing His Praises, and Gautam the rishi sings His Praise.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਛਾਇਓ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kab kal sujas naanak gur nit navatan jag chhaaio ||8||
english: Says KAL the poet, the ever-fresh praises of Guru Nanak are spread throughout the world. ||8||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਯਾਲਿ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਗਾਦਿ ਭੁਯੰਗਮ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi paayaal bhagat naagaad bhuya(n)gam ||
english: In the nether worlds, His Praises are sung by the devotees like Shaysh-naag in serpent form.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ॥
transliteration: mahaadeu gun ravai sadaa jogee jat ja(n)gam ||
english: Shiva, the Yogis and the wandering hermits sing His Praises forever.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੵਾਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੵਾਕਰਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਅ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai mun byaas jin bed byaakaran beechaari ||
english: Vyaas the silent sage, who studied the Vedas and its grammar, sings His Praise.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਅ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa gun ucharai jin hukam sabh srisat savaaree ||
english: His Praises are sung by Brahma, who created the entire universe by God's Command.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਮ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: brahama(n)d kha(n)d pooran braham gun niragun sam jaanio ||
english: God fills the galaxies and realms of the universe; He is known to be the same, manifest and unmanifest.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jap kal sujas naanak gur sahaj jog jin maanio ||9||
english: KAL chants the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Yoga. ||9||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi nav naath dha(n)n gur saach samaaio ||
english: The nine masters of Yoga sing His Praises; blessed is the Guru, who is merged into the True Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਧਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਜੇਨ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: maa(n)dhaataa gun ravai jen chakravai kahaaio ||
english: Maandhaataa, who called himself ruler of all the world, sings His Praises.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਉ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਬਸੰਤੌ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai bal raau sapat paataal basa(n)tau ||
english: Bal the king, dwelling in the seventh underworld, sings His Praises.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਰਥਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੰਤੌ ॥
transliteration: bharathar gun ucharai sadaa gur sa(n)g raha(n)tau ||
english: Bhart'har, abiding forever with Gorakh, his guru, sings His Praises.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਬਾ ਪਰੂਰਉ ਅੰਗਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: doorabaa paroorau a(n)garai gur naanak jas gaaio ||
english: Doorbaasaa, King Puro and Angra sing the Praises of Guru Nanak.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kab kal sujas naanak gur ghat ghat sahaj samaaio ||10||
english: Says KAL the poet, the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak intuitively permeate each and every heart. ||10||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਕੇ ੨ ॥
transliteration: savaeee mahale dooje ke 2 ||
english: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Second Mehl:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੋ ॥
transliteration: soee purakh dha(n)n karataa kaaran karataar karan samaratho ||
english: Blessed is the Primal Lord God, the Creator, the All-powerful Cause of causes.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਧੰਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੁਮ ਧਰਿਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਥੋ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo dha(n)n naanak masatak tum dhario jin hatho ||
english: Blessed is the True Guru Nanak, who placed His hand upon Your forehead.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤ ਧਰਿਓ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੁਠਉ ਛਜਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੋਹਿਯ ਅਗਾਜਿ ॥
transliteration: ta dhario masatak hath sahaj amiu vuthau chhaj sur nar gan mun bohiy agaaj ||
english: When He placed His hand upon Your forehead, then the celestial nectar began to rain down in torrents; the gods and human beings, heavenly heralds and sages were drenched in its fragrance.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਿਓ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਗਰਜਿ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਲੀਓ ਬਰਜਿ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਏਕ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇ ਸਮਜਿ ॥
transliteration: maario ka(n)tak kaal garaj dhaavat leeo baraj pa(n)ch bhoot ek ghar raakh le samaj ||
english: You challenged and subdued the cruel demon of death; You restrained Your wandering mind; You overpowered the five demons and You keep them in one home.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਸਮਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਰਾਖਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jag jeetau gur duaar khelahi samat saar rath unaman liv raakh nira(n)kaar ||
english: Through the Guru's Door, the Gurdwara, You have conquered the world; You play the game even-handedly. You keep the flow of your love steady for the Formless Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat deep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||1||
english: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਕਾਲੁਖ ਖਨਿ ਉਤਾਰ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗੵਾਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਦਰਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee drisat a(n)mrit dhaar kaalukh khan utaar timar agyaan jaahi daras duaar ||
english: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar from His eyes washes away the slime and filth of sins; the sight of His door dispels the darkness of ignorance.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਬਿਖਮ ਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: oi j sevahi sabad saar gaakhaRee bikham kaar te nar bhav utaar keee nirabhaar ||
english: Whoever accomplishes this most difficult task of contemplating the most sublime Word of the Shabad - those people cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and cast off their loads of sin.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਰਿ ਜਾਗੀਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਰੀ ਭੂਤ ਸਦੀਵ ਪਰਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat sahaj saar jaageele gur beechaar ni(n)maree bhoot sadeev param piaar ||
english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is celestial and sublime; whoever remains awake and aware, contemplating the Guru, embodies humility, and is imbued forever with the Supreme Love of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat deep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||2||
english: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਤਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਜਨ ਜੀਆ ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tai tau driRio naam apaar bimal jaas bithaar saadhik sidh sujan jeeaa ko adhaar ||
english: You hold tight to the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord; Your expanse is immaculate. You are the Support of the Siddhas and seekers, and the good and humble beings.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਤਾ ਜਨਿਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਰਹਹਿ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਜਲ ਪਦਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: too taa janik raajaa autaar sabad sa(n)saar saar rahahi jagatr jal padam beechaar ||
english: You are the incarnation of King Janak; the contemplation of Your Shabad is sublime throughout the universe. You abide in the world like the lotus on the water.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਪ ਤਰੁ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kalip tar rog bidaar sa(n)saar taap nivaar aatamaa tribidh terai ek liv taar ||
english: Like the Elyisan Tree, You cure all illnesses and take away the sufferings of the world. The three-phased soul is lovingly attuned to You alone.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat deep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||3||
english: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||3||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਤਾ ਹਦਰਥਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ਸਾਧਿ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tai taa hadarath paaio maan seviaa gur paravaan saadh ajagar jin keeaa unamaan ||
english: You were blessed with glory by the Prophet; You serve the Guru, certified by the Lord, who has subdued the snake of the mind, and who abides in the state of sublime bliss.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਮਾਨ ਆਤਮਾ ਵੰਤਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਣੀਅ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: har har daras samaan aatamaa va(n)tagiaan jaanee akal gat gur paravaan ||
english: Your Vision is like that of the Lord, Your soul is a fount of spiritual wisdom; You know the unfathomable state of the certified Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਚਲ ਠਾਣ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਥਾਨ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸੀਲ ਸਨਾਹੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee drisat achal thaan bimal budh suthaan pahir seel sanaahu sakat bidaar ||
english: Your Gaze is focused upon the unmoving, unchanging place. Your Intellect is immaculate; it is focused upon the most sublime place. Wearing the armor of humility, you have overcome Maya.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat deep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||4||
english: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||4||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤ ਤਮ ਹਰਨ ਦਹਨ ਅਘ ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਸਨ ॥
transliteration: drisat dharat tam haran dahan agh paap pranaasan ||
english: Casting Your Glance of Grace, you dispel the darkness, burn away evil, and destroy sin.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੂਰ ਬਲਵੰਤ ਕਾਮ ਅਰੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
transliteration: sabad soor balava(n)t kaam ar krodh binaasan ||
english: You are the Heroic Warrior of the Shabad, the Word of God. Your Power destroys sexual desire and anger.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ॥
transliteration: lobh moh vas karan saran jaachik pratipaalan ||
english: You have overpowered greed and emotional attachment; You nurture and cherish those who seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਤ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਢਾਲਣ ॥
transliteration: aatam rat sa(n)grahan kahan a(n)mrit kal dhaalan ||
english: You gather in the joyful love of the soul; Your Words have the Potency to bring forth Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਪੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo kal satigur tilak sat laagai so pai tarai ||
english: You are appointed the True Guru, the True Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; whoever is truly attached to You is carried across.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਫਿਰਣਸੀਹ ਅੰਗਰਉ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਕਰੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur jagat phiranaseeh a(n)garau raaj jog lahanaa karai ||5||
english: The lion, the son of Pheru, is Guru Angad, the Guru of the World; Lehnaa practices Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||5||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਇਛਾ ਚਾਰਹ ॥
transliteration: sadaa akal liv rahai karan siu ichhaa chaarah ||
english: Your mind remains lovingly attuned to the Lord forever; You do whatever you desire.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਪੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਖਵੈ ਕਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਹ ॥
transliteration: drum sapoor jiu nivai khavai kas bimal beechaarah ||
english: Like the tree heavy with fruit, You bow in humility, and endure the pain of it; You are pure of thought.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਇਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਜਾਣਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ihai tat jaanio sarab gat alakh bidaanee ||
english: You realize this reality, that the Lord is All-pervading, Unseen and Amazing.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj bhaai sa(n)chio kiran a(n)mrit kal baanee ||
english: With intuitive ease, You send forth the rays of the Ambrosial Word of power.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜਿ ਲਯੌ ॥
transliteration: gur gam pramaan tai paaio sat sa(n)tokh graahaj layau ||
english: You have risen to the state of the certified Guru; you grasp truth and contentment.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਕਲੁ ਸਮੁਲਵੈ ਜਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ ਭਯੌ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har parasio kal samulavai jan darasan lahane bhayau ||6||
english: KAL proclaims, that whoever attains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of Lehnaa, meets with the Lord. ||6||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗਹਰਿ ਗਹੁ ਹਦਰਥਿ ਦੀਓ ॥
transliteration: man bisaas paaio gahar gahu hadarath deeo ||
english: My mind has faith, that the Prophet has given You access to the Profound Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗਰਲ ਨਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਠਯੋ ਅਮਿਉ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
transliteration: garal naas tan nathayo amiu a(n)taragat peeo ||
english: Your body has been purged of the deadly poison; You drink the Ambrosial Nectar deep within.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦਿ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅਲਖਿ ਕਲ ਧਰੀ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: rid bigaas jaagio alakh kal dharee juga(n)tar ||
english: Your Heart has blossomed forth in awareness of the Unseen Lord, who has infused His Power throughout the ages.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sahaj samaadh ravio saamaan nira(n)tar ||
english: O True Guru, You are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi, with continuity and equality.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਉਦਾਰਉ ਚਿਤ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਹਰਨ ਪਿਖੰਤਿਹ ਕਲਮਲ ਤ੍ਰਸਨ ॥
transliteration: udaarau chit daarid haran pikha(n)tih kalamal trasan ||
english: You are open-minded and large-hearted, the Destroyer of poverty; seeing You, sins are afraid.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਲੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਸੁ ਜੰਪਉ ਲਹਣੇ ਰਸਨ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sad ra(n)g sahaj kal ucharai jas ja(n)pau lahane rasan ||7||
english: Says KAL, I lovingly, continually, intuitively chant the Praises of Lehnaa with my tongue. ||7||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: naam avakhadh naam aadhaar ar naam samaadh sukh sadaa naam neesaan sohai ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our medicine; the Naam is our support; the Naam is the peace of Samaadhi. The Naam is the insignia which embellishes us forever.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੌ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰਹ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g ratau naam siu kal naam sur narah bohai ||
english: KAL is imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Naam which is the fragrance of gods and human beings.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਪਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਰਵਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam paras jin paaio sat pragatio rav loi ||
english: Whoever obtains the Naam, the Philosopher's Stone, becomes the embodiment of Truth, manifest and radiant throughout the world.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: darasan parasiai guroo kai athasath majan hoi ||8||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it is as if one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||8||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੰਤੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sach teerath sach isanaan ar bhojan bhaau sach sadaa sach bhaakha(n)t sohai ||
english: The True Name is the sacred shrine, the True Name is the cleansing bath of purification and food. The True Name is eternal love; chant the True Name, and be embellished.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sach paaio gur sabad sach naam sa(n)gatee bohai ||
english: The True Name is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, is fragrant with the True Name.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਵਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis sach sa(n)jam varat sach kab jan kal vakhaan ||
english: KAL the poet utters the Praises of the one whose self-discipline is the True Name, and whose fast is the True Name.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੯॥
transliteration: darasan parasiai guroo kai sach janam paravaan ||9||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, one's life is approved and certified in the True Name. ||9||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਅ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਭ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਅਘ ਪਾਪ ਸਕਲ ਮਲ ॥
transliteration: ami drisat subh karai harai agh paap sakal mal ||
english: When You bestow Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace, You eradicate all wickedness, sin and filth.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਬਲ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh ar lobh moh vas karai sabhai bal ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - You have overcome all these powerful passions.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sukh man vasai dukh sa(n)saarah khovai ||
english: Your mind is filled with peace forever; You banish the sufferings of the world.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਕਾਲਖ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur nav nidh dareeaau janam ham kaalakh dhovai ||
english: The Guru is the river of the nine treasures, washing off the dirt of our lives.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਟਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: s kahu tal gur seveeai ahinis sahaj subhaai ||
english: So speaks TAL the poet: serve the Guru, day and night, with intuitive love and affection.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: darasan parasiai guroo kai janam maran dukh jaai ||10||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru, the pains of death and rebirth are taken away. ||10||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਤੀਜੇ ਕੇ ੩ ॥
transliteration: savaeee mahale teeje ke 3 ||
english: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Third Mehl:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: soee purakh sivar saachaa jaa kaa ik naam achhal sa(n)saare ||
english: Dwell upon that Primal Being, the True Lord God; in this world, His One Name is Undeceivable.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin bhagat bhavajal taare simarahu soee naam paradhaan ||
english: He carries His devotees across the terrifying world-ocean; meditate in remembrance on His Naam, Supreme and Sublime.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਥਪਿਓ ਜੇਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸਿਧੀ ॥
transliteration: tit naam rasik naanak lahanaa thapio jen srab sidhee ||
english: Nanak delighted in the Naam; He established Lehnaa as Guru, who was imbued with all supernatural spiritual powers.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਜਨ ਕਲੵ ਸਬੁਧੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਨ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਤਰੀਯਾ ॥
transliteration: kav jan kaly sabudhee keerat jan amaradaas bistareeyaa ||
english: So speaks KALL the poet: the glory of the wise, sublime and humble Amar Daas is spread throughout the world.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਵਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਮਵਲਸਰਾ ॥
transliteration: keerat rav kiran pragat sa(n)saarah saakh tarovar mavalasaraa ||
english: His Praises radiate throughout the world, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the maulsar (fragrant) tree.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਹਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਅਰੁ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪੰਥਿ ਨਰਾ ॥
transliteration: utar dakhinahi pub ar pascham jai jai kaar japa(n)th naraa ||
english: In the north, south, east and west, people proclaim Your Victory.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਰਦਾਯਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਗੰਗ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਧਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam rasan guramukh baradaayau ulat ga(n)g pascham dhareeaa ||
english: The Guru spoke the Lord's Name with His mouth and broadcast it throughout the world, to turn the tide of the hearts of men.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||1||
english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
