gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਖੵ ਅਰੁ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi soee naam jakhy ar ki(n)nar saadhik sidh samaadh haraa ||
english: The gods and heavenly heralds, the Siddhas and seekers and Shiva in Samaadhi meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਅਵਰ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਵਰਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi nakhytr avar dhroo ma(n)dal naaradaad prahalaad varaa ||
english: The stars and the realms of Dhroo, and devotees like Naaraad and Prahlaad meditate on the Naam.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਸੈਲ ਲੋਅ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saseear ar soor naam ulaasahi sail lo jin udhariaa ||
english: The moon and the sun long for the Naam; it has saved even mountain ranges.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||2||
english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਮੁਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: soee naam sivar nav naath nira(n)jan siv sanakaad samudhariaa ||
english: Dwelling upon that Immaculate Naam, the nine Yogic masters, Shiva and Sanak and many others have been emancipated.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chavaraaseeh sidh budh jit raate a(n)bareek bhavajal tariaa ||
english: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhas are imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਉਧਉ ਅਕ੍ਰੂਰੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਲਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: udhau akroor tilochan naamaa kal kabeer kilavikh hariaa ||
english: It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||3||
english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||3||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tit naam laag tetees dhiaavahi jatee tapeesur man vasiaa ||
english: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੰਗੇਵ ਪਿਤਾਮਹ ਚਰਣ ਚਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: soee naam simar ga(n)gev pitaamah charan chit a(n)mrit rasiaa ||
english: Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tit naam guroo ga(n)bheer garoo mat sat kar sa(n)gat udhareeaa ||
english: The great and profound Guru has brought forth the Naam; accepting the teachings as true, the Holy Congregation has been saved.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||4||
english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||4||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਸਾਖਹ ॥
transliteration: naam kit sa(n)saar kiran rav suratar saakhah ||
english: The Glory of the Naam shines forth, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the Elysian Tree.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਖਹ ॥
transliteration: utar dakhin pub des pascham jas bhaakhah ||
english: In the countries of the north, south, east and west, the Praises of the Naam are chanted.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: janam ta ihu sakayath jit naam har ridai nivaasai ||
english: Life is fruitful, when the Name of the Lord abides in the heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਆਸਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sur nar gan ga(n)dharab chhi darasan aasaasai ||
english: The angelic beings, heavenly heralds, celestial singers and the six Shaastras yearn for the Naam.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨੌ ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਧੵਾਇਅਓ ॥
transliteration: bhalau prasidh tejo tanau kaly joR kar dhyaaiao ||
english: The son of Tayj Bhaan of the Bhalla dynasty is noble and famous; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਹਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
transliteration: soee naam bhagat bhavajal haran gur amaradaas tai paaio ||5||
english: The Naam takes away the fears of the devotees about the word-ocean; Guru Amar Daas has obtained it. ||5||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨਰ ਨਾਮਿ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaavahi dev tetees ar saadhik sidh nar naam kha(n)d brahama(n)d dhaare ||
english: The thirty-one million gods meditate on the Naam, along with the Siddhas and seekers; the Naam supports solar systems and galaxies.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jah naam samaadhio harakh sog sam kar sahaare ||
english: One who meditates on the Naam in Samaadhi, endures sorrow and joy as one and the same.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਰੋਮਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਭਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naam siroman sarab mai bhagat rahe liv dhaar ||
english: The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰ ਗੁਰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: soee naam padaarath amar gur tus deeo karataar ||6||
english: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the treasure of the Naam, by the Creator Lord, in His Pleasure. ||6||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੂਰਉ ਸੀਲਿ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sat soorau seel balava(n)t sat bhaai sa(n)gat saghan garoo mat niravair leenaa ||
english: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, free of hate and vengeance.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਧਵਲੁ ਧੁਜਾ ਸੇਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jis dheeraj dhur dhaval dhujaa set baiku(n)th beenaa ||
english: Patience has been His white banner since the beginning of time, planted on the bridge to heaven.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਕਰਤਾਰਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: parasahi sa(n)t piaar jih karataarah sa(n)jog ||
english: The Saints meet their Beloved Guru, who is united with the Creator Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਤਉ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satiguroo sev sukh paaio amar gur keetau jog ||7||
english: Serving the True Guru, they find peace; Guru Amar Daas has given them this ability. ||7||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸ ਖਾਣੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਯ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਸ੍ਟ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naam naavan naam ras khaan ar bhojan naam ras sadaa chaay mukh mist baanee ||
english: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਸਾਇ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan satigur sevio jis pasaai gat agam jaanee ||
english: Blessed is service to the True Guru; by His Grace, the State of the Unfathomable Lord is known.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਮੁਧਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kul sa(n)booh samudhare paayau naam nivaas ||
english: All Your generations are totally saved; You dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸੵਿਉ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sakayath janam kalyucharai gur parasyiu amar pragaas ||8||
english: So speaks KALL: fruitful is the life of one who meets with Guru Amar Daas, radiant with the Light of God. ||8||

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਹਿਣੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: baarij kar daahinai sidh sanamukh mukh jovai ||
english: On His right hand is the sign of the lotus; the Siddhis, the supernatural spiritual powers, await His Command.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਂਵਾਂਗਿ ਜੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕਾਂਤਰ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ridh basai baa(n)vaa(n)g j teen lokaa(n)tar mohai ||
english: On His left are worldly powers, which fascinate the three worlds.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਅਕਹੀਉ ਸੋਇ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਉ ॥
transliteration: ridai basai akaheeu soi ras tin hee jaatau ||
english: The Inexpressible Lord abides in His Heart; He alone knows this joy.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਉ ॥
transliteration: mukhahu bhagat ucharai amar gur it ra(n)g raatau ||
english: Guru Amar Daas utters the words of devotion, imbued with the Love of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਧੵਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: masatak neesaan sachau karam kaly joR kar dhyaaiau ||
english: On His forehead is the true insignia of the Lord's Mercy; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਿਅਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਇਛ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
transliteration: parasiau guroo satigur tilak sarab ichh tin paaiau ||9||
english: Whoever meets with the Guru, the certified True Guru, has all his desires fulfilled. ||9||

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਵਲਿ ਰਯ ॥
transliteration: charan ta par sakayath charan gur amar paval ray ||
english: Supremely fruitful are the feet which walk upon the path of Guru Amar Daas.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਹਥ ਲਗਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਯ ॥
transliteration: hath ta par sakayath hath lagahi gur amar pay ||
english: Supremely fruitful are the hands which touch the feet of Guru Amar Daas.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਜੀਹ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਣਿਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jeeh ta par sakayath jeeh gur amar bhanijai ||
english: Supremely fruitful is the tongue which utters the praises of Guru Amar Daas.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਨਯਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਪਿਖਿਜੈ ॥
transliteration: nain ta par sakayath nayan gur amar pikhijai ||
english: Supremely fruitful are the eyes which behold Guru Amar Daas.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sravan ta par sakayath sravan gur amar sunijai ||
english: Supremely fruitful are the ears which hear the Praises of Guru Amar Daas.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਸੁ ਹੀਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੀਅ ਬਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ॥
transliteration: sakayath s heeu jit hee basai gur amaradaas nij jagat pit ||
english: Fruitful is the heart in which Guru Amar Daas, the Father of the world, Himself abides.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਸੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਜੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਤ ॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sakayath s sir jaalap bhanai j sir nivai gur amar nit ||1||10||
english: Fruitful is the head, says Jaalap, which bows forever before Guru Amar Daas. ||1||10||

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਰ ਦੁਖ ਨਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਨਰ ਨਿਧਨ ਨਹੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tinar dukh nah bhukh tinar nidhan nahu kaheeahi ||
english: They do not suffer pain or hunger, and they cannot be called poor.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਰ ਸੋਕੁ ਨਹੁ ਹੂਐ ਤਿਨਰ ਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tinar sok nahu hooai tinar se a(n)t na laheeahi ||
english: They do not grieve, and their limits cannot be found.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਰ ਸੇਵ ਨਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਰ ਸਯ ਸਹਸ ਸਮਪਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tinar sev nahu karahi tinar say sahas samapahi ||
english: They do not serve anyone else, but they give gifts to hundreds and thousands.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਰ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬਹਹਿ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਉਥਪਿ ਬਿਥਪਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tinar duleechai bahahi t nar uthap bithapahi ||
english: They sit on beautiful carpets; they establish and disestablish at will.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਤਿਨਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਭੈ ਪਟੁ ਰਿਪ ਮਧਿ ਤਿਹ ॥
transliteration: sukh lahahi tinar sa(n)saar mahi abhai pat rip madh tih ||
english: They find peace in this world, and live fearlessly amidst their enemies.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਸਕਯਥ ਤਿਨਰ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਜਿਹ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sakayath tinar jaalap bhanai gur amaradaas suprasa(n)n jih ||2||11||
english: They are fruitful and prosperous, says Jaalap. Guru Amar Daas is pleased with them. ||2||11||

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਪਢਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਰਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: tai padhiau ik man dhariau ik kar ik pachhaanio ||
english: You read about the One Lord, and enshrine Him in Your mind; You realize the One and Only Lord.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਨਯਣਿ ਬਯਣਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਠਾਂਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: nayan bayan muhi ik ik duhu thaa(n)i na jaanio ||
english: With Your eyes and the words You speak, You dwell upon the One Lord; You do not know any other place of rest.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕਸ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਣਉ ॥
transliteration: supan ik paratakh ik ikas mahi leenau ||
english: You know the One Lord while dreaming, and the One Lord while awake. You are absorbed in the One.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਤੀਸ ਇਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਿਧੁ ਪੈਤੀਸ ਨ ਖੀਣਉ ॥
transliteration: tees ik ar pa(n)j sidh paitees na kheenau ||
english: At the age of seventy-one, You began to march towards the Indestructible Lord.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਇਕਹੁ ਜਿ ਲਾਖੁ ਲਖਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: ikahu j laakh lakhahu alakh hai ik ik kar varaniau ||
english: The One Lord, who takes hundreds of thousands of forms, cannot be seen. He can only be described as One.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਤੂ ਇਕੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਅਉ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas jaalap bhanai too ik loRahi ik ma(n)niau ||3||12||
english: So speaks Jaalap: O Guru Amar Daas, You long for the One Lord, and believe in the One Lord alone. ||3||12||

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਗਹੀ ਜੈਦੇਵਿ ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: j mat gahee jaidev j mat naamai sa(n)maanee ||
english: The understanding which Jai Dayv grasped, the understanding which permeated Naam Dayv,

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਗਤ ਕੰਬੀਰਹਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: j mat trilochan chit bhagat ka(n)beerahi jaanee ||
english: the understanding which was in the consciousness of Trilochan and known by the devotee Kabeer,

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਰੁਕਮਾਂਗਦ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੰਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rukamaa(n)gad karatoot raam ja(n)pahu nit bhaaee ||
english: by which Rukmaangad constantly meditated on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny,

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮਰੀਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mareek prahalaad saran gobi(n)d gat paaee ||
english: which brought Ambreek and Prahlaad to seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe, and which brought them to salvation

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜੀ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਲੵ ਜਾਣੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tai lobh krodh trisanaa tajee s mat jaly jaanee jugat ||
english: says JALL that sublime understanding has brought You to renounce greed, anger and desire, and to know the way.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas nij bhagat hai dekh daras paavau mukat ||4||13||
english: Guru Amar Daas is the Lord's own devotee; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is liberated. ||4||13||

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਪੁਹਮਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਬਿਨਾਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas paraseeai puham paatik binaasahi ||
english: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the earth is purged of its sin.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਆਸਾਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas paraseeai sidh saadhik aasaasahi ||
english: The Siddhas and seekers long to meet with Guru Amar Daas.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਪਉ ਮੁਕਿਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas paraseeai dhiaan laheeai pau mukihi ||
english: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the mortal meditates on the Lord, and his journey comes to its end.

author: Bhatt Jaalap
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਅਭਉ ਲਭੈ ਗਉ ਚੁਕਿਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas paraseeai abhau labhai gau chukihi ||
english: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and the cycle of reincarnation is brought to an end.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਬਿੰਨਿ ਦੁਗਣ ਜੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਸੁਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਾਨਵ ਹਿਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik bi(n)n dugan j tau rahai jaa suma(n)tr maanav hilahi ||
english: Realizing the One Lord, love of duality ceases, and one comes to accept the Sublime Mantra of the Guru.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਪਾ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jaalapaa padaarath itaRe gur amaradaas dithai milahi ||5||14||
english: So speaks Jaalap: countless treasures are obtained, by the sight of Guru Amar Daas. ||5||14||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: sach naam karataar s driR naanak sa(n)grahiau ||
english: Guru Nanak gathered up the True Name of the Creator Lord, and implanted it within.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣਹ ਲਿਵ ਰਹਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: taa te a(n)gad lahanaa pragat taas charanah liv rahiau ||
english: Through Him, Lehnaa became manifest in the form of Guru Angad, who remained lovingly attuned to His Feet.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਕੁਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਆਸਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਣ ਵਖਾਣਉ ॥
transliteration: tit kul gur amaradaas aasaa nivaas taas gun kavan vakhaanau ||
english: Guru Amar Daas of that dynasty is the home of hope. How can I express His Glorious Virtues?

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਅਲਖ ਅਗੰਮ ਤਿਨਹ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ ॥
transliteration: jo gun alakh aga(n)m tinah gun a(n)t na jaanau ||
english: His Virtues are unknowable and unfathomable. I do not know the limits of His Virtues.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥਉ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਨਿਰਮਯੌ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਣ ॥
transliteration: bohithau bidhaatai niramayau sabh sa(n)gat kul udharan ||
english: The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, has made Him a boat to carry all His generations across, along with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੀਰਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤੁਅ ਪਾ ਸਰਣ ॥੧॥੧੫॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas keerat kahai traahi traahi tu paa saran ||1||15||
english: So speaks Keerat: O Guru Amar Daas, please protect me and save me; I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||15||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵਰਿਯਉ ॥
transliteration: aap naraain kalaa dhaar jag mahi paravariyau ||
english: The Lord Himself wielded His Power and entered the world.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਕਰਿਯਉ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar aakaar jot jag ma(n)dal kariyau ||
english: The Formless Lord took form, and with His Light He illuminated the realms of the world.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਤਹ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਪਕਿ ਦੀਪਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: jah kah tah bharapoor sabad deepak deepaayau ||
english: He is All-pervading everywhere; the Lamp of the Shabad, the Word, has been lit.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਖਹ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: jih sikhah sa(n)grahio tat har charan milaayau ||
english: Whoever gathers in the essence of the teachings shall be absorbed in the Feet of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲਿ ਨਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਵਤਰੵਿਉ ਅੰਗਦ ਲਹਣੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੁਅ ॥
transliteration: naanak kul ni(n)mal avataryiu a(n)gad lahane sa(n)g hu ||
english: Lehnaa, who became Guru Angad, and Guru Amar Daas, have been reincarnated into the pure house of Guru Nanak.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਪਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਅ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas taaran taran janam janam paa saran tu ||2||16||
english: Guru Amar Daas is our Saving Grace, who carries us across; in lifetime after lifetime, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||2||16||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਹ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sat sa(n)tokh pikh darasan gur sikhah ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the Gursikh is blessed with chanting and deep meditation, truth and contentment.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਮ ਪੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਖਹ ॥
transliteration: saran parahi te ubarahi chhod jam pur kee likhah ||
english: Whoever seeks His Sanctuary is saved; his account is cleared in the City of Death.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਚਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai bharapoor ridai ucharai karataarai ||
english: His heart is totally filled with loving devotion; he chants to the Creator Lord.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਪਲਕ ਡੁਬੰਤੵਹ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur gauhar dareeaau palak duba(n)tyh taarai ||
english: The Guru is the river of pearls; in an instant, he carries the drowning ones across.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲਿ ਨਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਵਤਰੵਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੈ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak kul ni(n)mal avataryiu gun karataarai ucharai ||
english: He was reincarnated into the House of Guru Nanak; He chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator Lord.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਅਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas jinh seviau tinh dukh daridr parahar parai ||3||17||
english: Those who serve Guru Amar Daas - their pains and poverty are taken away, far away. ||3||17||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਹਉ ਪਰੁ ਕਹਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥
transliteration: chit chitavau aradaas kahau par kahi bh na sakau ||
english: I consciously pray within my consciousness, but I cannot express it in words.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਝੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਉ ਤਕਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab chi(n)t tujh paas saadhasa(n)gat hau takau ||
english: I place all my worries and anxieties before You; I look to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, for help.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਤਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: terai hukam pavai neesaan tau karau saahib kee sevaa ||
english: By the Hukam of Your Command, I am blessed with Your Insignia; I serve my Lord and Master.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jab gur dekhai subh disat naam karataa mukh mevaa ||
english: When You, O Guru, gaze at me with Your Glance of Grace, the fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Creator, is placed within my mouth.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਲਖ ਕਾਰਣ ਪੁਰਖ ਜੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਹਉ ॥
transliteration: agam alakh kaaran purakh jo phuramaavahi so kahau ||
english: The Unfathomable and Unseen Primal Lord God, the Cause of causes - as He orders, so do I speak.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਰਹਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas kaaran karan jiv too rakhahi tiv rahau ||4||18||
english: O Guru Amar Daas, Doer of deeds, Cause of causes, as You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||4||18||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਭਿਖੇ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: bhikhe ke ||
english: Of Bhikhaa:

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan ar dhiaan tat siu tat milaavai ||
english: In deep meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru, one's essence merges with the essence of reality.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sach sach jaaneeai ik chitahi liv laavai ||
english: In truth, the True Lord is recognized and realized, when one is lovingly attuned to Him, with one-pointed consciousness.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਵਸਿ ਕਰੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਉਡੰਤ ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh vas karai pavan uda(n)t na dhaavai ||
english: Lust and anger are brought under control, when the breath does not fly around, wandering restlessly.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਵਸੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar kai vasai des hukam bujh beechaar paavai ||
english: Dwelling in the land of the Formless Lord, realizing the Hukam of His Command, His contemplative wisdom is attained.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: kal maahi roop karataa purakh so jaanai jin kichh keeau ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Guru is the Form of the Creator, the Primal Lord God; he alone knows, who has tried it.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੵਿਉ ਸੋਇ ਭਿਖਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਅਉ ॥੧॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gur milyiu soi bhikhaa kahai sahaj ra(n)g darasan deeau ||1||19||
english: So speaks Bhikhaa: I have met the Guru. With love and intuitive affection, He has bestowed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||19||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਹਉ ਟੋਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਡਿਠੇ ॥
transliteration: rahio sa(n)t hau tol saadh bahutere dithe ||
english: I have been searching for the Saints; I have seen so many Holy and spiritual people.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਤਪਸੀਅਹ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਏ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)niaasee tapaseeah mukhahu e pa(n)dit mithe ||
english: The hermits, Sannyaasees, ascetics, penitents, fanatics and Pandits all speak sweetly.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਕਿਨੈ ਨਹੁ ਪਰਚਉ ਲਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: baras ek hau phirio kinai nahu parachau laayau ||
english: I wandered around lost for a year, but no one touched my soul.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤਿਅਹ ਕਹਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਰਹਤ ਕੋ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਯਉ ॥
transliteration: kahatiah kahatee sunee rahat ko khusee na aayau ||
english: I listened to preachers and teachers, but I could not be happy with their lifestyles.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam chhod doojai lage tinh ke gun hau kiaa kahau ||
english: Those who have abandoned the Lord's Name, and become attached to duality - why should I speak in praise of them?

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਯਿ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਰਹਉ ॥੨॥੨੦॥
transliteration: gur day milaayau bhikhiaa jiv too rakhahi tiv rahau ||2||20||
english: So speaks Bhikhaa: the Lord has led me to meet the Guru. As You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||2||20||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਨਾਹੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਚੜਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: pahir samaadh sanaahu giaan hai aasan chaRiau ||
english: Wearing the armor of Samaadhi, the Guru has mounted the saddled horse of spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧਨਖੁ ਕਰ ਗਹਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਸੀਲਹ ਸਰਿ ਲੜਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: dhra(n)m dhanakh kar gahio bhagat seelah sar laRiau ||
english: Holding the bow of Dharma in His Hands, He has shot the arrows of devotion and humility.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਅਟਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਨੇਜਾ ਗਡਿਓ ॥
transliteration: bhai nirabhau har atal man sabad gur nejaa gadio ||
english: He is fearless in the Fear of the Eternal Lord God; He has thrust the spear of the Word of the Guru's Shabad into the mind.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਤੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh apat pa(n)ch doot bikha(n)dio ||
english: He has cut down the five demons of unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger, unsatisfied greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਲਉ ਭੂਹਾਲੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhalau bhoohaal tejo tanaa nripat naath naanak bar ||
english: Guru Amar Daas, the son of Tayj Bhaan, of the noble Bhalla dynasty, blessed by Guru Nanak, is the Master of kings.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਸਲੵ ਭਣਿ ਤੈ ਦਲੁ ਜਿਤਉ ਇਵ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਰਿ ॥੧॥੨੧॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas sach saly bhan tai dal jitau iv judh kar ||1||21||
english: SALL speaks the truth; O Guru Amar Daas, you have conquered the army of evil, fighting the battle this way. ||1||21||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਘਨਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਸੁਅ ਰੋਮਾਵਲਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਸੰਤ ਗਨੰਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ghanahar boo(n)d basu romaaval kusam basa(n)t gana(n)t na aavai ||
english: The raindrops of the clouds, the plants of the earth, and the flowers of the spring cannot be counted.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੋ ਗੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਅੰਤੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: rav sas kiran udar saagar ko ga(n)g tara(n)g a(n)t ko paavai ||
english: Who can know the limits of the rays of the sun and the moon, the waves of the ocean and the Ganges?

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਭਲੵ ਉਨਹ ਜੋੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: rudr dhiaan giaan satigur ke kab jan bhaly unah jou gaavai ||
english: With Shiva's meditation and the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, says BHALL the poet, these may be counted.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਲੇ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥੨੨॥
transliteration: bhale amaradaas gun tere teree upamaa tohi ban aavai ||1||22||
english: O Guru Amar Daas, Your Glorious Virtues are so sublime; Your Praises belong only to You. ||1||22||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਕੇ ੪ ॥
transliteration: savaeee mahale chauthe ke 4 ||
english: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fourth Mehl:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: ik man purakh nira(n)jan dhiaavau ||
english: Meditate single-mindedly on the Immaculate Primal Lord God.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad har gun sad gaavau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat man hoi bigaasaa ||
english: Singing His Praises, the mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨਹ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur poor janah kee aasaa ||
english: The True Guru fulfills the hopes of His humble servant.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev param pad paayau ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਧਿਆਯਉ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee abigat dhiaayau ||
english: Meditate on the Imperishable, Formless Lord God.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਚੰਪੈ ॥
transliteration: tis bhete daaridr na cha(n)pai ||
english: Meeting with Him, one escapes poverty.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਲੵ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਜੰਪੈ ॥
transliteration: kaly sahaar taas gun ja(n)pai ||
english: Kal Sahaar chants His Glorious Praises.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜੰਪਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਮਲ ਸੁਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੇ ਅਮਿਅ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)pau gun bimal sujan jan kere ami naam jaa kau phuriaa ||
english: I chant the pure praises of that humble being who has been blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਯਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: in satagur sev sabad ras paayaa naam nira(n)jan ur dhariaa ||
english: He served the True Guru and was blessed with the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Word of God. The Immaculate Naam has been enshrined in his heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਚਾਹਕੁ ਤਤ ਸਮਤ ਸਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har naam rasik gobi(n)d gun gaahak chaahak tat samat sare ||
english: He enjoys and savors the Lord's Name, and purchases the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe. He seeks the essence of reality; he is the Fountain of even-handed justice.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||1||
english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਛੁਟਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਅਮਿਅ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਦ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chhutat paravaah ami amaraa pad a(n)mrit sarovar sad bhariaa ||
english: The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool is forever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਪੁਬ ਜਿਨਹੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: te peevahi sa(n)t karahi man majan pub jinahu sevaa kareeaa ||
english: Those Saints who have served the Lord in the past drink in this Nectar, and bathe their minds in it.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਅਨਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਸਬਦ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tin bhau nivaar anabhai pad deenaa sabad maatr te udhar dhare ||
english: God takes their fears away, and blesses them with the state of fearless dignity. Through the Word of His Shabad, He has saved them.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||2||
english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਗੂੜੑ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੁ ਭਯਾ ॥
transliteration: satagur mat gooRh bimal satasa(n)gat aatam ra(n)g chalool bhayaa ||
english: The True Guru's understanding is deep and profound. The Sat Sangat is His Pure Congregation. His Soul is drenched in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗੵਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਵਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਰਕਾਸੵਾ ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਘਰਹਿ ਲਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jaagyaa man kaval sahaj parakaasyaa abhai nira(n)jan gharahi lahaa ||
english: The Lotus of His mind remains awake and aware, illuminated with intuitive wisdom. In His own home, He has obtained the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦਯਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satagur dayaal har naam driRhaayaa tis prasaad vas pa(n)ch kare ||
english: The Merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me, and by His Grace, I have overpowered the five thieves.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||3||
english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||3||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਉਨਮਾਨਿ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anabhau unamaan akal liv laagee paaras bhetiaa sahaj ghare ||
english: With intuitive detachment, He is lovingly attuned to the Fearless, Unmanifest Lord; He met with Guru Amar Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, within his own home.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satagur parasaad param pad paayaa bhagat bhaai bha(n)daar bhare ||
english: By the Grace of the True Guru, He attained the supreme status; He is overflowing with the treasures of loving devotion.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਨਮਾਂਤੁ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੇ ॥
transliteration: metiaa janamaa(n)t maran bhau bhaagaa chit laagaa sa(n)tokh sare ||
english: He was released from reincarnation, and the fear of death was taken away. His consciousness is attached to the Lord, the Ocean of contentment.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kav kaly thakur haradaas tane gur raamadaas sar abhar bhare ||4||
english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||4||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: abhar bhare paayau apaar rid a(n)tar dhaario ||
english: He fills the empty to overflowing; He has enshrined the Infinite within His heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan aatam prabodh man tat beechaario ||
english: Within His mind, He contemplates the essence of reality, the Destroyer of pain, the Enlightener of the soul.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਚਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa chaai har bhaai prem ras aape jaanai ||
english: He yearns for the Lord's Love forever; He Himself knows the sublime essence of this Love.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਇ ॥
transliteration: satagur kai parasaad sahaj setee ra(n)g maanai ||
english: By the Grace of the True Guru, He intuitively enjoys this Love.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਗਦ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: naanak prasaad a(n)gad sumat gur amar amar varataaio ||
english: By the Grace of Guru Nanak, and the sublime teachings of Guru Angad, Guru Amar Daas broadcast the Lord's Command.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈਂ ਅਟਲ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai(n) atal amar pad paaio ||5||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the status of eternal and imperishable dignity. ||5||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tokh sarovar basai ami ras rasan prakaasai ||
english: You abide in the pool of contentment; Your tongue reveals the Ambrosial Essence.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਦੂਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: milat saa(n)t upajai durat doora(n)tar naasai ||
english: Meeting with You, a tranquil peace wells up, and sins run far away.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਦਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar paaiau di(n)t har mag na hutai ||
english: You have attained the Ocean of peace, and You never grow tired on the Lord's path.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਮਫੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jam sat sa(n)tokh seel sa(n)naahu maphutai ||
english: The armor of self-restraint, truth, contentment and humility can never be pierced.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਬਿਧ ਨੈ ਸਿਰਿਉ ਜਗਿ ਜਸ ਤੂਰੁ ਬਜਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur pramaan bidh nai siriu jag jas toor bajaaiau ||
english: The Creator Lord certified the True Guru, and now the world blows the trumpet of His Praises.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਅਭੈ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai abhai amar pad paaiau ||6||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the state of fearless immortality. ||6||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਯਉ ॥
transliteration: jag jitau satigur pramaan man ek dhiaayau ||
english: O certified True Guru, You have conquered the world; You meditate single-mindedly on the One Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan satigur amaradaas jin naam driRaayau ||
english: Blessed, blessed is Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, who implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: nav nidh naam nidhaan ridh sidh taa kee daasee ||
english: The Naam is the wealth of the nine treasures; prosperity and supernatural spiritual powers are His slaves.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sarovar milio purakh bhetio abinaasee ||
english: He is blessed with the ocean of intuitive wisdom; He has met with the Imperishable Lord God.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: aad le bhagat jit lag tare so gur naam driRaaiau ||
english: The Guru has implanted the Naam deep within; attached to the Naam, the devotees have been carried across since ancient times.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai har prem padaarath paaiau ||7||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Love. ||7||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਬਲੀ ਨ ਹੁਟਇ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat paravaah preet pubalee na hutai ||
english: The flow of loving devotion and primal love does not stop.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਅ ਧਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਟਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sabad athaahu ami dhaaraa ras gutai ||
english: The True Guru drinks in the stream of nectar, the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Infinite Word of God.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: mat maataa sa(n)tokh pitaa sar sahaj samaayau ||
english: Wisdom is His mother, and contentment is His father; He is absorbed in the ocean of intuitive peace and poise.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਵਿਅਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਤਰਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: aajonee sa(n)bhaviau jagat gur bachan taraayau ||
english: The Guru is the Embodiment of the Unborn, Self-illumined Lord; by the Word of His Teachings, the Guru carries the world across.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰਪਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: abigat agochar aparapar man gurasabad vasaaiau ||
english: Within His mind, the Guru has enshrined the Shabad, the Word of the Unseen, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai jagat udhaaran paaiau ||8||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the Lord, the Saving Grace of the world. ||8||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jagat udhaaran nav nidhaan bhagatah bhav taaran ||
english: The Saving Grace of the world, the nine treasures, carries the devotees across the world-ocean.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit boo(n)d har naam bis kee bikhai nivaaran ||
english: The Drop of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's Name, is the antidote to the poison of sin.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਫਲਿਓ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: sahaj tarovar phalio giaan a(n)mrit phal laage ||
english: The tree of intuitive peace and poise blossoms and bears the ambrosial fruit of spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad paaeeahi dha(n)n te jan badabhaage ||
english: Blessed are those fortunate people who receive it, by Guru's Grace.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: te mukate bhae satigur sabad man gur parachaa paaiau ||
english: They are liberated through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; their minds are filled with the Guru's Wisdom.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਸਬਦ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tai sabad neesaan bajaaiau ||9||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You beat the drum of the Shabad. ||9||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸਧਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਚਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sej sadhaa sahaj chhaavaan sa(n)tokh saraaichau sadaa seel sa(n)naahu sohai ||
english: On the bed of faith, with the blankets of intuitive peace and poise and the canopy of contentment, You are embellished forever with the armor of humility.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਚਰਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਸੰਗਾਦਿ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad samaachario naam tek sa(n)gaad bohai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you practice the Naam; You lean on its Support, and give Your Fragrance to Your companions.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਜੋਨੀਉ ਭਲੵੁ ਅਮਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ajoneeu bhaly amal satigur sa(n)g nivaas ||
english: You abide with the Unborn Lord, the Good and Pure True Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੁਅ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas kalyucharai tu sahaj sarovar baas ||10||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You abide in the sacred pool of intuitive peace and poise. ||10||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: gur jinh kau suprasa(n)n naam har ridai nivaasai ||
english: The Lord's Name abides in the hearts of those who are pleasing to the Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਦੂਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: jinh kau gur suprasa(n)n durat doora(n)tar naasai ||
english: Sins run far away from those who are pleasing to the Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur jinh kau suprasa(n)n maan abhimaan nivaarai ||
english: Those who are pleasing to the Guru eradicate pride and egotism from within.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jinh kau gur suprasa(n)n sabad lag bhavajal taarai ||
english: Those who are pleasing to the Guru are attached to the Shadad, the Word of God; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪਰਚਉ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਕਯਥਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ॥
transliteration: parachau pramaan gur paaiau tin sakayathau janam jag ||
english: Those who are blessed with the wisdom of the certified Guru - blessed and fruitful is their birth into the world.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਭਜੁ ਕਲੵ ਕਬਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਗਿ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sree guroo saran bhaj kaly kab bhugat mukat sabh guroo lag ||11||
english: KALL the poet runs to the Sanctuary of the Great Guru; attached to the Guru, they are blessed with worldly enjoyments, liberation and everything. ||11||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਮਾ ਤਾਣਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਜੂਥ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur khemaa taaniaa jug jooth samaane ||
english: The Guru has pitched the tent; under it, all the ages are gathered.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਨੇਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਗਤ ਅਘਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: anabhau nejaa naam tek jit bhagat aghaane ||
english: He carries the spear of intuition, and takes the Support of Naam, the Name of the Lord, through which the devotees are fulfilled.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak a(n)gad amar bhagat har sa(n)g samaane ||
english: Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, through devotional worship, have merged into the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੂ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: ihu raaj jog gur raamadaas tumh hoo ras jaane ||12||
english: O Guru Raam Daas, You alone know the taste of this Raja Yoga. ||12||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਨਕੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janak soi jin jaaniaa unaman rath dhariaa ||
english: He alone is enlightened like Janaka, who links the chariot of his mind to the state of ecstatic realization.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਮਾਚਰੇ ਅਭਰਾ ਸਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh samaachare abharaa sar bhariaa ||
english: He gathers in truth and contentment, and fills up the empty pool within.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa amaraa puree jis dei s paavai ||
english: He speaks the Unspoken Speech of the eternal city. He alone obtains it, unto whom God gives it.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਬਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: ihu janak raaj gur raamadaas tujh hee ban aavai ||13||
english: O Guru Raam Daas, Your sovereign rule, like that of Janak, is Yours alone. ||13||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur naam ek liv man japai driRh tinh jan dukh paap kahu kat hovai jeeu ||
english: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith?

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਧਾਰੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: taaran taran khin maatr jaa kau drist dhaarai sabad rid beechaarai kaam krodh khovai jeeu ||
english: When the Lord, the Boat to carry us across, bestows His Glance of Grace, even for an instant, the mortal contemplates the Shabad within his heart; unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger are eradicated.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਸਭਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਗੵਾਨ ਬਿਖੵਾਤਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਧੵਾਨ ਧਾਵੈ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jeean sabhan daataa agam gyaan bikhyaataa ahinis dhyaan dhaavai palak na sovai jeeu ||
english: The Guru is the Giver to all beings; He speaks the spiritual wisdom of the Unfathomable Lord, and meditates on Him day and night. He never sleeps, even for an instant.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੵਾਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau dekhat daridr jaavai naam so nidhaan paavai guramukh gyaan duramat mail dhovai jeeu ||
english: Seeing Him, poverty vanishes, and one is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The spiritual wisdom of the Guru's Word washes away the filth of evil-mindedness.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur naam ek liv man japai driR tin jan dukh paap kahu kat hovai jeeu ||1||
english: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith? ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: dharam karam poorai satigur paaee hai ||
english: Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਰੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sevaa sidh saadh mun jan sur nar jaachahi sabad saar ek liv laaee hai ||
english: The Siddhas and Holy Saadhus, the silent sages and angelic beings, yearn to serve Him; through the most excellent Word of the Shabad, they are lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: phun jaanai ko teraa apaar nirabhau nira(n)kaar akath kathanahaar tujhahi bujhaaee hai ||
english: Who can know Your limits? You are the Embodiment of the Fearless, Formless Lord. You are the Speaker of the Unspoken Speech; You alone understand this.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਛੁਟਹੁ ਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਨ ਡੰਡ ਕਾਲ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੵਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhoole sa(n)saar chhutahu joonee sa(n)ghaar jam ko na da(n)d kaal guramat dhyaaee hai ||
english: O foolish worldly mortal, you are deluded by doubt; give up birth and death, and you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death. Meditate on the Guru's Teachings.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਗਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man praanee mugadh beechaar ahinis jap dharam karam poorai satigur paaee hai ||2||
english: You foolish mortal being, reflect on this in your mind; chant and meditate day and night. Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥
transliteration: hau bal bal jaau satigur saache naam par ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰੇਉ ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਰਿ ਕਰ ॥
transliteration: kavan upamaa deu kavan sevaa sareu ek mukh rasanaa rasahu jug jor kar ||
english: What Praises can I offer to You? What service can I do for You? I have only one mouth and tongue; with my palms pressed together, I chant to You with joy and delight.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਦੂਜਾ ਨ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਧਰ ॥
transliteration: phun man bach kram jaan anat doojaa na maan naam so apaar saar deeno gur rid dhar ||
english: In thought, word and deed, I know the Lord; I do not worship any other. The Guru has enshrined the most excellent Name of the Infinite Lord within my heart.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਨਲੵ ਕਵਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਕਚ ਕੰਚਨਾ ਹੁਇ ਚੰਦਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨ ਤਰ ॥
transliteration: naly kav paaras paras kach ka(n)chanaa hui cha(n)danaa subaas jaas simarat an tar ||
english: So speaks NALL the poet: touching the Philosopher's Stone, glass is transformed into gold, and the sandalwood tree imparts its fragrance to other trees; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am transformed.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹੀ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa ke dekhat duaare kaam krodh hee nivaare jee hau bal bal jaau satigur saache naam par ||3||
english: Seeing His Door, I am rid of sexual desire and anger. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru. ||3||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: raaj jog takhat deean gur raamadaas ||
english: Guru Raam Daas was blessed with the Throne of Raja Yoga.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚੰਦੁ ਜਗਤ ਭਯੋ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਤਾਰਨਿ ਮਨੁਖੵ ਜਨ ਕੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prathame naanak cha(n)d jagat bhayo aana(n)d taaran manukhy jan keeau pragaas ||
english: First, Guru Nanak illuminated the world, like the full moon, and filled it with bliss. To carry humanity across, He bestowed His Radiance.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀਅਉ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਮਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: gur a(n)gad deeau nidhaan akath kathaa giaan pa(n)ch bhoot bas keene jamat na traas ||
english: He blessed Guru Angad with the treasure of spiritual wisdom, and the Unspoken Speech; He overcame the five demons and the fear of the Messenger of Death.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਤਿ ਅਘਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਤੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਜਾਸ ॥
transliteration: gur amar guroo sree sat kalijug raakhee pat aghan dekhat gat charan kaval jaas ||
english: The Great and True Guru, Guru Amar Daas, has preserved honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Seeing His Lotus Feet, sin and evil are destroyed.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਨੵਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਭਯਉ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh bidh maanyiu man tab hee bhayau prasa(n)n raaj jog takhat deean gur raamadaas ||4||
english: When His mind was totally satisfied in every way, when He was totally pleased, He bestowed upon Guru Raam Daas the Throne of Raja Yoga. ||4||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਰਡ ॥
transliteration: rad ||
english: Radd:

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਧਾਰੵਿਉ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਵਿਉਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਤੇ ਨੀਰ ਸਰ ਅਵਰ ਅਨਲ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: jisahi dhaaryiu dharat ar vium ar pavan te neer sar avar anal anaad keeau ||
english: He established the earth, the sky and the air, the water of the oceans, fire and food.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸਸਿ ਰਿਖਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਦਿਨਿ ਸੈਲ ਤਰੂਅ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: sas rikh nis soor din sail taroo phal phul deeau ||
english: He created the moon, the starts and the sun, night and day and mountains; he blessed the trees with flowers and fruits.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸਪਤ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਕਿਅ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sur nar sapat samudr ki dhaario tribhavan jaas ||
english: He created the gods, human beings and the seven seas; He established the three worlds.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: soee ek naam har naam sat paaio gur amar pragaas ||1||5||
english: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the Light of the One Name, the True Name of the Lord. ||1||5||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਕਚਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਅਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਹਿ ਸੁਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kachahu ka(n)chan bhaiau sabad gur sravanahi sunio ||
english: Glass is transformed into gold, listening to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੁਯਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: bikh te a(n)mrit huyau naam satigur mukh bhaniau ||
english: Poison is transformed into ambrosial nectar, speaking the Name of the True Guru.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਉ ਹੋਯਉ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਦਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: lohau hoyau laal nadar satigur jad dhaarai ||
english: Iron is transformed into jewels, when the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਣ ਮਾਣਕ ਕਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਹਿਅਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: paahan maanak karai giaan gur kahiau beechaarai ||
english: Stones are transformed into emeralds, when the mortal chants and contemplates the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਕਾਠਹੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਖੰਡ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਅਉ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਗਇਅ ॥
transliteration: kaathahu sreekha(n)d satigur keeau dukh daridr tin ke gai ||
english: The True Guru transforms ordinary wood into sandalwood, eradicating the pains of poverty.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਚਰਨ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਪਰੇਤ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਭਇਅ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: satiguroo charan jinh parasiaa se pas paret sur nar bhai ||2||6||
english: Whoever touches the Feet of the True Guru, is transformed from a beast and a ghost into an angelic being. ||2||6||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਧਨਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਾਰਵੁ ਦਿਜਇ ॥
transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val dhanahi kiaa gaarav dijai ||
english: One who has the Guru on his side - how could he be proud of his wealth?

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਜਇ ॥
transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val lakh baahe kiaa kijai ||
english: One who has the Guru on his side - what would hundreds of thousands of supporters do for him?

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਨ ਪਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val giaan ar dhiaan anan par ||
english: One who has the Guru on his side, does not depend on anyone else for spiritual wisdom and meditation.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਸੁ ਸਚਹ ਘਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val sabad saakhee s sachah ghar ||
english: One who has the Guru on his side contemplates the Shabad and the Teachings, and abides in the Home of Truth.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਟੁ ਬੇਨਤਿ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jo guroo guroo ahinis japai daas bhat benat kahai ||
english: The Lord's humble slave and poet utters this prayer: whoever chants to the Guru night and day,

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹ ਥੇ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: jo guroo naam rid mahi dharai so janam maran duh the rahai ||3||7||
english: whoever enshrines the Name of the Guru within his heart, is rid of both birth and death. ||3||7||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar guroo bin samajh na aavai ||
english: Without the Guru, there is utter darkness; without the Guru, understanding does not come.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur bin surat na sidh guroo bin mukat na paavai ||
english: Without the Guru, there is no intuitive awareness or success; without the Guru, there is no liberation.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kar sach beechaar guroo kar re man mere ||
english: So make Him your Guru, and contemplate the Truth; make Him your Guru, O my mind.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸਪੁੰਨ ਅਘਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kar sabad sapu(n)n aghan katahi sabh tere ||
english: Make Him your Guru, who is embellished and exalted in the Word of the Shabad; all your sins shall be washed away.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਯਣਿ ਬਯਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿ ਕਵਿ ਨਲੵ ਕਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur nayan bayan gur gur karahu guroo sat kav naly kahi ||
english: So speaks NALL the poet: with your eyes, make Him your Guru; with the words you speak, make Him your Guru, your True Guru.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਅਉ ਨਹੁ ਕੀਅਉ ਤੇ ਅਕਯਥ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: jin guroo na dekhiau nahu keeau te akayath sa(n)saar mahi ||4||8||
english: Those who have not seen the Guru, who have not made Him their Guru, are useless in this world. ||4||8||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guroo guroo gur kar man mere ||
english: Dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru, O my mind.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਸਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਬਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taaran taran samrath kalijug sunat samaadh sabad jis kere ||
english: The All-powerful Guru is the Boat to carry us across in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Hearing the Word of His Shabad, we are transported into Samaadhi.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਦੁਖਨਿ ਨਾਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਯਕੁ ਸੂਰਉ ਜੋ ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਬਸਤ ਤਿਹ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: phun dukhan naas sukhadaayak soorau jo dharat dhiaan basat tih nere ||
english: He is the Spiritual Hero who destroys pain and brings peace. Whoever meditates on Him, dwells near Him.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਉ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਅਘ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਰੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: poorau purakh ridai har simarat mukh dekhat agh jaahi parere ||
english: He is the Perfect Primal Being, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord within his heart; seeing His Face, sins run away.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਾਹਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੫॥੯॥
transliteration: jau har budh ridh sidh chaahat guroo guroo gur kar man mere ||5||9||
english: If you long for wisdom, wealth, spiritual perfection and properity, O my mind, dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru. ||5||9||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: guroo mukh dekh garoo sukh paayau ||
english: Gazing upon the Face of the Guru, I find peace.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਹੁਤੀ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਿਊਸ ਪਿਵੰਨ ਕੀ ਬੰਛਤ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: hutee j piaas pioos piva(n)n kee ba(n)chhat sidh kau bidh milaayau ||
english: I was thirsty, yearning to drink in the Nectar; to fulfill that wish, the Guru laid out the way.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭੋ ਮਨ ਠਉਰ ਬਸੋ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੁ ਦਹੰ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: pooran bho man thaur baso ras baasan siu j daha(n) dis dhaayau ||
english: My mind has become perfect; it dwells in the Lord's Place; it had been wandering in all directions, in its desire for tastes and pleasures.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਵਾਲੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਮ ਜਲੵਨ ਤੀਰਿ ਬਿਪਾਸ ਬਨਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d vaal gobi(n)d puree sam jalyn teer bipaas banaayau ||
english: Goindwal is the City of God, built on the bank of the Beas River.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗਯਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਬਰਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥੬॥੧੦॥
transliteration: gayau dukh door barakhan ko s guroo mukh dekh garoo sukh paayau ||6||10||
english: The pains of so many years have been taken away; gazing upon the Face of the Guru, I find peace. ||6||10||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰੵਉ ॥
transliteration: samarath guroo sir hath dhary ||
english: The All-powerful Guru placed His hand upon my head.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਅਉ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰੰਨ ਅਘੰਨ ਹਰੵਉ ॥
transliteration: gur keenee kripaa har naam deeau jis dekh chara(n)n agha(n)n hary ||
english: The Guru was kind, and blessed me with the Lord's Name. Gazing upon His Feet, my sins were dispelled.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨੇ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਾਨ ਡਰੵਉ ॥
transliteration: nis baasur ek samaan dhiaan s naam sune sut bhaan dary ||
english: Night and day, the Guru meditates on the One Lord; hearing His Name, the Messenger of Death is scared away.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਭਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਸੁ ਆਸ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਪਰਸੁ ਕਰੵਉ ॥
transliteration: bhan daas s aas jagatr guroo kee paaras bhet paras kary ||
english: So speaks the Lord's slave: Guru Raam Daas placed His Faith in Guru Amar Daas, the Guru of the World; touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was transformed into the Philosopher's Stone.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਯਉ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰੵਉ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
transliteration: raamadaas guroo har sat keeyau samarath guroo sir hath dhary ||7||11||
english: Guru Raam Daas recognized the Lord as True; the All-powerful Guru placed His hand upon His head. ||7||11||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਭਾਟ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
transliteration: ab raakhahu daas bhaat kee laaj ||
english: Now, please preserve the honor of Your humble slave.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਕੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਫਾਰੇ ਕਰ ਆਜ ॥
transliteration: jaisee raakhee laaj bhagat prahilaad kee haranaakhas phaare kar aaj ||
english: God saved the honor of the devotee Prahlaad, when Harnaakhash tore him apart with his claws.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਛੀਨਤ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਨ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਜ ॥
transliteration: phun dropatee laaj rakhee har prabh jee chheenat basatr deen bahu saaj ||
english: And the Dear Lord God saved the honor of Dropadi; when her clothes were stripped from her, she was blessed with even more.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸੋਦਾਮਾ ਅਪਦਾ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਤ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: sodaamaa apadaa te raakhiaa ganikaa paRhat poore tih kaaj ||
english: Sudaamaa was saved from misfortune; and Ganikaa the prostitute - when she chanted Your Name, her affairs were perfectly resolved.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਭਾਟ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sree satigur suprasa(n)n kalajug hoi raakhahu daas bhaat kee laaj ||8||12||
english: O Great True Guru, if it pleases You, please save the honor of Your slave in this Dark Age of kali Yuga. ||8||12||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਝੋਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jholanaa ||
english: Jholnaa:

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
transliteration: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap praaneeahu ||
english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O mortal beings.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਅਪੈ ਰਸਨਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਸੈ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad har har japai naam nav nidh apai rasan ahinis rasai sat kar jaaneeahu ||
english: Chant the Shabad, the Word of the Lord, Har, Har; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, brings the nine treasures. With your tongue, taste it, day and night, and know it as true.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰੰਗ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਹਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਨ ਮਾਰਗ ਤਜਹੁ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੵਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
transliteration: phun prem ra(n)g paaeeai guramukhahi dhiaaeeai a(n)n maarag tajahu bhajahu har gyaaneeahu ||
english: Then, you shall obtain His Love and Affection; become Gurmukh, and meditate on Him. Give up all other ways; vibrate and meditate on Him, O spiritual people.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਰਿਦਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bachan gur rid dharahu pa(n)ch bhoo bas karahu janam kul udharahu dvaar har maaneeahu ||
english: Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart, and overpower the five passions. Your life, and your generations, shall be saved, and you shall be honored at the Lord's Door.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਮ ਬੰਛਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥੧॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jau ta sabh sukh it ut tum ba(n)chhavahu guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap praaneeahu ||1||13||
english: If you desire all the peace and comforts of this world and the next, then chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O mortal beings. ||1||13||

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap sat kar ||
english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: agam gun jaan nidhaan har man dharahu dhyaan ahinis karahu bachan gur ridai dhar ||
english: Know that the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Enshrine Him in your mind, and meditate on Him. Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਲ ਬਿਮਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਸਚ ਰੰਗ ਸਰਿ ॥
transliteration: phun guroo jal bimal athaah majan karahu sa(n)t gurasikh tarahu naam sach ra(n)g sar ||
english: Then, cleanse yourself in the Immaculate and Unfathomable Water of the Guru; O Gursikhs and Saints, cross over the Ocean of Love of the True Name.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਰਸਿ ਕਰਤ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa niravair nira(n)kaar nirabhau japai prem gurasabad ras karat driR bhagat har ||
english: Meditate lovingly forever on the Lord, free of hate and vengeance, Formless and Fearless; lovingly savor the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and implant devotional worship of the Lord deep within.

author: Bhatt Nalh
gurmukhi: ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੪॥
transliteration: mugadh man bhram tajahu naam guramukh bhajahu guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap sat kar ||2||14||
english: O foolish mind, give up your doubts; as Gurmukh, vibrate and meditate on the Naam. Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true. ||2||14||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guroo gur gur karahu guroo har paaeeai ||
english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru; through the Guru, the Lord is obtained.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਉਦਧਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਗ ਹੀਰ ਮਣਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: udadh gur gahir ga(n)bheer bea(n)t har naam nag heer man milat liv laaeeai ||
english: The Guru is an Ocean, deep and profound, infinite and unfathomable. Lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name, you shall be blessed with jewels, diamonds and emeralds.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਮਲ ਸਰਸ ਕਰਤ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਪਰਸ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: phun guroo paramal saras karat ka(n)chan paras mail duramat hirat sabad gur dhyaaeeai ||
english: And, the Guru makes us fragrant and fruitful, and His Touch transforms us into gold. The filth of evil-mindedness is washed away, meditating on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਛੁਟਕੰਤ ਸਦ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੵਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਿਖ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit paravaah chhutaka(n)t sad dvaar jis gyaan gur bimal sar sa(n)t sikh naaeeai ||
english: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar flows constantly from His Door. The Saints and Sikhs bathe in the immaculate pool of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naam nirabaan nidhaan har ur dharahu guroo gur gur karahu guroo har paaeeai ||3||15||
english: Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart, and dwell in Nirvaanaa. Chant Guru, Guru, Guru; through the Guru, the Lord is obtained. ||3||15||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap ma(n)n re ||
english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਿਵ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸੁਰ ਅਸੁਰ ਗਣ ਤਰਹਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sev siv sidh saadhik sur asur gan tarahi tetees gur bachan sun ka(n)n re ||
english: Serving Him, Shiva and the Siddhas, the angels and demons and servants of the gods, and the thrity-three million gods cross over, listening to the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਿਤ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: phun tarahi te sa(n)t hit bhagat gur gur karahi tario prahalaad gur milat mun ja(n)n re ||
english: And, the Saints and loving devotees are carried across, chanting Guru, Guru. Prahlaad and the silent sages met the Guru, and were carried across.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਤਰਹਿ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਹਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਲਗਿ ਤਜਹੁ ਰਸ ਅੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tarahi naaradaad sanakaad har guramukhahi tarahi ik naam lag tajahu ras a(n)n re ||
english: Naarad and Sanak and those men of God who became Gurmukh were carried across; attached to the One Name, they abandoned other tastes and pleasures, and were carried across.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਬੇਨਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਨ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
transliteration: daas benat kahai naam guramukh lahai guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap ma(n)n re ||4||16||29||
english: This is the prayer of the Lord's humble slave: the Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, chanting Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind. ||4||16||29||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ॥
transliteration: siree guroo saahib sabh oopar ||
english: The Great, Supreme Guru showered His Mercy upon all;

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪਰਿ ॥
transliteration: karee kripaa satajug jin dhroo par ||
english: in the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, He blessed Dhroo.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਭਗਤ ਉਧਰੀਅੰ ॥
transliteration: sree prahalaad bhagat udhareea(n) ||
english: He saved the devotee Prahlaad,

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਮਲ ਮਾਥੇ ਪਰ ਧਰੀਅੰ ॥
transliteration: hast kamal maathe par dhareea(n) ||
english: placing the Lotus of His Hand upon his forehead.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਲਖੵਾ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: alakh roop jee lakhyaa na jaaee ||
english: The Unseen Form of the Lord cannot be seen.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal saranaaee ||
english: The Siddhas and seekers all seek His Sanctuary.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur ke bachan sat jee dhaarahu ||
english: True are the Words of the Guru's teachings. Enshrine them in your soul.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੇਹ ਨਿਸ੍ਤਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam deh nistaarahu ||
english: Emancipate your body, and redeem this human incarnation.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਹਾਜੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur jahaaj khevat guroo gur bin tariaa na koi ||
english: The Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Boatman. Without the Guru, no one can cross over.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad prabh paaeeai gur bin mukat na hoi ||
english: By Guru's Grace, God is obtained. Without the Guru, no one is liberated.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak nikat basai banavaaree ||
english: Guru Nanak dwells near the Creator Lord.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਲਹਣਾ ਥਾਪਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tin lahanaa thaap jot jag dhaaree ||
english: He established Lehnaa as Guru, and enshrined His Light in the world.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਲਹਣੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: lahanai pa(n)th dharam kaa keeaa ||
english: Lehnaa established the path of righteousness and Dharma,

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਭਲੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: amaradaas bhale kau deeaa ||
english: which He passed on to Guru Amar Daas, of the Bhalla dynasty.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਸੋਢੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਪੵਉ ॥
transliteration: tin sree raamadaas sodhee thir thapy ||
english: Then, He firmly established the Great Raam Daas of the Sodhi dynasty.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਅਪੵਉ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam akhai nidh apy ||
english: He was blessed with the inexhaustible treasure of the Lord's Name.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਅਪੵਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਲਹੀਅੰ ॥
transliteration: apy har naam akhai nidh chahu jug gur sevaa kar phal laheea(n) ||
english: He was blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Name; throughout the four ages, it is inexhaustible. Serving the Guru, He received His reward.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਹਿ ਜੋ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਅੰ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dahi jo charan saran sukh paavahi paramaana(n)d guramukh kaheea(n) ||
english: Those who bow at His Feet and seek His Sanctuary, are blessed with peace; those Gurmukhs are blessed with supreme bliss.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਖਿ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਦਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਪੋਖਣ ਭਰਣੰ ॥
transliteration: paratakh deh paarabraham suaamee aad roop pokhan bharana(n) ||
english: The Guru's Body is the Embodiment of the Supreme Lord God, our Lord and Master, the Form of the Primal Being, who nourishes and cherishes all.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||1||
english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||1||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਚਿਤਿ ਚਾਓ ॥
transliteration: jih a(n)mrit bachan baanee saadhoo jan japahi kar bichit chaao ||
english: The Holy people chant the Ambrosial Words of His Bani with delight in their minds.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d nit ma(n)gal gur darasan saphal sa(n)saar ||
english: The Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world; it brings lasting bliss and joy.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਫਲੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਰਸਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saphal ga(n)gaa gur darasan parasan param pavitr gate ||
english: The Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world, like the Ganges. Meeting Him, the supreme sacred status is obtained.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਹਿ ਜਮ ਲੋਕੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਗੵਾਨਿ ਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jeetahi jam lok patit je praanee har jan siv gur gyaan rate ||
english: Even sinful people conquer the realm of Death, if they become the Lord's humble servants, and are imbued with the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਰਘੁਬੰਸਿ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਦਸਰਥ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੰਛਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੰ ॥
transliteration: raghuba(n)s tilak su(n)dar dasarath ghar mun ba(n)chhahi jaa kee sarana(n) ||
english: He is certified, like the handsome Ram Chander in the house of Dasrath of the Raghwa dynasty. Even the silent sages seek His Sanctuary.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||2||
english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||2||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਯਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar agam saagar tulahaa har naam guroo mukh paayaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, from the Mouth of the Guru, is the Raft to cross over the unfathomable world-ocean.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਗਾ ਇਹ ਆਈ ਹੀਐ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jag janam maran bhagaa ih aaee heeai parateet ||
english: The cycle of birth and death in this world is ended for those who have this faith in their hearts.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੀਐ ਆਈ ਜਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪਦਵੀ ਉਚ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: parateet heeai aaee jin jan kai tinh kau padavee uch bhaee ||
english: Those humble beings who have this faith in their hearts, are awarded the highest status.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਰੁ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੀ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: taj maaiaa mohu lobh ar laalach kaam krodh kee brithaa gaee ||
