english: They forsake Maya, emotional attachment and greed; they are rid of the frustrations of possessiveness, sexual desire and anger.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਅਵਲੋਕੵਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਛੁਟਕੵਾ ਦਿਬੵ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣੰ ॥
transliteration: avalokyaa braham bharam sabh chhutakyaa diby drist kaaran karana(n) ||
english: They are blessed with the Inner Vision to see God, the Cause of causes, and all their doubts are dispelled.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||3||
english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||3||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਯਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: parataap sadaa gur kaa ghat ghat paragaas bhayaa jas jan kai ||
english: The Glorious Greatness of the Guru is manifest forever in each and every heart. His humble servants sing His Praises.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ik paRahi sunahi gaavahi parabhaatihi karahi isnaan ||
english: Some read and listen and sing of Him, taking their cleansing bath in the early hours of the morning before the dawn.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ਸੁਧ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਹਿਤ ਕਰੰ ॥
transliteration: isnaan karahi parabhaat sudh man gur poojaa bidh sahit kara(n) ||
english: After their cleansing bath in the hours before the dawn, they worship the Guru with their minds pure and clear.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਕਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰੰ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan tan hoi paras paaras kau jot saroopee dhyaan dhara(n) ||
english: Touching the Philosopher's Stone, their bodies are transformed into gold. They focus their meditation on the Embodiment of Divine Light.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੂਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਨੰ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan jaga(n)naath jal thal mahi rahiaa poor bahu bidh barana(n) ||
english: The Master of the Universe, the very Life of the World pervades the sea and the land, manifesting Himself in myriads of ways.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||4||
english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||4||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਸ੍ਚਲ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੇਈ ਜੀਵ ਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਬਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jinahu baat nischal dhroo jaanee teee jeev kaal te bachaa ||
english: Those who realize the Eternal, Unchanging Word of God, like Dhroo, are immune to death.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਤਰਿਓ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਹਰ ਬਿੰਬ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: tinh tario samudr rudr khin ik mahi jalahar bi(n)b jugat jag rachaa ||
english: They cross over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant; the Lord created the world like a bubble of water.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਡਲਨੀ ਸੁਰਝੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਚਾ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)dalanee surajhee satasa(n)gat paramaana(n)d guroo mukh machaa ||
english: The Kundalini rises in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; through the Word of the Guru, they enjoy the Lord of Supreme Bliss.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰੰਮ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: siree guroo saahib sabh oopar man bach kra(n)m seveeai sachaa ||5||
english: The Supreme Guru is the Lord and Master over all; so serve the True Guru, in thought, word and deed. ||5||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jeeu ||
english: Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਕਵਲ ਨੈਨ ਮਧੁਰ ਬੈਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੈਨ ਸੰਗ ਸੋਭ ਕਹਤ ਮਾ ਜਸੋਦ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਹੀ ਭਾਤੁ ਖਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kaval nain madhur bain kot sain sa(n)g sobh kahat maa jasod jisahi dahee bhaat khaahi jeeu ||
english: You are lotus-eyed, with sweet speech, exalted and embellished with millions of companions. Mother Yashoda invited You as Krishna to eat the sweet rice.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਗ ਭਈ ਕਿੰਕਨੀ ਸਬਦ ਝਨਤਕਾਰ ਖੇਲੁ ਪਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: dekh roop at anoop moh mahaa mag bhaee ki(n)kanee sabad jhanatakaar khel paahi jeeu ||
english: Gazing upon Your supremely beautiful form, and hearing the musical sounds of Your silver bells tinkling, she was intoxicated with delight.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਕਲਮ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਕੈ ਈਸੁ ਬੰਮੵੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰਤ ਹੀਐ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kaal kalam hukam haath kahahu kaun met sakai ees ba(n)my gyaan dhyaan dharat heeai chaahi jeeu ||
english: Death's pen and command are in Your hands. Tell me, who can erase it? Shiva and Brahma yearn to enshrine Your spiritual wisdom in their hearts.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: sat saach sree nivaas aad purakh sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jeeu ||1||6||
english: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||1||6||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਸੁਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਿਰੀਕਾਰ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਸਰਬਰ ਕਉ ਕਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam param dhaam sudh budh nireekaar besumaar sarabar kau kaahi jeeu ||
english: You are blessed with the Lord's Name, the supreme mansion, and clear understanding. You are the Formless, Infinite Lord; who can compare to You?

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸੁਥਰ ਚਿਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਿਤ ਭੇਖੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਨਖ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: suthar chit bhagat hit bhekh dhario haranaakhas hario nakh bidaar jeeu ||
english: For the sake of the pure-hearted devotee Prahlaad, You took the form of the man-lion, to tear apart and destroy Harnaakhash with your claws.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਦਾ ਪਦਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਕੀਓ ਛਦਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਖੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kh chakr gadaa padam aap aap keeo chhadam apara(n)par paarabraham lakhai kaun taahi jeeu ||
english: You are the Infinite Supreme Lord God; with your symbols of power, You deceived Baliraja; who can know You?

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: sat saach sree nivaas aad purakh sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jeeu ||2||7||
english: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||2||7||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਪੀਤ ਬਸਨ ਕੁੰਦ ਦਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਸਹਿਤ ਕੰਠ ਮਾਲ ਮੁਕਟੁ ਸੀਸਿ ਮੋਰ ਪੰਖ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: peet basan ku(n)d dasan priaa sahit ka(n)th maal mukat sees mor pa(n)kh chaahi jeeu ||
english: As Krishna, You wear yellow robes, with teeth like jasmine flowers; You dwell with Your lovers, with Your mala around Your neck, and You joyfully adorn Your head with the crow of peacock feathers.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਬੇਵਜੀਰ ਬਡੇ ਧੀਰ ਧਰਮ ਅੰਗ ਅਲਖ ਅਗਮ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਣੈ ਉਛਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bevajeer bade dheer dharam a(n)g alakh agam khel keeaa aapanai uchhaahi jeeu ||
english: You have no advisors, You are so very patient; You are the Upholder of the Dharma, unseen and unfathomable. You have staged the play of the Universe with joy and delight.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਸੁਤਹ ਸਿਧ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਸਾਹਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa kathee na jaai teen lok rahiaa samaai sutah sidh roop dhario saahan kai saahi jeeu ||
english: No one can speak Your Unspoken Speech. You are pervading the three worlds. You assume the form of spiritual perfection, O King of kings.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: sat saach sree nivaas aad purakh sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jeeu ||3||8||
english: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||3||8||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo satiguroo satigur gubi(n)d jeeu ||
english: The True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਿ ਛਲਨ ਸਬਲ ਮਲਨ ਭਗ੍ਤਿ ਫਲਨ ਕਾਨੑ ਕੁਅਰ ਨਿਹਕਲੰਕ ਬਜੀ ਡੰਕ ਚੜ੍ਹੂ ਦਲ ਰਵਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: balihi chhalan sabal malan bhagt phalan kaanh kuar nihakala(n)k bajee da(n)k chaRhoo dal ravi(n)d jeeu ||
english: Enticer of Baliraja, who smothers the mighty, and fulfills the devotees; the Prince Krishna, and Kalki; the thunder of His army and the beat of His drum echoes across the Universe.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਵਣ ਦੁਰਤ ਦਵਣ ਸਕਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੁਸਲ ਕਰਣ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਆਪਿ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਹਸ ਮੁਖ ਫਨਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ravan durat davan sakal bhavan kusal karan sarab bhoot aap hee devaadh dev sahas mukh phani(n)d jeeu ||
english: The Lord of contemplation, Destroyer of sin, who brings pleasure to the beings of all realms, He Himself is the God of gods, Divinity of the divine, the thousand-headed king cobra.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਜਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਛ ਕਛ ਹੁਅ ਬਰਾਹ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਕੂਲਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਿਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jaram karam machh kachh hu baraah jamunaa kai kool khel khelio jin gi(n)d jeeu ||
english: He took birth in the Incarnations of the Fish, Tortoise and Wild Boar, and played His part. He played games on the banks of the Jamunaa River.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰੁ ਤਜੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਗਯੰਦ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naam saar heee dhaar taj bikaar man gaya(n)d satiguroo satiguroo satigur gubi(n)d jeeu ||4||9||
english: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand the True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself. ||4||9||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: siree guroo siree guroo siree guroo sat jeeu ||
english: The Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਿਜ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਕਲੵਾਨੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa maan nij nidhaan sach jaan ma(n)tr ihai nis baasur hoi kalyaan lahahi param gat jeeu ||
english: Respect and obey the Guru's Word; this is your own personal treasure - know this mantra as true. Night and day, you shall be saved, and blessed with the supreme status.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਣ ਜਣ ਸਿਉ ਛਾਡੁ ਧੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਾ ਫੰਧੁ ਕਾਟੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu jan jan siu chhaad dhohu haumai kaa pha(n)dh kaat saadhasa(n)g rat jeeu ||
english: Renounce sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment; give up your games of deception. Snap the noose of egotism, and let yourself be at home in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਗੇਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਚਿਤ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ਜਗਤ ਏਹੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਕਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: deh gehu tri sanehu chit bilaas jagat ehu charan kamal sadaa seu driRataa kar mat jeeu ||
english: Free your consciousness of attachment to your body, your home, your spouse, and the pleasures of this world. Serve forever at His Lotus Feet, and firmly implant these teachings within.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰੁ ਤਜੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਗਯੰਦ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naam saar heee dhaar taj bikaar man gaya(n)d siree guroo siree guroo siree guroo sat jeeu ||5||10||
english: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand. the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord. ||5||10||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਦਕਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak kai bharapoor jug jug vaahaguroo teraa sabh sadakaa ||
english: Your servants are totally fulfilled, throughout the ages; O Waahay Guru, it is all You, forever.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਊ ਤੂ ਕਦ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar prabh sadaa salaamat kahi na sakai kooo too kad kaa ||
english: O Formless Lord God, You are eternally intact; no one can say how You came into being.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਸਿਰੇ ਤੈ ਅਗਨਤ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਯਾ ਮਨ ਮਦ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan sire tai aganat tin kau mohu bhayaa man mad kaa ||
english: You created countless Brahmas and Vishnus; their minds were intoxicated with emotional attachment.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ ਲਖ ਜੋਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਕਉ ਤਦ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: chavaraaseeh lakh jon upaaee rijak deeaa sabh hoo kau tad kaa ||
english: You created the 8.4 million species of beings, and provide for their sustanance.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਦਕਾ ॥੧॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sevak kai bharapoor jug jug vaahaguroo teraa sabh sadakaa ||1||11||
english: Your servants are totally fulfilled, throughout the ages; O Waahay Guru, it is all You, forever. ||1||11||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਾ ਬਡਾ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu kaa badaa tamaasaa ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Great! Great is the Play of God!

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aape hasai aap hee chitavai aape cha(n)d soor paragaasaa ||
english: He Himself laughs, and He Himself thinks; He Himself illumines the sun and the moon.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਲੁ ਥੰਮੑਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aape jal aape thal tha(n)mhn aape keeaa ghat ghat baasaa ||
english: He Himself is the water, He Himself is the earth and its support. He Himself abides in each and every heart.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aape nar aape phun naaree aape saar aap hee paasaa ||
english: He Himself is male, and He Himself is female; He Himself is the chessman, and He Himself is the board.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਾ ਬਡਾ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
transliteration: guramukh sa(n)gat sabhai bichaarahu vaahu vaahu kaa badaa tamaasaa ||2||12||
english: As Gurmukh, join the Sangat, and consider all this: Waaho! Waaho! Great! Great is the Play of God! ||2||12||

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਡ ਮੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
transliteration: keeaa khel bad mel tamaasaa vaahiguroo teree sabh rachanaa ||
english: You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all You, forever.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਗਗਨਿ ਪਯਾਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤੇ ਮੀਠੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬਚਨਾ ॥
transliteration: too jal thal gagan payaal poor rahyaa a(n)mrit te meethe jaa ke bachanaa ||
english: You are pervading and permeating the water, land, skies and nether regions; Your Words are sweeter than Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Bhatt Gayand
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਰੁਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਚਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maanahi brahamaadik rudraadik kaal kaa kaal nira(n)jan jachanaa ||
english: Brahmas and Shivas respect and obey You. O Death of death, Formless Lord, I beg of You.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਖਚਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad paaeeai paramaarath satasa(n)gat setee man khachanaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the greatest thing is obtained, and the mind is involved with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਡ ਮੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੩॥੧੩॥੪੨॥
transliteration: keeaa khel bad mel tamaasaa vaahaguroo teree sabh rachanaa ||3||13||42||
english: You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all Your making. ||3||13||42||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: agam ana(n)t anaad aad jis koi na jaanai ||
english: The Lord is Inaccessible, Infinite, Eternal and Primordial; no one knows His beginning.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਧਰਿ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: siv bira(n)ch dhar dhyaan nitahi jis bed bakhaanai ||
english: Shiva and Brahma meditate on Him; the Vedas describe Him again and again.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar niravair avar nahee doosar koee ||
english: The Lord is Formless, beyond hate and vengeance; there is no one else like Him.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਭੰਜਨ ਗੜ੍ਹਣ ਸਮਥੁ ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)jan gaRhan samath taran taaran prabh soee ||
english: He creates and destroys - He is All-powerful; God is the Boat to carry all across.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੈ ॥
transliteration: naanaa prakaar jin jag keeo jan mathuraa rasanaa rasai ||
english: He created the world in its various aspects; His humble servant Mat'huraa delights in His Praises.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਚਿਤਹ ਬਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sree sat naam karataa purakh gur raamadaas chitah basai ||1||
english: Sat Naam, the Great and Supreme True Name of God, the Personification of Creativity, dwells in the Consciousness of Guru Raam Daas. ||1||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਰੀਆ ਧ੍ਰੁਵ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: guroo samarath gahi kareeaa dhruv budh sumat samhaaran kau ||
english: I have grasped hold of the All-powerful Guru; He has made my mind steady and stable, and embellished me with clear consciousness.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧੁਜਾ ਫਹਰੰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਘ ਪੁੰਜ ਤਰੰਗ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: phun dhra(n)m dhujaa phahara(n)t sadaa agh pu(n)j tara(n)g nivaaran kau ||
english: And, His Banner of Righteousness waves proudly forever, to defend against the waves of sin.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਹੀ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਅਉਰ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: mathuraa jan jaan kahee jee saach s aur kachhoo na bichaaran kau ||
english: His humble servant Mat'hraa knows this as true, and speaks it from his soul; there is nothing else to consider.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਬਡੌ ਕਲਿ ਮੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naam bohith badau kal mai bhav saagar paar utaaran kau ||2||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the Great Ship, to carry us all across the terrifying world-ocean, safely to the other side. ||2||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਤ ਹੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰਤੇ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tat hee satasa(n)gat sa(n)g sura(n)g rate jas gaavat hai ||
english: The Saints dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; imbued with pure celestial love, they sing the Lord's Praises.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਆਪਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਰਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: dhram pa(n)th dhario dharaneedhar aap rahe liv dhaar na dhaavat hai ||
english: The Support of the Earth has established this Path of Dharma; He Himself remains lovingly attuned to the Lord, and does not wander in distraction.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਭਨਿ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਉਨੑ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਇਛਤ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: mathuraa bhan bhaag bhale unh ke man ichhat hee phal paavat hai ||
english: So speaks Mat'huraa: those blessed with good fortune receive the fruits of their minds' desires.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਕੇ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਤਿਨੑ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਚਰੰਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: rav ke sut ko tinh traas kahaa j chara(n)n guroo chit laavat hai ||3||
english: Those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet, they do not fear the judgement of Dharamraj. ||3||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਧਾ ਪਰਪੂਰਨ ਸਬਦ ਤਰੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਤ ਦਿਨ ਆਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam sudhaa parapooran sabad tara(n)g pragatit din aagar ||
english: The Immaculate, Sacred Pool of the Guru is overflowing with the waves of the Shabad, radiantly revealed in the early hours before the dawn.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤਿ ਬਡ ਸੁਭਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer athaah at bad subhar sadaa sabh bidh ratanaagar ||
english: He is Deep and Profound, Unfathomable and utterly Great, eternally overflowing with all sorts of jewels.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮਰਾਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੰਤੂਹਲ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t maraal karahi ka(n)toohal tin jam traas mitio dukh kaagar ||
english: The Saint-swans celebrate; their fear of death is erased, along with the accounts of their pain.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਦੁਰਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਬੇ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kalajug durat door karabe kau darasan guroo sagal sukh saagar ||4||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the sins are taken away; the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is the Ocean of all peace and comfort. ||4||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਨਿ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰੈ ਫਿਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਜੁਗ ਕਬਹੁ ਕ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau mun dhyaan dharai phirat sagal jug kabahu ka kooo paavai aatam pragaas kau ||
english: For His Sake, the silent sages meditated and focused their consciousness, wandering all the ages through; rarely, if ever, their souls were enlightened.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਿਤ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਿਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਗਹਿ ਨ ਤਜਾਤ ਕਬਿਲਾਸ ਕੰਉ ॥
transliteration: bed baanee sahit bira(n)ch jas gaavai jaa ko siv mun gahi na tajaat kabilaas ka(n)u ||
english: In the Hymns of the Vedas, Brahma sang His Praises; for His Sake, Shiva the silent sage held his place on the Kailaash Mountain.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੌ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਤਪ ਜਟਾ ਜੂਟ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਏ ਫਿਰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau jogee jatee sidh saadhik anek tap jataa joot bhekh keee phirat udaas kau ||
english: For His Sake, the Yogis, celibates, Siddhas and seekers, the countless sects of fanatics with matted hair wear religious robes, wandering as detached renunciates.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਡਾਈ ਦਈ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: s tin satigur sukh bhaai kripaa dhaaree jee naam kee badaaee daee gur raamadaas kau ||5||
english: That True Guru, by the Pleasure of His Will, showered His Mercy upon all beings, and blessed Guru Raam Daas with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||5||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਤੇਜ ਪੁੰਜ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan dhiaan a(n)taragat tej pu(n)j tihu log pragaase ||
english: He focuses His Meditation deep within; the Embodiment of Light, He illuminates the three worlds.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਭਟਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਜਤ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: dekhat daras bhatak bhram bhajat dukh parahar sukh sahaj bigaase ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, doubt runs away, pain is eradicated, and celestial peace spontaneously wells up.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਅਲਿ ਸਮੂਹ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਬਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak sikh sadaa at lubhit al samooh jiu kusam subaase ||
english: The selfless servants and Sikhs are always totally captivated by it, like bumble bees lured by the fragrance of the flower.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦੵਮਾਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਥਪੵਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਉ ਤਖਤੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bidymaan gur aap thapy thir saachau takhat guroo raamadaasai ||6||
english: The Guru Himself established the Eternal Throne of Truth, in Guru Raam Daas. ||6||

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੵਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਯਾ ਮਦ ਮੋਹਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਅਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: taary sa(n)saar maayaa mad mohit a(n)mrit naam deeau samarath ||
english: The Universe is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, but it has been saved; the All-powerful Guru has blessed it with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਿਵੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਇ ਸਥੁ ॥
transliteration: phun keerativa(n)t sadaa sukh sa(n)pat ridh ar sidh na chhodai sath ||
english: And, the Praiseworthy Guru is blessed with eternal peace, wealth and prosperity; the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhis never leave him.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਿ ਬਡੌ ਅਤਿਵੰਤੁ ਮਹਾਬਲਿ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਦਾਸਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਤਥੁ ॥
transliteration: daan badau ativa(n)t mahaabal sevak daas kahio ihu tath ||
english: His Gifts are vast and great; His awesome Power is supreme. Your humble servant and slave speaks this truth.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਤਾਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਸੀਸਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਥੁ ॥੭॥੪੯॥
transliteration: taahi kahaa paravaah kaahoo kee jaa kai basees dhario gur hath ||7||49||
english: One, upon whose head the Guru has placed His Hand - with whom should he be concerned? ||7||49||

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: teen bhavan bharapoor rahio soee ||
english: He is totally pervading and permeating the three realms;

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨ ਸਰਸੁ ਕੀਅਉ ਨ ਜਗਤ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: apan saras keeau na jagat koee ||
english: in all the world, He has not created another like Himself.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: aapun aap aap hee upaayau ||
english: He Himself created Himself.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਅਸੁਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: sur nar asur a(n)t nahee paayau ||
english: The angels, human beings and demons have not found His limits.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਪਾਯਉ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਰੇ ਅਸੁਰਹ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਖੋਜੰਤ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paayau nahee a(n)t sure asurah nar gan ga(n)dhrab khoja(n)t phire ||
english: The angels, demons and human beings have not found His limits; the heavenly heralds and celestial singers wander around, searching for Him.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਚਲੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee achal ajonee sa(n)bhau purakhotam apaar pare ||
english: The Eternal, Imperishable, Unmoving and Unchanging, Unborn, Self-Existent, Primal Being of the Soul, the Infinity of the Infinite,

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਮਨਿ ਧੵਾਇਯਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath sadaa soee sarab jee man dhyaaiyau ||
english: the Eternal All-powerful Cause of causes - all beings meditate on Him in their minds.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sree gur raamadaas jayo jay jag mahi tai har param pad paaiyau ||1||
english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe. You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur naanak bhagat karee ik man tan man dhan gobi(n)d deeau ||
english: Nanak, the True Guru, worships God single-mindedly; He surrenders His body, mind and wealth to the Lord of the Universe.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗਦਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਿਜ ਧਾਰੀ ਅਗਮ ਗੵਾਨਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੵਉ ਹੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)gad ana(n)t moorat nij dhaaree agam gyaan ras rasy heeau ||
english: The Infinite Lord enshrined His Own Image in Guru Angad. In His heart, He delights in the spiritual wisdom of the Unfathomable Lord.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕੀਅਉ ਵਸਿ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਧੵਾਇਯਉ ॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas karataar keeau vas vaahu vaahu kar dhyaaiyau ||
english: Guru Amar Daas brought the Creator Lord under His control. Waaho! Waaho! Meditate on Him!

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sree gur raamadaas jayo jay jag mahi tai har param pad paaiyau ||2||
english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe. You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||2||

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਪੁਬ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜੁ ਗਣੰ ॥
transliteration: naarad dhroo prahalaad sudaamaa pub bhagat har ke j gana(n) ||
english: Naarad, Dhroo, Prahlaad and Sudaamaa are accounted among the Lord's devotees of the past.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਜਯਦੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਭਣੰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bareek jayadev trilochan naamaa avar kabeer bhana(n) ||
english: Ambreek, Jai Dayv, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer are also remembered.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਭਯਉ ਕਲਿ ਭਿੰਤਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਿ ਛਾਇਯਉ ॥
transliteration: tin kau avataar bhayau kal bhi(n)tar jas jagatr par chhaaiyau ||
english: They were incarnated in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; their praises have spread over all the world.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sree gur raamadaas jayo jay jag mahi tai har param pad paaiyau ||3||
english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe. You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਤੁਝੈ ਨਰ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਿਟਿਅਉ ਜੁ ਤਿਣੰ ॥
transliteration: manasaa kar simara(n)t tujhai nar kaam krodh mitiau j tina(n) ||
english: Those who meditate in remembrance on You within their minds - their sexual desire and anger are taken away.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਬਾਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਤੁਝੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਮਿਟਯਉ ਜੁ ਖਿਣੰ ॥
transliteration: baachaa kar simara(n)t tujhai tinh dukh daridr mitayau j khina(n) ||
english: Those who remember You in meditation with their words, are rid of their poverty and pain in an instant.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਅ ਦਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਾਰਸ ਸਰ ਬਲੵ ਭਟ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਯਉ ॥
transliteration: karam kar tu daras paras paaras sar baly bhat jas gaaiyau ||
english: Those who obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, by the karma of their good deeds, touch the Philosopher's Stone, and like BALL the poet, sing Your Praises.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sree gur raamadaas jayo jay jag mahi tai har param pad paaiyau ||4||
english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe. You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||4||

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਯਨ ਕੇ ਤਿਮਰ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jih satigur simara(n)t nayan ke timar mitahi khin ||
english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru - the darkness of their eyes is removed in an instant.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਮਰੰਥਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਨੋ ਦਿਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jih satigur simara(n)th ridai har naam dino din ||
english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their hearts, are blessed with the Lord's Name, day by day.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਮਰੰਥਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jih satigur simara(n)th jee kee tapat mitaavai ||
english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their souls - the fire of desire is extinguished for them.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਮਰੰਥਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jih satigur simara(n)th ridh sidh nav nidh paavai ||
english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru, are blessed with wealth and prosperity, supernatural spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਲੵ ਭਣਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: soee raamadaas gur baly bhan mil sa(n)gat dha(n)n dha(n)n karahu ||
english: So speaks BALL the poet: Blessed is Guru Raam Daas; joining the Sangat, the Congregation, call Him blessed and great.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਨਰਹੁ ॥੫॥੫੪॥
transliteration: jih satigur lag prabh paaeeai so satigur simarahu narahu ||5||54||
english: Meditate on the True Guru, O men, through Whom the Lord is obtained. ||5||54||

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jin sabad kamaai param pad paaio sevaa karat na chhodio paas ||
english: Living the Word of the Shabad, He attained the supreme status; while performing selfless service, He did not leave the side of Guru Amar Daas.

author: Bhatt Balh
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਗੵਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਉਜੀਆਰਉ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਅੰਧੵਾਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: taa te gauhar gyaan pragat ujeeaarau dukh daridr a(n)dhyaar ko naas ||
english: From that service, the light from the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, radiant and bright; it has destroyed pain, poverty and darkness.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਕਵਿ ਕੀਰਤ ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਮੁੜਿ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kav keerat jo sa(n)t charan muR laagahi tinh kaam krodh jam ko nahee traas ||
english: So speaks Keerat the poet: those who grasp hold of the feet of the Saints, are not afraid of death, sexual desire or anger.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiv a(n)gad a(n)g sa(n)g naanak gur tiv gur amaradaas kai gur raamadaas ||1||
english: Just as Guru Nanak was part and parcel, life and limb with Guru Angad, so is Guru Amar Daas one with Guru Raam Daas. ||1||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਯਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jin satigur sev padaarath paayau nis baasur har charan nivaas ||
english: Whoever serves the True Guru obtains the treasure; night and day, he dwells at the Lord's Feet.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਉ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਲੀਆਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: taa te sa(n)gat saghan bhaai bhau maanahi tum maleeaagar pragat subaas ||
english: And so, the entire Sangat loves, fears and respects You. You are the sandalwood tree; Your fragrance spreads gloriously far and wide.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਿਲੋਚਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਉਪਜੵੋ ਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: dhroo prahalaad kabeer tilochan naam lait upajyo j pragaas ||
english: Dhroo, Prahlaad, Kabeer and Trilochan chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and His Illumination radiantly shines forth.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪਿਖਤ ਅਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jih pikhat at hoi rahas man soee sa(n)t sahaar guroo raamadaas ||2||
english: Seeing Him, the mind is totally delighted; Guru Raam Daas is the Helper and Support of the Saints. ||2||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾਨੵਉ ਕੀਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam nira(n)jan jaany keenee bhagat prem liv laaee ||
english: Guru Nanak realized the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. He was lovingly attuned to loving devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਯੋ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa te a(n)gad a(n)g sa(n)g bhayo saair tin sabad surat kee neev rakhaaee ||
english: Gur Angad was with Him, life and limb, like the ocean; He showered His consciousness with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas kee akath kathaa hai ik jeeh kachh kahee na jaaee ||
english: The Unspoken Speech of Guru Amar Daas cannot be expressed with only one tongue.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸੋਢੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਸਕਲ ਤਾਰਣ ਕਉ ਅਬ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sodhee srist sakal taaran kau ab gur raamadaas kau milee badaaee ||3||
english: Guru Raam Daas of the Sodhi dynasty has now been blessed with Glorious Greatness, to carry the whole world across. ||3||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭਰੇ ਏਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ham avagun bhare ek gun naahee a(n)mrit chhaad bikhai bikh khaaee ||
english: I am overflowing with sins and demerits; I have no merits or virtues at all. I abandoned the Ambrosial Nectar, and I drank poison instead.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਮਾਯਾ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਪੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maayaa moh bharam pai bhoole sut daaraa siu preet lagaaee ||
english: I am attached to Maya, and deluded by doubt; I have fallen in love with my children and spouse.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਉਤਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਲੰਤ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ik utam pa(n)th sunio gur sa(n)gat tih mila(n)t jam traas mitaaee ||
english: I have heard that the most exalted Path of all is the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation. Joining it, the fear of death is taken away.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਭਾਟ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੫੮॥
transliteration: ik aradaas bhaat keerat kee gur raamadaas raakhahu saranaaee ||4||58||
english: Keerat the poet offers this one prayer: O Guru Raam Daas, save me! Take me into Your Sanctuary! ||4||58||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਬਿਵਸਿ ਕੀਅਉ ਕਾਮੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੇਸ ਪਛਾੜੵਉ ॥
transliteration: mohu mal bivas keeau kaam gahi kes pachhaaRy ||
english: He has crushed and overpowered emotional attachment. He seized sexual desire by the hair, and threw it down.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਰਚੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਪਮਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਝਾੜੵਉ ॥
transliteration: krodh kha(n)d paracha(n)d lobh apamaan siu jhaaRy ||
english: With His Power, He cut anger into pieces, and sent greed away in disgrace.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮੰਨੈ ॥
transliteration: janam kaal kar joR hukam jo hoi s ma(n)nai ||
english: Life and death, with palms pressed together, respect and obey the Hukam of His Command.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੰਧਿਅਉ ਸਿਖ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੈ ॥
transliteration: bhav saagar ba(n)dhiau sikh taare suprasa(n)nai ||
english: He brought the terrifying world-ocean under His Control; by His Pleasure, He carried His Sikhs across.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਆਤਪਤੁ ਸਚੌ ਤਖਤੁ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੰਜੁਤੁ ਬਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sir aatapat sachau takhat jog bhog sa(n)jut bal ||
english: He is seated upon the Throne of Truth, with the canopy above His Head; He is embellished with the powers of Yoga and the enjoyment of pleasures.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਸਲੵ ਭਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਟਲੁ ਰਾਜਿ ਅਭਗੁ ਦਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas sach saly bhan too atal raaj abhag dal ||1||
english: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, Your sovereign power is eternal and unbreakable; Your army is invincible. ||1||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too satigur chahu jugee aap aape paramesar ||
english: You are the True Guru, throughout the four ages; You Yourself are the Transcendent Lord.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵੰਤ ਧੁਰਹ ਧੁਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sur nar saadhik sidh sikh seva(n)t dhurah dhur ||
english: The angelic beings, seekers, Siddhas and Sikhs have served You, since the very beginning of time.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਲੋਅਹ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad anaad kalaa dhaaree trihu loah ||
english: You are the Primal Lord God, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages; Your Power supports the three worlds.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਨਿਗਮ ਉਧਰਣ ਜਰਾ ਜੰਮਿਹਿ ਆਰੋਅਹ ॥
transliteration: agam nigam udharan jaraa ja(n)mihi aaroah ||
english: You are Inaccessible; You are the Saving Grace of the Vedas. You have conquered old age and death.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਪਿਅਉ ਪਰਗਾਮੀ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ॥
transliteration: gur amaradaas thir thapiau paragaamee taaran taran ||
english: Guru Amar Daas has permanently established You; You are the Emancipator, to carry all across to the other side.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਅਘ ਅੰਤਕ ਬਦੈ ਨ ਸਲੵ ਕਵਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣ ॥੨॥੬੦॥
transliteration: agh a(n)tak badai na saly kav gur raamadaas teree saran ||2||60||
english: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, You are the Destroyer of sins; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||60||

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਪੰਜਵੇ ਕੇ ੫ ॥
transliteration: savaeee mahale pa(n)jave ke 5 ||
english: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰੰ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: simara(n) soee purakh achal abinaasee ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord God, Eternal and Imperishable.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat duramat mal naasee ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, the filth of evil-mindedness is eradicated.

author: Bhatt Keerat
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਿਦਿ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: satigur charan kaval rid dhaara(n) ||
english: I enshrine the Lotus Feet of the True Guru within my heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: gur arajun gun sahaj bichaara(n) ||
english: With intuitive peace and poise, I contemplate the Glorious Virtues of Guru Arjun.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas ghar keeau pragaasaa ||
english: He was revealed in the House of Guru Raam Daas,

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooree aasaa ||
english: and all hopes and desires were fulfilled.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਜਨਮਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: tai janamat guramat braham pachhaanio ||
english: From birth, He realized God through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kaly joR kar sujas vakhaanio ||
english: With palms pressed together, KALL the poet speaks His praises.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋਗ ਕੌ ਜੈਤਵਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਕੁ ਉਪਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat jog kau jaitavaar har janak upaayau ||
english: The Lord brought Him into the world, to practice the Yoga of devotional worship.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਕਾਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਬਸਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad guroo parakaasio har rasan basaayau ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has been revealed, and the Lord dwells on His tongue.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਗਦ ਅਮਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak a(n)gad amar laag utam pad paayau ||
english: Attached to Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, He attained the supreme status.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਭਗਤ ਉਤਰਿ ਆਯਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur arajun ghar gur raamadaas bhagat utar aayau ||1||
english: In the House of Guru Raam Daas, the devotee of the Lord, Guru Arjun was born. ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਉਨਮਾਨਿਅਉ ਰਿਦਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਸਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: badabhaagee unamaaniau rid sabad basaayau ||
english: By great good fortune, the mind is uplifted and exalted, and the Word of the Shabad dwells in the heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਅਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: man maanak sa(n)tokhiau gur naam driRhaayau ||
english: The jewel of the mind is contented; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਰਸਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar paarabraham satigur darasaayau ||
english: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Supreme Lord God is revealed through the True Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਅਨਭਉ ਠਹਰਾਯਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur arajun ghar gur raamadaas anabhau thaharaayau ||2||
english: In the House of Guru Raam Daas, Guru Arjun has appeared as the Embodiment of the Fearless Lord. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਬਰਤਾਇਆ ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਆਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: janak raaj barataaiaa satajug aaleenaa ||
english: The benign rule of Raja Janak has been established, and the Golden Age of Sat Yuga has begun.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਅਪਤੀਜੁ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gurasabade man maaniaa apateej pateenaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is pleased and appeased; the unsatisfied mind is satisfied.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਵ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak sach neev saaj satigur sa(n)g leenaa ||
english: Guru Nanak laid the foundation of Truth; He is blended with the True Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਬੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur arajun ghar gur raamadaas apara(n)par beenaa ||3||
english: In the House of Guru Raam Daas, Guru Arjun has appeared as the Embodiment of the Infinite Lord. ||3||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲੁ ਗੂੜੑਉ ਕੀਅਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਮਾਚਰੵਿਓ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਾਣਉ ॥
transliteration: khel gooRh keeau har raai sa(n)tokh samaacharyio bimal budh satigur samaanau ||
english: The Sovereign Lord King has staged this wondrous play; contentment was gathered together, and pure understanding was infused in the True Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਵਿਅਉ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਕਲੵ ਕਵੀਅਣਿ ਬਖਾਣਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: aajonee sa(n)bhaviau sujas kaly kaveean bakhaaniau ||
english: KALL the poet utters the Praises of the Unborn, Self-existent Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਵਰੵਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਗਦਿ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak a(n)gad vary gur a(n)gad amar nidhaan ||
english: Guru Nanak blessed Guru Angad, and Guru Angad blessed Guru Amar Daas with the treasure.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਵਰੵਉ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas arajun vary paaras paras pramaan ||4||
english: Guru Raam Daas blessed Guru Arjun, who touched the Philosopher's Stone, and was certified. ||4||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ॥
transliteration: sad jeevan arajun amol aajonee sa(n)bhau ||
english: O Guru Arjun, You are Eternal, Invaluable, Unborn, Self-existent,

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਯ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨੰਭਉ ॥
transliteration: bhay bha(n)jan par dukh nivaar apaar ana(n)bhau ||
english: the Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, Infinite and Fearless.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਗਹਣੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਦਹਣੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਉ ॥
transliteration: agah gahan bhram bhraa(n)t dahan seetal sukh daatau ||
english: You have grasped the Ungraspable, and burnt away doubt and skepticism. You bestow cooling and soothing peace.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਆਸੰਭਉ ਉਦਵਿਅਉ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤਉ ॥
transliteration: aasa(n)bhau udaviau purakh pooran bidhaatau ||
english: The Self-existent, Perfect Primal Lord God Creator has taken birth.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਗਦ ਅਮਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: naanak aad a(n)gad amar satigur sabad samaaiau ||
english: First, Guru Nanak, then Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, have been absorbed into the Word of the Shabad.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo raamadaas gur jin paaras paras milaaiau ||5||
english: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, who transformed Guru Arjun unto Himself. ||5||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar jaas jag a(n)dar ma(n)dar bhaag jugat siv rahataa ||
english: His victory is proclaimed all over the world; His Home is blessed with good fortune; He remains united with the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਯਉ ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੇਦਨਿ ਭਰੁ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paayau bad bhaagee liv laagee medan bhar sahataa ||
english: By great good fortune, He has found the Perfect Guru; He remains lovingly attuned to Him, and endures the load of the earth.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਯ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਪੀਰ ਨਿਵਾਰਨੁ ਕਲੵ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਤੋਹਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bhay bha(n)jan par peer nivaaran kaly sahaar tohi jas bakataa ||
english: He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of the pains of others. Kall Sahaar the poet utters Your Praise, O Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਿ ਸੋਢੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਮ ਧੁਜਾ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kul sodhee gur raamadaas tan dharam dhujaa arajun har bhagataa ||6||
english: In the Sodhi family, is born Arjun, the son of Guru Raam Daas, the holder of the banner of Dharma and the devotee of God. ||6||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: dhra(n)m dheer guramat gabheer par dukh bisaaran ||
english: The Support of the Dharma, immersed in the deep and profound Teachings of the Guru, the Remover of the pains of others.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਮ ਉਦਾਰੁ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad saar har sam udaar aha(n)mev nivaaran ||
english: The Shabad is excellent and sublime, kind and generous like the Lord, the Destroyer of egotism.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਨ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: mahaa daan satigur giaan man chaau na hutai ||
english: The Great Giver, the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, His mind does not grow weary of its yearning for the Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਵੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sativa(n)t har naam ma(n)tr nav nidh na nikhutai ||
english: The Embodiment of Truth, the Mantra of the Lord's Name, the nine treasures are never exhausted.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਚੰਦੋਆ ਤਾਣਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas tan sarab mai sahaj cha(n)doaa taaniau ||
english: O Son of Guru Raam Daas, You are contained amidst all; the canopy of intuitive wisdom is spread above You.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣਿਅਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur arajun kalyucharai tai raaj jog ras jaaniau ||7||
english: So speaks KALL the poet: O Guru Arjun, You know the sublime essence of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||7||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਾਣਿਅਉ ਲਾਖ ਮਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai nirabhau maaniau laakh mahi alakh lakhaayau ||
english: In the Fear of God, You enjoy the Fearless Lord; among the thousands of beings, You see the Unseen Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗਤਿ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar gat gabheer satigur parachaayau ||
english: Through the True Guru, You have realized the state of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parachai paravaan raaj mahi jog kamaayau ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, You are certified and approved; You practice Yoga in the midst of wealth and power.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਅਭਰ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur dha(n)n abhar sar subhar bharaayau ||
english: Blessed, blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has filled to overflowing the pools which were empty.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਿਓ ਸਰਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਮਾਇਯਉ ॥
transliteration: gur gam pramaan ajar jario sar sa(n)tokh samaaiyau ||
english: Reaching up to the certified Guru, You endure the unendurable; You are immersed in the pool of contentment.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur arajun kalyucharai tai sahaj jog nij paaiyau ||8||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have intuitively attained the state of Yoga within Yourself. ||8||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਬਦਨਿ ਬਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਰੵਉ ॥
transliteration: amiu rasanaa badan bar daat alakh apaar gur soor sabad haumai nivaary ||
english: Nectar drips from Your tongue, and Your mouth gives Blessings, O Incomprehensible and Infinite Spiritual Hero. O Guru, the Word of Your Shabad eradicates egotism.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾ ਹਰੁਨਿ ਦਲਿਅਉ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਾਰੵਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)chaa harun daliau su(n)n sahaj nij ghar sahaary ||
english: You have overpowered the five enticers, and established with intuitive ease the Absolute Lord within Your own being.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗ ਉਧਰੵਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam laag jag udhary satigur ridai basaaiau ||
english: Attached to the Lord's Name, the world is saved; enshrine the True Guru within your heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਜਨਕਹ ਕਲਸੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
transliteration: gur arajun kalyucharai tai janakah kalas deepaaiau ||9||
english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have illliminated the highest pinnacle of wisdom. ||9||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠੇ ॥
transliteration: sorathe ||
english: Sorat'h

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਪਾਰਥਉ ਚਾਲੈ ਨਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur arajun purakh pramaan paarathau chaalai nahee ||
english: : Guru Arjun is the certified Primal Person; like Arjuna, He never leaves the field of battle.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਨੇਜਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nejaa naam neesaan satigur sabad savaariau ||1||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is His spear and insignia. He is embellished with the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੇਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal saair set naam haree kaa bohithaa ||
english: The Lord's Name is the Boat, the Bridge to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤੁਅ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰ ਹੇਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tu satigur sa(n) het naam laag jag udhary ||2||
english: You are in love with the True Guru; attached to the Naam, You have saved the world. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥
transliteration: jagat udhaaran naam satigur tuthai paaiau ||
english: The Naam is the Saving Grace of the world; by the Pleasure of the True Guru, it is obtained.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਨਾਹਿ ਅਵਰ ਸਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਬਾਰੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪੜੀ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: ab naahi avar sar kaam baara(n)tar pooree paRee ||3||12||
english: Now, I am not concerned with anything else; at Your Door, I am fulfilled. ||3||12||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: jot roop har aap guroo naanak kahaayau ||
english: The Embodiment of Light, the Lord Himself is called Guru Nanak.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਭਯਉ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: taa te a(n)gad bhayau tat siu tat milaayau ||
english: From Him, came Guru Angad; His essence was absorbed into the essence.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗਦਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)gad kirapaa dhaar amar satigur thir keeau ||
english: Guru Angad showed His Mercy, and established Amar Daas as the True Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਅਮਰਤੁ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: amaradaas amarat chhatr gur raamahi deeau ||
english: Guru Amar Daas blessed Guru Raam Daas with the umbrella of immortality.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਕਹਿ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਯਣ ॥
transliteration: gur raamadaas darasan paras kahi mathuraa a(n)mrit bayan ||
english: So speaks Mat'huraa: gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of Guru Raam Daas, His speech became as sweet as nectar.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪਿਖਹੁ ਨਯਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: moorat pa(n)ch pramaan purakh gur arajun pikhahu nayan ||1||
english: With your eyes, see the certified Primal Person, Guru Arjun, the Fifth Manifestation of the Guru. ||1||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਉਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sat roop sat naam sat sa(n)tokh dhario ur ||
english: He is the Embodiment of Truth; He has enshrined the True Name, Sat Naam, Truth and contentment within His heart.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਲਿਖੵਉ ਅਛਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh paratakh likhy achhar masatak dhur ||
english: From the very beginning, the Primal Being has written this destiny upon His forehead.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਮਗੈ ਤੇਜੁ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਛਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: pragat jot jagamagai tej bhoo ma(n)dal chhaayau ||
english: His Divine Light shines forth, dazzling and radiant; His Glorious Grandeur pervades the realms of the world.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਹਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: paaras paras paras paras gur guroo kahaayau ||
english: Meeting the Guru, touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was acclaimed as Guru.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਭਨਿ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਹਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bhan mathuraa moorat sadaa thir laai chit sanamukh rahahu ||
english: So speaks Mat'huraa: I constantly focus my consciousness on Him; as sunmukh, I look to Him.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਜਹਾਜੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਲਗਿ ਬਿਤਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kalajug jahaaj arajun guroo sagal srist lag bitarahu ||2||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, Guru Arjun is the Boat; attached to him, the entire universe is safely carried across. ||2||

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਜਾਚਹੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਪਰ ਜਾਨੀਅਤੁ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਰਯਨਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: tih jan jaachahu jagatr par jaaneeat baasur rayan baas jaa ko hit naam siu ||
english: I beg from that humble being who is known all over the world, who lives in, and loves the Name, night and day.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੵੌ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤੁ ਧਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: param ateet paramesur kai ra(n)g ra(n)gyau baasanaa te baahar pai dekheeat dhaam siu ||
english: He is supremely unattached, and imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; he is free of desire, but he lives as a family man.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਾਗੵੌ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੈ ਕਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: apar para(n)par purakh siu prem laagyau bin bhagava(n)t ras naahee aurai kaam siu ||
english: He is dedicated to the Love of the Infinite, Limitless Primal Lord God; he has no concerns for any other pleasure, except for the Lord God.

author: Bhatt Kalh Sahar
gurmukhi: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਯ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mathuraa ko prabh srab may arajun gur bhagat kai het paai rahio mil raam siu ||3||
english: Guru Arjun is the All-pervading Lord God of Mat'huraa. Devoted to His Worship, he remains attached to the Lord's Feet. ||3||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਵ ਜੋਗ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na paavat dev sabai mun i(n)dr mahaa siv jog karee ||
english: All the gods, silent sages, Indra, Shiva and Yogis have not found the Lord's limits

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਨ ਛਾਡੵਿਉ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ॥
transliteration: phun bed bira(n)ch bichaar rahio har jaap na chhaadyiu ek gharee ||
english: not even Brahma who contemplates the Vedas. I shall not give up meditating on the Lord, even for an instant.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਜਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mathuraa jan ko prabh deen dayaal hai sa(n)gat srist nihaal karee ||
english: The God of Mat'huraa is Merciful to the meek; He blesses and uplifts the Sangats throughout the Universe.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗ ਤਾਰਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: raamadaas guroo jag taaran kau gur jot arajun maahi dharee ||4||
english: Guru Raam Daas, to save the world, enshrined the Guru's Light into Guru Arjun. ||4||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਯਾਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਤਮ ਮੈ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਉਜਾਗਰੁ ਆਨਿ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: jag aur na yaahi mahaa tam mai avataar ujaagar aan keeau ||
english: In the great darkness of this world, the Lord revealed Himself, incarnated as Guru Arjun.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਦੂਰਿ ਗਏ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: tin ke dukh kotik door gae mathuraa jinh a(n)mrit naam peeau ||
english: Millions of pains are taken away, from those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, says Mat'huraa.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਪਧਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਤ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਿਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨ ਬੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: ih padhat te mat chookahi re man bhed bibhed na jaan beeau ||
english: O mortal being, do not leave this path; do not think that there is any difference between God and Guru.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਛਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਅਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: paratachh ridai gur arajun kai har pooran braham nivaas leeau ||5||
english: The Perfect Lord God has manifested Himself; He dwells in the heart of Guru Arjun. ||5||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਉ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਲਾਰ ਉਦੈ ਤਬ ਲਉ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: jab lau nahee bhaag lilaar udai tab lau bhramate phirate bahu dhaayau ||
english: As long as the destiny written upon my forehead was not activated, I wandered around lost, running in all directions.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਘੋਰ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਬੂਡਤ ਥੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਿਟਿ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: kal ghor samudr mai boodat the kabahoo mit hai nahee re pachhutaayau ||
english: I was drowning in the horrible world-ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and my remorse would never have ended.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਯਹੈ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਜਗ ਤਾਰਨ ਕਉ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: tat bichaar yahai mathuraa jag taaran kau avataar banaayau ||
english: O Mat'huraa, consider this essential truth: to save the world, the Lord incarnated Himself.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਜਪੵਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਦੇਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨਿ ਗਰਭ ਨ ਆਯਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: japy jinh arajun dev guroo phir sa(n)kat jon garabh na aayau ||6||
english: Whoever meditates on Guru Arjun Dayv, shall not have to pass through the painful womb of reincarnation ever again. ||6||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kal samudr bhae roop pragat har naam udhaaran ||
english: In the ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name has been revealed in the Form of Guru Arjun, to save the world.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਬਸਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਨਿਵਾਰਨੁ ॥
transliteration: basahi sa(n)t jis ridai dukh daaridr nivaaran ||
english: Pain and poverty are taken away from that person, within whose heart the Saint abides.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭੇਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: niramal bhekh apaar taas bin avar na koee ||
english: He is the Pure, Immaculate Form of the Infinite Lord; except for Him, there is no other at all.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਅਉ ਭਯਉ ਤਿਹ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man bach jin jaaniau bhayau tih samasar soee ||
english: Whoever knows Him in thought, word and deed, becomes just like Him.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dharan gagan nav kha(n)d mahi jot svaroopee rahio bhar ||
english: He is totally pervading the earth, the sky and the nine regions of the planet. He is the Embodiment of the Light of God.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਭਨਿ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪਰਤਖੵ ਹਰਿ ॥੭॥੧੯॥
transliteration: bhan mathuraa kachh bhed nahee gur arajun paratakhy har ||7||19||
english: So speaks Mat'huraa: there is no difference between God and Guru; Guru Arjun is the Personification of the Lord Himself. ||7||19||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਗੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ajai ga(n)g jal atal sikh sa(n)gat sabh naavai ||
english: The stream of the Lord's Name flows like the Ganges, invincible and unstoppable. The Sikhs of the Sangat all bathe in it.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਬਾਚੀਅਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nit puraan baacheeahi bed brahamaa mukh gaavai ||
english: It appears as if the holy texts like the Puraanaas are being recited there and Brahma himself sings the Vedas.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਚਵਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਢੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: ajai chavar sir dhulai naam a(n)mrit mukh leeau ||
english: The invincible chauri, the fly-brush, waves over His head; with His mouth, He drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: gur arajun sir chhatr aap paramesar deeau ||
english: The Transcendent Lord Himself has placed the royal canopy over the head of Guru Arjun.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਗਦ ਅਮਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਗਯਉ ॥
transliteration: mil naanak a(n)gad amar gur gur raamadaas har pahi gayau ||
english: Guru Nanak, Guru Angad, Guru Amar Daas and Guru Raam Daas met together before the Lord.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਬੰਸ ਜਗਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਚਰੵਉ ਸੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਯਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hariba(n)s jagat jas sa(n)chary s kavan kahai sree gur muyau ||1||
english: So speaks HARBANS: Their Praises echo and resound all over the world; who can possibly say that the Great Gurus are dead? ||1||

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਗਯਉ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਭਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: dev puree mahi gayau aap paramesvar bhaayau ||
english: When it was the Will of the Transcendent Lord Himself, Guru Raam Daas went to the City of God.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣੁ ਦੀਅਉ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਹ ਬੈਠਾਯਉ ॥
transliteration: har si(n)ghaasan deeau siree gur tah baithaayau ||
english: The Lord offered Him His Royal Throne, and seated the Guru upon it.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਰਹਸੁ ਕੀਅਉ ਸੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਤੋਹਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਯ ਜਯ ਜੰਪਹਿ ॥
transliteration: rahas keeau sur dev tohi jas jay jay ja(n)pahi ||
english: The angels and gods were delighted; they proclaimed and celebrated Your victory, O Guru.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਰ ਗਏ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਿਨੑ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੰਪਹਿ ॥
transliteration: asur gae te bhaag paap tinh bheetar ka(n)pahi ||
english: The demons ran away; their sins made them shake and tremble inside.

author: Bhatt Mathura
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਰਹੁ ਕੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥
transliteration: kaate s paap tinh narahu ke gur raamadaas jinh paaiyau ||
english: Those people who found Guru Raam Daas were rid of their sins.

author: Bhatt Mathura
transliteration: chhatr si(n)ghaasan pirathamee gur arajun kau de aaiau ||2||21||9||11||10||10||22||60||143||
english: He gave the Royal Canopy and Throne to Guru Arjun, and came home. ||2||21||9||11||10||10||22||60||143||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਵਾਰਾਂ ਤੇ ਵਧੀਕ ॥ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok vaaraa(n) te vadheek || mahalaa 1 ||
english: Saloks In Addition To The Vaars. First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤੰਗੀ ਪੈਓਹਰੀ ਗਹਿਰੀ ਗੰਭੀਰੀ ॥
transliteration: uta(n)gee paioharee gahiree ga(n)bheeree ||
english: O you with swollen breasts, let your consciousness become deep and profound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਸੁੜਿ ਸੁਹੀਆ ਕਿਵ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਵਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਥਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sasuR suheeaa kiv karee nivan na jaai thanee ||
english: O mother-in-law, how can I bow? Because of my stiff nipples, I cannot bow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਚੁ ਜਿ ਲਗਾ ਗਿੜਵੜੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਧਉਲਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gach j lagaa giRavaRee sakheee dhaulaharee ||
english: O sister, those mansions built as high as mountains

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭੀ ਢਹਦੇ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਮੁੰਧ ਨ ਗਰਬੁ ਥਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: se bhee dhahade dith mai mu(n)dh na garab thanee ||1||
english: - I have seen them come crumbling down. O bride, do not be so proud of your nipples. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਹਰਣਾਖੀਏ ਗੂੜਾ ਵੈਣੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sun mu(n)dhe haranaakheee gooRaa vain apaar ||
english: O bride with deer-like eyes, listen to the words of deep and infinite wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਿਞਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਤਾਂ ਕੀਚੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa vasat sinjaan kai taa(n) keechai vaapaar ||
english: First, examine the merchandise, and then, make the deal.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹੀ ਦਿਚੈ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਕੂੰ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dohee dichai durajanaa mitraa(n) koo(n) jaikaar ||
english: Proclaim that you will not associate with evil people; celebrate victory with your friends.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੋਹੀ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਲਹੁ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jit dohee sajan milan lahu mu(n)dhe veechaar ||
english: This proclamation, to meet with your friends, O bride - give it some thought.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਜਣਾ ਐਸਾ ਹਸਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tan man deejai sajanaa aisaa hasan saar ||
english: Surrender mind and body to the Lord your Friend; this is the most excellent pleasure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis sau nehu na keechaee j disai chalanahaar ||
english: Do not fall in love with one who is destined to leave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਇਵ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jinhee iv kar bujhiaa tinhaa vitahu kurabaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who understand this. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਰੂ ਪਾਣਿ ਤਾਹੂ ਪੁਛੁ ਤਿੜੰਨੑ ਕਲ ॥
transliteration: je too(n) taaroo paan taahoo puchh tiRa(n)nh kal ||
english: If you wish to swim across the water, then consult those who know how to swim.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਖਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਵੰਞਾ ਏਨੑੀ ਕਪਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taahoo khare sujaan va(n)njaa enhee kaparee ||3||
english: Those who have survived these treacherous waves are very wise. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੜ ਝਖੜ ਓਹਾੜ ਲਹਰੀ ਵਹਨਿ ਲਖੇਸਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jhaR jhakhaR ohaaR laharee vahan lakhesaree ||
english: The storm rages and the rain floods the land; thousands of waves rise and surge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਆਲਾਇ ਬੇੜੇ ਡੁਬਣਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur siu aalaai beRe duban naahi bhau ||4||
english: If you cry out for help from the True Guru, you have nothing to fear - your boat will not sink. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈਸੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak duneeaa kaisee hoee ||
english: O Nanak, what has happened to the world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਕੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saalak mit na rahio koee ||
english: There is no guide or friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਬੰਧੀ ਹੇਤੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee ba(n)dhee het chukaaiaa ||
english: There is no love, even among brothers and relatives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: duneeaa kaaran deen gavaaiaa ||5||
english: For the sake of the world, people have lost their faith. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਓਹਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: hai hai kar kai ohi karen ||
english: They cry and weep and wail.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲੑਾ ਪਿਟਨਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: galhaa pitan sir khohen ||
english: They slap their faces and pull their hair out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naau lain ar karan samaai ||
english: But if they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they shall be absorbed into it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak tin balihaarai jaai ||6||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to them. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਡੀਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਸੀਧੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਧਾਉ ॥
transliteration: re man deeg na doleeai seedhai maarag dhaau ||
english: O my mind, do not waver or walk on the crooked path; take the straight and true path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਾਘੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਆਗੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paachhai baagh daraavano aagai agan talaau ||
english: The terrible tiger is behind you, and the pool of fire is ahead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸੈ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਪਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਾ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਢੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sahasai jeearaa par rahio maa kau avar na dha(n)g ||
english: My soul is skeptical and doubtful, but I cannot see any other way to go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh chhuteeai har preetam siu sa(n)g ||7||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, dwell with your Beloved Lord, and you shall be saved. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਘੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baagh marai man maareeai jis satigur deekhiaa hoi ||
english: The tiger is killed, and the mind is killed, through the Teachings of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai har milai bahuR na maranaa hoi ||
english: One who understands himself, meets with the Lord, and never dies again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਚੜਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਨ ਬੂਡਈ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: keechaR haath na boodaee ekaa nadar nihaal ||
english: One who sees the One and Only Lord with his eyes - his hands shall not get muddy and dirty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare gur saravar sachee paal ||8||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Guru has surrounded the ocean with the embankment of Truth. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਲੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: agan marai jal loR lahu vin gur nidh jal naahi ||
english: If you wish to put out the fire, then look for water; without the Guru, the ocean of water is not found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: janam marai bharamaaeeai je lakh karam kamaahi ||
english: You shall continue to wander lost in reincarnation through birth and death, even if you do thousands of other deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jam jaagaat na lagaee je chalai satigur bhaai ||
english: But you shall not be taxed by the Messenger of Death, if you walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak niramal amar pad gur har melai melaai ||9||
english: O Nanak, the immaculate, immortal status is obtained, and the Guru will unite you in the Lord's Union. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ ਕਊਆ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kalar keree chhapaRee kaooaa mal mal naai ||
english: The crow rubs and washes itself in the mud puddle.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਅਵਗੁਣੀ ਚਿੰਜੁ ਭਰੀ ਗੰਧੀ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan mailaa avagunee chi(n)j bharee ga(n)dhee aai ||
english: Its mind and body are polluted with its own mistakes and demerits, and its beak is filled with dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੰਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਕਾਗ ਕੁਪੰਖੀ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saravar ha(n)s na jaaniaa kaag kupa(n)khee sa(n)g ||
english: The swan in the pool associated with the crow, not knowing that it was evil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saakat siu aisee preet hai boojhahu giaanee ra(n)g ||
english: Such is the love of the faithless cynic; understand this, O spiritually wise ones, through love and devotion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa jaikaar kar guramukh karam kamaau ||
english: So proclaim the victory of the Society of the Saints, and act as Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੑਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: niramal nhaavan naanakaa gur teerath dareeaau ||10||
english: Immaculate and pure is that cleansing bath, O Nanak, at the sacred shrine of the Guru's river. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janame kaa phal kiaa ganee jaa(n) har bhagat na bhaau ||
english: What should I account as the rewards of this human life, if one does not feel love and devotion to the Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੈਧਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paidhaa khaadhaa baad hai jaa(n) man doojaa bhaau ||
english: Wearing clothes and eating food is useless, if the mind is filled with the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vekhan sunanaa jhooth hai mukh jhoothaa aalaau ||
english: Seeing and hearing is false, if one speaks lies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too hor haumai aavau jaau ||11||
english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; everything else is coming and going in egotism. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈਨਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਣੇ ਫੈਲ ਫਕੜੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: hain virale naahee ghane phail phakaR sa(n)saar ||12||
english: The Saints are few and far between; everything else in the world is just a pompous show. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗੀ ਤੁਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਜੀਵਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak lagee tur marai jeevan naahee taan ||
english: O Nanak, one who is struck by the Lord dies instantaneously; the power to live is lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਟੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਲਗੀ ਸਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: chotai setee jo marai lagee saa paravaan ||
english: If someone dies by such a stroke, then he is accepted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਲਗੀ ਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no laae tis lagai lagee taa paravaan ||
english: He alone is struck, who is struck by the Lord; after such a stroke, he is approved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪੈਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: piram paikaam na nikalai laaiaa tin sujaan ||13||
english: The arrow of love, shot by the All-knowing Lord, cannot be pulled out. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧੋਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਿ ਕਚਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaa(n)daa dhovai kaun j kachaa saajiaa ||
english: Who can wash the unbaked clay pot?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੂ ਪੰਜਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਕੂੜਾ ਪਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaatoo pa(n)j ralaai kooRaa paajiaa ||
english: Joining the five elements together, the Lord made a false cover.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਆਣਗੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaa(n)daa aanag raas jaa(n) tis bhaavasee ||
english: When it pleases Him, He makes it right.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਗਾਇ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਵਸੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: param jot jaagaai vaajaa vaavasee ||14||
english: The supreme light shines forth, and the celestial song vibrates and resounds. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਘੂਪ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ॥
transliteration: manahu j a(n)dhe ghoop kahiaa birad na jaananee ||
english: Those who are totally blind in their minds, do not have the integrity to keep their word.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਊਂਧੈ ਕਵਲ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)dhai oo(n)dhai kaval disan khare karoop ||
english: With their blind minds, and their upside-down heart-lotus, they look totally ugly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੁਝਨਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: ik kahi jaanan kahiaa bujhan te nar sughaR saroop ||
english: Some know how to speak and understand what they are told. Those people are wise and good-looking.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਦੁ ਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਗੀਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa naad na bed na gee ras ras kas na jaana(n)t ||
english: Some do not know the Sound-current of the Naad, spiritual wisdom or the joy of song. They do not even understand good and bad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਸਰ ਅਖਰ ਕਾ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਲਹੰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa sidh na budh na akal sar akhar kaa bheu na laha(n)t ||
english: Some have no idea of perfection, wisdom or understanding; they know nothing about the mystery of the Word.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਅਸਲਿ ਖਰ ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੰਤ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak te nar asal khar j bin gun garab kara(n)t ||15||
english: O Nanak, those people are really donkeys; they have no virtue or merit, but still, they are very proud. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
