transliteration: so brahaman jo bi(n)dai braham ||
english: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam kamaavai karam ||
english: He chants and meditates, and practices austerity and good deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਰਖੈ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: seel sa(n)tokh kaa rakhai dharam ||
english: He keeps to the Dharma, with faith, humility and contentment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRai hovai mukat ||
english: Breaking his bonds, he is liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਪੂਜਣ ਜੁਗਤੁ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: soee brahaman poojan jugat ||16||
english: Such a Brahmin is worthy of being worshipped. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੋ ਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਾ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: khatree so j karamaa kaa soor ||
english: He alone is a Kh'shaatriyaa, who is a hero in good deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan kaa karai sareer ||
english: He uses his body to give in charity;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: khet pachhaanai beejai daan ||
english: he understands his farm, and plants the seeds of generosity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: so khatree daragah paravaan ||
english: Such a Kh'shaatriyaa is accepted in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਜੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh je kooR kamaavai ||
english: Whoever practices greed, possessiveness and falsehood,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: apanaa keetaa aape paavai ||17||
english: shall receive the fruits of his own labors. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tan na tapaai tanoor jiu baalan had na baal ||
english: Do not heat your body like a furnace, or burn your bones like firewood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਫੇੜਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sir pairee kiaa pheRiaa a(n)dar piree samhaal ||18||
english: What have your head and feet done wrong? See your Husband Lord within yourself. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨੀ ਘਟੀ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਟੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanee ghatee sahu vasai sah bin ghat na koi ||
english: God the Cosmic Husband dwells within all hearts; without Him, there is no heart at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak te sohaaganee jinhaa guramukh paragat hoi ||19||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are the happy, virtuous soul-brides; the Lord is revealed to them. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਖੇਲਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jau tau prem khelan kaa chaau ||
english: If you desire to play this game of love with Me,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਤਲੀ ਗਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਉ ॥
transliteration: sir dhar talee galee meree aau ||
english: then step onto My Path with your head in hand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੈਰੁ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: it maarag pair dhareejai ||
english: When you place your feet on this Path,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sir deejai kaan na keejai ||20||
english: give Me your head, and do not pay any attention to public opinion. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਰਾੜਾ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naal kiraaRaa dosatee kooRai kooRee paai ||
english: False is friendship with the false and greedy. False is its foundation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੂਲਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: maran na jaapai mooliaa aavai kitai thaai ||21||
english: O Moollah, no one knows where death shall strike. ||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਹੀਣੰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan heena(n) agiaan poojaa ||
english: Without spiritual wisdom, the people worship ignorance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਵਰਤਾਵਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dh varataavaa bhaau doojaa ||22||
english: They grope in the darkness, in the love of duality. ||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur bin giaan dharam bin dhiaan ||
english: Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom; without Dharma, there is no meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੂਲੋ ਨ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: sach bin saakhee moolo na baakee ||23||
english: Without Truth, there is no credit; without capital, there is no balance. ||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੂ ਘਲੈ ਉਠੀ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: maanoo ghalai uthee chalai ||
english: The mortals are sent into the world; then, they arise and depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਵੇਹੀ ਗਲੈ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: saad naahee ivehee galai ||24||
english: There is no joy in this. ||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਝੁਰੈ ਦਲ ਮੇਲਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਲੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam jhurai dal melavai a(n)tar bal adhikaar ||
english: Raam Chand, sad at heart, assembled his army and forces.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਸੈਨਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜੁਝੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)tar kee sainaa seveeai man tan jujh apaar ||
english: The army of monkeys was at his service; his mind and body became eager for war.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਾ ਲੈ ਗਇਆ ਦਹਸਿਰੋ ਲਛਮਣੁ ਮੂਓ ਸਰਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: seetaa lai gaiaa dahasiro lachhaman mooo saraap ||
english: Raawan captured his wife Sita, and Lachhman was cursed to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak karataa karanahaar kar vekhai thaap uthaap ||25||
english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord is the Doer of all; He watches over all, and destroys what He has created. ||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਰੈ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਸੀਤਾ ਲਛਮਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: man mahi jhoorai raamacha(n)d seetaa lachhaman jog ||
english: In his mind, Raam Chand mourned for Sita and Lachhman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਣਵੰਤਰੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: hanava(n)tar aaraadhiaa aaiaa kar sa(n)jog ||
english: Then, he remembered Hanuman the monkey-god, who came to him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਦੈਤੁ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhoolaa dait na samajhaee tin prabh keee kaam ||
english: The misguided demon did not understand that God is the Doer of deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸੋ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak veparavaahu so kirat na mitaee raam ||26||
english: O Nanak, the actions of the Self-existent Lord cannot be erased. ||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹੌਰ ਸਹਰੁ ਜਹਰੁ ਕਹਰੁ ਸਵਾ ਪਹਰੁ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: laahaur sahar jahar kahar savaa pahar ||27||
english: The city of Lahore suffered terrible destruction for four hours. ||27||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹੌਰ ਸਹਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਦਾ ਘਰੁ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: laahaur sahar a(n)mrit sar siphatee daa ghar ||28||
english: The city of Lahore is a pool of ambrosial nectar, the home of praise. ||28||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਦੋਸਾਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: udosaahai kiaa neesaanee tot na aavai a(n)nee ||
english: What are the signs of a prosperous person? His stores of food never run out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਦੋਸੀਅ ਘਰੇ ਹੀ ਵੁਠੀ ਕੁੜਿਈਁ ਰੰਨੀ ਧੰਮੀ ॥
transliteration: udosee ghare hee vuthee kuRiee(n) ra(n)nee dha(n)mee ||
english: Prosperity dwells in his home, with the sounds of girls and women.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੀ ਰੰਨੀ ਘਰੇ ਸਿਆਪਾ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੰਮੀ ॥
transliteration: satee ra(n)nee ghare siaapaa rovan kooRee ka(n)mee ||
english: All the women of his home shout and cry over useless things.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਟੇ ਦੰਮ ਸਹੰਮੀ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: jo levai so devai naahee khate da(n)m saha(n)mee ||29||
english: Whatever he takes, he does not give back. Seeking to earn more and more, he is troubled and uneasy. ||29||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਬਰ ਤੂੰ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: pabar too(n) hareeaavalaa kavalaa ka(n)chan va(n)n ||
english: O lotus, your leaves were green, and your blossoms were gold.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਦੋਖੜੈ ਸੜਿਓਹਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੋਈਆ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kai dokhaRai saRiohi kaalee hoeeaa dehuree naanak mai tan bha(n)g ||
english: What pain has burnt you, and made your body black? O Nanak, my body is battered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਲਹਾਂ ਜੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jaanaa paanee naa lahaa(n) jai setee meraa sa(n)g ||
english: I have not received that water which I love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਨੁ ਪਰਫੁੜੈ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: jit dithai tan paraphuRai chaRai chavagan va(n)n ||30||
english: Seeing it, my body blossomed forth, and I was blessed with a deep and beautiful color. ||30||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਜਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raj na koee jeeviaa pahuch na chaliaa koi ||
english: No one lives long enough to accomplish all he wishes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: giaanee jeevai sadaa sadaa suratee hee pat hoi ||
english: Only the spiritually wise live forever; they are honored for their intuitive awareness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਫੈ ਸਰਫੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਏਵੈ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saraphai saraphai sadaa sadaa evai gaee vihaai ||
english: Bit by bit, life passes away, even though the mortal tries to hold it back.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak kis no aakheeai vin puchhiaa hee lai jaai ||31||
english: O Nanak, unto whom should we complain? Death takes one's life away without anyone's consent. ||31||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਅਹੁ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਾਂ ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dos na deahu raai no mat chalai jaa(n) budhaa hovai ||
english: Do not blame the Sovereign Lord; when someone grows old, his intellect leaves him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਤਾਂ ਅੰਨੑੇ ਪਵਣਾ ਖਾਤੀ ਟੋਵੈ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: galaa(n) kare ghanereeaa taa(n) a(n)nhe pavanaa khaatee tovai ||32||
english: The blind man talks and babbles, and then falls into the ditch. ||32||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਵਧਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: poore kaa keeaa sabh kichh pooraa ghat vadh kichh naahee ||
english: All that the Perfect Lord does is perfect; there is not too little, or too much.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਂਹਿ ਸਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh aisaa jaanai poore maa(n)hi samaa(n)hee ||33||
english: O Nanak, knowing this as Gurmukh, the mortal merges into the Perfect Lord God. ||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: abhiaagat eh na aakheeahi jin kai man mahi bharam ||
english: Do not call the wandering beggars holy men, if their minds are filled with doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin ke dite naanakaa teho jehaa dharam ||1||
english: Whoever gives to them, O Nanak, earns the same sort of merit. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੀਖਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: abhai nira(n)jan param pad taa kaa bheekhak hoi ||
english: One who begs for the supreme status of the Fearless and Immaculate Lord

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koi ||2||
english: - how rare are those who have the opportunity, O Nanak, to give food to such a person. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hovaa pa(n)dit jotakee ved paRaa mukh chaar ||
english: If I were a religious scholar, an astrologer, or one who could recite the four Vedas,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਆ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਜ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: navaa kha(n)daa vich jaaneeaa apane chaj veechaar ||3||
english: I could be famous throughout the nine regions of the earth, for my wisdom and thoughtful contemplation. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਕੈਲੀ ਘਾਤੁ ਕੰਞਕਾ ਅਣਚਾਰੀ ਕਾ ਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: brahaman kailee ghaat ka(n)njakaa anachaaree kaa dhaan ||
english: The four Hindu cardinal sins of murdering a Brahmin, a cow, a female infant, and acceptance of the offerings of an evil person,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਟਕ ਫਿਟਕਾ ਕੋੜੁ ਬਦੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: phitak phitakaa koR badeeaa sadaa sadaa abhimaan ||
english: cursed by the world and diseased by leprosy; he is forever and ever filled with egotistical pride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਿ ਏਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਵੀਸਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: paahi ete jaahi veesar naanakaa ik naam ||
english: One who forgets the Naam, O Nanak, is covered by these sins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਬੁਧੀ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਰਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh budhee jaaleeahi ik rahai tat giaan ||4||
english: Let all wisdom be burnt away, except for the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maathai jo dhur likhiaa s met na sakai koi ||
english: No one can erase that primal destiny written upon one's forehead.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jo likhiaa so varatadaa so boojhai jis no nadar hoi ||5||
english: O Nanak, whatever is written there, comes to pass. He alone understands, who is blessed by God's Grace. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa kooRai laalach lag ||
english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and become attached to greed and fraud,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa maaiaa mohanee a(n)tar tisanaa ag ||
english: are engrossed in the entanglements of Maya the enticer, with the fire of desire within them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵੇਲਿ ਨ ਤੂੰਬੜੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਠਗੇ ਠਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa vel na too(n)baRee maaiaa thage thag ||
english: Those who, like the pumpkin vine, are too stubborn climb the trellis, are cheated by Maya the cheater.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਚਲਾਈਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਮਿਲਹੀ ਵਗਿ ਸਗਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ba(n)nhi chalaaeeahi naa milahee vag sag ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged and led away; the dogs do not join the herd of cows.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap bhulaae bhuleeai aape mel milaai ||
english: The Lord Himself misleads the misguided ones, and He Himself unites them in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh chhuteeai je chalai satigur bhaai ||6||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saalaahee saalaahanaa bhee sachaa saalaahi ||
english: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, and sing the Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਆਹਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa ek dar beebhaa parahar aahi ||7||
english: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is True; stay away from all other doors. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak jah jah mai phirau tah tah saachaa soi ||
english: O Nanak, wherever I go, I find the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah ek hai guramukh paragat hoi ||8||
english: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dookh visaaran sabad hai je ma(n)n vasaae koi ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is the Dispeller of sorrow, if one enshrines it in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕਰਮ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te man vasai karam paraapat hoi ||9||
english: By Guru's Grace, it dwells in the mind; by God's Mercy, it is obtained. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
transliteration: naanak hau hau karate khap mue khoohan lakh asa(n)kh ||
english: O Nanak, acting in egotism, countless thousands have wasted away to death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਲੰਖ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: satigur mile s ubare saachai sabad ala(n)kh ||10||
english: Those who meet with the True Guru are saved, through the Shabad, the True Word of the Inscrutable Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur ik man seviaa tin jan laagau paai ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru single-mindedly - I fall at the feet of those humble beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har man vasai maaiaa kee bhukh jaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord abides in the mind, and the hunger for Maya departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se jan niramal oojale j guramukh naam samaai ||
english: Immaculate and pure are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, merge in the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਰਿ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak hor patisaaheeaa kooReeaa naam rate paatisaah ||11||
english: O Nanak, other empires are false; they alone are true emperors, who are imbued with the Naam. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਘਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਲੋਚੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu purakhai ghar bhagatee naar hai at lochai bhagatee bhaai ||
english: The devoted wife in her husband's home has a great longing to perform loving devotional service to him;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰਸ ਸਾਲਣੇ ਸਵਾਰਦੀ ਖਟ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bahu ras saalane savaaradee khat ras meethe paai ||
english: she prepares and offers to him all sorts of sweet delicacies and dishes of all flavors.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tiu baanee bhagat salaahade har naamai chit laai ||
english: In the same way, the devotees praise the Word of the Guru's Bani, and focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhan aagai raakhiaa sir vechiaa gur aagai jaai ||
english: They place mind, body and wealth in offering before the Guru, and sell their heads to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਗਤ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhagatee bhagat bahu lochade prabh lochaa poor milaai ||
english: In the Fear of God, His devotees yearn for His devotional worship; God fulfills their desires, and merges them with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਿਪਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har prabh veparavaahu hai kit khaadhai tipataai ||
english: My Lord God is Self-existent and Independent. What does He need to eat to be satisfied?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tipataasai har gun gaai ||
english: Whoever walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, is pleasing to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: dhan dhan kalajug naanakaa j chale satigur bhaai ||12||
english: Blessed, blessed are they, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਰਖਿਓ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo na sevio sabad na rakhio ur dhaar ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and do not keep the Shabad enshrined in their hearts

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhig tinaa kaa jeeviaa kit aae sa(n)saar ||
english: cursed are their lives. Why did they even come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramatee bhau man pavai taa(n) har ras lagai piaar ||
english: If one follows the Guru's Teachings, and keeps the Fear of God in his mind, then he is lovingly attuned to the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naau milai dhur likhiaa jan naanak paar utaar ||13||
english: By his primal destiny, he obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is carried across. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi jag bharamiaa ghar musai khabar na hoi ||
english: The world wanders lost in emotional attachment to Maya; it does not realize that its own home is being plundered.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh man hir laiaa manamukh a(n)dhaa loi ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is blind in the world; his mind is lured away by sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan khaRag pa(n)ch doot sa(n)ghaare guramat jaagai soi ||
english: With the sword of spiritual wisdom, kill the five demons. Remain awake and aware to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan paragaasiaa man tan niramal hoi ||
english: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed, and the mind and body are purified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਨਕਟੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naamaheen nakate phirahi bin naavai bahi roi ||
english: Those who lack the Naam wander around lost, with their noses cut off; without the Name, they sit and cry.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak jo dhur karatai likhiaa s met na sakai koi ||14||
english: O Nanak, no one can erase that which is pre-ordained by the Creator Lord. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa har dhan khatiaa gur kai sabad veechaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs earn the wealth of the Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤੁਟ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath paaiaa atut bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: They receive the wealth of the Naam; their treasures are overflowing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har gun baanee ucharahi a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord, whose end and limitations cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kaaran karataa karai vekhai sirajanahaar ||15||
english: O Nanak, the Creator is the Doer of all; the Creator Lord beholds all. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਦਸਵੈ ਆਕਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar sahaj hai man chaRiaa dasavai aakaas ||
english: Within the Gurmukh is intuitive peace and poise; his mind ascends to the Tenth Plane of the Akaashic Ethers.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਊਂਘ ਨ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tithai oo(n)gh na bhukh hai har a(n)mrit naam sukh vaas ||
english: No one is sleepy or hungry there; they dwell in the peace of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਆਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak dukh sukh viaapat nahee jithai aatam raam pragaas ||16||
english: O Nanak, pain and pleasure do not afflict anyone, where the Light of the Lord, the Supreme Soul, illuminates. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਸਭ ਗਲਿ ਆਏ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh kaa cholaRaa sabh gal aae paai ||
english: All have come, wearing the robes of sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik upajahi ik binas jaa(n)hi hukame aavai jaai ||
english: Some are born, and some pass away. They come and go according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran na chukaee ra(n)g lagaa doojai bhaai ||
english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; they are imbued with the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaaeean karanaa kachhoo na jaai ||17||
english: Bound in bondage, they are made to wander, and they cannot do anything about it. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau kirapaa dhaareean tinaa satigur miliaa aai ||
english: Those, upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, come and meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur mile ulatee bhaee mar jeeviaa sahaj subhaai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, they turn away from the world; they remain dead while still alive, with intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak bhagatee ratiaa har har naam samaai ||18||
english: O Nanak, the devotees are imbued with the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh cha(n)chal mat hai a(n)tar bahut chaturaaee ||
english: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is fickle; he is very tricky and clever within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: keetaa karatiaa birathaa gaiaa ik til thaai na paaee ||
english: Whatever he has done, and all that he does, is useless. Not even an iota of it is acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਬੀਜਦੇ ਸਭ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan jo beejade sabh dharam raai kai jaaee ||
english: The charity and generosity he pretends to give will be judged by the Righteous Judge of Dharma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satiguroo jamakaal na chhodaee doojai bhaai khuaaee ||
english: Without the True Guru, the Messenger of Death does not leave the mortal alone; he is ruined by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: joban jaa(n)daa nadar na aavaee jar pahuchai mar jaaee ||
english: Youth slips away imperceptibly, old age comes, and then he dies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: put kalat mohu het hai a(n)t belee ko na sakhaaee ||
english: The mortal is caught in love and emotional attachment to children and spouse, but none of them will be his helper and support in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve so sukh paae naau vasai man aaee ||
english: Whoever serves the True Guru finds peace; the Name comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak se vade vadabhaagee j guramukh naam samaaee ||19||
english: O Nanak, great and very fortunate are those who, as Gurmukh, are absorbed in the Naam. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh naam na chetanee bin naavai dukh roi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Name; without the Name, they cry in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aatamaa raam na poojanee doojai kiu sukh hoi ||
english: They do not worship the Lord, the Supreme Soul; how can they find peace in duality?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਾਢਹਿ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai a(n)tar mail hai sabad na kaadhahi dhoi ||
english: They are filled with the filth of egotism; they do not wash it away with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਲਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai mailiaa mue janam padaarath khoi ||20||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, they die in their filth; they waste the priceless opportunity of this human life. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bole a(n)dhule tis mahi aganee kaa vaas ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are deaf and blind; they are filled with the fire of desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਨੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: baanee surat na bujhanee sabad na karahi pragaas ||
english: They have no intuitive understanding of the Guru's Bani; they are not illumined with the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: onaa aapanee a(n)dar sudh nahee gur bachan na karahi visaas ||
english: They do not know their own inner being, and they have no faith in the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: giaaneeaa a(n)dar gurasabad hai nit har liv sadaa vigaas ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is within the being of the spiritually wise ones. They always blossom in His love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: har giaaneeaa kee rakhadaa hau sad balihaaree taas ||
english: The Lord saves the honor of the spiritually wise ones.I am forever a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: guramukh jo har sevade jan naanak taa kaa daas ||21||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of those Gurmukhs who serve the Lord. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮੁ ਸਰਪੁ ਹੈ ਜਗੁ ਘੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa bhuia(n)gam sarap hai jag gheriaa bikh maai ||
english: The poisonous snake, the serpent of Maya, has surrounded the world with its coils, O mother!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bikh kaa maaran har naam hai gur garuR sabad mukh paai ||
english: The antidote to this poisonous venom is the Name of the Lord; the Guru places the magic spell of the Shabad into the mouth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin satigur miliaa aai ||
english: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny come and meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mil satigur niramal hoiaa bikh haumai gaiaa bilaai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, they become immaculate, and the poison of egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa ke mukh ujale har daragah sobhaa paai ||
english: Radiant and bright are the faces of the Gurmukhs; they are honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak sadaa kurabaan tin jo chaalahi satigur bhaai ||22||
english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai nit hiradai har liv laai ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance. His heart is constantly attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: niravairai naal vair rachaaidaa apanai ghar lookee laai ||
english: Whoever directs hatred against the Guru, who has no hatred at all, only sets his own home on fire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar krodh aha(n)kaar hai anadin jalai sadaa dukh paai ||
english: Anger and egotism are within him night and day; he burns, and suffers constant pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kooR bol bol nit bhaukade bikh khaadhe doojai bhaai ||
english: They babble and tell lies, and keep on barking, eating the poison of the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bikh maaiaa kaaran bharamade phir ghar ghar pat gavaai ||
english: For the sake of the poison of Maya, they wander from house to house, and lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੇਰੇ ਪੂਤ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: besuaa kere poot jiu pitaa naam tis jaai ||
english: They are like the son of a prostitute, who does not know the name of his father.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam na chetanee karatai aap khuaai ||
english: They do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Creator Himself brings them to ruin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har guramukh kirapaa dhaareean jan vichhuRe aap milaai ||
english: The Lord showers His Mercy upon the Gurmukhs, and reunites the separated ones with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo satigur laage paai ||23||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the True Guru. ||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naam lage se oobare bin naavai jam pur jaa(n)hi ||
english: Those who are attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are saved; without the Name, they must go to the City of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai sukh nahee aai gae pachhutaahi ||24||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, they find no peace; they come and go in reincarnation with regrets. ||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa dhaavat rahi gae taa(n) man bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
english: When anxiety and wanderings come to an end, the mind becomes happy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaadee bujheeai saa dhan sutee nichi(n)d ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the soul-bride understands, and then she sleeps without worry.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tinhaa bhetiaa gur govi(n)d ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje mil rahe har paaiaa paramaana(n)d ||25||
english: O Nanak, they merge intuitively into the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: Those who serve their True Guru, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n lain har naam rakhahi ur dhaar ||
english: who honor and obey the Will of the True Guru, who keep the Lord's Name enshrined within their hearts,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aithai othai ma(n)neean har naam lage vaapaar ||
english: are honored, here and hereafter; they are dedicated to the business of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪਦੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad sinjaapade tit saachai darabaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs gain recognition in that Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਖਰਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saudaa kharach sach a(n)tar piram piaar ||
english: The True Name is their merchandise, the True Name is their expenditure; the Love of their Beloved fills their inner beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal neR na aavaee aap bakhase karataar ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Creator Lord Himself forgives them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਹੈਨਿ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se dhanava(n)t hain niradhan hor sa(n)saar ||26||
english: O Nanak, they alone are wealthy, who are imbued with the Naam; the rest of the world is poor. ||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jan kee tek har naam har bin naavai thavar na thaau ||
english: The Lord's Name is the Support of the Lord's humble servants. Without the Lord's Name, the there is no other place, no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naau man vasai sahaje sahaj samaau ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Name abides in the mind, and one is intuitively, automatically absorbed in the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee naam dhiaaiaa ahinis laagaa bhaau ||
english: Those with great good fortune meditate on the Naam; night and day, they embrace love for the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin hau sad kurabaanai jaau ||27||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of their feet; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh medanee tisanaa jalatee kare pukaar ||
english: The 8.4 million species of beings burn in desire and cry in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ihu mohu maaiaa sabh pasariaa naal chalai na a(n)tee vaar ||
english: All this show of emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you at that very last instant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bin har saa(n)t na aavaee kis aagai karee pukaar ||
english: Without the Lord, peace and tranquility do not come; unto whom should we go and complain?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee satigur paaiaa boojhiaa braham bichaar ||
english: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and comes to understand the contemplation of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਭ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: tisanaa agan sabh bujh gaee jan naanak har ur dhaar ||28||
english: The fire of desire is totally extinguished, O servant Nanak, enshrining the Lord within the heart. ||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਸੀ ਖਤੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: asee khate bahut kamaavade a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: I make so many mistakes, there is no end or limit to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਵਡ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har kirapaa kar kai bakhas laihu hau paapee vad gunahagaar ||
english: O Lord, please be merciful and forgive me; I am a sinner, a great offender.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਰ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu lekhai vaar na aavaee too(n) bakhas milaavanahaar ||
english: O Dear Lord, if You made an account of my mistakes, my turn to be forgiven would not even come. Please forgive me, and unite me with Yourself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai har prabh meliaa sabh kilavikh kat vikaar ||
english: The Guru, in His Pleasure, has united me with the Lord God; He has cut away all my sinful mistakes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: jinaa har har naam dhiaaiaa jan naanak tinh jaikaar ||29||
english: Servant Nanak celebrates the victory of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vichhuR vichhuR jo mile satigur ke bhai bhaai ||
english: Those who have been separated and alienated from the Lord are united with Him again, through the Fear and the Love of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran nihachal bhae guramukh naam dhiaai ||
english: They escape the cycle of birth and death, and, as Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਰਤਨ ਲਭੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: gur saadhoo sa(n)gat milai heere ratan labha(n)nhi ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, the diamonds and jewels are obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਕਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੰਨੑਿ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak laal amolakaa guramukh khoj laha(n)nhi ||30||
english: O Nanak, the jewel is priceless; the Gurmukhs seek and find it. ||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਧਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh naam na chetio dhig jeevan dhig vaas ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Naam. Cursed are their lives, and cursed are their homes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jis daa ditaa khaanaa painanaa so man na vasio gunataas ||
english: That Lord who gives them so much to eat and wear - they do not enshrine that Lord, the Treasure of Virtue, in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ihu man sabad na bhedio kiu hovai ghar vaas ||
english: This mind is not pierced by the Word of the Shabad; how can it come to dwell in its true home?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੀਆ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukheeaa dohaaganee aavan jaan mueeaas ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are like discarded brides, ruined by coming and going in the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam suhaag hai masatak manee likhiaas ||
english: The Gurmukhs are embellished and exalted by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the jewel of destiny is engraved upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam ur dhaariaa har hiradai kamal pragaas ||
english: They enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within their hearts; the Lord illumines their heart-lotus.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa hau sad balihaaree taas ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin mukh ujale jin a(n)tar naam pragaas ||31||
english: O Nanak, radiant and bright are the faces of those whose inner beings are illuminated with the Light of the Naam. ||31||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਸਿਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai soee jan sijhai bin sabadai mukat na hoee ||
english: Those who die in the Word of the Shabad are saved. Without the Shabad, no one is liberated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bhekh karahi bahu karam vigute bhaai doojai paraj vigoee ||
english: They wear religious robes and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are ruined; in the love of duality, their world is ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak bin satigur naau na paaeeai je sau lochai koee ||32||
english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, even though one may long for it hundreds of times. ||32||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਅਤਿ ਵਡ ਊਚਾ ਊਚੀ ਹੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naau at vad oochaa oochee hoo oochaa hoee ||
english: The Name of the Lord is utterly great, lofty and high, the highest of the high.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: apaR koi na sakaee je sau lochai koee ||
english: No one can climb up to it, even though one may long for it, hundreds of times.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਭਵੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mukh sa(n)jam hachhaa na hovaee kar bhekh bhavai sabh koee ||
english: Speaking about self-discipline, no one become pure; everyone walks around wearing religious robes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਜਾਇ ਚੜੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee pauRee jaai chaRai karam paraapat hoee ||
english: Those blessed by the karma of good deeds go and climb the ladder of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਇ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar aai vasai gurasabad veechaarai koi ||
english: The Lord comes and dwells within that one who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak sabad marai man maaneeai saache saachee soi ||33||
english: O Nanak, when someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, the mind is pleased and appeased. True is the reputation of those who are true. ||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu dukh saagar hai bikh dutar tariaa na jaai ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is a treacherous ocean of pain and poison, which cannot be crossed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa meraa karade pach mue haumai karat vihaai ||
english: Screaming, "Mine, mine!", they rot and die; they pass their lives in egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukhaa uravaar na paar hai adh vich rahe lapataai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are in limbo, neither on this side, nor the other; they are stuck in the middle.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s kamaavanaa karanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
english: They act as they are pre-destined; they cannot do anything else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramatee giaan ratan man vasai sabh dekhiaa braham subhaai ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the jewel of spiritual wisdom abides in the mind, and then God is easily seen in all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਚੜੈ ਤੇ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak satigur bohithai vadabhaagee chaRai te bhaujal paar la(n)ghaai ||34||
english: O Nanak, the very fortunate ones embark on the Boat of the True Guru; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||34||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur daataa ko nahee jo har naam dei aadhaar ||
english: Without the True Guru, there is no giver who can bestow the Support of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te naau man vasai sadaa rahai ur dhaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Name comes to dwell in the mind; keep it enshrined in your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tisanaa bujhai tipat hoi har kai naai piaar ||
english: The fire of desire is extinguished, and one finds satisfaction, through the Love of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai har apanee kirapaa dhaar ||35||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, when He showers His Mercy. ||35||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਰਲਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai jagat baraliaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
english: Without the Shabad, the world is so insane, that it cannot even be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har rakhe se ubare sabad rahe liv laai ||
english: Those who are protected by the Lord are saved; they remain lovingly attuned to the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਖੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa jin rakhee banat banaai ||36||
english: O Nanak, the Creator who made this making knows everything. ||36||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥਾ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਥਕੇ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: hom jag sabh teerathaa paRhi pa(n)dit thake puraan ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, have grown weary of making fire-offerings and sacrifices, making pilgrimages to all the sacred shrines, and reading the Puraanas.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: bikh maaiaa mohu na mitaee vich haumai aavan jaan ||
english: But they cannot get rid of the poison of emotional attachment to Maya; they continue to come and go in egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai mal utaree har japiaa purakh sujaan ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one's filth is washed off, meditating on the Lord, the Primal Being, the All-knowing One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: jinaa har har prabh seviaa jan naanak sad kurabaan ||37||
english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who serve their Lord God. ||37||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤਵਦੇ ਬਹੁ ਆਸਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu bahu chitavade bahu aasaa lobh vikaar ||
english: Mortals give great thought to Maya and emotional attachment; they harbor great hopes, in greed and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh asathir naa theeai mar binas jaai khin vaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not become steady and stable; they die and are gone in an instant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaag hovai satigur milai haumai tajai vikaar ||
english: Only those who are blessed with great good fortune meet the True Guru, and leave behind their egotism and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: har naamaa jap sukh paaiaa jan naanak sabad veechaar ||38||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, they find peace; servant Nanak contemplates the Word of the Shabad. ||38||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhagat na hovaee naam na lagai piaar ||
english: Without the True Guru, there is no devotional worship, and no love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam araadhiaa gur kai het piaar ||39||
english: Servant Nanak worships and adores the Naam, with love and affection for the Guru. ||39||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lobhee kaa vesaahu na keejai je kaa paar vasaai ||
english: Do not trust greedy people, if you can avoid doing so.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਧੁਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal tithai dhuhai jithai hath na paai ||
english: At the very last moment, they will deceive you there, where no one will be able to lend a helping hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh setee sa(n)g kare muhi kaalakh daag lagaai ||
english: Whoever associates with the self-willed manmukhs, will have his face blackened and dirtied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਲੋਭੀਆਂ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: muh kaale tinh lobheeaa(n) jaasan janam gavaai ||
english: Black are the faces of those greedy people; they lose their lives, and leave in disgrace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat har mel prabh har naam vasai man aai ||
english: O Lord, let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; may the Name of the Lord God abide in my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: janam maran kee mal utarai jan naanak har gun gaai ||40||
english: The filth and pollution of birth and death is washed away, O servant Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||40||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhur har prabh karatai likhiaa s metanaa na jaai ||
english: Whatever is pre-destined by the Lord God Creator, cannot be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis daa pratipaal kare har raai ||
english: Body and soul are all His. The Sovereign Lord King cherishes all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚੁਗਲ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭੁਖੇ ਰੁਲਿ ਮੁਏ ਏਨਾ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chugal ni(n)dak bhukhe rul mue enaa hath na kithaaoo paai ||
english: The gossipers and slanderers shall remain hungry and die, rolling in the dust; their hands cannot reach anywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਸਭ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baahar paakha(n)d sabh karam karahi man hiradai kapat kamaai ||
english: Outwardly, they do all the proper deeds, but they are hypocrites; in their minds and hearts, they practice deception and fraud.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤਿ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਖਲੋਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: khet sareer jo beejeeai so a(n)t khaloaa aai ||
english: Whatever is planted in the farm of the body, shall come and stand before them in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee har bhaavai bakhas milaai ||41||
english: Nanak offers this prayer: O Lord God, please forgive me, and unite me with Yourself. ||41||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਝੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man aavan jaan na sujhaee naa sujhai darabaar ||
english: The mortal being does not understand the comings and goings of reincarnation; he does not see the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਲੇਟਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi paletiaa a(n)tar agiaan gubaar ||
english: He is wrapped up in emotional attachment and Maya, and within his being is the darkness of ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tab nar sutaa jaagiaa sir da(n)d lagaa bahu bhaar ||
english: The sleeping person wakes, only when he is hit on the head by a heavy club.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਕਰਾਂ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਸੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa(n) karaa(n) upar har chetiaa se paain mokh duaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs dwell upon the Lord; they find the door of salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਓਹਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਤਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak aap ohi udhare sabh kuta(n)b tare paravaar ||42||
english: O Nanak, they themselves are saved, and all their relatives are carried across as well. ||42||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai so muaa jaapai ||
english: Whoever dies in the Word of the Shabad, is known to be truly dead.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras dhraapai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har daragahi gur sabad sinjaapai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is recognized in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਆ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai muaa hai sabh koi ||
english: Without the Shabad, everyone is dead.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh muaa apunaa janam khoi ||
english: The self-willed manmukh dies; his life is wasted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har naam na chetahi a(n)t dukh roi ||
english: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, shall cry in pain in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak karataa kare s hoi ||43||
english: O Nanak, whatever the Creator Lord does, comes to pass. ||43||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਢੇ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh budhe kade naahee jinhaa a(n)tar surat giaan ||
english: The Gurmukhs never grow old; within them is intuitive understanding and spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har gun ravahi a(n)tar sahaj dhiaan ||
english: They chant the Praises of the Lord, forever and ever; deep within, they intuitively meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਰਹਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: oi sadaa ana(n)d bibek rahahi dukh sukh ek samaan ||
english: They dwell forever in blissful knowledge of the Lord; they look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਇਕੋ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: tinaa nadaree iko aaiaa sabh aatam raam pachhaan ||44||
english: They see the One Lord in all, and realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul of all. ||44||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh baalak biradh samaan hai jinhaa a(n)tar har surat naahee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are like stupid children; they do not keep the Lord in their thoughts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਸਭ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: vich haumai karam kamaavade sabh dharam raai kai jaa(n)hee ||
english: They do all their deeds in egotism, and they must answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਛੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hachhe niramale gur kai sabad subhaai ||
english: The Gurmukhs are good and immaculately pure; they are embellished and exalted with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: onaa mail pata(n)g na lagaee j chalan satigur bhaai ||
english: Not even a tiny bit of filth sticks to them; they walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh jooth na utarai je sau dhovan paai ||
english: The filth of the manmukhs is not washed away, even if they wash hundreds of times.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh melian gur kai a(n)k samaai ||45||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are united with the Lord; they merge into the Guru's Being. ||45||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸਿਝੈ ॥
transliteration: buraa kare s kehaa sijhai ||
english: How can someone do bad things, and still live with himself?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਰੋਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਦਝੈ ॥
transliteration: aapanai rohi aape hee dajhai ||
english: By his own anger, he only burns himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਰਗੜੈ ਲੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kamalaa ragaRai lujhai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh drives himself crazy with worries and stubborn struggles.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi tis sabh kichh sujhai ||
english: But those who become Gurmukh understand everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੁਝੈ ॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh man siu lujhai ||46||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh struggles with his own mind. ||46||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur purakh na sevio sabad na keeto veechaar ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, the Primal Being, and do not reflect upon the Word of the Shabad

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਮਾਣਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਪਸੂ ਢੋਰ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: oi maanas joon na aakheean pasoo dhor gaavaar ||
english: - do not call them human beings; they are just animals and stupid beasts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: onaa a(n)tar giaan na dhiaan hai har sau preet na piaar ||
english: They have no spiritual wisdom or meditation within their beings; they are not in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mue vikaar mahi mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs die in evil and corruption; they die and are reborn, again and again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jeevadiaa no milai s jeevade har jagajeevan ur dhaar ||
english: They alone live, who join with the living; enshrine the Lord, the Lord of Life, within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sohane tit sachai darabaar ||47||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs look beautiful in that Court of the True Lord. ||47||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar har saajiaa har vasai jis naal ||
english: The Lord built the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; the Lord dwells within it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਰਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: guramatee har paaiaa maaiaa moh parajaal ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord; my emotional attachment to Maya has been burnt away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar vasat anek hai nav nidh naam samaal ||
english: Countless things are in the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; contemplate the Naam, and the nine treasures will be yours.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan bhagava(n)tee naanakaa jinaa guramukh ladhaa har bhaal ||
english: Blessed is that happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, seeks and finds the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪੮॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gaR ma(n)dar khojiaa har hiradai paaiaa naal ||48||
english: By great good fortune, one searches the temple of the body-fortress, and finds the Lord within the heart. ||48||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਤਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dah dis phir rahe at tisanaa lobh vikaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in the ten directions, led by intense desire, greed and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu na chukaee mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||
english: Their attachment to Maya does not cease; they die, only to be reborn, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sukh paaiaa at tisanaa taj vikaar ||
english: Serving the True Guru, peace is found; intense desire and corruption are discarded.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੪੯॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh gaiaa jan naanak sabad beechaar ||49||
english: The pains of death and birth are taken away; servant Nanak reflects upon the Word of the Shabad. ||49||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaai man har daragah paavahi maan ||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal being, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh paap sabh kateeahi haumai chukai gumaan ||
english: All your sins and terrible mistakes shall be taken away, and you shall be rid of your pride and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kamal vigasiaa sabh aatam braham pachhaan ||
english: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, realizing God, the Soul of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੫੦॥
transliteration: har har kirapaa dhaar prabh jan naanak jap har naam ||50||
english: O Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may chant the Name of the Lord. ||50||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree dhanava(n)tee jaaneeai bhaaee jaa(n) satigur kee kaar kamaai ||
english: In Dhanaasaree, the soul-bride is known to be wealthy, O Siblings of Destiny, when she works for the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਉ ਭਾਈ ਲਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man saupe jee sau bhaaee lae hukam phiraau ||
english: She surrenders her body, mind and soul, O Siblings of Destiny, and lives according to the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਵਹਿ ਬੈਸਹ ਭਾਈ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jah baisaavahi baisah bhaaee jah bhejahi tah jaau ||
english: I sit where He wishes me to sit, O Siblings of Destiny; wherever He sends me, I go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: evad dhan hor ko nahee bhaaee jevad sachaa naau ||
english: There is no other wealth as great, O Siblings of Destiny; such is the greatness of the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਂ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sache ke gun gaavaa(n) bhaaee sadaa sache kai sa(n)g rahaau ||
english: I sing forever the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; I shall remain with the True One forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੈਨਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: painan gun cha(n)giaaeeaa bhaaee aapanee pat ke saad aape khaai ||
english: So wear the clothes of His Glorious Virtues and goodness, O Siblings of Destiny; eat and enjoy the flavor of your own honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa kiaa saalaaheeai bhaaee darasan kau bal jaai ||
english: How can I praise Him, O Siblings of Destiny? I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich vadeeaa vadiaaeeaa bhaaee karam milai taa(n) paai ||
english: Great is the Glorious Greatness of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; if one is blessed with good karma, He is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਭਾਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik hukam ma(n)n na jaananee bhaaee doojai bhaai phiraai ||
english: Some do not know how to submit to the Hukam of His Command, O Siblings of Destiny; they wander around lost in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat dhoee naa milai bhaaee baisan milai na thaau ||
english: They find no place of rest in the Sangat, O Siblings of Destiny; they find no place to sit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukam tinaa manaaisee bhaaee jinaa dhure kamaaiaa naau ||
english: Nanak: they alone submit to His Command, O Siblings of Destiny, who are pre-destined to live the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੫੧॥
transliteration: tinh vitahu hau vaariaa bhaaee tin kau sad balihaarai jaau ||51||
english: I am a sacrifice to them, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||51||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਦਾੜੀਆਂ ਸਚੀਆ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਗੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: se daaReeaa(n) sacheeaa j gur charanee laga(n)nhi ||
english: Those beards are true, which brush the feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦਿ ਰਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: anadin sevan gur aapanaa anadin anad raha(n)nhi ||
english: Those who serve their Guru night and day, live in bliss, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਨੑਿ ॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak se muh sohane sachai dar disa(n)nhi ||52||
english: O Nanak, their faces appear beautiful in the Court of the True Lord. ||52||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਦਾੜੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mukh sache sach daaReeaa sach bolahi sach kamaahi ||
english: True are the faces and true are the beards, of those who speak the Truth and live the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਂਹਿ ਸਮਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad man vasiaa satigur maa(n)hi samaa(n)hi ||
english: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their minds; they are absorbed in the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sachee raasee sach dhan utam padavee paa(n)hi ||
english: True is their capital, and true is their wealth; they are blessed with the ultimate status.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sach sunahi sach ma(n)n lain sachee kaar kamaahi ||
english: They hear the Truth, they believe in the Truth; they act and work in the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sachee daragah baisanaa sache maahi samaahi ||
english: They are given a place in the Court of the True Lord; they are absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੫੩॥
transliteration: naanak vin satigur sach na paaeeai manamukh bhoole jaa(n)hi ||53||
english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the True Lord is not found. The self-willed manmukhs leave, wandering around lost. ||53||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa priu priu kare jalanidh prem piaar ||
english: The rainbird cries, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" She is in love with the treasure, the water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur mile seetal jal paaiaa sabh dookh nivaaranahaar ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the cooling, soothing water is obtained, and all pain is taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tis chukai sahaj oopajai chukai kook pukaar ||
english: My thirst has been quenched, and intuitive peace and poise have welled up; my cries and screams of anguish are past.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੫੪॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh saa(n)t hoi naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||54||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are peaceful and tranquil; they enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their hearts. ||54||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚੁ ਚਉ ਸਚੇ ਸਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa too(n) sach chau sache sau liv laai ||
english: O rainbird, chirp the True Name, and let yourself be attuned to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: boliaa teraa thaai pavai guramukh hoi alaai ||
english: Your word shall be accepted and approved, if you speak as Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheen tikh utarai ma(n)n lai rajaai ||
english: Remember the Shabad, and your thirst shall be relieved; surrender to the Will of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਝੋਕਿ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa jhok varasadaa boo(n)d pavai sahaj subhaai ||
english: The clouds are heavy, hanging low, and the rain is pouring down on all sides; the rain-drop is received, with natural ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jal hee te sabh oopajai bin jal piaas na jaai ||
english: From water, everything is produced; without water, thirst is not quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੫੫॥
transliteration: naanak har jal jin peeaa tis bhookh na laagai aai ||55||
english: O Nanak, whoever drinks in the Water of the Lord, shall never feel hunger again. ||55||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਹਜਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa too(n) sahaj bol sachai sabad subhaai ||
english: O rainbird, speak the Shabad, the True Word of God, with natural peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh terai naal hai satigur deeaa dikhaai ||
english: Everything is with you; the True Guru will show you this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanahi preetam milai vuthaa chhahabar laai ||
english: So understand your own self, and meet your Beloved; His Grace shall rain down in torrents.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jhim jhim a(n)mrit varasadaa tisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
english: Drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down softly and gently; thirst and hunger are completely gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kook pukaar na hovaee jotee jot milaai ||
english: Your cries and screams of anguish have ceased; your light shall merge into the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵਨੑਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫੬॥
transliteration: naanak sukh savanhi sohaaganee sachai naam samaai ||56||
english: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they are absorbed in the True Name. ||56||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhurahu khasam bhejiaa sachai hukam pathaai ||
english: The Primal Lord and Master has sent out the True Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੂੜੑੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: i(n)d varasai daiaa kar gooRhee chhahabar laai ||
english: Indra mercifully sends forth the rain, which falls in torrents.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹੇ ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਂ ਤਤੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabeehe tan man sukh hoi jaa(n) tat boo(n)d muhi paai ||
english: The body and mind of the rainbird are happy. only when the rain-drop falls into its mouth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਉਪਜੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: an dhan bahutaa upajai dharatee sobhaa paai ||
english: The corn grows high, wealth increases, and the earth is embellished with beauty.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin lok bhagat kare gur kai sabad samaai ||
english: Night and day, people worship the Lord with devotion, and are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape sachaa bakhas lae kar kirapaa karai rajaai ||
english: The True Lord Himself forgives them, and showering them with His Mercy, He leads them to walk in His Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahu kaamanee sachai sabad samaai ||
english: O brides, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and be absorbed in the True Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai kaa sahaj seegaar karihu sach rahahu liv laai ||
english: Let the Fear of God be your decoration, and remain lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੫੭॥
transliteration: naanak naamo man vasai har daragah lae chhadaai ||57||
english: O Nanak, the Naam abides in the mind, and the mortal is saved in the Court of the Lord. ||57||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਊਡਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਆਕਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa sagalee dharatee je phirahi ood chaRahi aakaas ||
english: The rainbird wanders all over the earth, soaring high through the skies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai jal paaeeai chookai bhookh piaas ||
english: But it obtains the drop of water, only when it meets the True Guru, and then, its hunger and thirst are relieved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kaa sabh kichh tis kai paas ||
english: Soul and body and all belong to Him; everything is His.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: vin boliaa sabh kichh jaanadaa kis aagai keechai aradaas ||
english: He knows everything, without being told; unto whom should we offer our prayers?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੫੮॥
transliteration: naanak ghat ghat eko varatadaa sabad kare paragaas ||58||
english: O Nanak, the One Lord is prevading and permeating each and every heart; the Word of the Shabad brings illumination. ||58||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak tisai basa(n)t hai j satigur sev samaai ||
english: O Nanak, the season of spring comes to one who serves the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੯॥
transliteration: har vuthaa man tan sabh paraphaRai sabh jag hareeaaval hoi ||59||
english: The Lord rains His Mercy down upon him, and his mind and body totally blossom forth; the entire world becomes green and rejuvenated. ||59||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabade sadaa basa(n)t hai jit tan man hariaa hoi ||
english: The Word of the Shabad brings eternal spring; it rejuvenates the mind and body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੬੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai jin siriaa sabh koi ||60||
english: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, which has created everyone. ||60||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak tinaa basa(n)t hai jinaa guramukh vasiaa man soi ||
