english: O Nanak, it is the spring season, for those Gurmukhs, within whose minds the Lord abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੬੧॥
transliteration: har vuthai man tan paraphaRai sabh jag hariaa hoi ||61||
english: When the Lord showers His Mercy, the mind and body blossom forth, and all the world turns green and lush. ||61||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੜੈ ਝਾਲਿ ਝਲੁੰਭਲੈ ਨਾਵੜਾ ਲਈਐ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: vadaRai jhaal jhalu(n)bhalai naavaRaa laeeai kis ||
english: In the early hours of the morning, whose name should we chant?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਲਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੬੨॥
transliteration: naau laeeai paramesarai bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath ||62||
english: Chant the Name of the Transcendent Lord, who is All-powerful to create and destroy. ||62||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਹਟ ਭੀ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: harahat bhee too(n) too(n) karahi bolahi bhalee baan ||
english: The Persian wheel also cries out, "Too! Too! You! You!", with sweet and sublime sounds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਉਚੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saahib sadaa hadoor hai kiaa uchee karahi pukaar ||
english: Our Lord and Master is always present; why do you cry out to Him in such a loud voice?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin jagat upaai har ra(n)g keeaa tisai vitahu kurabaan ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that Lord who created the world, and who loves it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap chhodahi taa(n) sahu milai sachaa ehu veechaar ||
english: Give up your selfishness, and then you shall meet your Husband Lord. Consider this Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: haumai phikaa bolanaa bujh na sakaa kaar ||
english: Speaking in shallow egotism, no one understands the Ways of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਹਾਣ ॥
transliteration: van trin tribhavan tujhai dhiaaidaa anadin sadaa vihaan ||
english: The forests and fields, and all the three worlds meditate on You, O Lord; this is the way they pass their days and nights forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaiaa kar kar thake veechaar ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord. People have grown weary of thinking about it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nadar karahi je aapanee taa(n) aape laihi savaar ||
english: But if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then He Himself embellishes us.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੬੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh jinhee dhiaaiaa aae se paravaan ||63||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord; blessed and approved is their coming into the world. ||63||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਗਵੀ ਕਪੜੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jog na bhagavee kapaRee jog na maile ves ||
english: Yoga is not obtained by wearing saffron robes; Yoga is not obtained by wearing dirty robes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ॥੬੪॥
transliteration: naanak ghar baithiaa jog paaeeai satigur kai upades ||64||
english: O Nanak, Yoga is obtained even while sitting in your own home, by following the Teachings of the True Guru. ||64||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa je bhavahi bed paRahi jug chaar ||
english: You may wander in all four directions, and read the Vedas throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੬੫॥
transliteration: naanak saachaa bhetai har man vasai paavahi mokh duaar ||65||
english: O Nanak, if you meet with the True Guru, the Lord shall come to dwell within your mind, and you shall find the door of salvation. ||65||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਮਤਿ ਭਵੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukam varatai khasam kaa mat bhavee phirahi chal chit ||
english: O Nanak, the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master, is prevailing. The intellectually confused person wanders around lost, misled by his fickle consciousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸੁਖ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਮਿਤ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sau kar dosatee sukh k puchhahi mit ||
english: If you make friends with the self-willed manmukhs, O friend, who can you ask for peace?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਉ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sau kar dosatee satigur sau laai chit ||
english: Make friends with the Gurmukhs, and focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੀ ਮਿਤ ॥੬੬॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran kaa mool kateeai taa(n) sukh hovee mit ||66||
english: The root of birth and death will be cut away, and then, you shall find peace, O friend. ||66||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਸੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhuliaa(n) aap samajhaaisee jaa kau nadar kare ||
english: The Lord Himself instructs those who are misguided, when He casts His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ॥੬੭॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree baaharee karan palaah kare ||67||
english: O Nanak, those who are not blessed by His Glance of Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||67||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaageeaa sohaaganee jinhaa guramukh miliaa har raai ||
english: Blessed and very fortunate are those happy soul-brides who, as Gurmukh, meet their Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot paragaaseeaa naanak naam samaai ||1||
english: The Light of God shines within them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur purakh hai jin sach jaataa soi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has realized the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jit miliai tikh utarai tan man seetal hoi ||
english: Meeting Him, thirst is quenched, and the body and mind are cooled and soothed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur sat purakh hai jis no samat sabh koi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, the True Primal Being, who looks upon all alike.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur niravair hai jis ni(n)daa usatat tul hoi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who has no hatred; slander and praise are all the same to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur sujaan hai jis a(n)tar braham veechaar ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the All-knowing True Guru, who has realized God within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur nira(n)kaar hai jis a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the Formless True Guru, who has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu satiguroo hai j sach driRaae soi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who implants the Truth within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur vaahu vaahu jis te naam paraapat hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, Blessed and Great is the True Guru, through whom the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sachaa sohilaa guramukh naam govi(n)d ||
english: For the Gurmukh, the true Song of Praise is to chant the Name of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam salaahanaa har japiaa man aana(n)d ||
english: Chanting the Praises of the Lord, their minds are in ecstasy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har paaiaa pooran paramaana(n)d ||
english: By great good fortune, they find the Lord, the Embodiment of perfect, supreme bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahiaa bahuR na man tan bha(n)g ||3||
english: Servant Nanak praises the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no obstacle will block his mind or body. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੂੰ ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: moo(n) pireeaa sau nehu kiu sajan milahi piaariaa ||
english: I am in love with my Beloved; how can I meet my Dear Friend?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau dhoodhedee tin sajan sach savaariaa ||
english: I seek that friend, who is embellished with Truth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur maidaa mit hai je milai ta ihu man vaariaa ||
english: The True Guru is my Friend; if I meet Him, I will offer this mind as a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਮੂੰ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: de(n)daa moo(n) pir das har sajan sirajanahaariaa ||
english: He has shown me my Beloved Lord, my Friend, the Creator.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਭਾਲੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak hau pir bhaalee aapanaa satigur naal dikhaaliaa ||4||
english: O Nanak, I was searching for my Beloved; the True Guru has shown me that He has been with me all the time. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਖੜੀ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪੰਧੁ ਮਤੁ ਮੂੰ ਸਜਣੁ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: hau khaRee nihaalee pa(n)dh mat moo(n) sajan aavae ||
english: I stand by the side of the road, waiting for You; O my Friend, I hope that You will come.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਅਜੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: ko aan milaavai aj mai pir mel milaavae ||
english: If only someone would come today and unite me in Union with my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੀ ਤਿਸ ਵਿਟਉ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਜੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੀ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: hau jeeu karee tis vitau chau kha(n)neeai jo mai piree dikhaavae ||
english: I would cut my living body into four pieces for anyone who shows me my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak har hoi daiaal taa(n) gur pooraa melaavae ||5||
english: O Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then He leads us to meet the Perfect Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jor haumai tan maaiaa kooRee aavai jaai ||
english: The power of egotism prevails within, and the body is controlled by Maya; the false ones come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa phuramaaiaa ma(n)n na sakee dutar tariaa na jaai ||
english: If someone does not obey the Command of the True Guru, he cannot cross over the treacherous world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee so chalai satigur bhaai ||
english: Whoever is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa darasan saphal hai jo ichhai so phal paai ||
english: The Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan is fruitful; through it, one obtains the fruits of his desires.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆਂ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee satigur ma(n)niaa(n) hau tin ke laagau paai ||
english: I touch the feet of those who believe in and obey the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai j anadin rahai liv laai ||6||
english: Nanak is the slave of those who, night and day, remain lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jinaa piree piaar bin darasan kiu tripateeai ||
english: Those who are in love with their Beloved - how can they find satisfaction without His Darshan?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak mile subhaai guramukh ihu man rahaseeai ||7||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meet Him with ease, and this mind blossoms forth in joy. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa piree piaar kiu jeevan pir baahare ||
english: Those who are in love with their Beloved - how can they live without Him?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਥੀਵਨਿ ਭੀ ਹਰੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jaa(n) sahu dekhan aapanaa naanak theevan bhee hare ||8||
english: When they see their Husband Lord, O Nanak, they are rejuvenated. ||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਤੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinaa guramukh a(n)dar nehu tai preetam sachai laaiaa ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who are filled with love for You, my True Beloved,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: raatee atai dehu naanak prem samaaiaa ||9||
english: O Nanak, remain immersed in the Lord's Love, night and day. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਆਸਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sachee aasakee jit preetam sachaa paaeeai ||
english: The love of the Gurmukh is true; through it, the True Beloved is attained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਹਿ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: anadin rahahi ana(n)d naanak sahaj samaaeeai ||10||
english: Night and day, remain in bliss, O Nanak, immersed in intuitive peace and poise. ||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sachaa prem piaar gur poore te paaeeai ||
english: True love and affection are obtained from the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kabahoo na hovai bha(n)g naanak har gun gaaeeai ||11||
english: They never break, O Nanak, if one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਨੑਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa a(n)dar sachaa nehu kiu jeevanhi piree vihooniaa ||
english: How can those who have true love within them live without their Husband Lord?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: guramukh mele aap naanak chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||12||
english: The Lord unites the Gurmukhs with Himself, O Nanak; they were separated from Him for such a long time. ||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਤਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kau prem piaar tau aape laaiaa karam kar ||
english: You grant Your Grace to those whom You Yourself bless with love and affection.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak lehu milaai mai jaachik deejai naam har ||13||
english: O Lord, please let Nanak meet with You; please bless this beggar with Your Name. ||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hasai guramukh rovai ||
english: The Gurmukh laughs, and the Gurmukh cries.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: j guramukh kare saaee bhagat hovai ||
english: Whatever the Gurmukh does, is devotional worship.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s kare veechaar ||
english: Whoever becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak paavai paar ||14||
english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, crosses over to the other shore. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar naam nidhaan hai gurabaanee veechaar ||
english: Those who have the Naam within, contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tin ke mukh sad ujale tit sachai darabaar ||
english: Their faces are always radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tin bahadiaa uthadiaa kade na visarai j aap bakhase karataar ||
english: Sitting down and standing up, they never forget the Creator, who forgives them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh mile na vichhuRahi j mele sirajanahaar ||15||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are united with the Lord. Those united by the Creator Lord, shall never be separated again. ||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾਂ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਹਾਂ ਕਰੜੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur peeraa(n) kee chaakaree mahaa(n) karaRee sukh saar ||
english: To work for the Guru, or a spiritual teacher, is terribly difficult, but it brings the most excellent peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਏ ਹੇਤ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee tis laae het piaar ||
english: The Lord casts His Glance of Grace, and inspires love and affection.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevai lagiaa bhaujal tarai sa(n)saar ||
english: Joined to the service of the True Guru, the mortal being crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaisee a(n)tar bibek beechaar ||
english: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, with clear contemplation and discriminating understanding within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak satigur miliai prabh paaeeai sabh dookh nivaaranahaar ||16||
english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, God is found; He is the Eradicator of all sorrow. ||16||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sevaa jo kare doojai bhaai chit laai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh may perform service, but his consciousness is attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: put kalat kuta(n)b hai maaiaa mohu vadhaai ||
english: Through Maya, his emotional attachment to children, spouse and relatives increases.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: daragahi lekhaa ma(n)geeai koee a(n)t na sakee chhadaai ||
english: He shall be called to account in the Court of the Lord, and in the end, no one will be able to save him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh dukh hai dukhadaaee moh maai ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, all is pain. Attachment to Maya is agonizingly painful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh nadaree aaiaa moh maaiaa vichhuR sabh jaai ||17||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh comes to see, that attachment to Maya separates all from the Lord. ||17||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਹ ਕੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hukam ma(n)ne sah keraa hukame hee sukh paae ||
english: The Gurmukh obeys the Order of her Husband Lord God; through the Hukam of His Command, she finds peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਮੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hukamo seve hukam araadhe hukame samai samaae ||
english: In His Will, she serves; in His Will, she worship and adores Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hukam varat nem such sa(n)jam man chi(n)diaa phal paae ||
english: In His Will, she merges in absorption. His Will is her fast, vow, purity and self-discipline; through it, she obtains the fruits of her mind's desires.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa suhaagan j hukamai bujhai satigur sevai liv laae ||
english: She is always and forever the happy, pure soul-bride, who realizes His Will; she serves the True Guru, inspired by loving absorption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak kripaa kare jin oopar tinaa hukame lae milaae ||18||
english: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, are merged and immersed in His Will. ||18||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੇ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਨਿਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh hukam na bujhe bapuRee nit haumai karam kamaai ||
english: The wretched, self-willed manmukhs do not realize His Will; they continually act in ego.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮੁ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: varat nem such sa(n)jam poojaa paakha(n)d bharam na jaai ||
english: By ritualistic fasts, vows, purities, self-disciplines and worship ceremonies, they still cannot get rid of their hypocrisy and doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਕੁਸੁਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬੇਧੇ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਉਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarahu kusudh maaiaa mohi bedhe jiu hasatee chhaar udaae ||
english: Inwardly, they are impure, pierced through by attachment to Maya; they are like elephants, who throw dirt all over themselves right after their bath.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin upaae tisai na chetahi bin chete kiu sukh paae ||
english: They do not even think of the One who created them. Without thinking of Him, they cannot find peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਏ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak parapa(n)ch keeaa dhur karatai poorab likhiaa kamaae ||19||
english: O Nanak, the Primal Creator has made the drama of the Universe; all act as they are pre-ordained. ||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh parateet bhaee man maaniaa anadin sevaa karat samaai ||
english: The Gurmukh has faith; his mind is contented and satisfied. Night and day, he serves the Lord, absorbed in Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਭ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar satigur guroo sabh pooje satigur kaa daras dekhai sabh aai ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, is within; all worship and adore Him. Everyone comes to see the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)neeai satigur param beechaaree jit miliai tisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
english: So believe in the True Guru, the supreme sublime Contemplator. Meeting with Him, hunger and thirst are completely relieved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau sadaa sadaa balihaaree gur apune jo prabh sachaa dei milaai ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who leads me to meet the True Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗੇ ਆਇ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak karam paaiaa tin sachaa jo gur charanee lage aai ||20||
english: O Nanak, those who come and fall at the Feet of the Guru are blessed with the karma of Truth. ||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਸੇ ਸਜਣ ਮੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jin pireeaa sau nehu se sajan mai naal ||
english: That Beloved, with whom I am in love, that Friend of mine is with me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਾਂ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar hau phiraa(n) bhee hiradai rakhaa samaal ||21||
english: I wander around inside and outside, but I always keep Him enshrined within my heart. ||21||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa ik man ik chit dhiaaiaa satigur sau chit laai ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord single-mindedly, with one-pointed concentration, link their consciousness to the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin kee dukh bhukh haumai vadaa rog gaiaa niradokh bhae liv laai ||
english: They are rid of pain, hunger, and the great illness of egotism; lovingly attuned to the Lord, they become free of pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi gun ucharahi gun mahi savai samaai ||
english: They sing His Praises, and chant His Praises; in His Glorious Praises, they sleep in absorption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur poore te paaiaa sahaj miliaa prabh aai ||22||
english: O Nanak, through the Perfect Guru, they come to meet God with intuitive peace and poise. ||22||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maaiaa mohu hai naam na lagai piaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are emotionally attached to Maya; they are not in love with the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੰਘਰੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰੈ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR kamaavai kooR sa(n)gharai kooR karai aahaar ||
english: They practice falsehood, gather falsehood, and eat the food of falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bikh maaiaa dhan sa(n)ch marahi a(n)t hoi sabh chhaar ||
english: Gathering the poisonous wealth and property of Maya, they die; in the end, they are all reduced to ashes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam such sa(n)jam karahi a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
english: They perform religious rituals of purity and self-discipline, but they are filled with greed, evil and corruption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak manamukh j kamaavai s thaai na pavai daragah hoi khuaar ||23||
english: O Nanak, the actions of the self-willed manmukhs are not accepted; in the Court of the Lord, they are miserable. ||23||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਗਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa raagaa(n) vich so bhalaa bhaaee jit vasiaa man aai ||
english: Among all Ragas, that one is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny, by which the Lord comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਾਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raag naad sabh sach hai keemat kahee na jaai ||
english: Those Ragas which are in the Sound-current of the Naad are totally true; their value cannot be expressed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੈ ਨਾਦੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਇਨੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raagai naadai baaharaa inee hukam na boojhiaa jaai ||
english: Those Ragas which are not in the Sound-current of the Naad - by these, the Lord's Will cannot be understood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukamai boojhai tinaa raas hoi satigur te sojhee paai ||
english: O Nanak, they alone are right, who understand the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tis te hoiaa jiu tisai dee rajaai ||24||
english: Everything happens as He wills. ||24||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich a(n)mrit naam hai a(n)mrit kahai kahaai ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naam niramalou niramal naam dhiaai ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one meditates on the Immaculate Naam, the Pure and Holy Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee tat hai guramukh vasai man aai ||
english: The Ambrosial Word of His Bani is the true essence. It comes to abide in the mind of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hiradai kamal paragaasiaa jotee jot milaai ||
english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and one's light merges in the Light.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak satigur tin kau melion jin dhur masatak bhaag likhaai ||25||
english: O Nanak, they alone meet with the True Guru, who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||25||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar tisanaa ag hai manamukh bhukh na jaai ||
english: Within the self-willed manmukhs is the fire of desire; their hunger does not depart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mohu kuta(n)b sabh kooR hai kooR rahiaa lapataai ||
english: Emotional attachments to relatives are totally false; they remain engrossed in falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿੰਤਵੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin chi(n)taa chi(n)tavai chi(n)taa badhaa jaai ||
english: Night and day, they are troubled by anxiety; bound to anxiety, they depart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran na chukaee haumai karam kamaai ||
english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation never end; they do their deeds in egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: gur saranaaee ubarai naanak lae chhadaai ||26||
english: But in the Guru's Sanctuary, they are saved, O Nanak, and set free. ||26||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh har dhiaaidaa satasa(n)gat satigur bhaai ||
english: The True Guru meditates on the Lord, the Primal Being. The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, loves the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat satigur sevade har mele gur melaai ||
english: Those who join the Sat Sangat, and serve the True Guru - the Guru unites them in the Lord's Union.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ehu bhaujal jagat sa(n)saar hai gur bohith naam taraai ||
english: This world, this universe, is a terrifying ocean. On the Boat of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Guru carries us across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhee bhaanaa ma(n)niaa gur pooraa paar la(n)ghaai ||
english: The Sikhs of the Guru accept and obey the Lord's Will; the Perfect Guru carries them across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਂਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa(n) kee har dhooR dehi ham paapee bhee gat paa(n)hi ||
english: O Lord, please bless me with the dust of the feet of the Guru's Sikhs. I am a sinner - please save me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: dhur masatak har prabh likhiaa gur naanak miliaa aai ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads by the Lord God, come to meet Guru Nanak.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jamaka(n)kar maar bidaarian har daragah lae chhadaai ||
english: The Messenger of Death is beaten and driven away; we are saved in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa no saabaas hai har tuthaa mel milaai ||27||
english: Blessed and celebrated are the Sikhs of the Guru; in His Pleasure, the Lord unites them in His Union. ||27||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam diRaaiaa jin vichahu bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me; it has dispelled my doubts from within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਮਗੁ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raam naam har keerat gaai kar chaanan mag dekhaaiaa ||
english: Singing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord's Name, the Lord's path is illuminated and shown to His Sikhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar ek liv laagee a(n)tar naam vasaaiaa ||
english: Conquering my egotism, I remain lovingly attuned to the One Lord; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramatee jam johi na sakai sachai naai samaaiaa ||
english: I follow the Guru's Teachings, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me; I am immersed in the True Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh aape aap varatai karataa jo bhaavai so naai laaiaa ||
english: The Creator Himself is All-pervading; as He pleases, He links us to His Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਲਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak naau lae taa(n) jeevai bin naavai khin mar jaaiaa ||28||
english: Servant Nanak lives, chanting the Name. Without the Name, he dies in an instant. ||28||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)tar haumai rog bhram bhoole haumai saakat durajanaa ||
english: Within the minds of the faithless cynics is the disease of egotism; these evil people wander around lost, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਣਾ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak rog gavaai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||29||
english: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated only by meeting with the True Guru, the Holy Friend. ||29||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: guramatee har har bole ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har prem kasaaee dinas raat har ratee har ra(n)g chole ||
english: Attracted by the Lord's Love, day and night, the body-robe is imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਟੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har jaisaa purakh na labhaee sabh dekhiaa jagat mai tole ||
english: I have not found any being like the Lord, although I have searched and looked all over the world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur naam diRaaiaa man anat na kaahoo dole ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within; now, my mind does not waver or wander anywhere else.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਲ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai gur satigur ke gul gole ||30||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord, the slave of the slaves of the Guru, the True Guru. ||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੰਨੑਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਿਞਾਤਾ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rate seee j mukh na moRa(n)nhi jinhee sinjaataa saaee ||
english: They alone are imbued with the Lord, who do not turn their faces away from Him - they realize Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਦੇ ਕਚੇ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਕਾਰਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhaR jhaR pavade kache birahee jinhaa kaar na aaee ||1||
english: The false, immature lovers do not know the way of love, and so they fall. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਭਾਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanee vihoonaa paat pata(n)bar bhaahee setee jaale ||
english: Without my Master, I will burn my silk and satin clothes in the fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂੜੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੁਡੰਦੜੀ ਸੋਹਾਂ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhooRee vich luda(n)daRee sohaa(n) naanak tai sah naale ||2||
english: Even rolling in the dust, I look beautiful, O Nanak, if my Husband Lord is with me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad araadheeai naam ra(n)g bairaag ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I worship and adore the Naam, with love and balanced detachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤੇ ਪੰਚ ਬੈਰਾਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਮਾਰੂ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jeete pa(n)ch bairaaeeaa naanak saphal maaroo ihu raag ||3||
english: When the five enemies are overcome, O Nanak, this musical measure of Raga Maaroo becomes frtuiful. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਮੂੰ ਇਕੁ ਤ ਲਖ ਤਉ ਜਿਤੀ ਪਿਨਣੇ ਦਰਿ ਕਿਤੜੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) moo(n) ik ta lakh tau jitee pinane dar kitaRe ||
english: When I have the One Lord, I have tens of thousands. Otherwise, people like me beg from door to door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਮਣੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਓ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੋ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: baaman birathaa gaio jana(n)m jin keeto so visare ||4||
english: O Brahmin, your life has passed away uselessly; you have forgotten the One who created you. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sorath so ras peejeeai kabahoo na pheekaa hoi ||
english: In Raga Sorat'h, drink in this sublime essence, which never loses its taste.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam gun gaaeeahi daragah niramal soi ||5||
english: O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, one's reputation is immaculate in the Court of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰਈ ॥
transliteration: jo prabh rakhe aap tin koi na maaraee ||
english: No one can kill those whom God Himself protects.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar naam nidhaan sadaa gun saaraee ||
english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them. They cherish His Glorious Virtues forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਅਗੰਮ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰਈ ॥
transliteration: ekaa tek aga(n)m man tan prabh dhaaraee ||
english: They take the Support of the One, the Inaccessible Lord; they enshrine God in their mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਉਤਾਰਈ ॥
transliteration: lagaa ra(n)g apaar ko na utaaraee ||
english: They are imbued with the Love of the Infinite Lord, and no one can wipe it away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har gun gaai sahaj sukh saaraee ||
english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they obtain the most excellent celestial peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan ridai ur haaraee ||6||
english: O Nanak, they enshrine the treasure of the Naam in their hearts. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਚੰਗਾ ਮਾਨਿ ਦੁਯੀ ਗਣਤ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kare s cha(n)gaa maan duyee ganat laahi ||
english: Whatever God does, accept that as good; leave behind all other judgements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: apanee nadar nihaal aape laihu laai ||
english: He shall cast His Glance of Grace, and attach you to Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jan dehu matee upades vichahu bharam jaai ||
english: Instruct yourself with the Teachings, and doubt will depart from within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਸੋਈ ਸਭ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa lekh soee sabh kamaai ||
english: Everyone does that which is pre-ordained by destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kachh tis dai vas doojee naahi jaai ||
english: Everything is under His control; there is no other place at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak sukh anad bhae prabh kee ma(n)n rajaai ||7||
english: Nanak is in peace and bliss, accepting the Will of God. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa jin simariaa seee bhae nihaal ||
english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the Perfect Guru, are exalted and uplifted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam araadhanaa kaaraj aavai raas ||8||
english: O Nanak, dwelling on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all affairs are resolved. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਏ ਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paapee karam kamaavade karade haae haai ||
english: The sinners act, and generate bad karma, and then they weep and wail.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਮਥਨਿ ਮਾਧਾਣੀਆ ਤਿਉ ਮਥੇ ਧ੍ਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak jiu mathan maadhaaneeaa tiu mathe dhram raai ||9||
english: O Nanak, just as the churning stick churns the butter, so does the Righteous Judge of Dharma churn them. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਜਨਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaain saajanaa janam padaarath jeet ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, O friend, the treasure of life is won.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਰਮ ਐਸੇ ਚਵਹਿ ਕੀਤੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak dharam aise chavahi keeto bhavan puneet ||10||
english: O Nanak, speaking in Righteousness, one's world becomes sanctified. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਭੜੀ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਮਿਠੀ ਗਲਣਿ ਕੁਮੰਤ੍ਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: khubhaRee kuthaai mithee galan kuma(n)treeaa ||
english: I am stuck in an evil place, trusting the sweet words of an evil advisor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਹਿ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak seee ubare jinaa bhaag mathaahi ||11||
english: O Nanak, they alone are saved, who have such good destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੜੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਵੰਨੑਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਹ ਆਪਣੈ ॥
transliteration: sutaRe sukhee sava(n)nhi jo rate sah aapanai ||
english: They alone sleep and dream in peace, who are imbued with the Love of their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਵਿਛੋਹਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਉ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਲਵੰਨੑਿ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: prem vichhohaa dhanee sau athe pahar lava(n)nhi ||12||
english: Those who have been separated from the Love of their Master, scream and cry twenty-four hours a day. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੜੇ ਅਸੰਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੀ ਕਾਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sutaRe asa(n)kh maaiaa jhoothee kaarane ||
english: Millions are asleep, in the false illusion of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਾਗੰਨੑਿ ਜਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰਣੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak se jaaga(n)nhi j rasanaa naam uchaarane ||13||
english: O Nanak, they alone are awake and aware, who chant the Naam with their tongues. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਣੇ ਵੁਠੇ ਨਗਰ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ॥
transliteration: mrig tisanaa pekh bhulane vuthe nagar ga(n)dhrab ||
english: Seeing the mirage, the optical illusion, the people are confused and deluded.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਫਬ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jinee sach araadhiaa naanak man tan phab ||14||
english: Those who worship and adore the True Lord, O Nanak, their minds and bodies are beautiful. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran paarabraham sa(n)mrath purakh apaar ||
english: The All-powerful Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Primal Being, is the Saving Grace of sinners.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jisahi udhaare naanakaa so simare sirajanahaar ||15||
english: Those whom He saves, meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ ਇਕਸ ਸਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojee chhod kuvaataRee ikas sau chit laai ||
english: Forsake duality and the ways of evil; focus your consciousness on the One Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਵਂੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਹਣਿ ਲੁੜੑੰਦੜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: doojai bhaava(n)ee naanakaa vahan luRh(n)daRee jaai ||16||
english: In the love of duality, O Nanak, the mortals are being washed downstream. ||16||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹਟੜੇ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tihataRe baajaar saudaa karan vanajaariaa ||
english: In the markets and bazaars of the three qualities, the merchants make their deals.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚੜੇ ਪਾਸਾਰ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sach vakhar jinee ladiaa se sachaRe paasaar ||17||
english: Those who load the true merchandise are the true traders. ||17||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪੰਥਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)thaa prem na jaanaee bhoolee phirai gavaar ||
english: Those who do not know the way of love are foolish; they wander lost and confused.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਉਦੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਅੰਧੵਾਰ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak har bisaraai kai paude narak a(n)dhyaar ||18||
english: O Nanak, forgetting the Lord, they fall into the deep, dark pit of hell. ||18||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੰਮਾਂ ਦੰਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa manahu na veesarai maa(n)gai da(n)maa(n) da(n)m ||
english: In his mind, the mortal does not forget Maya; he begs for more and more wealth.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਕਰੰਮਿ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: so prabh chit na aavaee naanak nahee kara(n)m ||19||
english: That God does not even come into his consciousness; O Nanak, it is not in his karma. ||19||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਥੁੜਂੀਦੋ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tichar mool na thuRa(n)eedo jichar aap kripaal ||
english: The mortal does not run out of capital, as long as the Lord Himself is merciful.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਖਰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sabad akhut baabaa naanakaa khaahi kharach dhan maal ||20||
english: The Word of the Shabad is Guru Nanak's inexhaustible treasure; this wealth and capital never runs out, no matter how much it is spent and consumed. ||20||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਖੰਭ ਵਿਕਾਂਦੜੇ ਜੇ ਲਹਾਂ ਘਿੰਨਾ ਸਾਵੀ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)bh vikaa(n)daRe je lahaa(n) ghi(n)naa saavee tol ||
english: If I could find wings for sale, I would buy them with an equal weight of my flesh.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੰਨਿ ਜੜਾਂਈ ਆਪਣੈ ਲਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਟੋਲਿ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: ta(n)n jaRaa(n)ee aapanai lahaa(n) s sajan tol ||21||
english: I would attach them to my body, and seek out and find my Friend. ||21||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾਂ ਦੈ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sajan sachaa paatisaahu sir saahaa(n) dai saahu ||
english: My Friend is the True Supreme King, the King over the heads of kings.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਿਠਿਆ ਸੋਹੀਐ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: jis paas bahithiaa soheeai sabhanaa(n) daa vesaahu ||22||
english: Sitting by His side, we are exalted and beautified; He is the Support of all. ||22||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 9 ||
english: Salok, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਾਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d gaaio nahee janam akaarath keen ||
english: If you do not sing the Praises of the Lord, your life is rendered useless.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਲ ਕਉ ਮੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har bhaj manaa jih bidh jal kau meen ||1||
english: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord; immerse your mind in Him, like the fish in the water. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhian siu kaahe rachio nimakh na hohi udaas ||
english: Why are you engrossed in sin and corruption? You are not detached, even for a moment!

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj har manaa parai na jam kee phaas ||2||
english: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, and you shall not be caught in the noose of death. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਇਉ ਹੀ ਗਇਓ ਲੀਓ ਜਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: taranaapo iu hee gaio leeo jaraa tan jeet ||
english: Your youth has passed away like this, and old age has overtaken your body.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਅਉਧ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj har manaa audh jaat hai beet ||3||
english: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord; your life is fleeting away! ||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਹੂਚਿਓ ਆਨਿ ॥
transliteration: biradh bhaio soojhai nahee kaal pahoochio aan ||
english: You have become old, and you do not understand that death is overtaking you.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਭਜੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak nar baavare kiu na bhajai bhagavaan ||4||
english: Says Nanak, you are insane! Why do you not remember and meditate on God? ||4||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan daaraa sa(n)pat sagal jin apunee kar maan ||
english: Your wealth, spouse, and all the possessions which you claim as your own

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: in mai kachh sa(n)gee nahee naanak saachee jaan ||5||
english: - none of these shall go along with you in the end. O Nanak, know this as true. ||5||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran bhai haran har anaath ke naath ||
english: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tih jaaneeai sadaa basat tum saath ||6||
english: Says Nanak, realize and know Him, who is always with you. ||6||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਤੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਨ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan jih to kau deeo taa(n) siu nehu na keen ||
english: He has given you your body and wealth, but you are not in love with Him.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ ਦੀਨ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak nar baavare ab kiu dolat deen ||7||
english: Says Nanak, you are insane! Why do you now shake and tremble so helplessly? ||7||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਓ ਅਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਨੀਕੇ ਧਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan sa(n)pai sukh deeo ar jih neeke dhaam ||
english: He has given you your body, wealth, property, peace and beautiful mansions.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa simarat kaahi na raam ||8||
english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: why don't you remember the Lord in meditation? ||8||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh sukh daataa raam hai doosar naahin koi ||
english: The Lord is the Giver of all peace and comfort. There is no other at all.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa tih simarat gat hoi ||9||
english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: meditating in remembrance on Him, salvation is attained. ||9||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਹ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: jih simarat gat paaeeai tih bhaj re tai meet ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, salvation is attained; vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਅਉਧ ਘਟਤ ਹੈ ਨੀਤ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa audh ghatat hai neet ||10||
english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: your life is passing away! ||10||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਤਨੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch tat ko tan rachio jaanahu chatur sujaan ||
english: Your body is made up of the five elements; you are clever and wise - know this well.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਲੀਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jih te upajio naanakaa leen taahi mai maan ||11||
english: Believe it - you shall merge once again into the One, O Nanak, from whom you originated. ||11||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਬਸੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat mai har joo basai sa(n)tan kahio pukaar ||
english: The Dear Lord abides in each and every heart; the Saints proclaim this as true.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਭਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tih bhaj manaa bhau nidh utarahi paar ||12||
english: Says Nanak, meditate and vibrate upon Him, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਹੀ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukh jih parasai nahee lobh mohu abhimaan ||
english: One who is not touched by pleasure or pain, greed, emotional attachment and egotistical pride

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa so moorat bhagavaan ||13||
english: - says Nanak, listen, mind: he is the very image of God. ||13||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਿਹਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)diaa naahi jihi ka(n)chan loh samaan ||
english: One who is beyond praise and slander, who looks upon gold and iron alike

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੈ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa mukat taahi tai jaan ||14||
english: - says Nanak, listen, mind: know that such a person is liberated. ||14||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog jaa kai nahee bairee meet samaan ||
english: One who is not affected by pleasure or pain, who looks upon friend and enemy alike

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੈ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa mukat taahi tai jaan ||15||
english: - says Nanak, listen, mind: know that such a person is liberated. ||15||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਦੇਤ ਨਹਿ ਨਹਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਨਤ ਆਨ ॥
transliteration: bhai kaahoo kau det nahi nahi bhai maanat aan ||
english: One who does not frighten anyone, and who is not afraid of anyone else

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਖਾਨਿ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa giaanee taahi bakhaan ||16||
english: - says Nanak, listen, mind: call him spiritually wise. ||16||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਜੀ ਲੀਓ ਭੇਖ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥
transliteration: jihi bikhiaa sagalee tajee leeo bhekh bairaag ||
english: One who has forsaken all sin and corruption, who wears the robes of neutral detachment

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਨਰ ਮਾਥੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa tih nar maathai bhaag ||17||
english: - says Nanak, listen, mind: good destiny is written on his forehead. ||17||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਜੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jihi maaiaa mamataa tajee sabh te bhaio udaas ||
english: One who renounces Maya and possessiveness and is detached from everything

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa tih ghat braham nivaas ||18||
english: - says Nanak, listen, mind: God abides in his heart. ||18||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jihi praanee haumai tajee karataa raam pachhaan ||
english: That mortal, who forsakes egotism, and realizes the Creator Lord

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਰੁ ਇਹ ਮਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak vahu mukat nar ih man saachee maan ||19||
english: - says Nanak, that person is liberated; O mind, know this as true. ||19||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਨਾਸਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਨ ਕਲਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai naasan duramat haran kal mai har ko naam ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੈ ਸਫਲ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਮ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: nis din jo naanak bhajai saphal hohi tih kaam ||20||
english: Night and day, O Nanak, whoever vibrates and meditates on the Lord's Name, sees all of his works brought to fruition. ||20||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jihabaa gun gobi(n)d bhajahu karan sunahu har naam ||
english: Vibrate with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; with your ears, hear the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਪਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਧਾਮ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa parahi na jam kai dhaam ||21||
english: Says Nanak, listen, man: you shall not have to go to the house of Death. ||21||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਜੈ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo praanee mamataa tajai lobh moh aha(n)kaar ||
english: That mortal who renounces possessiveness, greed, emotional attachment and egotism

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਤਰੈ ਅਉਰਨ ਲੇਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak aapan tarai auran let udhaar ||22||
english: - says Nanak, he himself is saved, and he saves many others as well. ||22||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਪੇਖਨਾ ਐਸੇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu supanaa ar pekhanaa aise jag kau jaan ||
english: Like a dream and a show, so is this world, you must know.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: in mai kachh saacho nahee naanak bin bhagavaan ||23||
english: None of this is true, O Nanak, without God. ||23||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: nis din maaiaa kaarane praanee dolat neet ||
english: Night and day, for the sake of Maya, the mortal wanders constantly.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: kotan mai naanak kooo naaraain jih cheet ||24||
english: Among millions, O Nanak, there is scarcely anyone, who keeps the Lord in his consciousness. ||24||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: jaise jal te budabudaa upajai binasai neet ||
english: As the bubbles in the water well up and disappear again,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਰਚੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: jag rachanaa taise rachee kahu naanak sun meet ||25||
english: so is the universe created; says Nanak, listen, O my friend! ||25||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: praanee kachhoo na chetaee mad maaiaa kai a(n)dh ||
english: The mortal does not remember the Lord, even for a moment; he is blinded by the wine of Maya.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਪਰਤ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bin har bhajan parat taahi jam pha(n)dh ||26||
english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, he is caught by the noose of Death. ||26||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਚਾਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਲੇਹ ॥
transliteration: jau sukh kau chaahai sadaa saran raam kee leh ||
english: If you yearn for eternal peace, then seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa duralabh maanukh deh ||27||
english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: this human body is difficult to obtain. ||27||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਧਾਵਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਲੋਗ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran dhaavahee moorakh log ajaan ||
english: For the sake of Maya, the fools and ignorant people run all around.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bin har bhajan birathaa janam siraan ||28||
english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, life passes away uselessly. ||28||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਭਜੈ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਮ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jo praanee nis din bhajai roop raam tih jaan ||
english: That mortal who meditates and vibrates upon the Lord night and day - know him to be the embodiment of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: har jan har a(n)tar nahee naanak saachee maan ||29||
english: There is no difference between the Lord and the humble servant of the Lord; O Nanak, know this as true. ||29||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਫਧਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: man maaiaa mai phadh rahio bisario gobi(n)d naam ||
english: The mortal is entangled in Maya; he has forgotten the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਉਨੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bin har bhajan jeevan kaune kaam ||30||
english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, what is the use of this human life? ||30||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: praanee raam na chetaee mad maaiaa kai a(n)dh ||
english: The mortal does not think of the Lord; he is blinded by the wine of Maya.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har bhajan bin parat taahi jam pha(n)dh ||31||
english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, he is caught in the noose of Death. ||31||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh mai bahu sa(n)gee bhae dukh mai sa(n)g na koi ||
english: In good times, there are many companions around, but in bad times, there is no one at all.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har bhaj manaa a(n)t sahaaee hoi ||32||
english: Says Nanak, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord; He shall be your only Help and Support in the end. ||32||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: janam janam bharamat phirio mitio na jam ko traas ||
english: Mortals wander lost and confused through countless lifetimes; their fear of death is never removed.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har bhaj manaa nirabhai paavahi baas ||33||
english: Says Nanak, vibrate and meditate on the Lord, and you shall dwell in the Fearless Lord. ||33||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਨ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jatan bahut mai kar rahio mitio na man ko maan ||
english: I have tried so many things, but the pride of my mind has not been dispelled.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਧਿਓ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: duramat siu naanak phadhio raakh lehu bhagavaan ||34||
english: I am engrossed in evil-mindedness, Nanak. O God, please save me! ||34||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੀਨਿ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: baal juaanee ar biradh phun teen avasathaa jaan ||
english: Childhood, youth and old age - know these as the three stages of life.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har bhajan bin birathaa sabh hee maan ||35||
english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, everything is useless; you must appreciate this. ||35||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੋ ਹੁਤੋ ਸੁ ਨਾ ਕੀਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਲੋਭ ਕੈ ਫੰਧ ॥
transliteration: karano huto s naa keeo pario lobh kai pha(n)dh ||
english: You have not done what you should have done; you are entangled in the web of greed.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਿਓ ਰਮਿ ਗਇਓ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਰੋਵਤ ਅੰਧ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak samio ram gaio ab kiu rovat a(n)dh ||36||
english: Nanak, your time is past and gone; why are you crying now, you blind fool? ||36||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਰਮਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: man maaiaa mai ram rahio nikasat naahin meet ||
english: The mind is absorbed in Maya - it cannot escape it, my friend.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਿਉ ਛਾਡਿਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਭੀਤਿ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak moorat chitr jiu chhaadit naahin bheet ||37||
english: Nanak, it is like a picture painted on the wall - it cannot leave it. ||37||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਚਾਹਤ ਕਛੁ ਅਉਰ ਅਉਰੈ ਕੀ ਅਉਰੈ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: nar chaahat kachh aur aurai kee aurai bhaee ||
english: The man wishes for something, but something different happens.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਠਗਉਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਾਸੀ ਗਲਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: chitavat rahio thagaur naanak phaasee gal paree ||38||
english: He plots to deceive others, O Nanak, but he places the noose around his own neck instead. ||38||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਕੀਓ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jatan bahut sukh ke keee dukh ko keeo na koi ||
english: People make all sorts of efforts to find peace and pleasure, but no one tries to earn pain.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun re manaa har bhaavai so hoi ||39||
english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: whatever pleases God comes to pass. ||39||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jagat bhikhaaree phirat hai sabh ko daataa raam ||
english: The world wanders around begging, but the Lord is the Giver of all.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਤਿਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak man simar tih pooran hovahi kaam ||40||
english: Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance on Him, and all your works will be successful. ||40||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jhoothai maan kahaa karai jag supane jiu jaan ||
english: Why do you take such false pride in yourself? You must know that the world is just a dream.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਿਓ ਬਖਾਨਿ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: in mai kachh tero nahee naanak kahio bakhaan ||41||
english: None of this is yours; Nanak proclaims this truth. ||41||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਕੋ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: garab karat hai deh ko binasai chhin mai meet ||
english: You are so proud of your body; it shall perish in an instant, my friend.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: jihi praanee har jas kahio naanak tihi jag jeet ||42||
english: That mortal who chants the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, conquers the world. ||42||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jih ghat simaran raam ko so nar mukataa jaan ||
english: That person, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord in his heart, is liberated - know this well.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹਿ ਨਰ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: tihi nar har a(n)tar nahee naanak saachee maan ||43||
english: There is no difference between that person and the Lord: O Nanak, accept this as the Truth. ||43||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ek bhagat bhagavaan jih praanee kai naahi man ||
english: That person, who does not feel devotion to God in his mind

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਕਰ ਸੁਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਤਨੁ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: jaise sookar suaan naanak maano taahi tan ||44||
english: - O Nanak, know that his body is like that of a pig, or a dog. ||44||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਤਜਤ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਤ ॥
transliteration: suaamee ko grihu jiu sadaa suaan tajat nahee nit ||
english: A dog never abandons the home of his master.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਉ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੁਇ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: naanak ih bidh har bhajau ik man hui ik chit ||45||
english: O Nanak, in just the same way, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord, single-mindedly, with one-pointed consciousness. ||45||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਅਰੁ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਧਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teerath barat ar daan kar man mai dharai gumaan ||
english: Those who make pilgrimages to sacred shrines, observe ritualistic fasts and make donations to charity while still taking pride in their minds

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਾਤ ਤਿਹ ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak nihaphal jaat tih jiu ku(n)char isanaan ||46||
english: - O Nanak, their actions are useless, like the elephant, who takes a bath, and then rolls in the dust. ||46||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਕੰਪਿਓ ਪਗ ਡਗਮਗੇ ਨੈਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
transliteration: sir ka(n)pio pag dagamage nain jot te heen ||
english: The head shakes, the feet stagger, and the eyes become dull and weak.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਈ ਤਊ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਨ ॥੪੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh bhaee taoo na har ras leen ||47||
english: Says Nanak, this is your condition. And even now, you have not savored the sublime essence of the Lord. ||47||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nij kar dekhio jagat mai ko kaahoo ko naahi ||
english: I had looked upon the world as my own, but no one belongs to anyone else.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਖੋ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੪੮॥
transliteration: naanak thir har bhagat hai tih raakho man maahi ||48||
english: O Nanak, only devotional worship of the Lord is permanent; enshrine this in your mind. ||48||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਭ ਝੂਠ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: jag rachanaa sabh jhooth hai jaan lehu re meet ||
english: The world and its affairs are totally false; know this well, my friend.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥੪੯॥
transliteration: kahi naanak thir naa rahai jiu baaloo kee bheet ||49||
english: Says Nanak, it is like a wall of sand; it shall not endure. ||49||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਗਇਓ ਰਾਵਨੁ ਗਇਓ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam gaio raavan gaio jaa kau bahu paravaar ||
english: Raam Chand passed away, as did Raawan, even though he had lots of relatives.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak thir kachh nahee supane jiu sa(n)saar ||50||
english: Says Nanak, nothing lasts forever; the world is like a dream. ||50||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜੋ ਅਨਹੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa taa kee keejeeai jo anahonee hoi ||
english: People become anxious, when something unexpected happens.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
transliteration: ihu maarag sa(n)saar ko naanak thir nahee koi ||51||
english: This is the way of the world, O Nanak; nothing is stable or permanent. ||51||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ ਪਰੋ ਆਜੁ ਕੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jo upajio so binas hai paro aaj kai kaal ||
english: Whatever has been created shall be destroyed; everyone shall perish, today or tomorrow.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਲੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak har gun gaai le chhaad sagal ja(n)jaal ||52||
english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and give up all other entanglements. ||52||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: doharaa ||
english: Dohraa:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਛੁਟਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bal chhutakio ba(n)dhan pare kachhoo na hot upaai ||
english: My strength is exhausted, and I am in bondage; I cannot do anything at all.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਬ ਓਟ ਹਰਿ ਗਜ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੫੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ab ot har gaj jiu hohu sahaai ||53||
english: Says Nanak, now, the Lord is my Support; He will help me, as He did the elephant. ||53||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bal hoaa ba(n)dhan chhute sabh kichh hot upaai ||
english: My strength has been restored, and my bonds have been broken; now, I can do everything.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥ ਮੈ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੫੪॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kichh tumarai haath mai tum hee hot sahaai ||54||
english: Nanak: everything is in Your hands, Lord; You are my Helper and Support. ||54||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗ ਸਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਨਿਬਹਿਓ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sakhaa sabh taj gae kooo na nibahio saath ||
english: My associates and companions have all deserted me; no one remains with me.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ॥੫੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ih bipat mai tek ek raghunaath ||55||
english: Says Nanak, in this tragedy, the Lord alone is my Support. ||55||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਹਿਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: naam rahio saadhoo rahio rahio gur gobi(n)d ||
english: The Naam remains; the Holy Saints remain; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, remains.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਕਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੫੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ih jagat mai kin japio gur ma(n)t ||56||
english: Says Nanak, how rare are those who chant the Guru's Mantra in this world. ||56||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਮੈ ਗਹਿਓ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ur mai gahio jaa kai sam nahee koi ||
english: I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart; there is nothing equal to it.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਿਟੈ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੭॥੧॥
transliteration: jih simarat sa(n)kat mitai daras tuhaaro hoi ||57||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on it, my troubles are taken away; I have received the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||57||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦਾਵਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)daavanee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Mundaavanee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਥਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿੰਨਿ ਵਸਤੂ ਪਈਓ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: thaal vich ti(n)n vasatoo paeeo sat sa(n)tokh veechaaro ||
english: Upon this Plate, three things have been placed: Truth, Contentment and Contemplation.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਪਇਓ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam thaakur kaa paio jis kaa sabhas adhaaro ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of our Lord and Master, has been placed upon it as well; it is the Support of all.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: je ko khaavai je ko bhu(n)chai tis kaa hoi udhaaro ||
english: One who eats it and enjoys it shall be saved.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵਸਤੁ ਤਜੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਖੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: eh vasat tajee nah jaaee nit nit rakh ur dhaaro ||
english: This thing can never be forsaken; keep this always and forever in your mind.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਮ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਚਰਨ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tam sa(n)saar charan lag tareeai sabh naanak braham pasaaro ||1||
english: The dark world-ocean is crossed over, by grasping the Feet of the Lord; O Nanak, it is all the extension of God. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਨੋ ਜੋਗੁ ਕੀਤੋਈ ॥
transliteration: teraa keetaa jaato naahee maino jog keetoee ||
english: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only You can make me worthy.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿਆਰੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਤਰਸੁ ਪਇਓਈ ॥
transliteration: mai niraguniaare ko gun naahee aape taras paioee ||
english: I am unworthy - I have no worth or virtues at all. You have taken pity on me.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਰਸੁ ਪਇਆ ਮਿਹਰਾਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: taras paiaa miharaamat hoee satigur sajan miliaa ||
english: You took pity on me, and blessed me with Your Mercy, and I have met the True Guru, my Friend.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai taa(n) jeevaa(n) tan man theevai hariaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, if I am blessed with the Naam, I live, and my body and mind blossom forth. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: raag maalaa ||
english: Raag Maalaa:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਏਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਪੰਚ ਬਰੰਗਨ ॥
transliteration: raag ek sa(n)g pa(n)ch bara(n)gan ||
english: Each Raga has five wives,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਅਲਾਪਹਿ ਆਠਉ ਨੰਦਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g alaapahi aathau na(n)dan ||
english: and eight sons, who emit distinctive notes.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਰਾਗ ਭੈਰਉ ਵੈ ਕਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: pratham raag bhairau vai karahee ||
english: In the first place is Raag Bhairao.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਚਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch raaganee sa(n)g ucharahee ||
english: It is accompanied by the voices of its five Raaginis:

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਭੈਰਵੀ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੀ ॥
transliteration: pratham bhairavee bilaavalee ||
english: First come Bhairavee, and Bilaavalee;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨਿਆਕੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਬੰਗਲੀ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)niaakee gaavahi ba(n)galee ||
english: then the songs of Punni-aakee and Bangalee;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਅਸਲੇਖੀ ਕੀ ਭਈ ਬਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pun asalekhee kee bhaee baaree ||
english: and then Asalaykhee.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਏ ਭੈਰਉ ਕੀ ਪਾਚਉ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: e bhairau kee paachau naaree ||
english: These are the five consorts of Bhairao.

author: Poet Alam
