gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਮ ਹਰਖ ਦਿਸਾਖ ਸੁਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)cham harakh disaakh sunaavahi ||
english: The sounds of Pancham, Harakh and Disaakh;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਬੰਗਾਲਮ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਧਵ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ba(n)gaalam madh maadhav gaavahi ||1||
english: the songs of Bangaalam, Madh and Maadhav. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਲਲਤ ਬਿਲਾਵਲ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: lalat bilaaval gaavahee apunee apunee bhaa(n)t ||
english: Lalat and Bilaaval - each gives out its own melody.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭੈਰਵ ਕੇ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਇਨ ਪਾਤ੍ਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asat putr bhairav ke gaavahi gaain paatr ||1||
english: when these eight sons of Bhairao are sung by accomplished musicians. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਮਾਲਕਉਸਕ ਆਲਾਪਹਿ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa maalakausak aalaapahi ||
english: In the second family is Maalakausak,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਪਾਚਉ ਥਾਪਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g raaganee paachau thaapahi ||
english: who brings his five Raaginis:

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡਕਰੀ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: go(n)dakaree ar devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Gondakaree and Dayv Gandhaaree,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਸੀਹੁਤੀ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)dhaaree seehutee uchaaree ||
english: the voices of Gandhaaree and Seehutee,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਏ ਪਾਚਉ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree e paachau gaaee ||
english: and the fifth song of Dhanaasaree.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲ ਰਾਗ ਕਉਸਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maal raag kausak sa(n)g laaee ||
english: This chain of Maalakausak brings along :

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਸਤਅੰਗ ਮੇਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaroo masataa(n)g mevaaraa ||
english: Maaroo, Masta-ang and Mayvaaraa,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਬਲਚੰਡ ਕਉਸਕ ਉਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabalacha(n)d kausak ubhaaraa ||
english: Prabal, Chandakausak,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਖਉਖਟ ਅਉ ਭਉਰਾਨਦ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: khaukhat au bhauraanad gaae ||
english: Khau, Khat and Bauraanad singing.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਮਾਲਕਉਸਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asat maalakausak sa(n)g laae ||1||
english: These are the eight sons of Maalakausak. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਆਇਅਉ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਟ ਸੁਤ ॥
transliteration: pun aaiau hi(n)dol pa(n)ch naar sa(n)g asat sut ||
english: Then comes Hindol with his five wives and eight sons;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਉਠਹਿ ਤਾਨ ਕਲੋਲ ਗਾਇਨ ਤਾਰ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: uthahi taan kalol gaain taar milaavahee ||1||
english: it rises in waves when the sweet-voiced chorus sings. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਤੇਲੰਗੀ ਦੇਵਕਰੀ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: tela(n)gee devakaree aaee ||
english: There come Taylangee and Darvakaree;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੀ ਸੰਦੂਰ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)tee sa(n)door suhaaee ||
english: Basantee and Sandoor follow;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸਰਸ ਅਹੀਰੀ ਲੈ ਭਾਰਜਾ ॥
transliteration: saras aheeree lai bhaarajaa ||
english: then Aheeree, the finest of women.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਆਰਜਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g laaee paa(n)chau aarajaa ||
english: These five wives come together.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਭਾਸਕਰ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: suramaana(n)d bhaasakar aae ||
english: The sons: Surmaanand and Bhaaskar come,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ੍ਰਬਿੰਬ ਮੰਗਲਨ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)drabi(n)b ma(n)galan suhaae ||
english: Chandrabinb and Mangalan follow.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸਰਸਬਾਨ ਅਉ ਆਹਿ ਬਿਨੋਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sarasabaan au aahi binodaa ||
english: Sarasbaan and Binodaa then come,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਰਸ ਬਸੰਤ ਕਮੋਦਾ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi saras basa(n)t kamodaa ||
english: and the thrilling songs of Basant and Kamodaa.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਕਹੇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: asat putr mai kahe savaaree ||
english: These are the eight sons I have listed.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਆਈ ਦੀਪਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pun aaee deepak kee baaree ||1||
english: Then comes the turn of Deepak. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਕਛੇਲੀ ਪਟਮੰਜਰੀ ਟੋਡੀ ਕਹੀ ਅਲਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: kachhelee patama(n)jaree todee kahee alaap ||
english: Kachhaylee, Patamanjaree and Todee are sung;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੋਦੀ ਅਉ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਕੇ ਥਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaamodee au goojaree sa(n)g deepak ke thaap ||1||
english: Kaamodee and Goojaree accompany Deepak. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੰਕਾ ਕੁੰਤਲ ਅਉ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kaala(n)kaa ku(n)tal au raamaa ||
english: Kaalankaa, Kuntal and Raamaa,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲਕੁਸਮ ਚੰਪਕ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kamalakusam cha(n)pak ke naamaa ||
english: Kamalakusam and Champak are their names;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਗਉਰਾ ਅਉ ਕਾਨਰਾ ਕਲੵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gauraa au kaanaraa kalyaanaa ||
english: Gauraa, Kaanaraa and Kaylaanaa;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਕੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asat putr deepak ke jaanaa ||1||
english: these are the eight sons of Deepak. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਵੈ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh mil sireeraag vai gaavahi ||
english: All join together and sing Siree Raag,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਰੰਗਨ ਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)chau sa(n)g bara(n)gan laavahi ||
english: which is accompanied by its five wives.:

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾਰੀ ਕਰਨਾਟੀ ਧਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bairaaree karanaatee dharee ||
english: Bairaaree and Karnaatee,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਗਵਰੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gavaree gaavahi aasaavaree ||
english: the songs of Gawree and Aasaavaree;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਪਾਛੈ ਸਿੰਧਵੀ ਅਲਾਪੀ ॥
transliteration: tih paachhai si(n)dhavee alaapee ||
english: then follows Sindhavee.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਥਾਪੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sireeraag siu paa(n)chau thaapee ||1||
english: These are the five wives of Siree Raag. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲੂ ਸਾਰਗ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਅਉਰ ਗੋਂਡ ਗੰਭੀਰ ॥
transliteration: saaloo saarag saagaraa aur go(n)d ga(n)bheer ||
english: Saaloo, Saarang, Saagaraa, Gond and Gambheer

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਗੁੰਡ ਕੁੰਭ ਹਮੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asat putr sreeraag ke gu(n)d ku(n)bh hameer ||1||
english: - the eight sons of Siree Raag include Gund, Kumb and Hameer. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਖਸਟਮ ਮੇਘ ਰਾਗ ਵੈ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: khasatam megh raag vai gaavahi ||
english: In the sixth place, Maygh Raag is sung,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਰੰਗਨ ਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)chau sa(n)g bara(n)gan laavahi ||
english: with its five wives in accompaniment:

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਗੋਂਡ ਮਲਾਰੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sorath go(n)d malaaree dhunee ||
english: Sorat'h, Gond, and the melody of Malaaree;

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pun gaavahi aasaa gun gunee ||
english: then the harmonies of Aasaa are sung.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਊਚੈ ਸੁਰਿ ਸੂਹਉ ਪੁਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: oochai sur soohau pun keenee ||
english: And finally comes the high tone Soohau.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘ ਰਾਗ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਚੀਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: megh raag siu paa(n)chau cheenee ||1||
english: These are the five with Maygh Raag. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾਧਰ ਗਜਧਰ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bairaadhar gajadhar kedaaraa ||
english: Bairaadhar, Gajadhar, Kaydaaraa,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਜਬਲੀਧਰ ਨਟ ਅਉ ਜਲਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jabaleedhar nat au jaladhaaraa ||
english: Jabaleedhar, Nat and Jaladhaaraa.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਕਰ ਅਉ ਸਿਆਮਾ ॥
transliteration: pun gaavahi sa(n)kar au siaamaa ||
english: Then come the songs of Shankar and Shi-aamaa.

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘ ਰਾਗ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: megh raag putran ke naamaa ||1||
english: These are the names of the sons of Maygh Raag. ||1||

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਖਸਟ ਰਾਗ ਉਨਿ ਗਾਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਤੀਸ ॥
transliteration: khasat raag un gaae sa(n)g raaganee tees ||
english: So all together, they sing the six Raagas and the thirty Raaginis,

author: Poet Alam
gurmukhi: ਸਭੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਰਾਗੰਨ ਕੇ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਦਸ ਬੀਸ ॥੧॥੧॥
transliteration: sabhai putr raaga(n)n ke athaarah das bees ||1||1||
english: and all the forty-eight sons of the Raagas. ||1||1||
